name: account_account_tag_code
summary: Adds a short code field to accounting tags (account.account.tag), so tags can be looked up and referenced by a stable code instead of their translated name. The field appears on the tag record itself in the accounting configuration.

name: account_account_tag_code
summary: Adds a short code field to accounting tags (account.account.tag), so tags can be looked up and referenced by a stable code instead of their translated name. This variant also depends on account_usability, which adds usability tweaks to the accounting screens.

name: account_analytic_account_tag
summary: Brings back the Tags field on analytic accounts, so each analytic account can be labeled with one or more categories. It is a technical restoration of a feature removed in Odoo 11, and the tags show on the analytic account form in Accounting.

name: account_analytic_account_tag
summary: Brings back the Tags field on analytic accounts, so each analytic account can be labeled with one or more categories. It is a technical restoration of a feature removed in Odoo 11, and the tags show on the analytic account form in Accounting.

name: account_analytic_brand
summary: Connects the brand module to accounting, so the analytic distribution defined on a branded analytic distribution model is copied onto the journal items of account moves. Users see the distribution filled in automatically on accounting lines; it is a technical bridge between two modules.

name: account_analytic_distribution_manual
summary: Lets users pick a saved analytic distribution from a list on an invoice or bill line, instead of typing the analytic accounts each time. The saved distributions are set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytic Accounting > Manual Analytic Distributions, and the choice appears as a Manual Distribution field at the top of the line.

name: account_analytic_distribution_manual
summary: Lets users pick a saved analytic distribution from a list on an invoice or bill line, instead of typing the analytic accounts each time. The saved distributions are set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytic Accounting > Manual Analytic Distributions, and the choice appears as a Manual Distribution field at the top of the line.

name: account_analytic_distribution_manual_date
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to the saved manual analytic distributions, so a distribution only shows up for documents dated within its active period. The dates are set on the distribution under Manual Analytic Distributions in Invoicing configuration.

name: account_analytic_distribution_model_recalculate
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to analytic distribution models, plus a recalculate option that regenerates the analytic distribution on journal items created from a model. Settings are on the Analytic Distribution Models screen under Invoicing > Configuration.

name: account_analytic_distribution_model_recalculate
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to analytic distribution models, plus a recalculate option that regenerates the analytic distribution on journal items created from a model. This variant lets one journal item be linked to several distribution models at once. Settings are on the Analytic Distribution Models screen under Invoicing > Configuration.

name: account_analytic_distribution_widget_rebalance
summary: Adds a Rebalance button to the analytic distribution popup that adjusts one line's percentage so the total comes to exactly 100%. Users find it wherever they edit an analytic distribution on an invoice or bill line.

name: account_analytic_document_date
summary: Adds an Accrual Date to invoices and bank statement lines, so income and expenses can be dated to the period they were earned or incurred rather than the invoice date. If left empty, it defaults to the invoice date on confirmation, and the analytic entries inherit it.

name: account_analytic_line_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a Commercial Entity field to analytic items, so they can be grouped by the customer or vendor's commercial entity. Users group Analytic Items by Commercial Entity under Invoicing > Accounting > Analytic Items.

name: account_analytic_line_name_text
summary: Technical change: the name of analytic lines becomes a multi-line Text field instead of a single-line text box, so longer descriptions fit. It only changes the Description field on analytic items.

name: account_analytic_maintenance
summary: Adds an Analytic Distribution to maintenance equipment, so each piece of equipment carries its cost allocation. Other modules can reuse that distribution when they create accounting, purchase, or inventory documents. It is set on the equipment form under Maintenance > Equipment.

name: account_analytic_organization
summary: Adds an Analytic Organization field on contacts, which is copied onto invoice lines and analytic items. That lets you filter and group analytic reporting by the organization a customer or vendor belongs to. It is set on the contact form under Contacts, and the value flows through when an invoice is validated.

name: account_analytic_organization
summary: Adds an Analytic Organization field on contacts, which is copied onto invoice lines and analytic items. That lets you filter and group analytic reporting by the organization a customer or vendor belongs to. It is set on the contact form under Contacts, and the value flows through when an invoice is validated.

name: account_analytic_parent
summary: Restores the parent and child hierarchy on analytic accounts, as in older Odoo versions, so accounts can be nested under other accounts. It also adds a computed Level field showing each account's depth, and it is the base for other hierarchy-based analytic modules. Turn on analytic accounting in Accounting settings first.

name: account_analytic_parent
summary: Restores the parent and child hierarchy on analytic accounts, as in older Odoo versions, so accounts can be nested under other accounts. It is the base for other hierarchy-based analytic modules. Turn on analytic accounting in Accounting settings first.

name: account_analytic_parent
summary: Restores the parent and child hierarchy on analytic accounts, as in older Odoo versions, so accounts can be nested under other accounts. It is the base for other hierarchy-based analytic modules. Turn on analytic accounting in Accounting settings first.

name: account_analytic_parent_plan_restrict
summary: Forces every account in a parent and child analytic hierarchy to belong to the same analytic plan, so one tree cannot span several plans. It is a technical rule on top of account_analytic_parent, with no new screens.

name: account_analytic_required
summary: Adds an Analytic Policy setting to accounts with four options: Always, Never, Posted moves, or Optional. Set it on the account under Accounting > Configuration > Chart of Accounts, and with Always, Odoo blocks journal lines on that account that have no analytic account.

name: account_analytic_required
summary: Adds an Analytic Policy setting to accounts with four options: Always, Never, Posted moves, or Optional. Set it on the account under Accounting > Configuration > Chart of Accounts, and with Always, Odoo blocks journal lines on that account that have no analytic account.

name: account_analytic_required
summary: Adds an Analytic Policy setting to accounts with four options: Always, Never, Posted moves, or Optional. Set it on the account under Accounting > Configuration > Chart of Accounts, and with Always, Odoo blocks journal lines on that account that have no analytic account.

name: account_analytic_root
summary: Computes a Root Analytic Account for each analytic account, meaning the top parent of its hierarchy, so reports can group accounts by their top-level business line. It is a reporting aid for accounts organized in a tree, and the root appears as a field on analytic accounts.

name: account_analytic_sequence
summary: Restores the Code field on analytic accounts, which is a sequence-style reference for each account. It is a small technical restoration of a field from earlier Odoo versions.

name: account_analytic_spread_by_tag
summary: Splits the amount of an accounting entry across all analytic accounts that share an analytic tag marked to spread. This lets a cost on an invoice line be shared across projects or departments through tags, with filters that include or exclude accounts. The tag settings are under Accounting > Configuration > Analytic Accounting > Analytic Tags.

name: account_analytic_tag
summary: Brings back analytic tags, labels attached to invoice lines and analytic entries to categorize them, for example by project or channel. Tags are created under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytical accounting > Analytic Tags and are copied onto the analytic entries when the invoice is posted.

name: account_analytic_tag
summary: Brings back analytic tags, labels attached to invoice lines and analytic entries to categorize them, for example by project or channel. Tags are created under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytical accounting > Analytic Tags and are copied onto the analytic entries when the invoice is posted.

name: account_analytic_tag_distribution
summary: Lets you define an analytic distribution on an analytic tag, so that using the tag on an invoice line creates analytic entries split according to that distribution. It is enabled with the Analytic Distribution checkbox on the tag form.

name: account_asset_batch_compute
summary: Adds a batch option to the Compute Assets wizard, so depreciation for many assets is processed as a background job through queue_job rather than in one go. It is used from the asset depreciation wizard in Accounting.

name: account_asset_compute_batch
summary: Adds Compute Depreciation Batch records that track each depreciation run: a name, the asset profiles included, an end date, and a per-profile amount report. The Compute Assets wizard gets a Create Batch option, and a batch can be delayed so it posts later.

name: account_asset_force_account
summary: Lets you override the asset, depreciation, and depreciation expense accounts directly on an asset form, instead of relying only on the defaults from the asset profile. The fields appear on the Asset form in Accounting.

name: account_asset_force_account
summary: Lets you enforce specific asset, depreciation, and depreciation expense accounts on each asset, through its asset profile or directly on the asset form. The accounts flow from the vendor bill line that created the asset, so the asset ends up posted to the chosen accounts.

name: account_asset_low_value
summary: Handles low-value items that were bought as an expense but tracked as assets. These assets have no residual value and no depreciation, and removing one only changes its status without an accounting entry. Create them from an asset profile with the Expense account and zero years, and the Low Value Asset flag appears on the asset.

name: account_asset_low_value
summary: Handles low-value items that were bought as an expense but tracked as assets. These assets have no residual value and no depreciation, and removing one only changes its status without an accounting entry. Create them from an asset profile with the Expense account and zero years, and the Low Value Asset flag appears on the asset.

name: account_asset_management
summary: Full fixed asset register: tracks company assets from purchase to removal, computes depreciation schedules, and creates the depreciation journal entries, either by hand or through the Compute Assets wizard or a scheduled job. It also adds asset groups, asset profiles, a removal wizard, and an asset analysis report. It replaces the standard Odoo asset module and is not compatible with it, and it lives under Accounting > Assets.

name: account_asset_management
summary: Full fixed asset register: tracks company assets from purchase to removal, computes depreciation schedules, and creates the depreciation journal entries, either by hand or through the Compute Assets wizard or a scheduled job. It also adds asset groups, asset profiles, a removal wizard, and an asset analysis report. It replaces the standard Odoo asset module and is not compatible with it, and it lives under Accounting > Assets.

name: account_asset_management_stock_lot
summary: Links a lot or serial number from inventory to an asset, for assets that are also managed as stock items. The product and lot appear on the asset form and the asset is reachable from the lot record.

name: account_asset_management_stock_lot
summary: Links a lot or serial number from inventory to an asset, for assets that are also managed as stock items. The product and lot appear on the asset form and the asset is reachable from the lot record.

name: account_asset_number
summary: Adds an Asset Number to each asset as its reference, which can be generated automatically from a sequence set on the asset profile. When auto-numbering is on, the number cannot be edited on that profile's assets. It is configured under Invoicing > Configuration > Asset Profile.

name: account_asset_number
summary: Adds an Asset Number to each asset as its reference, which can be generated automatically from a sequence set on the asset profile. When auto-numbering is on, the number cannot be edited on that profile's assets. It is configured under Invoicing > Configuration > Asset Profile.

name: account_asset_transfer
summary: Moves the cost of assets under construction (AUC) into finished assets. From the asset list, select the assets to transfer, pick the new profile in the transfer wizard, and Odoo posts a journal entry and creates the new assets. The transfer journal is set on the asset profile.
keywords: move asset cost to new asset

name: account_asset_transfer
summary: Moves the cost of assets under construction (AUC) into finished assets. From the asset list, select the assets to transfer, pick the new profile in the transfer wizard, and Odoo posts a journal entry and creates the new assets. The transfer journal is set on the asset profile.
keywords: move asset cost to new asset

name: account_avatax_exemption
summary: Connector piece for Avalara AvaTax sales tax exemptions in the US. It sends customer exemption certificates and nexus-region rules to AvaTax, and sends product tax codes too. Exemptions are managed on customer records and the exemption code rules appear under the AvaTax configuration.

name: account_avatax_exemption
summary: Connector piece for Avalara AvaTax sales tax exemptions in the US. It sends customer exemption certificates and nexus-region rules to AvaTax, and sends product tax codes too. Exemptions are managed on customer records and the exemption code rules appear under the AvaTax configuration.

name: account_avatax_exemption_base
summary: Base layer for AvaTax exemptions: adds the exemption records on customers, exemption types, activity types, groups of states, and per-exemption certificate lines. It is a technical anchor module that the full exemption connector builds on, and it has no separate screen of its own beyond the customer's exemptions.

name: account_avatax_exemption_base
summary: Base layer for AvaTax exemptions: adds the exemption records on customers, exemption types, activity types, groups of states, and per-exemption certificate lines. It is a technical anchor module that the full exemption connector builds on, and it has no separate screen of its own beyond the customer's exemptions.

name: account_avatax_oca
summary: Connector that calculates US and Canadian sales tax through the Avalara AvaTax service on customer invoices, using the warehouse and customer address. Each validated invoice is committed to the AvaTax account, and the AvaTax configuration, tax codes, and address validation are set up under Accounting settings. Note that its module names clash with Odoo Enterprise's built-in Avatax modules.

name: account_avatax_oca
summary: Connector that calculates US and Canadian sales tax through the Avalara AvaTax service on customer invoices, using the warehouse and customer address. Each validated invoice is committed to the AvaTax account, and the AvaTax configuration, tax codes, and address validation are set up under Accounting settings. This version's description notes Avalara certification is pending.

name: account_avatax_oca_log
summary: Keeps a log of every API call made to AvaTax, storing the request and response, and can notify users once a call counter reaches a limit. Logs are viewed from the Avatax log menu.

name: account_avatax_repair_oca
summary: Adds AvaTax sales tax to Repair Orders, so tax is computed when a repair is saved and carried to the invoice. Repair tax lines and request logs appear on the repair order form.

name: account_avatax_sale_oca
summary: Adds AvaTax sales tax calculation to Sales Orders, so tax is computed when the order is saved and carried through to the invoice. Discounts are handled, and the order shows the AvaTax tax amount, exemption code, and shipping address-based tax options.

name: account_avatax_website_sale
summary: Recalculates AvaTax sales tax during the online shop checkout, just before payment, so the customer sees the correct tax for their address. It only runs on e-commerce sales orders through the website checkout.

name: account_bank_statement_cascade_delete
summary: When a bank statement is deleted, its statement lines are deleted with it, instead of being left behind as separate journal entries. This is useful for cleaning up a wrongly imported statement completely. It is done from the journal's Operations > Statements list using Action > Delete.

name: account_bank_statement_chatter
summary: Adds the chatter (messages and attachments log) to bank statements, so notes and files can be kept on each statement. Open it from a bank or cash journal's bank statements list.

name: account_bank_statement_chatter
summary: Adds the chatter (messages and attachments log) to bank statements, so notes and files can be kept on each statement. Open it from a bank or cash journal's bank statements list.

name: account_banking_ach_base
summary: Technical base for US ACH payments: adds a Routing Number on banks, Legal ID on partners and the company, a Mandate URL on the company, and a delay-days field on mandates. Nothing is exported by this module alone; it is the prerequisite for the ACH credit transfer and direct debit file modules.

name: account_banking_ach_base
summary: Technical base for US ACH payments: adds a Routing Number on banks, Legal ID on partners and the company, a Mandate URL on the company, and a delay-days field on mandates. Nothing is exported by this module alone; it is the prerequisite for the ACH credit transfer and direct debit file modules.

name: account_banking_ach_credit_transfer
summary: Creates ACH files in Nacha format for outgoing credit transfers, so US vendor payments in a payment order can be sent to the bank as a file. Set it up with a payment mode using the ACH method, and the company Legal ID and bank routing number must be filled in.

name: account_banking_ach_direct_debit
summary: Creates ACH files in Nacha format for direct debit orders, so US customer collections can be sent to the bank as a file. Debit orders are created under Accounting > Customers > Debit Order using an ACH payment mode.

name: account_banking_international_credit_transfer
summary: Creates PAIN.001 XML payment files for international credit transfers, so a payment order to foreign beneficiaries can be uploaded to the bank. Set up a payment mode with the International Credit Transfer method, and it is created under Vendors > Payment Orders. Intermediary bank can be set on the partner bank account.

name: account_banking_mandate
summary: Adds banking mandates, the signed authorization a customer gives a company to debit their bank account. Mandates are stored on the bank account with a signature date, scan, and status, and are attached to invoices and payment lines. Set them up from the accounting menu or from a bank account on the contact.

name: account_banking_mandate
summary: Adds banking mandates, the signed authorization a customer gives a company to collect direct debits from their bank account. Mandates are stored on bank accounts and linked to customer invoices, debit orders and payments, and can be managed from Accounting or from the bank account itself. Debit orders are found under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders.

name: account_banking_mandate_contact
summary: Lets you pick a specific banking mandate, and so a specific bank account, on a contact, so debit orders for that contact's invoices use that mandate. The Contact Mandate field is on the contact form under Invoicing > Customers.

name: account_banking_mandate_contact
summary: Lets you choose a specific banking mandate, and therefore a specific bank account, on a contact. When a debit order is made for that contact's invoices, the chosen mandate is used. It is set on the Sales & Purchase tab of a contact, typically a child contact.

name: account_banking_mandate_sale
summary: Adds a Direct Debit Mandate field on sales orders. When a payment mode that requires a mandate is picked, the customer's first valid mandate is selected by default. The mandate is then copied from the sales order to the invoice.

name: account_banking_mandate_sale_contact
summary: Combines the sales mandate and contact mandate features, so the mandate chosen on a customer's contact is used on sales orders and copied to invoices. A company setting decides whether the default mandate comes from the sale partner, the invoice address or the delivery address. A customer's contact mandate is set on its Sales & Purchase tab.

name: account_banking_pain_base
summary: Technical base module with the shared fields and logic for SEPA payment files in the PAIN format. It adds initiating party identifiers and PAIN settings to payment modes, payment methods, payment orders and the company. It has no screens of its own, and the SEPA credit transfer and direct debit modules build on it.

name: account_banking_pain_base
summary: Hidden technical base for SEPA and PAIN bank payment files. It holds the initiating party identifiers and payment line options used by the SEPA credit transfer and direct debit file modules, and it has no screens of its own. The identifiers are set under Invoicing/Accounting > Configuration > Settings in the SEPA/PAIN section.

name: account_banking_sepa_credit_transfer
summary: Exports payment orders to SEPA credit transfer XML files (PAIN 001), used to send supplier payments to the bank in one file. Create a payment mode for SEPA credit transfer, choose the PAIN version, and create a payment order under Invoicing > Vendors > Payment Orders. The XML file is then generated for upload to the bank.

name: account_banking_sepa_credit_transfer
summary: Creates SEPA XML files (PAIN.001) for euro bank transfers, so a payment order to suppliers can be uploaded to the bank in one file. Set it up with a SEPA Credit Transfer payment mode under Vendors > Payment Orders, and check that the payment method uses the right PAIN version for your bank.

name: account_banking_sepa_direct_debit
summary: Creates SEPA direct debit XML files (PAIN.008) so customer collections in euros can be sent to the bank in one file. Debit orders are created under Invoicing/Accounting > Customers > Debit Order, using a SEPA Direct Debit payment mode with the creditor identifier set in settings.

name: account_banking_sepa_direct_debit
summary: Exports direct debit payment orders to SEPA direct debit XML files (PAIN 008), used to collect customer payments in bulk from their bank accounts. Set your SEPA creditor identifier in the invoicing settings, then create a debit order under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders. The XML file is generated for upload to the bank.

name: account_billing
summary: Lets you group several customer invoices into one Billing document, so the customer pays a single consolidated amount on a billing day instead of settling each invoice separately. Billings are created under Invoicing > Customers or Vendors > Billing, or from selected invoices with the Create Billing action on the invoice list.

name: account_billing
summary: Groups several customer or vendor invoices into one Billing document, issued once a month on a billing day, so the customer pays the consolidated amount the following month. Create billings from Invoicing > Customers or Vendors > Billing, or from selected invoices using the Create Billing action.

name: account_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to customer invoices and refunds, and shows the brand's information on the printed PDF. Brands are defined by the brand module, and the brand is chosen on the invoice in Accounting > Customers > Invoices.

name: account_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to customer invoices and refunds, and prints the brand's style and information on the PDF. Brands are defined by the brand module, and the brand is chosen on the invoice in Accounting > Customers > Invoices. The brand use level setting must be Optional or Required for the field to show.

name: account_budget_oca
summary: Adds budgets: planned amounts per analytic account, grouped under budgetary positions, with planned, practical, and theoretical amounts compared. Budgets are defined under Invoicing > Budgets, and three budget spreading reports are available.

name: account_budget_oca
summary: Adds budgets: planned amounts per analytic account, grouped under budgetary positions, with planned, practical, and theoretical amounts compared. Budgets are defined under Invoicing > Budgets, and three budget spreading reports are available.

name: account_cash_deposit
summary: Records cash deposits to the bank and cash orders from the bank. You enter the notes and coins by quantity for the deposit, and the bank notes and coin rolls are pre-set for several currencies. Create deposits under Invoicing > Accounting > Miscellaneous > Cash Deposits.

name: account_cash_deposit
summary: Records cash deposits to the bank and cash orders from the bank. You enter the notes and coins by quantity for the deposit, and the bank notes and coin rolls are pre-set for several currencies. Create deposits under Invoicing > Accounting > Miscellaneous > Cash Deposits.

name: account_cash_invoice
summary: Lets you pay or receive existing customer or vendor invoices and refunds directly from a cash journal's dashboard, without a bank statement line first. Requires developer mode and the Show Full Accounting Features user flag. Start from the cash journal dashboard and use the Pay Invoice button.

name: account_cash_invoice
summary: Lets you pay or receive existing customer or vendor invoices and refunds directly from a cash journal's dashboard, without a bank statement line first. Requires developer mode and the Show Full Accounting Features user flag. Start from the cash journal dashboard and use the Pay Invoice button.

name: account_chart_update
summary: Compares a company's chart of accounts with the chart template and lets you create or update accounts, taxes, tax codes, and fiscal positions that differ, for example after a tax reform. The wizard is under Accounting > Settings > Update Chart Template, and you can exclude individual records from the changes.

name: account_chart_update
summary: Compares a company's chart of accounts with the chart template and lets you create or update accounts, taxes, tax groups, and fiscal positions that differ, for example after a tax reform. The wizard is under Accounting > Settings > Update Chart Template, and you can exclude individual records from the changes.

name: account_chart_update_code_digits
summary: Lets the chart update wizard change the length of account codes, for example from 6 to 8 digits, when comparing the chart against its template. The new length is saved on the company as the default. It is found under Accounting > Settings > Update Chart Template.

name: account_chart_update_l10n_eu_oss
summary: Glue module that makes the chart update wizard skip EU OSS (One-Stop Shop) taxes, so they are not changed when the chart is updated. It only applies when the l10n_eu_oss module is also installed.

name: account_chart_update_l10n_eu_oss_oca
summary: Glue module that makes the chart update wizard skip EU OSS (One-Stop Shop) taxes when the chart is updated, using the OCA version of the OSS localization. Only relevant if the OCA OSS module is installed.

name: account_chart_update_l10n_eu_oss_oca
summary: Glue module that makes the chart update wizard skip EU OSS (One-Stop Shop) taxes when the chart is updated, using the OCA version of the OSS localization. Only relevant if the OCA OSS module is installed.

name: account_chart_update_multilang
summary: Makes the chart update wizard carry translated names of tax and fiscal position templates over to the company's actual taxes and fiscal positions. A technical add-on for multi-language charts, with no new screens.

name: account_check_deposit
summary: Manages paper checks received from customers: you pay an invoice with a Checks Received journal, then group the checks into a Check Deposit to send to the bank in one go. Deposits are created under Invoicing > Customers > Checks Deposits, and each deposit holds checks in one currency.

name: account_check_printing_report_base
summary: Adds the basic framework and a sample layout for printing paper checks from vendor payments, and lets a journal print checks automatically when a payment is validated. Print from Invoicing > Vendors > Payments, and choose the check layout in Invoicing settings. Specific check formats come from separate add-on modules.

name: account_check_printing_report_base
summary: Adds the basic framework and a sample layout for printing paper checks from vendor payments, and lets a journal print checks automatically when a payment is validated. Print from Invoicing > Vendors > Payments, and choose the check layout under company settings. Specific check formats come from separate add-on modules.

name: account_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to invoices, which can be typed directly on the invoice or loaded from a saved comment template. Comments can appear before or after the invoice lines on the printed document.

name: account_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to invoices, which can be typed directly on the invoice or loaded from a saved comment template. Comments can appear before or after the invoice lines on the printed document.

name: account_commission
summary: Calculates sales agent commissions on customer invoices, using the agents and rates set on the customer, and can create vendor bills from commission settlements for external agents. Commissions are settled when the invoice is issued or paid, and the commission total shows on the invoice.

name: account_commission
summary: Calculates sales agent commissions on customer invoices, using the agents and rates set on the customer, and can create vendor bills from commission settlements for external agents. It also adds a grouping by invoice to the grouped settlement report.

name: account_commission_oca
summary: OCA version of the invoice commission module: calculates sales agent commissions on customer invoices from the agents and rates set on the customer, and can create vendor bills from commission settlements for external agents. It builds on the OCA commission module.

name: account_credit_control
summary: Finds overdue customer balances above a tolerance and runs a reminder process: a credit control run generates lines per customer, which you can email, print as letters, or change state on. Policies with escalating levels set the delays and messages, and everything is found under Invoicing > Credit Control.

name: account_credit_control
summary: Helps accounting staff chase overdue customer payments. A Credit Control Run for a chosen date generates a follow-up line for each overdue invoice, based on policies with escalating levels such as e-mail or letter, and lines can be sent, printed or marked. Customers can have a payment promise and next action noted, under Invoicing, Credit Control.

name: account_credit_control_attach_invoice
summary: When a credit control summary, such as a reminder letter or email, is printed or sent, the detailed customer invoice report is merged into the same PDF so the customer sees the outstanding invoices. The invoice report to attach is chosen in the accounting settings. This needs the credit control module.

name: account_credit_control_dunning_fees
summary: Adds dunning fees to credit control reminders: a fixed fee, product, and currency can be set on each reminder level, and the fee is added to the reminder line and the summary report. The product is used for the tax on the fee.

name: account_credit_control_dunning_fees
summary: Adds dunning fees to credit control reminders: a fixed fee, product, and currency can be set on each reminder level, and the fee is added to the reminder line and the summary report. The product is used for the tax on the fee.

name: account_credit_control_queue_job
summary: Sends credit control emails as background jobs in batches, instead of all at once. The batch size is set in the accounting settings. This keeps large reminder runs from timing out.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_order_base
summary: Base for period-end accruals on orders: compares delivered or received quantities with invoiced quantities and generates accrued revenue or expense entries for the cutoff date. Cutoff lines update automatically until the entries are posted, and it is set up under Accounting cut-offs with analytic accounting enabled.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_order_stock_base
summary: Adds stock-based prepaid accounts to period-end accruals on orders, for storable goods in the accrued revenue and expense cutoffs. It is a technical extension used by the purchase and sales accrual modules and has no separate screen.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_purchase
summary: Accrues expenses on purchase orders at period end: goods or services received but not yet invoiced become accrued expense entries, and prepayments are shown separately. Orders forced to invoiced status are skipped, and the cutoff runs from Accounting > Cut-offs.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_purchase_stock
summary: Glue module that lets purchase order accruals use the quantities received in Inventory after the cutoff date, for storable products. It applies on top of the purchase accrual module and has no screens of its own.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_sale
summary: Accrues revenue on sales orders at period end: delivered or invoiced-later amounts become accrued revenue entries, and a scheduled job generates them at each period end. Orders forced to invoiced status are skipped, and the cutoff runs from Accounting > Cut-offs.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_sale_stock
summary: Glue module that lets sales order revenue accruals use the quantities delivered from Inventory after the cutoff date, for storable products. It applies on top of the sales accrual module and has no screens of its own.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_sale_stock_delivery
summary: Technical glue module that adds tests for the case where the Delivery module is used alongside the sales revenue accrual with stock. It changes no user-facing behavior.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_subscription
summary: Computes accrued expenses or revenues by comparing expected amounts, set up as subscriptions such as rent, internet, or insurance contracts, with the real amounts booked. Subscriptions are created under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Subscriptions, and the result feeds the period-end cut-off entries.

name: account_cutoff_accrual_subscription
summary: Computes accrued expenses or revenues by comparing expected amounts, set up as subscriptions such as rent, internet, or insurance contracts, with the real amounts booked. Subscriptions are created under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Subscriptions, and the result feeds the period-end cut-off entries.

name: account_cutoff_base
summary: Technical base for all cut-off modules: defines the cut-off documents, their lines, and the default cut-off journals and accounts. It gives no useful screen alone, but once other cut-off modules are installed, the settings appear under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings, and accrued tax accounts are set on taxes.

name: account_cutoff_base
summary: Technical base for all cut-off modules: defines the cut-off documents, their lines, and the default cut-off journals and accounts. It gives no useful screen alone, but once other cut-off modules are installed, the settings appear under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings, and accrued tax accounts are set on taxes.

name: account_cutoff_picking
summary: Generates accrued and prepaid expenses or revenues from receipts and deliveries: it finds purchase or sales lines where goods moved before the cut-off date but the invoice came later, and creates cut-off lines for them. The analysis window is set on the cut-off, and it is run with Re-Generate Lines on the cut-off document.

name: account_cutoff_picking
summary: Generates accrued and prepaid expenses or revenues from receipts and deliveries: it finds purchase or sales lines where goods moved before the cut-off date but the invoice came later, and creates cut-off lines for them. The analysis window is set on the cut-off, and it is run with Re-Generate Lines on the cut-off document.

name: account_cutoff_start_end_dates
summary: Computes prepaid and accrued amounts from the Start Date and End Date on invoice lines, so a yearly contract billed in April is split correctly across fiscal years. Cut-offs are created under Accounting > Cut-offs > Prepaid Revenue or the expense equivalents, with Re-Generate lines.

name: account_cutoff_start_end_dates
summary: Computes prepaid and accrued amounts from the Start Date and End Date on invoice lines, so a yearly contract billed in April is split correctly across fiscal years. Cut-offs are created under Accounting > Cut-offs > Prepaid Revenue or the expense equivalents, with Re-Generate lines.

name: account_dashboard_banner
summary: Adds a configurable banner across the top of the accounting dashboard, showing the lock dates and key figures such as income, liquidity, or overdue amounts. The cells are set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Dashboard > Dashboard Banner Cells, where you choose the type, order, and labels.

name: account_dashboard_banner_mis_builder
summary: Lets the accounting dashboard banner show KPIs from a MIS Builder report, so accountants can place any report figure on the dashboard. You add a cell of type MIS Builder KPI and pick the report, KPI, and period in the banner cell settings.

name: account_dms_field
summary: Adds a Documents tab to the customer and vendor journal entry form, so files can be attached and browsed from the document management system directly on the entry. The tab appears on the accounting move form.

name: account_due_list
summary: Adds a Payments and due list of every open receivable and payable, so you can see what customers owe and what you owe vendors, with all columns filterable. It is under Invoicing > Accounting > Payments and due list, and it needs the Show Full Accounting Features group.

name: account_due_list
summary: Adds a Payments and due list of every open receivable and payable, so you can see what customers owe and what you owe vendors, with all columns filterable. It is under Invoicing > Accounting > Payments and due list, and it needs the Show Full Accounting Features group.

name: account_due_list_aging_comment
summary: Adds an inline Aging Comments text field to each line of the Payments and due list, so collectors can note promises to pay or follow-up status next to an open item. It is found in Accounting > Payments and due list.

name: account_due_list_aging_comment
summary: Adds an inline Aging Comments text field to each line of the Payments and due list, so collectors can note promises to pay or follow-up status next to an open item. It is found in Accounting > Payments and due list.

name: account_due_list_days_overdue
summary: Adds a Days Overdue figure and overdue term columns, such as 1-30, 31-60, and 61+, to the Payments and due list, so aged receivables and payables are easy to read. The term buckets are defined under Invoicing > Configuration > Overdue Terms.

name: account_due_list_days_overdue
summary: Adds a Days Overdue figure and overdue term columns, such as 1-30, 31-60, and 61+, to the Payments and due list, so aged receivables and payables are easy to read. The term buckets are defined under Invoicing > Configuration > Overdue Terms.

name: account_due_list_payment_mode
summary: Adds the Payment Mode of each invoice to the Payments and due list, so you can see how each open item is expected to be paid. It is shown as a column in Invoicing > Accounting > Payments and due list.

name: account_due_list_payment_mode
summary: Adds the Payment Mode of each invoice to the Payments and due list, so you can see how each open item is expected to be paid. It is shown as a column in Invoicing > Accounting > Payments and due list.

name: account_ebitda_report
summary: Provides EBITDA financial reports built on MIS Builder, with three calculation methods (bottom-up, top-down, and an adjusted version for M&A), EBITDA margin, net debt to EBITDA, and a bridge from EBITDA to free cash flow. The report templates are under Accounting > Reporting > MIS Reporting > MIS Reports.

name: account_ecotax
summary: Adds French ecotax amounts to invoice lines and a total ecotax at the bottom of each document. Ecotax classifications, either fixed or weight-based, are set on products and can be combined per product. Classifications are set under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes > Ecotax Classification, and the ecotax is included in the product price and income account.

name: account_ecotax
summary: Adds French ecotax amounts to invoice lines and a total ecotax at the bottom of each document. Ecotax classifications, either fixed or weight-based, are set on products and can be combined per product. Classifications are set under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes > Ecotax Classification, and the ecotax is included in the product price and income account.

name: account_ecotax
summary: Adds French ecotax amounts to invoice lines and a total ecotax at the bottom of each document. Ecotax classifications, either fixed or weight-based, are set on products and can be combined per product. Classifications are set under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes > Ecotax Classification, and the ecotax is included in the product price and income account.

name: account_ecotax_report
summary: Adds reporting fields and a pivot and list analysis of ecotax lines, to help prepare the ecotax declaration. The analysis is under Accounting > Reporting > Management > Ecotax Line Analysis, and it needs ecotax set up on products first.

name: account_ecotax_sale
summary: Extends French ecotax to sales orders: ecotax lines and the ecotax total appear on each sale order line and the order total, using the product classifications. Configured through the base ecotax module.

name: account_ecotax_sale
summary: Extends French ecotax to sales orders: ecotax lines and the ecotax total appear on each sale order line and the order total, using the product classifications. Configured through the base ecotax module.

name: account_ecotax_sale
summary: Extends French ecotax to sales orders: ecotax lines and the ecotax total appear on each sale order line and the order total, using the product classifications. Configured through the base ecotax module.

name: account_ecotax_sale_tax
summary: Extends sales-order ecotax so that it is handled as a tax, with the tax-based treatment of ecotax on sale order lines. It is a technical add-on that requires the ecotax-as-tax module and has no separate screens.

name: account_ecotax_tax
summary: Computes ecotax through Odoo's own tax engine instead of the built-in ecotax fields, so ecotax can be shown as included or excluded from the product price and posted to its own accounting account. Set up with a tax group and Fixed or Weight-Based Ecotax taxes using Python formulas. The ecotax then does not count as turnover.

name: account_ecotax_tax
summary: Computes ecotax through Odoo's own tax engine instead of the built-in ecotax fields, so ecotax can be shown as included or excluded from the product price and posted to its own accounting account. Set up with a tax group and Fixed or Weight-Based Ecotax taxes using Python formulas. The ecotax then does not count as turnover.

name: account_edi_no_autocreate_partner
summary: Stops the EDI invoice import from creating new partners when a supplier cannot be matched. Unmatched invoices are assigned to a protected Partner Not Found contact, so someone can review and correct the partner before posting the bill.

name: account_edi_no_product_name_match
summary: Turns off matching of products by name when importing EDI invoices, so products are matched only by explicit identifiers such as vendor references, barcodes, or internal codes. It affects the EDI import of vendor bills.

name: account_edi_retrieve_partner
summary: Makes EDI invoice import link the vendor bill to the commercial partner (the main company), rather than a child contact that the import may pick first. Affects the vendor bills created by EDI import.

name: account_edi_retrieve_partner_from_purchase_order
summary: When a UBL vendor bill references a purchase order, takes the vendor from that purchase order during import. It is a technical rule on the UBL import and works only when the purchase module is installed.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_additional_document
summary: When a UBL or CII vendor bill is imported, attaches every file the supplier included, not only PDFs, such as spreadsheets, CSVs, and images, to the generated vendor bill. The extra files show as attachments on the bill.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_check_total
summary: When a UBL vendor bill is imported, fills the supplier Check Total with the tax-inclusive total from the XML file, so you can compare it to the total Odoo computes. The check total sits on the vendor bill form.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_invoice_line_name_enhance
summary: When a UBL or CII vendor bill is imported, adds the product name to each invoice line label if it is not already in the description, so lines are easier to read. Affects imported vendor bill lines.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_payment_unece
summary: Reads and writes UNECE payment means codes in UBL and CII e-invoices. On outgoing invoices, the code is taken from the payment method, such as SEPA direct debit, and on incoming ones an outbound payment means is set from it so you know not to pay manually. It needs the UNECE payment means data module.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_payment_unece
summary: Reads and writes UNECE payment means codes in UBL and CII e-invoices. On incoming invoices declared with SEPA direct debit, an outbound payment means is set so the bill shows it does not need paying. It needs the UNECE payment means data module and the payment partner module.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_purchase_match
summary: On UBL vendor bill import, finds the matching purchase order from the order reference and links each bill line to the right purchase order line, using product name and supplier product name. Mismatches are flagged on the bill, and a user can pick the PO line manually, which teaches future imports.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_purchase_match_product_packaging
summary: Adds a fallback for unit of measure and product packaging when UBL vendor bill lines are matched to purchase order lines. It uses the UNECE unit code from the file to pick the packaging or the unit of measure. It is a glue module between the purchase matching and UNECE unit modules.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_retrieve_tax
summary: When importing a UBL invoice, matches taxes by their UNECE tax category and code rather than by rate, so the right tax is found across companies and localizations. It affects tax lines on imported vendor bills.

name: account_edi_ubl_cii_supplier_invoice_number
summary: When a UBL vendor bill is imported, fills the Supplier Invoice Number field with the invoice number from the XML file. Affects imported vendor bills; the reference field is set on the bill form.

name: account_edi_ubl_move_line_uom_and_packaging_unece
summary: During UBL invoice import, reads the UNECE unit code on each line and sets the matching product packaging, or failing that the matching unit of measure, on the invoice line. Packaging takes priority when both match.

name: account_einvoice_generate
summary: Technical module that lets PDF invoices carry an embedded XML e-invoice, so the generation modules for UBL and Factur-X work together. It adds a setting for the XML format embedded in the PDF, under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings. On its own it adds no feature, and one of the UBL or Factur-X modules must also be installed.

name: account_einvoice_generate
summary: Technical module that lets PDF invoices carry an embedded XML e-invoice, so the generation modules for UBL and Factur-X work together. It adds a setting for the XML format embedded in the PDF, under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings. On its own it adds no feature, and one of the UBL or Factur-X modules must also be installed.

name: account_financial_report
summary: Adds a set of Excel-exportable accounting reports: General Ledger, Trial Balance, Open Items, Aged Partner Balance, VAT Report, and Journal Ledger. They open from Invoicing > Reporting > OCA accounting reports, and the aging buckets can be customized under Invoicing settings.

name: account_financial_report
summary: Adds a set of Excel-exportable accounting reports: General Ledger, Trial Balance, Open Items, Aged Partner Balance, VAT Report, and Journal Ledger. You can choose which columns to show and limit some of them from the columns page. They open from Invoicing > Reporting > OCA accounting reports.

name: account_financial_report_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit filter to all the OCA financial reports, so each report can be limited to one or more operating units. It is a glue module that applies on top of the financial reports and operating units modules.

name: account_financial_report_sale
summary: Adds a Delivery Address grouping option to the Open Items report, so open receivables can be grouped by the customer's delivery address. The option is chosen in the report wizard under Invoicing > Reporting > OCA accounting reports > Open Items.

name: account_financial_report_sale
summary: Adds a Delivery Address grouping option to the Open Items report, so open receivables can be grouped by the customer's delivery address. The option is chosen in the report wizard under Invoicing > Reporting > OCA accounting reports > Open Items.

name: account_financial_risk
summary: Adds a Financial Risk tab to customers where credit limits can be set for draft invoices, open invoices and unpaid balances. If a customer exceeds a limit, their new invoices cannot be validated unless the user has the Financial Risk Manager right. Credit information can optionally be shown in the customer portal.

name: account_financial_risk
summary: Adds a Financial Risk tab on customers where you set credit limits for drafts, open invoices, and unpaid balances. Invoices that would push a customer over a limit cannot be confirmed unless the user has the Financial Risk Manager group. Set it up on the customer under Invoicing > Customers and in Accounting settings.

name: account_fiscal_month
summary: Adds a Fiscal month type to date ranges, so monthly periods can be marked as fiscal months and used in reporting. It is a small technical addition on the date range type.

name: account_fiscal_position_allowed_journal
summary: Lets a fiscal position list the accounting journals it may use. An invoice with that fiscal position can then only use one of those journals, and the standard behavior applies when no journals are listed. The journals are set on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Taxes > Fiscal Positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_allowed_journal_purchase
summary: When a vendor bill is created from a purchase order, uses the allowed purchase journal set on the fiscal position, if there is exactly one. It builds on the allowed journals on fiscal positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_autodetect_optional_vies
summary: Adds a VIES (EU VAT number) validation step to automatic fiscal position detection. A fiscal position that requires VIES validation will only apply to partners whose VAT number has passed the check. Configure it on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Fiscal Positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_autodetect_optional_vies
summary: Adds a VIES (EU VAT number) validation step to automatic fiscal position detection. A fiscal position that requires VIES validation will only apply to partners whose VAT number has passed the check. Configure it on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Fiscal Positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_partner_type
summary: Adds a Fiscal Position Type to partners and fiscal positions, so each fiscal position is only auto-applied to partners of the matching type. A default type can be set per company. The partner field is on the contact form and the position type is set on the fiscal position.

name: account_fiscal_position_partner_type
summary: Adds a Fiscal Position Type to partners and fiscal positions, so each fiscal position is only auto-applied to partners of the matching type. A default type can be set per company. The partner field is on the contact form and the position type is set on the fiscal position.

name: account_fiscal_position_type
summary: Adds a use type to fiscal positions (sales, purchases, or all), which controls whether a position can be used on customer invoices, vendor bills, or both. Set it on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Taxes > Fiscal Positions, and it can also be set on chart templates.

name: account_fiscal_position_vat_check
summary: Blocks validating a customer invoice or credit note when its fiscal position requires a VAT number and the customer has none in Odoo. The partner form shows a warning banner when the VAT is missing. Turn on VAT Required on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_vat_check
summary: Blocks validating a customer invoice or credit note when its fiscal position requires a VAT number and the customer has none in Odoo. The partner form shows a warning banner when the VAT is missing. Turn on VAT Required on the fiscal position under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Positions.

name: account_fiscal_position_vies_warning
summary: Makes sure a fiscal position flagged Show VIES Warning can only be put on partners that passed VIES validation. Saving a partner or invoice without a valid VIES check shows a warning. Enable it by turning on Verify VAT Numbers in settings and setting the flags on the fiscal position.

name: account_fiscal_year
summary: Lets you create and edit fiscal years under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Years, and shows the current fiscal year's start and end dates on the company record. The fiscal year is stored per company.

name: account_fiscal_year
summary: Lets you create and edit fiscal years under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Years, and shows the current fiscal year's start and end dates on the company record. The fiscal year is stored per company.

name: account_fiscal_year
summary: Lets you create and edit fiscal years under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Years, and shows the current fiscal year's start and end dates on the company record. The fiscal year is stored per company.

name: account_fiscal_year_auto_create
summary: Automatically creates the next fiscal year for each company when the current one ends, using a daily scheduled job. The new year copies the previous year's dates, shifted by one year, and runs a 12-month period that the accountant can then adjust.

name: account_fiscal_year_auto_create
summary: Creates each company's next fiscal year automatically on the last day of the current one, using a daily scheduled job. The new year copies the previous year's dates shifted forward by one year, with a 12-month period that the accountant can then adjust. Useful for multi-company setups.

name: account_fiscal_year_closing
summary: Runs the year-end closing for countries that require closing or opening journal entries. You create a fiscal year closing under Accounting > Adviser > Fiscal year closings, calculate it with a closing template, review the moves, and post them. Templates are set up under Fiscal year closing configuration.

name: account_fiscal_year_closing
summary: Runs the year-end closing for countries that require closing or opening journal entries. You create a fiscal year closing under Accounting > Adviser > Fiscal year closings, calculate it with a closing template, review the moves, and post them. Templates are set up under Fiscal year closing configuration.

name: account_fiscal_year_closing_range
summary: Lets you generate many closing account mappings at once by giving a range of account codes, using a Generate Range wizard on the fiscal year closing configuration or template. It extends the fiscal year closing module.

name: account_force_early_discount
summary: Lets you apply an early payment discount even after the date it expires, when the invoice has Force financial discount set. The discount is applied in the Register Payment wizard, which shows the option when it is available.

name: account_global_discount
summary: Applies global percentage discounts to customer invoices and vendor bills. Discounts are defined once under Settings > Parameters > Global Discounts, assigned to customers or suppliers, and then appear in the Invoice Global Discounts section of each invoice. The invoice then shows the total discount and the amount before discounts.

name: account_in_payment
summary: Enables the in-payment mode for accounting, for payments that are on their way but not yet fully settled. It adds no fields of its own, and the module should not be installed alongside Enterprise accounting. It is a technical accounting enabler.

name: account_invoice_advance_compensation
summary: Tracks advance payments from customers and suppliers and applies them against regular invoices. An advance is created with an Advance product, paid as normal, and then a compensation wizard on the invoice offsets part of it against the invoice amount. It uses a dedicated advance journal and supports multiple currencies.

name: account_invoice_alternate_payer
summary: Adds an Alternate Payor/Payee field on customer invoices and vendor bills, so the money is paid or collected from a different partner than the main customer or vendor. The field is on the invoice form, and payments registered against it follow the alternate partner.

name: account_invoice_analytic_search
summary: Lets you find customer and vendor invoices by their analytic accounts, so you can pull up all invoices for a project or cost center by searching its code or name. The analytic accounts field is added to invoices in Accounting.

name: account_invoice_auto_send_by_email
summary: Sends posted customer invoices by email automatically once a day, for invoices whose transmit method is Email and that have not been sent yet. Sending runs as background queue jobs, so users do not have to send each invoice by hand. The result shows in the invoice chatter once the email goes out.

name: account_invoice_bank_brand
summary: Fills the invoice's bank account automatically from the brand selected on it, so each brand's invoices show the right remittance account. Each brand gets its own bank account under Settings > Users & Companies > Brands. Requires the brand accounting module.

name: account_invoice_bank_details
summary: Picks a default bank account on customer invoices and credit notes based on the invoice currency, and prints the bank details on the invoice report and customer portal. Vendor bills are not affected.

name: account_invoice_block_payment
summary: Adds a Payment Blocked flag on each invoice. If a user tries to register a payment on a blocked invoice, Odoo shows an error that names the blocked invoice. The flag is set on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_block_payment
summary: Adds a Payment Blocked flag on each invoice. If a user tries to register a payment on a blocked invoice, Odoo shows an error that names the blocked invoice. The flag is set on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_blocking
summary: Adds a No Follow-up flag on invoices that keeps their receivable and payable lines out of automatic follow-up and payment processes. The flag is set on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_blocking
summary: Adds a No Follow-up flag on invoices that blocks their receivable and payable lines, so automatic tasks such as payment file generation and follow-ups skip them. The flag is set on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_change_currency
summary: Adds an Update Currency button on draft invoices, which switches the invoice to another currency and recalculates every line price at a rate you can set. Requires the Accounting & Finance Adviser group, and the invoice must be saved before the change.

name: account_invoice_check_picking_date
summary: Warns the user when a vendor bill's accounting date falls in a different month from the receipt it is billed against. The warning appears as a popup when the bill is confirmed, so the date can be corrected before posting. It applies to purchase bills linked to stock receipts.

name: account_invoice_check_total
summary: Adds a Verification Total field to vendor bills, where the user types the total printed on the supplier's bill. When the bill is confirmed, Odoo compares its computed total with that figure and shows the difference, which catches data-entry errors. It is switched on with the Check Total on Vendor Bills setting in the vendor payments section of invoicing settings.

name: account_invoice_check_total
summary: Adds a Verification Total field to vendor bills. You type in the total printed on the bill, and Odoo checks it against the total it computes from the lines and taxes. The check can be turned on in settings and skipped per journal.

name: account_invoice_clearing
summary: Provides a wizard that offsets open customer invoices against open vendor bills of the same partner (or its child contacts) by posting an intermediate journal entry. Select invoices or bills in a list view and use the Invoice Clearing action, then choose the amounts to clear. It works on the residual amounts of unpaid items.

name: account_invoice_clearing
summary: Clears unpaid customer invoices against unpaid vendor bills for the same contact, by creating an intermediate journal entry for the residual amounts. A wizard on the invoice list starts the clearing, and the open amounts are offset against each other.

name: account_invoice_constraint_chronology
summary: Stops an invoice from being validated if it would break the order of invoice numbers, such as an earlier-dated draft still waiting, or a later-dated or higher-numbered invoice already posted. The check is switched on per journal.

name: account_invoice_constraint_chronology
summary: Stops an invoice from being validated if it would break the order of invoice numbers, such as an earlier-dated draft still waiting, or a later-dated or higher-numbered invoice already posted. The check is switched on per journal.

name: account_invoice_crm_tag
summary: Copies the tags set on a sales order onto the invoices created from it, and onto any credit note made from those invoices. The tags then show on invoices and in invoice analysis reports. Tags are set under Other info on the sales order.

name: account_invoice_crm_tag
summary: Copies the CRM tags from a sale order onto the invoices created from it, and onto the matching refunds. Tags are added on the sale order under Other Info, and then appear on the invoice and its lines.

name: account_invoice_currency_by_partner
summary: Lets you set a default customer currency and a default vendor currency on each contact. New customer invoices and vendor bills for that contact then open in that currency automatically, and fall back to the standard currency choice when none is set. The fields sit on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact.

name: account_invoice_currency_taxes
summary: On printed invoices in a foreign currency, shows the tax amounts again in the company's currency, in brackets, which some countries require. It only changes the invoice report.

name: account_invoice_custom_rounding
summary: Lets each invoice use its own tax calculation rounding method, instead of only the company-wide setting. The method can be set on a contact and is copied to that customer's invoices, and it can be changed on the invoice's Other Information tab. If nothing is selected, the company's rounding method applies.

name: account_invoice_customer_no_autofollow
summary: Stops Odoo from adding the customer or vendor as a follower on every invoice. A setting in General Settings turns the behavior off for the company.

name: account_invoice_customer_no_autofollow
summary: Stops Odoo from adding the customer or vendor as a follower on every invoice. A setting in General Settings turns the behavior off for the company.

name: account_invoice_date_due
summary: Makes the invoice Due Date editable even after posting, when a payment term is set, and updates the related journal lines when it changes. Users need the Allow to change due date group, and the field appears above the payment term once the invoice is posted.

name: account_invoice_date_due
summary: Makes the due date of an invoice editable even after it has been posted, and even when a payment term is set. Changing it also updates the related receivable or payable lines. Only users in the Allow to change due date group can edit it.

name: account_invoice_default_code_column
summary: Adds a dedicated Default Code column to the invoice report, so the product code always prints even if someone renames the line description or removes the code. It also makes invoices easier to read.

name: account_invoice_default_code_column
summary: Adds a dedicated Default code column to the printed invoice report, so the product code still appears even if someone renames the line description. Product codes sit in their own column, which makes printed invoices easier to read. It only changes the invoice report and PDF.

name: account_invoice_discount_amount
summary: Shows the early payment discount amount on the invoice and bill list, in both the document and company currency, so you can see what to pay to get the discount without opening each invoice. The columns appear only when a discount applies.

name: account_invoice_discount_date
summary: Adds a discount date to customer invoices and vendor bills for early payment discounts, and copies it to the receivable or payable lines. You can filter invoices to find those whose early discount is about to expire, so payments or collections happen in time. Early payment dates from payment terms are kept when the discount date changes.

name: account_invoice_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the total discount applied on an invoice and the total before discount, both on the invoice form and the printed PDF. The totals update automatically when a line discount is entered.

name: account_invoice_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the total discount amount and the total before discount on invoices, both in the form and on the printed invoice. These totals update when a discount is applied to any invoice line. No setup is needed.

name: account_invoice_download
summary: Base for downloading supplier invoices automatically from a supplier's online portal and importing them as vendor bills. You set up a download configuration per supplier account under Invoicing > Configuration > Import Vendor Bills > Download Bills, and the actual download source comes from separate backend modules.

name: account_invoice_download
summary: Base for downloading supplier invoices automatically from a supplier's online portal and importing them as vendor bills. You set up a download configuration per supplier account under Invoicing > Configuration > Import Vendor Bills > Download Bills, and the actual download source comes from separate backend modules.

name: account_invoice_download_ovh
summary: Adds OVH as a download source, so OVH supplier invoices are pulled automatically through the OVH API and imported as vendor bills. You create one download configuration per OVH account under Invoicing > Configuration > Import Vendor Bills > Download Bills, and the API credentials are generated from there.

name: account_invoice_download_ovh
summary: Adds OVH as a download source, so OVH supplier invoices are pulled automatically through the OVH API and imported as vendor bills. You create one download configuration per OVH account under Invoicing > Configuration > Import Vendor Bills > Download Bills, and the API credentials are generated from there.

name: account_invoice_download_scaleway
summary: Adds Scaleway as a download source, so Scaleway cloud invoices are pulled automatically from the Scaleway Billing API and imported as vendor bills. Setup needs a Scaleway API key with billing access, entered on the download configuration.

name: account_invoice_edifact
summary: Exports customer invoices in the UN/EDIFACT D96A format, so they can be sent electronically to customers that require EDIFACT. It builds on the sales and accounting modules.

name: account_invoice_export
summary: Sends customer invoices to an external system over HTTP. You enter a destination URL and Basic Authentication credentials on the transmit method, and the Send ebill button posts the invoice PDF to that address. Success or failure is written to the invoice chatter.

name: account_invoice_export
summary: Sends customer invoices to an external system over HTTP. You enter a destination URL, Basic Authentication credentials, and a connection timeout on the transmit method, and the Send ebill button posts the invoice PDF to that address. Success or failure is written to the invoice chatter.

name: account_invoice_export_job
summary: Runs the invoice export through queue_job, so sending invoices to external systems happens in background jobs rather than in the user's screen. It adds no screens of its own.

name: account_invoice_export_job
summary: Runs the invoice export through queue_job, so sending invoices to external systems happens in background jobs rather than in the user's screen. It adds no screens of its own.

name: account_invoice_export_server_env
summary: Technical module that reads the invoice export destination URL and credentials from the server configuration file. Each environment such as dev, test, or production can point to different endpoints without changing settings in the database.

name: account_invoice_facturx
summary: Makes customer invoice and refund PDFs comply with the Factur-X (ZUGFeRD) standard, by embedding the structured CII XML inside the PDF that Odoo generates. Set the XML format embedded in PDF invoice, the Factur-X level, and the refund type under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings.

name: account_invoice_facturx
summary: Makes customer invoice and refund PDFs comply with the Factur-X (ZUGFeRD) standard, by embedding the structured CII XML inside the PDF that Odoo generates. Set the XML format embedded in PDF invoice to Factur-X (CII) under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings.

name: account_invoice_facturx_py3o
summary: Makes Factur-X invoices work when the PDF is produced by the py3o reporting engine instead of the standard Odoo report. It is a technical bridge that needs the Factur-X module and the py3o report module.

name: account_invoice_facturx_py3o
summary: Makes Factur-X invoices work when the PDF is produced by the py3o reporting engine instead of the standard Odoo report. It is a technical bridge that needs the Factur-X module and the py3o report module.

name: account_invoice_fiscal_position_update
summary: This module is obsolete and no longer maintained. When the fiscal position or partner on an invoice changes, it updates the taxes and accounts on lines that have a product, and warns the user about lines without one. Newer standard Odoo behavior should be preferred where it covers the need.

name: account_invoice_fiscal_position_update
summary: When the fiscal position of an invoice changes, either directly or through a change of partner, the taxes and accounts on every product line are updated automatically. Lines without a product are left alone, and a warning tells the user.

name: account_invoice_fixed_discount
summary: Lets you enter a fixed money amount as a discount on an invoice line, in addition to percentage discounts, and shows it on the invoice report. If the triple discount module is also installed, a fixed discount takes priority over the triple discount fields.

name: account_invoice_fixed_discount
summary: Adds a fixed-amount discount field to each invoice line, so a set currency amount can be taken off a line instead of a percentage. The discount is also printed on the invoice report. It is an invoice-level change for sales and purchase invoices.

name: account_invoice_fixed_triple_discount
summary: Glue module that shows a warning when a fixed discount and a triple discount are both used on the same invoice line, recommending that only one be used, since the fixed discount takes priority. No new fields.

name: account_invoice_force_number
summary: Lets a user type a specific number for a draft invoice in a Force Number field, and that number is used when the invoice is confirmed, instead of the next sequence number. Users need the Invoice Force Number group, which is set in the user's access rights.

name: account_invoice_google_document_ai
summary: Sends an uploaded invoice to Google Document AI so that its data is read by OCR and used to fill in the draft invoice or vendor bill. It needs a Google Cloud project with the Document AI API and an OCR processor, and the settings are stored on the company.

name: account_invoice_import
summary: Creates draft vendor bills from PDF or XML invoice files uploaded through Invoicing > Vendors > Import Vendor Bill, or sent to a mail gateway. It finds the supplier by VAT number, can create or update partners, and uses per-supplier defaults for product, account, and taxes. Imported draft bills show warnings where data could not be matched.

name: account_invoice_import
summary: Creates draft vendor bills from PDF or XML invoice files uploaded through Invoicing > Vendors > Import Vendor Bill, or sent to a mail gateway. It finds the supplier by VAT number, and when no match is found the bill is created without a partner, so you can use Create or Update Partner. Per-supplier defaults set product, account, and taxes.

name: account_invoice_import
summary: Creates draft vendor bills from PDF or XML invoice files uploaded through Invoicing > Vendors > Import Vendor Bill, or sent to a mail gateway. It finds the supplier by VAT number, can create or update partners, and uses per-supplier defaults for product, account, and taxes. This version also supports updating a draft bill that came from a purchase order.

name: account_invoice_import_facturx
summary: Lets the vendor bill import read Factur-X and ZUGFeRD PDF invoices, which carry structured CII XML inside the PDF, so the bill is filled from the embedded data. It extends the invoice import wizard.

name: account_invoice_import_facturx
summary: Lets the vendor bill import read Factur-X and ZUGFeRD PDF invoices, which carry structured CII XML inside the PDF, so the bill is filled from the embedded data. It extends the invoice import wizard.

name: account_invoice_import_simple_pdf
summary: Creates vendor bills from plain PDF invoices that have no embedded XML. The text is pulled from the PDF, the supplier is matched by VAT number or keyword, and fields such as totals, dates, and invoice number are read using patterns you set per supplier in Odoo, without writing code. It extends the invoice import wizard under Invoicing > Vendors > Import Vendor Bill.

name: account_invoice_import_simple_pdf
summary: Lets you import vendor bills from plain PDF invoices that have no embedded XML, by reading the PDF text and pulling out amounts, dates and invoice numbers. The accountant sets up each vendor's extraction rules in Odoo without writing regular expressions, so new vendor layouts can be added without developer help. The rules live on the vendor contact and the imports run from the vendor bill import flow in Accounting.

name: account_invoice_import_ubl
summary: Adds support for importing UBL XML supplier invoices and refunds into Odoo's vendor bill import, so an electronic XML invoice can become a draft vendor bill automatically. It is a technical extension of the account invoice import feature in Accounting and uses the base_ubl_parse library. Refer to the invoice import usage and the UNECE tax configuration for setup.

name: account_invoice_import_ubl
summary: Adds support for importing UBL XML supplier invoices and refunds into Odoo's vendor bill import, so an electronic XML invoice can become a draft vendor bill automatically. It is a technical extension of the account invoice import feature in Accounting and uses the base_ubl library. The module notes it works with Belgian e-fff invoices, which are UBL files with an embedded PDF.

name: account_invoice_inter_company
summary: When several companies share one Odoo database, an invoice from one company to another can automatically generate the matching supplier invoice in the other company, and optionally validate it. The settings are under Settings > General Settings in the Companies section, and the generated invoices are linked back to their source on the account move. Useful only when the companies in the same database sell to each other.

name: account_invoice_inter_company
summary: When several companies share one Odoo database, an invoice from one company to another can automatically generate the matching supplier invoice in the other company, with optional auto validation and generation switches. It also adds an option to share products across all companies, a common product catalog. Settings are under Settings > General Settings in the Companies section.

name: account_invoice_line_default_account
summary: Gives each customer and vendor a default income or expense account, so manually entered invoice lines without a product pick up the right account automatically. When a user types a different account on an invoice line, Odoo can remember it on the contact unless that is turned off there. The default accounts are set on the contact record.

name: account_invoice_line_mass_edit
summary: Lets you edit many lines of a draft invoice or bill at once from an editable list opened by a Lines smart button on the invoice form. A change to one field applies to every line you select, which is handy for setting an account, tax or price across a whole invoice. Sections and notes are shown for reference only and are never changed.

name: account_invoice_line_report
