summary: Adds a reporting view that lists individual invoice lines, so you can analyze what was billed line by line instead of only invoice totals. It is found under Invoicing > Reporting > Management > Invoice Lines, and the user needs the Show Full Accounting Features option turned on.

name: account_invoice_line_sale_line_position
summary: Copies the sale order line position labels, such as sub-item numbering, onto the invoice lines and into the invoice report. An invoice line can carry several positions, and they print on the report. It is a bridge on top of sale_order_line_position, so it matters to users who number quotation lines.

name: account_invoice_line_sequence
summary: Adds a line number to each invoice line, starting at 1 and counting up as lines are added or reordered. Section and note lines are skipped, and the number prints on the invoice report so customers can refer to lines easily. It is a display and print change only.

name: account_invoice_margin
summary: Shows sales margin, as an amount and a percent, plus cost, on customer invoices, in the invoice list and in the invoice report. The figures are only visible to users with the Show Invoice Margin security option enabled on their user. It is a technical base feature that other margin modules build on.

name: account_invoice_margin
summary: Shows sales margin, as an amount and a percent, plus cost, on customer invoices, in the invoice list and in the invoice report. The figures are only visible to users with the Show Invoice Margin security option enabled on their user. It is a technical base feature that other margin modules build on.

name: account_invoice_margin_sale
summary: When an invoice comes from a sale order, it carries the cost from the sale order line onto the invoice line, so the margin on the invoice is accurate. Down-payment lines are left out of the margin calculation. Users still need the Show Invoice Margin security option to see the figures.
keywords: cost from sale order to invoice

name: account_invoice_margin_sale
summary: When an invoice comes from a sale order, it carries the cost from the sale order line onto the invoice line, so the margin on the invoice is accurate. Down-payment lines are left out of the margin calculation. Users still need the Show Invoice Margin security option to see the figures.
keywords: cost from sale order to invoice

name: account_invoice_mass_sending
summary: Lets you email many customer invoices at once through background jobs instead of one by one. From the invoice list choose Action > Send & print, tick Email, pick a template and run the mass sending, and the queue job system handles the batch without blocking the screen. Invoices are flagged while their send is pending.

name: account_invoice_mass_sending
summary: Lets you email many customer invoices at once through background jobs instead of one by one. From the invoice list choose Action > Send & print, tick Email, pick a template and run the mass sending, and the queue job system handles the batch without blocking the screen. Invoices are flagged while their send is pending.

name: account_invoice_mass_sending_direct_print
summary: Adds a Direct Print option to the mass invoice sending wizard, so selected invoices can be printed on a configured printer in a background job instead of only being emailed. It is switched on in the wizard and as a company default in Settings. Printer setup comes from the base_report_to_printer module.

name: account_invoice_merge
summary: Lets you combine several draft invoices for the same customer or vendor into one invoice from the invoice list, using the Merge Partner Invoice action. The invoices must share type, partner, currency and receivable account. The merge wizard can keep references from the originals and set a new invoice date.

name: account_invoice_merge
summary: Adds a Merge Partner Invoice action on the invoice list. Select several draft invoices for the same customer or vendor, with the same type, currency and receivable account, and merge them into one invoice. It is meant for combining draft invoices before they are posted.

name: account_invoice_merge_attachment
summary: When invoices are merged, the attachments of the original invoices are linked to the new merged invoice. It installs automatically with account_invoice_merge and adds a Link attachments option to the merge wizard.

name: account_invoice_overdue_reminder
summary: Lets you send overdue invoice reminders to customers by email, letter or phone from a wizard at Invoicing > Customers > Overdue Invoice Remind, and keeps a history of each reminder per invoice. It can filter customers by salesperson or customer, uses trigger delays and minimum intervals between reminders, and can attach invoices to the emails. It is meant as a simpler alternative to the complex account_credit_control module.

name: account_invoice_overdue_reminder
summary: Sends overdue invoice reminders to customers by email, letter or phone from a wizard under Invoicing, Customers, Overdue Invoice Remind. It keeps a history of every reminder per invoice, with results and notes, and is simple enough for staff without accounting skills. Reminders handle multiple currencies and show a total per currency.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on the customer form when the customer has overdue invoices, with the number of invoices, the total overdue amount and a link to see them. The banner also appears on the customer's contacts, and amounts are in company currency.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on customer contact forms when the customer has overdue invoices, with the count and total overdue amount in company currency and a link to the list. Parent companies and all their contacts show the same banner. Useful for checking a customer before taking a new order.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn_sale
summary: Adds the same overdue invoice banner to quotations and sale orders, so salespeople see that the invoicing customer has overdue invoices before confirming an order. It builds on the overdue warning on customer forms and shows the count and amount in company currency.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn_sale
summary: Adds the same overdue invoice banner to quotations and sales orders, so salespeople see that the invoicing customer has overdue invoices before confirming. It needs the overdue warning module, and shows the count and total overdue amount with a link to the invoices.

name: account_invoice_partner_reference
summary: Adds a Customer reference field to invoices and bills, filled from the contact's Reference on the Sales & Purchase tab. The reference shows as a column in the customer, supplier and credit note lists, so the buyer's PO or reference number is visible at a glance.

name: account_invoice_payment_mode_note_template
summary: Lets you write the payment mode note printed on invoices as a Jinja2 template, so the note can pull in values from the invoice such as amounts or bank details. Templates are defined per payment mode and fields are picked from the invoice model. It is a technical template feature for the text of the note.

name: account_invoice_payment_retention
summary: Lets you hold back part of an invoice amount as a retention, by percent or fixed amount, enforce it at payment, and release it later on another invoice. Retention fields appear on customer invoices and vendor bills and in the Register Payment wizard. Retention payable and receivable accounts must be set in Settings first.

name: account_invoice_payment_term_date_due
summary: On invoices that have a payment term, shows the computed due date, which Odoo otherwise hides. It lets users see when an invoice is due without working it out from the term.

name: account_invoice_payment_term_date_due
summary: On invoices with a payment term, the due date is normally hidden. This module shows the computed due date on the invoice so users can see when payment is expected. It is a display change only.

name: account_invoice_pricelist
summary: Stores the customer's pricelist on each invoice and uses it when lines are added by hand, so pricelist rules apply to manually entered invoice lines. Invoices can also be grouped by pricelist in the reporting views. The pricelist shows on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_pricelist
summary: Adds a pricelist field to customer invoices, filled from the customer's pricelist, which is used when lines are added by hand. Pricelist rules also apply in a multi-currency setting. Invoices can be grouped by pricelist in the list view.

name: account_invoice_pricelist_sale
summary: Copies the pricelist from a sales order onto the invoice created from it, so the invoice keeps the same pricing as the order. It extends the invoice pricelist feature and needs no extra setup.

name: account_invoice_pricelist_sale
summary: Copies the pricelist from a sale order to the invoice created from it, so the invoice keeps the price list the order used. It is a bridge between the sales and invoice pricelist features.

name: account_invoice_pricelist_technical
summary: Stops users from picking technical pricelists, which other features use internally, on invoice forms, so only regular price lists appear there. It extends sale_pricelist_technical from the same repository.

name: account_invoice_production_lot
summary: Shows the lot or serial numbers delivered on each customer invoice line, with quantities when the product is tracked by lots, and prints them on the invoice report. The lots appear on the invoice line form under Production Lots. Lot tracking must be turned on in Inventory settings.

name: account_invoice_production_lot
summary: Shows the lot or serial numbers delivered on each customer invoice line, with quantities when the product is tracked by lots, and prints them on the invoice report. The lots appear on the invoice line form under Production Lots. Lot tracking must be turned on in Inventory settings.

name: account_invoice_recipient_bank_currency
summary: Fills the Recipient Bank on an invoice based on the invoice's currency and the company, so the right bank account is picked for multi-currency billing. It helps when one company holds bank accounts in several currencies.

name: account_invoice_refund_code
summary: Gives a journal its own short code and a dedicated sequence for credit notes, so credit note numbers carry the refund code. It is set on the journal under Invoicing > Configuration > Journals.

name: account_invoice_refund_line_selection
summary: On the credit note wizard for a posted invoice, you can choose the refund specific lines option and pick only the invoice lines to refund, instead of reversing the whole invoice. This is how partial credit notes are made. It is started from the Add Credit Note button on a validated invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_link
summary: Links each credit note to the original invoice it reverses, shown as an Invoice reference field on the credit note form. It also tracks which original invoice line each refund line came from, so you can see what a credit note corrects.

name: account_invoice_refund_link
summary: Shows the link between a credit note and the invoice it refunds, through an Invoice reference field on the credit note. Each refund line also keeps track of the original invoice line it reverses. This makes it easy to see what was refunded from which invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_link_sale
summary: Links a credit note created from a sales order to the original invoice, when the refund covers lines that were invoiced on that specific invoice. It applies to products set to delivered quantities invoicing. Refunds raised from the sales order then point back to the right invoice.

name: account_invoice_refund_reason
summary: Lets you define a list of reasons for credit notes, such as returned goods or a pricing error. When a credit note is created from an invoice or bill, the user picks a reason, and reasons can be reported on. The reasons are managed under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Refund Reasons.

name: account_invoice_refund_reason
summary: Lets you pick a reason from a managed list when creating a credit note, under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Refund Reasons, and then report credit notes by reason in pivot views. Reasons can be added, edited or archived.

name: account_invoice_refund_reason_skip_anglo_saxon
summary: For refund reasons marked to skip Anglo-Saxon entries, credit notes are created without the extra stock valuation journal entries that this accounting method normally adds. The flag is set on each reason under Refund Reasons. It is a technical accounting add-on.

name: account_invoice_refund_reinvoice
summary: Adds a Restore Credit Note button on a refund that creates a new invoice with the same data, so a refund that should have been an invoice can be re-issued without retyping it. It is useful when the refund is linked to a sale or purchase order.

name: account_invoice_report_due_list
summary: Adds a list of each due date and amount to the printed invoice when the payment term has several installments. The Multiple date due option on the invoice turns it on. It needs a multi-line payment term under Invoicing > Configuration > Payment Terms.

name: account_invoice_report_grouped_by_picking
summary: Groups the lines of a printed customer invoice by delivery order, showing the sale order and picking info for each group. Service lines from the same sale order are placed in the group with the goods they belong to. It changes only the printed invoice report.

name: account_invoice_report_grouped_by_picking
summary: Groups the lines of a printed customer invoice by delivery order, showing the sale order and picking info for each group. Service lines from the same sale order are placed in the group with the goods they belong to. It changes only the printed invoice report.

name: account_invoice_report_grouped_by_picking_sale_mrp
summary: Makes the picking-grouped invoice report print correctly when sales include bill of materials kits, showing kit components under their delivery. It extends the grouped-by-picking invoice report for manufacturing kit products.

name: account_invoice_report_header_repeater
summary: Repeats the header on every page of the printed invoice report, so multi-page invoices show the customer and invoice details on each page. It changes only the printed invoice.

name: account_invoice_report_lot_expiration_date
summary: Adds the lot expiration date to lines on the printed invoice for products that track expiry dates. It suits sales of food or pharma products where the buyer needs the expiry date on the invoice.

name: account_invoice_report_payment_info
summary: Adds extended payment details to the printed invoice, including payments and reconciled amounts and references to credit notes. The exact content is controlled by a system parameter pattern that a developer sets.

name: account_invoice_report_picking_customer_note
summary: Prints the Picking Customer Comments from the delivery address contact on the invoice report, so notes meant for the warehouse or driver also appear on the invoice. It depends on sale_stock_picking_note, which provides the comment fields on the contact and sale order.

name: account_invoice_report_picking_customer_note
summary: Prints the Picking Customer Comments from the delivery address contact on the invoice report, so notes meant for the warehouse or driver also appear on the invoice. It depends on sale_stock_picking_note, which provides the comment fields on the contact and sale order.

name: account_invoice_report_printed_flag
summary: Marks invoices, bills and journal entries as printed when a report is generated, and can keep a log of which report names were printed. It adds Printed and Not Printed filters and group-by options on the accounting lists. It is configured under Settings > Printed Flag.

name: account_invoice_report_product_sticker
summary: Shows product stickers, such as promo or warning labels, on printed sale invoices. Stickers are set up under Settings > Technical > Product Stickers and turned on per invoice in the Other Info tab.

name: account_invoice_report_salesperson
summary: Shows the salesperson's name and phone or mobile number on the printed invoice and the unpaid invoices report. Pick the salesperson on the invoice before printing.

name: account_invoice_report_salesperson
summary: Shows the salesperson's name and phone or mobile number on the printed invoice and the unpaid invoices report. Pick the salesperson on the invoice before printing.

name: account_invoice_report_stock_packaging
summary: Shows packaging information, such as cases or pallets, on invoice lines for delivered quantities, so the invoice lists how many packs were shipped. It needs packaging set on sale order lines and invoicing on delivered quantities.

name: account_invoice_report_wo_taxation
summary: Adds a per-company option to hide the tax details on the printed invoice report. It is turned on as Hide Taxes on Invoices Report in Settings.

name: account_invoice_section_sale_order
summary: When one invoice covers several sale orders, it inserts a section line with each sale order's name above its lines, so the customer can tell which lines belong to which order. The naming pattern and grouping can be set per company and per customer.

name: account_invoice_section_sale_order
summary: When one invoice covers several sales orders, it adds a section line above each order's lines, named after that sales order. This makes it clear which invoice lines came from which order. The section naming scheme and grouping can be configured on the company and on the customer.

name: account_invoice_select_for_payment
summary: Adds a selection button before the Number column in the invoice list, used to mark invoices as Selected for payment. Use the Selected for payment filter, select the lines, and then choose Register payment from the Actions menu. The selection clears once a payment is registered.

name: account_invoice_send_template
summary: Adds a mail template choice to the batch send wizard for customer invoices. Pick the email template before sending, or leave it on the default. It is used from the Send action after selecting one or more invoices.

name: account_invoice_show_currency_rate
summary: Shows the exchange rate applied to an invoice in a foreign currency, so you can check the rate and the amount in company currency. The rate is based on the invoice date and currency. Multi-currency must be enabled first.

name: account_invoice_show_currency_rate
summary: Shows the exchange rate applied to an invoice in a foreign currency, so you can check the rate and the amount in company currency. The rate is based on the invoice date and currency. Multi-currency must be enabled first.

name: account_invoice_show_currency_rate
summary: Makes posted foreign currency invoices show the exchange rate that matches the amounts actually booked, rather than only the system rate. This matters when an invoice was posted at a different rate or its amount was edited by hand. The rate shows on the invoice and on its journal items.

name: account_invoice_start_end_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date fields to invoice and journal lines, for services that run over a period. A product can be flagged as must have these dates, which blocks posting when the dates are missing. It pairs well with prepaid and accrual cut-off modules.

name: account_invoice_start_end_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date fields to invoice and journal lines, for services that run over a period. A product can be flagged as must have these dates, which blocks posting when the dates are missing, and the dates also appear on the invoice reporting view. It pairs well with prepaid and accrual cut-off modules.

name: account_invoice_start_end_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date fields to invoice and journal lines, for services that run over a period. A product can be flagged as must have these dates, which blocks posting when the dates are missing. It pairs well with prepaid and accrual cut-off modules.

name: account_invoice_start_end_dates_move
summary: Lets you enter one start date and end date in the invoice header, which are then copied onto the lines of products flagged must have dates, or onto all lines if the company option is on. It builds on the start and end dates module. The company option Apply Start/End Dates To All Account Move Lines is on by default.

name: account_invoice_subscription_per_contact
summary: Lets you subscribe a user as a follower on a specific contact, so they are notified when invoices are created for that contact or its children. This goes beyond the single email address on a contact and keeps notifications targeted. Subscribe the user from the contact's chatter using the Invoice Created subtype.

name: account_invoice_supplier_ref_unique
summary: Stops the same vendor bill from being entered twice by checking that the vendor and the vendor invoice number pair is unique, ignoring case. It is turned on under Settings > Vendor Bills with the Check Unicity on Supplier Invoice Number option. This protects against paying one invoice twice.

name: account_invoice_supplier_ref_unique
summary: Stops the same vendor bill being entered twice by checking that the vendor and the bill reference together are unique, ignoring case. A duplicate bill is blocked when saved, which protects against paying the same bill twice. It is switched on with the Check Unicity on Supplier Invoice Number option in the Vendor Bills settings.

name: account_invoice_supplier_self_invoice
summary: Lets you set up suppliers for self billing, where your company creates the invoice in the supplier's name, using a separate self billing prefix and sequence. Once a supplier is set to self invoice on the Sales & Purchases tab, bills for that supplier can be created and sent as self-billed documents. The supplier has to agree to self billing.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update
summary: Adds a Check Supplier Info button on vendor bills that compares each line's price and quantity with the product's vendor pricelist. A wizard shows the proposed changes, such as a new vendor price line or an updated price, and the user can accept or drop them. Use it to keep vendor prices current after a supplier changes its rates.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update
summary: Adds a Check Supplier Info button on vendor bills that compares each line's purchase price with the vendor pricelist on the product, then lets you update the vendor info with the new price or create a new vendor line. Users can review the changes first and drop any temporary price changes. It keeps product purchase prices current from the bills you receive.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update_discount
summary: Extends the supplier info update so the discount on the vendor info is also updated when a vendor bill line has a different discount. It is a glue module that installs when purchase_discount is present. It adds current and new discount columns to the update wizard.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update_qty_multiplier
summary: Extends the vendor info update wizard so the Quantity Multiplier on the vendor info can be changed from a vendor bill. It is a glue module that installs when product_supplierinfo_qty_multiplier is present.

name: account_invoice_supplierinfo_update_triple_discount
summary: Extends the vendor info update so all three discounts on a vendor bill line can update the supplier discounts when they differ. It is a glue module that installs when the triple discount modules are present, and adds the second and third discount to the update wizard.

name: account_invoice_tax_note
summary: Lets you attach a mention, such as a legal note, to a tax group, and that note is printed on customer invoices when a tax from that group is used. It complements the note already set on the fiscal position. The notes are translatable and can differ by company.

name: account_invoice_tax_note
summary: Lets you write a note on each tax group that prints on customer invoices whenever a tax from that group is used. The note is translatable and can differ by company, and it complements the note set on a fiscal position. It is edited on the tax group, which is set from the tax's form under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes.

name: account_invoice_tax_required
summary: Stops an invoice from being confirmed while any line has no tax. When a user tries to confirm an invoice with an untaxed line, Odoo raises an error and blocks the confirmation. Use it when every invoice line must carry a tax.

name: account_invoice_tax_required
summary: Blocks posting of a customer invoice if any line has no tax set, so every line must carry a tax before the invoice can be validated. The error shows when the user clicks Post. It is a simple control with no settings.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method
summary: Lets each partner have a default way to send or receive invoices, such as email, post, customer portal or a country e-invoicing platform, set on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact. New invoices copy that method automatically and it can be changed per invoice. Extra methods can be added under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Transmit Methods.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method
summary: Lets each partner have a default way to send or receive invoices, such as email, post, customer portal or a country e-invoicing platform, set on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact. New invoices copy that method automatically and it can be changed per invoice. When Post or Customer Portal is chosen, the send and print button is hidden until the method is set back to email.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method
summary: Sets a transmit method on each contact, such as Email, Post or Customer Portal, and copies it to new invoices, where it can be changed. Customers have a sending method and vendors have a reception method, both on the Sales & Purchase tab of the contact. The list of methods can be extended, and other modules add their own, such as Chorus Pro for French public-sector e-invoicing.

name: account_invoice_transmit_method_substitution_rule
summary: Lets you set rules that swap the transmit method on an invoice when it matches a condition, such as a missing email address, or a direct debit payment that must go by post. Rules are defined under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Transmit Method Substitution Rules and apply when the invoice is created. The rule's domain decides when a substitution happens.

name: account_invoice_tree_currency
summary: Optionally shows a currency column in the customer and vendor invoice list views. It helps when a list mixes invoices in several currencies. Nothing else in invoicing changes.

name: account_invoice_tree_currency
summary: Adds an optional currency column to the invoice list view, so you can see the currency of each invoice without opening it. It is a small display option for the Customer Invoices and Bills lists.

name: account_invoice_triple_discount
summary: Gives each invoice line three successive discount fields, applied in order so each one acts on the price left by the previous discount. This suits trade discounts that stack on top of each other. The resulting net price shows on the invoice line and in the totals.

name: account_invoice_triple_discount
summary: Adds three successive discount fields to every invoice line, where each discount applies to the result of the one before. It works with invoice lines entered by hand and is shown on the invoice form. If the fixed discount module is also installed, a fixed discount takes priority over the three fields.

name: account_invoice_triple_discount
summary: Adds three successive discount fields to every invoice line, where each discount applies to the result of the one before. It works with invoice lines entered by hand and is shown on the invoice form. If the fixed discount module is also installed, a fixed discount takes priority over the three fields.

name: account_invoice_ubl
summary: Generates UBL XML files for customer invoices and credit notes, either as a PDF with the XML embedded or as an XML file with an optional embedded PDF. It supports UBL 2.1 by default and 2.0. The output format is chosen under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings > Invoicing in the Electronic Invoices section.

name: account_invoice_ubl_payment_mandate
summary: Adds direct debit mandate details to the UBL XML of an invoice when the payment means is direct debit, so the XML carries the mandate reference and the payer bank account. It is a technical extension of the UBL invoice generation and does not change what users see on the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_uom_column
summary: Splits the Quantity column on the printed invoice report into separate Quantity and UoM columns, which makes the units easier to read. It only changes the printed report.

name: account_invoice_validation_queued
summary: Lets you post many draft invoices or bills in background jobs instead of one at a time in the foreground. From the invoice list, select drafts, choose Action > Post entries and then Enqueue Validation, and each invoice gets its own job that can be tracked on a Validation Jobs tab. Sequences should be set to Standard rather than No gap to avoid conflicts.

name: account_invoice_view_payment
summary: Lets users jump straight to the payment from an invoice, either right after Validate & View Payment in the register payment wizard or later from the View Payments link next to the invoice's payments. It is useful when a payment needs a follow-up step such as printing a check. Only users in the Billing group can see the payments from the invoice.

name: account_invoice_warn_message
summary: Adds an invoice warning message field and shows a popup warning on the invoice, so the warning appears not only when the partner changes. It is a small technical extension to the invoice form.

name: account_invoice_warn_message
summary: Shows a warning popup on the invoice form when the customer has a warning message set on its contact, so the user notices before posting. The warning text is copied onto the invoice itself. Use it for customer-specific notices that staff must see.

name: account_journal_dashboard_statement_button
summary: Adds a Statement shortcut button to the Bank and Cash journal cards on the accounting dashboard, which opens the Bank Statements view. The button only appears once the journal has records linked to it.

name: account_journal_general_sequence
summary: Adds a separate Entry Number on journal entries and items, numbered by a sequence set per journal, with the option to renumber entries on demand. Only posted entries get a number, and entry numbers can be used in quick searches. Sequences are set on the journal under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Journals.

name: account_journal_general_sequence
summary: Adds a separate Entry Number on journal entries and items, numbered by a sequence set per journal, with the option to renumber entries on demand. Only posted entries get a number, and entry numbers can be used in quick searches. Sequences are set on the journal under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Journals.

name: account_journal_lock_date
summary: Adds a Lock Date and a Lock Date for Non-Advisers on each journal, so one journal can be closed without locking the others. A wizard can set both dates on several journals at once from the journal list. Set them in the Advanced Settings tab of each journal under Invoicing > Configuration > Journals.

name: account_journal_lock_date
summary: Adds a Lock Date and a Lock Date for Non-Advisers on each journal, so one journal can be closed without locking the others. A wizard can set both dates on several journals at once from the journal list. Set them in the Advanced Settings tab of each journal under Invoicing > Configuration > Journals.

name: account_journal_restrict_mode
summary: Turns on the Lock Posted Entries with Hash setting for every journal by default and stops users from switching it off, so posted entries cannot be changed afterward. The goal is an audit-proof record of posted accounting entries. It is a technical accounting control.

name: account_journal_restrict_mode
summary: Turns on the Lock Posted Entries with Hash setting by default for Sales, Purchase and Miscellaneous journals and stops users from switching it off, so posted entries cannot be changed afterward. Bank and cash journals are excluded because hashing conflicts with how Odoo creates bank transactions. It is a technical accounting control.

name: account_journal_restrict_mode
summary: Turns on the Lock Posted Entries with Hash setting for every journal by default and stops users from switching it off, so posted entries cannot be changed afterward. The goal is an audit-proof record of posted accounting entries. It is a technical accounting control.

name: account_liquidity_forecast
summary: Produces a liquidity forecast report that projects cash position from today to a chosen date, by day, week or month, optionally including draft entries. You can also add planning items for expected cash inflows and outflows on specific dates. The wizard is under Accounting/Invoicing > Reporting > Liquidity Forecast, and the report can be exported to Excel.

name: account_loan
summary: Manages bank loans and leases in Odoo, with a loan record that creates the expected schedule of accounting entries (or invoices for leases) when posted. You can check the amount still owed, record extra debt or repayments, and generate the entries up to a chosen date. Loans are found under Invoicing / Accounting > Accounting > Loans.

name: account_loan
summary: Manages bank loans and leases in Odoo, with a loan record that creates the expected schedule of accounting entries (or invoices for leases) when posted. You can check the amount still owed, record extra debt or repayments, and generate the entries up to a chosen date. Loans are found under Invoicing / Accounting > Accounting > Loans.

name: account_lock_date_update
summary: Lets an accounting adviser change the accounting lock dates from a wizard, without needing access to the full technical settings. It is opened from Actions > Update accounting lock dates and covers the non-adviser lock date, the all-users lock date and the tax lock date. The user needs the Billing Administrator role.

name: account_lock_date_update
summary: Lets an accounting adviser change the accounting lock dates from a wizard, without needing access to the full technical settings. It covers the global, tax, sales, purchase and hard lock dates, opened from Invoicing > Accounting > Lock Dates. The user needs the Billing Administrator role.

name: account_lock_date_update
summary: Lets an accounting adviser change the accounting lock dates from a wizard, without needing access to the full technical settings. It is opened from Actions > Update accounting lock dates and covers the non-adviser lock date, the all-users lock date and the tax lock date. The user needs the Billing Administrator role.

name: account_lock_to_date
summary: Lets you set period and fiscal year lock dates in the future, which stop posting or editing journal entries on or after that date. A wizard under Invoicing / Accounting > Actions > Update accounting lock to dates sets the sales, purchase, global and hard lock dates. Users with the Adviser group are blocked by the Lock To Date, while others are blocked by the non-adviser date.

name: account_lock_to_date
summary: Lets you set period and fiscal year lock dates in the future, which stop posting or editing journal entries on or after that date. A wizard under Invoicing / Accounting > Actions > Update accounting lock to dates sets them. Users with the Adviser group are blocked by the Lock To Date, while others are blocked by the non-adviser date.

name: account_mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds chosen contacts as followers on their company's invoices, so they receive copies of invoice emails. It is enabled per contact with the Invoices option in the In copy of field. It builds on the mail autosubscribe feature.

name: account_mail_autosubscribe
summary: Lets you pick partners who will automatically be copied on all invoices of their company, by ticking Invoices in the In copy of field on the partner. It works through the mail autosubscribe feature.

name: account_manual_currency
summary: Lets users set a currency manually on draft invoices and bills, and choose between the rate on the accounting date and a special rate agreed with the other party. Tick Manual Currency on the draft to type the rate, which also carries into the payment registration wizard. Users need access to multiple currencies to use it.

name: account_mass_reconcile
summary: Automatically matches large numbers of bank and ledger lines in bulk, using reconciliation profiles per account that can run by hand or on a schedule. Two simple methods match a debit and a credit by partner, reference or name, and every run is kept in a history. Start it under Invoicing / Accounting > Mass Automatic Reconcile, with the full accounting features permission.

name: account_mass_reconcile
summary: Automatically matches large numbers of bank and ledger lines in bulk, using reconciliation profiles per account that can run by hand or on a schedule. Two simple methods match a debit and a credit by partner, reference or name, and every run is kept in a history. Start it under Invoicing / Accounting > Mass Automatic Reconcile, with the full accounting features permission.

name: account_maturity_date_default
summary: Sets the due date of a receivable or payable journal item to the entry date when no due date was entered. It is a small technical default that only affects customer and vendor accounts.

name: account_menu_invoice_refund
summary: Adds two combined menus, Customers > Invoices / Credit Notes and Vendors > Bills / Refunds, so invoices and refunds can be found in one place. It is a navigation change only, with no new data.

name: account_menu_invoice_refund
summary: Adds combined menus so that Customers shows Invoices and Credit Notes together, and Vendors shows Bills and Refunds together. It only changes where the documents are found in the menu. No data or workflow is added.

name: account_move_analytic_link
summary: Lets you jump from a posted journal item that has an analytic distribution to the analytic items it generated, using the Open analytic items button on the move line or in the journal items view. It is a navigation shortcut for cost and project tracking.

name: account_move_auto_post_ref
summary: When a recurring invoice is set to auto-post, the next draft invoice it generates keeps the customer reference from the previous one. This saves retyping the reference on every recurring invoice. The customer reference is set on the Other info tab of the invoice.

name: account_move_base_import
summary: Imports bank or payment office files (CSV or Excel) directly as journal entries, using an import journal, and can then auto-complete them with matching rules by partner or statement label. Commissions taken by a payment office can be split out as their own amount. Technical note: it groups several older statement import modules into one.

name: account_move_base_import
summary: Imports bank or payment office files (CSV or Excel) directly as journal entries, using an import journal, and can then auto-complete them with matching rules by partner or statement label. Commissions taken by a payment office can be split out as their own amount. Technical note: it groups several older statement import modules into one.

name: account_move_budget
summary: Lets you define accounting budgets by account, date range and analytic account, independent of any report template. The budgets can then be used as a source in MIS Builder reports, and they are set up under Invoicing / Accounting > Miscellaneous > Account Move Budgets. Use it to compare actual ledger figures against planned amounts.

name: account_move_budget
summary: Lets you define accounting budgets by account, date range and analytic account, independent of any report template. The budgets can then be used as a source in MIS Builder reports, and they are set up under Accounting > Journals > Account Move Budgets. Use it to compare actual ledger figures against planned amounts.

name: account_move_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user clicks to cancel an invoice or journal entry, a confirmation wizard appears with an optional reason field. The wizard is turned on through the configuration of base_cancel_confirm. It adds a safety check before cancellation.

name: account_move_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user cancels an invoice or journal entry, a confirmation wizard appears with an optional reason field. This adds a safety step before cancelling posted accounting documents. The behavior is set up through the base cancel confirmation module.

name: account_move_change_company
summary: Lets you change the company of a journal entry or invoice while it is still in draft, by picking a different company on the record. Once posted, the company cannot be changed. It is useful when an entry was created under the wrong company in a multi-company database.

name: account_move_cutoff
summary: Generates deferred revenue and expense (cut-off) entries automatically when a posted entry has start and end dates, spreading the amount over the periods covered. Accounts are linked to a deferred account, and the generated entries use the Deferred Revenue and Expense journals set in Accounting configuration. It is built on the start and end dates module, and entries are linked back to their source.

name: account_move_fiscal_month
summary: Shows the fiscal month on journal entries and journal items, based on date ranges of the Fiscal Month type. You set up those date ranges and the entries pick up the right month. It is a small reporting aid for accounting periods.

name: account_move_fiscal_year
summary: Shows the fiscal year on journal entries and journal items, using the fiscal years you create under Invoicing > Configuration > Fiscal Years. It helps when reporting or filtering entries by year.

name: account_move_line_check_number
summary: Adds a check number field to journal items, so the check number used for a payment can be seen on the accounting lines. It depends on the check printing module.

name: account_move_line_cumulated_balance
summary: Adds a dedicated Journal Items Cumulated Balance list that shows a running balance per account, under Accounting > Accounting > Journal Items Cumulated Balance. The running total follows the current filter and sort order, and a date filter includes the opening balance before that date. The balance is only computed when the list is grouped or filtered by account, to avoid slow queries.

name: account_move_line_landed_cost_info
summary: Copies the landed cost adjustment lines, such as freight and duties, onto the journal items when a landed cost is validated, so the accounting entries show which landed cost created them. It helps reconcile the Goods Delivered Not Invoiced type accrual accounts. It is a technical traceability module for inventory valuation.

name: account_move_line_mrp_info
summary: Links the journal items generated by manufacturing orders and unbuild orders to those orders, so a stock manager can see the accounting lines from the Manufacturing Orders menu. Users with Show Full Accounting Features can trace an entry back to the production order that created it. Depends on the stock journal item info module.

name: account_move_line_mrp_info
summary: Links the journal items generated by manufacturing orders and unbuild orders to those orders, so a stock manager can see the accounting lines from the Manufacturing Orders menu. Users with Show Full Accounting Features can trace an entry back to the production order that created it. Depends on the stock journal item info module.

name: account_move_line_packaging
summary: Adds a packaging and packaging quantity to invoice lines, so users can enter quantities in packs or cases and the invoiced quantity is recalculated from them. It is set directly on each invoice line.

name: account_move_line_payment
summary: Lets you find journal items that are due today or earlier and register payments for them one by one, even when an invoice has several installments. Items are matched automatically once paid. Start from Invoicing > Review > Control > Journal Items, filter by Overdue and Receivable or Payable, then select the items and use Actions > Register payment.

name: account_move_line_product
summary: Shows the product on journal entries and journal items, which matters for inventory-related accounting entries under perpetual inventory. To see the journal items menu, the user needs the Show Full Accounting Features - Readonly group. It is a view change only.

name: account_move_line_product
summary: Shows the product on journal entries and journal items, which matters for inventory-related accounting entries under perpetual inventory. It is a view change only.

name: account_move_line_purchase_info
summary: Adds the purchase order line to the journal items, so supplier bills and stock receipts can be traced to the purchase order that created them. The purchase order also shows a count and a link to its journal entries. It supports reconciling the Goods Received Not Invoiced accrual account.

name: account_move_line_purchase_packaging
summary: Carries purchase packaging from a purchase order line onto the vendor bill line, and limits vendor bills to purchase packagings. It builds on the invoice line packaging module.

name: account_move_line_reconcile_manual
summary: Adds a wizard that reconciles journal items you select by hand. If the selection balances, it proposes a full reconciliation, otherwise you choose between partial reconciliation and a full reconciliation with a write-off. It brings back the manual reconciliation wizard from older Odoo versions.

name: account_move_line_repair_info
summary: Links the journal items created by repair orders, including invoices from a repair and material consumption entries, back to the repair order. It lets accountants trace repair costs in the ledger.

name: account_move_line_report_xls
summary: Adds an Excel export button to the journal items list, so the selected lines can be downloaded as an XLSX file. The columns can be changed by a developer. Select the lines in the list view and click the export button at the top.

name: account_move_line_sale_info
summary: Adds the sale order line and sale order to the journal items, so customer invoices and delivery entries can be traced to the sales order that created them. It supports reconciling the Goods Delivered Not Invoiced accrual account.

name: account_move_line_sale_info
summary: Adds the sale order line and sale order to the journal items, so entries can be traced to the sales order that created them. It supports reconciling the Goods Delivered Not Invoiced accrual account.

name: account_move_line_stock_info
summary: Adds the stock move to each journal item generated by inventory movements, so accounting lines can be traced to the warehouse transfer that created them. The stock manager sees them under Inventory > Reports > Stock moves. Users with Show Full Accounting Features see the link on the journal entry.

name: account_move_line_stock_info
summary: Shows which stock move each accounting journal line came from, as a column in the journal items list and on the journal item form. Users with access to both Inventory and Accounting can trace an invoice line or journal entry back to its goods movement. The column is hidden by default and can be turned on in the list.

name: account_move_line_tax_editable
summary: Makes tax fields on journal items editable while the entry is still in draft, instead of locked. Once an entry is posted, the taxes are fixed again. It is a fine-tuning option for accountants correcting taxes before posting.

name: account_move_name_sequence
summary: Gives journal entries and invoices their numbers from a sequence set on the journal, instead of letting users type the number by hand, and keeps a sequence for refunds on sales and purchase journals. It can allow gaps for certain document types and handles numbering more safely under concurrent use. The sequence is set on the journal form, and existing journals are updated at install.

name: account_move_name_sequence
summary: Gives journal entries and invoices their numbers from a sequence set on the journal, instead of letting users type the number by hand, and keeps a sequence for refunds on sales and purchase journals. It can allow gaps for certain document types and handles numbering more safely under concurrent use. The sequence is set on the journal form.

name: account_move_original_partner
summary: When one invoice combines several sale orders for different customers, it lists the original sale order customers next to the invoice customer on the invoice form. This makes it clear who each combined order belonged to.

name: account_move_pivot_view
summary: Adds a pivot view to customer invoices, vendor bills, refunds and receipts, so users can summarize amounts by any field in a table. Pivot is an extra view mode on those lists, alongside list and form views. It is useful for quick totals by customer, month or product.

name: account_move_pivot_view
summary: Adds a pivot view to customer invoices, vendor bills and refunds, so users can summarize them by any field, such as partner, product or date, in a grid. It appears as an extra view type on those lists in the accounting menus.

name: account_move_post_date_user
summary: Records the date and time a journal entry was posted and the user who posted it, so you can see when and by whom an entry was validated. The fields appear on the journal entry form.

name: account_move_post_date_user
summary: Records the date and time a journal entry was posted and the user who posted it, so you can see when and by whom an entry was validated. The fields appear on the journal entry form.

name: account_move_print
summary: Adds a Journal Entries option to the print menu of a journal entry, so an entry can be printed as a document. Open a journal entry and use the print button.

name: account_move_reconcile_export
summary: Adds a Reconciled Moves field on invoices that lists the payments matched to them, so the payment dates and amounts can be exported in an Excel or CSV export template. Standard Odoo does not offer an exportable field for this. Build an export template with the reconciled moves and payments fields.

name: account_move_reconcile_forbid_cancel
summary: Blocks cancelling or resetting to draft any invoice or journal entry that has already been reconciled, which usually means paid. Users see an error on the Reset to Draft button when a payment is attached. It protects against unwinding paid invoices.

name: account_move_reconcile_forbid_cancel
summary: Blocks cancelling or resetting to draft any invoice or journal entry that has already been reconciled, which usually means paid. Users see an error on the Reset to Draft button when a payment is attached. It protects against unwinding paid invoices.

name: account_move_reconcile_helper
summary: Adds a button on journal items that shows the lines they are reconciled with, and a Reconciled lines field, which makes matching easier to check. It also adds a balance column on journal items through the account balance line module.

name: account_move_reconcile_helper
summary: Adds a button on journal items that shows the lines they are reconciled with, and a Reconciled lines field, which makes matching easier to check. It also adds a balance column on journal items through the account balance line module.

name: account_move_sent_usability
summary: Adds a filter for Sent and Unsent journal entries and shows the sent status on the entry form. It helps users find invoices that have not yet been sent to the customer.

name: account_move_so_import
summary: Adds sale order based completion rules to the bank statement import, so imported bank lines can be matched to the sale orders they pay. It builds on the journal entry import module and keeps the sale dependency separate.

name: account_move_so_import
summary: Adds sale order based completion rules to the bank statement import, so imported bank lines can be matched to the sale orders they pay. It builds on the journal entry import module and keeps the sale dependency separate.

name: account_move_substate
summary: Adds custom sub-statuses to journal entries, so each main state such as posted or cancelled can have finer steps in your own workflow. The sub-state shows in the header of the entry form. A developer or admin defines the values using the base substate technical setup.

name: account_move_substate
summary: Adds custom sub-statuses to journal entries, so each main state such as posted or cancelled can have finer steps in your own workflow. The sub-state shows in the header of the entry form. A developer or admin defines the values using the base substate technical setup.

name: account_move_tag
summary: Adds colored tags to journal entries and journal items, so vendor bills and customer invoices can be told apart at a glance in the accounting journal. It is a simple labeling feature. Tags are managed on the record and are available in list views.

name: account_move_template
summary: Lets you define journal entry templates for recurring entries, such as monthly accruals, where each line amount is either computed by a formula or typed in when the template is used. A wizard loads a template onto a journal entry and asks for the amounts. Templates are defined under Invoicing / Configuration / Accounting / Journal Entry Templates, and extra options handle negative amounts and preset overwrites.

name: account_move_template
summary: Lets you define journal entry templates for recurring entries, such as monthly accruals, where each line amount is either computed by a formula or typed in when the template is used. A wizard loads a template onto a journal entry and asks for the amounts. Templates are defined under Invoicing / Configuration / Accounting / Journal Entry Templates.

name: account_move_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to invoices and journal entries, where a request for validation must be approved by the defined reviewers before the entry can be posted. Reviewers see pending requests under a Needs my Review filter and a Reviews tab. Tiers are configured under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_move_tier_validation
summary: Adds tier validation to journal entries, invoices and bills, so they need approval from configured reviewers before they can be posted. A user requests validation, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and then the entry can be posted. The Needs my Review filter shows what is waiting on you, and tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_move_tier_validation_approver
summary: Lets each supplier have a default approver for vendor bills, set on the supplier's Sales & Purchase tab. A bill then gets that person as Responsible for Approval, and a tier can be configured to use that field, so the right person signs off. The bill cannot be posted until the tier is validated.

name: account_move_total_by_account_internal_group
summary: Adds hidden totals by account internal group (assets, liabilities, equity, income, expense, off balance) to the journal entries list, with signs that show whether each group increased or decreased. It is useful when looking at stock entries where the usual signed total does not show that direction. The columns are hidden by default.

name: account_move_transfer_partner
summary: Adds a wizard that moves the amount still due on selected customer invoices or vendor bills to another partner, so one partner can settle debts on behalf of others. The wizard can be used only on invoices and refunds, and it lets you choose the destination partner, journal and accounting date.

name: account_move_update_analytic
summary: Lets you change the analytic account and tags on a posted invoice or bill line through an Update analytic wizard, which moves the analytic lines to the new analytic account. It is found on the invoice line or in the journal items view.

name: account_move_update_analytic
summary: Lets you change the analytic distribution on a posted invoice or bill line through an Update analytic wizard, which moves the analytic lines to the new distribution. It is found on the invoice line or in the journal items view.

name: account_multicompany_easy_creation
summary: Adds a wizard under Settings > Users and Companies > Company easy creation that sets up a new company in one step, including its currency, chart of accounts, bank accounts, sequences and the users allowed to use it. It is for multi-company databases where new companies are added regularly.

name: account_multicompany_reporting_currency
summary: Adds a second amount in a multi-company reporting currency to journal entries, using a rate, so figures from different companies can be compared in one currency. It depends on the base multi-company reporting currency module, which sets the currency itself.

name: account_multicurrency_revaluation
summary: Generates automatic revaluation journal entries that adjust foreign currency balances to the current exchange rate, for accounts you flag as allowing currency revaluation. A report wizard under Invoicing > Reporting > Closing Entries > Currency Revaluation Report creates the entries, and a reverse wizard can undo them. Account mappings for gains, losses and provisions are set in the accounting settings, and some of these are restricted to users in the Additional provisioning entries posting group.

name: account_netting
summary: Offsets a receivable balance against a payable balance for the same partner by creating a journal item that records the netting. Select the lines in Journal Items and use Action > Compensate, and the module checks they belong to the same partner and are AR and AP accounts. Some countries forbid this, so check local rules before using it.

name: account_netting
summary: Offsets a receivable balance against a payable balance for the same partner by creating a journal item that records the netting. Select the lines in Journal Items and use Action > Compensate, and the module checks they belong to the same partner and are AR and AP accounts. Some countries forbid this, so check local rules before using it.

name: account_operating_unit
summary: Adds Operating Units to invoices, payments, journal entries and journal items, so a company split into operating units can report and filter balances by unit. If the company marks its units as self-balanced, Odoo adds an inter-operating unit clearing account entry whenever a journal entry spans units. Security rules limit invoices, payments and journal items to the units a user can access.

name: account_operating_unit
summary: Adds Operating Units to invoices, payments, journal entries and journal items, so a company split into operating units can report and filter balances by unit. If the company marks its units as self-balanced, Odoo adds an inter-operating unit clearing account entry whenever a journal entry spans units. Security rules limit invoices, payments and journal items to the units a user can access.

name: account_operating_unit_access_all
summary: Lets a specific user see the accounting of all operating units without being added to each one in their user settings. It suits a shared accounting team that works on documents from every unit. It is switched on per user with the Access all OUs' accounting checkbox.

name: account_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to customer invoices, so invoices can be found and reported by the customer's company group. It builds on the base company group feature. The field shows on the invoice form.

name: account_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a company group field to customer invoices, so invoices can be grouped by the customer's parent group. The group itself is defined in the base partner company group module. It is useful for reporting on invoices for groups of related companies.

name: account_partner_reconcile
summary: Adds Match Receivables and Match Payables buttons on the customer and supplier form, which start matching the open invoices and payments of that partner. Only Accountant and Adviser users see the buttons. Turn on Show Full Accounting Features first.

name: account_partner_reconcile
summary: Adds Match Receivables and Match Payables buttons on the customer and supplier form, which start matching the open invoices and payments of that partner. Only Accountant and Adviser users see the buttons. Turn on Show Full Accounting Features first.

name: account_partner_required
summary: Adds a Partner policy setting to account types, with three choices: optional, always require a partner, or never allow one. Odoo then blocks journal lines that break the chosen policy, which helps enforce a customer or supplier on receivable and payable accounts. Configured under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Account Types.

name: account_partner_required
summary: Adds a Partner policy setting to accounts, with three choices: optional, always require a partner, or never allow one. Odoo then blocks journal lines that break the chosen policy, which helps enforce a customer or supplier on receivable and payable accounts. Configured under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Chart of Accounts.

name: account_payment_base_oca
summary: Base module for the OCA bank payment alternative project, which extends Odoo's native payment methods. It lets one payment method, such as a wire transfer to suppliers, stay unlinked to a bank account and pick which bank is debited when paying. It can also show a partly scrambled bank account number on invoices.

name: account_payment_base_oca_sale
summary: Adds a Payment Mode field to sale orders and to the sales analysis report, and puts payment instructions on the quotation and order report. It is the sales side of the OCA payment base module.

name: account_payment_base_oca_sale
summary: Adds a Payment Mode field to sale orders and to the sales analysis report. The mode is copied from the customer to the order and then to the invoice, and can be changed on a draft order or invoice. It is the sales side of the OCA payment base module.

name: account_payment_batch_oca
summary: Adds payment orders for paying supplier bills in batches, and debit orders for collecting from customers in batches. You pick the open lines to pay or debit, and the order produces the batch for the bank. The actions Add to Payment Order and Add to Debit Order are available on the invoices.

name: account_payment_batch_oca_reconcile
summary: Makes it easier to reconcile one bank statement line that covers a whole payment or debit batch. In the bank reconciliation screen, a Payment Lots or Debit Lots tab lets you select the batch and the counterpart lines are set automatically. It works with or without outstanding payment accounts.

name: account_payment_batch_oca_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to payment orders and debit orders, so a request must be approved by the defined reviewers before the payments can be confirmed. Reviewers filter the orders that need their review. Tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_payment_batch_process
summary: Lets you record one batch payment that settles several customer invoices or supplier bills, from a single wizard that lists the invoices. Each invoice can be paid in part, with the remainder left open or written off to an account. It is an older batch payment wizard, used with check printing.

name: account_payment_batch_process_discount
summary: Applies early payment discounts in the batch payment wizard, so invoices paid within the discount window get the discounted amount. Early discount is set on the payment term, with a discount percent and a number of days. It works from the Batch Payments action on selected invoices or bills.

name: account_payment_credit_card
summary: Records credit card purchases as vendor bills and pays them the normal way, while automatically creating the journal entry that moves the supplier liability to the credit card company. A journal is set up for each card with the Transfer AP to Credit Card Company option. Charges that are not on the statement, such as fees, can be added when the card is settled.

name: account_payment_credit_card
summary: Records credit card purchases as vendor bills and pays them the normal way, while automatically creating the journal entry that moves the supplier liability to the credit card company. A journal is set up for each card with the Transfer AP to Credit Card Company option. Charges that are not on the statement, such as fees, can be added when the card is settled.

name: account_payment_discount
summary: Adds early payment discounts to payment lines, so that paying within the discount date creates the extra journal line for the discount automatically. It uses the standard Odoo cash discount setup on payment terms and no new configuration. Discount details are shown on the payment lines.

name: account_payment_line
summary: Lets one payment be split across several invoices, with specific write-offs and analytic details on each counterpart line. It suggests how to distribute a payment across the partner's open items ordered by due date, and any lines you add by hand are used as usual. It is a payment distribution tool.

name: account_payment_line
summary: Lets one payment be split across several invoices, with specific write-offs and analytic details on each counterpart line. It suggests how to distribute a payment across the partner's open items ordered by due date, and any lines you add by hand are used as usual. It is a payment distribution tool.

name: account_payment_line_import
summary: Adds an Excel import to payments, so a payment distribution across invoices can be loaded from a spreadsheet. A sample file is available in the wizard that opens from the Import Excel action on a draft payment. It builds on the payment counterpart lines module.

name: account_payment_mandate
summary: Adds banking mandates, which record a customer's authorization for direct debits, such as SEPA or LSV. A mandate is attached to a bank account of the customer, and debit orders can require a valid one. Mandates are set up from the accounting menu or directly on a bank account, under Customers > Debit Orders.

name: account_payment_mandate_sale
summary: Adds a Direct Debit Mandate field to sale orders. When the chosen payment mode needs a mandate, the first valid mandate of the customer is pre-filled, and it is copied to the invoice. It also adds an invoicing commercial entity field.

name: account_payment_method_base
summary: Adds a list view, a form view and a menu entry for Odoo's built-in payment methods, which had no screens of their own. It is a technical module that makes payment methods visible and editable. Used as a base by other payment modules.

name: account_payment_method_base_mode
summary: Glue module that makes the payment mode screens inherit from the standard payment method views. It adds no new features, but keeps the payment method screens consistent across the two modules. It is technical, and nothing needs configuring.

name: account_payment_method_fs_storage
summary: Lets a payment method name a storage location, so the SEPA payment file generated from a payment order is saved there automatically when the payment is made. The storage must be enabled for use on payment methods, and it only applies to SEPA payments. It is a technical integration with the file storage module.

name: account_payment_mode
summary: Adds Payment Modes, a way to classify incoming and outgoing payments and route them to banks. Each mode links a payment method, a bank journal or allowed journals, and a payment type, and is managed under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Payment Modes. On its own it adds no screens for users; other modules rely on it.

name: account_payment_mode
summary: Adds Payment Modes, which classify how customers and suppliers pay and route payments to banks. The mode can be set on partners and invoices, filters the invoices included in a payment order, and controls how much of a customer's bank account number is printed on the invoice. It is configured under Invoicing/Accounting > Configuration > Management > Payment Modes.

name: account_payment_mode
summary: Adds Payment Modes, which classify how payments are routed to banks. It adds no visible feature of its own and is used by other modules. The modes are configured under Invoicing/Accounting > Configuration > Management > Payment Modes.

name: account_payment_mode_brand
summary: Restricts which payment modes can be used for each brand, so an invoice for a brand only offers the payment modes that brand allows. Brands are set up in Settings > Users & Companies > Brands, and the brand is picked on the invoice before the payment mode list narrows.

name: account_payment_multi_deduction
summary: Adds a Mark invoice as fully paid (multi deduct) option to the register payment wizard, so the gap between the payment and the invoice can be split across several deductions such as bank fees or write-offs. The deductions must add up to the payment difference before validation. The option appears when the amount paid is less than the invoice.

name: account_payment_multi_deduction
summary: Adds a Mark invoice as fully paid (multi deduct) option to the register payment wizard, so the gap between the payment and the invoice can be split across several deductions such as bank fees or write-offs. The deductions must add up to the payment difference before validation. The option appears when the amount paid is less than the invoice.

name: account_payment_notification
summary: Sends customers or suppliers a notification by email and/or SMS when a payment or debit order is sent. Notifications can be sent by hand from the Action menu on selected payments, or automatically when a payment is marked as sent. The notification method and automation are set under Settings > Invoicing.

name: account_payment_order
summary: Adds payment orders for vendor payments and debit orders for customer collections, where you pick the open invoice lines to pay or debit and then generate the bank file. Payment orders are under Invoicing > Vendors > Payment Orders, and debit orders under Invoicing > Customers > Debit Orders. Supplier and customer invoices also get Add to Payment Order and Add to Debit Order actions.

name: account_payment_order_grouped_output
summary: Adds an option to generate extra grouped journal entries for payment orders, combining the payments by payment date. This makes large payment orders easier to match on the bank statement, since one entry can match one bank line. It is a technical option on the payment mode, and it depends on the payment order module.

name: account_payment_order_grouped_output
summary: Adds an option to create extra grouped journal entries for a payment order, so a large batch can be reconciled on the bank statement as one or a few entries by payment date. The option is set on the payment mode. It is useful when a big payment run is hard to match line by line.

name: account_payment_order_notification
summary: Adds a button on payment and debit orders that emails each partner the details of their transactions in that order. It is used after invoices are linked to a payment mode and added to a payment or debit order. Partner email addresses must be set on the customers.

name: account_payment_order_notification
summary: Adds a button on payment and debit orders that emails each related customer or vendor a summary of their transactions in that order. Recipients can be reviewed in a wizard before sending. The order keeps a count of the notifications it has generated.

name: account_payment_order_return
summary: Adds an option in the debit order wizard that includes invoice lines already linked to a payment return, so a failed debit can be collected again. Use the Include move lines from returns checkbox before adding all move lines. It depends on the payment return and payment order modules.

name: account_payment_order_return
summary: Adds an option in the Create Payment Lines wizard to include invoices linked to a payment return, so a rejected direct debit can be collected again in a new debit order. Tick Include move lines from returns before adding all lines. It extends the payment order and payment return features.

name: account_payment_order_tier_validation
summary: Adds tier validation to payment orders, so they need approval from configured reviewers before payments are confirmed. Request validation on the order, review the pending approvals in the Reviews tab, then confirm the payments once everyone has approved. Tiers are configured under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_payment_order_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to payment orders, so a request must be approved by the defined reviewers before the payments can be confirmed. Reviewers filter the orders that need their review. Tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_payment_order_vendor_email
summary: Lets a payment mode send the payment details by email to the partner, using an email template chosen on the mode. It also tracks a discount amount on payment lines. It is set on the payment mode.

name: account_payment_partner
summary: Adds a Supplier Payment Mode and Customer Payment Mode to partners, and a Payment Mode on invoices that defaults from the partner. It controls which bank account is shown on the invoice, can hide digits of the customer account, and filters the invoices offered in a payment order. Invoices without a payment mode are still shown.

name: account_payment_partner
summary: Adds customer and supplier payment modes to contacts, and a payment mode on invoices that defaults from the contact. When creating a payment order, invoices are filtered by payment mode, and invoices without a mode still appear. It also controls how much of a customer's bank account number is printed on the invoice.

name: account_payment_promissory_note
summary: Lets you set a due date on a payment recorded as a promissory note. When invoices are selected, the latest due date among them is filled in automatically. It is used on customer and vendor payments that are marked Promissory Note.

name: account_payment_promissory_note
summary: Lets you set a due date on a payment recorded as a promissory note. When invoices are selected, the latest due date among them is filled in automatically. It is used on customer and vendor payments marked Promissory Note.

name: account_payment_purchase
summary: Adds a Supplier Bank Account and a Payment Mode to purchase orders, copied from the supplier to the order and then to the vendor bill. The values can be changed on a draft order or bill. Once a payment order is made, only bills with the chosen payment mode, or no mode, are listed.

name: account_payment_purchase
summary: Adds a Supplier Bank Account and a Payment Mode to purchase orders, copied from the vendor and then carried onto the vendor bill. They can be changed on a draft order or bill if needed. The bill then carries the right bank details for payment.

name: account_payment_purchase_stock
summary: Joins the purchase payment mode feature with the purchase and stock modules so the two work together. It adds no visible feature of its own and is used by other modules.

name: account_payment_purchase_stock
summary: Glue module that connects purchase payment modes with purchasing and receiving. It adds no new screens of its own. It is technical and used by other modules.

name: account_payment_return
summary: Records customer payments that the bank returned, such as bounced transfers or failed direct debits, and reopens the related invoices so the debt is open again with history kept. You enter a return with the reconciled receivable lines and the amount returned, and can match it to invoices. It is found under Invoicing > Customers > Customer Payment Returns.

name: account_payment_return
summary: Records customer payments that the bank returned, such as bounced transfers or failed direct debits, and reopens the related invoices so the debt is open again with history kept. You enter a return with the reconciled receivable lines and the amount returned, and can match it to invoices. It is found under Invoicing > Customers > Customer Payment Returns.

name: account_payment_return_financial_risk
summary: Ties returned payments into a customer's financial risk. Returned payments add to the customer's risk amount, and a customer over the limit cannot confirm new sales orders. It is set up the same way as Financial Risk, with an extra option to include payment returns.

name: account_payment_return_financial_risk
summary: Counts customer payment returns against the customer's financial risk limit, so a partner who exceeds the limit cannot confirm new sales orders. It extends the financial risk module and is set per customer in the Financial Risk settings. The rule is tested by trying to raise an invoice above the limit after a return.

name: account_payment_return_import
summary: Adds an Import Payment Return wizard under Invoicing > Customers, which loads a CSV file of bank returns and creates the payment return records automatically. Multiple files in a zip are supported. It is a generic base that other modules extend for specific bank formats.

name: account_payment_return_import
summary: Adds an Import Payment Return wizard under Invoicing > Customers, which loads a CSV file of bank returns and creates the payment return records automatically. Multiple files in a zip are supported. It is a generic base that other modules extend for specific bank formats.

name: account_payment_return_import_iso20022
summary: Imports payment returns from ISO 20022 bank files (pain.002 and camt.054), so returned payments from the bank can be loaded into Odoo without typing them in. It extends the payment return import wizard and works with the payment order module.

name: account_payment_return_import_iso20022
summary: Imports payment returns from ISO 20022 bank files (pain.002, camt.053 and camt.054), so returned payments from the bank can be loaded into Odoo without typing them in. It extends the payment return import wizard and works with the payment order module.

name: account_payment_return_import_iso20022
summary: Imports payment returns from ISO 20022 bank files (pain.002 and camt.054), so returned payments from the bank can be loaded into Odoo without typing them in. It extends the payment return import wizard and works with the payment order module.

name: account_payment_sale
summary: Adds a Payment Mode field to sales orders, copied from the customer and then onto the customer invoice. It can be changed on the order or on a draft invoice. This routes sales payments through the right payment mode automatically.

name: account_payment_sale
