summary: Adds a Payment Mode field to sales orders, copied from the customer's default and then onto the customer invoice. It can be changed on the sale order or on a draft invoice. It is the sales side of the payment partner module.

name: account_payment_sepa_base
summary: Technical base for SEPA file generation. It holds the fields and functions shared by the SEPA credit transfer and SEPA direct debit modules, including the company initiating party identifiers set in Invoicing/Accounting > Configuration > Settings under SEPA/PAIN. It adds no feature by itself.

name: account_payment_sepa_credit_transfer
summary: Exports supplier payment orders as SEPA credit transfer XML files in ISO 20022 PAIN format, which the bank can import to pay many suppliers at once. It also supports SEPA instant transfers and non-euro wire transfer files. You create a payment order under Invoicing/Accounting > Vendors > Payment Orders and choose a SEPA payment method.

name: account_payment_sepa_direct_debit
summary: Exports customer debit orders as SEPA direct debit XML files in ISO 20022 PAIN format, so the bank can collect from many customers at once. It supports SEPA Core and B2B mandates. You create a debit order under Invoicing/Accounting > Customers > Debit Orders and choose a SEPA direct debit payment mode.

name: account_payment_show_invoice
summary: Adds an Invoices column to the payments list, showing which invoices each payment settled, using the vendor reference by default. It appears under Invoicing > Vendors > Payments and Invoicing > Customers > Payments.

name: account_payment_state_keep_draft
summary: Lets customer and vendor payments be registered in Draft instead of being posted and marked as Paid straight away. Draft payments can be checked before they are confirmed, and reconciliation happens once the payment is posted. The default state is set per payment type under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings.

name: account_payment_term_discount
summary: Adds early payment discounts to payment terms, so a customer who pays within a set number of days gets the discount when registering the payment. Terms are set with a discount percent and days, and the discount can exclude shipping and taxes. The discount is recorded on the invoice and posted to discount income or expense accounts.

name: account_payment_term_extension
summary: Extends payment terms with rounding, month and week periods, several payment days, holiday postponement, and lines that count from the previous line's due date. Due dates on invoices then follow these richer rules. Set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Invoicing > Payment Terms.

name: account_payment_term_extension
summary: Extends payment terms with rounding, month and week periods, several payment days, holiday postponement, and lines that count from the previous line's due date. Due dates on invoices then follow these richer rules. Set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Invoicing > Payment Terms.

name: account_payment_term_partner_holiday
summary: Lets a customer or supplier have holiday periods, so that a computed due date falling in one of them is moved to the first available date. The periods are entered on the contact's Sales & Purchase tab. It builds on the payment term extension module.

name: account_payment_term_partner_paydays
summary: Lets each customer or supplier have their own payment days, which override the payment days set on the payment term when the due date of an invoice is calculated. The days are set on the contact record. It builds on the payment term extension module.
keywords: pay on the first of month

name: account_payment_term_restriction
summary: Restricts each payment term to sales, purchase or both, so a sales-only term cannot be used on a bill and a purchase-only term cannot be used on an invoice. The setting is on the payment term form under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Payment Terms.

name: account_payment_term_restriction_purchase
summary: Stops payment terms that are restricted to sales from being used on purchase orders. Only terms set to Purchases or All can be chosen on a purchase order. It extends the payment term restriction module.

name: account_payment_term_restriction_sale
summary: Stops payment terms that are restricted to purchases from being used on sale orders. Only terms set to Sales or All can be chosen on a sale order. It extends the payment term restriction module.

name: account_payment_term_security
summary: Limits changing the payment terms on customers and invoices to users who have the Change payment terms in partners and invoices permission. Others see the terms but cannot edit them. The permission is set on the user record.

name: account_payment_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to customer and vendor payments. A user requests validation on a payment, each reviewer in the tier chain signs off, and the payment can only be confirmed once every review has passed. Reviews appear on the Payment form under the Reviews tab, with a 'Needs my Review' filter to find items waiting on you; tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: account_payment_unece
summary: Adds a UNECE standard payment means code to each payment method, so electronic invoices (CII and UBL formats) carry the correct payment type. Set it on each payment method under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Payment Methods. Mainly useful if you send e-invoices that need a standard payment code.

name: account_payment_unece
summary: Adds a UNECE standard payment means code to each technical payment method, so electronic invoices (CII and UBL formats) carry the correct payment type. Set it on each payment method under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Technical Payment Methods. Mainly useful if you send e-invoices that need a standard payment code.

name: account_payment_unece
summary: Adds a UNECE standard payment means code to each payment method, so electronic invoices (CII and UBL formats) carry the correct payment type. Set it on each payment method under Accounting > Configuration > Management > Payment Methods. Mainly useful if you send e-invoices that need a standard payment code.

name: account_payment_widget_amount
summary: On an invoice or bill with outstanding payments, a popover lets you choose how much of a specific payment to apply to it, instead of the full amount. Odoo then reconciles that partial amount automatically. Shows in the invoice form under Invoicing > Customers > Invoices or Vendors > Bills.
keywords: apply part of payment to invoice

name: account_payment_widget_amount
summary: On an invoice or bill with outstanding payments, a popover lets you choose how much of a specific payment to apply to it, instead of the full amount. Odoo then reconciles that partial amount automatically. Shows in the invoice form under Invoicing > Sales > Customer Invoices or Purchases > Vendor Bills.
keywords: apply part of payment to invoice

name: account_payroll_sheet_import
summary: Lets accountants upload an Excel (.xlsx) payroll file and post it as accounting journal entries. Columns are mapped to accounts per company, employees are matched by VAT, ID or passport number, and any missing employees are listed in a report wizard. Use it when an external payroll provider sends spreadsheets and you need them posted to Odoo accounting.

name: account_period_lock_date_multi_company
summary: Lets you set accounting lock dates for each company from one list view, for databases with several companies. Lock dates stop entries being posted before that date. Find it under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Companies Accounting Locks.

name: account_portal_invoice_search
summary: Adds search by invoice name and reference to the Invoices & Bills page in the customer portal. Portal users can find a specific document faster. Nothing changes for internal users.

name: account_product_fiscal_classification
summary: Replaces setting sale and purchase taxes one by one on each product with a single Fiscal Classification. Choosing a classification on a product sets both its taxes, and incompatible tax combinations are blocked. Optional rules restrict classifications to product categories, under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Fiscal Classifications.

name: account_product_fiscal_classification
summary: Replaces setting sale and purchase taxes one by one on each product with a single Fiscal Classification. Choosing a classification on a product sets both its taxes, and incompatible tax combinations are blocked. Adds fiscal classification templates that load with a chart of accounts template.

name: account_purchase_stock_report_non_billed
summary: Adds goods received on purchase orders to the Non Billed Stock Moves report, so received items not yet covered by a vendor bill show up with the quantity still to invoice. Pick a date and the report lists moves created before it. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Non Billed Stock Moves.

name: account_purchase_stock_report_non_billed
summary: Adds goods received on purchase orders to the Non Billed Stock Moves report, so received items not yet covered by a vendor bill show up with the quantity still to invoice. Pick a date and the report lists moves created before it. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Non Billed Stock Moves.

name: account_receipt_journal
summary: Creates separate journals for sales receipts and purchase receipts, so they are kept apart from invoices and bills. Turn on Sale Receipt in Accounting settings, then find the two new journals under Accounting > Configuration > Journals. Once a receipt journal exists, receipts must use it rather than a normal journal.

name: account_receipt_journal
summary: Lets you create journals used only for sales and purchase receipts, and makes receipts use them automatically. Once a receipt journal exists, normal journals can no longer be used for receipts. The option is set on the journal itself.

name: account_receipt_send
summary: Adds a Send and Print button to customer receipts, plus a mail template for emailing a receipt to the customer. Create a receipt under Invoicing > Customers > Receipts, confirm it, then use the button. Turn on Sale Receipt in Accounting settings first.

name: account_receipt_send
summary: Adds a Send button and a dedicated mail template for sales receipts, so a receipt can be emailed to the customer like an invoice. It is switched on with the Sale Receipt option under Invoicing > Configuration > Customer Invoices. Receipts are then created from the Customers > Receipts menu.

name: account_reconcile_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you put analytic tags on bank statement lines and on reconciliation model lines, so bank transactions carry the same cost centre or department tags as the rest of your accounting. Tags are set during bank reconciliation. Requires the Analytic Tags feature to be turned on.

name: account_reconcile_due_date
summary: Adds a due date field to bank statement lines, and carries it into the journal items created when you reconcile. Set the date on a bank transaction during import or reconciliation, then check it on Journal Items. Find bank lines from the bank card on Invoicing > Overview.
keywords: set due date on bank line

name: account_reconcile_match_regex
summary: Adds a regular expression field to reconciliation models, so messy bank labels are cleaned up before Odoo searches for the invoice. For example, the pattern Fattura (.*) turns the label Fattura INV/21/12323 into INV/21/12323 and matches on that. Set it on an invoice matching rule under the reconciliation models.
keywords: extract invoice number from bank description

name: account_reconcile_model_multicompany_propagate
summary: Adds a Propagate to companies button on reconciliation models, copying a model to other companies that share the same chart of accounts. Companies with a matching model of the same name are skipped, and the journal is not copied. Found under Invoicing > Settings > Conciliation Models, and the user needs access to the other companies.
keywords: copy reconciliation model to other companies

name: account_reconcile_model_oca
summary: Restores the unique matching option on reconciliation models, which Odoo moved from Community to Enterprise in version 17. Turning it on makes a rule match only when exactly one candidate fits. Set it on the reconciliation model form under the bank reconciliation rules.

name: account_reconcile_oca
summary: Adds the Community reconciliation widget for bank statements and for accounts marked as reconcile. From Invoicing > Dashboard, or Accounting > Actions > Reconcile, you can match bank lines and journal items to invoices and payments, including aggregated lines and manual entries. This is a base engine that other reconciliation modules in this family build on.

name: account_reconcile_oca
summary: Adds the Community reconciliation widget for bank statements and for accounts marked as reconcile. From Invoicing > Dashboard, or Invoicing > Accounting > Actions > Reconcile, you can match bank lines and journal items to invoices and payments, including manual entries. This is a base engine that other reconciliation modules build on.

name: account_reconcile_oca_add_default_filters
summary: When a bank statement line has a customer or vendor, the Reconcile tab opens already filtered to that partner. It also limits to receivable, payable and outstanding payment or receipt accounts, so VAT lines are hidden by default. Lines without a partner behave as before, with no default filters.

name: account_reconcile_oca_add_default_filters
summary: When a bank statement line has a customer or vendor, the Reconcile tab opens already filtered to that partner. It also limits to receivable, payable and outstanding payment or receipt accounts, so VAT lines are hidden by default. Lines without a partner behave as before, with no default filters.

name: account_reconcile_oca_queue
summary: Runs automatic bank reconciliation as a background queue job, so importing a large bank statement does not tie up the screen. Turn on Auto reconcile in background in Accounting settings, which is stored per company. Useful when statements have many lines and processing is slow.

name: account_reconcile_restrict_partner_mismatch
summary: Blocks reconciling receivable or payable items when their partners differ, or when only one of them has a partner. Existing mismatches can be listed under Accounting > Adviser > Reconciled items with partner mismatch. The rule can be turned off per company, and per journal under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Journals.

name: account_reconcile_sale_order
summary: Lets you hold off invoicing sales orders until the payment arrives. A bank payment matching an invoiceable sales order can be reconciled directly, and the order appears in the Sales Orders tab of the reconciliation widget. Set up a rule of type Rule to match sales orders under Invoicing > Configuration > Reconciliation Models.
keywords: match sales order to bank payment

name: account_reconcile_wizard
summary: Replaces the reconcile action with a wizard that matches selected journal items from the same account, or from different accounts of the same partner. Differences create a transfer entry or a write-off entry, and partial reconciliation can be allowed. Found under Invoicing > Accounting > Reconcile, and it can replace the netting module.

name: account_refund_early_payment_discount
summary: Lets early payment discount terms apply to customer credit notes and vendor refunds, not just to invoices and bills. The discount is set through the payment terms as usual, and the refund shows the discounted amount. Useful when refunds are settled with a prompt payment discount.

name: account_reporting_volume
summary: Adds a Volume measure to the Invoice Analysis report, so you can total the volume of invoiced goods by product, customer or period. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Management > Invoice Analysis, by adding Volume from the Measures menu.

name: account_reporting_weight
summary: Adds a Weight measure to the Invoice Analysis report, so you can total the weight of invoiced goods by product, customer or period. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Management > Invoice Analysis, by adding Weight from the Measures menu. Visible to users with the Accountant role in Accounting & Finance.

name: account_reversal
summary: Improves reversing journal entries. Adds a To Be Reversed checkbox and filter on entries, a reason field on journal items, and a reason on the reverse wizard for all entry types. Find the checkbox in the Other Info tab of a journal entry, and the list of entries to reverse under Accounting > Journal Entries to be Reversed.

name: account_sale_stock_report_non_billed
summary: Adds a Non Billed Stock Moves report. Pick a date and it lists delivery stock moves created before that date that still have quantity to invoice, with the amount to invoice. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Non Billed Stock Moves, with a threshold date that can be set per company.

name: account_sale_stock_report_non_billed
summary: Adds a Non Billed Stock Moves report. Pick a date and it lists delivery stock moves created before that date that still have quantity to invoice, with the amount to invoice. Found under Invoicing > Reporting > Non Billed Stock Moves, with a threshold date that can be set per company.

name: account_sequence_option
summary: Lets invoices, bills and journal entries use optional numbering sequences, for example different numbering schemes or year-based prefixes. Enable Use sequence options in developer mode under Settings > Technical > Manage Sequence Options. Sequence options can also be defined in XML for a new year-based scheme.

name: account_sequence_option
summary: Lets invoices, bills and journal entries use optional numbering sequences, for example different numbering schemes or year-based prefixes. Enable Use sequence options in developer mode under Settings > Technical > Manage Sequence Options. Sequence options can also be defined in XML for a new year-based scheme.

name: account_spread_cost_revenue
summary: Spreads a cost or revenue over several periods, for example a yearly prepaid expense booked monthly. You create a spread board with the total amount, number of periods and start date, and it generates the journal entries for each period. Found under Invoicing > Accounting > Journals > Spread Costs/Revenues; full features need the Show Full Accounting Features group.

name: account_spread_cost_revenue
summary: Spreads a cost or revenue over several periods, for example a yearly prepaid expense booked monthly. You create a spread board with the total amount, number of periods and start date, and it generates the journal entries for each period. Found under Invoicing > Accounting > Journals > Spread Costs/Revenues; full features need the Show Full Accounting Features group.

name: account_spread_cost_revenue_enhanced
summary: Adds extra spread features: link a spread sheet to an existing journal entry (not only an invoice), and create the spread entries as an invoice rather than a plain entry. Needs the base spread module, account_spread_cost_revenue, installed.

name: account_statement_base
summary: Technical base module that restores the Bank Statement and Bank Statement Lines views, which left core Accounting in Odoo 16. Other bank statement modules depend on it. Nothing here for end users to use directly.

name: account_statement_base
summary: Technical base module that restores the Bank Statement Lines views, which left core Accounting in Odoo 16. Other bank statement modules depend on it. Nothing here for end users to use directly.

name: account_statement_import_base
summary: Technical base module shared by the file-based and online bank statement import modules. It adds an import ID and raw data to bank statement lines, which helps avoid importing the same transaction twice. Nothing here for end users to run directly.

name: account_statement_import_base
summary: Technical base module that shares code between the file-based and online bank statement import modules. It adds a unique import ID and raw data to bank statement lines, which helps avoid importing the same line twice. It has no screens of its own.

name: account_statement_import_base
summary: Technical base module shared by the file-based and online bank statement import modules. It adds an import ID and raw data to bank statement lines, which helps avoid importing the same transaction twice. Nothing here for end users to run directly.

name: account_statement_import_camt
summary: Adds import of CAMT.053 and CAMT.054 bank statement files, the SEPA XML formats that banks use for statements and payment batches. Once installed, these formats are available in the statement import wizard on a bank journal. It is a file format add-on for the generic statement file import.

name: account_statement_import_camt54
summary: Imports CAMT.054 customer payment batch files into a dedicated journal, reconciling the customer invoices as paid and posting the payments to an internal transfer account. You then import the full CAMT.053 statement into the bank journal to clear that transfer account. It can also add a balancing line to the statement and includes Swiss QRR partner reference support.

name: account_statement_import_camt54
summary: Imports CAMT.054 customer payment batch files into a dedicated journal, reconciling the customer invoices they pay and posting the payments to an internal transfer account. The CAMT.053 full statement can then be imported and the transfer account cleared. An optional balancing line can be enabled on the journal, and a Swiss ISR partner reference setting is included.

name: account_statement_import_file
summary: Provides the framework for importing bank statement files from a bank journal's dashboard. Choose a file, and Odoo creates one or more bank statements and attaches the original file for reference. Format-specific modules, such as OFX or spreadsheet imports, add support for the actual file types.

name: account_statement_import_file
summary: Provides the framework for importing bank statement files. Each bank journal gets an Import Statement button on the Invoicing dashboard that opens a wizard listing the supported formats. It also attaches the source file to the statement and handles files covering several bank accounts; a format module such as OFX is still needed to read a given file type.

name: account_statement_import_file_reconcile_oca
summary: Adds an Import and Start to Reconcile button to the bank statement file import wizard. After the file is imported, Odoo goes straight to the reconciliation screen. Requires the Community reconciliation module account_reconcile_oca.

name: account_statement_import_file_reconcile_oca
summary: Adds an Import and Start to Reconcile button to the statement import wizard, so after importing a file the user goes straight to the reconciliation screen. It joins the file import and the reconcile modules together. It requires both to be installed.

name: account_statement_import_move_line
summary: Adds an Import journal items button on a bank statement and on the bank journal's dashboard. It opens a wizard that filters and selects accounting lines to add as bank statement lines. Users need the Show Full Accounting Features group to use it.

name: account_statement_import_ofx
summary: Adds support for importing OFX bank statement files, a common format that banks export, including files that cover several bank accounts. Use it from the statement import wizard on a bank journal. Only the transactions needed for accounting are brought in.

name: account_statement_import_ofx
summary: Imports bank statements from OFX files (Open Financial Exchange), including files that cover several bank accounts. Use the Import Statement button on the bank journal in the Invoicing dashboard and select the OFX file. Only the transaction data needed for accounting is kept.

name: account_statement_import_ofx_by_acctid
summary: Adds an OFX ACCTID field to bank accounts, so OFX statements are matched to the bank account by that value. If the field is empty, Odoo falls back to the account number. Use it when the ID in your OFX files differs from the number saved in Odoo, and set it under Contacts > Configuration > Bank Accounts.

name: account_statement_import_ofx_by_acctid
summary: Adds an OFX ACCTID field to bank accounts and matches OFX statements by that value first, falling back to the account number only when it is empty. This fixes import mismatches when the account number in the file differs from the one saved in Odoo. Set the field under Contacts > Configuration > Bank Accounts.

name: account_statement_import_online
summary: Technical base for online bank statement providers, which pull transactions from a bank's web service into Odoo. A provider is set up on a bank journal under Online Bank Statement Providers, and statements are then pulled for a chosen date range. Empty statements can be allowed per provider, and the Show Full Accounting Features group is required.

name: account_statement_import_online_gocardless
summary: Pulls bank transactions from GoCardless Bank Account Data into bank statements, either for a historical date range or automatically through a scheduled pull. You connect the bank with a GoCardless user secret on the journal's online provider. Pull historical statements from Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Journals.

name: account_statement_import_online_gocardless
summary: Pulls bank transactions from GoCardless Bank Account Data into bank statements for a bank journal, either on request or through a scheduled pull. It needs a GoCardless account and a user secret configured on the provider. GoCardless provides a free API for connecting bank accounts.

name: account_statement_import_online_ofx
summary: Pulls bank statements online from OFX institutions, with a list of over 300 supported institutions available. You set up a provider per bank with its login details under Invoicing > Configuration > Online Bank Statement Providers, then run the pull wizard from the journal. An option allows empty statements to be created on each pull.

name: account_statement_import_online_paypal
summary: Pulls PayPal transactions into the PayPal bank journal as online bank statements, using PayPal API credentials. Open the journal, click Pull Online Bank Statement and choose a date range. Setup requires a Client ID and Secret from PayPal Developer.

name: account_statement_import_online_paypal
summary: Pulls PayPal transactions into bank statements for the journal that represents the PayPal account, for a date range you choose. It needs a Client ID and Secret from a PayPal for Business account. The statements then appear in the usual reconciliation flow.

name: account_statement_import_online_plaid
summary: Pulls bank transactions from Plaid.com into bank statements, with both Sandbox and Production environments supported. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account, choose Plaid as the online provider, and sync from the bank account's actions. Statements can then be pulled for a date range.

name: account_statement_import_online_plaid
summary: Pulls online bank statements from Plaid.com, with both Sandbox and Production environments supported. Set the bank account's Bank Feeds to Online, choose Plaid.com as the provider, then sync with Plaid and pull a date range. A scheduled pull can also run automatically.

name: account_statement_import_online_ponto
summary: Pulls transactions from MyPonto.com into bank statements for linked bank accounts, for a date range you choose or through the scheduled pull. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account and select MyPonto as the online provider. Once configured, new transactions arrive without manual imports.

name: account_statement_import_online_qonto
summary: Pulls online bank statements from the Qonto bank into Odoo. Set the bank account's Bank Feeds to Online, select Qonto as the provider, then pull a date range from the pull wizard. Setup is done under Invoicing > Configuration > Bank Accounts.

name: account_statement_import_online_stripe
summary: Pulls Stripe balance transactions into a bank journal as statement lines, with Stripe fees recorded separately. The provider is set up on the bank journal, with options for the label, note and reference of each line. It helps match Stripe payouts to bank entries.

name: account_statement_import_online_wise
summary: Pulls Wise.com transactions into bank statements for a linked account, either for a date range or through the scheduled pull. Strong Customer Authentication uses keys generated or pasted in the provider settings. Set Bank Feeds to Online on the bank account and select Wise as the provider.

name: account_statement_import_paypal
summary: Imports PayPal CSV statement reports as bank statements. You download the monthly or custom statement from PayPal and import it, choosing the PayPal format. Column layouts are set under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > PayPal Report Mappings if your report differs.

name: account_statement_import_qif
summary: Imports QIF files, a legacy Quicken bank format, as bank statements from the Import statement button on a bank journal. QIF cannot prevent the same transaction being imported twice or handle multiple currencies, so OFX is preferred where the bank offers it.

name: account_statement_import_qif
summary: Imports QIF files, a legacy Quicken bank format, as bank statements from the Import statement button on a bank journal. QIF cannot prevent the same transaction being imported twice or handle multiple currencies, so OFX is preferred where the bank offers it.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file
summary: Base for importing bank statements from TXT or CSV files, which are mapped to Odoo fields with a column mapping. Create the mapping under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings to match your bank's file layout. XLS and XLSX support comes from add-on modules.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file
summary: Imports any TXT, CSV or XLSX bank file as bank statements, using a column mapping that matches your bank's file layout. Create the mapping under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings, then import from the bank journal.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file
summary: Imports TXT, CSV or XLSX files as bank statements, mapping the file's columns to Odoo fields using a saved sheet mapping. You create one mapping per bank export format under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings. Use it when your bank gives you a spreadsheet export.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file_xls
summary: Adds XLS (older Excel format) support to the sheet-based bank statement import. Set up the column mapping under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings, then import the XLS file from the bank journal.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_file_xlsx
summary: Adds XLSX (modern Excel format) support to the sheet-based bank statement import. Set up the column mapping under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Statement Sheet Mappings, then import the XLSX file from the bank journal.

name: account_statement_import_sheet_html_file
summary: Detects when an XLSX bank file is actually an HTML file, which some banks export, and reads it as a bank statement. It extends the spreadsheet statement import and needs no extra setup. It is a technical parser add-on.

name: account_statement_line_order
summary: Adds a Statement Line Internal Index setting on bank journals, which controls how bank statement lines are ordered. A second option keeps lines from the same statement together, which fixes the mixed order when several statements arrive on the same day. It is set on the journal.

name: account_statement_reconcile_status
summary: Shows on each bank statement whether it is Not Started, In Progress or Fully Reconciled, with a coloured badge in the list view. It also records when a statement was first fully reconciled, so you can spot one that was later undone. Search filters find statements that still need attention.

name: account_tax_balance
summary: Computes tax balances for a chosen company, date range and set of target moves. Run it from Accounting > Reporting > Taxes Balance. It also exposes compute methods that localization modules can call.

name: account_tax_balance
summary: Computes tax balances for a chosen company, date range and set of target moves. Run it from Accounting > Reporting > Taxes Balance. It also exposes compute methods that localization modules can call.

name: account_tax_change
summary: Lets you define a tax change from a given date, mapping old taxes to new ones, and apply it to existing customer invoices in bulk. Invoices already posted or paid are skipped. Set the mapping under Invoicing > Configuration > Accounting > Tax changes, then select invoices in the customer invoices list.
keywords: apply new tax rate to invoices

name: account_tax_fixed_amount_currency
summary: Lets a fixed-amount tax be expressed in a currency other than the invoice currency, for example CHF 10 on a EUR invoice. The amount is converted to the document currency at the exchange rate of the invoice date. Set Amount Currency on a fixed tax under Invoicing > Configuration > Taxes; leave it empty for the normal behaviour.

name: account_tax_fixed_amount_multiplier
summary: Adds an Amount Multiplier choice to fixed-amount taxes. The fee can apply once per line (for example stamp duties), per line quantity (the default), per quantity in the product's unit of measure, or per product weight for weight-based levies. Set it on a fixed tax under Invoicing > Configuration > Taxes.

name: account_tax_group_widget_base_amount
summary: Adds the base amount to the tax group summary shown on invoices and receipts, so the taxable base appears next to each tax in the printed report. Only affects how the tax summary is displayed.
keywords: base amount on invoice tax summary

name: account_tax_group_widget_base_amount
summary: Adds the base amount to the tax group summary shown on invoices and receipts, including their printed reports. Customers and reviewers can then see the taxable base beside each tax total. Only the report display changes.

name: account_tax_legal_notes_translate
summary: Makes the Legal Notes field on taxes translatable, so the same legal text can be stored in each language used on documents. The field is a rich text field, so formatted notes can be entered. It is set on the tax's form.

name: account_tax_one_vat
summary: Allows only one VAT tax on each invoice line, which some countries such as Belgium require. Invoice lines show a warning when a second VAT is added, and products are checked when saved. Turn on One VAT tax only in Invoicing settings, and mark a tax as VAT under its Advanced Options.
keywords: only one VAT rate per line

name: account_tax_one_vat
summary: Ensures only one VAT tax can be used on each product and invoice line, a rule some countries such as Belgium require. Products get VAT and VAT name fields, and a warning or error appears when a second VAT is chosen. Turn it on with the One VAT tax only setting, and mark a tax as VAT under its advanced options.

name: account_tax_one_vat_purchase
summary: Applies the one-VAT-tax-per-line rule to purchase order lines, so only one VAT tax can be chosen on each line. Builds on account_tax_one_vat and needs its settings turned on.

name: account_tax_one_vat_purchase
summary: Applies the one VAT tax rule to purchase order lines, so only one VAT tax can be picked on a line. It extends the one VAT tax module for purchasing and needs no extra setup.

name: account_tax_one_vat_sale
summary: Applies the one-VAT-tax-per-line rule to sales order lines, so only one VAT tax can be chosen on each line. Builds on account_tax_one_vat and needs its settings turned on.

name: account_tax_one_vat_sale
summary: Applies the one VAT tax rule to sales order lines, so only one VAT tax can be picked on a line. It extends the one VAT tax module for sales and needs no extra setup.

name: account_tax_repartition_line_tax_group_account
summary: Sets a default account on a tax group that is copied to the tax repartition lines of its taxes. This means new taxes created by tax integrations, such as US sales tax services, get an account automatically. Set Default account to use in repartition lines on the tax group.

name: account_tax_unece
summary: Adds UNECE tax type and category codes, plus the EU VAT exemption (VATEX) code, to taxes so e-invoices (CII and UBL) carry the right tax information. Set the codes on each tax under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Taxes. Some localization modules fill them in already.

name: account_tax_unece
summary: Adds UNECE tax type and category codes to taxes so e-invoices (CII and UBL) carry the right tax information. Set the codes on each tax under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Taxes. Some localization modules fill them in already.

name: account_tax_unece
summary: Adds UNECE tax type and category codes, plus the EU VAT exemption (VATEX) code, to taxes so e-invoices (CII and UBL) carry the right tax information. Set the codes on each tax under Accounting > Configuration > Accounting > Taxes. Some localization modules fill them in already.

name: account_template_active
summary: Lets you switch individual accounts, taxes and fiscal positions in accounting templates on or off, so unwanted items are not created when a chart of accounts is loaded. Useful across many companies or when building a custom localization. Found under Accounting > Configuration > Templates.

name: account_usability
summary: Brings back accounting menus and options that Odoo Enterprise shows but Community hides: bank statements, cash registers, account tags and groups, chart and tax templates, and fiscal position templates. It also adds Anglo-Saxon accounting and the Show Full Accounting Features group to user forms, renames Billing to Accounting, and allows a fiscal year end date in settings.

name: account_usability
summary: Brings back accounting menus and options that Odoo Enterprise shows but Community hides: bank statements, cash registers, account tags and groups, chart and tax templates, and fiscal position templates. It also adds Anglo-Saxon accounting and the Show Full Accounting Features group to user forms, renames Billing to Accounting, and allows a fiscal year end date in settings.

name: account_usability
summary: Brings back accounting menus and options that Odoo Enterprise shows but Community hides: bank statements, cash registers, account tags and groups, chart and tax templates, and fiscal position templates. It also adds Anglo-Saxon accounting and the Show Full Accounting Features group to user forms, renames Billing to Accounting, and allows a fiscal year end date in settings.

name: account_usability
summary: Brings back accounting menus and options that Odoo Enterprise shows but Community hides: bank statements, cash registers, account tags and groups, chart and tax templates, and fiscal position templates. It also adds Anglo-Saxon accounting and the Show Full Accounting Features group to user forms, renames the Invoicing menu to Accounting, and allows a fiscal year end date in settings.

name: account_vendor_bank_account_default
summary: Lets you set a default bank account on each supplier, used on their vendor bills as the recipient bank account. If none is set, Odoo uses the first bank account created on the contact. It is set on the Sales & Purchase tab and applies to company contacts or individuals with no parent company.

name: account_vendor_bank_account_default_purchase
summary: Carries the supplier's default bank account onto purchase orders, and from there onto the vendor bills created from them. The bank account shows on the purchase order's Other info tab. It is set on the supplier's contact.

name: account_voucher_killer
summary: Hides the Register payment button on customer and supplier invoices, the Register payment bulk action, and the Customer payments and Supplier payments menus, unless a user has the Payments for Invoices permission. Grant that permission to individual users under Settings > Users, or through the group under Settings > Groups.

name: account_warn_option
summary: Adds preset blocking or warning messages to customers. On a customer's Internal Notes tab, pick a Warn Option under Warning on the Invoice, and that message shows whenever an invoice is made for the customer. The Warnings option in the customer invoice settings must be turned on first.

name: agreement
summary: Adds an Agreement record for contracts and other agreements with customers or suppliers, with a code, name, partner, signature date, and start and end dates. Optional agreement types and a template flag can be turned on in settings, and the agreement_sale module adds the related settings.

name: agreement
summary: Adds an Agreement record so contracts and other agreements with customers or suppliers are kept in one place. Each agreement has a code, name, partner, Sale or Purchase domain, and signature, start and end dates, shown under Agreements > Agreements with a smart button on the partner form. Access comes in Read-Only, User and Manager roles.

name: agreement
summary: Adds an Agreement record with a code, name, partner, signature date, and start and end dates, so contracts with customers or suppliers can be tracked. A commercial entity can be stored for contact persons of a company. Optional agreement types and template flags are available.

name: agreement_account
summary: Adds an Agreement field to customer invoices and vendor bills, linking each bill to its agreement. The agreement gets counts of customer invoices and vendor bills. Set the field on the invoice form.

name: agreement_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Links a helpdesk ticket to an agreement, and adds a Tickets smart button on the agreement that lists its related tickets. Set the agreement on the ticket under Helpdesk > Tickets. Lets you see how well a contract is being supported.

name: agreement_helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice
summary: When a field service order is created from a helpdesk ticket, the ticket's agreement is carried over to the new order. Needs the field service and agreement modules installed.

name: agreement_helpdesk_mgmt_sale
summary: When the agreement on a linked sales order changes, the helpdesk ticket takes that agreement, but only if the ticket has none set yet. Connects support tickets to the contract behind the sale.

name: agreement_helpdesk_mgmt_serviceprofile
summary: Adds a Service Profile field to helpdesk tickets, linking each ticket to a service profile of its agreement. This is glue between the helpdesk link and the service profile module.

name: agreement_legal
summary: Lets a legal team build agreement templates from sections, clauses, appendices and recitals, with dynamic fields filled from records. An agreement is created from a template, a PDF is generated, and it moves through approval stages before being sent to the customer for signature. Templates and stages are set under Agreement > Configuration.

name: agreement_legal
summary: Lets a legal team build agreement templates from sections, clauses, appendices and recitals, with dynamic fields filled from records. An agreement is created from a template, a PDF is generated, and it moves through approval stages before being sent to the customer for signature. Templates and stages are set under Agreement > Configuration.

name: agreement_maintenance
summary: Links maintenance requests and equipment to maintenance agreements and service profiles. A Maintenance Requests smart button on the agreement lists the related requests, which can be grouped by service profile. Set the agreement on a request under Maintenance.

name: agreement_project
summary: Links projects and tasks to an agreement, and adds a Tasks smart button on the agreement that lists its related tasks. Set the agreement on a project under Project > Configuration > Projects, so you can track project performance against a contract.

name: agreement_rebate
summary: Adds rebate (rappel) conditions to sales agreements, such as a global discount, a discount per line item, or a discount by amount section. A wizard then creates rebate settlements for the period and the related invoices. Set up under Agreements, using an agreement of the rebate type.

name: agreement_rebate
summary: Adds rebate (rappel) conditions to sales agreements, such as a global discount, a discount per line item, or a discount by amount section. A wizard then creates rebate settlements for the period and the related invoices. Set up under Agreements, using an agreement of the rebate type.

name: agreement_rebate_partner_company_group
summary: Applies rebate agreements to all members of a company group, not just the single contact. When rebate settlements are created from invoices of several group members, the agreement covers all of them. It relies on the partner company group setup.

name: agreement_repair
summary: Links repair orders to an agreement, and adds a Repairs smart button on the agreement that lists its repair orders. Set the agreement on a repair order under Repair > Repair Orders, to track repair work against a contract.

name: agreement_sale
summary: Adds an Agreement field and an Agreement Type field to sales orders, and a Sale Orders count on the agreement. Lets you tie a quotation or order to the contract it belongs to, from the sales order form.

name: agreement_serviceprofile
summary: Adds an Agreement Service Profile record to agreements, holding a name, a link to the agreement and an active flag, plus a service product, partner and stage. Each profile describes a service covered by an agreement, and is used by the maintenance and helpdesk link modules.

name: agreement_serviceprofile
summary: Adds an Agreement Service Profile record to agreements, holding a name, a link to the agreement and an active flag, plus a service product, partner and stage. Each profile describes a service covered by an agreement, and is used by the maintenance and helpdesk link modules.

name: agreement_sign_oca
summary: Lets you send an agreement for e-signature from its Request Signature button, using a sign request. Once the document is fully signed, the agreement moves to the Signed Agreements stage and the signed copy is attached. A smart button on the agreement lists its sign requests, and the stage is set in company settings.

name: ai_automation
summary: Adds an AI OCA Action type to server actions, so a prompt sent to an AI connection (Ollama by default) can run as an automation. The prompt can use record fields as placeholders, and the AI can call optional tools. Technical, set up under Settings > Technical > Actions > Server Actions.

name: ai_connection
summary: Technical base that defines AI Connection records, holding a name, kind, URL, model and temperature. It has no providers of its own, so other modules such as ai_connection_openai add the actual connections. Nothing here for end users to run directly.

name: ai_connection_openai
summary: Lets an AI Connection use the OpenAI API, and any service that speaks the same API such as LiteLLM, by entering an API key on the connection. Technical setup, done on the AI Connection record.

name: ai_oca_bridge
summary: Connects Odoo records to external AI systems such as n8n. An administrator defines bridges (model, URL, filters and payload), and users run them from the bolt icon in the chatter, with the choices filtered by configuration. Set up under AI Bridge > AI Bridge.

name: ai_oca_bridge
summary: Connects Odoo records to external AI systems such as n8n. An administrator defines bridges (model, URL, filters and payload), and users run them from the bolt icon in the chatter, with the choices filtered by configuration. Set up under AI Bridge > AI Bridge.

name: ai_oca_bridge_chatter
summary: Lets an external AI chatbot, built in a tool such as n8n, answer messages in the Odoo chat as an assigned user. You create a chatter bridge, assign it to a user, and that user replies automatically. Requires the AI bridge module.

name: ai_oca_bridge_crm_lead
summary: Triggers AI bridges when CRM leads are created, changed or deleted, when they match the bridge's domain. Use it to have an external AI enrich new leads or write follow-up emails. Executions appear under the AI Bridge Execution menu.

name: ai_oca_bridge_document_page
summary: Sends knowledge articles from the OCA Knowledge app (document pages) to external AI systems through bridges, so an AI agent can use them as a source of knowledge. Create, update and delete triggers each need a bridge, and executions appear under AI Bridge Execution.

name: ai_oca_bridge_extra_parameters
summary: Adds custom extra parameters to AI bridge payloads, computed from Python expressions that do not depend on the record's fields. Create them under AI Bridge > AI Bridge Extra Parameters, then add them to a bridge's payload.

name: ai_oca_bridge_fieldservice
summary: Connects field service orders to AI bridges, so creating, changing or deleting a field service order can trigger an external AI system. A glue module between the AI bridge and the Field Service app.

name: ai_oca_bridge_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Connects helpdesk tickets to AI bridges, so creating, changing or deleting a ticket can trigger an external AI system. A glue module between the AI bridge and the Helpdesk Management app.

name: ai_oca_bridge_mrp
summary: Connects manufacturing work orders to AI bridges, so creating, changing or deleting a work order can trigger an external AI system. Executions appear under the AI Bridge Execution menu. Requires the Manufacturing app.

name: ai_oca_mcp
summary: Exposes selected Odoo AI tools through an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so external AI clients such as n8n or custom agents can call Odoo functions. Each client authenticates with its own API key, shown once when created. Set up in Developer mode under AI > MCP Server.

name: ai_oca_native_generate_ollama
summary: Replaces the AI text generation in the HTML editor, which normally goes through Odoo IAP to OpenAI, with a locally hosted Ollama server. Configure the Ollama connection and model through system parameters, so generated text stays on your own infrastructure.

name: ai_tool
summary: Technical base for defining AI tools, which are Odoo functions registered so MCP servers, automations and other AI features can call them. Other modules register their functions here. Nothing for end users to run directly.

name: analytic_amount_security
summary: Restricts which users can see the amounts (costs) on analytic lines, using an Allow to read analytic costs permission. Without it, all internal users can see the amounts on lines they already have access to. Set it per user under Settings > Users in developer mode.

name: analytic_base_department
summary: Links analytic accounts and analytic items to departments, so each analytic account can be assigned a department and each line records its department. Department analytic accounts also show on the department form. Needs the Employees app for the department field.

name: analytic_base_department
summary: Links analytic accounts and analytic items to departments, so each analytic account can be assigned a department and each line records its department. Department analytic accounts also show on the department form. Needs the Employees app for the department field.

name: analytic_brand
summary: Lets you define analytic distribution models that use a brand in their domain, so the analytic distribution is chosen automatically for products or lines of that brand. Requires the brand module.

name: analytic_brand
summary: Links an analytic account to a brand, which is used as the default analytic account wherever that brand is used, when analytic accounting is active. Requires the brand module.

name: analytic_brand
summary: Links an analytic distribution to a brand, used as the default wherever that brand is used while analytic accounting is active. Requires the brand and account brand modules.

name: analytic_distribution_widget_remove_save
summary: Removes the Save button from the analytic distribution widget, so distributions are saved along with the record instead of separately. Needs no setup.

name: analytic_hr_department_restriction
summary: Limits which analytic plans and analytic accounts each user can see, based on their employee's department. Plans and accounts with no department are visible to everyone, and users with the Invoicing permission see everything. Set departments on plans and accounts, and link each user to an employee with a department.

name: analytic_hr_department_restriction
summary: Limits which analytic plans and analytic accounts each user can see, based on their employee's department. Plans and accounts with no department are visible to everyone, and users with the Invoicing or Billing permission see everything. Set departments on plans and accounts, and link each user to an employee with a department.

name: analytic_mixin_analytic_account
summary: Gives records that use the analytic mixin a computed list of their analytic accounts, plus a comma-separated text of their names, both taken from the analytic distribution. Useful for exports and for custom modules that need the accounts as a field. Nothing for end users to set up.

name: analytic_operating_unit
summary: Sets which operating units may use each analytic account. Users only see and use analytic accounts for the operating units they have access to, while accounts with no operating unit stay open to everyone with analytic access. Set the operating units on each analytic account under Accounting > Configuration > Analytic Accounting > Analytic Accounts.

name: analytic_operating_unit
summary: Sets which operating units may use each analytic account. Users only see and use analytic accounts for the operating units they have access to, while accounts with no operating unit stay open to everyone with analytic access. Set the operating units on each analytic account under Accounting > Configuration > Analytic Accounting > Analytic Accounts.

name: analytic_operating_unit_access_all
summary: Adds an Access all OUs analytic checkbox on a user, so that user can use the analytic accounts of every operating unit without being added to each one. Set it under Settings > Users & Companies > Users. Builds on analytic_operating_unit.

name: analytic_partner
summary: Adds an Other Partner field to analytic items, so costs and revenues can be grouped and searched by a partner. The value carries over from invoice lines when invoices are validated, and the partner form has a Cost/Revenue smart button. Found under Invoicing > Accounting > Management > Analytic Items, and needs the Show Full Accounting Features and Analytic Accounting rights.

name: analytic_partner
summary: Adds an Other Partner field to analytic items, so costs and revenues can be grouped and searched by a partner. The value carries over from invoice lines when invoices are validated, and the partner form has a Cost/Revenue smart button. Found under Invoicing > Accounting > Management > Analytic Items, and needs the Show Full Accounting Features and Analytic Accounting rights.

name: animal
summary: Stores information about animals, such as name, species, breed, color, size, weight, birth date and gender. Each animal can be linked to a species, breed and color. Animals are found under the Animals menu.

name: announcement
summary: Shows pop-up announcements to targeted internal users in the Odoo backend, with rich formatting and a read log for each user. A user must mark an announcement as read before continuing, and unread ones stay in the top-bar speaker icon. Announcements are created under Discuss > Announcements by members of the Announcements Managers group.

name: announcement
summary: Shows pop-up announcements to chosen internal users when they log in, which they must mark as read, and keeps a log of who has read each one. Announcements can be rich text and targeted to specific users or groups, and are managed under Discuss, Announcements by users in the Announcements Managers group. Unread items can also be reopened from the top bar.

name: announcement_dialog_size
summary: Makes announcement pop-ups open full size by default. It is switched on by adding the system parameter announcement.full_size, and removing that parameter restores the normal size. Builds on the announcement module.

name: api_log
summary: Stores the request and response of API calls in the database. Each logged response gets an API_LOG_ENTRY_ID header pointing to its log record. A scheduled action can delete logs older than the retention period, default 180 days, but it is disabled by default and must be switched on under Settings > Technical > Automation > Scheduled Actions.

name: api_log
summary: Stores the request and response of API calls in the database. Each logged response gets an API_LOG_ENTRY_ID header pointing to its log record. Useful for auditing and debugging API traffic.

name: api_log_mail
summary: Creates an activity, and optionally sends an email, when an exception is logged in an API log collection, so someone is alerted to the API error. Set the Error Activity type on the log collection that has logging enabled.

name: apikey_scope_editable
summary: Lets you set a scope when creating an API key in your user preferences, so the key only reaches a specific application, model or functional area of Odoo. Find it under your user menu > Preferences > Account Security > New Api Key, where a scope field appears.

name: asterisk_click2dial
summary: Connects Odoo to an Asterisk phone server. It adds a Dial button next to phone numbers, which rings the user's own phone first and then calls the contact, and it shows the caller's name on the IP phone for incoming calls from known contacts. Asterisk settings are kept per server and per user.

name: asterisk_click2dial
summary: Connects Odoo to an Asterisk phone server. It adds a Dial button next to phone numbers, which rings the user's own phone first and then calls the contact, and it shows the caller's name on the IP phone for incoming calls from known contacts. Asterisk settings are kept per server and per user.

name: attachment_category
summary: Adds document categories, which can be nested, and lets you set them as tags on attachments to sort and find documents. Set the categories from the Attachments screen.

name: attachment_delete_restrict
summary: Stops users from deleting attachments (files attached to records) unless they are allowed to. Permissions can be set globally or per model, for example limiting deletion to the record owner, admins, or specific groups or users. It is configured in General Settings under Permissions and in each model's settings.

name: attachment_delete_restrict
summary: Restricts who can delete attachments, set per model, at five levels: default, owner only, custom groups or users, owner plus strict rules, and so on. The global level and per-model settings sit under Settings > General Settings > Permission.

name: attachment_logging
summary: Shows who uploaded each attachment and when, next to the attachments in the chatter. It can also post a note in the chatter when an attachment is added or removed. Turn on Attachment Logging under Settings > General Settings in the Discuss section.

name: attachment_logging
summary: Shows who uploaded each attachment and when, next to the attachments in the chatter. It can also post a note in the chatter when an attachment is added or removed. Turn on Attachment Logging under Settings > General Settings in the Discuss section.

name: attachment_preview
summary: Adds a preview icon next to attachments and binary file fields, opening PDFs and most LibreOffice files in a panel beside the form. You can move between attachments with arrow buttons, or pop the preview out into its own window.

name: attachment_queue
summary: A technical base module that wraps file attachments in a queue so they can be processed in the background. Each queued file has a type, state, done date and failure message, and admins can reschedule failed files from Settings, Technical, Database Structure, Attachments Queue. It is mainly used by other modules such as attachment_synchronize.

name: attachment_queue
summary: Technical base that wraps attachments in a queue so they can be processed asynchronously in background jobs. The queue is listed under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Attachments Queue, and the cron batch size is set in system parameters. Used by attachment_synchronize.

name: attachment_queue_email
summary: Automatically turns email attachments into queued files based on conditions such as sender, recipient, subject or file extension. Each matching attachment is added to the attachment queue for later processing. The conditions are set on the Incoming Mail Server (Fetchmail) configuration.

name: attachment_synchronize
summary: Imports and exports files to and from remote servers, such as S3 or SFTP, through storage backends. You create Attachment Import or Export Tasks under Settings > Technical, and files pass through the attachment queue. Storage backends need the matching fs modules installed.

name: attachment_synchronize
summary: Imports files from external storage servers (such as SFTP or S3) into Odoo and exports files from Odoo back out. Import and export are scheduled as tasks that define where to look, which files match, and what happens to the source files afterwards. Tasks are found under Settings, Technical.

name: attachment_unindex_content
summary: Turns off the full-text indexing of attachment content, which saves database space and processing time. Indexed text is cleared from existing attachments when the module is installed. Technical; there is no screen to use, and search by file content stops working.

name: attachment_unindex_content
summary: Turns off the storing of extracted text from attachments, which saves database space and processing time. It also clears the stored text from existing attachments when installed. Users are not affected in day-to-day use, but full text search inside attached files will no longer work.

name: attachment_zipped_download
summary: Downloads several selected attachments as one zip file. Select files under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Attachments, then choose Actions > Download. Developers can reuse a helper mixin to add zip download to other models.

name: attachment_zipped_download
summary: Downloads several selected attachments as one zip file. Select files under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Attachments, then choose Actions > Download. Developers can reuse a helper mixin to add zip download to other models.

name: attribute_set
summary: Lets you define custom attributes on any model, including many-to-one and many-to-many attributes that point to custom options or other Odoo records. Attributes are grouped into attribute sets, and can be stored in a single serialized field for speed. It provides no screens of its own, so attributes are created under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Attributes.

name: attribute_set
summary: Lets you define custom attributes on any model, including many-to-one and many-to-many attributes that point to custom options or other Odoo records. Attributes are grouped into attribute sets, and can be stored in a single serialized field for speed. It provides no screens of its own, so attributes are created under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Attributes.

name: attribute_set_completeness
summary: Gives each attribute set a completion rate, based on chosen fields weighted by proportion. Records of that set, such as products, then show a completion rate and a completion state. Set it in the Completeness section of an attribute set.

name: attribute_set_mass_edit
summary: Allows mass editing of selected attributes on many records at once. Tick Allow Mass Editing on an attribute and refresh the browser, and a mass editing profile is created for each attribute group. Builds on attribute_set and the server action mass edit tools.

name: attribute_set_searchable
summary: Makes an attribute searchable from the search bar of its model. Tick Searchable on the attribute and refresh, then start typing in the search view of the related model to filter by that attribute.

name: auditlog
summary: Keeps a record of who created, viewed, changed, deleted or exported data in chosen models, including old and new field values. Admins define which models and operations to log under Settings, Technical, Audit, Rules, and review the results under Audit, Logs. Logs older than 6 months can be cleared by an optional scheduled action.

name: auditlog
summary: Logs create, read, write, delete and export operations on the data models you choose, recording who did it, the session and the HTTP request. Subscribe models under Settings > Technical > Audit > Rules, and check the changes under Audit > Logs. A scheduled action can delete logs older than 180 days, but it is disabled by default.

name: auth_admin_passkey
summary: Lets a system administrator log in as any user with an extra administrator password set in the server configuration file, which can be stored encrypted. Odoo can email the user and the admin when this happens. The feature stays off until the password is configured.

name: auth_admin_passkey
summary: Lets a system administrator log in as any user with a separate admin password stored in the server configuration file. Users and admins can be emailed when it is used, and the password can be stored encrypted. It is a server-level technical setting with no screens of its own.

name: auth_admin_passkey_totp_mail_enforce
summary: Glue module so that logging in with the administrator passkey skips the email two-factor check. It only matters when both the passkey and email 2FA modules are installed.

name: auth_api_key
summary: Lets external programs authenticate their HTTP requests with an API key sent in a request header, instead of a user login. Keys are created in Settings > Technical in developer mode and tied to a user. Because headers are visible, it is meant for known sources.

name: auth_api_key
summary: Lets outside programs call Odoo's web services using an API key sent in an HTTP header instead of a password. Keys are created and managed under Technical settings in debug mode, and an option lets keys keep working for inactive users. It is a technical feature used by integrations.

name: auth_api_key_group
summary: Lets you group API keys together, so other modules can limit access to services or records by key group. Grouping on its own changes nothing, and it is for developers building that access control.
keywords: limit API access by key group

name: auth_api_key_group
summary: Groups API keys together so other modules can restrict services or records to a set of keys. Grouping on its own does nothing visible to users. It is a technical building block on top of API keys.

name: auth_api_key_group
summary: Lets you group API keys together, so other modules can limit access to services or records by key group. Grouping on its own changes nothing, and it is for developers building that access control.
keywords: limit API access by key group

name: auth_api_key_server_env
summary: Lets API keys be defined in server environment configuration sections instead of only in the database. This stops keys from carrying over into other environments when a production database is restored elsewhere.

name: auth_api_key_server_env
summary: Defines API keys in the server configuration file instead of the database. This keeps keys from carrying over when a database is copied between environments. It is a technical setting that depends on server environment configuration.

name: auth_jwt
summary: Lets developers protect web routes with JSON Web Token (JWT) login, using validators configured in Odoo for signing and audience checks. Users are identified from the token. It is a developer and integration feature with no end-user screens.

name: auth_jwt_demo
summary: Test and demo module for JWT token authentication. It creates a demo validator and a whoami route that returns details about the partner in the token. Not meant for production use.

name: auth_jwt_demo
summary: A demo module for JWT login that creates a sample validator and a test route that returns the partner identified in the token. It is meant for developers testing auth_jwt, not for production use. It is technical.

name: auth_jwt_server_env
summary: Configures JWT token authentication validators through server environment settings, instead of only in the database. Technical; relevant to developers and administrators who run JWT logins.

name: auth_ldaps
summary: Lets users log in against an LDAP server over SSL (LDAPS). Turn on Use LDAPS in the LDAP server settings under Settings > General Settings > LDAP Authentication. Certificate validation can be skipped per server if needed.

name: auth_oauth_autologin
summary: Sends users straight to the OAuth identity provider login page when exactly one enabled provider is set to automatic login, so the usual Odoo login screen is hidden. The normal page is still reachable at /web/login?no_autologin. Configure providers under Settings > Users and Companies.

name: auth_oauth_autologin
summary: Sends users straight to the OAuth identity provider login page when exactly one enabled provider is set to automatic login, so the usual Odoo login screen is hidden. The normal page is still reachable at /web/login?no_autologin. Configure providers under Settings > Users and Companies.

name: auth_oauth_filter_by_domain
summary: Shows only the OAuth login providers whose allowed domains match the web address the user is on. Providers with no allowed domains appear on every domain. The domains are set on the OAuth Providers screen in settings.

name: auth_oauth_login_field
summary: When a user signs up through OAuth, takes the login name from the token if one is provided, so a user's login can differ from their email. It is often paired with OpenID Connect token mapping. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: auth_oauth_multi_token
summary: Lets the same OAuth account, from Google, Odoo, Facebook and other providers, stay logged in on more than one device at the same time. A limit on simultaneous connections can be set per user. Login itself does not change: pick the provider and sign in.

name: auth_oauth_multi_token
summary: Lets the same user stay logged in on several devices at once through the same OAuth account, such as Google or Odoo login. A per-user limit caps how many simultaneous connections are allowed. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: auth_oauth_ropc
summary: Lets users log in with a username and password through the OAuth resource owner password flow. This is less secure than other OAuth flows, so it is meant mainly for the Odoo mobile app, which only supports password login.

name: auth_oidc
summary: Lets users sign in to Odoo through an OpenID Connect provider, such as Microsoft Azure, using the authorization code flow. Providers are set up under OAuth providers in settings, and their login buttons appear on the login page. It is a setup task for IT administrators.

name: auth_oidc_environment
summary: Reads OpenID Connect provider settings, such as client ID and secret, from the server environment file instead of the database. This keeps the credentials out of the database when it is copied. It is a technical setting that depends on server environment.

name: auth_partner
summary: Technical base that lets contacts (partners) log in through authentication directories, covering sign-up, email validation, password reset, invite emails and impersonation. Found under Settings > Technical > Partner Authentication. It has no web pages of its own, so it is not meant for end users on its own.

name: auth_partner
summary: Technical base that lets contacts (partners) log in through authentication directories, covering sign-up, email validation, password reset, invite emails and impersonation. Found under Settings > Technical > Partner Authentication. It has no web pages of its own, so it is not meant for end users on its own.

name: auth_saml
summary: Lets users log in to Odoo through a SAML2 identity provider, using buttons added to the login screen, for single sign-on. Providers are set up under Settings > Users & Companies > SAML Providers. Passwords can be disabled in settings so users sign in only through the identity provider.

name: auth_saml
summary: Lets users sign in to Odoo through a SAML 2 identity provider, for single sign-on across company applications. Users are pre-created with their SAML details, and passwords can be turned off so they rely on SSO. Providers are configured under SAML providers in settings.

name: auth_saml_environment
summary: Reads SAML provider settings, such as metadata and certificates, from server environment configuration files instead of the database. This keeps each environment's SSO setup separate when a database is restored elsewhere.

name: auth_session_timeout
summary: Logs out users whose sessions have been inactive for too long. The default limit is 2 hours and is set with a system parameter, and a parameter can list technical URLs that skip the check. Useful for security on shared computers.

name: auth_session_timeout
summary: Logs users out automatically after a period of inactivity, two hours by default. The timeout and a list of pages to ignore are set as system parameters. It is a technical security setting.

name: auth_signup_verify_email
summary: Lets people sign up for an account without choosing a password, then sets the password on first login, so the email address has to be real. Outgoing email must be working and free sign-up must be enabled for customer accounts. Use it for customer or portal registration.

name: auth_signup_verify_email
summary: Makes public sign-ups verify a real email address before anything else. Applicants leave the password blank at sign-up and set it at first login, after the email is checked. Turn on Free sign up for customer accounts in General Settings and make sure outgoing email works.

name: auth_totp_enforce
summary: Requires internal users to set up an authenticator app for two-factor login before they can reach the backend. On their next login, users are taken through a mandatory setup page with a QR code. Members of the exempt group are not forced, and portal and public users are out of scope.

name: auth_user_case_insensitive
summary: Makes user login names case insensitive, so an upper or lower case version of a login signs in the same user. Search also works with mixed case logins on databases that already had case sensitive ones. It is a technical login behaviour with no new screens.

name: auth_user_case_insensitive
summary: Makes user login names case insensitive, so the same login works whatever capitals are typed, including on databases that already had case-sensitive logins. Installs on existing users without any screen changes.

name: auto_backup
summary: Creates automatic backups of the database on a schedule, deletes old backups after a set number of days, and can send copies to an external server over SFTP. Backup configurations are set under Settings, Database Structure, Automated Backup. It is an admin tool with no effect on daily users.

name: auto_backup_fs_file
summary: Adds Fs File as a database backup method, so scheduled backups can be stored on any filesystem supported by fsspec, such as cloud storage or a network drive. Set it on an automated backup under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Automated Backups. Needs the fs_file and fs_storage storage setup first.

name: automation_oca
summary: Runs automated workflows on any record type, such as a welcome email to new contacts, a reminder to customers who left items in their basket, or documents to sign for new employees. Each configuration sets a model and filters, then a sequence of steps, which can include delays. Found under the Automation menu.

name: autovacuum_message_attachment
summary: Automatically deletes old chatter messages, emails and attachments once they pass a retention period, to keep the database from growing. Rules are set per model, message type and subtype, or attachment name pattern under Settings > Technical > Email > Message And Attachment Vacuum Rules, and the cron must be activated.

name: autovacuum_message_attachment
summary: Automatically deletes old chatter messages, emails and attachments based on rules that set the model, message type and number of days to keep. This keeps the database from growing too large over time. Rules are configured under Settings, Technical, Email, Message and Attachment Vacuum Rules.

name: bank_statement_check_number
summary: Adds a Check Number column to bank statement lines, so the cheque number of a bank transaction is recorded on the statement. Builds on the check number support for journal items.

name: barcode_action
summary: Lets a barcode scan launch an action. The scanned barcode is passed to a method set in the action's context, which returns the window to open, such as finding a contact by its external reference. The demo data shows a partner lookup for administrators.

name: barcode_action
summary: Lets a barcode scan launch an action, such as scanning a partner's external reference to open that partner's record. Each action is configured with the model, the method to run and an optional record. It builds on the barcode module and is used by developers to add scan shortcuts.

name: barcode_scanner
summary: Technical base for the barcode scanning app: a full-screen scanning shell, with registries where feature modules add scan screens, scan handlers and menu tiles. Handles barcode input from a scanner or keyboard, and gives audio and vibration feedback. Needs a feature module such as barcode_stock to do real work.

name: barcode_stock
summary: Warehouse barcode app for receipts, deliveries and internal transfers, used in a full-screen scanning screen. Scan product barcodes to register quantities and validate the operation, with feedback on each scan. Only EAN13 barcodes are supported, and the app opens from Warehouse Operations in the main menu.

name: barcodes_generator_abstract
summary: Generates barcodes for any model from a barcode rule pattern, such as a fixed prefix followed by a variable price or a sequence number. The base part can be typed in by a user or come from a sequence, and a model-specific module such as the product generator is needed to use it. Rules are set under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers > Barcode Nomenclatures.

name: barcodes_generator_abstract
summary: Generates barcodes for any model from a barcode rule pattern, such as a fixed prefix followed by a variable price or a sequence number. The base part can be typed in by a user or come from a sequence, and a model-specific module such as the product generator is needed to use it. Rules are set under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers > Barcode Nomenclatures.

name: barcodes_generator_location
