summary: Connects shipping methods to the CTT Express web services for Portugal and Spain. Shipping codes and labels are generated when a transfer is validated, a label can be regenerated from the transfer, and manifests and pickups can be requested. Prices come from standard Odoo price methods.

name: delivery_cttexpress
summary: Connects shipping methods to the CTT Express web services for Portugal and Spain. Shipping codes and labels are generated when a transfer is validated, a label can be regenerated from the transfer, and manifests and pickups can be requested. Prices come from standard Odoo price methods.

name: delivery_dachser
summary: Connects shipping methods to the Dachser freight API. Shipping cost can be quoted from the Add shipping wizard, and validating a transfer creates the shipment with its tracking number and label attached. Dachser API details are set on the shipping method.

name: delivery_date_exclude_service
summary: Lets you leave certain service products out of the expected delivery date on a sales order. Each service product has an Affect Delivery Date flag, and services with it unchecked add no lead time. The flag is on the product's Sales tab.

name: delivery_deliverea
summary: Connects shipping methods to the Deliverea multi-carrier platform. Shipping codes and labels are created when a transfer is validated, pickups and shipments can be managed, and tracking status changes come back into Odoo. Set up as a delivery method with Deliverea as the provider.

name: delivery_driver
summary: Lets you set a default driver on a shipping method, and carries that driver onto transfers. The driver is picked from partners marked as drivers. Found on the shipping method and on the transfer.

name: delivery_driver_stock_picking_batch
summary: Shows the drivers from the transfers inside a batch transfer, and sets the default driver from the shipping method when a transfer is created with that carrier. Needs batch transfers and delivery methods turned on in Inventory settings.

name: delivery_dropoff_site
summary: Adds drop-off sites, pickup points run by carriers where recipients collect their parcels. On a sales order with a drop-off delivery, the customer can choose a site as the delivery address, and the final recipient is kept on the transfer. Sites have addresses, optional geolocation and opening hours.

name: delivery_dropoff_site
summary: Adds drop-off sites, pickup points run by carriers where recipients collect their parcels. On a sales order with a drop-off delivery, the customer can choose a site as the delivery address, and the final recipient is kept on the transfer. Sites have addresses, optional geolocation and opening hours.

name: delivery_easypost_oca
summary: Connects shipping methods to the EasyPost API, giving one integration to many carriers such as USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL. Rates can be fetched on a sales order from Add Shipping, labels are generated in PDF or thermal formats, and tracking is kept on the transfer. Test and production API keys are set on the shipping method.

name: delivery_estimated_package_quantity_by_weight
summary: Works out how many packages a transfer should need, based on product weights and the carrier's maximum weight per package, and warns when the actual package count is higher. It helps keep the number of packages billed by the carrier down. Product packagings are not supported.

name: delivery_estimated_package_quantity_by_weight
summary: Works out how many packages a transfer should need, based on product weights and the carrier's maximum weight per package, and warns when the actual package count is higher. It helps keep the number of packages billed by the carrier down. Product packagings are not supported.

name: delivery_free_fee_removal
summary: Hides free delivery lines from the sales order report. These lines are not invoiceable, so they do not appear on invoices either. Switched on under Settings > Sales > Shipping.

name: delivery_free_over_untaxed_price
summary: Decides whether shipping is free based on the untaxed total of the sales order, instead of the taxed total. Tick Use amount untaxed on the shipping method, next to Free if order amount is above.

name: delivery_line_sale_line_position
summary: Adds the sales order line position (its line number or label) as a column on the delivery report, and makes it visible on the transfer. This helps match delivered lines to the lines on the customer's order.

name: delivery_line_sale_line_position
summary: Adds the sales order line position (its line number or label) as a column on the delivery report, and makes it visible on the transfer. This helps match delivered lines to the lines on the customer's order.

name: delivery_line_sale_line_position
summary: Adds the sales order line position (its line number or label) as a column on the delivery report, and makes it visible on the transfer. This helps match delivered lines to the lines on the customer's order.

name: delivery_multi_destination
summary: Lets one shipping method carry different prices by destination, such as a rate per region or city. Each destination is a line on a Destinations tab, and lines are checked in priority order. Set Destination type to Multiple destinations on the shipping method.

name: delivery_multi_destination
summary: Lets one shipping method carry different prices by destination, such as a rate per region or city. Each destination is a line on a Destinations tab, and lines are checked in priority order. Set Destination type to Multiple destinations on the shipping method.

name: delivery_package_fee
summary: Adds package fees to shipping methods. When an outgoing transfer is done, a sales order line is added for each fee, priced from the customer's pricelist and set to the number of packages. Fees are set on the shipping method under Inventory > Configuration > Delivery.

name: delivery_package_fee
summary: Adds package fees to shipping methods. When an outgoing transfer is done, a sales order line is added for each fee, priced from the customer's pricelist and set to the number of packages. Fees are set on the delivery method under Inventory > Configuration > Delivery.

name: delivery_package_number
summary: Tracks the number of packages on a transfer. It can be typed in, or computed from the delivery packages used, and carrier modules can use it to rate shipments and print labels. Found in the transfer's Additional Info tab.

name: delivery_package_number
summary: Tracks the number of packages on a transfer. It can be typed in, or computed from the delivery packages used, and carrier modules can use it to rate shipments and print labels. Found in the transfer's Additional Info tab.

name: delivery_package_number
summary: Tracks the number of packages on a transfer. It can be typed in, or computed from the delivery packages used, and carrier modules can use it to rate shipments and print labels. Found in the transfer's Additional Info tab.

name: delivery_package_type_number_parcels
summary: Adds a Number of parcels field to package types, so a package type such as 2 parcels fills in the count automatically. The count shows in the Put in Pack wizard and on delivery packages, and scanning the package type barcode packs the picked lines with that count.

name: delivery_package_type_number_parcels
summary: Adds a Number of parcels field to package types and to packages, so the number of boxes in a package type is recorded without using package levels. The value is set by hand on the package type.

name: delivery_package_type_number_parcels
summary: Adds a Number of parcels field to package types and to packages, so the number of boxes in a package type is recorded without using package levels. The value is set by hand on the package type.

name: delivery_package_type_shipping_weight
summary: Lets a package type's own weight count as the shipping weight of a package, so product weights are not added on top. Set Is shipping weight on the package type.

name: delivery_postlogistics
summary: Prints Swiss Post PostLogistics shipping labels through the Barcode web service. A Create label button on each delivery order saves the label as an attachment on that transfer. Needs a Swiss Post business customer account, with login details on the shipping method.

name: delivery_postlogistics
summary: Prints Swiss Post PostLogistics shipping labels through the Barcode web service. A Create label button on each delivery order saves the label as an attachment on that transfer. Needs a Swiss Post business customer account, with login details on the shipping method.

name: delivery_postlogistics_dangerous_goods
summary: Declares dangerous goods on PostLogistics labels when they are generated, by extending the Swiss Post label module. It needs the PostLogistics labels module and the dangerous goods module.

name: delivery_postlogistics_server_env
summary: Technical layer that adds OCA server environment settings, such as per-environment credentials, to the PostLogistics shipping integration. It needs the PostLogistics module and the server environment module.

name: delivery_pre_shipping
summary: Lets you send a delivery to the carrier before the transfer is validated, using a Send to shipper manually button on a ready transfer. The tracking reference is filled in, and validation will not send it to the carrier again.

name: delivery_price_method
summary: Lets any shipping method, including those that call a carrier web service, calculate its price locally using a fixed price or price rules. Choose Price method on the shipping method form: Fixed Price or Based on Rules.

name: delivery_price_method
summary: Lets any shipping method, including those that call a carrier web service, calculate its price locally using a fixed price or price rules. Choose Price method on the shipping method form: Fixed Price or Based on Rules.

name: delivery_procurement_group_carrier
summary: Technical glue that copies the sales order's delivery carrier onto the procurement group, so the carrier can drive routing and the grouping of deliveries. It has no screen of its own.

name: delivery_procurement_group_carrier
summary: Records the carrier from the sales order on the procurement group, so stock routes can differ by carrier and several orders can be grouped into one delivery per carrier. Base module with no screens of its own.

name: delivery_purchase
summary: Lets you add delivery costs to a purchase order. Pick a Delivery Method on the purchase order, and its cost is calculated from the delivery price rules, with destinations reversed to act as sources. The cost is shown on the receipt.

name: delivery_purchase
summary: Lets you add delivery costs to a purchase order. Pick a Delivery Method on the purchase order, and its cost is calculated from the delivery price rules, with destinations reversed to act as sources. The cost is shown on the receipt.

name: delivery_purchase_multi_destination
summary: Glue module that lets the purchase delivery cost use multiple origins, so the supplier's address picks the matching price rule. Configured the same way as the multiple destinations module.

name: delivery_roulier
summary: Base module for connecting shipping methods to several carriers through the Roulier library, which wraps carrier APIs. It holds the shared logic only, so a carrier-specific module such as La Poste, DPD, Geodis or GLS must also be installed.

name: delivery_roulier
summary: Base module for connecting shipping methods to several carriers through the Roulier library, which wraps carrier APIs. It holds the shared logic only, so a carrier-specific module such as La Poste, DPD, Geodis or GLS must also be installed. Packages are needed so labels can be generated per parcel.

name: delivery_roulier_chronopost_fr
summary: Generates Chronopost France shipping labels through the Roulier library. Adds a sub-account and a file format to carrier accounts, and is used through a carrier account on the shipping method.

name: delivery_roulier_dpd_fr
summary: Sends and tracks parcels with DPD France, generating labels through the Roulier library. It covers the Classic, Predict and Relais products. The company address with phone number and the DPD account under Carrier Accounts must be filled in.

name: delivery_roulier_geodis_fr
summary: Sends parcels with Geodis France. Labels come from Geodis web services, and an EDI file is produced locally for another module to send. Agencies are the Geodis hubs your warehouse uses, set up as partner contacts, and each parcel is sent on its own.

name: delivery_roulier_laposte_fr
summary: Sends parcels with La Poste and Colissimo in France, generating labels through the Roulier library. Adds insurance and recommended-delivery fields on transfers, and a label format on carrier accounts.

name: delivery_roulier_option
summary: Adds options such as insurance and cash on delivery to shipping methods used with Roulier carriers, and a customs category on transfers. It is a technical add-on for the Roulier carrier modules.

name: delivery_roulier_option
summary: Adds options such as insurance and cash on delivery to shipping methods used with Roulier carriers, and a customs category on transfers. It is a technical add-on for the Roulier carrier modules.

name: delivery_schenker
summary: Connects shipping methods to the DB Schenker booking and tracking APIs. When a transfer is validated the shipment is booked, and the tracking number and PDF label come back in the chatter and as an attachment. A default packaging is needed on the shipping method.

name: delivery_schenker
summary: Connects shipping methods to the DB Schenker booking and tracking APIs. When a transfer is validated the shipment is booked, and the tracking number and PDF label come back in the chatter and as an attachment. A default packaging is needed on the shipping method.

name: delivery_sendcloud_oca
summary: Connects Odoo to Sendcloud so users can compute shipping costs and ship from sales orders. Sendcloud methods appear under Add shipping, parcels are created when a transfer is confirmed, and Sendcloud data such as carriers, returns, sender addresses and invoices is synced. Includes a return parcel wizard and service point options.

name: delivery_state
summary: Adds tracking fields to transfers, such as shipment date, delivery date and the carrier's delivery state, and can send an email when a delivery is marked delivered. A scheduled action updates pending deliveries for carriers that offer tracking.

name: delivery_state
summary: Adds tracking fields to transfers, such as shipment date, delivery date, the carrier's delivery state and a proof of delivery file, and can send an email when a delivery is marked delivered. A scheduled action updates pending deliveries for carriers that offer tracking.

name: delivery_state_manual
summary: Lets you set the delivery state of a transfer by hand, for shipping methods flagged Manual Delivery State. The carrier tracking fields are hidden for these methods. The flag is set on the shipping method.

name: delivery_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Makes move, transfer and package weights include the weight of the packaging, not just the products. This affects the shipping weight used on delivery packages.

name: delivery_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Changes the weight shown on moves, transfers and packages so that it includes packaging weight, not just the product weight. Packages get a shipping weight field.

name: delivery_ups_oca
summary: Connects shipping methods to the UPS web service. Rates are estimated from the sales order, a Create Shipping Label button appears on transfers, UPS errors are shown if creation fails, and cancelling a transfer cancels the shipment. UPS client ID, secret and shipper number are set on the shipping method.

name: despatch_advice_import
summary: Imports supplier despatch advice files, in XML or PDF, to prepare the matching receipt. Automatic validation of the receipt is opt-in, so importing does not confirm the receipt unless that option is chosen.

name: despatch_advice_import
summary: Imports supplier despatch advice files, in XML or PDF, to prepare the matching receipt. Lines can be checked against the expected quantities, and over-quantity validation is an option.

name: despatch_advice_import_ubl
summary: Adds UBL XML support to the despatch advice import, so UBL despatch files sent by suppliers can be read. It has no screens of its own.

name: developer_menu
summary: Adds a shortcut menu next to the Technical menu that gathers the main developer tools in one place. Shown to users in the ERP manager group.

name: developer_menu
summary: Adds a Developer menu next to the Technical menu that gathers the most-used technical screens in one place, so developers save time finding them. It is visible to users in the Administration or ERP manager group. It changes navigation only and adds no data.

name: developer_menu
summary: Adds a shortcut menu next to the Technical menu that gathers the main developer tools in one place. Shown to users in the ERP manager group.

name: disable_odoo_online
summary: Removes links to odoo.com from the Community edition. The update notifier is switched off, the apps and updates entries are hidden under Technical Parameters, and documentation, support and Odoo account links are removed from the user menu.

name: disable_odoo_online
summary: Removes links to odoo.com from the Community edition. The update notifier is switched off, the apps and updates entries are hidden under Technical Parameters, and documentation, support and Odoo account links are removed from the user menu.

name: dms
summary: The core Document Management System. Users store, organize and browse files in folders with tags and categories, directly inside Odoo, using the Documents view. Folders and files can be shared with portal users or through a tokenized link, and files can be kept in the database, as attachments or on the file system.

name: dms
summary: Document management inside Odoo: create, organise and view files in directories and categories, stored in the database or as attachments. Users manage files in the Documents view, admins set up storages and access groups, and a tokenised link can share a file or directory with anyone.

name: dms_attachment_link
summary: Adds an Add DMS File option in a record's chatter, so a file from the document management system can be attached to that record without copying its content. Search for the file in the popup and click Add.

name: dms_attachment_link
summary: Adds an Add DMS File option in a record's chatter, so a file from the document management system can be attached to that record without copying its content. Search for the file in the popup and click Add.

name: dms_auto_classification
summary: Uploads a zip file of documents and sorts each file into the right folder using filename and folder patterns from a classification template. You analyze the zip first to preview the results, then classify to create the documents. It is found under Documents, Auto Classification.

name: dms_auto_classification
summary: Sorts the files in a zip archive into DMS folders automatically, using filename and folder patterns from a classification template. The archive is analysed first so the planned locations can be checked, then the files are created. Found under Documents > Auto Classification.

name: dms_field
summary: Creates a folder tree for a record, such as a customer or contact, so each record gets its own documents area. A DMS tab appears on the record form, and the folder layout comes from an embedded DMS template. Developers can add this to any model.

name: dms_field_auto_classification
summary: Combines zip file auto classification with embedded DMS, so uploaded files are sorted into the folders of the matching record. For example, a file can be matched to a customer by a number in its filename. It is found under Documents, Auto Classification.

name: dms_field_auto_classification
summary: Extends automatic classification so files in a zip are filed into the embedded document folders of a specific record, such as a contact, matched by a value in the filename like a VAT number. Set up under Documents > Configuration > Classification Templates.

name: dms_file_sequence
summary: Adds an automatic sequence code to Document Management (DMS) files so each file's display name can start with a number, for example '01 - Test'. The naming pattern is set in Technical > System Parameters rather than on a document screen, so it is mainly an admin setup.

name: dms_storage
summary: Lets Document Management (DMS) files be stored in an external storage system, such as an SFTP or cloud storage backend, instead of only inside Odoo. Files keep the same folder and name structure in the external store, and the storage is chosen on the DMS storage and file records.

name: dms_storage
summary: Lets Document Management (DMS) files be stored in an external storage system, such as an SFTP or cloud storage backend, instead of only inside Odoo. Files keep the same folder and name structure in the external store, and the storage is chosen on the DMS storage and file records.

name: dms_user_role
summary: Connects document access groups to user roles, so everyone with a given role automatically gets access to the matching document folders. A Roles tab is added to access groups. It requires the roles module.

name: document_knowledge
summary: Base module for the Knowledge app. It adds a Knowledge top menu and lets users with the Central access to Documents permission see every file attached to any record they can read, under Knowledge > Documents. Knowledge > Configuration > Settings is where the related apps (attachment indexation, wiki, approvals) are installed.

name: document_knowledge
summary: Base module for the Knowledge app. It adds a Knowledge top menu and lets users with the Central access to Documents permission see every file attached to any record they can read, under Knowledge > Documents. Knowledge > Configuration > Settings is where the related apps (attachment indexation, wiki, approvals) are installed.

name: document_page
summary: Adds a wiki for internal documentation. Users write web pages organised into categories, with category templates that pre-fill new pages and a version history of changes (with an optional improved diff view).

name: document_page_access_group
summary: Limits who can see each wiki page. On a page's Security tab you can pick groups, specific users, or leave both empty so everyone can see it.

name: document_page_access_group_user_role
summary: Lets you give access to a wiki page through a user role from the base_user_role module. Roles are set on the page's Roles tab, and users with that role get access.

name: document_page_approval
summary: Adds an approval workflow for wiki page changes. Edits go to an approver group, which is notified with a link to review the history, and readers see the last approved version until a new one is approved.

name: document_page_approval
summary: Adds an approval workflow for wiki page changes. Edits go to an approver group, which is notified with a link to review the history, and readers see the last approved version until a new one is approved.

name: document_page_environment_manual
summary: Adds an Environment Manual template, based on the ISO 14001 structure, as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page, choose the Environment Manual category and fill in the template content.

name: document_page_environment_manual
summary: Adds an Environment menu entry and a wiki category for environment pages under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page and select the environment category.

name: document_page_environment_manual
summary: Adds an Environment menu entry and a wiki category for environment pages under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals, plus a management system page type field on pages. This is mainly a classification helper for environment documents.

name: document_page_environmental_aspect
summary: Adds an Environmental Aspects template for the Environment Management System. Users create aspect pages from Management Systems > Documentation > Environmental Aspects and fill in the template content.

name: document_page_environmental_aspect
summary: Adds an Environmental Aspects template for the Environment Management System. Users create aspect pages from Management Systems > Documentation > Environmental Aspects and fill in the template content.

name: document_page_group
summary: Lets you set groups on wiki page categories with a Visible to field, so pages in a category are only seen by the chosen groups. Pages inherit that visibility.

name: document_page_health_safety_manual
summary: Adds a Health and Safety Manual template, based on the OHSAS 18001 structure, as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page, pick the category and fill in the template.

name: document_page_health_safety_manual
summary: Adds a Health and Safety Manual template, based on the OHSAS 18001 structure, as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page, pick the category and fill in the template.

name: document_page_mgmtsystem
summary: Adds a management system page type field to wiki pages so they can be classified for the management system modules. It is a technical classification field with no separate screen of its own.

name: document_page_partner
summary: Links a wiki page to a partner, such as a customer or supplier, so pages can be searched or grouped by partner. Partner is a field on the page form.

name: document_page_procedure
summary: Provides a Procedure template for wiki pages. If mgmtsystem_manual is also installed, the template can be customised under Management Systems > Configuration > Categories.

name: document_page_procedure
summary: Provides a Procedure template for wiki pages. Users create a Procedure page under Management Systems > Documentation > Procedures, and the template can be customised from the Procedure category.

name: document_page_product
summary: Links wiki pages to products. A Wiki Pages button on the product lets users see the linked pages or create new ones for that product.

name: document_page_project
summary: Links wiki pages to projects. A Wiki Pages button on a project lets users see the linked pages or create new ones for that project.

name: document_page_project_task
summary: Links wiki pages to project tasks, so one spec page can cover several tasks and a task can reference several pages. When a page's tasks all share one project, the project is filled in automatically, and the task shows a count of its linked pages.

name: document_page_quality_manual
summary: Adds a quality manual template with the ISO 9001 structure as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page, choose the Quality Manual category and fill in the content.

name: document_page_quality_manual
summary: Adds a quality manual template with the ISO 9001 structure as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Users create a page, choose the Quality Manual category and fill in the content.

name: document_page_reference
summary: Lets a wiki page link to another page by a reference name written as a placeholder in the content. When the page is viewed, the placeholder becomes a direct link that shows the other page's name.

name: document_page_reference
summary: Lets a wiki page link to another page by a reference name written as a placeholder in the content. When the page is viewed, the placeholder becomes a direct link that shows the other page's name.

name: document_page_reference
summary: Lets a wiki page link to another page by a reference name written as a placeholder in the content. When the page is viewed, the placeholder becomes a direct link that shows the other page's name.

name: document_page_tag
summary: Adds keywords (tags) to wiki pages so they are easier to find later. Users type a keyword on the page and search for it by name in the Knowledge search bar.

name: document_page_tag
summary: Adds keywords (tags) to wiki pages so they are easier to find later. Users type a keyword on the page and search for it by name in the Knowledge search bar.

name: document_page_tag_print_control
summary: Blocks printing of wiki pages that carry a tag marked Not Printable, and shows a warning when someone tries. Users with the Manager role in Document Knowledge can still print any page.

name: document_page_work_instruction
summary: Adds a Work Instructions template as a wiki category under Management Systems > Documentation > Work Instructions. Users create an instruction page from the template and fill in the content.

name: document_quick_access
summary: Lets users find any record by scanning a QR code or barcode from a launcher in the top navbar (or Alt+Shift+Q), then jumps to that record. Admins define which model each code opens under Technical > Document Quick Access, so QR codes can be printed on reports and labels.

name: document_quick_access
summary: Lets users scan a barcode or QR code, or type one, to jump straight to a record such as a sale order or a product. Printed reports can carry a QR code for fast lookup, and a search launcher opens with a shortcut in the top bar. Rules that link each barcode format to a model are set under Settings, Technical, Document Quick Access.

name: document_quick_access_folder_auto_classification
summary: Scans files dropped into a storage folder, such as scanned documents, and attaches each one to the record its QR code points to. Files that match no code are kept as unprocessed documents for someone to assign by hand. It is a background job that depends on the document quick access rules and an external storage setup.

name: document_quick_access_folder_auto_classification
summary: Runs a background job that scans files in a storage folder and attaches each one to the record its QR code points to. Files that match no rule are kept as unprocessed documents so a user can assign them by hand.

name: document_url
summary: Lets users attach a web link (URL) to any record. From the chatter attachment icon, click Add URL, fill in a name and address, and the link appears with the record's other attachments.

name: document_url_google_drive
summary: Lets users attach a file from Google Drive to a record by picking it in a Google Drive window from the chatter attachment menu. It needs the Google API keys set in Settings and adds a URL attachment for the chosen file.

name: donation
summary: Manages donations received as cash, cheque or bank transfer, creating the matching journal entries, donor tax receipts and thank-you letters. It also handles campaigns, in-kind donations (no accounting entry, but a receipt can be issued) and check totals for control.

name: donation
summary: Manages donations received as cash, cheque or bank transfer, creating the matching journal entries, donor tax receipts and thank-you letters. It also handles campaigns, in-kind donations (no accounting entry, but a receipt can be issued) and check totals for control.

name: donation_bank_statement_oca
summary: Adds a Donation button in the OCA bank statement reconciliation screen. Clicking it opens a pre-filled donation form for a bank credit transfer, which can be validated or saved as a draft.

name: donation_base
summary: Technical base for donations. It adds a donation type to products, tax receipt options on partners, a donor tax receipt record and an annual tax receipt generator, but no donation workflow by itself.

name: donation_base
summary: Technical base for donations. It adds a donation type to products, tax receipt options on partners, a donor tax receipt record and an annual tax receipt generator, but no donation workflow by itself.

name: donation_direct_debit
summary: When a donation is validated with a SEPA direct debit payment method, the donation line is added to a draft SEPA debit order, or a new one is created if none exists. The donation's chatter gets a link to that order, and the donor's mandate is required on the donation.

name: donation_mass
summary: Manages Mass requests for a religious community, created by hand or from donation lines. A mass request is held in a stock account until the mass is celebrated, then moved to revenue, and masses can also be transferred to an external celebrant.

name: donation_mass
summary: Creates a mass request from a donation line when a Mass product is used, linking it to the donation and its line. The donation amount goes to a stock account and moves to revenue once the mass is validated.

name: donation_recurring
summary: Handles regular donors, such as monthly direct debit givers, with recurring donation templates. A wizard copies each template into a new draft donation every month for validation, and a template can be suspended or reactivated.

name: donation_stay
summary: Adds a Create Donation button on a stay's form in the Lodging app. A wizard creates a draft donation from the guest's stay, which the user then validates.

name: edi_account_core_oca
summary: Technical base for EDI rules on accounting documents such as invoices and bills. It adds no screens of its own, and other modules build the actual electronic exchange rules on top of it.

name: edi_account_oca
summary: Technical extension for EDI on accounting moves. It adds a Disable auto flag on invoices to skip automatic EDI, and an event listener hook that developers use to react when an invoice is posted.

name: edi_account_oca
summary: Technical extension for EDI on accounting moves. It adds a Disable auto flag on invoices to skip automatic EDI, and an event listener hook that developers use to react when an invoice is posted.

name: edi_account_oca
summary: Technical module that provides component listeners for accounting moves, so developers can trigger EDI or integration code when an invoice changes state. It adds no fields or screens for end users.

name: edi_backend_partner_oca
summary: Adds a Partner field to EDI backends, so a connection can be restricted to one trading partner. Partners also get a list of their EDI backends and a count.

name: edi_component_oca
summary: Lets EDI exchange steps (process, receive, generate, send) run custom code written as components. It is a developer integration module with no end-user screens of its own.

name: edi_core_oca
summary: Core of the EDI framework. It provides EDI backends, exchange types and exchange records for documents sent to or received from other systems, plus optional configuration rules that react to events. Users find it under the EDI menu, where exchange records are listed and processed.

name: edi_edifact_oca
summary: Adds an EDIFACT backend type to the EDI framework with basic configuration. It is a setup module for businesses exchanging EDIFACT messages.

name: edi_ediversa_oca
summary: Connects a company to the Ediversa EDI platform. Admins enable Use Edi Ediversa on the company and enter the test flag, user and password, but the module does nothing visible on its own and needs a companion module to send or receive documents.

name: edi_ediversa_oca_invoice_send
summary: Sends validated customer invoices to Ediversa as EDI files. Once an invoice is validated a file is generated, and a scheduled action sends it to Ediversa. A per-customer option controls whether invoices are sent.

name: edi_ediversa_oca_sale_order_import
summary: Imports sale orders sent through Ediversa. A scheduled action fetches pending order files and creates the corresponding sale orders, so customer orders arrive without manual entry.

name: edi_endpoint_oca
summary: Lets an EDI backend receive documents over HTTP through configurable endpoints under EDI > Config > Endpoints. Each endpoint has an exec mode, and the default stores the incoming body as a new exchange record for processing.

name: edi_endpoint_oca
summary: Lets an EDI backend receive documents over HTTP through configurable endpoints under EDI > Config > Endpoints, stored as exchange records for processing. Set up each endpoint under EDI > Config > Endpoints, choosing its backend and exchange type.

name: edi_exchange_deduplicate_oca
summary: Before an EDI record is sent, it checks whether a newer record for the same document exists, and if so marks the older one as obsolete so it is not sent. An option can then delete the obsolete records.

name: edi_exchange_deduplicate_oca
summary: Before an EDI record is sent, it checks whether a newer record for the same document exists, and if so marks the older one as obsolete so it is not sent. An option can then delete the obsolete records.

name: edi_exchange_deduplicate_oca
summary: When an EDI record is created, older pending records for the same document (or the same type, when none is linked) are marked obsolete so only the newest is sent or processed. An option can then delete the obsolete records.

name: edi_exchange_record_file_manager
summary: Adds a Manage File button on EDI exchange records that failed (send error or process error). The wizard lets a user replace the file with a new one or edit its content in a code editor, then retry.

name: edi_exchange_template_oca
summary: Builds EDI output files from QWeb templates, so the layout of an outgoing document is defined by a template rather than code. Templates are set up under the EDI configuration and can use a report or a custom template.

name: edi_exchange_template_oca
summary: Builds EDI output files from QWeb templates, so the layout of an outgoing document is defined by a template. Each template can be limited to certain exchange types, which are chosen with an exchange template handler.

name: edi_exchange_template_oca
summary: Builds EDI output files from QWeb templates, so the layout of an outgoing document is defined by a template rather than code. Templates are set up under the EDI configuration.

name: edi_exchange_template_party_data
summary: Makes party data (such as names, identifiers and addresses of the trading partners) available inside EDI templates. It is deprecated and has been superseded by edi_party_helper_oca, so new work should use that module.

name: edi_mrp_oca
summary: Adds EDI configuration for manufacturing orders (mrp.production). It is a base module with no new fields or screens of its own, for builders of manufacturing EDI integrations.

name: edi_notification_oca
summary: Creates an activity for chosen users or groups when an EDI exchange record fails to process. Each exchange type sets whether notifications are on, which activity type to use, and who gets assigned.

name: edi_notification_oca
summary: Creates an activity for chosen users or groups when an EDI exchange record fails to process. Each exchange type sets whether notifications are on, which activity type to use, and who gets assigned.

name: edi_notification_oca
summary: Creates an activity for chosen users or groups when an EDI exchange record fails to process. It also installs a ready-made configuration rule, Notify Users On Exchange Error, that can be reviewed under EDI configurations.

name: edi_oca
summary: Core of the EDI framework, with EDI backends, exchange types and exchange records for documents sent or received electronically, and jobs run through the queue. Users find it under the EDI menu.

name: edi_oca
summary: Core of the EDI framework, with EDI backends, exchange types and exchange records for documents sent or received electronically, and jobs run through the queue. It also sets a job priority per exchange type. Users find it under the EDI menu.

name: edi_oca
summary: Technical bundle that installs the split EDI modules together during the move to the newer module layout. It adds no features of its own and may be removed in a later version.

name: edi_partner_oca
summary: Base module that adds EDI configuration for partners (contacts). It has no fields or screens of its own and is meant for builders of partner-specific EDI rules.

name: edi_party_data_oca
summary: Retrieves party information, such as names and identifiers of the sender and receiver, for an EDI exchange using a component. It is deprecated in favour of edi_party_helper_oca, which does the same lookup without the component framework.

name: edi_party_data_oca
summary: Retrieves party information for an EDI exchange, including the partner's ID numbers. The ID categories allowed on each exchange type control which identifiers are sent, and all IDs are sent if none are set.

name: edi_party_helper_oca
summary: Retrieves EDI party details, such as name, identifiers and endpoint, for an exchange without needing the component framework. Each exchange type can limit which ID categories are shared and which one holds the endpoint ID.

name: edi_product_multi_barcode_oca
summary: Adds EDI configuration for product barcodes, so products with several barcodes can be sent and matched in EDI exchanges. It is a setup module with no screens of its own.

name: edi_product_oca
summary: Adds EDI configuration for products and product packaging so their codes can be exchanged with trading partners. It also depends on the endpoint module, and has no screens of its own.

name: edi_product_oca
summary: Adds EDI configuration for products and product packaging so their codes can be exchanged with trading partners. It has no screens of its own.

name: edi_product_oca
summary: Adds EDI configuration for products and units of measure so unit codes can be exchanged with trading partners. It has no screens of its own.

name: edi_project_oca
summary: Base module that adds EDI configuration for projects and tasks, so developers can react when a project or task is created, changed or deleted. It has no screens of its own.

name: edi_purchase_oca
summary: Base module for sending and receiving purchase orders electronically. It adds a Disable auto flag on purchase order lines, an Exchange ready flag, and a per-vendor EDI purchase configuration.

name: edi_purchase_ubl_output_oca
summary: Generates purchase orders as UBL XML files and sends them through EDI, using a simple configuration on the exchange type. It is a glue module between the purchase order UBL feature and the EDI framework.

name: edi_queue_oca
summary: Runs EDI exchange record generation as queue jobs, so it happens in the background. Each exchange type can set a job priority and channel.

name: edi_queue_oca
summary: Runs EDI generate, send, receive and process steps as background queue jobs instead of immediately. Each exchange type can pick a job channel and priority, and hold jobs until a set time of day, which helps with trading partners that only accept files at night.

name: edi_record_metadata_oca
summary: Stores technical data from an incoming EDI file on the related record, such as original values you may need later, without parsing the file again. The data is saved on the exchange record in a metadata field.

name: edi_record_metadata_oca
summary: Stores technical data from an incoming EDI file on the related record, such as original values you may need later, without parsing the file again. It can also save metadata automatically when records are created during an EDI session.

name: edi_record_metadata_oca
summary: Stores technical data from an incoming EDI file on the related record, such as original values you may need later, without parsing the file again. It can also save metadata automatically when records are created during an EDI session.

name: edi_sale_edifact_oca
summary: Provides an example EDIFACT exchange type for sales and tests for importing sale orders in that standard. It is a reference setup for teams building EDIFACT order imports.

name: edi_sale_endpoint
summary: Glue module that connects sales EDI with EDI endpoints, so sale orders can be received through an HTTP endpoint. It adds no screens of its own.

name: edi_sale_input_oca
summary: Imports incoming sale orders from EDI channels. Each exchange type can decide whether the imported order is confirmed automatically, and default values for the import wizard can be passed through the exchange type's advanced settings.

name: edi_sale_oca
summary: Base EDI configuration for sales. It adds an EDI disable flag and an exchange ready flag on sale order lines, and an EDI sale configuration on customers, which the inbound and outbound sale modules use.

name: edi_sale_oca
summary: EDI configuration for sales orders, including an option to disable EDI on an order and control over whether imported orders are confirmed by exchange type. Used with the inbound sale order import.

name: edi_sale_stock_oca
summary: Glue module between sales EDI and stock EDI, so sale-related and delivery-related exchanges work together. It adds no screens of its own.

name: edi_sale_ubl_oca
summary: Sets up UBL order states on sales orders and their lines, following the PEPPOL state definitions, and computes the EDI state shown on sale order views. It is for businesses exchanging UBL orders.

name: edi_sale_ubl_output_oca
summary: Provides example templates for UBL order response (ORDRSP) output, so a confirmation XML can be generated for a customer's sale order. The sample full order response is not meant to be used directly and should be replaced by a company's own template.

name: edi_state_oca
summary: Lets records such as sale order lines carry specific EDI statuses (for example accepted or rejected) grouped into workflows. Statuses are set up under EDI > Config > States and enabled per exchange type.

name: edi_state_oca
summary: Lets records such as sale order lines carry specific EDI statuses (for example accepted or rejected) grouped into workflows. Statuses are set up under EDI > Config > States and enabled per exchange type.

name: edi_stock_oca
summary: Base EDI configuration for stock pickings (deliveries, receipts and transfers). It provides listeners that developers use to trigger EDI when a transfer is validated.

name: edi_stock_oca
summary: Adds a Disable auto flag on stock transfers so a specific transfer can be kept out of automatic EDI. Developers use the stock picking listeners to add their own integrations.

name: edi_storage_oca
summary: Exchanges EDI files through a storage backend such as SFTP. Each EDI backend gets input and output folders with pending, done and error subfolders, and the handlers move files between them and update the exchange records.

name: edi_storage_oca
summary: Exchanges EDI files through a storage backend such as SFTP. Each EDI backend gets input and output folders with pending, done and error subfolders, and the handlers move files between them and update the exchange records.

name: edi_storage_queue_oca
summary: Runs EDI storage file exchanges, such as SFTP transfers, as queue jobs in the background. It adds no screens of its own.

name: edi_ubl_oca
summary: Adds a UBL backend type to the EDI framework with basic configuration. It is a setup module for businesses exchanging UBL XML documents such as invoices and orders.

name: edi_ubl_output_base_oca
summary: Provides reusable UBL templates for party and address blocks (company names, addresses, country), so other UBL outputs such as purchase orders can share them. It has no screens of its own.

name: edi_utm_oca
summary: Automatically sets the UTM source to EDI on records created through the EDI process, so you can tell which new records came in by EDI. It adds no screens of its own.

name: edi_voxel_account_invoice_oca
summary: Sends validated customer invoices to the Voxel (baVel) platform, either straight away or at a scheduled time depending on the company's send mode. Customers must have Enable Voxel ticked, and sending runs as background jobs.

name: edi_voxel_oca
summary: Base connection module for the Voxel (baVel) electronic platform. It does nothing useful on its own and is required by the Voxel invoice, delivery order and sale import modules, which handle the business documents.

name: edi_voxel_sale_order_import_oca
summary: Imports sales orders from Voxel on a scheduled action, for companies with Voxel enabled. Orders that were not imported before are fetched and created as background jobs.

name: edi_voxel_sale_secondary_unit_oca
summary: When Voxel orders are imported, matches each line to a secondary unit of measure (such as a case or pack) if one exists, and sets the imported quantity as the secondary quantity. Otherwise the standard unit and quantity are used.

name: edi_voxel_secondary_unit_oca
summary: Adds a Voxel code field to secondary units of measure, so a pack or case unit can be matched to the code Voxel uses. Set it on the product's secondary unit under General Information.

name: edi_voxel_stock_picking_oca
summary: Sends validated delivery orders, as a picking report, to Voxel for customers with Enable Voxel ticked. Sending is queued as background jobs, with timing set by the company's send mode.

name: edi_webservice_component_oca
summary: Legacy component-based way to send EDI exchange files through a web service. It is only needed for setups that already rely on it, and new exchange types should use edi_webservice_core_oca instead.

name: edi_webservice_core_oca
summary: Attaches a web service connection to an EDI backend and sends EDI exchange files through it, configured under EDI > Config > Backends on the Webservice tab. Exchange types choose the EDI WebService Send Handler as their sender.

name: edi_webservice_oca
summary: Connects EDI backends and exchange types to web services, so EDI files can be sent through them. The web service is set on the backend's Webservice tab and the call details are set in the webservice record.

name: edi_webservice_oca
summary: Deprecated umbrella module that only installs edi_webservice_core_oca and edi_webservice_component_oca to keep older installs working. New setups should depend on edi_webservice_core_oca directly.

name: edi_webservice_oca
summary: Connects EDI backends and exchange types to web services, so EDI files can be sent through them. The web service is set on the backend's Webservice tab and the call details are set in the webservice record.

name: edi_xml_oca
summary: Base module with helper tools for building and reading XML files in EDI exchanges. It has no screens of its own and is used by other XML-based EDI modules.

name: edi_xml_oca
summary: Base module with helper tools for building and reading XML files in EDI exchanges. It has no screens of its own and is used by other XML-based EDI modules.

name: email_template_qweb
summary: Lets email template bodies be written as QWeb views instead of plain templates. Designers can reuse snippets and use inheritance, and select the QWeb View as the body templating engine on the email template.

name: endpoint
summary: Technical framework for creating custom web API endpoints. Each endpoint record, created under Technical > Endpoints, becomes a real Odoo route whose behaviour is defined by a code snippet, and RPC calls are blocked on these routes for security.

name: endpoint
summary: Technical framework for creating custom web API endpoints under Technical > Endpoints. Each record becomes one HTTP route with its own name, path, execution mode and optional request content schema, and RPC calls are blocked on these routes for security.

name: endpoint_auth_api_key
summary: Requires an API key to call custom endpoints, and lets an admin choose which API key groups are allowed on each endpoint. Endpoints are configured under Technical > Endpoints, and callers must hold a key from an allowed group.

name: endpoint_cache
summary: Adds response caching to endpoints, with a cache policy and a count of cached entries on each endpoint. Code snippets use helper methods to store and reuse results of slow computations.

name: endpoint_cache_preheat
summary: Lets an endpoint's cache be generated in advance by a background job, so slow endpoints do not time out or block a scheduled call. Tick Automatic cache pre-heat on the endpoint to turn it on.

name: endpoint_jsonifier
summary: Lets an endpoint use a JSON exporter (jsonifier parser) so records are output in a configured JSON layout. It contains no business logic itself and is used from endpoint code snippets.

name: endpoint_product_catalog
summary: Adds product catalog settings to endpoints, such as an assortment, a language and whether prices are included, so a website or partner can pull a product list over the API. Code snippets build the catalog from these settings.

name: endpoint_route_handler
summary: Technical base that creates and removes web routes on the fly from records, so each record can generate its own URL. Developers use it as a mixin or tool, and it has no screens for end users.

name: endpoint_route_handler
summary: Technical base that creates and removes web routes on the fly from records, so each record can generate its own URL. Developers use it as a mixin or tool, and it has no screens for end users.

name: endpoint_route_handler
summary: Technical base that creates and removes web routes on the fly from records, including CORS settings, so each record can generate its own URL. Developers use it as a mixin or tool and it has no end-user screens.

name: event_contact
summary: Lets you name contacts for an event, the people to call about it, under the Organizer section of the event form. Event templates can also carry contacts, which are copied onto new events.

name: event_email_reminder
summary: Sends reminder emails for upcoming events using a scheduled action and a chosen email template. The cron's settings control how far ahead to look and whether draft events are included, and a stage can be excluded from reminders.

name: event_mail
summary: Adds mail schedulers to events. Mail templates are created under Events > Configuration, one default template is set in Events > Settings, and each event gets its own scheduled emails that can be changed on its Communication tab.

name: event_mail
summary: Adds mail schedulers to events. Mail templates are created under Events > Configuration, one default template is set in Events > Settings, and each event gets its own scheduled emails that can be changed on its Communication tab.

name: event_min_seat
summary: Adds a minimum number of seats (registrations) to events, and event templates can carry a default minimum. Events that have not reached the minimum show in red in the list view.

name: event_project
summary: Links an event to a project, which copies the event's name, dates, organizer and note onto the project and keeps them in sync. Event preparation tasks can then be tracked on that project.

name: event_registration_cancel_reason
summary: When an attendee cancels a registration, the user picks a predefined reason from a list, such as the reason for dropping out. Reasons are set under Events > Configuration and can be limited to certain event types.

name: event_registration_mass_mailing
summary: Adds selected event attendees to one or more mailing lists from the attendee list (Action > Add to mailing list). A contact is created for any attendee whose email is not already in the list.

name: event_registration_mass_mailing
summary: Adds selected event attendees to one or more mailing lists from the attendee list (Action > Add to mailing list). A contact is created for any attendee whose email is not already in the list.

name: event_registration_multi_qty
summary: Lets one event registration stand for several attendees by setting a quantity on the registration. It is turned on per event with Allow multiple attendees per registration.

name: event_registration_multi_qty
summary: Lets one event registration stand for several attendees by setting a quantity on the registration. It is turned on per event with Allow multiple attendees per registration.

name: event_registration_partner_unique
summary: Stops the same contact from being registered twice for one event, when the event's Forbid Duplicates option is on. It works with partner_event so contacts are matched to existing records instead of duplicated.

name: event_registration_partner_unique
summary: Stops the same contact from being registered twice for one event, when the event's Forbid Duplicates option is on. Contacts are matched to existing records through partner_event instead of being duplicated.

name: event_registration_qr_code
summary: Gives each event registration a unique QR code, stored on the registration record. It can be used to check attendees in or match a printed badge.

name: event_sale_free_no_invoiceable
summary: Keeps sale orders that contain only zero-price event ticket lines out of the To Invoice list, so the list is not cluttered with free tickets. The orders themselves are not changed, only how they appear in the list.

name: event_sale_registration_multi_qty
summary: When an event ticket is sold on a sale order, one registration is created with the ordered quantity as the number of attendees. Sales of group tickets therefore create a single multi-attendee registration.

name: event_sale_reservation
summary: Lets event tickets be sold before the event exists, as reservations. Each event type shows a Reserved seats count, and the event can be scheduled to be created once enough seats have been reserved.

name: event_sale_session
summary: When selling an event ticket on a sale order, the buyer must choose a session if the event has sessions. The registration is added to that session when the order is confirmed.

name: event_sale_update_qty
summary: After a sale order is confirmed, an Edit quantity button on an event ticket line changes the number of attendees and adds or removes the matching event registrations. The wizard lists the registrations on that line so attendees can be added or removed.

name: event_session
summary: Splits an event into sessions, such as individual days or time slots, each with its own start and end, attendees and mails. A wizard can create a whole schedule of sessions at once from a recurrence pattern.

name: event_session_registration_multi_qty
summary: Lets a session registration carry a quantity of attendees, so one booking can cover a group for a particular session. It builds on the multi-quantity registration feature, so that module must be installed too.

name: event_session_registration_multi_qty
summary: Lets a session registration carry a quantity of attendees, so one booking can cover a group for a particular session. It builds on the multi-quantity registration feature, so that module must be installed too.

name: event_stage_cancelled
summary: Lets an event stage be flagged as cancelled. A Cancel Event button then cancels the event's registrations after confirmation, and a mail scheduler can be set to send after cancellation.

name: event_track_location_overlap
summary: Stops two confirmed tracks (talks) from being scheduled in the same room at the same time, unless the room is marked as overlappable under Events > Configuration > Locations. By default no room allows overlaps.

name: excel_import_export
summary: A developer toolkit for building Excel exports, imports and reports from Excel templates, where layout and formulas are designed in Excel and filled with Odoo data. Templates are managed under Settings, Technical, Excel Templates, and wizards let users export or import using them. Developers use it to add spreadsheet reports to their apps.

name: excel_import_export
summary: Base module for building Excel export, import and report wizards from Excel template files. Developers design the layout in Excel and map the data with instructions, and users then export or import with the template.

name: excel_import_export_demo
summary: Demo module with examples of Excel import, export and report features. It covers exporting and importing sales orders, a sales report and a partner list, and is meant for trying out or learning the feature.

name: excel_import_export_unidecode
summary: Adds an option to strip accents from exported Excel values, so for example ESPAÑA exports as ESPANA. It is turned on per field in the Excel template.

name: extendable
summary: Technical loader for the Extendable library, which lets Python classes be extended across Odoo addons. It adds no screens and is meant for developers.

name: extendable
summary: Technical loader for the Extendable library, which lets Python classes be extended across Odoo addons. It adds no screens and is meant for developers.

name: extendable_fastapi
summary: Technical bridge that lets FastAPI endpoint handlers use Extendable classes and Extendable Pydantic models for their requests and responses. It is for developers building FastAPI APIs.

name: extendable_fastapi
summary: Technical bridge that lets FastAPI endpoint handlers use Extendable classes and Extendable Pydantic models for their requests and responses. It is for developers building FastAPI APIs.

name: fastapi
summary: Integrates the FastAPI Python framework into Odoo so developers can build typed REST APIs with automatic docs. FastAPI apps are configured as FastAPI Endpoint records in the FastAPI menu, each exposing a set of routes.

name: fastapi
summary: Integrates the FastAPI Python framework into Odoo so developers can build typed REST APIs with automatic docs. FastAPI apps are configured as FastAPI Endpoint records in the FastAPI menu, each exposing a set of routes.

name: fastapi_auth_api_key
summary: Provides FastAPI dependencies so an endpoint can require an API key, and can get an Odoo environment for the user that owns the key. The API key group is set on the FastAPI endpoint.

name: fastapi_auth_jwt
summary: Lets FastAPI routes check JWT bearer tokens issued through Odoo's auth_jwt module, returning a 401 error when a required token is missing or invalid. Developers use the provided dependencies in their routes.

name: fastapi_auth_jwt
summary: Lets FastAPI routes check JWT bearer tokens issued through Odoo's auth_jwt module, returning a 401 error when a required token is missing or invalid. Developers use the provided dependencies in their routes.

name: fastapi_auth_jwt_demo
summary: Test and demo module for FastAPI JWT authentication. It contains sample routes and tests based on the auth_jwt_demo validators, and is meant for developers rather than daily users.

name: fastapi_auth_partner
summary: Lets customers and other partners sign in to API routes built with FastAPI, with routes to manage partner logins. Admins manage partners and auth directories under FastAPI > Authentication, and can impersonate a partner for support.

name: fastapi_auth_partner
summary: Lets customers and other partners sign in to API routes built with FastAPI, with routes to manage partner logins. Admins manage partners and auth directories under FastAPI > Authentication, and the directory is set on the FastAPI endpoint.

name: fastapi_captcha
summary: Protects chosen FastAPI routes with a captcha. On the endpoint you enable captcha, pick Google reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha or Altcha, enter the secret key and a route pattern, and matching requests must send a valid token.

name: fastapi_captcha_altcha_backend
summary: Runs an Altcha captcha server inside FastAPI, with challenge routes for the Altcha widget and local verification, so no third-party captcha service is needed. It is chosen on the endpoint as the altcha_local captcha type.

name: fastapi_encrypted_errors
summary: Adds an encrypted reference to FastAPI error responses, which holds the error message and traceback. Support staff use the Decrypt Error wizard in the FastAPI menu to read it, and the key can be regenerated on the endpoint.

name: fastapi_endpoint_context
summary: Gives FastAPI requests an overridable context, including the endpoint's app and id, so developers can change behaviour deep in the code without overriding routers. Developers add their own values by overriding a method on the endpoint.

name: fastapi_log
summary: Logs the full requests and responses of a FastAPI endpoint to the database when Log Requests is ticked on that endpoint. A smart button on the endpoint opens its logs, and a global FastAPI Logs menu lists them all.

name: fastapi_log_mail
summary: Creates an activity when an exception is logged on a FastAPI endpoint, so the responsible person is alerted. Set it up the same way as api_log_mail on the endpoint.

name: fetchmail_attach_from_folder
summary: Files emails from chosen mail server folders onto matching records, such as attaching an email to a contact found by its email address. Matching can use the exact address, the domain or the standard Odoo rule. Folders and matching rules are set on the Incoming Mail Server (Fetchmail) form.

name: fetchmail_incoming_test
summary: Lets administrators test incoming email without a real mail server. A Simulate Incoming Email button on the Incoming Mail Server form opens a composer, and the message is routed like a fetched email, creating the target record such as a helpdesk ticket. A Replay Email File option feeds in a saved .eml file to reproduce how a message was handled.

name: fetchmail_notify_error_to_sender
summary: Sends an automatic reply to the sender when Odoo cannot process an incoming email, so mistakes such as writing to a wrong address are not silently lost. The reply uses an editable email template set on the Incoming Mail Server. Admins configure it on the mail server form.

name: fetchmail_notify_error_to_sender_test
summary: Test module for the fetchmail error notification feature, so the tests can run without installing the full test_mail module. It has no end-user features and is only relevant to developers.

name: fetchmail_notify_error_to_sender_test
summary: Test module for the fetchmail error notification feature, so the tests can run without installing the full test_mail module. It has no end-user features and is only relevant to developers.

name: fetchmail_thread_default
summary: Sends incoming emails that Odoo cannot match to any record into one chosen thread, such as a channel, instead of creating new records from them. Subscribers to that thread are notified and can review or ignore the mail.

name: fetchmail_thread_default
summary: Sends incoming emails that Odoo cannot match to any record into one chosen thread, such as a channel, instead of creating new records from them. Subscribers to that thread are notified and can review or ignore the mail.

name: field_vector
summary: A technical add-on that adds a new Vector field type for storing lists of numbers, such as the data used by AI or similarity search. It is for developers building features on top of it. Users do not interact with it directly.

name: fieldservice
summary: The core Field Service app for scheduling and tracking on-site work orders at customer locations. It covers locations, workers, equipment, teams and order stages, with orders viewable as kanban, calendar and map views from the Field Service app.

name: fieldservice
summary: Base Field Service app for managing service locations, workers (technicians) and service orders. It handles order stages, teams, territories, the Field Service dashboard and map features for dispatching field work.

name: fieldservice_account
summary: Links field service orders to customer invoices, so each order shows the invoices billed for it. Stages can be marked as invoiceable, and invoices show their related orders. It appears on the order and invoice forms.

name: fieldservice_account_analytic
summary: Adds analytic accounts and a billed customer to field service locations and orders, so job costs and revenue can be tracked by project and bill the right party. Set the analytic account on the location under Field Service > Master Data > Locations.

name: fieldservice_account_analytic
summary: Adds analytic accounts and a billed customer to field service locations and orders, so job costs and revenue can be tracked by project and bill the right party. Set the analytic account on the location under Field Service > Master Data > Locations.

name: fieldservice_account_payment
summary: Lets a field worker register a customer payment from a field service order while on site, choosing the payment method and amount. Payments are linked to the order and counted on it.

name: fieldservice_account_payment
summary: Lets a field worker register a customer payment on a field service order while on site, choosing the payment method and amount. The payments are linked back to the order's Payments button.

name: fieldservice_activity
summary: Adds a checklist of activities or tasks to each field service order, which can be copied from a template when the template is added. Activities are managed under Field Service > Configuration > Manage Order Activities.

name: fieldservice_activity
summary: Adds a checklist of activities to field service orders, which can be pre-filled from order templates. Workers work through the activities on each order, and required activities are tracked. It is set up under Field Service, Configuration, Manage Order Activities.

name: fieldservice_address_no_change
summary: Keeps the address on a completed field service order fixed, so later edits to the customer's location do not change the historical record. The order stores its own copy of the address fields once it is completed.

name: fieldservice_agreement
summary: Links field service orders to service agreements, and adds a Service Orders smart button on each agreement to see its jobs. The agreement also shows its linked locations and equipment count.

name: fieldservice_agreement_repair
summary: Connects repair orders to agreements through the equipment, so you can see which repairs an agreement covers. It is relevant when repairs are part of a service agreement.

name: fieldservice_availability
summary: Adds blackout days and blackout groups (dates when no service runs), stress days (high-demand dates) and delivery time ranges. A scheduled start date that falls on a blackout day for the route cannot be saved on an order.

name: fieldservice_availability
summary: Technical base for scheduling availability. It defines blackout days (closed dates), blackout groups, stress days (busy dates) and delivery time ranges, under Field Service, Configuration, Scheduling. It does nothing on its own until other modules use these records.

name: fieldservice_base_location
summary: Adds a ZIP field to field service locations, so entering a ZIP code fills in the city and address details automatically. ZIP entries are created under Contacts > Configuration > ZIPs.

name: fieldservice_calendar
summary: Creates a calendar meeting for each field service order, with the assigned worker as an attendee. The team's calendar user owns the events, and each meeting links back to its order.

name: fieldservice_crm
summary: Lets a salesperson create field service orders from a CRM opportunity, for example to send someone on site to survey a job before quoting. The opportunity gets an FS Orders smart button.

name: fieldservice_crm
summary: Lets sales create field service orders from CRM opportunities, for example to survey a site before quoting. An opportunity gets a Create FSM Order button and an FS Orders smart button. It is used from the CRM app.

name: fieldservice_current_location
summary: Adds a Use Current Location button on a field service order that creates a sub-address under the chosen location, using the device's GPS coordinates. It is most useful on a phone on site.

name: fieldservice_digitized_signature
summary: Adds a customer signature to field service orders, with a Signed By name and a Signed On date, captured on the Execution tab and printed on the Field Service Order report. The Signature field uses the web sign widget, and typing a name can generate a signature.

name: fieldservice_equipment_stock
summary: Creates a Field Service equipment record automatically when a serial-numbered product is moved in a configured stock operation. This tracks customer equipment in the field, and is set up on the product and the operation type.

name: fieldservice_equipment_stock
summary: Creates field service equipment records automatically when serial-numbered products are moved in stock on configured operation types, such as deliveries or receipts. This lets you track which equipment is installed where. It is set on products and operation types.

name: fieldservice_equipment_stock_return
summary: Lets a Return order type send a worker to collect equipment from its current location, and records the return as a new stock picking. The return is started from the equipment record.

name: fieldservice_equipment_warranty
summary: Adds warranty start and end dates, plus warranty duration and type, to field service equipment, based on the product's warranty settings. It shows the warranty status on each equipment record.

name: fieldservice_expense
summary: Lets field workers record expenses on a field service order from its Expenses tab, and the expense is linked to the order via a stat button. The expense itself is created in the Expenses app.

name: fieldservice_fleet
summary: Links field service vehicles to Fleet vehicles and field workers to Fleet drivers. An existing Fleet vehicle can be converted into a field service vehicle, and existing service vehicles get matching Fleet records when the module is installed.

name: fieldservice_fleet
summary: Links Field Service vehicles to vehicles and drivers in the Fleet app. A Fleet vehicle can be converted into an FSM vehicle, and existing FSM vehicles get matching Fleet records on install.

name: fieldservice_geoengine
summary: Shows field service locations and orders on a map, colored by stage, using OpenStreetMap through the geo engine. Each location is placed using its address. The map views are on the Field Service dashboard and the locations.

name: fieldservice_geoengine
summary: Adds a map view of field service locations and orders using OpenStreetMap through the GeoEngine module, with orders coloured by stage. It is opened from the Field Service dashboard.

name: fieldservice_google_map
summary: Adds a Google Maps view of field service orders and locations, with orders coloured by stage. It is opened from the Field Service dashboard and needs a Google Maps API key set in Settings.

name: fieldservice_isp_account
summary: Tracks employee timesheet hours and contractor costs on a field service order, then creates a customer invoice and a vendor bill when the order is completed. The order's Accounting tab shows the entries and total cost.

name: fieldservice_isp_flow
summary: Adds default order stages and stage checks for internet service provider field work. Orders can also be given a warehouse, delivery method and products on the Inventory tab, and confirming the order creates the delivery orders.

name: fieldservice_isp_flow
summary: Adds default order stages and stage checks for internet service provider field work. Orders can also be given a warehouse, delivery method and products on the Inventory tab, and confirming the order creates the delivery orders.

name: fieldservice_kanban_info
summary: Shows the scheduled time range, customer address and phone numbers directly on field service kanban cards, so workers see key job details without opening the order. The time format can be set in the settings.

name: fieldservice_kanban_info
summary: Shows the scheduled time window, the customer's address and the contact's phone directly on field service kanban cards, so dispatchers and technicians can see the key details without opening each order. The time format can be set in Field Service settings.

name: fieldservice_maintenance
summary: Connects field service orders with maintenance requests and equipment, so maintenance can be scheduled and performed on site. A field service order of the maintenance type creates a maintenance request, and equipment can have a maintenance schedule.

name: fieldservice_order_property
summary: Lets a team add custom property fields to its field service orders, with optional defaults and an option to show them on the kanban view. The properties shown adjust to the team of each order.

name: fieldservice_portal
summary: Lets portal customers see the field service orders at their locations and each order's current stage. Each stage can be made visible or hidden in the portal.

name: fieldservice_project
summary: Lets field service orders be created from a project or a project task, and links each order back to its project and task. Use the Service Orders tab on the project or task to create or see them.

name: fieldservice_project
summary: Creates field service orders from a project or project task, and links them back to it. The Service Orders tab appears on projects and tasks.

name: fieldservice_purchase
summary: Links field service to purchasing. Vendor pricelists can be set for field service workers, and purchase orders can be raised from a field service order, for example to buy parts or hire a subcontractor.

name: fieldservice_recurring
summary: Sets up recurring field service orders, such as regular maintenance visits, from a template and a frequency rule. The first order is created on confirmation, and a scheduled job creates the later ones.

name: fieldservice_recurring
summary: Creates repeating field service orders, such as weekly or monthly visits. The recurrence is set with frequency rules, for example every second Monday, and a scheduled job creates the future orders. It is found under Field Service, Operations, Recurring Orders.

name: fieldservice_repair
summary: Lets a field service order of the Repair type repair a field equipment, with a repair order created and linked automatically. Equipment must have a product and serial number set, and parts can be added, changed or removed.

name: fieldservice_repair
summary: Links repair orders to field service orders for equipment that is repaired on site. Choosing the Repair type on an order with an equipment creates a repair order, and the equipment's parts can be added, replaced or removed.

name: fieldservice_repair_order_template
summary: Pre-fills the repair orders created from field service orders using a repair order template, which is chosen on a field service template. It is set under Field Service, Master Data, Templates.

name: fieldservice_route
summary: Groups each worker's field service orders into a sorted daily route. When an order is assigned and scheduled, a day route for that worker and date is created automatically. Routes have a maximum number of orders, days and territories, and are set under Field Service, Master Data, Routes.

name: fieldservice_route
summary: Builds a daily route for each worker, the sorted list of orders that person or vehicle will do that day. When an order is assigned and scheduled, its day route is created automatically, and routes are managed under Field Service > Master Data.

name: fieldservice_route_availability
summary: Blocks scheduling orders on blackout days for routes that use a blackout group. Trying to set a scheduled start (ETA) on a blackout date shows an error. Blackout groups are set on the route.

name: fieldservice_route_availability
summary: Empty compatibility module kept so older databases can upgrade. Its blackout day feature was merged into fieldservice_availability, which new installs should use directly.

name: fieldservice_sale
summary: Lets products sold on a sale order generate field service orders. The sale order gets a Service Location, and when a field order is completed the linked sale line is marked as delivered.

name: fieldservice_sale
