summary: Lets you sell field services from sales orders. Confirming a sales order with a field service product creates field service orders, and the sales line's delivered quantity is updated once the order is completed. A field service location can be set on the sales order.

name: fieldservice_sale_agreement
summary: Copies the agreement from a sales order onto the field service orders it creates. It is a bridge between the sale agreement and field service agreement modules.

name: fieldservice_sale_agreement_equipment_stock
summary: When a delivery creates field equipment from a sale order line, the sale's agreement is copied onto the new equipment. This keeps the contract linked to the installed equipment.

name: fieldservice_sale_agreement_equipment_stock
summary: Copies the agreement from a sales order onto the equipment created from that sale, so the agreement follows the installed equipment. It is a bridge between sales agreements, field service and stock equipment.

name: fieldservice_sale_recurring
summary: Lets you sell recurring field services. Confirming a sales order with a recurring service product creates the recurring field service orders, linked to the sales line, using the product's recurring template.

name: fieldservice_sale_recurring_agreement
summary: Links recurring field service tasks to agreements, so the sales orders generated from them get the agreement set automatically. The agreement set on a recurring task is carried onto each sales order it creates.

name: fieldservice_sale_stock
summary: Links the delivery pickings from a sales order to the field service order it creates, so stock moves for storable products appear on the job. Stock sold per sale order is delivered as part of the service.

name: fieldservice_sale_stock_from_pos
summary: Lets point of sale purchases of a product create field service orders, including handling refunds. The POS setting controls when the orders and stock moves are linked, either immediately or at session close.

name: fieldservice_sale_stock_route
summary: Schedules field service orders created from sales onto a route day automatically. Confirming the order requires a location with a route, a worker and route days. A Postpone Delivery button moves an order to the next route day, and routes can have a Force Schedule option that allows any day.

name: fieldservice_sign
summary: Adds customer signature capture on field service orders, which can be required before the order is completed, and document signing through the sign_oca module. A signature request for a document is linked to the order and its status is shown on it.

name: fieldservice_size
summary: Records sizes, such as area or item count, on field service locations and orders. The order size fills in from the location's size for that order type, which helps with route time planning and stock planning.

name: fieldservice_size
summary: Records a size for field service locations, such as area or number of items, and orders take a size value from their type's default size. The sizes can be used for planning routes, time and stock.

name: fieldservice_size
summary: Records a size for field service locations, such as area or number of items, and orders take a size value from their type's default size. The sizes can be used for planning routes, time and stock.

name: fieldservice_skill
summary: Limits which field workers can be assigned to an order by matching the skills and skill levels the job needs. Skills are set on categories and templates, and the worker list on an order is filtered to those who have them and serve the location.

name: fieldservice_skill
summary: Limits which workers can be assigned to an order by their skills and levels. Categories and templates set the required skills, and the worker list is filtered by skill and by the location's territory. Skills are set on categories, workers and territories.

name: fieldservice_stage_server_action
summary: Runs a server action automatically when a field service order moves into a chosen stage, such as sending a notification or creating a record. It is configured per stage under Field Service, Configuration, Stages.

name: fieldservice_stage_validation
summary: Stops an order, worker, location or equipment from moving to a stage until chosen fields are filled in, such as actual end date or resolution notes. The required fields are set per stage, and a validation error is shown if one is empty.

name: fieldservice_stage_validation
summary: Stops a record from moving to a stage until chosen fields are filled in, showing a validation error otherwise. For example, a completed order can require an actual end date or resolution notes.

name: fieldservice_stock
summary: Connects field service orders to inventory, so pickings, stock moves and procurements can be tied to an order. Locations get an inventory location, and territories can be assigned the warehouse that serves them.

name: fieldservice_stock
summary: Connects inventory to field service. Locations and territories can have an inventory location or warehouse, and stock pickings and moves are linked to the job. Related transfers can be validated automatically when an order completes.

name: fieldservice_stock_picking
summary: Lets a Field Service Order send materials out to a job site and receive them back using standard stock transfers. Users pick the outgoing and incoming operation types on the order's Inventory tab and create the transfers in one click, then reach them from the Deliveries and Returns smart buttons. Field service templates can pre-set those operation types.

name: fieldservice_stock_request
summary: Adds stock requests to Field Service Orders, so the products a job needs are requested from a warehouse straight from the order. Users add products on the order's Inventory tab and confirm to generate delivery orders, and delivered quantities update the order lines once the transfers are validated. The stock requests are shown on the Field Service Order.

name: fieldservice_stock_request
summary: Adds stock requests to Field Service Orders, so the products a job needs are requested from a warehouse straight from the order. Users add products on the order's Inventory tab and confirm to generate delivery orders, and delivered quantities update the order lines once the transfers are validated. The request orders can also show the assigned person and the actual delivery date.

name: fieldservice_stock_scrap
summary: Lets users scrap inbound stock requests from a Field Service Order directly from the order, using a Scrap action and a smart button that links to the scrap records. It is for discarding materials that cannot be used at a job. The scrap records are shown from the Field Service Order and back again.

name: fieldservice_subcontracting
summary: Creates a draft purchase order to a subcontractor when a field service order is assigned to a subcontractor worker and moved to the set stage. It keeps the purchase order's expected arrival in sync with the order schedule and updates delivered quantities from timesheets. Subcontractors are marked on partners.

name: fieldservice_timeline
summary: Shows field service orders on a timeline view, sorted by their latest request date, in a new menu under Field Service, Operations. It adds a visual schedule of orders on the web timeline.

name: fieldservice_timeline
summary: Adds a timeline view of Field Service Orders so you can see the schedule of work, and a menu item for orders by latest request date. Users can drag events to reschedule them or zoom with the mouse wheel. It shows as a view switcher on the orders list and under Field Service > Operations.
keywords: drag and drop schedule field service

name: fieldservice_timeline
summary: Adds a timeline view of Field Service Orders grouped by assigned worker, so you can see scheduled work across workers on one chart. Users can drag events to reschedule them or zoom with the mouse wheel. An Orders by Latest Request menu under Field Service > Operations lists orders on the timeline.
keywords: drag and drop schedule field service

name: fieldservice_timesheet
summary: Lets workers record the time spent on field service orders with timesheets, and shows the timesheet entries on each order. Entries also appear in the timesheet reports.

name: fieldservice_vehicle
summary: Manages field service vehicles and assigns them to workers, and each order can record which vehicle is used. Vehicles are set up under Field Service, Master Data, Vehicles.

name: fieldservice_vehicle
summary: Keeps a list of vehicles for field service work and lets you assign each vehicle to a worker as the driver. A vehicle can then be picked on a Field Service Order. Vehicles are maintained under Field Service > Master Data > Vehicles.

name: filter_multi_user
summary: Lets admins share a saved custom filter with chosen users or groups, so the same filter appears in their Favorites list. Only the owner can edit the filter. Sharing is set on the filter record under Settings, Technical, User Interface, User-defined Filters.

name: fleet_vehicle_calendar_year
summary: Adds a Calendar Year field to fleet vehicles, for places that describe a vehicle's year by calendar year rather than model year. It is a plain text field on the vehicle form. Technical in scope: it adds a field and nothing else.

name: fleet_vehicle_calendar_year
summary: Adds a Calendar Year field to fleet vehicles, for places that describe a vehicle's year by calendar year rather than model year. It is a plain text field on the vehicle form. Technical in scope: it adds a field and nothing else.

name: fleet_vehicle_category
summary: Adds vehicle categories, such as tow truck, ambulance, trailer or boat, each with a name and description. Each vehicle can then be given a category on its form. Categories are kept as their own records.

name: fleet_vehicle_configuration
summary: Lets you record several internal configurations of the same vehicle, each with a maximum seat count, such as a 5-seat and a 7-seat version of one car. Configurations are listed on the vehicle form. It does not handle option packages or variants of the same model.

name: fleet_vehicle_configuration
summary: Lets you record several internal configurations of the same vehicle, each with a maximum seat count, such as a 5-seat and a 7-seat version of one car. Configurations are listed on the vehicle form. It does not handle option packages or variants of the same model.

name: fleet_vehicle_fuel_capacity
summary: Adds a Fuel Capacity field, in litres, to each fleet vehicle. The value is stored on the vehicle form for reference. The module adds no calculations or reports on top of the field.

name: fleet_vehicle_fuel_capacity
summary: Adds a Fuel Capacity field, in litres, to each fleet vehicle. The value is stored on the vehicle form for reference. The module adds no calculations or reports on top of the field.

name: fleet_vehicle_fuel_type_ethanol
summary: Adds Ethanol and Flex (gasoline or ethanol) as fuel types for fleet vehicles. The new options appear in the Fuel Type field on the vehicle form.

name: fleet_vehicle_fuel_type_ethanol
summary: Adds Ethanol and Flex (gasoline or ethanol) as fuel types for fleet vehicles. The new options appear in the Fuel Type field on the vehicle form, and on vehicle models as a default fuel type.

name: fleet_vehicle_history_date_end
summary: When a new driver is assigned to a vehicle, the end date is filled in automatically on the previous driver's history entry. Standard Odoo only sets the start date. The change shows in the vehicle's driver assignment history.

name: fleet_vehicle_history_date_end
summary: When a new driver is assigned to a vehicle, the end date is filled in automatically on the previous driver's history entry. Standard Odoo only sets the start date. The change shows in the vehicle's driver assignment history.

name: fleet_vehicle_inspection
summary: Records vehicle entry and exit inspections, each with a checklist of inspection items, a result per item, notes and images. Confirming an inspection creates a service record for the vehicle, and cancelling it deletes that record. Inspection items are set up under Fleet > Configuration > Inspection Items, and the inspections show as a smart button on the vehicle.

name: fleet_vehicle_inspection
summary: Records vehicle entry and exit inspections, each with a checklist of inspection items, a result per item, notes and images. Confirming an inspection creates a service record for the vehicle, and cancelling it deletes that record. Inspection items are set up under Fleet > Configuration > Inspection Items, and the inspections show as a smart button on the vehicle.

name: fleet_vehicle_inspection_template
summary: Lets you save reusable inspection templates, each an ordered set of inspection items, and pick one when creating a vehicle inspection. Templates are maintained under Fleet > Configuration > Inspection Templates.

name: fleet_vehicle_inspection_template
summary: Lets you save reusable inspection templates, each an ordered set of inspection items, and pick one when creating a vehicle inspection. Templates are maintained under Fleet > Configuration > Inspection Templates.

name: fleet_vehicle_log_fuel
summary: Adds fuel logs for vehicles, recording each fuel purchase with its cost, odometer reading, date and description, in the same way as service logs. The logs are listed on each vehicle with a count, and fuel is included as a cost type in the vehicle cost report.

name: fleet_vehicle_ownership
summary: Records who owns each vehicle by linking an owner contact to the vehicle. The owner is set on the vehicle form, and each contact shows the vehicles they own.

name: fleet_vehicle_purchase
summary: Lets purchase orders reference a fleet vehicle, both on the order header and on each order line, so purchases can be tied to a specific vehicle. Vehicles also show their related purchase orders. It is a link between the Purchase and Fleet apps.

name: fleet_vehicle_purchase
summary: Lets purchase orders reference a fleet vehicle, both on the order header and on each order line, so purchases can be tied to a specific vehicle. Vehicles also show their related purchase orders. It is a link between the Purchase and Fleet apps.

name: fleet_vehicle_purchase_link
summary: Lets you set a fleet vehicle on each purchase order line. A vehicle then has a Purchases smart button with the count of linked lines, and Fleet > Fleet > Purchases lists the purchase orders linked to vehicles. It needs the Fleet Vehicle Purchase module.

name: fleet_vehicle_purchase_link
summary: Lets you set a fleet vehicle on each purchase order line. A vehicle then has a Purchases smart button with the count of linked lines, and Fleet > Fleet > Purchases lists the purchase orders linked to vehicles. It needs the Fleet Vehicle Purchase module.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_activity
summary: Creates an activity for the fleet manager when a vehicle service is coming due, based on a number of days set in Fleet settings. The reminder appears in the user's activities list, so nothing due is missed.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_activity
summary: Creates an activity for the fleet manager when a vehicle service is coming due, based on a number of days set in Fleet settings. The reminder appears in the user's activities list, so nothing due is missed.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_calendar
summary: Adds a Meetings smart button on vehicle service records for scheduling calendar meetings tied to that service. Calendar events can also be searched by the service they belong to. It requires the service kanban module.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_kanban
summary: Turns vehicle service logs into a kanban board with configurable stages, tags, priority, a responsible user, chatter and activities. Stages, tags and activity types are configured under Fleet > Configuration > Services Logs. It is a fleet maintenance pipeline view.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_kanban
summary: Turns vehicle service logs into a kanban board with configurable stages, tags, priority, a responsible user and activity types. Stages, tags and activity types are configured under Fleet > Configuration > Services Logs. It is a fleet maintenance pipeline view.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_services
summary: Lets a vehicle service record include several sub-services, the same way contracts do, so one service can list all the work done. The included services are shown on the service form.

name: fleet_vehicle_service_services
summary: Lets a vehicle service record include several sub-services, the same way contracts do, so one service can list all the work done. The included services are shown on the service form.

name: fleet_vehicle_stock
summary: Creates a fleet vehicle automatically when a serial-numbered product is completed on a stock operation type that is set up for it, such as receipts or deliveries. Vehicles then link to their serial number and show their current inventory location. It must be enabled on both the product and the operation type.

name: fleet_vehicle_stock
summary: Creates a fleet vehicle automatically when a serial-numbered product is completed on a stock operation type that is set up for it, such as receipts or deliveries. Vehicles then link to their serial number and show their current inventory location. It must be enabled on both the product and the operation type.

name: fleet_vehicle_usage
summary: Records each time an employee takes a fleet vehicle out and returns it, with pick-up and return dates, driver, destination, state and comments. A vehicle shows whether it is currently in use. Usage is logged against the vehicle.

name: fleet_vehicle_usage
summary: Records each time an employee takes a fleet vehicle out and returns it, with pick-up and return dates, driver, destination, state and comments. A vehicle shows whether it is currently in use. Usage is logged against the vehicle.

name: fs_attachment
summary: Technical module that stores Odoo attachments in an external file system, such as S3-compatible or NFS storage, instead of Odoo's filestore. It is configured under Settings > Technical > FS Storage, and attachments get internal and filesystem URL fields. Useful for multi-server deployments that need shared file access.

name: fs_attachment
summary: Technical module that stores Odoo attachments in an external file system, such as S3-compatible or NFS storage, instead of Odoo's filestore. It is configured under Settings > Technical > FS Storage, and attachments get internal and filesystem URL fields. Useful for multi-server deployments that need shared file access.

name: fs_attachment_environment
summary: Technical glue module that lets the external attachment storage use the server environment settings from fs_storage_environment. It adds no screens of its own and is aimed at administrators and developers.

name: fs_attachment_s3
summary: Adds Amazon S3 support to external attachment storage. It adds signed URL options for serving files through X-Accel-Redirect, which allows files in a private S3 bucket to be served, a signed URL expiry setting, and enforcement of file mimetypes. It is configured under Settings > Technical > Storage > File Storage.

name: fs_attachment_s3_environment
summary: Technical glue module that lets the S3 attachment storage use the server environment settings. It adds no screens of its own and is aimed at administrators and developers.

name: fs_base_multi_image
summary: Technical base module that lets other models link several images stored in an external file system, either specific to one record or shared from a library of images. Managing shared images requires the Image Manager role. It has no end-user screen of its own.

name: fs_base_multi_image
summary: Technical base module that lets other models link several images stored in an external file system, either specific to one record or shared from a library of images. Managing shared images requires the Image Manager role. It has no end-user screen of its own.

name: fs_base_multi_media
summary: Technical base module that stores media files in an external file system and lets other models link several of them, either specific to one record or shared from a media library. Managing shared media requires the Media Manager role, and media types are kept as their own records.

name: fs_base_multi_media
summary: Technical base module that stores media files in an external file system and lets other models link several of them, either specific to one record or shared from a media library. Managing shared media requires the Media Manager role, and media types are kept as their own records.

name: fs_file
summary: Technical field type FSFile that stores a file's content in an external file system instead of Odoo's filestore. The content is read only when needed and can be streamed, which suits large files. Developers use it on their own models; there is no separate end-user screen.

name: fs_file
summary: Technical field type FSFile that stores a file's content in an external file system instead of Odoo's filestore. The content is read only when needed and can be streamed, which suits large files. Developers use it on their own models; there is no separate end-user screen.

name: fs_file_demo
summary: Demo module for the FSFile field. Under Settings > Technical > Fs File you can create a sample record that stores its file externally. It is for testing and learning, not production use.

name: fs_file_demo
summary: Demo module for the FSFile field. Under Settings > Technical > Fs File you can create a sample record that stores its file externally. It is for testing and learning, not production use.

name: fs_folder
summary: Technical field type FsFolder that links an Odoo record, such as a customer, to a folder in an external file system and lets users manage that folder's contents from the record form. Developers add the field to their own models. Storage options for default folder contents are added to file storages.

name: fs_folder_demo
summary: Demo module that adds an FsFolder field to contacts, so a partner form can create a folder for that contact. The folder is created in a subfolder of the Odoo filestore. It is for demonstration and testing.

name: fs_folder_environment
summary: Technical glue module that lets folder storages use the server environment settings from fs_storage_environment. It adds no screens of its own and is aimed at administrators and developers.

name: fs_folder_ms_drive
summary: Extends folder fields so a record's external folder can be browsed and managed when it lives on a Microsoft drive, such as OneDrive or SharePoint. It depends on the Microsoft Drive storage setup. It is aimed at administrators and developers who configure the storage.

name: fs_folder_webdav
summary: Improves the record folder screens when the folder lives on a WebDAV storage, such as Nextcloud, and notes the setup needed for WebDAV. It needs the webdav4 Python library installed on the server. Admin-facing.

name: fs_image
summary: Technical field type FSImage that stores images in an external file system, like Odoo's Image field. Developers can cap the width and height so large uploads are resized, and images get an alt text shown when they cannot display. It has no separate end-user screen.

name: fs_image
summary: Technical field type FSImage that stores images in an external file system, like Odoo's Image field. Developers can cap the width and height so large uploads are resized, and images get an alt text shown when they cannot display. It has no separate end-user screen.

name: fs_image_thumbnail
summary: Technical mixin that creates and stores thumbnails of externally stored images on first request, then reuses them. It is for other modules to build on and is not meant for end users. Thumbnails are kept as attachments.

name: fs_image_thumbnail
summary: Technical mixin that creates and stores thumbnails of externally stored images on first request, then reuses them. It is for other modules to build on and is not meant for end users. Thumbnails are kept as attachments.

name: fs_product_brand_multi_image
summary: Lets product brands carry several images stored in external file storage. Users add images on the product brand form under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product Brands, either by uploading or by reusing an existing image. It replaces the standard product brand image add-on.

name: fs_product_brand_multi_image
summary: Lets product brands carry several images stored in external file storage. Users add images on the product brand form under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product Brands, either by uploading or by reusing an existing image. It replaces the standard product brand image add-on.

name: fs_product_multi_image
summary: Attaches several images to products and product categories, stored in external file storage instead of the database. A new tab on the category and product forms lets users upload or reuse images, tag them, and in the product template choose which variant attribute values an image applies to. It replaces the standard product image add-on.

name: fs_product_multi_image
summary: Attaches several images to products and product categories, stored in external file storage instead of the database. A new tab on the category and product forms lets users upload or reuse images, tag them, and in the product template choose which variant attribute values an image applies to. It replaces the standard product image add-on.

name: fs_product_multi_media
summary: Attaches media files to products and product categories, stored in external file storage instead of the database. A new tab on the category and product forms lets users upload or reuse media, and media on a product template can be tied to specific variant attribute values. It replaces the standard product media add-on.

name: fs_product_multi_media
summary: Attaches media files to products and product categories, stored in external file storage instead of the database. A new tab on the category and product forms lets users upload or reuse media, and media on a product template can be tied to specific variant attribute values. It replaces the standard product media add-on.

name: fs_product_public_category_multi_image
summary: Adds an Images section to eCommerce public categories, so a website category can show several images stored in external file storage. Users find it under Website > eCommerce > Products > eCommerce Categories, and upload or reuse images there.

name: fs_storage
summary: Technical base for defining external file storage backends, such as S3, SFTP or FTP, through the fsspec library. Storages are set up under Settings > Technical > FS Storage, and a default storage keeps files in a directory on the Odoo server. Other fs_* modules use these storages to keep their data.

name: fs_storage
summary: Technical base for defining external file storage backends, such as S3, SFTP or FTP, through the fsspec library. Storages are set up under Settings > Technical > FS Storage, and a default storage keeps files in a directory on the Odoo server. Other fs_* modules use these storages to keep their data.

name: fs_storage_backup
summary: Lets you send database backups to one or more external storages. A scheduled action backs up the database and deletes old backups after a set number of days, and the chatter can notify you if a backup fails. The filestore should not be used as the backup location.

name: fs_storage_backup_environment
summary: Technical glue module that lets the backup storages use the server environment settings from fs_storage_environment. It adds no screens of its own and is aimed at administrators and developers.

name: fs_storage_environment
summary: Technical bridge that lets external file storages be defined in environment files or the main Odoo configuration file, so the same setup can differ per environment. It is for administrators and developers and adds no end-user screens.

name: fs_storage_environment
summary: Technical bridge that lets external file storages be defined in environment files or the main Odoo configuration file, so the same setup can differ per environment. It is for administrators and developers and adds no end-user screens.

name: fs_storage_ms_drive
summary: Lets a file storage use a Microsoft drive, such as OneDrive or SharePoint, as its backend through Microsoft Graph. Calls run with the credentials of the Odoo user doing the action, so each user must link their Microsoft account, and expired tokens are refreshed automatically.

name: geoengine_base_geolocalize
summary: Adds a map point to partners and fills it automatically from their address using OpenStreetMap's Nominatim geocoding service. Users see the location on the partner's Geoengine Map tab. Read the Nominatim usage policy before relying on it.

name: geoengine_base_geolocalize
summary: Adds a map point to partners and fills it automatically from their address using OpenStreetMap's Nominatim geocoding service. Users see the location on the partner's Geoengine Map tab. Read the Nominatim usage policy before relying on it.

name: geoengine_partner
summary: Lets users place a point on a map for a partner's address. On the partner form, open the Geoengine Map tab, switch to edit mode, click the map to add a point, drag it to move it, or use the trash icon to remove it.

name: geoengine_partner
summary: Lets users place a point on a map for a partner's address. On the partner form, open the Geoengine Map tab, switch to edit mode, click the map to add a point, drag it to move it, or use the trash icon to remove it.

name: geospatial_plot
summary: Lets users draw land plots on a map and link each plot to the partner using it, with an owner if different, a plot address, and size in a chosen area unit. The plots and acreage totals appear on the partner form. Default area unit is set in the Configuration settings.

name: github_connector
summary: Developer tool that syncs GitHub organizations, teams, users, repositories and branches into Odoo, downloads source code, and runs analysis rules over the code. It is set up through GitHub > Settings > Sync Object, and needs GitHub credentials and a local source code path in the Odoo configuration file.

name: github_connector
summary: Developer tool that syncs GitHub organizations, teams, users, repositories and branches into Odoo, downloads source code, and runs analysis rules over the code. It is set up through GitHub > Settings > Sync Object, and needs GitHub credentials and a local source code path in the Odoo configuration file.

name: github_connector_odoo
summary: Developer tool that extends GitHub Connector for repositories containing Odoo modules. It lists each module with its versions, authors, license, series, dependencies and Runbot link, and adds menus for them. Organization settings hold the default author text and the Runbot ID file URL.

name: github_connector_odoo
summary: Developer tool that extends GitHub Connector for repositories containing Odoo modules. It lists each module with its versions, authors, license, series, dependencies and Runbot link, and adds menus for them. Organization settings hold the default author text and the Runbot ID file URL.

name: graphql_base
summary: Technical base for building GraphQL endpoints in Odoo with the graphene library, with an optional GraphiQL explorer. It does nothing on its own, since a developer must write the schema and controller. It has no end-user screen.

name: graphql_base
summary: Technical base for building GraphQL endpoints in Odoo with the graphene library, with an optional GraphiQL explorer. It does nothing on its own, since a developer must write the schema and controller. It has no end-user screen.

name: graphql_demo
summary: Demo module with a sample GraphQL endpoint and tests for graphql_base. Developers can copy it as an example, and it can be opened in GraphiQL at the demo URL. It is for testing and learning, not production use.

name: graphql_demo
summary: Demo module with a sample GraphQL endpoint and tests for graphql_base. Developers can copy it as an example, and it can be opened in GraphiQL at the demo URL. It is for testing and learning, not production use.

name: helpdesk_mgmt
summary: The core Helpdesk app for handling customer support tickets. Users create tickets, assign them to teams and members, move them through stages, and organize them with categories, tags and channels on a kanban dashboard. Customers can submit and follow tickets through the website portal.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_account
summary: Links helpdesk tickets with customer invoices and journal entries, with smart buttons on both the ticket and the accounting document. The smart buttons appear only for users in the Show Full Accounting Features group.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_activity
summary: Lets a helpdesk ticket link to a record of another configured model and create an activity, such as a call or meeting, on that record right from the ticket. The ticket can move to a preset next stage, and it can change stage when the activity is marked done. Available models are set in Helpdesk settings and the done stage per team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_activity
summary: Lets helpdesk agents create an activity, such as a call or meeting, on any linked record directly from a ticket, and moves the ticket to a new stage when that activity is done. The available models and the done stage are set per team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_assign_method
summary: Adds automatic ticket assignment to helpdesk teams, chosen on the team form as manual, random, balanced (fewest open tickets) or sequential round-robin. Automatic assignment works only for users who are members of the team, and the responsible user is set when a ticket is created or updated.
keywords: assign ticket to least busy agent

name: helpdesk_mgmt_assign_method
summary: Adds automatic ticket assignment to helpdesk teams, chosen on the team form as manual, random, balanced (fewest open tickets) or sequential round-robin. Automatic assignment works only for users who are members of the team, and the responsible user is set when a ticket is created or updated.
keywords: assign ticket to least busy agent

name: helpdesk_mgmt_assign_method_hr_holidays
summary: Stops tickets from being auto-assigned to team members who are on leave. A team option allows assigning tickets to users on leave anyway. It requires the assignment method and time-off modules.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_crm
summary: Converts a helpdesk ticket into a CRM opportunity, copying the ticket details and messages, and keeps the two linked. A wizard lets you pick the salesperson and sales team. The button is on the ticket form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice
summary: Creates Field Service orders from a helpdesk ticket, using the Service Orders tab on the ticket to track their status. A ticket cannot be closed until all its related service orders are closed.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice
summary: Creates field service orders from a helpdesk ticket and shows their status on the ticket. A ticket can only be closed once all of its linked service orders are closed. Service orders are managed in the ticket's Service Orders tab.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_equipment
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to field service equipment, so each ticket shows the equipment it concerns and each equipment record shows its tickets. It appears on the ticket form and the equipment form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_equipment_warranty
summary: Shows the equipment's warranty start and end dates on the helpdesk ticket, so agents can see at a glance whether a complaint is under warranty. The dates appear on the ticket form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_project
summary: Passes a helpdesk ticket's project and task on to any field service order created from that ticket. The order is then linked to the same project and task as the ticket.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_mail_autogenerated_header
summary: Stops the stage welcome email from being sent back when a ticket comes in from an automatic reply, such as an out-of-office message. This prevents mail loops between the helpdesk and the sender.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_merge
summary: Adds a wizard, opened from the helpdesk ticket list, that merges several tickets into a new ticket or into an existing one. It is for cleaning up duplicate or repeated support requests.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_merge
summary: Adds a wizard to merge several helpdesk tickets into one, either into a new ticket or into an existing one. It is opened from the ticket list view.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_portal_follower
summary: Lets customers add email addresses as followers of a ticket from the website portal, so colleagues get updates. The addresses are entered comma-separated in an Emails in Copy field.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project
summary: Lets helpdesk tickets belong to a project and link to a task. Teams can have a default project, and projects and tasks show a ticket count with a smart button to the tickets. It joins the Helpdesk and Project apps.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to projects and tasks, with a default project per team. Projects and tasks show a ticket count, and tickets can be linked to a task. It appears on the ticket form and the project forms.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project_domain
summary: Limits which projects and tasks a helpdesk user can pick on a ticket, using a domain set on the company, on each team, or as Python code. A team uses its own domain if one is set, otherwise the company-wide domain applies. It is configured in the Helpdesk settings and on each team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project_stage
summary: Keeps helpdesk ticket stages and project task stages in sync. When a ticket moves to a stage that has a task stage set, its linked task moves too, and the reverse. Task stages are set under Helpdesk > Configuration > Stages.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_rating
summary: Lets customers rate the help they received on a ticket. A rating request email goes out at the stage you set, and tickets show the percentage of positive ratings.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_rating
summary: Lets customers rate the support they received on a ticket. Each stage can have a rating email template, and tickets track their positive rating percentage. Stages are set up under Helpdesk > Configuration > Stages.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sale
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to sales orders, so a ticket can have several orders and each order shows its tickets. Each ticket has a Sales Order button that opens the linked orders.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sale
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to sales orders. A ticket can have several sales orders, and each order shows its related ticket, so support work and sales can be traced together.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sale_project
summary: Keeps a helpdesk ticket's project in step with its sales order. If the order's project changes and the ticket has no project, the ticket takes that project. It is a technical link with no separate screens.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sla
summary: Adds service level agreements (SLAs) to helpdesk tickets. An SLA is set per team and gives each ticket a deadline in hours or days, counted on the team's working hours calendar. On the Kanban view the deadline shows green when on track and red when the SLA is breached, and SLAs are configured under Helpdesk > Configuration > SLA.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sla
summary: Adds service level agreements to tickets, with response and resolution deadlines per SLA based on working hours. Kanban cards and the ticket form show whether each deadline is met or missed. SLAs are set up under Helpdesk, Configuration, SLA.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_stage_validation
summary: Requires certain ticket fields to be filled in before a ticket can move into a stage. If they are blank, the user gets a validation error. The required fields are set per stage under Helpdesk > Configuration > Stages, for example resolution notes before a ticket is marked complete.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_stage_validation
summary: Stops a ticket from moving to a stage until chosen fields are filled in, such as resolution notes. The required fields are set per stage, and the user sees a validation error if one is missing.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_stock
summary: Lets warehouse staff open helpdesk tickets from stock operations. A Helpdesk button on each transfer line and a Tickets button on the transfer create a ticket for that product or move. It is enabled per operation type, with an optional default helpdesk team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_team_partner
summary: Controls which customer can be picked on a helpdesk ticket, based on its team. A team can have a default customer, be limited to one customer, or be limited to a list of allowed customers. It suits companies that set up one helpdesk team per customer.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_template
summary: Pre-fills the description of a new ticket from a template tied to its category, for example a checklist for a common issue. Categories are configured per team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_timesheet
summary: Lets helpdesk agents log timesheet hours against tickets, with planned, consumed and remaining hours and progress shown on each ticket. Timesheets are enabled per team and can use a default project.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_timesheet_sale
summary: Lets a helpdesk ticket be tied to a sales order and sales order line, so the hours logged on the ticket can be billed through that line. Tickets can be marked billable.

name: helpdesk_mgmtsystem_nonconformity
summary: Creates a nonconformity record, from the quality management system, directly from a helpdesk ticket and keeps the two linked. Stages can also be tied to nonconformity stages. The link shows on both the ticket and the nonconformity.

name: helpdesk_motive
summary: Adds a Motive field to helpdesk tickets, so each ticket records the reason it was raised. The list of motives is limited to the ticket's team, and motives are managed under Helpdesk > Configuration > Motives.

name: helpdesk_motive
summary: Adds a Motive field to helpdesk tickets so agents can record why a ticket was opened. The motive list is set up per team, so each team only sees the reasons relevant to it. Motives are managed under Helpdesk > Configuration > Motives.

name: helpdesk_portal_priority
summary: Lets customers choose a priority when they open a ticket through the helpdesk customer portal. The chosen priority is then set on the ticket in the back office. It appears on the portal ticket creation form.

name: helpdesk_portal_restriction
summary: Restricts which helpdesk teams and ticket categories each customer can open tickets for. It is set on the customer's contact form. Customers then only see the allowed options when submitting a ticket in the portal.

name: helpdesk_product
summary: Adds a Product field to helpdesk tickets, so a ticket can name the product it is about. Products have a setting that controls whether they can be picked on tickets.

name: helpdesk_product
summary: Adds a Product field to helpdesk tickets so a ticket can be tied to the product it concerns. Products also get a smart count of related tickets, so you can see all support tickets for a product from its form. It shows on the ticket form and on product forms.

name: helpdesk_ticket_close_inactive
summary: Automatically closes helpdesk tickets that have had no activity for a set number of days, configured per team. Before closing, it can send a warning email to the customer and team members, and a final closing email when the limit is reached. Settings are on the Helpdesk team form under Settings > Teams.

name: helpdesk_ticket_open_tab
summary: Adds a button on Helpdesk kanban cards that opens a ticket in a new browser tab. Agents can keep the team board open while working on a ticket. It is found in the Helpdesk team kanban view.

name: helpdesk_ticket_partner_response
summary: Automatically moves a helpdesk ticket to another stage when the customer replies, whether through the portal or by email. On the team settings you choose which stage a ticket must be in and which stage it moves to. This is useful when a ticket waiting on the customer should be flagged as answered.

name: helpdesk_ticket_related
summary: Lets you link helpdesk tickets to each other, for example a follow-up or a duplicate ticket. The Related tickets field on the ticket form shows the linked tickets, giving a fuller history of a customer issue.

name: helpdesk_timesheet_time_type
summary: Shows the Time Type field from timesheets on the time tracking tab of helpdesk tickets. This lets agents classify the time they spend on a ticket by type. It is a small bridge between helpdesk timesheets and time types.

name: helpdesk_timesheet_time_type_non_billable
summary: Makes non-billable time logged on helpdesk tickets leave the remaining and total hours alone. When a timesheet on a ticket uses a non-billable time type, the hours are not deducted from the remaining hours. Time types are set under Project > Configuration > Time Type.

name: helpdesk_type
summary: Adds a Type field to helpdesk tickets, with a list you maintain under Helpdesk Configuration. Types can be limited to specific teams and can optionally be shown on the customer portal form, where they can also be made required.

name: helpdesk_type_sla
summary: Lets an SLA policy in the Helpdesk SLA module apply only to chosen ticket types. Set it on the SLA policy form, so each ticket type can follow its own service targets.

name: hotel
summary: Hotel management for a property with rooms, room types, floors, amenities and hotel services. It records guest stays as folios (a bill with room and service lines), tracks check-in and check-out history, and links folios to sales orders and invoices. It is a vertical application for hotels and apartments.

name: hotel
summary: Hotel management for a property with rooms, room types, floors, amenities and hotel services. It records guest stays as folios (a bill with room and service lines), tracks check-in and check-out history, and links folios to sales orders and invoices. It is a vertical application for hotels and apartments.

name: hotel_housekeeping
summary: Manages housekeeping for hotel rooms: a housekeeping record per room with activities, the housekeeper assigned, start and end times, a dirty or clean status, and an inspector who checks quality. A housekeeping report summarises the work. It builds on the hotel module.

name: hotel_housekeeping
summary: Manages housekeeping for hotel rooms: a housekeeping record per room with activities, the housekeeper assigned, start and end times, a dirty or clean status, and an inspector who checks quality. A housekeeping report summarises the work. It builds on the hotel module.

name: hotel_housekeeping
summary: Manages housekeeping for hotel rooms: a housekeeping record per room with activities, the housekeeper assigned, start and end times, a dirty or clean status, and an inspector who checks quality. A housekeeping report summarises the work. It builds on the hotel module.

name: hotel_reservation
summary: Lets staff reserve hotel rooms for single guests or groups, by room type and capacity, and confirm the booking. It can generate folios and print check-in, check-out and room reports, and offers a quick reservation and a reservation summary. It also depends on the website sales module.

name: hotel_restaurant
summary: Adds restaurant features to the hotel: table bookings, food orders that can be charged to a room's folio, kitchen order tickets, and restaurant reports. It depends on the point of sale module for payments.

name: hr_accident
summary: Records employee accidents in the Employees app under Accidents. Each record holds the employee, a reference, the date, a description and related documents uploaded from a Documents tab. It is a simple register for tracking incidents.

name: hr_announcement
summary: Lets announcements target specific employees, departments or job positions, not just users. When a targeted user logs in, the announcement shows to them. Managers create these under Discussion > Announcements, choosing the audience in the announcement type field.

name: hr_appraisal_oca
summary: Runs performance appraisals: managers evaluate employees, employees can complete self-assessments, and review forms can be customised. Appraisals appear as cards on a dashboard in the Appraisals app, with templates, tags and requests for feedback.

name: hr_attendance_autoclose
summary: Automatically closes attendance records that stay open longer than a maximum number of hours, so one forgotten check-out does not spoil every later record. The limit is set under Attendances > Configuration, and employees can be excluded from auto-close. Closed records are flagged with a reason.

name: hr_attendance_autoclose
summary: Automatically closes attendance records that stay open longer than a maximum number of hours, so one forgotten check-out does not spoil every later record. The limit is set under Attendances > Configuration, and employees can be excluded from auto-close. Closed records are flagged with a reason.

name: hr_attendance_calendar_view
summary: Adds a calendar view as an option for displaying attendance records, so check-ins can be seen laid out by day on a calendar. It is a view switcher addition on the Attendances screens.

name: hr_attendance_employee_calendar_planning
summary: Makes overtime from attendance calculate correctly for employees on flexible hours with planned calendars. It joins the employee calendar planning and attendance overtime rules, and is only needed when flexible hours are used.

name: hr_attendance_full_history
summary: Lets employees see their complete attendance history, not only the current month. From My Profile, they can open the This month smart button and remove the filter to see every past check-in and check-out.

name: hr_attendance_geolocation
summary: Records the location, as latitude and longitude, where each check-in and check-out happens. It only works in secure browser sessions (HTTPS), and the coordinates are stored on each attendance record.

name: hr_attendance_modification_tracking
summary: Logs every change to an attendance's check-in or check-out in the chatter, and flags records changed by hand as manually changed. It helps spot time cheating, and list and form views show this change information.

name: hr_attendance_modification_tracking
summary: Logs every change to an attendance's check-in or check-out in the chatter, and flags records changed by hand as manually changed. It helps spot time cheating, and list and form views show this change information.

name: hr_attendance_reason
summary: Lets you define reasons for attendance that is shorter or longer than normal, such as visiting a customer or leaving early to collect children. Employees pick a reason when they check in or out, and reasons are set under Attendances > Configuration.

name: hr_attendance_reason
summary: Lets you define reasons for attendance that is shorter or longer than normal, such as visiting a customer or leaving early to collect children. Employees pick a reason when they check in or out, and reasons are set under Attendances > Configuration. Reasons can also be shown and required on the attendance kiosk screen.

name: hr_attendance_report_theoretical_time
summary: Adds a report under Attendances > Reporting that compares worked time from attendances with theoretical time from the working calendar, public holidays and leaves. Missing days are filled in with their scheduled hours, and some leave types can count as worked time.

name: hr_attendance_report_theoretical_time
summary: Adds a report under Attendances > Reporting that compares worked time from attendances with theoretical time from the working calendar, public holidays and leaves. Missing days are filled in with their scheduled hours, and some leave types can count as worked time.

name: hr_attendance_rest_time_included
summary: Counts employee breaks as part of working time. When an employee checks out with a rest-time reason, the break is included in their hours, and several breaks can be recorded on one attendance. Rest-time reasons are set under Attendances > Configuration.

name: hr_attendance_rfid
summary: Lets an RFID card reader log employee attendance. Each employee's card code is stored on their record, and an external reader system calls the attendance registration method with the card code. Administrators set up the card codes, and the reader system is built separately.

name: hr_birthday_welcome_message
summary: Shows a birthday greeting in the welcome message when an employee checks in on their birthday. It compares the day and month with the employee's date of birth, which is set under Private Information.

name: hr_collective_agreement
summary: Core model for collective wage agreements in a multi-company setup, with a code, name, scope, publication dates, official publication, state and observations. HR administrators manage them under Human Resources > Configuration > Collective Agreements, along with the scopes and official publication sources.

name: hr_collective_agreement_partner
summary: Links collective agreements to contacts, such as the companies that are bound by them. A Collective Agreements smart button appears on the contact form when agreements are assigned, and a wizard assigns them to a partner. It builds on the collective agreement module.

name: hr_commission
summary: Lets employees act as sales commission agents. It adds an agent type for employees whose commissions are not invoiced in the commission settlement wizard, and flags a contact as an employee when it is linked to an HR employee.

name: hr_commission
summary: Lets employees act as sales commission agents. It adds an agent type for employees whose commissions are not invoiced in the commission settlement wizard, and flags a contact as an employee when it is linked to an HR employee.

name: hr_commission_oca
summary: Lets employees act as sales commission agents, built on the OCA account commission module. It adds an agent type for employees whose commissions are not invoiced in the commission settlement wizard, and it links contacts to HR employees.

name: hr_contract_bonus
summary: Adds bonuses to employee contracts, either fixed or variable, with a frequency. Bonuses are created under Employees > Configuration > Contracts > Employee Bonuses, then assigned to a contract, which updates the annual wage and shows totals with and without the bonus.

name: hr_contract_document
summary: Lets users attach documents to an employee contract, such as a signed copy or related paperwork, and shows a document count on the contract. Documents are kept on the contract form.

name: hr_contract_document
summary: Lets users attach documents to an employee contract, such as a signed copy or related paperwork, and shows a document count on the contract. Documents are kept on the contract form.

name: hr_contract_employee_calendar_planning
summary: Keeps employee working schedules consistent when contracts and multi-calendar planning are used together. Existing contract calendars are moved into the employee's calendars, and contracts can no longer overwrite the employee calendar. Contract calendar fields are hidden, while salary history stays on the contract.

name: hr_contract_employee_calendar_planning
summary: Keeps employee working schedules consistent when contracts and multi-calendar planning are used together. Existing contract calendars are moved into the employee's calendars, and contracts can no longer overwrite the employee calendar. Contract calendar fields are hidden, while salary history stays on the contract.

name: hr_contract_multi_job
summary: Lets one employee contract hold several jobs, with one marked as the main job, which fills the contract's Job Title. An example is a construction worker doing bricklaying and electrical work, or a waiter who also works as a barman.

name: hr_contract_reference
summary: Gives each new employee contract a reference number automatically, taken from a predefined sequence. The prefix and number format can be changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers > Sequences, in the Contract Reference entry.

name: hr_contract_reference
summary: Gives each new employee contract a reference number automatically, taken from a predefined sequence. The prefix and number format can be changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers > Sequences, in the Contract Reference entry.

name: hr_contract_renew
summary: Adds a Renew Contract button to an employee contract. It opens a wizard for the new start date and creates a new contract copied from the original, with the new dates.

name: hr_contract_update_overtime
summary: Recalculates employee overtime from attendance using the contract terms, with an Update Overtime action on the contract history list, the contract history form, and the contract form. Updating from the history also reorganises leaves across contract calendars. Count Extra Hours must be enabled in Attendance settings first.

name: hr_contract_update_overtime
summary: Recalculates employee overtime from attendance accurately, even when contracts changed over time. It can be run for one employee's contract from the employee's contract actions, or for several contracts at once from the contracts list.

name: hr_course
summary: Manages employee training courses. Courses are defined under Employees > Courses, scheduled as sessions with dates, cost and training company under Employees > Courses Schedule, then attendees are assigned, the session is run, and results are recorded to finish it.

name: hr_course
summary: Manages employee training courses. Courses are defined under Employees > Courses, scheduled as sessions with dates, cost and training company under Employees > Courses Schedule, then attendees are assigned, the session is run, and results are recorded to finish it.

name: hr_course_survey
summary: Attaches an examination survey to a course, so attendees complete an evaluation at the end of the training. A failed attendee can be given a retry. The survey is picked on the course and on the training schedule.

name: hr_department_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic account field to HR departments, so department costs can be tracked in analytic accounting. The field is on the department form.

name: hr_department_code
summary: Adds a Code field to HR departments, for a short identifier such as a department number or abbreviation. It is shown on the department form.

name: hr_department_deputy
summary: Adds deputy managers to HR departments, so a department can name one or more people who stand in for its manager. The deputies are set on the department form.

name: hr_dms_field
summary: Adds a Documents tab to employee forms, with a folder structure created automatically for each employee from the file templates you define. Employees can see their own documents if the setting allows it. It is found on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_age
summary: Calculates each employee's age automatically from their date of birth and shows it on the employee form. Once the birthday is entered, the age fills in by itself.

name: hr_employee_bank_restrict
summary: Hides bank account details on contacts that belong to employees, so only users with full accounting rights can see them. Regular customer and supplier contacts still show bank accounts to everyone. It works through each employee's Work Contact.

name: hr_employee_birth_name
summary: Adds a Birth Name field to employee records, for the name a person was born with. It is a plain text field on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_birthday_mail
summary: Sends automatic birthday emails to employees and, if they opt in, tells colleagues about the birthday. Each person sets their options under My Profile > Private Information, and a daily scheduled action sends the mails at the hour you choose.

name: hr_employee_birthday_mail
summary: Sends automatic birthday emails to employees and, if they opt in, tells colleagues about the birthday. Each person sets their options on their profile, and a daily scheduled action sends the mails at the hour you choose.

name: hr_employee_calendar_planning
summary: Lets an employee's working time change by date range, for example a different schedule from a given date. Working time profiles are added with start and end dates under the Work Information tab, and Odoo combines them into one working calendar for the employee.

name: hr_employee_calendar_planning
summary: Lets an employee's working time change by date range, for example a different schedule from a given date. Working time profiles are added with start and end dates under the Work Information tab, and Odoo combines them into one working calendar for the employee.

name: hr_employee_cost_history
summary: Lets you change an employee's hourly timesheet cost from a chosen date onward, and keeps a log of every past change. A Cost History button on the employee shows how the rate has moved over time. It is used from the Employees app, via the Update Cost action on the employee's Settings tab.

name: hr_employee_digitized_signature
summary: Adds a signature image field to employee records, so a scanned or digitised signature can be stored for each employee. It is a plain image field on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_document
summary: Adds a documents button on each employee profile that opens the attachments linked to that employee. HR officers and managers see them, and so does the employee themselves, so the employee record can serve as document storage for staff files.

name: hr_employee_document
summary: Adds a documents button on each employee profile that opens the attachments linked to that employee. HR officers and managers see them, and so does the employee themselves, so the employee record can serve as document storage for staff files.

name: hr_employee_document_from_applicant
summary: When a candidate is hired and the Create Employee button is used, the documents attached to the candidate are carried over to the new employee record. It connects Recruitment with the employee documents module.

name: hr_employee_document_from_applicant
summary: When a candidate is hired and the Create Employee button is used, the documents attached to the candidate are carried over to the new employee record. It connects Recruitment with the employee documents module.

name: hr_employee_firstname
summary: Splits the employee name into separate First Name and Last Name fields, at least one of which is required. The two are combined into the name shown across Odoo, and the display order is set in Employees settings.

name: hr_employee_firstname_partner_firstname
summary: Glue module that makes the partner first and last name fields and the employee name fields work together. When an employee is created from a user, the first and last names are taken from the user. It has no screens of its own.

name: hr_employee_group_overview_readonly
summary: A setup guide for giving some users read-only access to the Employees app, with a separate group for users who can still write. The only field it adds is a cars count on employees. It is for administrators configuring access, not for everyday users.

name: hr_employee_id
summary: Gives each employee a unique, company-wide identification number, generated automatically from a sequence or as random digits. A custom number can still be typed in, and then nothing is generated. The generation method and digit count are set under Employees > Configuration in developer mode.

name: hr_employee_id
summary: Gives each employee a unique, company-wide identification number, generated automatically from a sequence or as random digits. A custom number can still be typed in, and then nothing is generated. The generation method and digit count are set under Employees > Configuration in developer mode.

name: hr_employee_language
summary: Records the languages each employee speaks, with levels for reading, writing, speaking and listening. The list is on the employee's Languages tab, and an Employees > Languages view lets you filter staff by language.

name: hr_employee_lastnames
summary: Splits the employee name into a first name, a father's last name and a mother's last name, and combines them into the displayed name. The first name and the first last name are required, and the second last name is optional.

name: hr_employee_medical_examination
summary: Tracks employee medical examinations, each with a date, state, result and note. A wizard can generate one examination per selected employee for a year, under Employees > Medical Examinations > Generate Medical Examinations, and the examinations can then be managed one by one.

name: hr_employee_partner_external
summary: Flags an employee as external, meaning they are administered by another company (a partner) but work in yours, and links that partner to the employee. The employee can be a real person or a virtual placeholder where the partner decides who works.

name: hr_employee_partner_external
summary: Flags an employee as external, meaning they are administered by another company (a partner) but work in yours, and links that partner to the employee. The employee can be a real person or a virtual placeholder where the partner decides who works.

name: hr_employee_phone_extension
summary: Adds optional Internal Number and Short Number fields to employees, for their phone extension and short dial code. The fields sit on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_phone_extension
summary: Adds optional Internal Number and Short Number fields to employees, for their phone extension and short dial code. The fields sit on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_phone_pin
summary: Stores a company mobile phone's PIN and PUK on the employee record, with the PIN limited to 4 digits and the PUK to 8. Only users in the Change PIN/PUK group can view or edit them, and officers in the employee group need that group too.

name: hr_employee_ppe
summary: Manages personal protective equipment (PPE) issued to employees. Products can be flagged as PPE with a duration and instructions, a daily scheduled check flags expired allocations, and a receipt can be printed when an equipment request includes PPE.

name: hr_employee_ppe
summary: Manages personal protective equipment (PPE) issued to employees. Products can be flagged as PPE with a duration and instructions, a daily scheduled check flags expired allocations, and a receipt can be printed when an equipment request includes PPE.

name: hr_employee_relative
summary: Stores information about an employee's family members, including the relationship, date of birth, age, job and an optional linked contact. Relationship types are kept as their own list. It appears as a Relatives list on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_second_lastname
summary: Splits the employee name into a first name, a father's last name and a mother's last name, and combines them into the displayed name. The mother's last name is optional, and the form shows the three fields together.

name: hr_employee_service
summary: Records an employee's hire date, start date and termination date, and calculates how long they have been with the company in years, months and days. Start and hire dates are different: hire is when the offer is accepted, start is the first working day.

name: hr_employee_service
summary: Records an employee's hire date, start date and termination date, and calculates how long they have been with the company in years, months and days. Start and hire dates are different: hire is when the offer is accepted, start is the first working day.

name: hr_employee_service_contract
summary: Works out an employee's service dates from their contracts: the first and last contract, and the start and termination dates taken from them. These dates feed the service duration calculation in the employee service module.

name: hr_employee_service_contract
summary: Works out an employee's service dates from their contracts: the first and last contract, and the start and termination dates taken from them. These dates feed the service duration calculation in the employee service module.

name: hr_employee_ssn
summary: Shows the employee SSN and SIN fields in the interface so they can be viewed and edited. It only exposes fields that are already in the data model. Use it where HR needs these national identifiers on the employee form.

name: hr_employee_ssn
summary: Shows the employee SIN field in the interface so it can be viewed and edited. It only exposes a field that is already in the data model. Use it where HR needs the Canadian social insurance number on the employee form.

name: hr_expense_advance_clearing
summary: Lets the company advance money to an employee, who spends it on a purchase and then clears the advance by submitting the actual costs. If the costs are more than the advance the company pays the difference, and if they are less the employee returns the rest. Advances are requested under Expenses > My Expenses > Advances.

name: hr_expense_advance_clearing
summary: Lets the company advance money to an employee, who spends it on a purchase and then clears the advance by submitting the actual costs. If the costs are more than the advance the company pays the difference, and if they are less the employee returns the rest. Advances are requested under Expenses > My Expenses > Advances.

name: hr_expense_advance_clearing_sequence
summary: Gives employee advance expense reports their own numbering sequence, with the default set to EXAV0001. The number is filled in automatically on new advance reports, and the format is changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers.

name: hr_expense_advance_clearing_sequence
summary: Gives employee advance expense reports their own numbering sequence, with the default set to EXAV0001. The number is filled in automatically on new advance reports, and the format is changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers.

name: hr_expense_analytic_tag
summary: Lets users add analytic tags to expenses, so the analytic entries created from them carry those tags. This makes it possible to report on expense costs by tag.

name: hr_expense_analytic_tag
summary: Lets users add analytic tags to expenses, so the analytic entries created from them carry those tags. This makes it possible to report on expense costs by tag.

name: hr_expense_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancel button on expense reports that undoes reconciliations and deletes the related payments and journal entries, so a reimbursed expense can be corrected. It works on reports that were paid by the employee, then posted and paid.

name: hr_expense_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancel button on expense reports that undoes reconciliations and deletes the related payments and journal entries, so a reimbursed expense can be corrected. It works on reports that were paid by the employee, then posted and paid.

name: hr_expense_employee_analytic_default
summary: Sets the analytic distribution on new expenses from an analytic distribution model. The model is tied to the employee's work address, and the distribution updates when the employee on the expense is changed. The models are set under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytic Accounting.

name: hr_expense_exception
summary: Attaches custom exception types to expense reports, such as a product not found or a wrong line format, so reports with problems can be filtered and fixed. It is most useful when expenses are imported in bulk, since errors are likely there. Expenses can also be marked to ignore their exceptions.

name: hr_expense_invoice
summary: For supplier invoices that an employee paid personally. A vendor bill can be picked on each expense line, or one vendor bill can be created for several expenses from the report, and the entries move the debt to the employee. Paying the expense sheet also reconciles the supplier invoice.

name: hr_expense_invoice
summary: For supplier invoices that an employee paid personally. A vendor bill can be picked on each expense line, or one vendor bill can be created for several expenses from the report, and the entries move the debt to the employee. Paying the expense sheet also reconciles the supplier invoice.

name: hr_expense_journal
summary: For expenses paid with a company credit card or another company payment method. Users pick which payment type was used on the expense, and that journal is then used as the bank journal on the expense report, so the payment posts to the right account.

name: hr_expense_journal
summary: For expenses paid with a company credit card or another company payment method. Users pick which payment type was used on the expense, and that journal is then used as the bank journal on the expense report, so the payment posts to the right account.

name: hr_expense_pay_to_vendor
summary: Adds a Pay to Vendor option when an expense is paid by the company. It is for buying something, such as a plane ticket, directly from a supplier through the expense, so the payable goes to the vendor rather than the employee, and registering payment clears it.

name: hr_expense_payment
summary: Links payments to expense reports. When a payment is registered on an expense sheet, the payment is recorded on the sheet and the sheet shows the payments made against it.

name: hr_expense_payment
summary: Links payments to expense reports. When a payment is registered on an expense sheet, the payment is recorded on the sheet and the sheet shows the payments made against it.

name: hr_expense_petty_cash
summary: Handles expenses paid from petty cash. Cash holders are set up as petty cash records, topped up through a vendor bill, and then picked on expenses. A holder whose balance is too low must be topped up before a report is submitted. Petty cash accounts are set under Invoicing > Accounting > Petty Cash.

name: hr_expense_remove_mobile_link
summary: Technical cleanup that removes Enterprise mobile app download links, references and images from the Expenses app. It shows no new screens and is useful for installs that should not show app promotions.

name: hr_expense_remove_mobile_link
summary: Technical cleanup that removes Enterprise mobile app download links, references and images from the Expenses app. It shows no new screens and is useful for installs that should not show app promotions.

name: hr_expense_sequence
summary: Gives expense reports their own numbering sequence, with the default set to EX0001. The number is filled in automatically on new reports, and the format is changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers.

name: hr_expense_sequence
summary: Gives expense reports their own numbering sequence, with the default set to EX0001. The number is filled in automatically on new reports, and the format is changed under Settings > Technical > Sequences & Identifiers.

name: hr_expense_sequence_option
summary: Technical add-on that lets expense reports use the optional sequence rules from the sequence option framework. Administrators define the rules, and the expense report numbering follows them.

name: hr_expense_sequence_option
summary: Technical add-on that lets expense reports use the optional sequence rules from the sequence option framework. Administrators define the rules, and the expense report numbering follows them.

name: hr_expense_tier_validation
summary: Adds multi-level approval to expense reports. Approval tiers are defined in Settings > Technical, a validation is requested on a report, and reviewers see their pending reviews until all are validated, then the report can be approved. Users can filter for reports that need their review.

name: hr_expense_tier_validation
summary: Adds multi-level approval to expense reports. Approval tiers are defined in Settings > Technical, a validation is requested on a report, and reviewers see their pending reviews until all are validated, then the report can be approved. System parameters can exclude certain fields from approval.

name: hr_expense_vendor_receipt
summary: Creates a vendor receipt from an expense report when the report uses a receipt journal. The receipt is created when the report is approved, and it can then be edited and posted like a normal purchase receipt from the report's journal entry.

name: hr_expense_work_acceptance
summary: Lets a work acceptance be created from an expense report, filled in from the report's lines, and tracks the accepted quantity on each expense line. The button appears on the expense sheet after it is confirmed, and it is turned on under Purchase > Configuration > Settings.

name: hr_holidays_auto_extend
summary: Automatically extends an approved leave when its period runs out, for leaves that have no fixed return date. Leave types are marked as auto extendable, the flag is set on approval, and it can be unchecked once the leave should stop extending.

name: hr_holidays_calendar_planning
summary: Makes Time Off work together with employee calendar planning and flexible hours. It is a bridge module, so you only need it if you use flexible hours with time off. It adds no new fields of its own.

name: hr_holidays_leave_auto_approve
summary: Lets a leave type approve its requests automatically, with a policy that can apply to requests created by HR officers and to other requests. The policy is set on the leave type under Time Off > Configuration > Time Off Types.

name: hr_holidays_leave_repeated
summary: Lets an employee create repeating time off, such as the same leave every week for a number of times or until an end date. Repeat settings are on the Time Off request form, and the leave type must have Repeat turned on in its configuration. Each repetition is created as its own request when saved.

name: hr_holidays_leave_report_calendar_type
summary: Adds a Leave Type filter to the Time Off Overview calendar, both in the side filter panel and in the search bar. This lets managers view the calendar for just one kind of leave. It is found under Time Off > Overview.

name: hr_holidays_natural_period
summary: Adds Natural day and Natural day (Half Day) options to the request unit of a leave type, so a leave can be counted in calendar days. The request unit is set on the leave type and the allocation. Leave requests then use it from the Time Off dashboard.

name: hr_holidays_natural_period_public
summary: Lets a leave type that counts natural days choose whether public holidays are excluded from the leave length. A checkbox on the leave type, which must have its Request Unit set to Natural Day, controls it. Leave types are found under Time Off > Configuration > Time Off Types.

name: hr_holidays_public
summary: Manages public holidays in Time Off so they are not counted as leave days when the leave type excludes them. Public holidays are entered under Calendar > Configuration > Public Holidays and show as grey days on the calendar. Exclusion is turned on per leave type under Time Off > Configuration > Time Off Types.

name: hr_holidays_public
summary: Keeps a list of public holidays by year and country, and shows them on the Time Off calendar as non-working days like weekends. Each time off type can be set to exclude public holidays from the leave day count, and a wizard copies a year's holidays to the next year. Found under the Leaves menu in Public Holidays.

name: hr_holidays_public
summary: Keeps a list of public holidays by year and country, and shows them on the Time Off calendar as non-working days like weekends. Each time off type can be set to exclude public holidays from the leave day count, and a wizard copies a year's holidays to the next year. Found under the Leaves menu in Public Holidays.
