name: hr_holidays_public_city
summary: Adds cities to public holiday lines, so a holiday can apply only to specific cities instead of a whole country or state. This is useful when local holidays differ by city. It is set on the public holiday lines in Calendar configuration.

name: hr_holidays_public_city
summary: Lets a public holiday apply only to specific cities, for cases where local holidays differ from the national list. Each holiday line gets a Cities field, and it appears on the Public Holidays records under the Leaves menu. It is a small add-on to the public holidays module.

name: hr_holidays_settings
summary: Technical add-on that adds an empty Settings screen under Leaves > Configuration > Settings. It has no options of its own, but other add-ons use it to add their leave settings in one place. Users will only see it if another leave add-on puts options there.

name: hr_holidays_settings
summary: Adds an empty Settings form under Leaves > Configuration > Settings. It holds no options itself, but gives other modules a place to add their time off settings. This is a technical base module.

name: hr_holidays_summary_email
summary: Sends employees a daily or weekly email listing other employees' time off in the company for that period. Each employee chooses No, Daily, or Weekly on their record, and the weekday for the weekly email is set in Settings. The setting lives on the employee and user records, and the email goes out from the scheduled jobs.

name: hr_holidays_team_manager
summary: Adds a Time Off Team Manager access group. Members can view, edit, and create time off requests and allocation requests only for employees in their own department, so a department lead can handle team leave without full HR access. Users are given the group on their user record.

name: hr_job_category
summary: Lets you tag job positions with categories, such as Supervisor. When an employee gets a contract for that job, the job's tags are copied to the employee record, and if the job changes on the same contract the old tags are removed. Tags are set on the Job Position form and then show up on the Employee form.

name: hr_job_category
summary: Lets you tag job positions with categories, such as Supervisor. When an employee gets a contract for that job, the job's tags are copied to the employee record, and if the job changes on the same contract the old tags are removed. Tags are set on the Job Position form and then show up on the Employee form.

name: hr_leave_custom_hour_interval
summary: Lets employees request time off by specific start and end hours, such as 9:00 to 11:30, instead of whole days. It works with a time off type set to take time in Custom Hours, and the hour fields appear on the Time Off request form under My Time Off.
keywords: time off start hour end hour

name: hr_leave_custom_hour_interval
summary: Lets a time off request use custom start and end hours. You tick a Custom Hours checkbox on the request and enter the times, which needs a time off type that takes time in Hours. The request form is under Time Off in the My Time Off menu.

name: hr_leave_type_code
summary: Adds a short code field to time off types, such as VAC or SICK. Where the leave type is shown, its name appears as CODE - Name when a code is set. The code is entered on the time off type under Time Off > Configuration > Time Off Types.

name: hr_maintenance_security
summary: Stops HR users from getting the Equipment Manager maintenance role automatically, so HR staff do not gain maintenance access by default. The role can still be assigned manually. This is a technical security setting.

name: hr_maintenance_security
summary: Technical access change: HR users no longer get the Equipment Manager maintenance group automatically, which decouples the HR and Maintenance apps. The group can still be assigned by hand to any user who needs it.

name: hr_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit field to each employee, plus a default operating unit taken from the logged-in user when a new employee is created. Each operating unit also lists the employees allowed in it. The fields show on the Employee form and on the Operating Unit record.

name: hr_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit field to each employee, plus a default operating unit taken from the logged-in user when a new employee is created. Each operating unit also lists the employees allowed in it. The fields show on the Employee form and on the Operating Unit record.

name: hr_org_chart_overview
summary: Adds an interactive organization chart under Employees > Reporting > Organizational Chart. Users can expand and collapse levels, click an employee to open their record, and search by name or department to filter the chart.

name: hr_payroll_attendance_report
summary: Adds attendance records and a total worked hours figure to the payslip, so the printed payslip shows attendance control. It is a technical report add-on to the Payroll app and needs attendance to be installed.

name: hr_payroll_document
summary: Stores payroll files, such as payslips, as attachments on each employee record, and gives HR a wizard to manage an employee's payroll documents in one place. By default payslips are encrypted with the employee's identification number, and HR or the employee can turn that off in the profile or the employee form.

name: hr_payroll_document_pymupdf
summary: Technical add-on that uses the PyMuPDF library as a second attempt to read text from PDF payslips in the payroll document wizard. It only changes how PDFs are read and adds no screens of its own.

name: hr_payroll_period
summary: Adds payroll periods to a fiscal year, such as monthly or weekly pay schedules. Creating a payslip batch fills in the payment date and batch name from the chosen period, and closing a batch closes its period. Set up under Payroll > Configuration > Payroll Fiscal Year, and used from Payslip Batches.

name: hr_personal_equipment_request
summary: Lets employees request personal equipment, and lets HR track what each employee has been issued. Products are flagged as employee personal equipment, and each allocation carries a start date and an expiry date on the employee record. Requests are made from the Employees menu under Personal Equipment Requests.

name: hr_personal_equipment_request
summary: Lets employees request personal equipment, and lets HR track what each employee has been issued. Products are flagged as employee personal equipment, and each allocation carries a start date and an expiry date on the employee record. Requests are made from the Employees menu under Personal Equipment Requests.

name: hr_personal_equipment_request_tier_validation
summary: Adds approval tiers to personal equipment requests, so a request has to be signed off by one or more reviewers before it goes ahead. Set up through Settings > Technical > Tier Validation, which needs the base_tier_validation module, and the approve buttons appear on the request form.

name: hr_personal_equipment_stock
summary: Connects equipment requests to Inventory. When a request is accepted, stock moves are created for each item, and when the delivery is done the allocation is marked valid if the delivered quantity matches. Services skip stock and are validated on the allocation itself. Deliveries show as a transfers smart button on the request.

name: hr_personal_equipment_stock
summary: Connects equipment requests to Inventory. When a request is accepted, stock moves are created for each item, and when the delivery is done the allocation is marked valid if the delivered quantity matches. Services skip stock and are validated on the allocation itself. Deliveries show as a transfers smart button on the request.

name: hr_personal_equipment_variant_configurator
summary: Lets users pick a product variant, such as a size or colour, when adding an item to a personal equipment request. The product must be flagged as personal equipment and have its variants set up.

name: hr_phone
summary: Checks and formats phone numbers on the Employee form, the same way the Contacts app does for partners. When an incoming call comes in, it also looks up the matching employee by number.

name: hr_professional_category
summary: Adds a list of professional categories, each with a code and company, and lets you set one on each employee contract. The list is maintained under Employees > Configuration > Professional Categories.

name: hr_professional_category
summary: Adds a list of professional categories, each with a code and company, and lets you set one on each employee contract. The list is maintained under Employees > Configuration > Professional Categories.

name: hr_recruitment_phone
summary: Checks and formats phone numbers on applicants in Recruitment, the same way the Contacts app does for partners. On incoming calls it also looks up the matching applicant by number.

name: hr_recruitment_torecruit
summary: Works out how many people to recruit for each job position, from a target headcount minus the current employees on contract. When headcount falls short, the job's vacancy is published automatically. The To be recruited count shows on the Job Position form.

name: hr_shift
summary: Plans variable shifts for employees week by week. You create shift templates with times, colour, and days, then make a weekly planning and generate shift assignments for each employee, shown as cards in the Shifts app. Creating plannings needs the Shift Manager security group.

name: hr_shift_holidays_public
summary: Stops shifts being assigned on public holidays at the employee's work address. Those days are shown as black on the shift assignment card. It needs the calendar public holiday module to supply the holidays.

name: hr_study
summary: Adds a structured Study field to employees, picked from a list you maintain under Employees > Configuration > Studies, instead of free text. It is set on the employee's Private Information tab, in the Education section.

name: hr_timesheet_amount_security
summary: Restricts the cost and amount figures on the timesheet reports so only users allowed to read analytic costs can see them. Users without that permission see the timesheet reports without the money columns. The restriction applies to the attendance and timesheet analysis reports.

name: hr_timesheet_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you put analytic tags on tasks and timesheet entries, so the analytic items created from those timesheets carry the tags, for cost or reporting analysis. Tags appear on the task form and on timesheet lines.

name: hr_timesheet_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you put analytic tags on tasks and timesheet entries, so the analytic items created from those timesheets carry the tags, for cost or reporting analysis. Tags appear on the task form and on timesheet lines.

name: hr_timesheet_autofill_project_off
summary: Turns off Odoo's automatic filling of the Project field on new timesheet lines. Users now choose the project each time instead of getting the one from their recent entries. No setup is needed, and it works as soon as the module is installed.

name: hr_timesheet_begin_end
summary: Adds Begin Hour and End Hour fields to timesheet lines, so each entry can record the time of day it started and stopped, as decimal hours. They show on the timesheet list and form.

name: hr_timesheet_begin_end
summary: Adds Begin Hour and End Hour fields to each timesheet line, so you can record the start and finish times of work as well as the duration. These show on the timesheet entries in the Timesheets app. A similar feature exists in project_timesheet_time_control.

name: hr_timesheet_calendar
summary: Adds a calendar view to timesheets so time can be entered and seen against a calendar of days. Each entry gets a start time, and the alignment of timesheets in the calendar can be chosen in settings. It appears as a calendar view in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_date_order_desc
summary: Makes new timesheet lines appear at the top of the list and sorts the list by date, newest first. This makes it quicker to add and find recent entries. It applies to the timesheet list in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_date_order_desc
summary: Changes the timesheet list so the newest entries are at the top, and new lines are added there. The list is sorted by date, newest first.

name: hr_timesheet_day_week
summary: Adds a Day of Week field to timesheets, so you can search or group entries by weekday. Weekend entries are also shaded differently in the list views, with a filter to show only those. It appears in the Timesheets app and the timesheet analysis report.

name: hr_timesheet_editable_top
summary: Makes new timesheet lines appear at the top of the list instead of the bottom, so quick entries are easier to add. It is a small layout change to the timesheet list in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_editable_top
summary: Adds new timesheet lines at the top of the Timesheets list instead of the bottom, which helps when logging several entries in a row.

name: hr_timesheet_employee_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you set analytic tags on each employee, which are then applied to the analytic items created from that employee's timesheets. It is set on the Employee form, in the Timesheets section, and needs analytic accounting tags enabled for the user.

name: hr_timesheet_employee_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you set analytic tags on each employee, and those tags are copied onto the timesheet entries and analytic items recorded for that employee. This keeps reporting consistent without choosing tags each time. The tags are set on the employee record and show up in Invoicing > Analytic Items.

name: hr_timesheet_name_customer
summary: Adds a separate Description Customer field to timesheet lines, used for customer-facing timesheets. It is copied from the internal description by default, and a Timesheet Customer report prints that version instead. The field is visible to Timesheets administrators in the timesheet list and form.

name: hr_timesheet_name_customer
summary: Adds a Customer Description field to timesheet lines, separate from the internal Description. It is copied from Description when left empty, shows in the customer portal in place of the internal text, and feeds a Timesheet Customer print report. The field is visible to Timesheets administrators.

name: hr_timesheet_portal
summary: Lets portal users add and edit their own timesheets from the website instead of the back office. Access is given by adding users to the Editable timesheets group, or by making it an implied group of the Portal group.

name: hr_timesheet_portal
summary: Lets portal users, such as external contractors or customers, add, edit and delete their own timesheet lines from the website. Users in the Editable timesheets group see plus and pencil buttons on their timesheets page. It is used on the website portal rather than the back office.

name: hr_timesheet_predefined_description
summary: Lets you keep a list of standard timesheet descriptions, such as a meeting or a review. A user picks one on a timesheet line and the Description fills in automatically, and it can still be edited. The list is managed under Timesheets > Configuration > Predefined Descriptions.

name: hr_timesheet_predefined_description_rules
summary: Adds rules to predefined timesheet descriptions: allow extra free text, make that text required, or append it to the description name. These rules only apply when the timesheet line is linked to a task, and are set on the predefined description form.

name: hr_timesheet_report
summary: Builds configurable timesheet reports from selected timesheet entries, or from a general date and employee filter. You choose the fields, grouping order and time format, then view the report in the browser or export it as PDF or Excel. It is opened from the Action menu in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_report
summary: Builds a configurable timesheet report from selected entries, or from a broader set of filters. You choose the columns, how rows are grouped, and the time format (hours or days), then view it in the browser or export it to PDF or XLSX. Start from Timesheets > Action > Generate Timesheet Report.

name: hr_timesheet_report_rounded
summary: Bridge module that makes the timesheet report show rounded times when Sale Timesheet Rounded is also installed. It installs automatically when both modules are present and needs no setup.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet
summary: Adds timesheet sheets: employees fill in their time for a period (weekly, monthly, or daily) and submit it, and a reviewer approves or refuses each sheet. Each sheet has a Summary tab and a Details tab. The reviewer and period are set under Timesheet Options in Settings.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet
summary: Adds timesheet sheets, which group each employee's time into a period (daily, weekly or monthly). Employees submit the sheet at the end of the period, and a reviewer approves it. The default period and reviewer are set in Timesheet Options under Settings.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_attendance
summary: Lets employees check in and out directly from their timesheet sheet, and compares the time they were present with the time they worked. Managers can see total attendance and the difference from the planned working time. It appears on the Attendances tab of the timesheet sheet.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_attendance
summary: Adds check in and check out buttons to a timesheet sheet, and lists the attendances for that period. It totals attendance hours and compares them with the timesheet hours, which helps with performance review. It sits on the Attendances tab of the sheet.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_autodraft
summary: Automatically creates a draft timesheet sheet whenever a timesheet entry is added or changed and no suitable sheet covers it. This helps make sure every entry belongs to a sheet that can be submitted. It is switched on under Timesheets > Configuration > Settings in Timesheet Options.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_autodraft
summary: Automatically creates a draft timesheet sheet when a timesheet entry is not covered by an existing sheet, so no time falls outside a sheet. Turn it on under Timesheet Options in Timesheets > Configuration > Settings.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_department_manager
summary: Lets the Department Manager of an employee's department be the reviewer who approves timesheet sheets. You pick By Department Manager in the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy setting. Each department needs a manager set on it.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_department_manager
summary: Lets the timesheet sheet reviewer be the employee's department manager. You pick By Department Manager in the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy setting, after assigning a manager to each department.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_project_manager
summary: Lets the Project Manager of a project approve the timesheet sheets for that project. Sheets gain a Project field, and entries are filtered by it. You pick By Project Manager in the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy setting.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_project_manager
summary: Adds a Project Manager option to the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy in Settings, so the project's manager reviews the sheet. It adds a Project field to the timesheet sheet to link the sheet to a project.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_warning
summary: Lets managers define custom warning rules for timesheet sheets, using a Python expression such as a limit on hours. Odoo checks sheets against these rules and creates a warning on each sheet that matches. Rules are defined under Configuration > Warnings in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_task_domain
summary: Limits the Task field on timesheet lines so only tasks of the selected project appear, and only those in open stages. This stops people picking the wrong or closed task. It applies when entering time in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_task_domain
summary: Limits the Task field on timesheet entries to tasks in the chosen project, and only offers tasks in open stages. It applies when a user logs time against a task.

name: hr_timesheet_task_required
summary: Makes the Task field compulsory on timesheets for projects that are set to require it. It can be turned on per project, with a company-wide default in Project settings. It applies when users enter timesheets in the Project and Timesheets apps.

name: hr_timesheet_task_stage
summary: Lets users open or close a task straight from a timesheet line. Closing moves the task to the first stage marked as Closed. It appears as a field on the timesheet entry in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_time_control
summary: Records the exact start date and time of each timesheet entry, down to the second, and lets users start and stop timers. A helper lets users switch between timers quickly. It is used from Timesheets > Timesheet > All Timesheets.

name: hr_timesheet_time_control_begin_end
summary: Adds Begin and End time fields to timesheet lines, built on the time control feature of project timesheets. It lets you record when work started and finished as well as how long it lasted. It appears on timesheet entries in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_time_restriction
summary: Stops users logging timesheets on past dates, for a set number of days, either per project or globally. A user can be given an override flag to ignore the restriction. Set per project under Project > Configuration, or globally under Timesheets > Configuration > Settings.

name: hr_timesheet_time_type
summary: Lets you tag each timesheet line with a Time Type to classify the kind of work it was. Time types are defined under Project > Configuration > Time Type. They help in planning and in client reports that group time by type.

name: hr_timesheet_time_type
summary: Adds a list of time types (name, code, description) and a Time Type field on timesheet lines, to classify work for planning meetings or client reports. It is a simple classification, so the same list works for any category of work.

name: hr_timesheet_type_non_billable
summary: Lets you mark a time type as non-billable, so timesheets logged with it do not reduce the remaining hours on a task or count as effective hours. This is useful for time that should be recorded but not charged against the project budget. It is set on the time type under Project > Configuration > Time Type.

name: hr_timesheet_unusual_days
summary: Shades weekends and public holidays in a different background color on the timesheet calendar, so they stand out when entering time. It works alongside the timesheet calendar view and time off holidays.

name: hr_work_entry_profile
summary: Adds a smart button on the user's profile that opens their work entries, so employees can see their own work entries from their profile.

name: html_image_url_extractor
summary: Technical developer utility that returns the image URLs found in any HTML field, in the order they appear. Modules such as blog excerpts use it to pick a cover image when the post has none. It adds nothing for end users.

name: html_text
summary: A technical utility that extracts plain text from rich text (HTML) fields, with an option to shorten it by words or characters and add an ellipsis. It is used by developers to build short previews. Users see no screens from it.

name: html_text
summary: Technical developer utility that pulls plain text out of any HTML field, with optional truncation by word or character count and an appended ellipsis. It is used to build short excerpts and adds nothing for end users.

name: iap_alternative_provider
summary: A technical base for connecting Odoo's IAP service, used for paid services such as SMS, to an alternative provider. It adds a provider choice on the IAP account. It is used by developers of connector modules.

name: iap_alternative_provider
summary: Technical base module that lets another add-on supply a provider for Odoo IAP services, such as sending SMS, in place of Odoo's own IAP service. It adds a provider field on the IAP account. The connector-telephony repository has an example that sends SMS through OVH.

name: image_tag
summary: Adds a simple list of image tags, such as labels for product photos, that other add-ons use to describe images linked to records. Only users with the Image Tag Manager role can maintain the list. The multi-image product add-on uses it.

name: image_tag
summary: Adds a simple list of image tags, such as labels for product photos, that other add-ons use to describe images linked to records. Only users with the Image Tag Manager role can maintain the list. The multi-image product add-on uses it.

name: image_tag_environment
summary: Technical glue module that makes Server Environment settings available on image tags. A technical name is entered when creating an image tag. It adds no screens for end users.

name: image_tag_environment
summary: Technical glue module that makes Server Environment settings available on image tags. A technical name is entered when creating an image tag. It adds no screens for end users.

name: impersonate_login
summary: Lets an authorised user, such as support staff, log in as another user and return to their own account with one button. The chatter shows who is impersonating, messages go out under the original user, and each session is logged. Admins can block impersonation of users with settings rights.

name: impersonate_login
summary: Lets a support user log in as another user with a Switch Login option, and a Back to Original User button returns them. While impersonating, the chatter shows who is logged in as whom, messages go out under the original user, and each login is recorded under Settings > Technical. Only members of the Impersonate Users group can do it.

name: internal_stock_quant_package
summary: Lets warehouse staff use internal packages as trolleys while picking, and makes sure those packages are emptied when a pack station or a carrier takes the goods. Packages are flagged internal under Inventory > Products > Packages, and each picking type decides when emptying happens. Package use must be switched on in Inventory settings first.

name: internal_stock_quant_package
summary: Lets warehouse staff use internal packages as trolleys while picking, and makes sure those packages are emptied when a pack station or a carrier takes the goods. Packages are flagged internal under Inventory > Products > Packages, and each picking type decides when emptying happens. Package use must be switched on in Inventory settings first.

name: intrastat_base
summary: Common base for Intrastat, the EU reporting of trade in goods and services. It adds an Intrastat setting on fiscal positions, makes Country required on partners, and adds an Intrastat section to Invoicing settings where you choose who gets the reminder emails. Country-specific reporting add-ons build on it.

name: intrastat_base
summary: Common base for Intrastat, the EU reporting of trade in goods and services. It adds an Intrastat setting on fiscal positions, makes Country required on partners, and adds an Intrastat section to Invoicing settings where you choose who gets the reminder emails. Country-specific reporting add-ons build on it.

name: intrastat_delivery
summary: Carries the incoterm and Intrastat transport mode set on a shipping method over to sales orders when they are confirmed, and then on to the invoices made from them. If the shipping method has none, the defaults from Settings apply. Set on the shipping method records.

name: intrastat_product
summary: Core Intrastat product reporting. It builds the periodic EU goods declaration from invoices and deliveries, with a declaration form, one line per product, HS codes, regions and transaction types, and an XLSX export. Country-specific add-ons for France or Belgium build on it. It is found under the Intrastat section of Invoicing.

name: intrastat_product
summary: Core Intrastat product reporting. It builds the periodic EU goods declaration from invoices and deliveries, with a declaration form, one line per product, HS codes, regions and transaction types, and an XLSX export. Country-specific add-ons for France or Belgium build on it. It is found under the Intrastat section of Invoicing.

name: intrastat_product_generic
summary: Adds a menu entry for a generic Intrastat product declaration, for countries that have no country-specific localization module. It is found in Invoicing under the Intrastat section.

name: intrastat_product_generic
summary: Adds a menu entry for a generic Intrastat product declaration, for countries that have no country-specific localization module. It is found in Invoicing under the Intrastat section.

name: intrastat_product_hscodes_import
summary: Loads the HS codes and their Intrastat codes into the system, with descriptions in several languages, so product codes do not have to be typed in by hand. The Load Intrastat Codes wizard sits in the Intrastat section of Invoicing settings.

name: intrastat_product_hscodes_import
summary: Loads the HS codes and their Intrastat codes into the system, with descriptions in several languages, so product codes do not have to be typed in by hand. The installer wizard appears on install and can be run again from Settings > Technical > Configuration Wizards, for one company or all companies.

name: intrastat_product_hscodes_import
summary: Loads the HS codes and their Intrastat codes into the system, with descriptions in several languages, so product codes do not have to be typed in by hand. The Load Intrastat Codes wizard sits in the Intrastat section of Invoicing settings.

name: iot_amqp_oca
summary: Lets an IoT device be controlled through AMQP messages sent via a message broker. Odoo publishes a message to the broker, which forwards it to the device to run an action. AMQP hosts are defined in the IoT app and attached to a device output.

name: iot_amqp_oca
summary: Lets an IoT device be controlled through AMQP messages sent via a message broker. Odoo publishes a message to the broker, which forwards it to the device to run an action. AMQP hosts are defined in the IoT app and attached to a device output.

name: iot_input_oca
summary: Lets an IoT device send data into Odoo, such as temperature readings or RFID scans, without needing its own Odoo user. Each input has its own URL protected by a passphrase, and when the device calls it, a chosen function runs on a chosen model. Inputs are set up from IoT > Config Devices, in the Inputs section of a device.

name: iot_input_oca
summary: Lets an IoT device send data into Odoo, such as temperature readings or RFID scans, without needing its own Odoo user. Each input has its own URL protected by a passphrase, and when the device calls it, a chosen function runs on a chosen model. Inputs are set up from IoT > Config Devices, in the Inputs section of a device.

name: iot_key_employee_rfid
summary: Lets an employee's RFID card act as an IoT key, so the card can open doors or trigger devices that IoT rules allow it to control. Each employee record gets a card code and a link to an IoT key.

name: iot_oca
summary: Base module for the IoT add-ons. It defines IoT devices, communication systems, device groups and tags, and a record of the actions sent to each device. On its own it adds only the IoT device screens for administrators.

name: iot_output_oca
summary: Lets one IoT device have several outputs, each with its own action and communication system, so a single device can receive different commands. Outputs and their action history are kept per device.

name: iot_output_oca
summary: Lets one IoT device have several outputs, each with its own action and communication system, so a single device can receive different commands. Outputs and their action history are kept per device.

name: iot_rule
summary: Adds IoT keys, such as a badge or virtual key, IoT locks that can be opened, and rules that link them. A key belongs to an employee, a partner, or an anonymous agent, and it can have an expiry date. Every key action is logged with its result and time. It is managed from the IoT app.

name: iot_rule
summary: Adds IoT keys, such as a badge or virtual key, IoT locks that can be opened, and rules that link them. A key belongs to an employee, a partner, or an anonymous agent, and it can have an expiry date. Every key action is logged with its result and time. It is managed from the IoT app.

name: iot_template_oca
summary: Lets you set up IoT devices from a template. The device contacts Odoo with the template name, and Odoo creates it with its inputs, outputs, keys and tags already in place. Templates are kept under IoT > Templates, and new devices are configured from IoT > Config Device.

name: iot_template_oca
summary: Lets you set up IoT devices from a template. The device contacts Odoo with the template name, and Odoo creates it with its inputs, outputs, keys and tags already in place. Templates are kept under IoT > Templates, and new devices are configured from IoT > Config Device.

name: ir_actions_report_multi_company
summary: Makes report actions, the print templates, belong to a company, so each company sees only its own reports. The usual multi-company record rule is applied automatically. It is a technical add-on with no screens of its own.

name: ir_config_parameter_multi_company
summary: Lets a system parameter, which is a technical setting, have a different value for each company. The value used depends on the company currently selected. It is a technical add-on for multi-company setups, and developers can force a specific company in code.

name: ir_filters_multi_company
summary: Adds a company to user-defined list filters, so a saved filter can be limited to one company in a multi-company setup. It is a technical add-on.

name: ir_ui_view_multi_company
summary: Lets a custom screen layout, or view, be limited to particular companies, so one company can have its own version of a screen. The Company field is set on the view under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Views. It is mainly for administrators and developers.

name: jsonifier
summary: A developer tool that converts records into JSON data using a simple description of which fields to include, with options for nested records and custom field names. It can also use saved export profiles to define the output. Developers use it to build APIs and integrations.

name: jsonifier
summary: Developer tool that converts any record or recordset to JSON, using a parser that lists which fields to include and what to call them. It can also translate field values and run custom resolvers, and export configurations can generate parsers. It adds nothing for end users.

name: kpi
summary: Lets you define key performance indicators with good, warning and bad thresholds, computed from SQL queries or Python code on local or external databases. Values refresh automatically on a schedule and keep a history of past results, with a colored status for each range. It is designed to feed spreadsheet dashboards.

name: kpi
summary: Lets you define key performance indicators with colour thresholds, such as good, warning and bad, using fixed values or SQL or Python code, on local or external databases. A scheduler refreshes each KPI hourly according to its frequency, and past values are kept in a history. It is built on the spreadsheet dashboard module.

name: l10n_be_cooperator
summary: Belgian localization for the Cooperators module, which manages cooperative members. It adds Belgian legal forms on partners and subscription requests, a default communication on capital release requests, and yearly tax shelter declarations with a printable tax shelter certificate for each cooperator.

name: l10n_be_cooperator_national_number
summary: Adds a Belgian National Number field to the cooperator subscription request. Two toggles on the company, Display National Number and Require National Number, decide whether it is shown and whether it is mandatory, and they are set in Settings.

name: l10n_be_cooperator_portal
summary: Lets cooperators see their tax shelter reports in the website customer portal. It works with the Belgian cooperator localization.

name: l10n_be_cooperator_portal_national_number
summary: Lets a cooperator change their Belgian national number from their account page in the portal.

name: l10n_be_cooperator_website_national_number
summary: Adds the Belgian national number question to the public website form for cooperative subscription requests.

name: l10n_ch_cooperator
summary: Swiss localization for the Cooperators module. It adds the Swiss legal form of companies on partners and subscription requests.

name: l10n_de_cooperator
summary: German localization for the Cooperators module. It adds the German legal form of companies on partners and subscription requests.

name: l10n_es_cooperator
summary: Spanish localization for the Cooperators module. It adds a Tax ID field to subscription requests, both in the back office and on the website form.

name: l10n_eu_nace
summary: Imports the EU NACE Rev. 2 industry classification as partner categories, in 23 languages, so partners can be tagged by industry code. You assign a category on the partner form, and a wizard can refresh the data from the EU source.

name: l10n_eu_nace
summary: Imports the EU NACE Rev. 2 industry classification as partner categories, in 23 languages, so partners can be tagged by industry code. You assign a category on the partner form, and a wizard can refresh the data from the EU source.

name: l10n_eu_oss_oca
summary: Helps set up EU One-Stop-Shop VAT for distance sales. A wizard creates the OSS taxes for each EU country you sell into, with their rates, and fiscal positions map them to EU customers. It is set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings > Taxes.

name: l10n_eu_oss_oca
summary: Helps set up EU One-Stop-Shop VAT for distance sales. A wizard creates the OSS taxes for each EU country you sell into, with their rates, and fiscal positions map them to EU customers. It is set up under Invoicing > Configuration > Settings > Taxes.

name: l10n_eu_product_adr
summary: Marks products as dangerous goods under the ADR road transport rules, with the danger class, UN number, labels and limited quantity. Dangerous products get an ADR tab on the product form, and transfers show the total ADR points based on quantities and weights.

name: l10n_eu_product_adr_dangerous_goods
summary: Adds reference lists to the ADR dangerous goods data, such as storage classes, packaging types, storage temperature and WGK class, plus extra product fields like NAG and VeVA codes and flash point. It is lookup data for the ADR module and adds no new workflow.

name: l10n_fr_cooperator
summary: French localization for the Cooperators module. It adds French legal forms of companies on partners and subscription requests, and removes the IBAN from the required fields of the subscription request.

name: l10n_us_account_routing
summary: Adds a routing number field to banks, so each bank can carry one validated routing number. It is shown on the bank record.

name: l10n_us_base_county
summary: Adds United States counties, imported from US Census data, and a County field on partners. Each county is linked to its state.

name: l10n_us_crm_county
summary: Adds a County field to CRM leads, using the US county list.

name: l10n_us_form_1099
summary: Marks vendors as 1099 contractors, with a 1099 type and a 1099-MISC box on the partner's Sales & Purchases tab, and adds a 1099 report of payments by type and box under Invoicing > Reporting. The IRS filing itself is still done separately.

name: l10n_us_form_1099
summary: Marks vendors as 1099 contractors, with a 1099 type and a 1099-MISC box on the partner's Sales & Purchases tab, and adds a 1099 report of payments by vendor, type and box under Invoicing > Reporting. The IRS filing itself is still done separately.

name: l10n_us_gaap
summary: A sample US chart of accounts based on GAAP, with expenses grouped by function because SEC rules do not allow classification by nature. It is a starting point for a company to adapt, and it is offered as a chart template when setting up a US company's accounting.

name: l10n_us_gaap_mis_report
summary: Adds ready-made US Balance Sheet and Income Statement templates for the MIS Builder reporting module, based on the US GAAP chart of accounts. Create a new report under Invoicing > Reporting > MIS Reports and pick one of these templates.

name: l10n_us_gaap_mis_report
summary: Adds ready-made US Balance Sheet and Income Statement templates for the MIS Builder reporting module, based on the US GAAP chart of accounts. Create a new report under Invoicing > Reporting > MIS Reports and pick one of these templates.

name: l10n_us_mis_financial_report
summary: Adds US Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Basis report templates for MIS Builder, built on account types. A report can be limited to chosen journals, and lines with a zero value can be hidden. Create one under Invoicing > Reporting > MIS Reports.

name: l10n_us_mis_financial_report
summary: Adds US Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet report templates for MIS Builder, built on account types. Pick one of them in a new MIS report under Invoicing > Reporting > MIS Reports.

name: l10n_us_mis_financial_report
summary: Adds US Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet report templates for MIS Builder, built on account types. Pick one of them in a new MIS report under Invoicing > Reporting > MIS Reports.

name: l10n_us_partner_legal_number
summary: Adds a Legal ID number record type for North American banking and financial use. The module is brief and does not document where the number appears on screen.

name: l10n_us_sales_tax_engine
summary: Calculates US sales tax on sale orders and invoices, combining state, county, city and district rates for a ZIP code. It checks a local rate database first, then optional external tax APIs, and keeps an audit log of each calculation. It also tracks nexus, product taxability and exemptions, and needs jurisdiction, ZIP and rate data imported with the Import Tax Rates wizard before it can resolve rates.

name: l10n_us_sales_tax_provider_api_ninjas
summary: Adds API Ninjas as a ZIP-level sales tax rate source for the US Sales Tax Engine. An API key is entered in Settings. The free tier covers ZIP-level rates, and county and city rates need a paid subscription.

name: l10n_us_sales_tax_provider_ziptax
summary: Adds ZipTax as a ZIP-level sales tax rate source for the US Sales Tax Engine. An API key is entered in Settings, and the free tier allows 100 calls a month.

name: letsencrypt
summary: Server administration tool, not a business feature. It lets the Odoo server request and renew its own SSL certificate from Let's Encrypt on a schedule, and saves the certificate for the SSL proxy to use. Domains, DNS and reload settings are in General Settings, and nothing is requested when the base URL is localhost.

name: lims
summary: A simple Laboratory Information Management System. Samplers log samples with customer, sample type and planned analyses, analysts enter results, and verifiers check them. Analytes carry specification limits with warning levels, and sample types can be flagged as hazardous.

name: login_all_company
summary: On first login, gives the user access to all companies instead of only their default one. Once the user changes their company selection, that choice is kept.

name: login_all_company
summary: On first login, gives the user access to all companies instead of only their default one. Once the user changes their company selection, that choice is kept.

name: loyalty_card_fixed_expiration_date
summary: Lets gift card programs have a fixed expiry. When cards are generated without a date, each one expires today plus the program's duration in days. Set under Point of Sale > Products > Gift Cards & eWallet.

name: loyalty_coupon_no_mail
summary: Adds a Never option to the When setting in a loyalty program's Communications tab. Coupons created under that program are not emailed to the customer when they are created.

name: loyalty_criteria_multi_product
summary: Lets a promotion require several product groups at once, each with its own minimum quantity, such as two of product A and three of product B. Choose Multi Product as the loyalty criteria on a program rule under Sales > Products > Discount & Loyalty.

name: loyalty_criteria_multi_product
summary: Lets a promotion require several product groups at once, each with its own minimum quantity, such as two of product A and three of product B. Choose Multi Product as the loyalty criteria on a program rule under Sales > Products > Discount & Loyalty.

name: loyalty_incompatibility
summary: Lets you mark promotions or coupons as incompatible with each other, so they are not applied together. Set the Incompatible Promotions field on a promotion under Sales > Products > Discount & Loyalty.

name: loyalty_initial_date_validity
summary: Adds a start date to promotions, alongside the end date, so a promotion can be set to begin on a chosen day. Set the Start date on the promotion form under Sales > Products > Discount & Loyalty.

name: loyalty_limit
summary: Limits how many times a promotion can be used, per customer or per salesperson. Salesperson limits can be set as strict, and the number used is shown on the program. It is a base for sales and point of sale to build on.

name: loyalty_limit
summary: Limits how many times a promotion can be used, per customer or per salesperson. Salesperson limits can be set as strict, and the number used is shown on the program. It is a base for sales and point of sale to build on.

name: loyalty_margin_computation
summary: Technical base that adds a Python formula field to loyalty rewards, for calculating their margin. It does nothing on screen by itself, and another add-on builds the sales behaviour on top of it.

name: loyalty_mass_mailing
summary: Adds a Mailings smart button to promotions. Clicking it opens the mailings linked to the promotion, or creates a new one pre-filled with the promotion's customer filter if none exists yet.

name: loyalty_mass_mailing
summary: Adds a Mailings smart button to promotions. Clicking it opens the mailings linked to the promotion, or creates a new one pre-filled with the promotion's customer filter if none exists yet.

name: loyalty_multi_gift
summary: Lets a promotion offer several gift products to choose from, each with a quantity, and sets which one is the default. Set the Program Type to Multi Gift and build the gift list. Extra modules use it on sale orders and point of sale.

name: loyalty_partner_applicability
summary: Limits a promotion to chosen customers, either by picking specific partners, by a filter on partners, or both (a customer matching either one qualifies). It also adds a setting to allow coupon sharing.

name: loyalty_partner_applicability
summary: Limits a promotion to chosen customers, either by picking specific partners, by a filter on partners, or both (a customer matching either one qualifies). It also adds a setting to allow coupon sharing.

name: loyalty_partner_applicability
summary: Limits a promotion to chosen customers, either by picking specific partners, by a filter on partners, or both (a customer matching either one qualifies). It also adds a setting to allow coupon sharing.

name: loyalty_program_chatter
summary: Adds a chatter, with messages and activities, to promotion and gift card program records, so the team can log notes and schedule follow-ups. Open a program under Discount & Loyalty or Gift Cards & eWallet to find it.

name: mail_activity_board
summary: Adds activity boards, with list, kanban, calendar, pivot and graph views of scheduled activities, reached from the Boards menu. Records get an activity smart button that opens their activities, and each activity links back to the record it belongs to.

name: mail_activity_board
summary: Adds an Activity Board with list, kanban, calendar, pivot and graph views to see planned activities in one place. A smart button on records shows their activities, and each activity links back to the record it came from. The board is found under the Boards menu.

name: mail_activity_cancel_tracking
summary: When an activity is cancelled, a message with its details is posted in the record's chatter, so the cancellation is on record.

name: mail_activity_dashboard
summary: Adds a link to the Activity Board in the Dashboards menu, so activity planning can be viewed alongside other dashboards. It is a technical bridge that needs the activity board and spreadsheet dashboard modules installed.

name: mail_activity_done
summary: Keeps completed activities instead of losing them. Marking an activity as Done saves it with a completion date, and completed activities can be filtered under Settings > Technical > Activities for later reporting.

name: mail_activity_done
summary: Keeps completed activities instead of losing them. Marking an activity as Done saves it with a completion date, and completed activities can be filtered under Settings > Technical > Activities for later reporting.

name: mail_activity_done
summary: Keeps completed activities as Done records instead of deleting them, so they can be reported on later. It switches this option on for all existing and new activity types. Since Odoo 18 this is native, so the module mainly makes sure the setting is on everywhere.

name: mail_activity_filter_internal_user
summary: Adds an Assign to internal user only option to activities. When it is ticked, the assignee picker is limited to internal users, so portal or external contacts are not offered.

name: mail_activity_future_counter
summary: Adds a second badge to the activity clock icon in the top bar, showing how many future activities there are. The existing badge keeps showing overdue and today's activities.

name: mail_activity_meeting_reminder
summary: Lets an administrator set default calendar reminders on meeting activity types, so every new meeting activity of that type gets the reminder. The defaults are set on the activity type record.

name: mail_activity_partner
summary: Adds Contact and Commercial Entity fields to activities, so a to-do can be linked to the customer or supplier it is about.

name: mail_activity_plan
summary: Lets you define a set of activities as a plan, such as an onboarding checklist, and launch it on any record that takes activities. Launching shows a summary of the activities, and Create activities adds them to the record. Plans are set up under Settings > Technical > Discuss > Activity Plans.

name: mail_activity_plan_domain
summary: Restricts activity plans and their individual steps to records that match a domain condition. A plan can appear only for certain partners, and a step is skipped for records it does not fit. The Domain field is on the activity plan and plan line forms under Settings > Technical > Activities.

name: mail_activity_reminder
summary: Sends reminder notifications before or on the deadline of planned activities. Reminder days are set per activity type, such as 0 for the deadline day and 5 for five days before. It is configured under Settings > Technical > Activity Types.

name: mail_activity_reply_creator
summary: When a user clicks Done and schedule next on an activity, the new activity is assigned back to the person who created the original. Changing the activity type in the new activity form also keeps the chosen assignee instead of resetting it to yourself, unless the type has its own default user.

name: mail_activity_reply_creator
summary: When a user clicks Done and schedule next on an activity, the new activity is assigned back to the person who created the original. Changing the activity type in the new activity form also keeps the chosen assignee instead of resetting it to yourself, unless the type has its own default user.

name: mail_activity_team
summary: Lets activities be assigned to a team instead of just one person. Teams have members and a leader, and activities can be routed to a team's members. Teams are set up under Settings > Technical > Discuss > Activity Teams, and users are added in their preferences.

name: mail_activity_unlink_log
summary: Posts a message in the chatter whenever an activity is deleted, so a deletion leaves a trace on the record.

name: mail_activity_unlink_log
summary: Posts a message in the chatter whenever an activity is deleted, so a deletion leaves a trace on the record.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment
summary: When sending a record by email, you can pick attachments already stored on that record. Files are first added with a log note, then selected in the mail composer. This saves re-uploading documents that are already on the record.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment
summary: Lets you send an email from a record with files that are already attached to it. You add files to the record with a log note, then pick them in the send email wizard. It adds an Object Attachments field to the email composer.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment_account
summary: Brings the existing-attachment picker to the invoice and document sending wizard in Accounting. You can choose files already on an invoice when emailing it to a customer. It requires the base existing attachment module.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment_account
summary: Lets you attach files already on an invoice to the email sent from the invoice Send and Print wizard. It extends the existing attachment email feature to invoices.

name: mail_attachment_xml_preview
summary: Shows XML attachments as a collapsible tree instead of one line of raw text. This helps with electronic invoices such as CFDI or UBL, bank statements and EDI messages. It runs in the browser, and files that are not valid XML or are over 5 MB show as raw text.

name: mail_autogenerated_header
summary: Marks outgoing Odoo emails as automatically generated, so receiving servers do not send vacation auto-replies, and drops auto-generated incoming emails to avoid mail loops. A config parameter can turn the outgoing marking off. This is a technical email setting.

name: mail_autogenerated_header
summary: Marks Odoo outgoing emails as automatically generated, so receiving mail servers do not send vacation auto-replies. It also drops auto-generated incoming emails, which prevents mail loops. Outgoing marking can be turned off with a system parameter. This is a technical email setting.

name: mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds selected contacts as followers on their company's business documents, such as invoices. For example, an accountant can be copied on every invoice for a customer. You set the models under Configuration > Technical > Automation > Autosubscribe Models and tick In copy of on the partner.

name: mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds chosen partners, such as an accountant, in copy of every company document sent for a given customer, whatever the invoice address. Models are chosen under Settings > Technical > Automation > Autosubscribe Models, and each partner has an In copy of field. Templates can opt out.

name: mail_brand
summary: Makes outgoing emails use a brand, showing the brand's logo and company details and linking to its website. Brands are created under Contacts > Brands, and the email composer has a Brand field to apply one to a message.

name: mail_chatter_split
summary: Adds filter buttons above the chatter to show all messages, only user messages, only system logs, or only planned activities. The chosen view is remembered when you move between records.

name: mail_cleanup
summary: Technical server setting for incoming mail. On IMAP servers, it marks old emails as read, moves them to a folder, or deletes them after a set number of days, just before mail is fetched. It is configured per mail server in the server config file.

name: mail_cleanup
summary: Marks old incoming emails as read and moves them to a folder, and deletes old messages from the mail server before fetching new ones. Retention periods are set per incoming mail server. It keeps the shared mailbox tidy and stops unrouted junk mail from piling up.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc
summary: Adds separate Cc and Bcc fields to the email composer. Default Cc and Bcc partners can be set on the company, and a Bcc field is added to email templates, with their addresses matched to partners.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc
summary: Adds separate Cc and Bcc fields to the mail composer, which Odoo otherwise lacks. Default Cc and Bcc contacts can be set on the company form, and Bcc can be set on mail templates. Each recipient gets their own email, with the same To, Cc and Bcc headers.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc_account
summary: Adds Cc and Bcc fields to the Send and Print wizard for invoices, so an invoice can go to other people besides the invoice contact. It installs automatically when both Accounting and the Cc and Bcc email module are present.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc_account
summary: Adds Cc and Bcc fields to the Send and Print wizard for invoices, so an invoice can go to other people besides the invoice contact. It installs automatically when both Accounting and the Cc and Bcc email module are present.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc_mail_tracking
summary: Shows Cc and Bcc recipients in the chatter for each sent email, next to the To line. The recipient list can be expanded into To, Cc and Bcc groups, and settings choose the default view and whether users can toggle it. It needs both the Cc and Bcc and email tracking modules.

name: mail_debrand
summary: Removes Odoo branding from outgoing emails, including the Powered by Odoo footer and links. Once installed, it applies to all emails sent. Use it so customers do not see the Odoo name in emails.

name: mail_debrand
summary: Removes the Powered by Odoo footer and the Odoo name from email templates, so outgoing emails do not show Odoo branding. Install it and new emails are sent without it.

name: mail_debranding
summary: Removes the Powered by Odoo footer and the Odoo name from email templates, so outgoing emails do not show Odoo branding. Install it and new emails are sent without it.

name: mail_disable_follower_notification
summary: Turns off the Send Notification option by default when adding followers from the chatter, so new followers are added without an email being sent.

name: mail_discuss_channel_unread_sort
summary: Sorts the Discuss channel list so channels with unread messages come first, with the most recently active at the top. Read channels keep the normal alphabetical order.

name: mail_discuss_security
summary: Adds a See Discuss Menu group, so the Discuss app and its message icon are shown only to users in that group. By default every user sees them.

name: mail_drop_target
summary: Lets you drag an email file from your desktop onto a record's chatter to attach it there. It supports .eml files, and .msg files if an extra library is installed. Followers are notified about the new message, and that notification can be turned off in settings.

name: mail_drop_target
summary: Lets you drag an email file from your desktop, an .eml or an Outlook .msg, onto a record's chatter to attach it there. Followers are notified by default, and that can be turned off in settings.

name: mail_edit
summary: Lets users edit the text of a chatter message, delete it, or move it to a different record. Use the pen icon on a message in the chatter. Edit and move rights are given through user permissions.

name: mail_environment
summary: Lets incoming and outgoing mail servers be configured from the server environment files, so production and test databases can use different mail servers. It is a technical setup for administrators.

name: mail_environment
summary: Lets incoming and outgoing mail servers be configured from the server environment files, so production and test databases can use different mail servers. It is a technical setup for administrators.

name: mail_environment_google_gmail
summary: Sets up Gmail as an outgoing mail server from the server environment config file, including the Gmail client ID, secret and authorization. It is a technical setup for administrators.

name: mail_environment_google_gmail
summary: Sets up Gmail authentication for mail servers from the server environment config file, including the Gmail client ID, secret and authorization. It is a technical setup for administrators.

name: mail_environment_office365
summary: Sets up Office 365 as an outgoing mail server from the server environment config file, including the Microsoft client ID and secret. It is a technical setup for administrators.

name: mail_extra_header
summary: Adds an Extra Headers field to outgoing mail servers, so custom headers can be added to all emails sent through that server. The field takes a dictionary of header names and values. It is set on the outgoing mail server form.

name: mail_force_email_notification
summary: Forces specific chatter notifications to be sent by email, even to users who are connected to Odoo. It works through a context key that developers set when posting messages. End users see no change, so this is a developer feature.

name: mail_forward
summary: Lets users forward a chatter message from any record to another user, or to the chatter of another record, without adding the recipients as followers. Hover over a message and click the forward icon. The target model needs Enable Forward To turned on in Technical > Models.

name: mail_forward
summary: Lets a user forward a message from any record's chatter to other users or to another record. Forwarding to users adds them as followers without notifying the existing followers. A Forward icon appears on chatter messages, and models must be enabled for forwarding under Settings > Technical.

name: mail_gateway
summary: Base module for connecting an external chat system, such as Telegram or WhatsApp, to Odoo Discuss. Customer messages arrive in Discuss, and replies are sent back through the external chat. Messages can be linked to records, and a sender can be assigned to a partner. Gateways are set up in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways, and each chat system needs its own connector module.

name: mail_gateway
summary: Base module for connecting an external chat system, such as Telegram or WhatsApp, to Odoo Discuss. Customer messages arrive in Discuss, and replies are sent back through the external chat. Messages can be linked to records, and a sender can be assigned to a partner. Gateways are set up in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways, and each chat system needs its own connector module.

name: mail_gateway_instagram
summary: Connects Instagram Direct Messages to Odoo Discuss. Incoming DMs appear as gateway channels, and replies typed in Discuss are sent back as text. The Meta app has to be published in Live mode before messages are delivered, and only Instagram Login is supported, not Facebook Login page-scoped setups.

name: mail_gateway_telegram
summary: Lets a group of users answer Telegram chats from Odoo Discuss, through a Telegram bot created with BotFather. Once someone messages the bot, the conversation appears in the gateway, and replies go back to that person. Setup is in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Mail Gateway.

name: mail_gateway_telegram
summary: Lets a group of users answer Telegram chats from Odoo Discuss, through a Telegram bot created with BotFather. Once someone messages the bot, the conversation appears in the gateway, and replies go back to that person. Setup is in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Mail Gateway.

name: mail_gateway_telegram_standalone
summary: A general Telegram Bot connector that other modules can use to send notifications. Bot tokens and authorized chat IDs are managed in one place under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways, with a Fetch Chats button to find chat IDs and a Test Connection button to check the link.

name: mail_gateway_whatsapp
summary: Lets a team reply to WhatsApp chats from Odoo Discuss, and send WhatsApp message templates from records, with their variables filled from the record. It needs a WhatsApp Business account and a Meta app, and the webhook has to be publicly reachable. Gateways are set up under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways.

name: mail_gateway_whatsapp
summary: Lets a team reply to WhatsApp chats from Odoo Discuss, and send WhatsApp message templates from records, with their variables filled from the record. It needs a WhatsApp Business account and a Meta app, and the webhook has to be publicly reachable. Gateways are set up under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways.

name: mail_gateway_whatsapp
summary: Lets a team reply to WhatsApp chats from Odoo Discuss, and send WhatsApp message templates from records, with their variables filled from the record. It needs a WhatsApp Business account and a Meta app, and the webhook has to be publicly reachable. Gateways are set up under Settings > Technical > Email > Gateways.

name: mail_history_mark_unread
summary: Adds a Mark as Unread button to messages in the History mailbox and in search results in Discuss. The message goes back to the Inbox as a new unread message and leaves History.

name: mail_improved_tracking_value
summary: Improves the record of field value changes for many2many and one2many fields, which the default tracking does not handle well. It also adds a clearer view of those changes under Settings > Technical > Improved tracking values.

name: mail_inline_css
summary: Technical tool that converts style tags in email templates stored in the database into inline styles, so they render the same way as the web editor output in email clients. It adds nothing for end users beyond email rendering.

name: mail_inline_css
summary: Converts style blocks in email templates into inline styles, so they display correctly in mail clients. It applies the same processing the web editor uses for templates stored in the database. This is a technical helper with no visible screens.

name: mail_layout_force
summary: Forces a specific email layout on chosen email templates, replacing the standard Odoo layout. You can also force a no-layout option or a custom one for emails sent from the chatter. It is set under the Settings tab of an email template in Settings > Technical > Email > Email Templates.

name: mail_layout_force
summary: Lets an administrator choose the outer layout of an email, such as the logo and footer, for a specific email template or for emails sent from a chatter. It is set under Configuration > Technical > Emails > Templates, in the Force Layout field on the Advanced Parameters tab.

name: mail_layout_preview
summary: Lets you preview email templates in the browser as a full layout, outside the Odoo backend theme. Use the preview button on a template, choose the options, and open the full layout preview link. It is mainly for developers and template designers.

name: mail_layout_preview
summary: Adds a full layout preview for email templates, so you can see the finished email outside the Odoo backend theme. Use the preview button on a template and pick the parameters. Mainly useful when building email templates.

name: mail_mention_suggestion_config
summary: Chooses who is suggested when a user types @ in a chatter log note: all partners (the default), users including portal and public users, or internal users only. The option is set in Settings under Mail Mention Suggestions Option.

name: mail_message_destiny_link_template
summary: Provides a developer email template that writes a chatter note on the source record linking to the records it created, such as a purchase order noting the invoice it produced. It is a building block for developers and has no screens by itself. Users see the note only where a developer uses it.

name: mail_message_destiny_link_template
summary: Adds an email template that posts a chatter message on both the source and the target record when one record creates or changes another. It is a developer tool, called from custom code.

name: mail_message_search
summary: Adds a Message Search field to records with a chatter, so you can search the text of their conversations. It matches each word across subject, body, sender and reply-to. A system parameter can cap how many messages are searched on very large databases.

name: mail_multicompany
summary: Makes outgoing mail servers, incoming mail servers and messages company-specific, so each company sends and fetches its own email. Set the company on each outgoing mail server under Settings > Technical > Outgoing Mail Servers.

name: mail_multicompany
summary: Adds a company to outgoing mail servers and messages, so email sent from Odoo uses the right company's server. Set the company on each outgoing mail server under Settings > Technical > Outgoing Mail Servers.

name: mail_no_user_assign_notification
summary: Stops the automatic email a user gets when they are assigned as responsible on certain records, such as Salesperson on contacts. You list the models to exclude in a system parameter. Only models that have a user field are affected.

name: mail_notification_clean_status_error
summary: Extends Odoo's scheduled cleanup so that failed email notifications are also deleted, not only successfully sent ones. This stops failed notifications from piling up and slowing down chatter queries. It runs automatically in the background.

name: mail_notification_custom_subject
summary: Lets you set a custom subject line for notification emails, using templates chosen by model and message subtype. Templates are created under Settings > Technical > Email > Subject Replacement Templates in debug mode. The subject is replaced when Odoo sends the email.

name: mail_notification_custom_subject
summary: Changes the subject line of chatter notification emails, using a template with Jinja expressions that applies per model and message subtype. Templates are created in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Subject Replacement Templates.

name: mail_notification_link
summary: Makes the document name in a messaging menu notification clickable, so it opens the record directly. Clicking elsewhere on the notification still opens the chatter, and a check icon marks it as read.

name: mail_notification_sound_volume
summary: Adds a notification volume slider to the user's Preferences, with a test button, so each user can set the sound level for chat and inbox alerts. It defaults to 100% and only shows when notifications are handled inside Odoo.

name: mail_notification_with_history
summary: Adds the previous chatter discussion to the email that followers receive for a new message, so they can see the context without opening Odoo.

name: mail_notify_employee_leave
summary: When a user mentions or assigns an employee who is out of office on an approved leave today, the sender gets a notification with the expected return date, at most once a day. The employee must be linked to an Odoo user for this to work.

name: mail_operating_unit
summary: Lets each Operating Unit send email from its own alias domain and its own outgoing mail server. The domain or server is picked up from the email template or the operating unit, and standard Odoo mail settings are used when neither is set.

name: mail_optional_autofollow
summary: Adds a checkbox on the send message wizard to choose whether new recipients become followers of the record. The box starts ticked when the context asks for it.

name: mail_optional_autofollow
summary: Adds a checkbox on the mail composer to decide whether new recipients are added as followers of the record. It starts ticked only when the action passes the right context. Use it to avoid unwanted followers on a message.

name: mail_optional_follower_notification
summary: Adds a checkbox in the mail composer to choose whether to notify the record's followers when sending a message. By default Odoo notifies everyone, so this lets you send a message quietly. Company settings also let administrators change the default.

name: mail_outbound_static
summary: Keeps the From address of outgoing email fixed to a company address, while the real sender goes in the Sender header, to follow RFC 2822. Each outgoing mail server can have a domain whitelist and an Email From address, and defaults can be set in the Odoo config file.

name: mail_outbound_static
summary: Lets outgoing mail use a fixed From address chosen on the outgoing mail server, while keeping the real sender in the Sender header. A domain list decides when the original sender is kept. This is a technical email setting for compliance with email standards.

name: mail_partner_forwarding
summary: Lets a contact have a forwarding partner, a user who also receives all of that contact's notifications. For example, an assistant can be copied on an executive's messages. It is set on the contact form.

name: mail_partner_opt_out
summary: Adds a button next to a contact's email to put that address on the blacklist, so it gets no mass mailing emails. It also adds a mass action on the contacts list to add or remove many addresses, and a Blacklist filter to list them.

name: mail_partner_opt_out
summary: Adds a button next to partner email addresses to add them to the mass mailing blacklist, so they stop receiving campaign emails. Clicking the ban again removes the address from the blacklist. A Blacklisted filter lists all such contacts.

name: mail_post_defer
summary: Sends chatter messages through the outgoing mail queue, so they wait at least 30 seconds before going out. During that time the sender can delete the message and start again. This makes posting faster when the mail server is slow or there are many followers.

name: mail_post_defer
summary: Holds posted messages in the outgoing mail queue for at least 30 seconds, so posting in the chatter is faster and a message can still be deleted while it waits. The queue is sent by a scheduled job.

name: mail_print
summary: Adds a print icon next to messages in a chatter, so a message can be printed as a readable version. Internal notes are excluded.

name: mail_quoted_reply
summary: Adds a Reply button on messages in the chatter, which opens a composer prefilled to reply to that message. It is useful for answering a customer's email directly from the thread. The reply appears in the same conversation.

name: mail_quoted_reply
summary: Adds a reply button to messages in a chatter, which opens a composer with the answer. Useful for replying to a customer's message.

name: mail_recipient_blocklist
summary: Blocks outgoing emails sent to certain recipients, using rules that match an exact address, a domain, text, a wildcard or a regular expression. Rules are managed under Settings > Technical > Email > Recipient Block Rules. Blocked emails are stopped before they leave the system.

name: mail_restrict_follower_selection
summary: Limits which contacts can be chosen as followers, for example only employees, using a domain set in system parameters. The limit can apply to all records or to one model. It also stops automatic adding of followers who do not match the domain.

name: mail_restrict_follower_selection
summary: Limits which partners can be picked as followers, using a domain such as employees only, and stops automatic adding of followers that do not match. The domain is set in System Parameters, either for all records or for one record type.

name: mail_restrict_send_button
summary: Hides the Send message button in the chatter unless the user has the Show Send Message Button group. Use it to stop some users from emailing external contacts from record chatters. The group is assigned under the user's access rights.

name: mail_restrict_send_button
summary: Hides the Send Message button in the chatter for users who do not have the Show Send Message Button group. Give that group to the users who should see it.

name: mail_send_confirmation
summary: Asks for confirmation when Send is pressed in the simple message composer in a chatter, to avoid sending an internal note to external followers by mistake. It does not apply to the full composer, which shows the recipients.

name: mail_send_confirmation
summary: Asks the user to confirm before sending a message from the chatter composer, to avoid sending an internal message to external followers by mistake. It applies to the simple chatter composer only. The full composer is not affected.

name: mail_send_confirmation
summary: Asks for confirmation when Send is pressed in the message composer in a chatter, to avoid sending an internal note to external followers by mistake.

name: mail_sent_history
summary: Adds a Sent History mailbox in Discuss that lists every message and note you have sent yourself. Its search bar finds your sent messages.

name: mail_server_by_user
summary: Uses the outgoing mail server whose login matches the email of the user doing the action, when messages and emails are sent. It is a technical email setup.

name: mail_show_follower
summary: Lists the document's external followers at the top of outgoing emails in a Sent to note, so recipients can see who else gets the message. Internal users can be shown or hidden, and the text is set under General Settings in Discuss.

name: mail_show_follower
summary: Shows the document's followers in the Cc line of emails sent from Odoo, when there is more than one. Internal users can be left out, and the text and format of the Sent to block can be set in General Settings under Mail. Users can also be excluded from the Cc line on their own profile.

name: mail_suggested_recipient_unchecked
summary: Leaves suggested extra recipients unticked by default when writing a message in a chatter, so they are not emailed unless you tick them. For example, a lead's partner on a CRM opportunity is suggested this way.

name: mail_suggested_recipient_unchecked
summary: Unticks suggested recipients by default when a user writes a message in a chatter, such as a customer who is not yet a follower. The user must tick them to send the email to that person. This avoids sending to suggested contacts by accident.

name: mail_template_attachment_i18n
summary: Adds attachments to a mail template based on the recipient's language, or on the template's own language, so the right language version of a document is sent. It is set on the template in debug mode under Settings > Technical > Email > Templates.

name: mail_template_attachment_per_lang
summary: Automatically adds attachments to email templates based on the recipient's language, such as sending the right language version of terms and conditions. The language method and attachments are set on the email template under Settings, Technical, Email, Templates. Users see the correct files added when they pick that template in the email composer.

name: mail_template_domain
summary: Lets an email template appear only for records that match a condition, such as only company contacts. Templates without a condition still show for every record of their model. The condition is set on the template under Restrict to in Settings > Technical > Email > Templates.

name: mail_template_multi_attachment
summary: Lets an email template create several attachments, generated from the record when the email is sent, instead of only one. Set a simple attachment or several report attachments on the Attachments tab of the template.

name: mail_template_multi_company
summary: Lets you limit an email template to one company when you run several companies in the same database. Each template gets a Company field, so a company-specific template is used only by that company. Set it under Settings > Technical > Email > Templates (developer mode required).

name: mail_template_substitute
