summary: Lets one email template automatically replace another when conditions are met, such as sending a different template for a particular company. You add substitution rules on the template, each with a domain. It also works with the invoice sending wizard in Accounting.

name: mail_template_substitute
summary: Lets you swap a standard email template for an alternative one when conditions are met, for example a different template for a particular company. Each template gets a Substitutions tab where you add rules with a domain that sets when the swap happens. Found under Email > Templates.

name: mail_template_substitute_account_move
summary: Extends email template substitution to invoices and bills (account.move), so a different email template can be used for an invoice when its conditions match. The rules are set up on the template's Substitutions tab, the same way as the base module. Accounting add-on; it affects invoice emails.

name: mail_thread_create_nolog
summary: A technical module that stops the 'Record created' message from being saved to the database and generates it on the fly when the chatter is displayed. The chatter still shows the creation entry, but the message table grows more slowly. No new screens for users.

name: mail_tracking
summary: Shows whether each email sent from the chatter was delivered, opened, bounced or failed. Each notified partner gets a status icon next to their name, and bounced or failed emails are flagged on the message. Internal notification status is used for internal users, and a system parameter can turn off the tracking image in outgoing emails, which disables the Opened status.

name: mail_tracking
summary: Shows delivery status icons next to each recipient in the chatter for emails sent from Odoo, such as Waiting and Opened. It also adds failed-message lists and tracking records to the mail data. The Opened status depends on a tracking image in emails, which can be turned off with a system parameter.

name: mail_tracking_mailgun
summary: Connects email tracking to Mailgun, so statuses such as received or bounced come from Mailgun webhooks instead of guesses from the SMTP server. It can also check a partner's email address against Mailgun's bounce list and validity check. Configured in Settings > General Settings > Discuss with your Mailgun API key and domain.

name: mail_tracking_mailgun
summary: Connects email tracking to Mailgun, so the status in the chatter reflects real delivery results such as Received or Bounced. It can also check partner addresses against the Mailgun bounced list. Setup is in General Settings under Discuss, where you enter the Mailgun API details.

name: mail_tracking_mass_mailing
summary: Links mass mailing statistics with email tracking, so each mailing recipient shows its email status and tracking events. Contacts also get an email score to help clean up bad addresses in mailing lists. Mass mailing sends once per recipient, so duplicate the mailing to send it again.

name: maintenance_account
summary: Creates equipment automatically when a vendor bill with a product marked Can be Maintenance is confirmed. A matching equipment category is created for the product, and a smart button shows the equipment created from the bill. It is found on Accounting vendor bills.

name: maintenance_account
summary: Creates maintenance equipment records automatically when a vendor bill is confirmed for products marked as maintenance items. An equipment category is created for each product category if one is not already linked, and a smart button on the bill shows the equipment created. Found on Vendor Bills and on the equipment records.

name: maintenance_equipment_category_hierarchy
summary: Lets equipment categories sit inside parent categories, so category names show their full path. Set the parent category on the equipment category form in Maintenance configuration. This gives a tree of categories instead of a flat list.

name: maintenance_equipment_certification
summary: Stores certificates for each piece of equipment, with a name, date, notes and an attached file. Open any equipment under Maintenance > Equipment and use the Certification tab to add or view them.

name: maintenance_equipment_certification
summary: Stores certificates on each piece of equipment and can email responsible users before a certificate expires. Reminder rules set how many days before expiry each notice goes out, and a daily scheduled job sends them. Turn the alert on in Settings > Maintenance, and set up the rules under Maintenance > Configuration.

name: maintenance_equipment_contract
summary: Links maintenance equipment to supplier contracts, so a contract lists the equipment it covers and each equipment shows its contracts with a count. Add the equipment in the Equipments field on the contract form. Depends on the OCA contract module.

name: maintenance_equipment_contract
summary: Links maintenance equipment to supplier contracts, so each equipment shows its contracts and each contract lists its equipment. Equipment is added on the contract form in the Equipments field. The contract count is shown on the equipment.

name: maintenance_equipment_hierarchy
summary: Lets equipment be organized in a parent and child hierarchy, such as a machine with its parts underneath. Each equipment shows its child equipment and a count of them. It is set on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_image
summary: Adds images to maintenance equipment, so a photo of each machine can be kept with its record. It is a small add-on with no extra menus or workflow.

name: maintenance_equipment_ref
summary: Adds an Internal Reference field to maintenance equipment, for your own numbering or code. It appears on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_sequence
summary: Gives each maintenance equipment an automatic reference number, built from a prefix and sequence set on its equipment category. New equipment in that category are numbered automatically. The prefix and sequence are set on the equipment category under Maintenance > Configuration.

name: maintenance_equipment_sequence
summary: Automatically numbers new equipment using a sequence set on each equipment category, with a prefix and next number. Equipment created in that category gets the next code. The sequence is set on the equipment category form.

name: maintenance_equipment_status
summary: Adds a Status field to equipment, with a list you define under Maintenance configuration. Statuses can be limited to certain equipment categories. The status is shown on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_tags
summary: Adds colored tags to maintenance equipment, so you can group or filter equipment by labels. Tags are managed in the maintenance configuration and assigned on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_usage
summary: Records when an employee takes a maintenance equipment and when it comes back, with the pickup and return dates, a state and comments. Each equipment keeps a usage history and an in-use flag. Found on the equipment record.

name: maintenance_equipment_usage
summary: Records who has used a piece of equipment, with pick up and return dates and states. Each equipment shows its usage history and whether it is currently in use. It is useful for tools or devices lent out to employees.

name: maintenance_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to maintenance requests in both directions, so a support ticket can lead to or reference a repair job. Each side has a tab where you can link existing records or create new ones. It requires both the Helpdesk and Maintenance apps.

name: maintenance_inspection
summary: Adds inspection checklists to preventive maintenance requests. Each inspection line records an item, its instruction and a result, and closing the inspection makes it read-only. Maintenance Plans can hold standard inspection items that are added automatically to each generated preventive request.

name: maintenance_location
summary: Adds a hierarchical location system for maintenance, with locations nested inside other locations. Equipment, plans and requests can be assigned a location, and locations can have a partner, coordinates and a sequence. Locations are managed in the maintenance configuration.

name: maintenance_location
summary: Organises maintenance equipment and requests by location, using a parent and child hierarchy of locations. Equipment, requests and maintenance plans each get a Location field, and locations can store an address and coordinates. Locations are set up under Maintenance > Configuration.

name: maintenance_location_hr
summary: Lets you assign a maintenance equipment to an employee or location, and records an owner on each location. It combines the location and HR add-ons, so the assignment fields appear on equipment and location forms. Requires the Employees app.

name: maintenance_partner
summary: Links equipment and maintenance requests to contacts. Equipment gets an assigned partner, and contacts get smart buttons showing their equipment and requests. This is useful when equipment belongs to or is serviced for a customer.

name: maintenance_plan
summary: Lets each equipment have several preventive maintenance plans, such as a monthly check and a yearly service, instead of only one. Plan kinds are defined in the maintenance configuration. Each plan has its own schedule and is found on the equipment's maintenance tab.

name: maintenance_plan
summary: Lets one equipment have several preventive maintenance plans, each with its own kind, frequency and duration, instead of a single schedule. Kinds are defined under Maintenance > Configuration, and plans appear on the Maintenance tab of the equipment and generate the requests on schedule.

name: maintenance_plan_activity
summary: Lets a maintenance plan define follow-up activities, such as calls or to-dos with a responsible user, that are created when the plan's maintenance requests are generated. Each activity can be scheduled a set number of days before the request date. Set on the plan form.

name: maintenance_plan_activity
summary: Lets a maintenance plan define activities, such as a checklist task, that are created along with each maintenance request the plan generates. Each activity has a responsible user and a number of days before the request date. These are set on the plan form.

name: maintenance_plan_only
summary: Hides Odoo's built-in recurring settings on maintenance requests, so users only see the maintenance plan scheduling. It is a technical module that avoids two competing recurrence options.

name: maintenance_product
summary: Links equipment to products and product categories, so new equipment can be created from a product. Equipment categories follow product categories automatically. Products are flagged with Can be Maintenance in their settings.

name: maintenance_product
summary: Links maintenance equipment to products, so creating an equipment from a product fills in its name and category. Products can be marked Can be Maintenance, and product categories are matched to equipment categories. Useful when machines are already set up as product records.

name: maintenance_project
summary: Ties maintenance equipment and requests to projects, so maintenance work can be logged as timesheets against a project task. An equipment can link a project, and preventive requests use the equipment's project by default. A technical add-on for timesheet tracking on maintenance.

name: maintenance_project
summary: Adds projects and tasks to equipment and maintenance requests, so maintenance work can be tracked like other project work. Equipment can link to a project, and requests take the equipment's project by default, including preventive ones. It is mainly a technical base for timesheets on requests.

name: maintenance_purchase
summary: Creates equipment automatically when a purchase order is validated, using a category set on the product. Equipment links back to its purchase and purchase line, and purchase orders show a smart button for the equipment. It is found on purchase orders.

name: maintenance_remote
summary: Adds a Remote field to maintenance requests, so an IT-related request can show the remote it happened on. It is a technical add-on aimed at IT teams.

name: maintenance_request_employee
summary: Lets you assign employees to a maintenance request, so it is clear who will work on the job. Employees are picked on the request form. It requires the Employees app.

name: maintenance_request_purchase
summary: Links purchase orders to maintenance requests, so parts or services bought for a repair can be tracked on the request. Each request and each purchase order shows a smart button to its linked records. This is useful for repairs that need spare parts.

name: maintenance_request_repair
summary: Links maintenance requests to repair orders, so a repair order can be attached to a maintenance request. Each repair order shows its linked requests and a count. It requires the Repairs app.

name: maintenance_request_sequence
summary: Numbers maintenance requests automatically using a sequence on each maintenance team, with an optional team prefix. Each new request gets a reference code from that team's sequence. The prefix and sequence are set on the team form.

name: maintenance_request_sequence
summary: Gives maintenance requests automatic reference codes based on the team they belong to. Each team has a prefix and sequence, and its requests show the generated code. Set up on the team record.

name: maintenance_request_stage_transition
summary: Controls which stage a maintenance request can move to next. You set the next and previous stages on each stage, and the allowed next stages appear as buttons in the request header. Configured under Maintenance > Configuration > Maintenance Stages.

name: maintenance_request_tags
summary: Lets you tag maintenance requests with coloured labels, for example to group or categorise the work. Tags are defined on the request form and stored per request.

name: maintenance_request_tags
summary: Adds colored tags to maintenance requests so you can label and filter them. Tags are managed in the maintenance configuration and appear on the request form.

name: maintenance_security
summary: Hides the Maintenance menu from users who have no maintenance group, and stops users without maintenance access from getting assignment emails with a link to equipment they cannot open. Technical, access-related add-on.

name: maintenance_security
summary: Limits the Maintenance menu to users who have one of the maintenance groups. It also stops the assignment email from being sent to users with no maintenance access, since it would contain a link they cannot open. This is a technical security module.

name: maintenance_sign_oca
summary: Sends equipment documents for e-signature, either manually from the equipment list using a sign template or automatically. Signature requests show as a smart button on the equipment form. Requires a sign template whose model is the maintenance equipment.

name: maintenance_stock
summary: Lets maintenance requests consume stock, such as spare parts taken from the warehouse. Each request has a Picking list button that creates stock transfers with their own sequence, from the equipment's default warehouse. Consumptions must be enabled on the equipment first.

name: maintenance_team_hierarchy
summary: Lets maintenance teams be nested under parent teams, and each team shows the requests of its sub teams. Counts of to-do requests are shown by date, high priority, blocked and unscheduled. The parent team is set on the team form.

name: maintenance_team_hierarchy
summary: Lets maintenance teams be arranged in a parent and child hierarchy. Each team shows its related requests along with counts for due, high priority, blocked and unscheduled requests.

name: maintenance_timesheet
summary: Lets people record timesheet hours on maintenance requests, and shows totals of hours spent, planned and remaining with a progress figure. Timesheets appear in the request's Timesheets tab. It requires the maintenance project and Timesheets modules.

name: maintenance_timesheet_time_control
summary: Adds start and stop timer buttons on maintenance requests for timesheet tracking, so a technician can run a timer while working. It follows the project timesheet time control, and the request needs a project set before the buttons show. This is a technical add-on.

name: maintenance_timesheet_time_control
summary: Adds Start and Stop timer buttons to maintenance requests that have a project, and records the exact start time of each timesheet line. Works through the timesheet time control feature. Shown on the maintenance request form; the buttons need a project on the request.

name: marketing_campaign_budget
summary: Adds Budget Amount and Actual Cost fields to marketing campaigns, in company currency, for planning only. It does not calculate profitability or ROI. Found on the campaign form under Marketing > Campaigns, and visible only to Sales salespersons.

name: marketing_campaign_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to marketing campaigns, with Running, Upcoming and Finished filters and group-by by month. Use it to see which campaigns are live, planned or over. Found under Marketing > Campaigns.

name: marketing_crm_partner
summary: Copies the lead's marketing tracking fields onto the customer record when a lead is converted into a customer. The tracking fields sit in the Extra Info > Marketing section of the lead. Found in CRM when converting a lead.

name: marketing_crm_partner
summary: Copies the lead's marketing tracking fields onto the customer record when a lead is converted into a customer. The tracking fields are entered on the lead under Extra Info > Tracking. Found in CRM when converting a lead.

name: mass
summary: Empty placeholder module left from the Odoo 18 migration of the old mass module. Its features moved into donation_mass, so it does nothing and should be uninstalled once nothing depends on it. Technical; no user screens.

name: mass
summary: Manages religious Mass requests from donors through planning and celebration, with a celebrant and intention on each request. Accounting: a request is held as stock until the Mass is celebrated, then moved to revenue, and transfers to an external celebrant create a payable entry. Under the Mass menu.

name: mass_mailing_contact_active
summary: Adds an active flag to mailing contacts and their list subscriptions, so a contact can be archived without being deleted. Found on mailing contacts and subscriptions under Email Marketing.

name: mass_mailing_custom_unsubscribe
summary: Records why each contact is on a mailing list and why they unsubscribed, as proof for GDPR. Unsubscribe events are logged in the Opt-Out report under Email Marketing > Reporting, and a system parameter can redirect to the subscriptions form. Useful for showing consent.

name: mass_mailing_custom_unsubscribe
summary: Records why each contact is on a mailing list and why they unsubscribed, as proof for GDPR. Unsubscribe events are logged under Email Marketing > Unsubscriptions, with metadata stored on the blacklist and subscription records.

name: mass_mailing_custom_unsubscribe
summary: Lets you set the reasons offered when someone unsubscribes from a mailing, with optional required details, and records why and when each contact subscribed or unsubscribed. You can also stop unsubscribing from one list from removing the contact from others, and unsubscriptions from non-list recipients are recorded. Configured under Email Marketing > Configuration > Unsubscription Reasons.

name: mass_mailing_disable_tracking
summary: Turns off open tracking and link click tracking for mass mailings, so emails carry no tracking pixel and links are not rewritten through Odoo. Both are off for new mailings after install and can be turned back on in Settings > Email Marketing.

name: mass_mailing_event_registration_exclude
summary: Lets a mailing exclude people who are already registered for an event, based on their registration state such as registered, confirmed, cancelled or attended. You pick the event and the excluded states on the mailing, so a follow-up send skips people who already signed up. Shown on the mailing form under Email Marketing.

name: mass_mailing_event_registration_exclude
summary: Lets a mailing exclude people who are already registered for an event, based on their registration state such as registered, confirmed, cancelled or attended. You pick the event and the excluded states on the mailing, so a follow-up send skips people who already signed up. Shown on the mailing form under Email Marketing.

name: mass_mailing_list_dynamic
summary: Turns a mailing list into a dynamic list that refreshes from its filter before each send, so new matching contacts are added automatically. Tick Dynamic on the list and choose a sync method and criteria under Email Marketing > Mailing Lists. Use Sync now to refresh it by hand.

name: mass_mailing_list_dynamic
summary: Turns a mailing list into a dynamic list that refreshes from its filter before each send, so new matching contacts are added automatically. Tick Dynamic on the list and choose a sync method and criteria under Email Marketing > Mailing List. Use Sync now to refresh it by hand.

name: mass_mailing_list_prune_blacklisted
summary: Removes blacklisted contacts from mailing lists. When you pick a list that contains blacklisted contacts while creating a mailing, a Prune lists button opens a wizard showing them so you can confirm their removal. Shown on the mailing form under Email Marketing.

name: mass_mailing_multi_company
summary: Adds a Company field to mailing campaigns, mailing lists, contacts and subscriptions, so each company only sees and selects its own lists and contacts. Restricts the list choices on mailing and contact forms to the right company. Found in Email Marketing in a multi-company database.

name: mass_mailing_partner
summary: Links mailing contacts to customers and vendors by matching email addresses, and can create the partner when none matches. Partner forms get Mailing contacts and Mass mailing stats smart buttons, and an Add to mailing list action adds selected partners to a list. Useful for keeping email marketing tied to your contacts.

name: mass_mailing_partner
summary: Links mailing contacts to customers and vendors by matching email addresses, and can create the partner when none matches. Partner forms get Mailing contacts and Mass mailing stats smart buttons, and an Add to mailing list action adds selected partners to a list. Useful for keeping email marketing tied to your contacts.

name: mass_mailing_partner_title
summary: Keeps the title on mailing contacts in sync with the partner's title when the Partner Title module is installed. Technical add-on with no new screens; it only adds a title field to mailing contacts.

name: mass_mailing_resend
summary: Adds a Resend button to a finished mailing that sets it back to draft, so you can change its recipients or list and send it again to people who have not received it. Found on the mailing form under Email Marketing > Mailings.

name: mass_mailing_resend
summary: Adds a Resend button to a finished mailing that sets it back to draft, so you can change its recipients or list and send it again to people who have not received it. Found on the mailing form under Email Marketing > Mailings.

name: mass_mailing_unique
summary: Blocks duplicate mailing list names and duplicate contact emails, so imports and manual entry do not create doubled lists or contacts. Applies to Email Marketing lists and mailing contacts.

name: mautic_connector
summary: Base connector between Odoo and a Mautic marketing automation instance. It stores the Mautic URL and OAuth2 credentials on a backend record, handles login and token refresh, and offers a Test Connection button. It does not sync business data itself; other modules build on it, and backends are set up under Connectors > Mautic Backends.

name: membership
summary: Manages memberships for associations and clubs: membership categories such as Silver or Gold, paid or free members, associated members, and special member prices. Membership lines and states are tracked per partner, and renewals can be invoiced and proposed through sales and accounting. Found under the Membership app and member fields on contacts.

name: membership_account_invoice_start_end_dates
summary: Makes membership periods follow the Start Date and End Date of the invoice lines they come from, so the membership covers exactly the period invoiced. This helps with accounting cut-offs. Found on membership lines and invoice lines.

name: membership_delegated_partner
summary: Lets a membership line belong to a delegated partner, who receives the membership even though a different partner is invoiced. On a membership invoice you pick the delegated partner. Users need the Delegated partner in membership permission in user settings.

name: membership_delegated_partner
summary: Lets a membership line belong to a delegated partner, who receives the membership even though a different partner is invoiced. On a membership invoice you pick the delegated partner. Users need the Delegated partner in membership permission in user settings.

name: membership_extension
summary: Extends the membership module with membership categories (such as Silver or Gold), editable membership lines, and a separate membership security group. It also keeps the start date of the last period, blocks deleting members, and can give associated members their own joining date. Categories are set under Association > Configuration > Membership Categories.

name: membership_extension
summary: Extends the membership module with membership categories (such as Silver or Gold), editable membership lines, and a separate membership security group. It also keeps the start date of the last period, blocks deleting members, and can give associated members their own joining date. Categories are set under Association > Configuration > Membership Categories.

name: membership_initial_fee
summary: Adds a one-time initial fee to a partner's first invoice for a membership product. The fee can be a fixed amount or a percentage of the price, set on the product, and appears as a separate line labelled Membership initial fee unless you choose another product for it.

name: membership_initial_fee
summary: Adds a one-time initial fee to a partner's first invoice for a membership product. The fee can be a fixed amount or a percentage of the price, set on the product, and appears as a separate line labelled Membership initial fee unless you choose another product for it.

name: membership_prorate
summary: Charges only the part of a periodic membership fee that covers the period the member actually gets, instead of the full fee. Turn on Prorate on the membership product; this applies to invoices created by hand or through the Buy Membership button on the member form.

name: membership_prorate
summary: Charges only the part of a periodic membership fee that covers the period the member actually gets, instead of the full fee. Turn on Prorate on the membership product; this applies to invoices created by hand or through the Buy Membership button on the member form.

name: membership_prorate_variable_period
summary: Makes proration work for memberships with variable periods, by calculating the period from the invoice date in weekly, monthly or yearly units. It is a helper that combines membership_prorate and membership_variable_period, so it only applies when both are in use.

name: membership_variable_period
summary: Lets a membership last a set length of time from the join date, such as one year from subscription, instead of fixed quota cycles. Set Membership type to Variable periods on the product, then pick the quantity and interval, and a scheduled job updates states so lapsed members show as old members.

name: membership_variable_period
summary: Lets a membership last a set length of time from the join date, such as one year from subscription, instead of fixed quota cycles. A renewal bought in the same category starts the day after the last period ends, and a scheduled job updates states so lapsed members show as old members. Set Membership type to Variable periods on the product.

name: membership_withdrawal
summary: Records why and when a member asked to withdraw from membership, on the membership line, with a date the membership period must end. Reasons are kept in a list under Association > Configuration. The last reason and date are also shown on the partner.

name: membership_withdrawal
summary: Records why and when a member asked to withdraw from membership, on the membership line, with a date the membership period must end. Reasons are kept in a list under Members > Configuration. The last reason and date are also shown on the partner.

name: mgmtsystem
summary: Base module for management system apps such as ISO quality, safety or environment compliance. It provides the Management System app with systems, audit reports, nonconformities, immediate, corrective and preventive actions, and improvement opportunities. Systems are set under Configuration > Systems, and other management modules are switched on in Settings.

name: mgmtsystem
summary: Base module for management system apps such as ISO quality, safety or environment compliance. It provides the Management System app with systems, audit reports, nonconformities, immediate, corrective and preventive actions, and improvement opportunities. Systems are set under Configuration > Systems, and other management modules are switched on in Settings.

name: mgmtsystem
summary: Base module for management system apps such as ISO quality, safety or environment compliance. It provides the Management System app with systems, audit reports, nonconformities, immediate, corrective and preventive actions, and improvement opportunities. Settings also let you switch on sector-specific systems such as automotive and laboratories.

name: mgmtsystem
summary: Base module for management system apps such as ISO quality, safety or environment compliance. It provides the Management System app with systems, audit reports, nonconformities, immediate, corrective and preventive actions, and improvement opportunities. Systems are set under Configuration > Systems, and other management modules are switched on in Settings.

name: mgmtsystem_action
summary: Tracks corrective, preventive and improvement actions in the Management System app, each with an owner, deadline, stage and tags. Stages and tags are set under Configuration > Actions. Includes an action report with days to open and days overdue.

name: mgmtsystem_action_efficacy
summary: Adds an Efficacy tab to management system actions, where you rate whether the action worked, name the inspector and write notes. Changes to the efficacy fields are tracked in the chatter. Found on the Action form.

name: mgmtsystem_action_efficacy
summary: Adds an Efficacy tab to management system actions, where you rate whether the action worked, name the inspector and write notes. Changes to the efficacy fields are tracked in the chatter. Found on the Action form.

name: mgmtsystem_action_hazard
summary: Links one management system action to several hazards, so an action can be listed under each hazard it addresses. From a hazard you can see all its related actions. Set on the Hazards tab of the action and on the hazard record.

name: mgmtsystem_action_template
summary: Lets you save common action setups as templates, with a default title, type, responsible person, tags and description. Picking a template on a new action fills those fields in automatically. Templates are set under Management System > Configuration > Action Templates.

name: mgmtsystem_action_template
summary: Lets you save common action setups as templates, with a default title, type, responsible person, tags and description. Picking a template on a new action fills those fields in automatically. Templates are set under Management System > Configuration > Action Templates.

name: mgmtsystem_audit
summary: Plans and runs internal audits in the Management System app. You name the audit, assign auditors and a date, prepare a verification checklist to print, log answers while auditing, and turn findings into nonconformities and improvement opportunities. Auditor and approver access is set through the Management System user groups.

name: mgmtsystem_audit
summary: Plans and runs internal audits in the Management System app. You name the audit, assign auditors and a date, prepare a verification checklist to print, log answers while auditing, and turn findings into nonconformities and improvement opportunities. Auditor and approver access is set through the Management System user groups.

name: mgmtsystem_claim
summary: Tracks customer and vendor claims and complaints in the Management System app, with stages and categories for each claim. Claims can be created from incoming emails through the mail gateway. Stages are set under Management System > Configuration > Claim.

name: mgmtsystem_environment
summary: Sets up an Environment Management System (EMS). It installs a management system linked to the Environment Manual template, and brings in audits, reviews, environmental aspects and documentation. Manuals are under Management Systems > Documentation.

name: mgmtsystem_environment
summary: Sets up an Environment Management System (EMS), covering the Environment Manual, management reviews, audits, environmental aspects, nonconformities, actions and employee training. Work through Management Systems, and write the manual under Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_environment
summary: Sets up an Environment Management System (EMS), covering the Environment Manual, management reviews, audits, environmental aspects, nonconformities, actions and employee training. Work through Management Systems, and write the manual under Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_evaluation
summary: Creates evaluations, or checks, for any kind of record such as partners, employees or products. You define an evaluation template per model, with possible results, and users fill in evaluations that can notify a user or manager. Evaluations are kept on each record.

name: mgmtsystem_evaluation_hr
summary: Allows management system evaluations to be used on employees, so an employee record gets evaluations like any other evaluated record. It is an add-on that joins the evaluation module with HR.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard
summary: Records hazards for health and safety work: each hazard gets a type, origin, department, responsible person, analysis date, probability, severity and control measures, plus implementation tests. Lists such as types and severities are set under Management Systems > Configuration > Hazard.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard
summary: Records hazards for health and safety work: each hazard gets a type, origin, department, responsible person, analysis date, probability, severity and control measures, plus implementation tests. Lists such as types and severities are set under Management Systems > Configuration > Hazard.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard_maintenance_equipment
summary: Links maintenance equipment to hazards, so a hazard record lists the machines it involves. Pick equipment on the hazard form under Management System > Documentation > Hazards.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard_risk
summary: Adds risk scoring to hazards: a risk type, a company formula that computes the risk score, and residual risk evaluations after controls are in place. The formula is chosen in Settings under Management System. Residual risk rows are added on the hazard.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard_risk
summary: Adds risk scoring to hazards: a risk type, a company formula that computes the risk score, and residual risk evaluations after controls are in place. The formula is chosen in Settings under Management System. Residual risk rows are added on the hazard.

name: mgmtsystem_hazard_risk
summary: Adds risk scoring to hazards: a risk type, a company formula that computes the risk score, and residual risk evaluations after controls are in place. Set the formula in Settings under Management System, and fill in probability, severity and usage on the Risk Evaluation tab of a hazard.

name: mgmtsystem_health_safety
summary: Sets up a Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS) using a Health and Safety Manual template, with audits, management reviews, hazard and risk management and documentation. Manuals are under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_health_safety
summary: Provides the Health and Safety Manual template as a document page category, so a new manual can be started from it under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Technical content add-on for safety documentation.

name: mgmtsystem_info_security_manual
summary: Adds an Information Security Manual template as a wiki page category, based on the ISO 27001 structure. You create a new page under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals and pick the Information Security category, then fill it in or edit the template.

name: mgmtsystem_info_security_manual
summary: Provides an Information Security Manual template as a document page category, so a new security manual page can be created under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals. Documentation add-on with no workflow of its own.

name: mgmtsystem_information_security
summary: Adds an Information Security Management System (ISMS) app for ISO 27001 style work, bringing together the security manual, feared events, actions, audits and reviews. Feared events are rated by probability and severity, and security controls can be linked to actions. Set up under Management Systems > Configuration and Documentation > Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_kpi
summary: Adds a Key Performance Indicators menu under the Management Systems app, using the KPI module. The module's own description is short, so the exact screens are not documented here.

name: mgmtsystem_manual
summary: Adds a Documentation menu to the Management System app, where manuals are kept as wiki pages built from templates. Other management system modules, such as the quality and health and safety manuals, depend on it. Found under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_manual
summary: Adds a Documentation menu to the Management System app, where manuals are kept as wiki pages built from templates. Other management system modules, such as the quality and health and safety manuals, depend on it. Found under Management Systems > Documentation > Manuals.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity
summary: Logs nonconformities, meaning problems found against a quality, environment, safety or security standard. Each record has a partner, a related reference, a responsible person and a manager, and moves through configurable stages, with email notifications per stage. Found under Management System > Nonconformities.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity
summary: Logs nonconformities, meaning problems found against a quality, environment, safety or security standard. Each record has a partner, a related reference, a responsible person and a manager, and moves through configurable stages. Found under Management System > Nonconformities.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_hazard
summary: Links hazards to a nonconformity, so a problem found on the nonconformity can point to the safety hazards involved. Pick them on the Hazards tab of the nonconformity form.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_hr
summary: Adds a Department field to nonconformities, so each problem can be assigned to the department it concerns. It is a bridge between the Management System and the HR departments. Pick the department on the nonconformity form.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_maintenance
summary: Links a maintenance request to nonconformities, so a problem found during maintenance can be logged against the request it came from. Pick the maintenance request on the nonconformity form, and the request shows a nonconformity count.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_maintenance_equipment
summary: Lets you pick a maintenance equipment on a nonconformity, so a problem can be tied to the machine it concerns. Set the Equipment field on the nonconformity form.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_maintenance_equipment
summary: Lets you pick a maintenance equipment on a nonconformity, so a problem can be tied to the machine it concerns. Set the Equipment field on the nonconformity form.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_mrp
summary: Adds a Workcenter field to nonconformities, so a problem can be tied to the work center where it happened. The field appears only when Manage Work Order Operations is enabled for the user. A bridge between the Management System and Manufacturing apps.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_mrp
summary: Adds a Workcenter field to nonconformities, so a problem can be tied to the work center where it happened. The field appears only when Manage Work Order Operations is enabled for the user. A bridge between the Management System and Manufacturing apps.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_product
summary: Adds a Product field to nonconformities, so a problem can be linked to the product it affects. Pick the product on the nonconformity form. A bridge between the Management System and Product modules.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_project
summary: Lets an action on a nonconformity be a project, with the project linked to the action. The action gets a type and a project field, plus a full name. Found on the action form in the Management System app.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_quality_control_oca
summary: Links quality control inspections to nonconformities, so a nonconformity can point to the inspection that found it and inspections show their nonconformity count. Pick the inspection on the nonconformity form. A bridge between Management System and Quality Control.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_quality_control_oca
summary: Links quality control inspections to nonconformities, and can create a nonconformity automatically when an inspection on a product fails. Products have a Create Nonconformity flag for this, and a trigger on the product creates inspections when it moves in transfers. Configured on the product under Inventory.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_repair
summary: Links a repair order to nonconformities, so a problem found during a repair can be logged against that order. Pick the repair order on the nonconformity form, and the repair order shows a nonconformity count.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_type
summary: Classifies each nonconformity as Internal, Partner, Customer or External. For partner-caused problems it adds a button to email the partner's Quality contact, and it keeps the not-compliant quantity from exceeding the quantity checked. Set the type on the nonconformity form; the default is Internal.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_type
summary: Classifies each nonconformity as Internal, Partner, Customer or External. For partner-caused problems it adds a button to email the partner's Quality contact, and it keeps the not-compliant quantity from exceeding the quantity checked. Set the type on the nonconformity form; the default is Internal.

name: mgmtsystem_nonconformity_type
summary: Classifies each nonconformity as Internal, Partner, Customer or External. For partner-caused problems it adds a button to email the partner's Quality contact, and it keeps the not-compliant quantity from exceeding the quantity checked. Set the type on the nonconformity form; the default is Internal.

name: mgmtsystem_objective
summary: Sets measurable objectives inside the Management System, each with an owner, start and end dates and indicators. Indicators have targets (minimum or maximum) and recorded values with units, so progress against each objective can be tracked.

name: mgmtsystem_partner
summary: Adds a Quality address type to a contact, so a supplier or customer can have a dedicated quality contact. That contact is used for nonconformity emails. A bridge between Management System and Contacts.

name: mgmtsystem_quality
summary: Sets up a Quality Management System (QMS) with a quality manual, procedures and work instructions, management reviews, audits, nonconformities, corrective and preventive actions, improvement opportunities and a customer satisfaction survey. Follow-ups, action plans and effectiveness checks are tracked in the Management System app.

name: mgmtsystem_quality
summary: Sets up a Quality Management System (QMS) with a quality manual, procedures and work instructions, management reviews, audits, nonconformities, corrective and preventive actions, improvement opportunities and a customer satisfaction survey. Follow-ups, action plans and effectiveness checks are tracked in the Management System app.

name: mgmtsystem_review
summary: Runs top management reviews of your systems. Each review records the date, participants, policies, KPI and survey results, and each discussed problem is logged as a review line linked to an action or nonconformity. Found under Management Systems > Reviews, where you can print the report.

name: mgmtsystem_review
summary: Runs top management reviews of your systems. Each review records the date, participants, policies, KPI and survey results, and each discussed problem is logged as a review line linked to an action or nonconformity. Found under Management Systems > Reviews, where you can print the report.

name: mgmtsystem_review_objective
summary: Adds objectives to management reviews, with a start date, end date and the objectives reviewed in that period. Lets a review check progress against the objectives set in the Management System.

name: mgmtsystem_review_survey
summary: Attaches survey answers to management reviews, so survey results can be reviewed alongside the review's other data. It uses the Survey app.

name: mgmtsystem_risk
summary: Provides shared probability and severity scales that risk assessments across the management system modules use. It is a technical base module with no separate screens of its own.

name: mgmtsystem_security_event
summary: Manages feared events (security incidents) for an information security management system, each tied to confidentiality, integrity and/or availability and linked to attack vectors, threat sources, scenarios and security controls. Events are rated by probability and severity, and a risk matrix report plots them by risk level. Found under Management System > Manuals > Security.

name: mgmtsystem_survey
summary: Runs customer satisfaction surveys for the Management System app, which can be published on the website, printed and emailed, or completed by phone. Surveys are set up under Management System > Configuration > Surveys and use the Survey app.

name: mgmtsystem_survey
summary: Runs customer satisfaction surveys for the Management System app, which can be published on the website, printed and emailed, or completed by phone. Surveys are set up under Management System > Configuration > Surveys and use the Survey app.

name: microsoft_calendar_filter
summary: Limits which calendar events sync between Outlook and Odoo. You can stop private Outlook events from reaching Odoo, which also removes ones already synced, and set a domain so only matching Odoo events go to Outlook. Installing it changes nothing until the options are set under Settings > General Settings > Integrations.

name: microsoft_drive_account
summary: Lets each user link their own Microsoft OneDrive or SharePoint account to Odoo from their preferences page, so other modules can work with Drive as that user. Needs an Azure app registration whose client ID and secret are entered in Settings. Technical connection add-on for Microsoft Drive integrations.

name: mis_builder
summary: Builds management information system (MIS) reports and dashboards, with KPIs as rows and time periods as columns, mostly drawn from accounting entries. Templates are set up under Accounting > Configuration > MIS Reporting, and report instances under Accounting > Reports. Reports export to PDF and Excel and can be added to dashboards.

name: mis_builder
summary: Builds management information system (MIS) reports and dashboards, with KPIs as rows and time periods as columns, mostly drawn from accounting entries. Templates are set up under Accounting > Configuration > MIS Reporting, and report instances under Accounting > Reports. Reports export to PDF and Excel and can be added to dashboards.

name: mis_builder_analytic
summary: Lets a MIS report use analytic (cost accounting) lines as its data source instead of journal items. On the report, set the source to Actuals (alternative) and the move lines source to MIS Account Analytic Line. Found in Accounting > Reports > MIS Reporting.

name: mis_builder_analytic
summary: Lets a MIS report use analytic (cost accounting) lines as its data source instead of journal items. On the report, set the source to Actuals (alternative) and the move lines source to MIS Account Analytic Line. Found in Accounting > Reports > MIS Reporting.

name: mis_builder_budget
summary: Adds budgets to MIS reports, set either per KPI or per general ledger account, so a report column can show budgeted figures adjusted to its period. Several budgets can exist per report template, for example one per year, and a budget is picked as the data source on a column. The two budget methods cannot be mixed in one budget.

name: mis_builder_budget
summary: Adds budgets to MIS reports, set either per KPI or per general ledger account, so a report column can show budgeted figures adjusted to its period. Several budgets can exist per report template, for example one per year, and a budget is picked as the data source on a column. The two budget methods cannot be mixed in one budget.

name: mis_builder_budget_product
summary: Adds a product to budget lines by account, so budgets can show products and MIS reports can be filtered by product. When a budget by GL account is created it can also be filled with one line per product. Extends the MIS Builder Budget module.

name: mis_builder_cash_flow
summary: Adds a cash flow forecast to MIS reports. It uses the due date on accounting entries, plus manual forecast lines for money expected in or out, and recurring cash flow plans that create a series of forecast lines in one click, capped per company. Set up under Accounting > Reports > MIS Reporting, using the Cash Flow report.

name: mis_builder_cash_flow
summary: Adds a cash flow forecast to MIS reports. It uses the due date on accounting entries, plus manual forecast lines for money expected in or out. Set up under Accounting > Reports > MIS Reporting, using the Cash Flow report.

name: mis_builder_cash_flow
summary: Adds a cash flow forecast to MIS reports. It uses the due date on accounting entries, plus manual forecast lines for money expected in or out. Set up under Accounting > Reports > MIS Reporting, using the Cash Flow report.

name: mis_builder_contract
summary: Adds contract lines as a data source for MIS reports. Virtual lines are calculated from contract line dates, amounts and recurrence, for both customer and vendor contracts. Choose MIS Contract Lines as the move lines source on a report column, which needs the OCA contract module.

name: mis_builder_demo
summary: Demo data for MIS Builder, built on the standard chart of accounts. It adds sample styles, a budget, an expense-by-category report template, and a report instance showing budget, committed purchases, actuals and what is available. Meant for trying the module out, not for production.

name: mis_builder_demo
summary: Demo data for MIS Builder, built on the standard chart of accounts. It adds sample styles, a budget, an expense-by-category report template, and a report instance showing budget, committed purchases, actuals and what is available. Meant for trying the module out, not for production.

name: mis_builder_total_committed_purchase
summary: Adds a committed purchases data source for MIS reports, counting all purchase order lines that are not draft or cancelled. Lets a report column show spend that is committed but not yet invoiced. The account comes from the product, then its category, as a fallback.

name: mis_template_financial_report
summary: Provides ready-made Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet templates for MIS reports. Pick one of them when creating a new MIS report. Where supported, the Horizontal option on the Layout tab puts the two columns side by side on one page.

name: mis_template_financial_report
summary: Provides ready-made Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet templates for MIS reports. Pick one of them when creating a new MIS report. Where supported, the Horizontal option on the Layout tab puts the two columns side by side on one page.

name: misc_settings
summary: A technical anchor module that gives a Miscellaneous Settings section in Settings, where other custom settings can be placed. It has no features of its own; developers use it to group settings.

name: module_analysis
summary: Shows how much of the installed code comes from Odoo core, OCA, or custom in-house modules, with counts of Python, XML, JavaScript and style lines. Rules decide each module's type and are maintained under Apps, Module Analysis. It helps companies estimate upgrade effort and technical debt.

name: module_analysis
summary: Shows how much of the code running on your instance comes from Odoo core, OCA or custom modules, using pivot and pie stats under Apps > Module Analysis. Module types come from editable rules, so your own modules can be classified too. Useful for estimating the upgrade effort for custom code.

name: module_auto_update
summary: Upgrades only the installed modules whose code has changed since the last successful upgrade, by comparing checksums of their files. A method on the modules runs the upgrade, and a system parameter sets which file patterns are ignored. A technical maintenance tool for deployments.

name: module_auto_update
summary: Upgrades only the installed modules whose code has changed since the last successful upgrade, by comparing checksums of their files. A method on the modules runs the upgrade, and a system parameter sets which file patterns are ignored. A technical maintenance tool for deployments.

name: module_auto_update
summary: Upgrades only the installed modules whose code has changed since the last successful upgrade, instead of upgrading everything. It works by comparing saved checksums of each module's files. It is an administrator tool for maintenance and deployments.

name: module_change_auto_install
summary: Lets administrators change which modules install automatically through the server configuration file, adding or removing modules from the automatic install list. It is a server-level setting set in the Odoo configuration file, not in the app. End users see no difference except which modules are present.

name: module_change_auto_install
summary: Lets you change which modules are installed automatically, by adding or removing entries in the Odoo server configuration file. It is a server setting with no screens for users, and it is for administrators who want different auto-install behaviour.

name: mrp_account_analytic
summary: Creates analytic items when raw materials are consumed or work center time is recorded on a manufacturing order, with the quantity and cost. Set the analytic account on the Miscellaneous tab of the order. Costs are analysed under Manufacturing > Reports > Analytic Items.

name: mrp_attachment_mgmt
summary: Shows the attachments of a BoM at every level, plus the product's attachments, from a work order. Smart buttons on the work order open Product Attachments and BoM Attachments. Found under Manufacturing > Operations > Work Orders, with the Work Orders setting turned on.

name: mrp_attachment_mgmt
summary: Shows the attachments of a BoM at every level, plus the product's attachments, from a work order. Smart buttons on the work order open Product Attachments and BoM Attachments. Found under Manufacturing > Operations > Work Orders, with the Work Orders setting turned on.

name: mrp_bom_assign_auto
summary: When a manufacturing order needs a BoM, picks the first BoM whose components are all available. If none qualifies, it falls back to the standard Odoo choice. It is controlled by a setting under Manufacturing.

name: mrp_bom_attribute_match
summary: For products with many variants, such as a desk in hundreds of colours, a BoM line can use a product template as a component. The matching component variant is picked automatically from the attribute value chosen on the manufacturing order, so one BoM line replaces one line per colour.

name: mrp_bom_component_mass_change
summary: Replaces or removes a component in several BoMs in one step. A button on a BoM component line, shown when the component appears in more than one BoM, opens a wizard that lists the BoMs to update and applies the change with the new quantity.
keywords: update bill of materials at once

name: mrp_bom_component_menu
summary: Adds a Bill of Material Components menu item under Manufacturing > Products, so components can be reached directly from the menu. It is a navigation shortcut with no other changes.

name: mrp_bom_current_stock
summary: Adds a BoM Current Stock Explosion report under Manufacturing > Reporting. Choose a product, BoM and location, and it lists every component down the BoM levels with the quantity available in the source location, printable to Excel.

name: mrp_bom_current_stock
summary: Adds a BoM Current Stock Explosion report under Manufacturing > Reporting. Choose a product, BoM and location, and it lists every component down the BoM levels with the quantity available in the source location, printable to Excel.

name: mrp_bom_hierarchy
summary: On the BoM list, go to a child BoM, a parent BoM or a product's BoM components with one click, which makes multi-level bills of materials easier to maintain. Found under Manufacturing > Products > Bills of Materials.

name: mrp_bom_hierarchy
summary: On the BoM list, go to a child BoM, a parent BoM or a product's BoM components with one click, which makes multi-level bills of materials easier to maintain. Found under Manufacturing > Products > Bills of Materials.

name: mrp_bom_image
summary: Shows the product image on the BoM form, stored in three sizes. It is a small add-on that makes BoMs easier to recognise visually.

name: mrp_bom_image
summary: Shows the product image on the BoM form, stored in three sizes. It is a small add-on that makes BoMs easier to recognise visually.

name: mrp_bom_line_formula_quantity
summary: Calculates a BoM line's component quantity from a formula, such as one based on the production quantity or a custom product attribute. The formula goes in the Quantity Formula field on the BoM line. Works with the website shop when a custom attribute is used.

name: mrp_bom_line_formula_quantity
summary: Calculates a BoM line's component quantity from a formula, such as one based on the production quantity or a custom product attribute. The formula goes in the Quantity Formula field on the BoM line. Works with the website shop when a custom attribute is used.

name: mrp_bom_line_net_qty
summary: Adds net and gross quantities to BoM lines using a loss percentage. Enter the gross quantity and calculate the net, or enter the net and calculate the gross, with buttons on the BoM. Lines that differ from the theoretical values are highlighted in yellow.

name: mrp_bom_line_uom_rounding
summary: Checks BoM component quantities against the rounding of their unit of measure. For a unit measured in whole pieces, a quantity such as 0.5 is rejected when a component is added to a BoM. It prevents impossible fractional quantities.

name: mrp_bom_location
summary: Adds a Location field to BoMs and their component lines, to tell apart BoMs for the same product or to show the preferred stock locations to take parts from. The location also shows on the BoM Structure report.

name: mrp_bom_location
summary: Adds a Location field to BoMs and their component lines, to tell apart BoMs for the same product or to show the preferred stock locations to take parts from. The location also shows on the BoM Structure report.

name: mrp_bom_matrix_report
summary: Adds a BOM Matrix report under Manufacturing > Reporting, showing which components feed which parent products. It helps spot materials used across many assemblies, so you can avoid running out of them.

name: mrp_bom_note
summary: Adds a rich-text Notes tab to each BoM, for instructions or remarks that belong with the recipe. Edit it under Manufacturing > Master Data > Bill of Materials.

name: mrp_bom_order_by_product_name
summary: Sorts the BoM list by product template name, then variant name and code, instead of by sequence and ID. The sequence field is hidden because it no longer drives the order.

name: mrp_bom_priority
summary: Replaces the BoM sequence with a priority field, so the most important BoMs are shown first. The priority also decides which BoM is picked when a manufacturing order selects one.

name: mrp_bom_produce_delay
summary: Adds a Produce Delay field to BoMs, so production time is entered when the BoM is created. Changing it on the BoM also updates the product's produce delay, which works best when each product has one BoM.

name: mrp_bom_produce_delay_in_hour
summary: Shows the BoM produce delay in hours instead of days. It is a glue module that joins the BoM produce delay and the product produce delay in hours modules.

name: mrp_bom_product_price_margin
summary: Shows the BoM cost beside the product's standard price, sale price and margin on the BoM form, and highlights lines where they differ. You can update the standard price from this panel, which requires the Product Standard Margin module. Published by GRAP.

name: mrp_bom_select_product_variant
summary: When creating or editing a BoM, you pick a product variant, and the product template is filled in automatically. The BoM list and search show variants instead of templates.

name: mrp_bom_select_product_variant
summary: When creating or editing a BoM, you pick a product variant, and the product template is filled in automatically. The BoM list and search show variants instead of templates.

name: mrp_bom_simple_report
summary: Adds a simple PDF report to print one or more BoMs without extra detail. It can also be embedded in other report templates, for example to print nested BoMs for a given quantity.

name: mrp_bom_structure_report_level_1
summary: Adds a BoM Structure (Level 1) PDF report that prints only the first level of components, leaving out the sub-BoMs of each component. Print it from the Print menu on a BoM.

name: mrp_bom_structure_xlsx
summary: Exports the full BoM structure to an Excel (.xlsx) file. Use Print > Export BoM Structure to Excel on the BoM form or list.

name: mrp_bom_structure_xlsx_level_1
summary: Exports only the first level of the BoM structure to Excel (.xlsx). Select one or more BoMs and use Print / Export BoM Structure (Level 1) to Excel.

name: mrp_bom_structure_xlsx_level_1
summary: Exports only the first level of the BoM structure to Excel (.xlsx). Select one or more BoMs and use Print / Export BoM Structure (Level 1) to Excel.

name: mrp_bom_tag
summary: Adds tags to BoMs, organised in a parent and child hierarchy, so a BoM can be found by keyword. Tags are set up under Manufacturing > Configuration > BoM Tags.

name: mrp_bom_tracking
summary: Logs changes to key BoM fields, such as product, quantity, type, delays and picking type, in the chatter. Changes to the components on BoM lines are also noted there.

name: mrp_bom_tracking
summary: Logs changes to key BoM fields, such as product, quantity and type, in the chatter. Changes to the components on BoM lines are also noted there.

name: mrp_bom_version
summary: Adds Draft, Active and Historical states to BoMs, plus a New Version button that retires the current BoM and creates the next version as a draft. Activation is logged in the chatter, and a setting can let active BoMs be re-edited.

name: mrp_bom_version
summary: Adds Draft, Active and Historical states to BoMs, so a BoM can be approved for use and later retired. A setting in Manufacturing > Configuration > Settings can allow active BoMs to go back to draft for changes. Versioning uses a New Version action.

name: mrp_bom_warn_message_oca
summary: Lets you set a warning message on a BoM that appears when the BoM is used on a manufacturing order. The warning shows in the order header until the order is done or cancelled, and as a popup when the order is created by hand. Set it in the Warning section of the BoM.

name: mrp_bom_weight
summary: Calculates the net and gross weight of each component line on a BoM, and totals them for the BoM. It uses product weights and units of measure, and shows a button to adjust the BoM quantity when a weighted product differs from its components. Depends on the BoM net quantity module.

name: mrp_bom_widget_section_and_note_one2many
summary: Adds section headers and notes to the components list of a BoM, the same way they work on invoices. The lines sit on a separate page of the BoM form. Needs the Accounting app for the section and note widget.

name: mrp_bom_widget_section_and_note_one2many
summary: Adds section headers and notes to the components list of a BoM, the same way they work on invoices. The lines sit on a separate page of the BoM form. Needs the Accounting app for the section and note widget.

name: mrp_bom_widget_section_and_note_one2many
summary: Adds section headers and notes to the components list of a BoM, the same way they work on invoices. The lines sit on a separate page of the BoM form. Needs the Accounting app for the section and note widget.

name: mrp_byproduct_auto_create_lot
summary: Creates a unique lot or serial number automatically for each by-product made on a manufacturing order. It applies to products tracked by lots or serial numbers with auto create lot turned on, and it works for serial numbers too.

name: mrp_component_operation
summary: Lets you move, scrap or swap components while a manufacturing order is open. An Operate Component button lets you take a product from another location and link it to the order, using the operations set up under Manufacturing > Configuration > Settings > Component Operations.

name: mrp_component_operation_scrap_reason
summary: Adds a scrap reason code to the component operation wizard, so a component scrapped during production is recorded with a reason. It is a glue module between component operations and scrap reason codes.

name: mrp_default_workorder_time
summary: For work orders recorded with too little time, counts the projected time as fully productive when the recorded time falls below a threshold percentage (10 percent by default). Turn on Record standard projected order time in the Manufacturing settings to use it, and set the thresholds per company.

name: mrp_flattened_bom_xlsx
summary: Exports a BoM to Excel as a flattened list, with the intermediate sub-assembly levels removed so every lowest-level component appears against the top product. Units follow the product units of measure. Use Print / Export Flattened BOM to Excel on selected BoMs.

name: mrp_flattened_bom_xlsx
summary: Exports a BoM to Excel as a flattened list, with the intermediate sub-assembly levels removed so every lowest-level component appears against the top product. Units follow the product units of measure. Use Print / Export Flattened BOM to Excel on selected BoMs.

name: mrp_flattened_bom_xlsx_direct_materials_cost
summary: Adds the direct material cost to the flattened BoM Excel export. Use it when you want the material cost of a product in the same spreadsheet as its component list. Extends the flattened BoM export.

name: mrp_flattened_bom_xlsx_labour_cost
summary: Adds a labour cost tab to the flattened BoM Excel export, showing the labour cost set on each BoM. Builds on the direct material cost version of the export.

name: mrp_flattened_bom_xlsx_subcontracting_cost
summary: Adds a subcontracting cost tab to the flattened BoM Excel export, showing the subcontracting cost set on each BoM. Requires the subcontracting module and builds on the direct material cost export.

name: mrp_lot_number_propagation
summary: Carries a lot or serial number from a component over to the finished product in a batch production. It is set on the BoM, and each component line can be flagged to pass its lot number on.

name: mrp_lot_production_date
summary: Sets the production date automatically on lots and serial numbers created when a manufacturing order is validated. Products must be tracked by lot or serial number for this to apply.

name: mrp_lot_production_date
summary: Sets the production date automatically on lots and serial numbers created when a manufacturing order is validated. Products must be tracked by lot or serial number for this to apply.

name: mrp_mass_production_order
summary: Creates several manufacturing orders in one step from a wizard, under Manufacturing > Operations > Massive MRP Production Orders. You choose the components and finished products locations, and can mark the orders as done or confirmed.

name: mrp_mto_owner
summary: Passes the owner of a source manufacturing order to the new order created from a make-to-order stock rule. It is a technical link for owner-restricted stock, so the new order keeps the same owner.

name: mrp_multi_level
summary: An MRP scheduler that works out what to buy or make for each product, starting from the top of the bill of materials and going down through each level. It uses inventory, demand and supply parameters set per product and MRP area. Results appear as planned orders, which can be turned into purchase orders or manufacturing orders.

name: mrp_multi_level
summary: An MRP scheduler that works out what to buy or make for each product, starting from the top of the bill of materials and going down through each level. It uses inventory, demand and supply parameters set per product and MRP area. Results appear as planned orders, which can be turned into purchase orders or manufacturing orders.

name: mrp_multi_level_consume_safety_stock
summary: Lets the MRP planner use safety stock during busy periods, up to a chosen safety stock lead date. Until that date, stock is consumed without being rebuilt, and a resupply is created only if forecast stock would fall below zero. The date is set on the MRP area or product MRP area.

name: mrp_multi_level_estimate
summary: Feeds demand estimates from the stock demand estimate system into the MRP multi level planner. Estimates can be grouped into weekly or other day buckets with Group Days of Estimates on the product MRP area.

name: mrp_multi_level_estimate
summary: Feeds demand estimates from the stock demand estimate system into the MRP multi level planner. Estimates can be grouped into weekly or other day buckets with Group Days of Estimates on the product MRP area.

name: mrp_operating_unit
summary: Adds an operating unit to manufacturing orders created from procurement, and restricts users to the manufacturing orders whose location belongs to an operating unit they can access. Create a reordering rule for the product and run the scheduler to create an order.

name: mrp_order_report_lot
summary: Adds a Lot/SN column to the production order report and splits consumed quantities by lot for lot-tracked products. It shows on the printed production order.

name: mrp_order_report_lot_barcode
summary: Puts lot and serial number barcodes on the production order report, so manufacturing users can scan them. Products must be tracked by lot number or serial number.

name: mrp_order_report_lot_reserved
summary: Adds a Reserved column to the production order report and splits consumed quantities by lot for lot-tracked products. It combines the lot and reserved report add-ons.

name: mrp_order_report_reserved
summary: Adds a Reserved column to the production order report, showing the quantities reserved for unfinished orders. It changes the printed report only, with no new fields.

name: mrp_package_propagation
summary: Carries the package, such as a box with a label already on it, from a component over to the finished product. Enable Package Propagation on the BoM and flag the component line. The component quantity must be 1, and the order must produce exactly the BoM quantity.

name: mrp_packaging_default
summary: Uses product packagings on BoM lines in manufacturing and kits, so component packaging quantities are included by default. Turn on Product Packagings in the Inventory settings to set packagings on products and use them on BoM lines.

name: mrp_planned_order_matrix
summary: Lets planners enter fixed planned orders (a master production schedule) in a grid, with products as rows and date periods as columns. The sheets and lines are stored as MPS Sheet records, and the planned orders can be reviewed afterwards under Manufacturing > Planning.

name: mrp_product_characterisation
summary: Adds an 'Intermediate Products' flag and a 'Component' flag on products, derived from whether a product is used in a bill of materials and whether it has its own BoM. This lets users filter Bills of Materials by intermediate or component products, which is useful for bakery-style recipes where a leaven is made in-house and flour is bought.

name: mrp_product_lot_sequence
summary: Makes Manufacturing Orders use the lot or serial number sequence configured on the product when the lot sequence policy is set to product. Lot numbers generated from an MO then follow that product's own numbering instead of the standard Odoo lot numbering.

name: mrp_product_produce_delay_in_hour
summary: Adds a production lead time expressed in hours to products, next to the standard day-based field. Useful for short processes such as artisanal food production where a recipe takes hours rather than whole days. It appears on the product form.

name: mrp_production_allow_recursive
summary: Adds a company setting that allows the same product to be both a component and the finished product of a Manufacturing Order. It is switched on under Manufacturing > Configuration > Settings and removes Odoo's default block on that case.

name: mrp_production_auto_validate
summary: Automatically validates a Manufacturing Order once its 'Pick components' transfer is validated, for Bills of Materials where this is enabled. It is set per BoM and needs a warehouse using two or three step manufacturing, so the pick operation is created. It shows on the MO and the BoM.

name: mrp_production_back_to_draft
summary: Adds a button to put a confirmed or cancelled Manufacturing Order back into draft so it can be edited again. It is available from the MO form in Manufacturing.

name: mrp_production_check_bom_alignment
summary: Checks each Manufacturing Order against its current Bill of Materials and shows a warning banner on the MO when components, quantities, operations, consumed-in-operation, or by-products no longer match the BoM, for example after the BoM was edited following confirmation. Confirming a misaligned MO asks the user whether to fix it, go back, or confirm anyway.
keywords: MO out of sync with BoM

name: mrp_production_date_planned_finished
summary: Lets planners set the Scheduled End date of a Manufacturing Order first, and then calculates the Scheduled Start by subtracting the BoM manufacturing lead time. It suits long processes measured in days or weeks, and it is used on the MO form.

name: mrp_production_generator_by_date_interval
summary: Adds a Production Generator wizard under Manufacturing > Planning that creates many Manufacturing Orders at once for a product and BoM over a chosen date range, each scheduled at a chosen hour. The created MOs are listed per day afterwards.

name: mrp_production_grouped_by_product
summary: Merges make-to-order Manufacturing Orders for the same product and BoM into one order when they fall within a time window, instead of creating one MO per sales order. The window is set on the Manufacturing operation type (max hour and interval in days), and the MO quantity is increased.

name: mrp_production_location_picking_type
summary: Adds a Production Location field on Manufacturing operation types. When an MO uses that operation type, the configured location is used as its production location instead of the default. It is set under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: mrp_production_move_line_auto_fill
summary: Brings the auto-fill of move lines (filling quantities and lots automatically on operations) from stock_move_line_auto_fill into Manufacturing Orders. It adds an auto-fill operations option on the MO, so component and finished quantities can be filled in without manual entry.

name: mrp_production_note
summary: Adds a rich text Notes field on Manufacturing Orders, under a Notes tab on the MO form. Users can record instructions or comments about a production order.

name: mrp_production_note
summary: Adds a rich text Notes field on Manufacturing Orders, under a Notes tab on the MO form. Users can record instructions or comments about a production order.

name: mrp_production_picking_type_from_route
summary: When a user picks a product on a new manually created MO, the operation type is updated automatically from the routes configured on that product. This saves the user from choosing the right manufacturing operation type by hand.

name: mrp_production_putaway_strategy
summary: Applies putaway strategies to finished products of a Manufacturing Order, so that finished goods land in the bin the strategy specifies rather than the default location. The chatter notes when a putaway strategy was applied. Requires Multi-Step Routes and putaway strategies set on locations.

name: mrp_production_quant_manual_assign
summary: Lets users choose the exact stock quants (specific lots, locations, or packages) that reserve the components of a Manufacturing Order, instead of letting Odoo pick them. It is opened from the tag icon next to Reserved Quantity on a component line. Components can be marked to be consumed now.

name: mrp_production_quant_manual_assign
summary: Lets users choose the exact stock quants (specific lots, locations, or packages) that reserve the components of a Manufacturing Order, instead of letting Odoo pick them. It is opened from the tag icon next to Reserved Quantity on a component line. This variant also handles single-lot production.

name: mrp_production_serial_matrix
summary: Provides a grid on the Manufacturing Order (Serial Numbers Matrix button) for producing several units of a serial-tracked product that also consume lot or serial-tracked components. The user enters finished serial numbers and fills a matrix that assigns component lots or serials to each finished unit, with warnings for invalid picks.
keywords: assign component serials to finished serials

name: mrp_production_serial_matrix_import_xlsx
summary: Adds an Excel export and import to the serial matrix. Users download the matrix as an xlsx file, fill it in a spreadsheet, and upload it back to fill the matrix automatically. It is available from the Serial Numbers Matrix on a Manufacturing Order.

name: mrp_production_serial_matrix_queue_job
summary: Runs the validation of the serial numbers matrix as a background job through queue_job, so large matrices do not block the user's screen. The matrix behaves the same, but validation is queued.

name: mrp_production_serial_matrix_subcontracting
