summary: Adds a Serial Numbers Matrix button to subcontracting receipts for serial-tracked subcontracted products, so the component lots and serials can be filled directly from the receipt. The user who started the matrix gets a message on the receipt when processing finishes or fails.

name: mrp_production_unique_lot
summary: Stops a lot or serial number produced by one Manufacturing Order from being reused on another MO, and limits the lot picker to unused lots for lot-tracked products. It is enabled per operation type with the Force Production Lot Uniqueness option.

name: mrp_propagate_lot_info
summary: Copies selected lot fields (such as custom lot attributes) from the single lot consumed as a component into the finished product lot and into flagged by-product lots when the MO is validated. Profiles define which fields propagate, and they can be set on BoM lines or product categories. It is under Manufacturing > Configuration.
keywords: pass lot data to finished product

name: mrp_repair_order
summary: Creates a repair order from a Manufacturing Order that is done, with one repair per MO. The MO and repair order are linked by smart buttons so users can jump between them. It is useful when a produced item may need servicing later.

name: mrp_restrict_lot
summary: Carries a specific lot number from a sales order line (for example one set up for automatic lot generation) onto the Manufacturing Order that produces it. The MO then uses that lot for the finished product. It is mainly used together with sale_order_lot_generator.

name: mrp_restrict_lot
summary: Carries a specific lot number from a sales order line (for example one set up for automatic lot generation) onto the Manufacturing Order that produces it. The MO then uses that lot for the finished product. It is mainly used together with sale_order_lot_generator.

name: mrp_sale_info
summary: Shows the sales order, customer, commitment date, and customer reference on Manufacturing Orders and Work Orders, in the list and in an Extra information tab. The sales details are kept when several MOs from the same sale order line are merged. Module depends on sale_mrp and sale_stock.
keywords: which customer is this MO for

name: mrp_sale_info
summary: Shows the sales order, customer, commitment date, and customer reference on Manufacturing Orders and Work Orders. It also covers make-to-order sales, where a sale can trigger an MO automatically when stock is short. Those MOs carry the originating sale details.

name: mrp_sale_info
summary: Shows the sales order, customer, commitment date, and customer reference on Manufacturing Orders and Work Orders, in the list and in an Extra information tab. It also links MOs back to their source references. It depends only on sale_mrp.

name: mrp_stock_analytic
summary: Lets users set an analytic distribution on a Manufacturing Order so the cost of flushed components is posted to analytic accounts when the MO is completed. It depends on the OCA stock_analytic module and works when automated inventory valuation is on for the product category. It appears on the MO form.

name: mrp_stock_analytic
summary: Lets users set an analytic distribution on a Manufacturing Order and pushes it to component moves, and optionally to finished product and by-product moves when a setting is enabled. It also carries the distribution into WIP accounting entries created by the WIP Accounting wizard. It depends on the OCA stock_analytic module.

name: mrp_stock_analytic
summary: Lets users set an analytic distribution on a Manufacturing Order so the cost of flushed components is posted to analytic accounts when the MO is completed. It depends on the OCA stock_analytic module and works when automated inventory valuation is on for the product category.

name: mrp_stock_move_actual_date
summary: Extends the Actual Date feature from stock_move_actual_date to Manufacturing Orders, unbuild orders, and scraps, so the real date of these moves can be set. It is a technical bridge with no new fields visible to users.

name: mrp_stock_move_actual_date
summary: Extends the Actual Date feature from stock_move_actual_date to Manufacturing Orders, unbuild orders, and scraps, so the real date of these moves can be set. It is a technical bridge module with no new fields visible to users.

name: mrp_stock_move_line_qty_picked
summary: Shows the quantity picked on component and finished moves when they are viewed from a Manufacturing Order. It brings the picked-quantity display of stock_move_line_qty_picked into MOs. It is a display bridge with no new fields.

name: mrp_stock_owner_restriction
summary: Lets a Manufacturing Order be assigned to a specific owner (a partner whose stock is consigned or owned by a customer) and restricts component stock to that owner. It brings stock_owner_restriction into MOs, and it appears on the MO form.

name: mrp_subcontracting_bom_dual_use
summary: Lets a Bill of Materials of type Subcontracting also be used for regular in-house manufacturing, when its Allow in regular production option is ticked. Users can then manufacture the product in a normal MO with that BoM.
keywords: subcontracting BoM for in house MO

name: mrp_subcontracting_bom_dual_use
summary: Lets a Bill of Materials of type Subcontracting also be used for regular in-house manufacturing, when its Allow in regular production option is ticked. Users can then manufacture the product in a normal MO with that BoM.
keywords: subcontracting BoM for in house MO

name: mrp_subcontracting_inhibit
summary: Stops a purchase order for a subcontracted product from automatically creating a subcontracting order, so the purchase acts as a regular buy. A checkbox on the purchase line and on the Buy route (also on replenishment) controls this, for cases where the vendor sells the finished product directly. It needs Multi-Step Routes.

name: mrp_subcontracting_inhibit
summary: Stops a purchase order for a subcontracted product from automatically creating a subcontracting order, so the purchase acts as a regular buy. A checkbox on the purchase line and on the Buy route (also on replenishment) controls this, for cases where the vendor sells the finished product directly. It needs Multi-Step Routes.

name: mrp_subcontracting_partner_management
summary: When a company partner is ticked as a Subcontractor, Odoo creates its dedicated subcontracting location, receipt operation type, Buy rule, and resupply rule automatically, and archives them when the box is cleared. A Subcontractor Location Stock smart button shows stock at that partner. It requires Multi-Step Routes.

name: mrp_subcontracting_purchase_link
summary: Links a subcontracting purchase order line to the manufacturing orders it creates, so each subcontract MO shows its purchase order. A button on the purchase order opens the related subcontract MOs. It appears on purchase orders and MOs.

name: mrp_subcontracting_purchase_link
summary: Links a subcontracting purchase order line to the manufacturing orders it creates, so each subcontract MO shows its purchase order. A button on the purchase order opens the related subcontract MOs. It appears on purchase orders and MOs.

name: mrp_subcontracting_skip_no_negative
summary: Skips the negative stock block from stock_no_negative when a subcontracting receipt is validated. This is needed because Odoo moves the goods before recording the subcontractor production, so the subcontractor location would otherwise show negative stock and fail. It is a technical fix with no new fields.

name: mrp_subcontracting_skip_no_negative
summary: Skips the negative stock block from stock_no_negative when a subcontracting receipt is validated. This is needed because Odoo moves the goods before recording the subcontractor production, so the subcontractor location would otherwise show negative stock and fail. It is a technical fix with no new fields.

name: mrp_subcontracting_stock_owner_restriction
summary: Keeps subcontracting receipts consistent when the stock owner changes, by removing component detail lines whose owner no longer matches. It is a technical bridge between subcontracting and stock owner restriction, with no new fields visible to users.

name: mrp_tag
summary: Adds a multi-value Tags field to Manufacturing Orders, so users can label MOs with categories such as priority, customer type, or line. Tags are stored as a hierarchical list and can be filtered or grouped in the MO list.

name: mrp_unbuild_move_link
summary: Records, on each stock move created by an unbuild order, which stock move from the original manufacturing order it reverses. This gives a traceable link from the unbuild back to the production move. It is a technical link with no new screens.

name: mrp_unbuild_move_link
summary: Records, on each stock move created by an unbuild order, which stock move from the original manufacturing order it reverses. This gives a traceable link from the unbuild back to the production move. It is a technical link with no new screens.

name: mrp_unbuild_restore_origin
summary: Keeps the stock owner from the original MO move lines on an unbuild, and adds an option to return components to the exact source locations they were consumed from. The option is Return Components to Original Location on the unbuild order.

name: mrp_unbuild_subcontracting
summary: Creates a draft unbuild order automatically when a return of subcontracted goods is created, and validates it when the return is validated. The unbuilds are marked as subcontracted and are visible from the return picking, though they are hidden from the normal unbuild list (under Subcontracted Unbuild Orders in debug mode).

name: mrp_unbuild_valuation_layer_link
summary: Adds a Valuation button on done Unbuild Orders that opens the stock valuation layers (accounting value entries) created by that unbuild. It lets users check the cost impact of an unbuild.

name: mrp_unbuild_valuation_layer_link
summary: Adds a Valuation button on done Unbuild Orders that opens the stock valuation layers (accounting value entries) created by that unbuild. It lets users check the cost impact of an unbuild.

name: mrp_warehouse_calendar
summary: Makes Manufacturing Orders created from procurements (reordering rules, make to order) compute their planned start date using the working calendar of the warehouse, so a product needed on Monday starts on the last working day before. Manual rescheduling also counts lead time in warehouse working days. The calendar is set on the warehouse.

name: mrp_warehouse_calendar
summary: Makes Manufacturing Orders created from procurements (reordering rules, make to order) compute their planned start date using the working calendar of the warehouse, so a product needed on Monday starts on the last working day before. Manual rescheduling also counts lead time in warehouse working days. The calendar is set on the warehouse.

name: mrp_warehouse_calendar
summary: Makes Manufacturing Orders created from procurements compute their planned start date using the working schedule of the warehouse, so a product needed on Monday starts on the last working day before. Manual rescheduling also counts lead time in warehouse working days. The working schedule is assigned on the warehouse.

name: mrp_weighing
summary: Connects the weighing assistant from stock_weighing to production. Finished moves can be weighed, and a Manufacturing Order can be closed from Inventory operations (batch pickings) while the components are weighed and their lots chosen. It appears on the MO and on the weighing screens.

name: mrp_workcenter_cost
summary: Lets each product choose how workcenter cost is calculated: Effective (the real time logged on work orders, standard Odoo) or Theoretical (the planned time of the workcenter, ignoring what was actually recorded). It is set on the product form and affects production cost.

name: mrp_workcenter_dashboard
summary: Turns the Workcenter dashboard back on. Odoo removed it from Community after version 13, and this module restores the overview of work centers and their work orders under Manufacturing.

name: mrp_workcenter_hierarchical
summary: Lets work centers have a parent work center, so a plant can be organized into sections such as a department containing lines and machines. The hierarchy is set on the work center form and can be shown in up to three parent levels, configurable under Manufacturing settings.

name: mrp_workcenter_scrap_reason
summary: Restricts scrap reason codes to those assigned to the work center of the work order when scrapping from an operation. Reason codes can be given allowed work centers under Inventory > Configuration > Scrap Reason Codes.

name: mrp_workcenter_workorder_link
summary: Adds buttons that jump between a work center and its work orders, plus a list of linked work orders on the work center form. It helps shop floor users move from a machine to the jobs queued on it and back.

name: mrp_workorder_blocking_time
summary: Lets an operation require a waiting period, such as a cooling or curing step, during which the MO cannot move on. The minimum time is set in hours on the operation, and changes to the MO are blocked until it passes. Users can record an interruption reason if the step is stopped early.

name: mrp_workorder_last_worker
summary: Stores on each work order the last user who worked on it, whether or not they are still working on it. It shows the most recent operator on the work order.

name: mrp_workorder_lot_display
summary: Shows the finished lot number on the work order kanban cards, and lets users search work orders by finished lot number. It helps shop floor staff see which lot each job is making.

name: mrp_workorder_priority
summary: Adds a priority field to work orders, copied from the related Manufacturing Order. Work orders can then be sorted, filtered, and grouped by priority in the work order list and on work center overviews.

name: mrp_workorder_sequence
summary: Adds a Sequence number to work orders on a Manufacturing Order, so the steps of a routing appear in their process order. It is visible on the work orders tab of the MO.

name: mrp_workorder_sequence
summary: Adds a Sequence number to work orders on a Manufacturing Order, so the steps of a routing appear in their process order. It is visible on the work orders tab of the MO.

name: multi_pms_properties
summary: Technical module that adds multi-property support to the property management system (PMS). It applies the standard multi-company checks to the property field so that related records must belong to the same property. It adds no visible screens.

name: multi_pms_properties
summary: Technical module that adds multi-property support to the property management system (PMS). It applies the standard multi-company checks to the property field so that related records must belong to the same property. It adds no visible screens.

name: multi_step_wizard
summary: Technical base module that provides a mixin for building wizards with several steps, including a state field and an option to go back. It does nothing on its own, and developers use it to build other wizards.

name: multi_step_wizard
summary: A technical base for building wizards that move through several steps, with the option to go back to the previous step. It does nothing on its own. Developers use it to build guided multi-page dialogs in other modules.

name: multicompany_configuration
summary: Adds a configuration form that helps set up partners and products across several companies at once, storing per-company values in one place. It extends partners, products, and product categories, so a single setup screen can fill in the company-specific settings.

name: multisearch_field
summary: Lets users search several values at once in any search box by typing a leading slash and separating values with a configurable character such as a pipe or semicolon. It is configured through the multi_search_separator system parameter, and it is a technical search aid for developers and power users.

name: mute_notification_user_autosubscribe
summary: Stops users who are automatically subscribed to a document through a user field from receiving chatter notifications for it. Admins define rules under Settings > Technical > Auto Subscribe Mute, choosing the model, users, and groups, and a user can switch notifications back on for a specific document.

name: nsca_client
summary: Technical integration that sends passive check results from Odoo cron jobs to a Nagios or Shinken monitoring server via the NSCA client. Admins configure servers and checks under Configuration > Technical > NSCA Client, and the module needs send_nsca installed on the system. It is for IT monitoring, not business users.

name: nutritional_info
summary: Stores nutrition facts for each product, such as energy and fat values, with a reference quantity and unit. Users print a Nutritional Info report from the product. The types of values shown and their order are set under General Settings.

name: nutritional_info_stock_lot
summary: Lets each lot or batch of a product have its own nutrition values, which override the product values on the Nutritional Info report. A report for a lot combines lot values with the product's own data. It is set up on the lot form.

name: odoo_project
summary: Lets an organization declare its Odoo projects with the list of installed modules and see code statistics, which modules can be upgraded, modules still waiting in open pull requests, and modules in the repository that are not installed. It builds on the odoo_repository data. It is a tool for technical teams and consultants.

name: odoo_project_changelog
summary: Generates an HTML changelog for each repository used in an Odoo project, between two chosen git references, listing only the meaningful commits and leaving out translations, tests, and docs. It adds a changelog section to the project form. It is a technical tool for release notes.

name: odoo_project_migration
summary: Adds migration reports to Odoo projects, estimating the effort needed to move the project's installed modules to a newer Odoo version based on the migration data collected by odoo_repository_migration. It appears on the project form and in exported reports. It is a technical planning tool.

name: odoo_project_stat
summary: Adds two pie charts to the Odoo project form, one for the number of installed modules and one for lines of code, split into groups such as Odoo CE, Enterprise, OCA, and specific code. The split criteria can be configured. It is a visual summary for technical teams.

name: odoo_repository
summary: Base technical module that stores data scanned from Odoo and OCA repositories: module versions, branches, authors, licenses, and repositories. It also manages which Odoo versions are tracked and the access tokens used for scanning. It is the foundation for the other module composition analysis tools and has no business screens of its own.

name: odoo_repository
summary: Base technical module that stores data scanned from Odoo and OCA repositories: module versions, branches, authors, licenses, and repositories. It also manages which Odoo versions are tracked and the access tokens used for scanning. It is the foundation for the other module composition analysis tools and has no business screens of its own.

name: odoo_repository_migration
summary: Collects migration status for modules between Odoo versions (for example 16.0 to 18.0), flagging whether each module is fully ported, missing, replaced, moved to standard Odoo, or moved to OCA. Users can record what a module became in a given version through a timeline. Results appear on each module in the Migration tab under Odoo Repositories.

name: odoo_test_xmlrunner
summary: A developer add-on that runs Odoo's automated tests and produces XML test reports that continuous integration systems can read. It only changes how tests are run and reported. End users are not affected.

name: onchange_helper
summary: Technical helper that lets developers run an onchange method from Python code, so values entered by a script match what a user would get from the form. It adds no visible screens and is used by other modules and integrations.
keywords: field values as typed in form

name: onchange_helper
summary: A developer helper that runs the automatic field updates that normally happen on screen, such as filling a customer's address after choosing them, when values are set from code or import. It is a technical module with no screens of its own. Developers call it from their Python code.

name: operating_unit
summary: Adds Operating Units, which are internal divisions of a company with their own management and data separation. Admins create them under Settings > Users & Companies > Operating Units, and users are given access to specific units so that they only see that unit's records. It is the base for other OU-aware modules.

name: operating_unit
summary: Adds Operating Units, which are internal divisions of a company with their own management and data separation. Admins create them under Settings > Users & Companies > Operating Units, and users are given access to specific units so that they only see that unit's records. It is the base for other OU-aware modules.

name: operating_unit_access_all
summary: Adds a checkbox on the user form that gives a user access to all operating units for master data, without listing each unit on the user. It is set under Settings > Users & Companies > Users.

name: operating_unit_access_all
summary: Adds a checkbox on the user form that gives a user access to all operating units for master data, without listing each unit on the user. It is set under Settings > Users & Companies > Users.

name: outgoing_email_by_model
summary: Lets an administrator choose a specific outgoing mail server and sender address for each model, such as sales orders sending from a different address than invoices. The settings sit on the model record under Settings > Technical > Models, and the model must use chatter.

name: outgoing_email_by_model
summary: Sets a specific outgoing mail server and sender address for a given model, such as sending all of one app's emails from a dedicated address. You fill in the fields on the model record under Settings > Technical > Models. It applies only to models that use the chatter.

name: partner_account_multicompany_default
summary: Lets a user copy a partner's receivable and payable accounts and fiscal position from the current company to all other companies they can access, from a button on the partner's Accounting tab. This saves setting up the same partner account in each company by hand.

name: partner_accreditation
summary: Lets you record accreditations or certifications on contacts, such as an official licence. Accreditations are kept as a managed list and tagged on each partner. They show on the contact form.

name: partner_accreditation
summary: Adds an Accreditations field to contacts, where users can record official licences, certifications, or recognitions a partner holds. Accreditations are managed as a list of records and tagged on partners, under Contacts configuration.

name: partner_address_format_domestic
summary: Lets each country have a separate domestic address format, used on printed documents when the transaction is within the company's own country. The format is set on the country record under Contacts > Configuration > Countries.

name: partner_address_split
summary: Technical helper that splits a partner's street into a chosen number of shorter lines, for countries with narrow address fields on printed documents. It adds a helper method for developers and no visible screens.

name: partner_address_split
summary: Adds helper methods that split a partner's address into a chosen number of street lines. It is useful in countries where street fields have length limits or printing constraints. This is a technical developer module with no visible screens.

name: partner_address_street3
summary: Adds a third street line to contacts and addresses, so long or multi-part street addresses can be entered without squeezing them. It appears on the contact form and in address layouts.

name: partner_address_street3
summary: Adds a third street line to contact addresses. It shows on the contact form and in printed address formats. Useful when addresses need more lines.

name: partner_affiliate
summary: Adds an Affiliates tab on company contacts for holding companies and other group structures. The Contacts and Addresses tab then shows only the people linked to the company. The Affiliates tab appears only on company records.

name: partner_affiliate
summary: Adds an Affiliates tab on company contacts for holding companies and related company structures, and limits the Contacts and Addresses tab to people linked to the company. It appears on the partner form for companies only.

name: partner_aging
summary: Adds an interactive customer and supplier aging report as of any chosen date, showing each open invoice and bill and how overdue it is in buckets. It is opened from Accounting > Sales > Customer Aging or Vendors > Supplier Aging. Unapplied credits are not included.

name: partner_aging
summary: Adds an interactive customer and supplier aging report as of any chosen date, showing each open invoice and bill and how overdue it is in buckets. It is opened from Accounting > Sales > Customer Aging or Purchases > Supplier Aging. Unapplied credits are not included.

name: partner_archive_propagate
summary: Adds an Archive Contact and Children button on company contacts, which also archives the child contacts after a confirmation list. Contacts linked to active users are skipped, and unarchiving propagates back. A setting can force this when archiving outside the screen, such as through imports or automated jobs.

name: partner_archive_propagate
summary: When a company or parent contact is archived with the Archive Contact and Children button, a wizard lists its child contacts and archives them too, skipping any linked to active users. Each child records which parent caused its archiving, so unarchiving the parent restores them. A setting can also apply this to imports and automated archiving.

name: partner_auto_archive
summary: Adds an Auto Archive checkbox to contacts, and a scheduled job that archives the ticked contacts every 15 days. The schedule can be changed in Scheduled Actions under the name Contact: Archive Contacts. It appears on the partner form.

name: partner_auto_archive
summary: Adds an Auto Archive checkbox to contacts, and a scheduled job that archives the ticked contacts every 15 days. The schedule can be changed in Scheduled Actions under the name Contact: Archive Contacts. It appears on the partner form.

name: partner_bank_acc_holder_name
summary: Shows the Account Holder Name field on bank account forms, which Odoo removed from the standard view. The data was already stored, so existing values reappear. It is set on the partner's bank account.

name: partner_bank_acc_type_constraint
summary: Checks the bank account type chosen by the user against the account number, and blocks saving if the IBAN or checksum does not match the selected type. It restores an older Odoo behaviour where bad bank details raised a clear error. It appears on the bank account of a partner.

name: partner_bank_code
summary: Adds Bank Code and Bank Branch Code fields to banks, for banks that use these identifiers in payments. They are filled in under Contacts > Configuration > Bank Accounts > Bank.

name: partner_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to contacts, with a brand logo shown on the form and a brand flag on kanban cards, so partners can be grouped or filtered by brand (for example a retail chain). It depends on the brand and contacts modules.

name: partner_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to contacts, with a brand logo shown on the form and a brand flag on kanban cards, so partners can be grouped or filtered by brand (for example a retail chain). It depends on the brand and contacts modules.

name: partner_capital
summary: Adds capital details to company contacts: the country where the capital comes from, the registered capital amount and currency, and a turnover range with a company size. They are under the Sales & Purchases > Capital section of the contact, and turnover ranges are set under Contacts > Configuration.

name: partner_capital
summary: Records the capital of a company on its contact: the country the capital comes from, the registered capital amount, and a turnover range. Turnover ranges are managed under Contacts > Configuration. The fields are in the Sales & Purchases > Capital section.

name: partner_category_description
summary: Adds a Description field to contact tags, so you can explain what each tag means and when to use it. Descriptions are filled in when creating tags under Contacts > Configuration > Contact Tags.

name: partner_category_multi_company
summary: Makes contact tags (partner categories) company-specific, so each tag can belong to one company and the parent tag hierarchy is kept per company. It is a technical multi-company extension for the tags field on contacts.

name: partner_category_multi_company_account
summary: Adds a company check when matching payments with partner categories in reconciliation models, so a reconciliation model only applies within its own company. It is a technical multi-company guard.

name: partner_category_multi_company_analytic
summary: Adds a company check on partner categories used in analytic distribution models, so an analytic rule for a partner tag only applies in the matching company. It is a technical multi-company guard for analytics.

name: partner_category_security
summary: Adds separate permissions for contact tags. Publishers can change the tags on contacts, managers can create and edit tags, and the Contact Tags menu is only visible to managers. Other internal users can only read tags.

name: partner_category_security
summary: Adds security groups for contact tags. Publishers can change the tags on contacts, and Managers can also create, edit and delete tags. The Contact Tags menu is shown only to Managers.

name: partner_category_security_crm
summary: Connects the contact tag permissions to CRM so that users with Own Documents Only sales rights can read tags on contacts but not change them. It is a glue module with no new screens.

name: partner_category_type
summary: Adds a Type selection field to contact tags, so tags can be classified into groups for use by other modules. It is set on the tag record under Contacts > Configuration > Tags.

name: partner_category_type
summary: Adds a Type field to contact tags, so tags can be classified by type. Other modules can use this type to group tags or change how they behave. It appears on the contact tag form.

name: partner_classification
summary: Adds a structured Classification field to contacts, as an alternative to free tags. Classifications are created under Contacts > Configuration > Classifications, and a value set on one contact carries over to all contacts of the same commercial entity.

name: partner_company_default
summary: Sets a default company on contacts, so new contacts belong to the company you are working in. It is a base multi-company helper. It shows on the contact form.

name: partner_company_default
summary: Sets the company of a new contact to the user's company by default, which Odoo stopped doing after version 12. This keeps contacts separated by company in multi-company databases. It appears as the Company field on the contact.

name: partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to companies, which is copied to their contacts and can be searched and grouped on contacts, leads, sales orders, and invoices. It is useful for reporting on customers who belong to the same group. It depends on the accounting, CRM, and sales group bridge modules.

name: partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to companies, which is copied to their contacts and can be searched and grouped on contacts, leads, sales orders, and invoices. It is useful for reporting on customers who belong to the same group. It depends on the accounting, CRM, and sales group bridge modules.

name: partner_company_type
summary: Adds a Legal Form field to company contacts, chosen from a list of legal forms that each have a name and an abbreviation. Before this, the title field only applied to individuals, so this makes the company legal form available for companies.

name: partner_company_type
summary: Adds a Legal Entity Type field to company contacts, such as LLC or Ltd, with the list of types restricted by country and state. Admins define the types, and each company gets one type. It appears on the partner form.

name: partner_contact_access_link
summary: Adds a small button next to each contact under a company form that opens that person's full contact record. It saves going back to the contacts list to edit someone listed under a company.

name: partner_contact_access_link
summary: Adds a small button next to each sub-contact's name on a company form that opens that contact's full form. This saves navigating through Contacts to find a person. It works on any company that has sub-contacts.

name: partner_contact_address_default
summary: Lets each contact have a default delivery address, invoice address and contact person, which are picked on sales and invoice documents. An option lets you choose any partner rather than only child contacts. It is set on the contact form and in General Settings under Contact Category.

name: partner_contact_address_default
summary: Lets a contact have a default shipping address, invoice address, and default contact person, chosen from its child contacts (or any partner if the company setting Allow All Partners is enabled). These defaults appear on the contact form and are used on sales and invoices for that contact.

name: partner_contact_age_range
summary: Defines age ranges such as 18 to 25 or 26 to 35 and assigns each contact to a range based on its age, updated by a scheduled job. Age ranges are managed under Contacts > Configuration > Age Ranges. It depends on the birthdate module.

name: partner_contact_age_range
summary: Defines age ranges such as 18 to 25 or 26 to 35 and assigns each contact to a range based on its age, updated by a scheduled job. Age ranges are managed under Contacts > Configuration > Age Ranges. It depends on the birthdate module.

name: partner_contact_age_range
summary: Groups contacts into age ranges that you define, based on their computed age. A scheduled job keeps the ranges updated. Age ranges are set under Contacts > Configuration > Age Ranges.

name: partner_contact_birthdate
summary: Adds a Birthdate date field and a computed Age field on individual contacts (not companies), shown on the Personal Information tab. It is the base for other personal details modules.

name: partner_contact_birthdate
summary: Adds a Birthdate field to person contacts and computes their age from it. It is set on the contact's form when the contact is not a company. Age is updated automatically.

name: partner_contact_birthplace
summary: Adds birth city, zip, state and country fields to person contacts, in the Personal Information tab. It applies only to individuals, not companies.

name: partner_contact_department
summary: Adds a Department drop-down on contacts, with departments defined under Contacts > Configuration > Departments, and each department belongs to its own company. It appears on the contact form below Job Position. Do not install together with partner_department.

name: partner_contact_department
summary: Adds a Department field to contacts, chosen from a list you maintain under Contacts > Configuration > Departments. It sits below the Job Position field on the contact form.

name: partner_contact_gender
summary: Adds a Gender field to person contacts with Male, Female and Other options. It is set on the Personal Information tab of the contact form.

name: partner_contact_gender
summary: Adds a Gender selection field to person contacts, shown on the Personal Information tab. It is a simple personal detail field that other contact modules build on.

name: partner_contact_in_several_companies
summary: Lets one person be a contact at several companies, for example a freelancer or film crew member who works for multiple clients. Each person is either a standalone contact or attached to a standalone person, and the other positions are listed on the contact. Useful for the gig economy.

name: partner_contact_job_position
summary: Adds a Categorized Job Position field on contacts that picks from a tree of job positions defined under Contacts > Configuration > Job Positions, alongside the free text Job Position field. Useful for grouping contacts by role.

name: partner_contact_job_position
summary: Adds a Categorized Job Position field to contacts, chosen from a list of job positions you maintain. The free-text job position is still available as well. Job positions are managed under Contacts > Configuration > Job Positions.

name: partner_contact_job_position
summary: Adds a Categorized Job Position field on contacts that picks from a tree of job positions defined under Contacts > Configuration > Job Positions, alongside the free text Job Position field. Useful for grouping contacts by role.

name: partner_contact_lang
summary: Lets users change the language of a contact after it is created, which Odoo does not allow by default. A child contact takes its company's language when it has none, and changing a company's language fills it into contacts that have none. Contacts can also be searched and grouped by language.

name: partner_contact_lang
summary: Improves contact language handling: a contact with no language takes its parent company's language, and changing a company's language fills it in for contacts that have none. You can also change a contact's language after creation, and search or group contacts by language.

name: partner_contact_nationality
summary: Adds a Nationality field to person contacts, in the Personal Information tab. It is a link to a list of nationalities.

name: partner_contact_nationality
summary: Adds a Nationality field (a country link) to person contacts, shown on the Personal Information tab. It is a personal detail field for individual contacts.

name: partner_contact_personal_information_page
summary: Adds a Personal Information tab to contact forms, as a home for personal fields about people. On its own it adds no fields; it is the base that the birthdate, gender, nationality and birthplace modules build on. This is a technical base module.

name: partner_contact_personal_information_page
summary: Adds a Personal Information tab to person contacts. It has no fields of its own and exists so that other modules, such as birthdate, gender, and nationality, can place their personal details there.

name: partner_contact_role
summary: Lets a contact be given one or more business roles or responsibilities, in addition to its job position. Roles are defined under Sales > Configuration > Address Book > Partner Roles and appear in the Roles field on the contact.

name: partner_contact_role
summary: Lets a contact have one or more roles, such as a responsibility, on top of their job position. Roles are set on the contact form and managed under Sales > Configuration > Address Book > Partner Roles.

name: partner_contact_sale_info_propagation
summary: Copies the Salesperson and Sales Channel from a company to its contacts when they are created under it or when the company's values change. Contacts that already have their own value are left alone. It is used on the Sales & Purchases tab.

name: partner_contact_sale_info_propagation
summary: Copies the Salesperson and Sales Teams from a company to its contacts when they are created under it or when the company's values change. Contacts that already have their own value are left alone. It is used on the Sales & Purchases tab.

name: partner_contact_sale_info_propagation
summary: Propagates a change of Salesperson on a company down through its whole contact hierarchy, replacing the salesperson only on contacts that have none or that had the company's previous one. Contacts with their own different salesperson are not touched. It is used on the Sales & Purchases tab.

name: partner_contact_tags_in_popup
summary: Shows a contact's tags in the Contacts and Addresses pop-up form, so they can be seen without opening the full contact. It is a small display change with no new data.

name: partner_contact_type_end_user
summary: Adds an End User option to the address type of a partner, so end customer addresses can be recorded separately from the ordering customer. It appears on the address type field of contacts.

name: partner_contact_type_end_user
summary: Adds an End User address type for partner addresses, used to record end customers linked to the ordering company. Pick it as the address type on a contact's address.

name: partner_contract_anniversary
summary: Adds a Contracts tab on customer and contact records showing the first contract start date and the contract anniversary date for the current year. Users can filter contacts by anniversary date, which helps plan renewals and customer outreach.

name: partner_country_lang
summary: Adds a language setting on each country, so that when a contact's country is set, its language is filled in automatically (for example France gives French). Countries are set under Contacts > Configuration > Countries, and the language must be installed first.

name: partner_country_lang
summary: Sets a language on each country, and that language is filled in automatically when a contact is given that country. For example, choosing France sets French on the contact. The country language is set under Contacts > Configuration > Countries.

name: partner_country_state_required
summary: Makes the State field required on contacts whose country has federal states, based on the State Required setting on the country. It is a validation aid on the contact form.

name: partner_country_state_required
summary: Makes the state or province field mandatory on contact addresses for countries that have federal states. Users cannot save an address in such a country without choosing a state. It is set through the country settings and applies on the contact form address section.

name: partner_data_vies_populator
summary: When a company's VAT number is entered, fetches the company's name and address from the EU VIES VAT service and fills them into the contact, with the last address line split into city and zip. It is useful for creating EU business customers from their VAT number. It depends on base_vat.

name: partner_deduplicate_acl
summary: Lets users other than sales settings managers run the contact deduplication tool by adding new permission groups. An admin sets a user's deduplication level (manual or automatic) in the user's access rights. The tool is found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_acl
summary: Gives separate Deduplicate Contacts permissions, Manually or Automatically, to chosen users, so they can run the deduplication tool without being Sales settings managers. It is set on the user under Access Rights, and the tool is at Contacts > Tools > Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_by_ref
summary: Adds Reference as a criterion for finding duplicate contacts in the Deduplicate Contacts tool, so contacts sharing the same internal reference are proposed as duplicates. It is ticked in the search criteria of that tool.

name: partner_deduplicate_by_ref
summary: Adds the contact Reference field as a criterion the deduplication wizard can use to find duplicate contacts. Users tick Reference in the search section of the wizard. Found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_by_website
summary: Adds the contact Website field as a criterion the deduplication wizard can use to find duplicate contacts. Users tick Website in the search section of the wizard. Found under Contacts, Tools, Deduplicate Contacts.

name: partner_deduplicate_filter
summary: Lets the Deduplicate Contacts tool skip certain records, such as companies, individual contacts, or contacts with or without a parent company. These exclusions are ticked in the Exclude contacts having section of the tool.

name: partner_deduplicate_filter
summary: Lets the deduplication wizard leave some contacts out of the search. Users can exclude individuals or companies, or contacts with or without a parent company. The options appear in the Exclude contacts having section of the wizard.

name: partner_delivery_info
summary: Adds a Delivery Indications list (named notes such as gate code or leave at reception) that can be set on a customer and sent to the carrier with deliveries. The indication is set on the customer contact.

name: partner_delivery_schedule
summary: Lets a customer have delivery days and hours set, such as Monday to Friday 9 to 12, which are kept on the customer and managed under Sales > Configuration > Delivery Schedule. It uses the delivery module, and this version depends on stock_delivery.

name: partner_delivery_schedule
summary: Lets a customer have delivery days and hours set, such as Monday to Friday 9 to 12, which are kept on the customer and managed under Sales > Configuration > Delivery Schedule. This variant depends on the delivery module.

name: partner_delivery_zone
summary: Assigns a delivery zone code to each customer, and copies it onto sales orders, pickings, and stock moves so that deliveries can be grouped and searched by zone. Zones are created under Contacts > Configuration > Delivery Zones. Used in sales and inventory views.

name: partner_delivery_zone
summary: Assigns a delivery zone code to each customer, and copies it onto sales orders, pickings, and stock moves so that deliveries can be grouped and searched by zone. Zones are created under Contacts > Configuration > Delivery Zones. Used in sales and inventory views.

name: partner_delivery_zone_calendar
summary: Adds a working calendar to each delivery zone, so zones can have their own resource schedule. It is a technical extension of the delivery zone with no extra screens of its own.

name: partner_delivery_zone_weighing
summary: Shows the customer's delivery zone on the cards in the weighing assistant, so the person weighing a shipment can see where it goes. It bridges stock weighing and delivery zones.

name: partner_department
summary: Adds Department as a type of contact record. A department is a real partner that contacts can belong to, and it has a Members smart button and a list of its contacts. It can then be chosen as the partner on documents such as sales orders, and it is not compatible with partner_contact_department.

name: partner_disable_gravatar
summary: Stops Odoo from querying gravatar.com for a profile picture whenever an email address is typed on a contact. It stops email addresses being sent to an outside service, and it is a privacy setting with no screens.
keywords: stop sending emails to third party

name: partner_disable_gravatar
summary: Turns off Odoo's automatic lookup of contact pictures on gravatar.com when an email address is entered. This stops email addresses from being sent to a third party service. It is a technical behaviour change with no setting of its own.

name: partner_display_name_line_break
summary: Changes the layout of printed reports so that a company name and the contact name appear on separate lines in the address block. It affects how partner names look on printed documents such as invoices.
keywords: company and contact on separate lines

name: partner_display_name_line_break
summary: Changes the layout of printed reports so that a company name and the contact name appear on separate lines in the address block. It affects how partner names look on printed documents such as invoices.
keywords: company and contact on separate lines

name: partner_duns
summary: Adds a DUNS number field to contacts, the Dun and Bradstreet unique identifier for a business. It also shows which other partner has the same DUNS number, to help spot duplicates.

name: partner_duns
summary: Adds a DUNS number field to contacts, the nine-digit business identifier from Dun and Bradstreet. It also shows other contacts that share the same DUNS number. The field is on the contact form.

name: partner_email_check
summary: Checks the email address on contacts for valid format, converts it to lowercase, and can block duplicate addresses and check that the email domain exists. These checks are switched on under company settings. Requires the Python package email-validator.

name: partner_email_check
summary: Checks and cleans contact email addresses. Addresses are converted to lowercase and can be checked for valid syntax, unique use across contacts, and whether the domain can receive mail. These checks are switched on in Settings and need the email-validator Python package.

name: partner_email_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same email address, so possible duplicates are spotted early. Users can then merge the records with the Action > Merge wizard. Other contacts that are parent or child of this one are not flagged.

name: partner_email_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same email address, so possible duplicates are spotted early. Users can then merge the records with the Action > Merge wizard. Other contacts that are parent or child of this one are not flagged.

name: partner_email_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same email address. This helps spot duplicate contacts before they are merged using the partner merge wizard. The banner appears on the contact form only.

name: partner_employee_quantity
summary: Adds an employee count to company contacts and groups it into named size ranges such as 10 to 50 employees. Ranges are managed under Contacts, Configuration. The fields appear on company contact forms.

name: partner_employee_quantity
summary: Records the number of employees of a company contact, and groups it into configurable ranges such as 1 to 10 or 11 to 50. The fields appear for companies under Employee quantity, and ranges are set under Contacts > Configuration.

name: partner_event
summary: Links contacts to the events they registered for through a smart button, and lets users search contacts by event attendance. Event registrations can create or update contacts automatically when the event option Create Partners in registration is ticked, and several contacts can be registered at once from the contact list. It depends on the events module.

name: partner_event
summary: Links contacts to the events they registered for through a smart button, and lets users search contacts by event attendance. Event registrations can create or update contacts automatically when the event option Create Partners in registration is ticked, and several contacts can be registered at once from the contact list. It depends on the events module.

name: partner_external_map
summary: Adds Map and Route buttons on a contact form that open the contact's address in an external map service such as Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Bing, Here, or MapQuest. Each user picks their preferred map site and starting address in their preferences.

name: partner_external_map
summary: Adds Map and Route buttons to the contact form that open the address in an online map. Each user picks a preferred map site and a start address for routes in their preferences. Supported sites include Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Bing Maps, Here Maps and MapQuest.

name: partner_fax
summary: Adds a Fax field to the contact form so the fax number can be stored with each contact. It is a simple extra field next to the other phone details.

name: partner_firstname
summary: Splits the name of individual contacts into separate first name and last name fields. The full name is filled in automatically, and the order of names is set in General Settings. A Recalculate names button updates existing contacts after a change.

name: partner_firstname
summary: Splits person contacts into separate First Name and Last Name fields, while the full Name is built automatically from them. If someone types only the full name, Odoo tries to split it using the pattern chosen in General Settings. Existing names can be recalculated with a button.

name: partner_firstname_auth_signup
summary: Links the first name and last name split to the customer sign-up form, so people registering on the website enter their names separately. It is a glue module that only installs when both sign-up and the first and last name feature are present.

name: partner_firstname_portal
summary: Lets logged-in portal customers edit their own first and last name from their account page. It is a glue module that works when both the portal and the first and last name feature are installed.

name: partner_identification
summary: Lets a contact or company hold several identification numbers, such as commercial register, VAT ID, fiscal ID, membership number, or driver licence, each with the issuing body and validity dates. ID types are configured under Contacts > Configuration > Partner ID Categories, and an optional Python check can validate each type. The numbers appear on an ID Numbers tab.

name: partner_identification
summary: Adds an ID Numbers tab on contacts to record identification numbers such as commercial register, VAT or driver license numbers. Each number has a type, issuer, place and validity dates. ID types are set up under Contacts, Configuration, Partner ID Categories.

name: partner_identification_eori
summary: Adds an EORI number as a category in the contact identification numbers feature. EORI is the EU customs identifier for traders. It is a small add-on that only adds the category.

name: partner_identification_eori
summary: Adds an EORI number category to the partner ID types, used for EU customs identification of traders. The number is then recorded on the ID Numbers tab of a contact.

name: partner_identification_gln
summary: Adds GLN and GCP ID categories for GS1 identifiers, so a contact can store its Global Location Number and company prefix on the ID Numbers tab. GLNs are checked as valid EAN-based numbers, and GCP values must be 1 to 12 digits.

name: partner_identification_gln
summary: Adds a GLN (Global Location Number) category to the contact identification numbers feature. GLN is the GS1 code that identifies a business location. It is a small add-on that only adds the category.

name: partner_identification_gln
summary: Adds a GLN ID category for GS1 Global Location Numbers, so a contact can store its GLN on the ID Numbers tab. It is the older variant that handles GLN only, without the company prefix.

name: partner_identification_import
summary: Lets imported business documents, such as e-invoices in UBL format, match the right contact using an extra identification number, for example the buyer's GLN or company ID. It connects the document import tool to partner identification numbers. It is a technical bridge for EDI-style imports.

name: partner_identification_unique_by_category
summary: Lets an administrator require that ID numbers are unique within a chosen ID category, so the same number cannot be saved on two contacts. The option is set on each ID category. It extends the Partner Identification Numbers feature.

name: partner_industry_parent
summary: Adds a parent and child structure to partner industries, so an industry can sit under a broader one such as Technology under Services. Full industry names show the path. It is a base change to the industry list used on contacts.

name: partner_industry_secondary
summary: Adds secondary industries to contacts, so one contact can belong to several sectors alongside its main industry. It can also turn on industries for individuals, not just companies. Industries are managed under Contacts, Configuration.

name: partner_industry_secondary
summary: Adds a Secondary Industries field next to the main industry on contacts, and lets industries be organised in a hierarchy. Industries are managed under Contacts > Configuration > Industries, and individuals can be given industries through a setting.

name: partner_interest_group
summary: Adds an Interest Groups multi-select to contacts, with configurable groups that record what a partner cares about, such as advocacy topics or events. It helps organisations group contacts by topic for outreach. Groups are managed under Contacts configuration.

name: partner_interest_group
summary: Adds an Interest Group field to contacts where users tag what each partner is interested in. The groups are configurable by the user. Useful for grouping and reaching partners by topic, such as advocacy or events.

name: partner_invoicing_mode
summary: Base module that adds an Invoicing Mode setting to customers, such as Standard or a special schedule, with a Next Invoice Date. A scheduled action generates standard invoices, grouping sales orders by company, customer, currency, and payment term. Other modules add At Shipping, Monthly, and Weekly modes on top of it.

name: partner_invoicing_mode
summary: Technical base module that adds an Invoicing Mode to customer contacts, with a standard default, and a way to generate invoices automatically on a schedule for standard customers. Sales orders are grouped by company, invoiced partner, currency and payment term, and a Next Invoice Date appears on the contact. Other modules build on it to offer at-shipping, weekly and monthly invoicing.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_at_shipping
summary: Lets a customer be set to invoice at shipping, so an invoice is created automatically when the goods are delivered. The option is on the customer's Invoicing Mode and can be combined with a one-invoice-per-shipping option. It is part of the partner invoicing mode family.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_at_shipping
summary: Lets a customer be set to invoicing At Shipping, so their invoice is created and validated automatically when goods are delivered. A One Invoice Per Shipping option also exists, but it does not work with this mode. The mode is set on the customer contact and the sales order.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_at_shipping
summary: Lets a customer be set to invoice at shipping, so an invoice is created automatically when the goods are delivered. A delay in days can be set on the customer to wait after shipping before invoicing (0 means immediately). It is part of the partner invoicing mode family.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_cash_on_delivery
summary: Lets a payment mode be marked as cash on delivery, so that when the goods are delivered an invoice is created for the amount the driver collects. These invoices can be identified on the delivery, and can optionally be posted straight away. It appears on payment modes and on pickings.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_monthly
summary: Lets a customer be set to monthly invoicing, so their sales are invoiced automatically once a month. The invoicing day is set in the company settings. The mode is chosen on the customer contact.

name: partner_invoicing_mode_monthly
summary: Adds a Monthly invoicing mode for customers, so their sales are invoiced automatically once a month on a chosen day set in the company settings. It is part of the partner invoicing mode family.

name: partner_is_company_auth_signup
summary: Asks people who register on the website whether they are an individual or a company. The answer is saved on their contact. It extends the customer sign-up form.

name: partner_iterative_archive
summary: Archives all child contacts automatically when their parent contact is archived, following the hierarchy down. It works without any screens or settings.

name: partner_iterative_archive
summary: Archives all child contacts automatically when their parent contact is archived, following the hierarchy down. It works without any screens or settings.

name: partner_label
summary: Lets users tick contacts and print address labels for them. Label size, padding, and margins are set in General Settings under Labels configuration, with a preview before printing. It suits sticker sheets for mailings.

name: partner_label
summary: Prints address labels for selected contacts. Label width, height, margins and paper format are set per company under General Settings, with a preview button to check the layout before printing.

name: partner_last_invoice_date
summary: Adds Last Invoice Date and Last Bill Date fields to contacts, based on posted invoices and bills. It helps spot contacts that have stopped buying or that are no longer active. The fields appear on the contact form.

name: partner_lastname_uppercase
summary: Converts the last name of person contacts to uppercase whenever they are created or changed, when the setting is on. A server action can convert existing last names once, and that step cannot be undone. It depends on the first and last name module.

name: partner_lastname_uppercase
summary: Converts the last name of person contacts to uppercase whenever they are created or changed, when the setting is on. A server action can convert existing last names once, and that step cannot be undone. It depends on the first and last name module.

name: partner_manual_rank
summary: Lets users mark a contact as a customer or a supplier by hand, which Odoo otherwise sets automatically from invoices. A system setting turns off Odoo's automatic customer and supplier ranking so manual flags stay as entered. The flags can be used in filters.

name: partner_manual_rank
summary: Restores the older Odoo option to tick a contact as a Customer or a Supplier by hand, instead of relying only on invoice history. The two checkboxes can then be used in filters and searches. They appear on the contact form.

name: partner_match_or_create
summary: Technical helper used by the donation and stay API modules. It finds an existing contact by the details provided (such as email or phone) or creates a new one, so that external systems do not create duplicate contacts. It has no screens of its own.

name: partner_middlename
summary: Adds a Middle Name field to person contacts, so names are entered as first, middle, and last name fields. The full name is built from them, in an order chosen under Partner Names Order in General Settings. It cannot be used together with the second last name module.

name: partner_middlename
summary: Adds a Middle Name field so individual contacts can have first, middle and last names entered separately. The full name is built from the three parts, in an order chosen in General Settings. It cannot be installed with the second last name module.

name: partner_mobile
summary: Adds a Mobile phone field back to contacts. The standard Odoo field was dropped in version 19, and this module restores it on the contact form.

name: partner_mobile_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same mobile number. Numbers are put in standard format first, so matches are reliable. It helps spot duplicates before using the partner merge wizard.

name: partner_mobile_duplicate_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on a contact form when another contact has the same mobile number, so duplicates are spotted early. Mobile numbers are reformatted to international format when entered, which makes matches reliable. Users can merge the records with the Action > Merge wizard.

name: partner_mobile_validation
summary: Formats the mobile number of a contact into international format as it is typed, based on the contact's country. It joins the mobile field module with the standard phone validation module.

name: partner_multi_company
summary: Lets each contact be assigned to chosen companies on the Sales & Purchases tab, so it is only visible in those companies. An empty selection means the contact is visible in all companies. Bank accounts also take the company list.

name: partner_multi_company
summary: Lets each contact be assigned to chosen companies on the Sales & Purchases tab, so it is only visible in those companies. An empty selection means the contact is visible in all companies.
keywords: companies a contact is used in

name: partner_multi_relation
summary: Lets users record relationships between contacts, such as is assistant of, is sibling of, or has contract with, with names for both directions. Relationship types can limit which kinds of contact can be linked, and relations can have start and end dates. Relations are managed under Contacts > Relations.

name: partner_multi_relation
summary: Lets users record relationships between contacts, such as assistant of, sibling of or has contract with. Relation types, with optional start and end dates and limits on contact types, are set under Contacts, Relations. Each contact gets a list of its relations.

name: partner_multi_relation_archive_propagate
summary: When a company is archived, also archives the partners linked to it through relation types marked Propagate archive, skipping those with active users and noting them on the company. Unarchiving restores them. It requires partner relations and archive propagation.

name: partner_multi_relation_archive_propagate
summary: When a company is archived, contacts linked to it by relation types marked Propagate archive are archived too, unless they have active users. Those contacts are restored when the company is unarchived. Relations with propagation switched off are not affected.

name: partner_multi_relation_function
summary: Lets a relation between two contacts carry its own job function, so a person can be a CEO at one company and a volunteer at another. The function shows in the relation's display name. Only relation types set to allow functions can use it.

name: partner_multi_relation_function
summary: Lets a relationship between two contacts carry a function, so one person can have different roles in different organisations, such as CEO in one company and volunteer in another. The function is shown in the relationship name. It extends the partner relations module.

name: partner_noncommercial
summary: Adapts the contact screens for non-commercial organisations by renaming companies to organisations and changing related wording. It also adds filters often used by such groups, such as related organisation, responsible user and organisation type. Useful for charities, associations and similar bodies.

name: partner_phone_extension
summary: Adds a Phone Extension field to contacts, to record the internal extension of a phone number. It appears on the contact form next to the phone.

name: partner_phone_secondary
summary: Adds a second phone number field to contacts. It is a simple extra field on the contact form for an alternative number.

name: partner_phonecall_schedule
summary: Records the days and hours when each contact expects phone calls, using schedules. The contact's Phone calls tab shows whether now is a good time to call and a combined timetable. A filter lists the contacts that can be called right now.

name: partner_phonecall_schedule
summary: Records the days and times when each contact is happy to receive calls, using resource schedules. A readonly flag on the contact shows whether it is a good time to call now, and a filter lists contacts that are available to call. It appears on a Phone calls tab of the contact form.

name: partner_pricelist_search
summary: Lets users search contacts by their pricelist. The pricelist form gets a Customers smart button that lists the contacts using that pricelist. It is useful for finding who is on a given price list.

name: partner_pricelist_search
summary: Adds a search by price list on contacts, and a Customers smart button on each price list showing the contacts that use it. It helps find which customers are on a given price list.

name: partner_pricelist_tracking
summary: Logs changes to a contact's pricelist, including automatic changes made when the country or state changes. This gives a record of who or what changed the price list so users can check and correct it. It is set up from the contact form and the chatter.

name: partner_priority
summary: Adds a priority level to contacts, used to rank customers or to flag how sensitive an account is. Priority levels are defined under Contacts, Configuration, Priorities, and set on the contact form.

name: partner_property
summary: Lets administrators define extra custom fields, through Odoo properties, for company contacts and for person contacts separately. Users fill them in on the contact form using the Add a Property option above the tabs. It is a way to add fields without developer work.
keywords: different fields for company and person

name: partner_property
summary: Lets administrators add custom fields, called properties, to contacts, with one set for companies and another for individuals. Properties can be shown on kanban cards. They are created from the contact form using the properties control.

name: partner_prospect
summary: Marks contacts that have never bought anything as Prospects, so they can be told apart from current customers. A contact stops being a prospect once it has a confirmed sale order or a customer invoice, and draft or cancelled quotations do not count. The flag is a checkbox on the contact record.

name: partner_purchase_manager
summary: Adds a Purchase Manager user field to contacts, showing which internal user handles purchasing for that contact. It sits on the Sales and Purchase tab of the contact form.

name: partner_quality_log
summary: Adds a Qualification Log tab to contacts where users rate value for money, service, and attention given. Each save records the average as a partner quality score in a history with date and the user who rated. It is useful for tracking supplier or customer satisfaction.

name: partner_rank_commercial_entity
summary: Combines customer and supplier ranks for all contacts that belong to the same commercial entity, so the rank is shared at the company level. A company and its contacts are treated as one relationship. It is a background change to how ranks are calculated.

name: partner_rank_single
summary: Stops a contact from being both a customer and a supplier at the same time. Attempts to set both are blocked with an error message. It is a validation rule on the contact record.

name: partner_readonly_security
summary: Adds a Partner edition permission that users can be switched off, so they can view contacts without creating, changing or deleting them. It is set on each user's access rights.

name: partner_ref_unique
summary: Lets each company require that contact reference numbers are unique, either for all contacts or only for companies. The option is set under Settings, Companies, in the Partners section. Duplicate references are then blocked.

name: partner_repair_button
summary: Adds a Repairs smart button on each contact that opens the repair orders linked to that contact, with a count. It makes it quick to see a customer's repair history.

name: partner_restrict_payment_acquirer
summary: Lets a customer be given a short list of allowed online payment providers on the Sales & Purchases tab. In the customer portal, only those providers appear when that customer pays an invoice. An empty list allows all providers.

name: partner_risk_insurance
summary: Adds a Credit Insurance tab on customers to record the credit insurer, policy, insured credit limit and coverage percentage. Invoices can be marked as insured by a credit policy, and a wizard lists invoices sorted by risk. It is meant for businesses that insure customer debt.

name: partner_risk_insurance_product_sticker_invoice_report
summary: Prints an insurance company logo as a sticker on customer invoices when the invoice is covered by credit insurance. The sticker is set up per insurer and per insured state. It appears on the printed invoice report.

name: partner_sale_pivot
summary: Adds a Sales Analysis smart button on the customer form. It opens a pivot of that customer's sales with products in rows and confirmation dates in columns, and it is only shown to users with sales access rights.

name: partner_sale_pivot
summary: Adds a Sales Analysis smart button on customer forms that shows that customer's sales, grouped by product in rows and confirmation dates in columns. The button only appears for users in the sales access groups. It gives a quick sales history view without leaving the customer record.

name: partner_salesperson_propagate
summary: When the salesperson of a company is changed, the new salesperson is copied to all its child contacts. It keeps the account owner consistent across a company and its contacts.

name: partner_salesperson_propagate
summary: When the salesperson of a company is changed, the new salesperson is copied to all its child contacts. It keeps the account owner consistent across a company and its contacts.

name: partner_search_alias
summary: Adds a Search Alias field to contacts for unofficial names or nicknames, so a contact can be found by a name people actually use. The field appears on the form after the reference field.

name: partner_search_alias
summary: Adds a Search Alias field to contacts for alternative or unofficial names, such as nicknames or trading names. The alias can be searched, so a contact is found by any of its known names. The field sits under the reference field on the form.

name: partner_second_lastname
summary: Adds a second last name field for individual contacts, used in countries that record two surnames. When a full name is typed in, the module tries to split it into first name, last name and second last name. It extends the first and last name feature.

name: partner_second_lastname
summary: Adds a second last name field for person contacts, for countries where two surnames are used. A typed full name is split into first, last, and second last name using the pattern chosen in General Settings. It extends the first and last name module.

name: partner_shipping_policy
summary: Adds a shipping policy setting to contacts, which sets how deliveries are grouped on sales orders. Sales orders take the value from the delivery address contact, then the main contact, then a company default. The field is on the Sales and Purchase tab.

name: partner_shipping_policy
summary: Adds a Shipping Policy to each customer, on the Sales & Purchases tab, which sets the default for new sales orders. It uses the delivery address contact's policy first, then the main contact's, then the company default. It extends sales with stock.
keywords: ship as soon as available customer

name: partner_socialmedia
summary: Adds fields on contacts for social media and chat profiles, such as Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, and Skype. It is a simple place to save those links on the contact form.

name: partner_stage
summary: Adds lifecycle stages to contacts, such as Draft, Active and Inactive, shown as a clickable status bar at the top of the contact form. Each stage can map to a related state. Stages are set up under Contacts, Configuration.

name: partner_stage
summary: Adds lifecycle stages to contacts, such as Draft, Active, and Inactive, shown in a stage bar at the top of the contact form. Stages can be changed by clicking the bar, and each stage links to a simple state. It is a way to set up a contact approval or lifecycle workflow.

name: partner_stage_only_confirmed
summary: Limits the contact pickers on forms to confirmed contacts only, so draft contacts do not show up in drop-downs. It applies automatically once installed and is set up under Configuration. It depends on partner stages.

name: partner_statement
summary: Prints customer and vendor statements from the contact list, in three styles: Activity (transactions in a date range with the opening balance), Detailed Activity (with prior and ending balances), and Outstanding (all unpaid items at a date). Aging buckets can be shown, and Excel versions are included. Users need Invoicing rights and the options are in Invoicing settings.

name: partner_statement
summary: Prints customer and vendor statements from the contact list, in three styles: Activity (transactions in a date range with the opening balance), Detailed Activity (with prior and ending balances), and Outstanding (all unpaid items at a date). Aging buckets can be shown, and Excel versions are included. Users need Billing rights and the options are in Invoicing settings.

name: partner_store
summary: Adds a Store option to the contact type selector, for contacts that represent a store or shop location. The type is chosen with the radio buttons at the top of the contact form.

name: partner_street_city_search
summary: Adds a street search that matches the street, second street line and city fields together. Users can find a contact by typing part of an address in the contact search bar. It extends the normal contact search.

name: partner_street_number
summary: Splits the street of an address into street name, street number, and extra number using a pattern set per country, and rebuilds the street from those parts. Users can enter the parts separately, and a wizard can split or rebuild existing partners in bulk. It is useful where street numbers need their own fields.

name: partner_subject_to_vat
summary: Adds an Is subject to VAT checkbox on company contacts to record whether the company is liable for VAT. It is a simple flag on the contact form.

name: partner_subject_to_vat
summary: Adds a checkbox on contacts to record whether the company is subject to VAT. It gives a clear yes or no for VAT status on the contact record.

name: partner_supplier_ref
summary: Adds a Supplier Reference field to contacts so users can store the reference or code that a supplier uses for them. The field is on the contact record.

name: partner_supplier_ref_sequence
summary: Fills in the Supplier Reference automatically from a numbering sequence when a new supplier is created. Suppliers are told apart from customers using the manual rank feature. It saves typing a code for each new vendor.

name: partner_supplierinfo_smartbutton
summary: Adds a Products Supplied button to a vendor's contact form. Clicking it lists the products that vendor supplies, based on the vendor pricelists set on the products. It is found on the vendor contact under Contacts or Purchase > Orders > Vendors.

name: partner_supplierinfo_smartbutton
summary: Adds a Products Supplied smart button on each vendor, which opens the list of products that vendor supplies. The vendor's products come from the Purchase tab of each product.

name: partner_survey
summary: Adds a Surveys smart button on contacts that lists the survey answers from that contact, and a filter that finds contacts by their survey answers. Company-level survey counts are also shown.

name: partner_survey
summary: Adds a Surveys smart button on contacts that lists survey answers from that contact, and a filter that finds contacts by their answers. It also lets users share a survey with one or many contacts from a wizard, from the contact form or the list view.

name: partner_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval workflow for new company contacts. A new company stays archived and in a To Approve stage until an approver signs it off, and the approval rules come from tier definitions. Users can send a contact for approval from the contact form.

name: partner_tier_validation
