summary: Puts new company contacts through an approval step before they can be used. Each new company is kept archived in a Draft stage until it is approved, and a change to Is Company or Parent sends it for approval again. It requires the stages module with the default stage set to To Approve.

name: partner_time_to_pay
summary: Shows on the Sales & Purchases tab of a contact how many days its customers take to pay, and how many days it takes to pay its vendors, averaged over last year, this year, and lifetime. It also adds a Payment Date to invoices, taken from the full reconciliation date.

name: partner_time_to_pay
summary: Shows on the Sales & Purchases tab of a contact how many days its customers take to pay, and how many days it takes to pay its vendors, averaged over last year, this year, and lifetime. It also adds a Payment Date to invoices, taken from the full reconciliation date.

name: partner_title
summary: Adds a Title field to person contacts, such as Mr, Ms, or Dr, with the list maintained under Settings > Technical > Contact Titles. Titles are only for people, not companies. It restores a field dropped from core in version 19.

name: partner_title_active
summary: Lets administrators archive contact titles such as Mr or Mrs instead of deleting them. Archived titles are hidden from new contacts but kept on existing ones. It is a base change to the titles list.

name: partner_title_contacts
summary: Adds a Contact Titles menu under Contacts > Configuration, so titles from the partner title module can be managed from the Contacts app. It is a small menu bridge.

name: partner_title_order
summary: Adds a sequence to contact titles so they are listed in a chosen order rather than alphabetically. It is a small base change to the titles list.

name: partner_type_base
summary: Technical base module that adds flags to contacts for address types, such as whether a contact is an individual, whether its address is read only, and whether it can be a parent or child. Other modules use these flags to build custom address types. It has no screens of its own.

name: partner_tz
summary: Shows the time zone field on the contact form and adds helper functions for working with time zones. Users can see and set the time zone for each contact. It is a base and display change with no new workflow.

name: partner_tz
summary: Shows the Timezone field on the contact form and provides helper functions for time zones for developers. It has no default timezone set on contacts.

name: partner_uom_mapping
summary: Adds a table under Contacts > Configuration > Product UoM that maps Odoo units of measure to the unit names used by each partner, such as a supplier that writes Box for Carton. It is useful when exchanging data with suppliers or customers that use their own unit names.

name: partner_usps_address_validation
summary: Adds a Validate button on US contacts that checks the address against the USPS address database and replaces it with the standard format, including the full nine digit ZIP code. A validation date is recorded on the contact. It needs USPS API credentials in settings.

name: partner_utm_source
summary: Adds a UTM Source field to contact records, so you can record where a contact came from, such as a marketing campaign or ad. You can also group the contacts list by that source. The field shows on the contact form and in the contacts list view.

name: partner_vat_unique
summary: Stops two customers or suppliers from being saved with the same VAT (tax ID) number. Empty VAT fields are not treated as duplicates, so contacts without a VAT can be saved freely. The check runs when a contact is saved on the contact form.

name: partner_vat_unique
summary: Stops two customers or suppliers from having the same VAT number. Empty VAT fields are not treated as duplicates. The rule is switched on in Settings.

name: password_security
summary: Lets an administrator set company-wide password rules: minimum length, required lowercase, uppercase, numbers and special characters, password expiry in days, and password history. The rules are set under General Settings in the Password Policy section and are enforced on users of that company at their next password change.

name: password_security
summary: Sets company-wide password rules, including expiry in days, minimum length, required lowercase, uppercase, numbers and special characters, and password history. The rules apply on each user's next password change. They are configured in General Settings under the Password Policy section.

name: payment_partner
summary: Lets you restrict specific online payment providers to chosen customers. Mark a provider as not global, then pick which partners can use it, and it appears only for those contacts. Set up on the payment provider form and the contact form.

name: payment_require_legal
summary: Requires customers to accept your legal terms before they can pay through the online payment form, for example from a quotation sent to the portal. The acceptance is stored on the payment transaction. Customers see the terms checkbox on the payment step of the quotation.

name: payment_sequra
summary: Adds SeQura as an online payment provider, using its checkout to take payment on orders. Customers are redirected to SeQura's checkout, and the payment is recorded as a transaction in Odoo. It is set up on the Payment Providers form with the SeQura merchant ID and account keys.

name: payment_worldline
summary: Adds Worldline as an online payment provider, a French provider covering several European countries. Once it is set up with its PSP ID and API keys, customers can pay online through Worldline on quotations, invoices and the portal. It is configured on the Payment Providers form.

name: payroll
summary: Manages employee payroll: salary structures, salary rules, payslips, payslip batches and contribution registers. A default salary structure can be set on the company and overridden per employee, and new contracts are pre-filled with it. Used from the Payroll app, and payroll fields appear on the Employee and Contract forms.

name: payroll
summary: Manages employee payroll: salary structures, salary rules, payslips, payslip batches and contribution registers. Payslips are computed for each employee from their contract versions. Used from the Payroll app, with payroll fields on the Employee form and in settings.

name: payroll
summary: Manages employee payroll: salary structures, salary rules, payslips, payslip batches and contribution registers, driven by employee contracts. Leave types get a payroll code so time off can flow into payslip calculations. Used from the Payroll app, with payroll fields on the Employee and Contract forms.

name: payroll_account
summary: Posts payroll to accounting. Each salary rule can carry debit and credit accounts, an analytic account and tax settings, and each payslip gets a salary journal and an accounting entry. Set up under Payroll Configuration, Salary Rules, on the Accounting tab.

name: payroll_account
summary: Posts payroll to accounting. Each salary rule can carry debit and credit accounts, an analytic account and tax settings, and each payslip gets a salary journal and an accounting entry. Set up under Payroll Configuration, Salary Rules, on the Accounting tab.

name: payroll_contract_advantages
summary: Lets you attach advantages (benefits with an amount) to an employee contract, each based on a template with lower and upper bounds and a default value. The amount on the contract can be read in salary rules, so benefits can affect pay calculations. Templates are set up in Payroll and advantages are added on the contract form.

name: payroll_contract_advantages
summary: Lets you attach advantages (benefits with an amount) to an employee contract, each based on a template with lower and upper bounds and a default value. The amount on the contract can be read in salary rules, so benefits can affect pay calculations. Templates are set up in Payroll and advantages are added on the contract form.

name: payroll_hr_public_holidays
summary: Puts public holidays into payslip worked days, so salary rules can pay or count public holiday days. Holidays must be entered in the Public Holidays menu from calendar_public_holiday, because standard Time Off holidays are not picked up. Public holiday days appear as a PHOL line on the payslip.

name: payroll_rule_time_parameter
summary: Technical add-on that adds Rule Parameters to the Payroll configuration menu. Salary rule Python code can read a named parameter with payslip.time_parameter, so a rate or threshold can change by date without editing the rule. It adds no new screens for payslips.

name: pdf_helper
summary: Technical module with no screens of its own. Other modules use it to read XML files attached inside a PDF and to embed an XML file into a PDF, which is needed for electronic invoices. It sits in the EDI repository.

name: pdf_xml_attachment
summary: Technical helper for reading and embedding XML files inside PDF documents, such as the XML part of an electronic invoice. Other modules and developers call it from code, and there is no screen for end users. It can also be used outside Odoo through a Python utility.

name: pim
summary: Adds a PIM (Product Information Management) app that gathers the product, variant, attribute and category screens into one menu. Users get PIM Reader, User or Manager access, so product data can be managed without the full Sales or Inventory apps. The PIM menu appears once a user is given one of these access levels.

name: pingen
summary: Sends uploaded attachments to pingen.com, a paid online service that prints and posts letters. On an attachment you tick a box to push it, and you can choose to send it, priority or economy, and colour or black and white. Pingen status updates come back automatically through webhooks.

name: pingen_env
summary: Technical add-on that reads the pingen.com API settings (client ID, token, organization ID and webhook secret) from server environment variables instead of the company form. It is for deployments that manage configuration outside the database. It adds no new screens.

name: pms
summary: The main Property Management System for hotels and similar properties, covering rooms, reservations, check-in, folios, room types, board services, availability and rate plans, and sales channels. Staff work from the PMS Management app with multi-property and multi-company support. It is a large feature set, and the module description points to an external user guide.

name: pms_account
summary: Connects the PMS to Accounting so each property shows its customer invoices and vendor bills through smart buttons. Invoice and bill lines can be tagged with one or more properties, and a property can be linked to an analytic account. PMS services can also carry a vendor.

name: pms_account_asset
summary: Links fixed assets from Asset Management to each property, so you can see which assets belong to a property and jump to them from the property form. Each asset records the property it belongs to. Depreciation is tracked per property through the asset records.

name: pms_account_move_budget
summary: Adds a Property (hotel) field to budget lines, so accounting budgets can be split by property. It is a technical bridge between the PMS and Budget Management and adds no new screens of its own. The field appears on budget lines wherever they are shown.

name: pms_base
summary: The foundation of the PMS suite. It defines properties with address, timezone and area, rooms and room types, amenities, property services, lifecycle stages, teams and tags. Users open it from the Properties menu, and settings let them turn on rooms, amenities, services and teams.

name: pms_contract
summary: Links recurring contracts from the Contracts module to properties, so a contract can cover one or more properties. Property services can be linked to contract lines for recurring billing. Smart buttons move between a property and its contracts.

name: pms_crm
summary: Links CRM leads and opportunities to properties, so a sales lead can reference one or more properties and each property shows its leads. Use the Properties tab on the lead and the Leads smart button on the property. Lead counts update on both forms.

name: pms_hr_property
summary: Lets you assign the properties (hotels) where an employee works, so an employee can have more than one workplace. Each property also lists its assigned employees. It shows on the employee form and on the property form.

name: pms_l10n_es
summary: Spanish localization for the PMS. It adds the statistics and traveller reporting used for Spanish tourism registration: a wizard that generates the INE statistics file with ADR and RevPAR ranges, and the SES traveller report with minor and guardian details. It also adds Spanish tourism classification and ID fields on properties, rooms, guests and reservations.

name: pms_l10n_es_sii
summary: Spanish SII add-on for the PMS. It sets up the PMS anonymous guest partner so it is handled correctly when invoices are reported to the Spanish tax authority (AEAT). It is technical and there is nothing to configure.

name: pms_l10n_es_tbai
summary: Makes simplified invoices issued by the PMS work with the Spanish TicketBAI e-invoicing module. Invoices to the PMS generic guest partner are flagged as simplified, so no guest data goes into the XML and the submission is not rejected. It is technical and has no screens of its own.

name: pms_partner_identification
summary: Adds identity document fields to guest check-in records: document type, number, expedition date and country. Document types come from the partner identification categories. The fields show on the check-in guest form.

name: pms_partner_second_lastname
summary: Adds a second last name field to check-in guest records, for guests who use two family names. It shows on the guest check-in form.

name: pms_project
summary: Links projects and tasks to properties, so a task can be assigned to a specific property. Each property gets a Tasks tab, and tasks and projects can be filtered by property. It shows in the Project app and on the property form.

name: pms_purchase
summary: Adds a Property field to purchase order lines, so each purchased item can be allocated to a property. It also adds putaway rules that send received stock to a property location, and purchase reports by property. It shows on purchase order lines in the Purchase app.

name: pms_sale
summary: Manages property reservations through sales orders in the Sales app. It adds a reservation configurator, guest details per reservation, reservation stages, a timeline view, automated emails and payment links sent from reservations. Reservations link back to their sales order.

name: pms_stock
summary: Gives each property its own inventory location, so the items kept at that property can be tracked. The location is set on the Stock tab of the property form. Putaway rules can control where items are stored within it.

name: pms_website
summary: Publishes properties on your website, with a public page for each property and website categories for grouping them. Properties get public descriptions, and amenities can be flagged as main amenities. Publishing is done from the Properties menu or the website button on the property form.

name: pms_website_sale
summary: Lets visitors book a property online through the website shop. They search by city, guest count or dates, choose a reservation type, and add it to the eCommerce cart before checking out. Visitors must log in to add a booking to the cart.

name: portal_account_personal_data_only
summary: Restricts portal users so they see only the invoices that belong to their own contact or its children. Without it, portal users can see any invoice where a colleague in their organization is a follower. This keeps documents private between members and departments.

name: portal_account_personal_data_only
summary: Limits portal users so they see only their own invoices, not invoices of colleagues from the same organization who follow the same documents. Invoices for the user's own contact and that contact's child contacts remain visible. It has no screens of its own.

name: portal_debranding
summary: Removes Odoo branding from the customer portal pages. It is a technical setting with no screens of its own.

name: portal_invitation_by_website
summary: When granting portal access from Contacts, you can pick which website the invited user is restricted to, either for the whole selection or per contact. The invitation link then uses that website's domain. Use it when you run several websites.

name: portal_odoo_debranding
summary: Removes Odoo branding from the customer portal pages, according to its description. It is a technical setting with no screens of its own.

name: portal_sale_accept_terms
summary: Requires customers to accept terms before they can confirm a quotation in the portal. You fill the Terms to accept field on the sale order, and the signature popup shows those terms with an Accept button that unlocks once they are accepted.

name: portal_sale_confirm_require_login
summary: Makes customers log in or sign up before they open a quotation or order through a portal link, and requires their partner details to be complete before they confirm, sign or pay. It is controlled by the Require login option under Quotations and Orders in Sales settings, which is off by default.

name: portal_sale_confirm_require_login
summary: Makes customers log in or sign up before they open a quotation or order through a portal link, and requires their partner details to be complete before they confirm, sign or pay. It is controlled by the Require login option under Quotations and Orders in Sales settings, which is off by default.

name: portal_sale_list_extra_info
summary: Adds the customer's order reference and the untaxed total to the sales order list that customers see in the portal, so they can find and check orders faster. It also makes it simpler for developers to add more columns later. Customers see these extra columns when they log in to their portal.

name: portal_sale_order_search
summary: Lets customers search their own sales orders and quotations in the portal, including by the order reference they set themselves. The search is added to the portal's order list. It helps customers find an order without contacting the company.

name: portal_sale_order_search
summary: Adds a search to the customer portal for sales orders and quotations, so customers can find one quickly. The manifest also describes letting customers set their own order reference.

name: portal_sale_personal_data_only
summary: Limits portal users so they see only their own sale orders and quotations, not those of colleagues from the same organization who follow the same documents. Invoices linked to their orders stay visible to them.

name: portal_sale_personal_data_only
summary: Stops portal users from seeing sales orders that belong to other people in their organization, even when those colleagues follow the order. Each portal user sees only the orders linked to their own contact and its child contacts, along with the related invoices. This keeps documents private between departments.

name: pos_access_right
summary: Adds Point of Sale permission groups, so you can control what cashiers may do at the till: sell negative quantities, give discounts, change unit prices, handle many orders at once, delete orders or order lines, and take payments. These are set per PoS configuration.

name: pos_analytic_by_config
summary: Posts point of sale orders to analytic accounts based on the PoS configuration, usually one per store. You create an analytic distribution model for each PoS config under Invoicing Configuration, and sessions use it when they are reconciled.

name: pos_analytic_by_config
summary: Posts point of sale orders to analytic accounts based on the PoS configuration, usually one per store. You create an analytic distribution model for each PoS config under Invoicing Configuration, and sessions use it when they are reconciled.

name: pos_auto_invoice
summary: Makes point of sale orders be invoiced by default. An Invoice By Default checkbox in the Point of Sale accounting settings marks each new order as to-invoice, so cashiers do not have to tick it each time.

name: pos_barcode_block
summary: Blocks the point of sale when a scanned barcode matches no product, so an unknown item cannot be sold by accident. The cashier sees an error message. The fix is to set that barcode on a product.

name: pos_barcode_rule_priced_with_change_rate
summary: Adds a barcode rule for price-encoded barcodes, like the standard priced product rule, and converts the encoded price using a change rate set on the PoS configuration. This is useful when the price on a label is in another currency. It is set up on the barcode nomenclature and the PoS config.

name: pos_blind_session_closing
summary: Hides the expected cash amounts when a PoS session is closed, so cashiers count the cash without seeing the target figure. Only users in the group 'Can see POS closing amounts' see the expected figures. It is set on the user form under Extra Rights.

name: pos_bypass_global_discount
summary: Makes the point of sale respect the Bypass Global Discount flag, so products flagged to skip order-level discounts are left out when a cashier applies a global discount in PoS. It is meant to be installed alongside the global discount and loyalty modules.

name: pos_cash_control_extension
summary: Lets a PoS session keep a fixed cash fund and checks that the opening and closing cash match, so differences are not missed. It extends the cash in and cash out controls on the session.

name: pos_cash_control_override
summary: Gives Point of Sale users back the rights to do cash in and cash out operations in their sessions, even without Accounting Billing rights. Use it when cashiers need to move cash but should not have accounting access.
keywords: cash in cash out permission POS
cash control rights point of sale

name: pos_cash_move_reason
summary: Lets cashiers record Put Money In and Take Money Out movements with a reason, such as a bank deposit or a small expense. Each reason is tied to an income or expense account, and an accounting entry is created when the session closes. Reasons are set under Point of Sale Configuration, Move Reason.

name: pos_cash_move_reason
summary: Lets cashiers record Put Money In and Take Money Out movements with a reason, such as a bank deposit or a small expense. Each reason is tied to an income or expense account, and an accounting entry is created when the session closes. Reasons are set under Point of Sale Configuration, Move Reason.

name: pos_cashback
summary: Adds a cashback message in point of sale when a card or check payment gives change, since that change would otherwise come out of the cash drawer. It flags that the money should be handled as cashback. It only adds a message and no new fields.

name: pos_category_complete_name
summary: Adds a Complete Name field to Point of Sale product categories, showing the full parent path of each category. This makes categories easier to find and search in the PoS category list.

name: pos_category_multicompany
summary: Separates Point of Sale product categories by company, so each company uses its own PoS categories. It adds a company field on PoS categories.

name: pos_category_multicompany
summary: Separates Point of Sale product categories by company, so each company uses its own PoS categories. It adds a company field on PoS categories.

name: pos_category_vertical_display
summary: Shows the point of sale product categories as a vertical list instead of the standard layout. It is a display setting only, so the categories and products themselves do not change.

name: pos_config_logo
summary: Lets each point of sale use its own logo on printed receipts, instead of the company logo. Turn on the alternative logo setting for that PoS in Point of Sale Settings and upload the image.

name: pos_config_phone
summary: Prints a phone number set for each point of sale in the receipt header, in place of the company's main phone number. You set it in Point of Sale Settings for each PoS. Useful when each shop has its own phone line.

name: pos_container_deposit
summary: Handles returnable deposits such as bottle deposits in the PoS. When a product with a deposit is sold, the deposit product is added automatically and kept in step with the quantity, and a returned bottle is recorded as a negative quantity sale. Deposit products are set up on the Point of Sale products.

name: pos_customer_age_warning
summary: Shows a customer's name in red at the till when their age is at or below an age warning threshold set in PoS settings, for example for alcohol sales or a venue age limit. Age is calculated from the customer's date of birth. It depends on the PoS partner birthdate module.

name: pos_customer_comment
summary: Lets cashiers see and edit a customer's PoS comment from the point of sale screen. Customers with a comment show an icon in the POS customer list, and the comment can be edited on the customer form in the Cashier Comment field.

name: pos_customer_display_monitor
summary: Lets a PoS user choose which monitor the customer display opens on, and remembers that choice for each point of sale. It applies to local customer displays only, not the proxy-based display. It is set up in Point of Sale Settings with the Customer Display option.

name: pos_customer_history_color
summary: Highlights order lines in purple when the selected customer has bought that product before, so cashiers can spot returning purchases and suggest upsells. It works on the PoS order lines and needs no setup beyond installing it.

name: pos_customer_required
summary: Requires the cashier to select a customer on a PoS order, either before starting the order or before paying, as set on the Point of Sale configuration. If no customer is chosen, the till shows an error, and the customer field becomes required in the back office.

name: pos_customer_tree_view_vat
summary: Shows the VAT number as a column in the customer list used in the Point of Sale. It is a display change only.
keywords: customer tax number point of sale

name: pos_customer_tree_view_vat
summary: Shows the VAT number as a column in the customer list used in the Point of Sale. It is a display change only.
keywords: customer tax number point of sale

name: pos_daily_sales_reports_category_only
summary: Changes the PoS daily sales report to show totals by product category only, hiding individual product lines. It is on by default and can be turned off per PoS config in Point of Sale settings.

name: pos_default_partner
summary: Sets a default customer on each point of sale config, so orders without a chosen customer are assigned to that customer. You set it in Point of Sale Settings for each PoS.

name: pos_discount_all
summary: Shows the total discount given on a PoS sale on the cashier screen and the printed ticket. The amount is worked out against the default pricelist price, so it includes line discounts, fixed prices and pricelist discounts. Discount products are flagged with Is a Discount.

name: pos_display_order_number
summary: Shows the order number next to the total in the PoS order summary. It depends on the divided order summary module, which provides the left-hand panel where the number appears.

name: pos_display_total_quantity
summary: Shows the total item quantity in the PoS order summary, so cashiers can check that every item was scanned. It depends on the divided order summary module.

name: pos_divide_order_summary
summary: Splits the PoS order summary into two parts so other modules can add content on the left-hand side, such as the order number or total quantity. It is a technical base module with no visible effect on its own.

name: pos_early_receipt_printing
summary: Lets a shop PoS (not only restaurants) print a bill before payment, using the Bill action in the order's Actions menu. It is turned on in Point of Sale Settings under Bills and Receipts for shops, or under Restaurant Mode for restaurant configs. It depends on the restaurant module.

name: pos_edit_order_line
summary: Adds an Edit order lines button to the PoS screen. It opens a popup where the cashier types the price, quantity and discount for each line directly, instead of selecting a field first. It is turned on with Allow Edit Order Line in the PoS config.

name: pos_edit_order_line
summary: Adds an Edit order lines button to the PoS screen. It opens a popup where the cashier types the price, quantity and discount for each line directly, instead of selecting a field first. It is turned on with Allow Edit Order Line in the PoS config.

name: pos_environment
summary: Adds custom header and footer text to PoS receipts that depends on the server environment, such as development, pre-production or production. It is useful where test and live receipts must be told apart, which some countries require. The text is set through server environment configuration files.

name: pos_escpos_status
summary: Lets Odoo read the status of ESC/POS receipt printers through the escpos driver, so a disconnected printer is shown correctly. It keeps compatibility with the older pywebdriver setup and has no screens of its own.

name: pos_financial_risk
summary: Applies partner credit limits to PoS orders. When a sale would take a customer over their credit limit, only payment methods not marked as credit-limit restricted stay available. Restrictions can be set on each payment method and per PoS config, and it depends on the account financial risk module.
keywords: customer credit check point of sale

name: pos_full_refund
summary: Adds a button on the refund ticket screen that adds every line of the selected order to the refund in one click, then returns to the main sale screen. It is used to refund a whole sale at the till.

name: pos_global_discount_in_line
summary: Shows the order-level discount on each line instead of adding a separate discount product to the order. It is turned on with Add Discount in Line in PoS settings and depends on the PoS discount module.

name: pos_hide_banknote_button
summary: Removes the +10, +20 and +50 quick banknote buttons from the PoS payment screens. It is a display-only change with no settings.

name: pos_hide_cost_price_and_margin
summary: Hides cost and margin figures in the PoS for every user, including PoS managers. Odoo already hides them from PoS users by default, and this module extends that to managers. Installing it applies to all users.

name: pos_hide_empty_category
summary: Hides PoS categories that contain no sellable products, which often happens with seasonal items. This keeps empty categories from cluttering the till screen.

name: pos_hide_partner_info
summary: Hides the phone and address fields in the customer list on the PoS screen, so cashiers see only the name. It is a display-only setting.

name: pos_hr_access_right
summary: Lets several employees work as cashiers in one PoS session, and applies the PoS access rights of each linked user. Employees with no user account use the rights of the currently logged-in user. It needs PoS HR and PoS access rights installed.

name: pos_lot_barcode
summary: Lets cashiers scan a lot or serial number barcode on the PoS screen instead of typing it in. It is used for lot-tracked products sold through the till.
keywords: lot barcode scanner point of sale

name: pos_lot_barcode
summary: Lets cashiers scan a lot or serial number barcode on the PoS screen instead of typing it in. It is used for lot-tracked products sold through the till.
keywords: lot barcode scanner point of sale

name: pos_lot_selection
summary: Lets cashiers pick from existing lots on the PoS screen for lot-tracked products, instead of typing a number. The product must be set to track by lots, made available in the PoS, and have stock in the PoS location.

name: pos_loyalty_exclude
summary: Lets loyalty rules exclude chosen products in the PoS, matching the sales version of this feature. Excluded products are left out of the loyalty program at the till. It depends on the sale loyalty exclude module and PoS loyalty.

name: pos_loyalty_redeem_payment
summary: Lets a gift card from a Gift Card loyalty program be used as a payment method at the PoS. The cashier enters the card code and an amount to redeem, and a payment line is added to the order. A loyalty card report can be downloaded after the order is completed.

name: pos_margin
summary: Shows the margin on PoS orders while the sale is being entered, both as a total under the order and per line. The margin rate also appears in the PoS order report and the margin amount in the order list. The display can be turned off per PoS config under Diplay Margin.

name: pos_margin
summary: Shows the margin on PoS orders while the sale is being entered, both as a total under the order and per line. The margin rate also appears in the PoS order report. The display can be turned off per PoS config under Diplay Margin.

name: pos_margin_stored
summary: Stores the margin amount and percentage on PoS orders and order lines, so they can be searched and reported. Odoo calculates margin for PoS but does not keep it in the database by default. Useful for finding weak sales and for statistics.

name: pos_meal_voucher
summary: Handles meal vouchers as a payment method at the PoS. Products eligible for vouchers can be marked on the product form or by category, and the payment screen shows the eligible total and warns when the amount received is too high. Receipts can show voucher information.

name: pos_membership
summary: Shows a customer's membership status on the PoS customer list and form. It also blocks selling a membership product at the till unless the Invoice option is set. It depends on the Odoo membership module.

name: pos_membership_extension
summary: Stops cashiers from selling a product to a customer who is not in an allowed membership category. Products show a not-sellable icon until a customer from an allowed category is selected, and the product popup lists the allowed categories. Allowed categories are set on the product Sales tab.

name: pos_minimize_menu
summary: Shrinks the menu bar at the top of the PoS so there is more room for the current ticket. Chosen buttons can still be kept visible on the main screen through the Important Buttons setting in PoS settings.

name: pos_open_cashbox_after_payment
summary: Opens the cash drawer after every payment, whatever the payment method. It is useful when cashiers put the receipt in the drawer even for card payments.

name: pos_operating_unit
summary: Restricts which PoS configurations, sessions, orders and payments a user can see, based on operating units. Each PoS config lists the operating units allowed to use it. It is used in multi-operating-unit setups.
keywords: multi operating unit point of sale

name: pos_order_attachment
summary: Lets cashiers attach files to a PoS order from the till screen. Attachments are stored on the order, and a document count is shown on it.

name: pos_order_copy
summary: Adds a copy option to PoS orders so an existing order can be duplicated from the point of sale order view. It also adds fields such as order date, cashier, session, tip amount and ticket code to PoS orders.

name: pos_order_line_customer_history
summary: Adds a History button on the PoS screen that lists a selected customer's past order lines, with search, sort and date filters. Chosen lines can be added to the current order as product and quantity only, without their old prices or discounts.

name: pos_order_line_show_product_info
summary: Shows extra product details, such as barcode and internal reference, inside each PoS order line so cashiers can check items at the till. It needs no setup after installation. The module's notes say it targets Odoo 17.

name: pos_order_new_line
summary: Forces a new order line when a product is selected again, instead of adding to the existing line. This lets the same product be sold at different prices or discounts within one order.

name: pos_order_remove_line
summary: Adds a button on each PoS order line to remove it from the till. A warning when a line is removed can also be turned on. These options are set under PoS Interface in the PoS configuration.
keywords: delete product line point of sale

name: pos_order_remove_line
summary: Adds a button on each PoS order line to remove it from the till. This lets cashiers take an item off the order during a sale.
keywords: delete product line point of sale

name: pos_order_reorder
summary: Lets a paid PoS order be re-ordered into a new order, so repeat purchases are quick to ring up. It is turned on with Allow Reorder in the PoS settings.

name: pos_order_split_invoice
summary: Splits a PoS order into two invoices: one paid at the till and a second invoice to another partner who pays afterwards. It is aimed at co-payments, such as in pharmacies or medical centers. It needs a special pricelist with a Split Invoice rule.

name: pos_order_to_sale_order
summary: Adds a Create Order button on the PoS that turns the current till sale into a sales order instead of taking payment at once, and discards the PoS order. Options set the new order as draft, confirmed, delivered or invoiced. It is used for regular customers who want one invoice at month end.
keywords: convert POS order to sale order

name: pos_order_to_sale_order
summary: Adds a Create Order button on the PoS that turns the current till sale into a sales order instead of taking payment at once, and discards the PoS order. Options set the new order as draft, confirmed, delivered or invoiced. It is used for regular customers who want one invoice at month end.
keywords: convert POS order to sale order

name: pos_order_to_sale_order_delivery
summary: Lets cashiers add a shipping method when creating a sales order from the PoS, so the delivery carrier is set on the new order. The shipping methods offered are chosen in PoS settings under Inventory.

name: pos_order_to_sale_order_report
summary: After a PoS sales order is created, the chosen sale order report downloads automatically. The report is set under Sale Order Creation in PoS settings.

name: pos_order_to_sale_order_sale_financial_risk
summary: Applies the sales financial risk checks to sales orders created from the PoS. Customers get the same warning or block at the till as they would on a sales order in the back office. It is a bridge between the sale financial risk and PoS sale order modules.
keywords: customer credit check POS sales order

name: pos_partner_address_required
summary: Makes the address fields required on the customer form in the PoS, so cashiers must fill them in for new customers. Cashiers see the address fields marked as required when adding or editing a customer at the till.
keywords: mandatory customer address point of sale

name: pos_partner_alternative_pricelist_load_background
summary: When a customer is selected at the PoS, loads the alternative pricelists linked to their pricelist in the background, so prices are ready sooner. It extends the background pricelist loading and adds no new screens.

name: pos_partner_birthdate
summary: Adds a date of birth field to the customer screen in the PoS, so it can be entered at the till. Other PoS modules, such as the customer age warning, build on this field.

name: pos_partner_firstname
summary: Shows and edits the first name and last name fields on the PoS customer screen, using the partner first name module. It also depends on PoS support for the is company field.

name: pos_partner_firstname
summary: Shows and edits the first name and last name fields on the PoS customer screen, using the partner first name module. It also adds a setting for the order in which names are displayed.

name: pos_partner_firstname_required
summary: Makes the first name required on the customer form in the PoS, so cashiers must enter it for new customers. Cashiers must enter the first name before the customer can be saved at the till.
keywords: mandatory first name point of sale

name: pos_partner_is_company
summary: Shows the Individual or Company choice on the PoS customer screen and lets the cashier change it. It is used when a sale is to a business rather than a person.

name: pos_partner_load_new_data
summary: Loads newly created or changed customer records into the PoS in the background, as soon as the customer list is opened. New customers can then be used without reloading the session.

name: pos_partner_location_abstract
summary: Base module for choosing a customer's location on a map from the PoS. It stores the chosen location on the contact, can estimate the address from coordinates, and can generate a location QR code. It is a core base for map provider modules and has no screens of its own.

name: pos_partner_location_google_map
summary: Lets cashiers pick a customer's address on a Google Map from the PoS customer form, using the globe icon, and save the location to the contact. It needs a Google Maps API key set on the PoS config.

name: pos_partner_no_create
summary: Stops cashiers creating new customers from the PoS screen. Cashiers can only pick existing contacts, and new customers have to be added in the back office.
keywords: prevent customer creation point of sale

name: pos_partner_pricelist_load_background
summary: When a customer is selected at the PoS, loads the customer's own pricelist in the background, even if it was not among the pricelists loaded at startup. That pricelist then becomes available to choose for the order.

name: pos_partner_ref
summary: Adds the contact reference field to the customer screen in the PoS, so it can be entered and viewed at the till. It appears on the customer screen in the PoS, where it can be typed in directly.

name: pos_partner_sale_warning
summary: Shows a warning when a selected customer has a sales warning on their contact. The warning can be blocking or non-blocking, and is set in the Internal Notes tab of the contact. Sale warnings must also be turned on in Sales settings.

name: pos_partner_second_lastname
summary: Lets cashiers view and edit a customer's second last name on the PoS customer screen. It works alongside the first and last name fields added by the PoS first name module.

name: pos_partner_vat_required
summary: Makes the VAT field required on the customer form in the PoS, so cashiers must enter a VAT number for new customers. The rule applies on the partner view used in the PoS.
keywords: customer VAT mandatory point of sale

name: pos_partner_vat_valid
summary: Checks the VAT number entered on the PoS customer form and flags an invalid one, using the base VAT validation rules. A VAT that fails the check is flagged on the PoS customer form.
keywords: tax ID validation point of sale

name: pos_payment_change
summary: Lets a cashier change the payment methods used on a PoS order, as long as the session is open and entries have not been generated. The policy is set per PoS config: Refund and Resale creates new orders with the correct payments, and Update Payments edits the payment lines directly.

name: pos_payment_change
summary: Lets a cashier change the payment methods used on a PoS order, as long as the session is open and entries have not been generated. The policy is set per PoS config: Refund and Resale creates new orders with the correct payments, and Update Payments edits the payment lines directly.

name: pos_payment_description
summary: Shows the payment details of each PoS order in the order list view, so you can see how an order was paid without opening it. The payment description is stored on each order and shown in the order list view.

name: pos_payment_description
summary: Shows the payment details of each PoS order in the order list view, so you can see how an order was paid without opening it. The payment description is stored on each order and shown in the order list view.

name: pos_payment_method_cashdro
summary: Lets a PoS take payment on a CashDro terminal. The cashier sends the amount to the terminal, the customer pays on the device, and the cashier can cancel a pending request from the payment line. It is set on a cash payment method with the terminal host name and login.

name: pos_payment_method_cashdro
summary: Lets a PoS take payment on a CashDro terminal. The cashier sends the amount to the terminal, the customer pays on the device, and the cashier can cancel a pending request from the payment line. It is set on a cash payment method with the terminal host name and login.

name: pos_payment_method_change_policy
summary: Changes how a PoS gives change when a customer overpays. Instead of a negative cash line, the surplus can be booked to an Exceptional Profit product, such as a No change service product, set on the payment method. The change option is set on the payment method form.

name: pos_payment_method_image
summary: Shows an image for each payment method on the PoS payment screen. If no image is uploaded, a default image is used based on whether the method is cash, customer wallet or bank.

name: pos_payment_restriction
summary: Restricts what a cashier can do on the PoS payment screen. The tendered amount can be made read-only, and a helper can disable the Validate button while a payment is pending, such as waiting for an automatic card transaction. These are set on the PoS config under Payments.

name: pos_payment_show_order
summary: Shows the order on the right-hand side of the PoS payment screen, so the cashier does not have to go back to the order screen during checkout. The order panel stays visible while the cashier takes payment.

name: pos_payment_terminal
summary: Adds support for a generic payment terminal, such as a credit card reader, and a check printer on the PoS. For payment methods set to OCA Payment Terminal, a Send button passes the amount, currency and payment mode to the IoT box or pywebdriver. Payment mode is Card by default, or Check for check printers.
keywords: credit card terminal point of sale

name: pos_payment_terminal
summary: Adds support for a generic payment terminal, such as a credit card reader, and a check printer on the PoS. For payment methods set to OCA Payment Terminal, a Send button passes the amount, currency and payment mode to the IoT box or pywebdriver. The module also adds a setting to hide the back button and a fast payment option.
keywords: credit card terminal point of sale

name: pos_payment_usability
summary: Changes the layout of the PoS payment screen to make it easier to use. The description gives no further detail of the changes.

name: pos_picking_delayed
summary: Speeds up validating a PoS order by creating its stock picking later, in a background job. Orders show in a different colour until the job runs. It needs the queue job module and a queue channel set in the server config, and is used with synchronous fiscal certification setups.

name: pos_picking_load
summary: Lets a cashier load existing stock pickings, such as online or website orders ready for pickup, into a new PoS order. The cashier can then add or remove products and take payment for what is actually handed over. Pick types are enabled under Warehouse Configuration with Available in Point of Sale.

name: pos_place
summary: Records the place where a sale is made, such as a station or counter, on each PoS order. Cashiers select the current place from the PoS, and sales can be reported by place. Places are created under Point of Sale Configuration, Places.

name: pos_pms_link
summary: Connects the PoS to hotel reservations from the PMS. Reservation services can be added to a PoS order, and an order can be paid on a reservation so the charges go onto the reservation's services. These options are set on the PoS config.

name: pos_price_to_weight
summary: Lets scanned barcodes carry a price, which is converted into a computed quantity by dividing it by the unit price. This is for shops that sell scaled products, so stock quantities stay correct. Barcode rules and whether prices include tax are set in the barcode nomenclature.

name: pos_pricelist_technical
summary: Hides technical pricelists, which exist only to compute other pricelists, from the PoS pricelist selector. The cashier sees only normal pricelists.

name: pos_printing_qztray
summary: Prints PoS receipts on a thermal printer through QZ Tray, a software print driver, so an IoT Box is not needed. You enable QZ Tray Printing on the PoS config and choose a QZ Tray printer, and the cash drawer opens after each receipt. The QZ Tray desktop app must be running on the POS machine.

name: pos_product_cost_security
summary: Stops Point of Sale from failing for users who cannot see product cost. Without it, loading the POS data can raise a permission error. It is a glue module between the cost security and Point of Sale features.

name: pos_product_cost_security
summary: Glue module that stops permission errors when the PoS loads product data for users who cannot see the product cost field. It adds no screens.

name: pos_product_display_default_code
summary: Shows the internal reference of each product before its name in the PoS, for example [FURN_0001] Desk Organizer, in the product list, order lines and receipt. It is turned on with Display Default Code in the PoS Interface settings.

name: pos_product_display_default_code
summary: Shows the internal reference of each product before its name in the PoS, for example [FURN0001] Desk Organizer, in the product list, order lines and receipt. It is turned on with Display Default Code in the PoS settings.

name: pos_product_expiry
summary: Checks the expiry date of lot-tracked products when they are sold at the PoS, so cashiers can see whether a product can still be delivered. It is turned on with the Check Lot Expiry setting on the PoS config.
keywords: expiration date check point of sale

name: pos_product_info_location
summary: Shows the stock quantity of a product by internal location in the PoS product info popup. Only locations under the stock source of the PoS operation type appear, and zero-quantity locations are hidden. This helps staff find stock in a warehouse with shelves and drawers.

name: pos_product_label
summary: Adds a Print Labels button to the PoS order that prints product labels for the products on the order. A wizard lets you choose the label layout and quantities, like the Print Labels button on stock transfers.

name: pos_product_mergeable_line
summary: Stops order lines of a product from being merged, so each sale of that product keeps its own line. It is set per product with the Mergeable Line checkbox. This suits returnable items where every movement must be recorded.

name: pos_product_multi_barcode
summary: Lets a product be scanned at the PoS with any of its several barcodes, using the multi barcode list on the product. The extra barcodes are stored as a list on the product.

name: pos_product_multi_barcode
summary: Lets a product be scanned at the PoS with any of its several barcodes, using the multi barcode list on the product. The extra barcodes are stored as a list on the product.

name: pos_product_packaging_container_deposit
summary: Adds the container deposit fee from product packaging to a PoS order, as a separate order line marked as a container deposit. The deposit product is set on the product packaging.

name: pos_product_packaging_multi_barcode
summary: Lets product packaging barcodes be scanned at the PoS. You add one or more barcodes to a product packaging in Inventory, and the till recognises them when scanned.

name: pos_product_pricelist_alternative
summary: Works out PoS product prices from alternative pricelists. The price is the lower of the reference pricelist and its alternative pricelists, following the OCA product pricelist alternative module.

name: pos_product_quick_info
summary: Lets cashiers view product information in the PoS without adding the product to the cart. It is turned on per PoS config with Display Quick Product Info.
keywords: quick view product point of sale

name: pos_product_template
summary: Groups product variants together at the PoS, so an item with variants shows as one entry. Clicking it opens the variant list, where the cashier picks a variant by its attribute values. It is turned on with Product template show variants in PoS settings.

name: pos_receipt_gift_card
summary: Prints gift card codes and remaining balances on the PoS payment receipt. It depends on the PoS loyalty module.
keywords: gift card ticket point of sale

name: pos_receipt_hide_info
summary: Hides the cashier name, company email and company phone from PoS receipts. Each option is set per PoS config in Point of Sale settings.

name: pos_receipt_hide_price
summary: Adds a Hide Price button on the PoS receipt screen. Clicking it removes the prices from the receipt for printing and emailing.

name: pos_receipt_hide_price
summary: Adds a Hide Price button on the PoS receipt screen that removes prices from the receipt for printing and emailing. The module also notes that prices can be hidden when receipts are generated automatically.

name: pos_receipt_replace_user_by_trigram
summary: Shows each cashier's trigram, a short initials code, on PoS receipts instead of the full user name. Trigrams are generated by a scheduled action and the replacement can be turned off per PoS config.

name: pos_receipt_replace_user_by_trigram_hr
summary: Technical link between the trigram receipt feature and PoS HR, so employee trigrams are used on receipts. It has no screens of its own.

name: pos_receipt_usability
summary: Changes the layout of the PoS receipt screen to make it easier to use. The description gives no further detail of the changes.

name: pos_receipt_vat_detail
summary: Adds the VAT base amount and VAT amount to the PoS receipt, so the tax breakdown matches the invoice. This is useful when a customer needs receipt details for an expense claim.

name: pos_report_session_summary
summary: Adds a Session Summary PDF report to PoS sessions. You print it from the session by choosing Print and then Session Summary.

name: pos_report_session_summary
summary: Adds a Session Summary PDF report to PoS sessions. You print it from the session by choosing Print and then Session Summary.

name: pos_require_product_quantity
summary: Stops empty order lines at the till. When Payment is clicked and a line has a quantity of zero, a popup appears instead. It is turned on per PoS config.

name: pos_reset_search
summary: Clears the product search box when a product is clicked, so beginners can narrow the list and then select a product with the mouse. The Enter-key search still works for trained users.

name: pos_restaurant_multi_company
summary: Adds a company field to restaurant floors, tables and printers, so each company sees only its own floors and printers in restaurant PoS. Records without a company stay available to all.

name: pos_restaurant_receipt_usability
summary: On the receipt screen of a split bill in the restaurant PoS, returns the cashier to the split screen to keep splitting the ticket, instead of starting a new blank order. The split continues until the whole order is paid.

name: pos_restaurant_split_order_usability
summary: Shows the lines already paid on the restaurant split screen and links each split order to its original order. Cashiers can see what has already been paid while splitting a bill.

name: pos_rma
summary: Lets cashiers create a return (RMA) from an order line on a PoS order. The quantity and a reason are required, and each RMA is linked back to the PoS order. It depends on the RMA module.

name: pos_sale_order_print
summary: Lets cashiers print quotations and sales orders from the PoS. You pick an order from the Quotation/Order list and choose the report to print. The reports offered are set under Sales in PoS settings.

name: pos_sale_picking_keep
summary: Stops the PoS from changing the delivery pickings of sales orders or creating new pickings under the PoS picking type. Pickings from sales orders stay as they are.
keywords: PoS picking type no new pickings

name: pos_sale_product_config_no_variant
summary: Shows the selected attribute values of a no-variant configurable product on the PoS order line. The values are stored in an Extra Values field that can be shown in the order line list.

name: pos_screen_element_custom_size
summary: Sets custom sizes for some PoS screen elements, such as the minimum width of product tiles and the font sizes of product names and price tags. Blank fields keep the standard sizes. These are set per PoS config under POS Screen Custom Settings.

name: pos_session_pay_invoice
summary: From an open PoS session in the back office, pays a supplier invoice or customer refund in cash, or collects payment of a customer invoice. The buttons are Pay Supplier, Pay Refund and Get Payment from Invoice. A cash payment method is needed on the PoS.

name: pos_session_pay_invoice
summary: From an open PoS session in the back office, pays a supplier invoice or customer refund in cash, or collects payment of a customer invoice. The buttons are Pay Supplier, Pay Refund and Get Payment from Invoice. A cash payment method is needed on the PoS.

name: pos_session_sequence
summary: Gives each PoS its own numbering sequence for sessions, set in PoS settings as Session IDs Sequence. Sessions are then named using that sequence.

name: pos_show_clock
summary: Shows the current time on the main PoS screen. No setting is needed, since it is a display change only.

name: pos_stock_available_online
summary: Shows live stock quantities on product tiles in the PoS, for the warehouse of the PoS operation type and any extra warehouses chosen in PoS settings. Quantities update in all open PoS screens when stock changes, and a minimum quantity alert can be set.

name: pos_stock_available_online
summary: Shows live stock quantities on product tiles in the PoS, for the warehouse of the PoS operation type and any extra warehouses chosen in PoS settings. Quantities update in all open PoS screens when stock changes, and a minimum quantity alert can be set.

name: pos_supplierinfo_search
summary: Lets cashiers search products at the PoS by supplier name, supplier product code or supplier product name, typed into the product search box. The supplier data is stored as a searchable list on each product.

name: pos_supplierinfo_search
summary: Lets cashiers search products at the PoS by supplier name, supplier product code or supplier product name, typed into the product search box. The supplier data is stored as a searchable list on the product template.

name: pos_tare
summary: Lets a cashier enter the tare weight of a container when weighing products, so the net weight is worked out automatically and shown on the order line and receipt. The tare can be typed in, scanned from a barcode, or set per product. It needs an electronic scale and barcode reader set up in the IoT Box section.

name: pos_ticket_extra_company_info
summary: Adds the company address and company registry details to the PoS ticket. The address shown is a separate ticket address set on the company.

name: pos_ticket_extra_company_info_l10n_fr
summary: Adds the company SIRET number to the PoS ticket for French companies. It requires the French localization module.

name: pos_timeout
summary: Changes how long the PoS waits when sending orders to the server, instead of the default timeout. The timeout is set per PoS config and is multiplied by the number of orders sent in one call. Useful on poor connections or with slow custom modules.

name: pos_to_weight_by_product_uom
summary: Makes the To Weigh With Scale option on new products default to on when their unit of measure belongs to a category marked To Weigh With Scale. This saves ticking it on each product. It can still be changed per product on the Sales tab.

name: pos_user_restrict_provider_info
summary: Hides supplier information in the PoS product details from PoS users, so cashiers do not see vendor details. Only PoS users are affected, and other users still see supplier information.

name: pos_user_restrict_stripe_bypass_user
summary: Lets users in the Assigned POS Only group take Stripe card payments in the PoS. It is a bridge between Stripe for PoS and PoS user restriction, and adds no screens of its own.

name: pos_user_restriction
summary: Limits selected users to the points of sale assigned to them. A PoS Manager picks the assigned users on each PoS config, and those users get the Assigned POS Only group. Authorized employees can then switch cashiers within a session.

name: postgres_vacuum
summary: Adds scheduled actions that vacuum and analyze the database tables, to be run manually from Scheduled Actions. This suits busy databases where Postgres autovacuum is not recommended. It is a technical administration tool with no user screens.

name: pricelist_brand
summary: Lets pricelist rules apply to products of a chosen brand, so a brand can get its own price or discount. You set Brand in the Applied On field of a pricelist item. It needs the product brand module.

name: pricelist_brand
summary: Lets pricelist rules apply to products of a chosen brand, so a brand can get its own price or discount. You set Brand in the Applied On field of a pricelist item. It needs the product brand module.

name: pricelist_cache
summary: Technical background feature that pre-computes prices for every product in every pricelist and stores them in a cache, so a full price catalog for a customer can be produced quickly. A scheduled task rebuilds the cache each day, and new products, pricelists or pricelist rules are cached when created. Other modules and integrations use the cached prices.

name: pricelist_cache
summary: Caches prices for all products and all pricelists each day with a scheduled job, so a full price catalog for a customer can be built quickly. New products, pricelists and pricelist items add their prices to the cache when created. It is a technical base that supports a cache wizard on partners.

name: pricelist_cache_rest
summary: Exposes cached customer prices through a web address that other systems can call with an API key, returning product IDs and prices for a given customer. It is for system integrations rather than people using the screens. The API keys allowed to call it are set on the company.

name: pricelist_price_base_custom
summary: Adds a Custom Value option to the Based on field of formula pricelists. The base price is supplied by the code that calls the pricelist, so it is a technical extension for custom solutions.

name: printer_zpl2
summary: Adds ZPL II label printing, so labels can be printed on Zebra-style label printers. Label layouts are created under Settings, Printing, Labels, or imported from ZPL2 code. A developer can print a label from code, and a print label wizard can be added to any model.

name: printer_zpl2
summary: Adds ZPL II label printing, so labels can be printed on Zebra-style label printers. Label layouts are created under Settings, Printing, Labels, or imported from ZPL2 code. A developer can print a label from code, and a print label wizard can be added to any model.

name: printing_auto_base
summary: Technical base for printing a report or attachment automatically, without someone clicking print. The rules say which report or attachment to print and on which record type. It has no screens of its own.

name: printing_auto_label_printer
summary: Lets automatic printing send a report or attachment to a label printer. It adds a label option to the automatic printing rules. It depends on the automatic printing base module.

name: printing_auto_mrp
summary: When a manufacturing order is completed, automatically prints the documents set on its operation type. You choose which report or attachment to print on the Operation Type.

name: printing_auto_shipment_advice
summary: When a shipment advice is marked done, automatically prints the documents set on the warehouse. You choose which report or attachment to print on the warehouse.

name: printing_auto_stock_picking
summary: Lets you set a report, such as a delivery slip, or a carrier label attachment to print automatically when a transfer is marked done. The setup is done on the Operation Type, so every transfer of that type prints the chosen documents. It is found under Inventory, in the Operation Type configuration.

name: printing_simple_configuration
summary: A technical base for printing setups: it lets you store a print server address, port and list of printers, attached to a company or a warehouse. Other print workflows, such as label printing, can then use these settings. There is little to see on its own, so it is mainly used together with other printing modules.

name: privacy
summary: Gives you a register of data processing activities to help with GDPR-style compliance. For each activity you record its name, description, controller, processors, and optionally a filter that defines which contacts are affected. It is a record-keeping tool and does not give legal advice.

name: privacy
summary: Gives you a register of data processing activities to help with GDPR-style compliance. For each activity you record its name, description, controller, processors, and optionally a filter that defines which contacts are affected. It is a record-keeping tool and does not give legal advice.

name: privacy_consent
summary: Tracks whether contacts have explicitly agreed to be included in a data processing activity, as GDPR article 6.1.a requires. On each activity you choose how consent is requested, manually or by email template, and each contact gets a consent record showing accepted or not. Consents appear on the activity under Privacy and on the contact form.

name: privacy_consent
summary: Tracks whether contacts have explicitly agreed to be included in a data processing activity, as GDPR article 6.1.a requires. On each activity you choose how consent is requested, manually or by email template, and each contact gets a consent record showing accepted or not. Consents appear on the activity under Privacy and on the contact form.

name: privacy_partner_to_be_forgotten
summary: Anonymizes a contact who asks to be erased under GDPR, replacing name, email, phone, address, tax ID and similar personal data while keeping any link to the parent company. It also removes chatter messages and attachments on that contact, and archives linked users. Run it from the Anonymize (GDPR) action on a contact, which needs the Anonymize Contacts right.

name: procurement_auto_create_group
summary: Creates a new procurement group automatically during each replenishment run, so the transfers from that run contain only that run's moves. Groups are named in a PG sequence and can be seen under Additional info on the transfer. It is enabled per rule in the route settings under Inventory, Configuration, Routes.

name: procurement_auto_create_group
summary: Makes each procurement run, meaning a replenishment triggered by stock rules, create its own procurement group such as PG/000001. The transfers from that run then hold only the moves from that run, so they are not mixed with other orders. You switch it on per rule with Auto-create Procurement Group, and the group shows under Additional info on a transfer.

name: procurement_auto_create_group_carrier
summary: A glue module that stores the delivery carrier on the procurement group created by the auto-create group feature. It adds no screens of its own. It only links the carrier to the group that the procurement run creates.

name: procurement_auto_create_group_carrier
summary: Glue module that stores the delivery carrier on the procurement group when procurement groups are created automatically. It is technical and has no screens.

name: procurement_purchase_no_grouping
summary: Stops procurements from merging the purchase order lines they generate, so each replenishment keeps its own line. The behaviour is set per product category and falls back to a company default in settings. Options include standard grouping and no line grouping, which reuses an open purchase order for the supplier without merging lines.

name: procurement_purchase_no_grouping
summary: Controls whether purchase orders created automatically from replenishment are grouped together. Each product category can use standard grouping, no line grouping, or no order grouping, falling back to a company default. The setting is made on the product category form and in Purchase settings.

name: procurement_purchase_requisition_generation
summary: Restores the older behaviour where replenishing a product creates a blanket order, meaning a call for tenders, instead of a draft purchase order. Set the product to the Buy route with a vendor, and choose Propose a call for tenders in its Reordering section, then Replenish creates the blanket order. It is used from Purchases, Products and Blanket Orders.

name: procurement_purchase_requisition_generation_dropshipping
summary: Links blanket orders created from dropshipping sales back to the originating sale order. A purchase order made from such a blanket order gets the customer shipping address and the dropship picking type. Each blanket order line keeps the Origin Sale Order Line, so you can trace it to the sale.

name: procurement_purchase_sale_no_grouping
summary: Makes the no order grouping option work for service products sold on sales orders that generate purchases, so each sale creates its own purchase order instead of joining an existing one. It is a glue module between the no-grouping and sale-purchase features, set on the product category form.

name: product_abc_classification
summary: Sorts products into ABC levels, such as A for the most important, by the share of products or volume in a chosen period. Classification profiles hold the levels and are assigned to categories or products, and a scheduled job applies them. Profiles are set under Inventory, Configuration, Products.

name: product_abc_classification
summary: Builds an ABC classification, which sorts products into A, B and C levels by importance, to help inventory teams focus on the most valuable items. Managers create a profile with percentage levels under Configuration, Products, ABC Classification Profile, and assign it to categories or variants. A scheduled job then gives each product a computed level, which can differ from the manual one and is flagged.

name: product_abc_classification_sale_stock
summary: Adds an ABC profile type that ranks products by the number of sale order lines delivered from a chosen date. It keeps a history of the ranking per product and warehouse. It is set up in the same ABC Classification Profile menu, under Sales or Inventory.

name: product_abc_classification_sale_stock
summary: Adds an ABC profile that ranks products by how many sales order lines were delivered in a period. Products are then graded A, B or C by how often they sell. It is set up from the ABC classification profile under Inventory.

name: product_account_multicompany_default
summary: Copies a product's income and expense accounts from the current company to every other company you can access. You do it with the Propagate expense/income account to other companies button on the product form. It works for both product templates and variants.

name: product_alias
summary: Lets you give a product variant an alternative name, called an alias, based on its attribute value combination, such as a sales or marketing name. Aliases are defined on the product template and linked to the variants. It is used for catalog and e-commerce naming.

name: product_allergen
summary: Lets you define allergens with an icon and attach them to products and variants, with the product template showing the allergens of its variants. You can turn on allergen icons on product labels for products without barcodes, in General Settings. Allergens are managed from their own menu and added on the Allergens tab of the product form.

name: product_analytic
summary: Lets you set default analytic distribution models on a product or product category. When that product is added to an invoice line, the matching distribution is filled in automatically, using the product first and then its category. Set it on the product and product category forms.

name: product_analytic
summary: Lets you set an income analytic account and an expense analytic account on a product or product category. When the product is added to a customer invoice or a supplier bill, the matching analytic account is filled in automatically, falling back from product to category. Set on the product and product category forms.

name: product_analytic
summary: Lets you set an income analytic account and an expense analytic account on a product or product category. When the product is added to a customer invoice or a supplier bill, the matching analytic account is filled in automatically, falling back from product to category. Set on the product and product category forms.

name: product_analytic_donation
summary: A glue module between donation and product analytic. When a donation line uses a product, or a product category, that has an income analytic account, that account is filled in on the donation line automatically. It adds no screens of its own.

name: product_analytic_purchase
summary: A glue module between purchase and product analytic. When a product, or its category, has an expense analytic account, that account is filled in on the purchase order line automatically. It adds no screens of its own.

name: product_analytic_sale
summary: A glue module between sale and product analytic. Each sale order line gets the analytic distribution stored on its product, or on the product category, when there is one. It adds no screens of its own.

name: product_assortment
summary: Lets users define a product assortment, which is a filter with an explicit list of allowed products and a list of restricted products. Assortments are applied to customers to control what they can see or buy. They are managed from the Product Assortment menu.

name: product_assortment
summary: Lets you build product assortments, which are saved filters that combine a domain with explicit lists of allowed and restricted products. Assortments can be linked to customers so that they only see the products in their range. You create them from the Product Assortment menu.

name: product_attachment_link
summary: Makes attachments visible across a product template and its variants. A smart button on each product form jumps to the attachments of the other side, so you do not have to upload the same file twice. It shows on the product template and product variant forms.

name: product_attachment_zipped_download
summary: Lets users download the attachments of selected products together as one zip file. It saves downloading product documents one at a time. It is available from the product list actions.

name: product_attachment_zipped_download
summary: Lets you download the attachments of the selected products together as one .zip file. Select products in the product list and use the download action. It is handy for pulling all the datasheets or images for a set of products at once.

name: product_attribute_archive
summary: Lets users archive a product attribute or one of its values. Archived attributes can no longer be used on new products, but existing variants are not changed. It is set from the archive action on the attribute.

name: product_attribute_archive
summary: Lets you archive product attributes and attribute values, so they can no longer be used on new products. Existing product variants are not changed. Use the normal archive action on an attribute or a value.

name: product_attribute_auto_add
summary: When you add a new value to an attribute, it is added automatically to every product template that uses that attribute. You can exclude a template by ticking Disable Attribute Autoupdate on its form. The option is enabled per attribute with Auto-Add Value to Product Templates, under Products, Variants, Attributes.

name: product_attribute_company_favorite
summary: Lets each company keep its own short list of favourite product attributes and values. Only the favourites appear in the attribute dropdown on product forms. Two settings under Inventory, Products decide whether new attributes and values are favourites for all companies.

name: product_attribute_company_favorite
summary: Lets each company keep its own short list of favourite product attributes and values. Only the favourites appear in the attribute dropdown on product forms. Two settings under Inventory, Products decide whether new attributes and values are favourites for all companies.

name: product_attribute_custom_value_variant
summary: When a customer picks a custom value on a sale order line, that value becomes a real variant instead of free text. You enable this per attribute value with Create custom variant, so the variant can hold its own stock and purchase data. The created variant then appears on the sale order line.

name: product_attribute_line_template
summary: Lets users define reusable attribute templates, such as a standard set of size and colour attributes. Applying a template to a product adds its attribute lines automatically. Templates are created under Settings, Attribute Templates.

name: product_attribute_model_link
summary: Links a product attribute to any Odoo model, so the records of that model become its attribute values. Creating, renaming or deleting a record updates the matching attribute value, and changes can also flow back the other way. The link is set on the attribute under Inventory, Configuration, Products, Attributes.

name: product_attribute_set
summary: Shows a product's attributes on its form, using the Attribute Set module, and lets each product category suggest a default attribute set. This module does not add an attribute menu, since that is provided by the PIM application. It is a link between products and attribute sets.

name: product_attribute_set
summary: Shows a product's attributes on its form, using the Attribute Set module, and lets each product category suggest a default attribute set. This module does not add an attribute menu, since that is provided by the PIM application. It is a link between products and attribute sets.

name: product_attribute_set_completeness
summary: Shows a completion rate and a completion state on each product form, based on its attribute set. Products can also be filtered with the Complete and Not Complete search filters. It helps you find products whose data is still missing.

name: product_attribute_set_list_view
summary: Adds every attribute from an attribute set as an optional column in the Products and Product Variants list views. You can edit attribute values inline, and select several products to change one cell for all of them. Pick the columns with the column picker at the top right of the list.

name: product_attribute_value_archive
summary: Lets you archive an attribute value that is still used by an archived variant, instead of getting an error when you try to remove it. This is useful when a size or colour was sold once and is no longer offered. It works from the attribute configuration.

name: product_attribute_value_avoid_auto_fill
summary: Adds an option on a product attribute that stops its values from being filled in automatically on product templates. It applies to attributes with variant creation set to Never. Users then choose the values by hand.

name: product_attribute_value_dependent_mixin
