summary: A technical base module for developers. It gives other models a reusable set of fields, such as product template, variant and attribute values, so a record can depend on specific product variants. It has no end-user screen of its own.

name: product_attribute_value_dependent_mixin
summary: Technical base that lets other models tie their records to particular product variants or attribute values, using computed filters. Developers use it so each feature does not have to write its own variant filter. It has no screens of its own.

name: product_attribute_value_menu
summary: Adds a menu under Sales, Configuration for the extra prices of each attribute value on each product template, with CSV or XLSX import. It also adds an Attribute Values list that shows each value with its attribute. Use it to review and edit extra prices in one place.

name: product_attribute_value_menu
summary: Adds a list of all attribute values, with the attribute and value shown, under the Attributes menu. It also adds an Attribute Values Extra Prices list under Sales Configuration, where extra prices per product can be edited and imported. Extra prices can be changed in the list view.

name: product_average_price_invoice
summary: Computes each product's average purchase price (APP) from posted vendor bills and average sale price (ASP) from customer invoices, as weighted averages of untaxed amounts. The window starts at 30 days and widens up to 360 days until data is found, and the period is stored with the price. Shown on the General Information tab next to Cost, with a daily job and a refresh button, and each company has its own figures.

name: product_barcode_constraint_per_company
summary: Relaxes the barcode uniqueness rule on products, so two products in different companies can share the same barcode. A barcode still has to be unique inside one company. It is a technical change with no new screens.

name: product_barcode_required
summary: Makes the barcode field required on products when the company setting is on. The barcode is filled in from the internal reference by default. The setting is turned on under General Settings, Products.

name: product_brand
summary: Lets you create product brands, each with a logo, a partner and a description, and assign a brand to every product. Sales and invoice reports can then be grouped or filtered by brand. Brands are managed under Sales, Configuration, Products, Product Brands.

name: product_brand_mrp
summary: Adds the product brand to manufacturing orders, so manufacturing reports can be filtered and grouped by brand. A Brand group and filter appears in the manufacturing search view. Useful when you produce for several brands.

name: product_brand_purchase
summary: Adds the product brand to purchase reports, so purchases can be grouped and filtered by brand. The Product Brands menu is also available under Purchase, Configuration, Products. Useful for seeing how much you buy per brand.

name: product_brand_stock
summary: Adds the product brand to stock moves, move lines and stock quants, so Stock reports can be grouped and filtered by brand. A Brand group and filter appears in the stock search views. Useful for checking inventory by brand.

name: product_brand_stock_account
summary: Adds the Brand group and filter to the Stock and Accounting valuation reports, so stock value can be broken down by brand. It depends on the product brand and stock accounting modules. Useful for valuing inventory per brand.

name: product_brand_tag
summary: Lets you add tags to product brands, for example to group brands by category or season. Tags are managed on the brand records and can be used to filter them. It extends the product brand feature.

name: product_brand_tag
summary: Lets you add tags to product brands, for example to group brands by category or season. Tags are managed on the brand records and can be used to filter them. It extends the product brand feature.

name: product_catalog
summary: A backport of the Odoo 17 product catalog, which is a technical base for product picker grids. This module adds a catalog button text field that other modules use. It has no visible screen of its own.

name: product_catalog_sale
summary: Adds a Catalog option to sales order lines, where you tick products in a grid and add them to the order in one go. Open a sales order and click Catalog in the order lines. It speeds up quoting when you add many products.

name: product_catalog_stock
summary: Adds the product catalog to draft stock transfers, so users can search for products and add them quickly to a receipt or delivery. It saves adding lines one by one. The catalog button appears on the transfer form.

name: product_category_active
summary: Lets users archive a product category to hide it from use. Archiving is blocked if products are still in the category or in its sub-categories. The archive button is on the category form.

name: product_category_code
summary: Adds a Code field to product categories, so each category can carry a short identifier. It is a simple extra field on the category form.

name: product_category_code_unique
summary: Makes product category codes unique, and fills in a code from a sequence when none is typed. The check depends on the restriction chosen in settings. This version relies on the product category code module for the code field.

name: product_category_code_unique
summary: Makes product category codes unique, and fills in a code from a sequence when none is typed. You choose one of three restriction levels, whole system, parent and children, or category hierarchy, under General Settings, Product Category Code. The module checks existing codes whenever the restriction changes and shows an error if duplicates exist.

name: product_category_company
summary: Makes product categories company-dependent, so a category can be set for one company and only be used there. It is a technical base that adds a company field on categories. A similar alternative is the product category company favourite module.

name: product_category_company_favorite
summary: Lets each company choose which product categories it uses, so users see only the relevant categories when creating products. You mark categories as favourite per company under Inventory, Configuration, Product Categories while that company is selected. New root categories follow the favourite setting of the current company.

name: product_category_description
summary: Adds a Description text field to product categories. Use it to explain what belongs in each category. The field appears on the category form.

name: product_category_hr_department
summary: Links product categories to HR departments, and uses that link to filter products on sales and purchase order lines by the user's department. You set the department on the product category form. It is useful when each department should only pick its own products.

name: product_category_level
summary: Adds a Level field to product categories that shows how many parent categories sit above each one. It helps you see how deep a category is in the tree. The value is computed from the category hierarchy.

name: product_category_name_translatable
summary: Lets product category names be translated into other languages. A setting chooses which language is used for full category names in lists and reports. It works around a limit in standard Odoo.

name: product_category_product_link
summary: Adds a link from each product category to the products directly in it, so the products can be listed from the category. Products in sub-categories are not included. It is a technical link used by other features.

name: product_category_product_qty
summary: Shows how many product variants are in each product category, as a Variants Quantity field on the category. It gives a quick count of how many products sit in a category. It is a small reporting helper.

name: product_category_tag
summary: Lets users attach tags to product categories, such as labels for grouping or reporting. Tags are added in a Tags tab on the category form. Tags are managed under Inventory, Configuration, Product Categories.

name: product_category_tax
summary: Lets you set customer and vendor taxes on a product category, then push them to all its products with an Apply to Products button. This is handy when every product in a category uses the same tax setup. The taxes are set on the product category form.

name: product_category_type
summary: Adds a Type to product categories. A View category can only hold other categories, and a Normal category can only hold products, which stops a parent view category from being picked on a product. It restores a feature that was in Odoo Community until version 10.

name: product_category_type
summary: Adds a Type to product categories, set to View or Normal. View categories can only hold other categories, and normal categories hold products, which stops users from picking a parent category for a product. It restores a feature that was in Odoo before version 10.

name: product_category_type
summary: Adds a Type to product categories. A View category can only hold other categories, and a Normal category can only hold products, which stops a parent view category from being picked on a product. It restores a feature that was in Odoo Community until version 10.

name: product_category_uom
summary: Sets a default unit of measure on each product category, which new products in that category inherit. It saves choosing the unit for each product. The default is set on the category form.

name: product_category_usage_group
summary: Restricts which users can use a product category. You set a Usage Group on the category, and only members of that group can assign it to products. Set it on the product category form.

name: product_class
summary: Defines product classes, such as Furniture or Electronics, each with a set of allowed attributes and some marked as required. Products in a class can only use the attributes allowed for it, and must fill in the required ones. Classes are created under Inventory or Sales, Configuration, Product Classes.

name: product_code_mandatory
summary: Makes the internal reference a required field on products, so a product cannot be saved without one. Products that had no reference when the module was installed get a temporary one. It applies to the product form.

name: product_code_mandatory
summary: Makes the Internal Reference, which is the product code, required on every product, so a product cannot be saved without one. Products that already have a blank code get a temporary value during installation. It is a rule on the product form.

name: product_code_mixin
summary: A technical mixin that adds a Product Code field to other models, such as sales lines, purchase lines, invoice lines and stock moves. It lets the product's internal reference be shown or exported on those lines. It has no screens of its own.

name: product_code_regex_validation
summary: Lets you set a regular expression on each product category, so product codes in it must match a format. The check runs when you create or rename a product, change its category, or unarchive it. The pattern is set on the category form.

name: product_code_unique
summary: Stops two products from sharing the same internal reference, so each code or SKU is unique across the database. Products without a reference get a temporary one when the module is installed. The check runs when a product is saved.

name: product_company_default
summary: Fills the Company field on new products with the user's current company, so products are not created without one by accident. It only sets the default; users can still change it. It affects product creation.

name: product_company_default
summary: Sets the user's company as the default company on new product templates. It saves choosing the company each time a product is created. It is a small default change on the product form.

name: product_compute_template_field_from_variant_helper
summary: A technical helper for developers that makes it easy to define product template fields computed from variant values. It has no screens for users. Other modules use it to build their own template fields.

name: product_configurator
summary: The base engine for configurable products. It provides attribute restrictions, configuration steps, images for each configuration, and a configurator wizard that other modules use on sales and manufacturing orders. It is rarely used alone, since the Sale and Manufacturing configurators build on it.

name: product_configurator
summary: The base engine for configurable products. It provides attribute restrictions, configuration steps, images for each configuration, and a configurator wizard that other modules use on sales and manufacturing orders. It is rarely used alone, since the Sale and Manufacturing configurators build on it.

name: product_configurator_mrp
summary: Lets you run the product configurator on manufacturing orders, and configure bill of materials lines with attribute choices so components vary with the configuration. The configurator wizard appears on Manufacturing Orders and the BoM settings are on Bills of Materials. It is useful for made-to-order products.

name: product_configurator_sale
summary: Lets you open the product configurator from sales order lines, so the customer's options are chosen in a wizard before the line is added. The chosen configuration is kept on the order line. It is found on the sales order lines.

name: product_contract
summary: Lets products be sold as contracts. Selecting a contract template on a product and confirming a sales order creates a contract for it, with the recurrence and renewal rules set on the product. Contract products are not invoiced directly on the sales order, because the recurring contract handles billing, and the sales order shows a contract count.

name: product_contract
summary: Links products to contract templates, so confirming a sale order creates a recurring contract for each recurring product on it. You mark a product as a contract on its form, choose the contract template, and set the default recurrence rules. Sale orders show a contract count and link to the contracts they created.

name: product_contract_brand
summary: A glue module that passes the brand from a sale order to the contract created from it. It is technical and adds no separate screens. The brand then follows the recurring contract.

name: product_contract_recurrence_in_price
summary: Adds an option on contract products to show the total of all planned invoices in the sales order line. A product that costs 10 per month for a year then shows 120 as its total instead of 10. It can be set on the product or per line in the contract configurator.

name: product_contract_section
summary: Copies sales order sections and notes onto the contracts generated from the order, so the contracts keep the same headings and comments as the quote. Each section appears on the contract of the products it covers, in the original order. This shows on the generated contract lines.

name: product_contract_variable_quantity
summary: Sets default variable quantity settings, meaning the quantity type and formula, on contract products. Sales order lines and the contracts generated from them then start with the right variable quantity rule. The defaults are set on the product form.

name: product_cost_price_avco_sync
summary: Updates a product's cost price from the unit price of incoming stock moves, for products that use the average cost (AVCO) valuation method. This keeps the cost on the product in line with what was actually received. It runs automatically with stock receipts.

name: product_cost_price_avco_sync
summary: For average-cost (AVCO) products, correcting the cost or quantity of a validated receipt restates its valuation layer and re-prices the outgoing moves valued after it, so the product cost and reported margins stay right. Use it only with manual inventory valuation, not automated.

name: product_cost_price_avco_sync
summary: Updates a product's cost price from the unit price of incoming stock moves, for products that use the average cost (AVCO) valuation method. This keeps the cost on the product in line with what was actually received. It runs automatically with stock receipts.

name: product_cost_security
summary: Adds two access levels for product cost, one to view it and one to edit it. Users without read access do not see the Cost field on products, and users without write access cannot change it. Access is granted per user under Settings, Users and Companies, with the Product costs dropdown.

name: product_cost_security
summary: Adds security groups that control who can see and who can edit the product cost price. Users without access do not see the Cost field on product forms. Access is granted per user in Settings, Users, under Product costs.

name: product_cost_security_stock_account
summary: Keeps stock operations working for users who cannot see product costs. Without it, stock moves can fail with a permission error when valuation entries are created. It is a glue module between cost security and stock valuation.

name: product_country_restriction
summary: Defines embargo-style rules that restrict which countries a product can flow to, globally, per category, per product or per variant, with optional date windows. It provides a method that checks whether a product can be used in a country on a given date. It cannot be used alone, so it is a base for other modules.

name: product_customerinfo
summary: Adds a Customers section to the product Sales tab, where each customer gets its own product name, product code, price, minimum order quantity and date range. Pricelist rules can then use these customer prices. It works like the vendor price list but for customers.

name: product_customerinfo_elaboration
summary: Lets you set a default elaboration and elaboration note for each customer and product, using the customer info block on the product's Sales tab. When a quotation is created for that customer, the elaboration is filled in automatically on the order lines. It depends on the sale_elaboration module for the elaboration list.

name: product_customerinfo_invoice
summary: Shows the customer's own product code on customer invoices, taken from the product's customer information. Each invoice line carries the code defined for that customer and product. It depends on the product customer info module.

name: product_customerinfo_picking
summary: Shows the customer's own product code and name on each stock move in a transfer, taken from the customer product info on the product. Useful when a customer refers to items by their own codes.

name: product_customerinfo_sale
summary: Shows each customer's own product code and product name on sales order lines, so sales teams can search a product by the customer's code and see that name in the line description. If the product has no minimum quantity from its price rules, the line quantity starts at the customer's minimum quantity. Set up on the product's customer entries.

name: product_default_code_res_company_code
summary: Generates product internal references automatically, prefixed with the company code, such as COD-000001, with a separate sequence per company. The reference field becomes read-only for products that belong to a company. It only applies to products that have a company set.

name: product_dimension
summary: Adds length, width and height fields to products and product variants, with a dimensional unit of measure. The volume is calculated from the three dimensions. The fields are on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_dimension
summary: Adds length, width and height to products and variants, with a dimensional unit of measure, and computes the volume from them. You fill these in on the Inventory tab of the product. If the product has several variants, the dimensions are shown on the variants.

name: product_document_domain
summary: Fixes the Documents smart button on product forms, so it shows the documents of the product and, for a variant, those of its template. It also adds more filters to the product document search, and the default filter can be removed or changed. This makes the count match what users see.

name: product_document_type
summary: Adds a configurable Document Type to product documents, such as Document, Data Sheet or Safety Data Sheet. Types are managed per company and can be translated. You set the types under Sales, Configuration, Products, Document Types, and pick one on each product document.

name: product_drained_weight
summary: Adds a drained weight field to products, for the weight of the product without its liquid, such as the fill weight of a tinned food. The field is on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_english_name
summary: Shows the English product name next to the name in the user's own language on the product form. This helps spot translation mistakes, especially for products bought abroad. Users need to be in the Show english name group and have a non-English language set.

name: product_eprel
summary: Connects to the EU EPREL product database to pull energy labels and product fiche links for products that have a model identifier and an EPREL category. Users can fetch data on demand from the product form or through a scheduled sync. An EPREL API key is entered under General Settings, Integrations.

name: product_expiry_assign
summary: Lets stock reserve expired lots, which the standard product expiry module blocks. You can turn on Ignore Expiration Date under Inventory settings in Traceability, or set a context key in code. It is useful for moving expired stock to another location.

name: product_expiry_configurable
summary: Sets Use, Removal, Alert and Expiration times on product categories, and those values then fill in the products of the category. Optional scheduled jobs can create activities that warn users when lot dates are close or past. The jobs are switched on under Settings, Technical, Scheduled Actions.

name: product_expiry_simple
summary: A simpler alternative to the standard expiry dates feature, with one expiry date field on lots, moves and stock instead of four, and no automatic date calculation from product delays. It keeps FEFO, meaning first expired first out, and shows an expiry warning on transfers. It is the lighter choice when you enter expiry dates by hand.

name: product_fao_fishing
summary: Adds FAO fishing areas and capture techniques to products, using attributes whose values carry FAO zone codes. You set them on the product template and on the attribute values. It is for fishery products that need these FAO codes.

name: product_fao_fishing
summary: Adds FAO fishing areas and capture techniques to products, using attributes whose values carry FAO zone codes. You set them on the product template and on the attribute values. It is for fishery products that need these FAO codes.

name: product_form_account_move_line_link
summary: Adds a Journal Items button on product forms, for both the product template and its variants, so you can jump straight to the accounting lines for that product. The button shows how many of those lines exist, labeled as invoiced. It appears on the product form in the Sales, Purchase and Inventory apps.

name: product_form_pricelist
summary: Lets users edit fixed-price pricelist items straight from the product form, so the price for a customer group can be set without going to the pricelist. It can also hide the standard sales price field. The fixed prices are listed on the product form.

name: product_form_pricelist
summary: Lets you edit a product's fixed price pricelist items directly on the product form, without going to the pricelist. Items created this way are always fixed prices. It can also hide the Sales price field when the matching setting is on.

name: product_form_sale_link
summary: Adds a Sales button on the product form that opens the sale order lines for that product, with a count shown on the button. It lets a user see how and where a product has been sold. The button is on the product form in the Sales app.

name: product_form_sale_link
summary: Adds a Sales button on product forms that opens the sale order lines for that product. The button shows how many times the product was sold. It is a quick way to see the sales history of a product.

name: product_get_price_helper
summary: A technical helper that lets developers compute a product's price for a given pricelist, fiscal position, company and date in one call. It has no screens for users. Other modules use it to get consistent prices.

name: product_get_price_helper
summary: Adds a helper that computes a product's price from its pricelist, fiscal position, company and date, and returns the value, discount and tax status. It is a developer tool for other modules and has no screens of its own.

name: product_harmonized_system
summary: Stores Harmonized System (H.S.) customs codes, plus local extensions, and lets each product or category carry one. It also records the country of origin of a product, which customs paperwork often needs. The full code list is loaded by localization modules, and the menu is added by a separate stock module.

name: product_harmonized_system
summary: Stores Harmonized System (H.S.) customs codes, plus local extensions, and lets each product or category carry one. It also records the country of origin of a product, which customs paperwork often needs. The full code list is loaded by localization modules, and the menu is added by a separate stock module.

name: product_harmonized_system_delivery
summary: Hides the plain text HS code and country of origin fields that the delivery module adds to products, so users only see the structured H.S. code and origin country. It is a technical clean-up that adds no new screens. It prevents two conflicting customs fields from confusing users.

name: product_harmonized_system_delivery
summary: Hides the plain text HS code and country of origin fields that the delivery module adds to products, so users only see the structured H.S. code and origin country. It is a technical clean-up that adds no new screens. It prevents two conflicting customs fields from confusing users.

name: product_harmonized_system_stock
summary: Adds an H.S. Codes menu under Inventory, Configuration, Products, so the customs codes can be maintained there. It adds no other behaviour. Without this module, the codes are only reachable from technical menus.

name: product_harmonized_system_stock
summary: Adds an H.S. Codes menu under Inventory, Configuration, Products, so the customs codes can be maintained there. It adds no other behaviour. Without this module, the codes are only reachable from technical menus.

name: product_harmonized_system_tax_rate
summary: Stores import duty or tariff rates per H.S. code and country of origin, and shows the rate on the product. Only ad valorem rates, meaning a percentage of value, are supported, and each product has one origin. Rates are added under Inventory, H.S. Codes Tax Rates.
keywords: customs duty rate country of origin

name: product_ingredient
summary: Records the ingredients and allergens of each product and of each lot, with a percentage for each ingredient. Users can print an ingredients label report. Allergen and ingredient lists are kept in the product's Ingredients tab.

name: product_internal_reference_generator
summary: Generates product and variant internal references from a sequence. A product template gets a prefix from a chosen Internal Reference Template, and each variant gets its own number after it. Templates are set under Inventory, Configuration, Internal Reference Templates, and the reference becomes read-only.

name: product_is_bulk
summary: Adds an Is Bulk tick box to products. It is computed from the main unit of measure, but you can set it by hand. Use it to flag products that are handled as bulk.

name: product_list_price_from_pricelist
summary: Sets product sales prices from the rules of a chosen pricelist. An Update Product Prices button applies the pricelist rules to all products in one go. The pricelist is chosen in Sales settings.

name: product_list_price_from_pricelist
summary: Recalculates product sales prices from the rules of a chosen pricelist, using the Update Product Prices button in Sales settings. Use it when sale prices should follow a pricelist formula. You pick the pricelist under Pricing in the settings.

name: product_logistics_uom
summary: Lets you pick a different unit of measure per product for weight and volume, such as litres instead of cubic metres. The unit is set on the product form, and the values are still stored in Odoo's default units. The default units are chosen under Products in General Settings.

name: product_logistics_uom
summary: Lets each product use its own unit of measure for weight and volume, such as litres instead of cubic metres. A default unit can be set for weight, volume and length under General Settings. The values are still stored in the standard units behind the scenes.

name: product_logistics_uom_net_weight
summary: A glue module that makes product logistics units work together with net weight when products use different weight units, so the net versus gross weight check does not fail. It installs automatically when both modules are present. It adds no separate screens.

name: product_logistics_uom_total_weight
summary: Shows the total weight of stock, which is the weight per unit times the quantity, on product kanban and list views and in stock reporting. The total is shown in kilograms or pounds. You find it under Inventory, Products and Inventory, Reporting, Stock.

name: product_lot_sequence
summary: Lets each product have its own lot or serial number sequence, with a prefix, padding and next number. When you create a new lot for the product, its number is proposed from that sequence. The fields appear on the Inventory tab when the product is tracked by lots.

name: product_lot_sequence
summary: Lets each product have its own lot or serial number sequence, which is proposed when new lots are created for that product. The sequence has a prefix, padding and next number. The option is on the Inventory tab of products tracked by lot.

name: product_main_seller
summary: Shows each product's main vendor, which is the first vendor in its vendor list, as a field on the product. It lets you see the default supplier at a glance. It is computed from the vendor list.

name: product_main_seller
summary: Shows each product's main vendor, which is the first vendor in its vendor list, as a field on the product form. It makes it quick to see who a product is normally bought from. It is found on the product form's Purchase tab.

name: product_main_supplierinfo
summary: Shows the main vendor of a product on the product form. The main vendor is the preferred supplier for that product. It is a display addition to the product record.

name: product_manufacturer
summary: Adds manufacturer details to products, including the manufacturer, the manufacturer's product name, its product code and a product web link. These are filled in on the product form. They are useful when you resell goods made by someone else.

name: product_manufacturer
summary: Adds a manufacturer, the manufacturer's product name, code and web address to products. These fields are on the product form. They help record who makes a product and the code they use for it.

name: product_margin_classification
summary: Gives products a margin classification, with a profit margin target and rounding rules, and shows a theoretical price where the sale price differs. Buttons apply the theoretical price to all products, or only to those that are too cheap or too expensive. Classifications are configured under Sales, Configuration, Products, Margin Classifications.

name: product_medical
summary: Adds a base set of medical product fields to products, such as CE certificate link, medical device class, drug category, PPE category, in vitro diagnostic type and declarations of conformity. It is a starting structure for medical and regulated products. The fields are on the product form.

name: product_mrp_info
summary: Adds an MO's smart button on the product form that lists the manufacturing orders producing that product or its variants. It gives a quick view of the production history of a product. It is found on the product form.

name: product_mrp_info
summary: Adds an MO's smart button on the product form that lists the manufacturing orders producing that product or its variants. It gives a quick view of the production history of a product. It is found on the product form.

name: product_multi_barcode
summary: Lets a product have several barcodes, ordered by priority so the first one is the main barcode. Any of them can be scanned or searched to find the product. The barcodes are listed in the Barcodes field on the product.

name: product_multi_barcode
summary: Lets a product have several barcodes, ordered by priority so the first one is the main barcode. Any of them can be scanned or searched to find the product. The barcodes are listed in the Barcodes field on the product.

name: product_multi_barcode_constraint_per_company
summary: A glue module that lets products in different companies share a barcode while still using multiple barcodes per product. It links the two barcode modules together. It adds no screens of its own.

name: product_multi_barcode_stock_menu
summary: Adds a Product Barcodes menu under Inventory, Configuration, Product, so you can see every barcode across all products in one list. It is an overview menu and does not change how barcodes work. Use it to check or audit barcodes.

name: product_multi_category
summary: Lets a product belong to several extra categories as well as its main category. The extra categories are for classification only and do not change pricing, stock or sales behaviour. The field is on the product form.

name: product_multi_category
summary: Lets a product belong to several extra categories alongside its main category, for classification only. The extra categories do not change how stock or accounting work. They are useful for browsing products in more than one way.

name: product_multi_code
summary: Lets a product have several internal references, each entered as a row on the product form. Duplicate references are blocked, and only users in the Manager product multi code group can edit the list. It is useful when one product is known by several codes.

name: product_multi_company
summary: Lets you choose which companies each product is available in. If no company is selected, the product is visible in all of them, and the current company is the default. The selection is made on the General Information tab of the product form.

name: product_multi_company
summary: Lets you choose which companies each product is available in. If no company is selected, the product is visible in all of them, and the current company is the default. The selection is made on the General Information tab of the product form.

name: product_multi_company_stock
summary: Stops a company from being removed from a product's company list while that company still has stock or stock moves for the product. You get an error if you try. It protects stock records from being orphaned.

name: product_multi_image
summary: Adds an image gallery to product templates, so a product can have several images. The first image is the main picture, and each image can be limited to chosen variants. Images are managed on the Images tab of the product template.

name: product_multi_price
summary: Lets a product have several named prices, such as wholesale or retail, shown in an Other Prices list. Those prices can then be used as the base for pricelist formulas. Price names are defined under Settings, Technical, Database Structure.

name: product_net_weight
summary: Adds a Net Weight field to products and renames the existing weight to Gross Weight, so you can record the weight without packaging. Fill in Net Weight on the Inventory tab. The change is in the product form.

name: product_net_weight
summary: Adds a net weight field to products and renames the existing weight field to Gross Weight. Users can record both the weight of the product alone and its weight with packaging. Both are on the product Inventory tab.

name: product_next_reception_date
summary: Shows the next expected receipt date for a product, based on incoming transfers. It helps users see when new stock is due. The date appears on the product form.

name: product_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to product templates and categories. A new product gets the user's default operating unit, and security rules show users only the products of their own units. It needs the operating unit module and is set on the product template form.

name: product_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to product templates and categories. A new product gets the user's default operating unit, and security rules show users only the products of their own units. It needs the operating unit module and is set on the product template form.

name: product_optional_product_quantity
summary: Lets optional products on a product carry a quantity multiplier, so one option can add more than one unit. You turn it on in Sales settings under Product Catalog, and set optional products with quantities on the Sales tab of the product form. Other modules build the user flow on top of it.

name: product_origin
summary: Adds a country and state of origin to products, showing where the product is made or grown. The fields are on the General Information tab of the product form. They can be used for labelling and customs paperwork.

name: product_origin
summary: Stores a product's country of origin and, optionally, the state within it. These are filled in on the General Information tab of the product form. Use it to record where goods come from.

name: product_pack
summary: Lets you define a product as a pack, which is a bundle of other products sold together. You set the pack type and how component prices are charged, then choose the products that make up the pack. This is the base for the sale and purchase pack features and on its own adds the pack settings to the product form.

name: product_pack
summary: Lets a product be a pack made of other products, with a pack type and component pricing. You mark the product as a pack with Is Pack, then add the products included in it. It is a base for sale pack features and other modules.

name: product_packaging_archive
summary: Lets users archive product packagings so they are no longer offered for new orders or transfers. Existing packagings are not changed. It adds an active flag to packagings.

name: product_packaging_calculator
summary: Adds a helper that works out how many of each packaging size make up a given quantity, such as pallets, big boxes and boxes for 2860 units. It is a developer helper that returns the breakdown, and shows it as text on products. It is used when picking stock by packaging.

name: product_packaging_calculator_packaging_level
summary: Changes the packaging breakdown text to use packaging level codes, such as 1PL or 2TU, instead of full packaging names. It joins the packaging calculator with the packaging level feature. It is a display change only.

name: product_packaging_container_deposit
summary: Adds a container deposit product to package types, so a deposit fee, such as for a returnable plastic box, can be added to sales and purchase orders. The deposit product should be a service product. The largest package type on each level is used unless a specific one is given on the order line.

name: product_packaging_dimension
summary: Stores length, width, height, weight and volume on product packagings, with their own units. These are filled in on each packaging line of the product. They are used when you need the size of a box or case.

name: product_packaging_dimension
summary: Stores the length, width, height, weight and volume of each product packaging, with units of measure. These are shown on the packaging line of the product. Useful for shipping and warehouse planning.

name: product_packaging_level
summary: Groups product packagings into levels: primary for the retail pack, secondary for a box, and tertiary for a pallet. You manage the levels under Inventory, Configuration, Products, Product Packaging Level. This is different from the standard package types, which are used for put-away routing.

name: product_packaging_level
summary: Lets users define packaging levels such as primary retail pack, secondary box and tertiary pallet, and attach each product packaging to one. Levels are managed under Inventory, Configuration, Products, Product Packaging Level. Package types can also be linked to a level.

name: product_packaging_level_purchasable
summary: Restricts purchase orders to the packagings you allow. You mark a packaging level, or a specific packaging, as Can be purchased, and purchase lines that do not match the setup are blocked. It applies to purchase order lines.

name: product_packaging_level_salable
summary: Restricts sales order lines to the packagings allowed for sale. You mark a packaging level, or a specific packaging, as Can be sold, and sale lines that do not fit are blocked. It applies to sales order lines.

name: product_packaging_level_salable
summary: Blocks sales order lines that use a packaging which is not set to be sold at its level. Each packaging level has a Can be sold setting that decides which packagings appear on sales order lines. It adds a check when the order line is saved.

name: product_packaging_level_vendor
summary: Marks a packaging level as vendor specific, meaning it is the pack a supplier uses rather than one for customers. It is a flag on the packaging level used when working with suppliers.

name: product_packaging_multi_barcode
summary: Lets each product packaging have several barcodes, ordered by priority with the main one first. The barcodes can be scanned to identify that packaging. It extends the multiple barcodes feature to packagings.

name: product_packaging_unece
summary: Adds UNECE Rec 21 packaging type codes to packaging levels, and those codes carry through to the product packagings. It is used to identify the packaging type in standard trade data. It adds no screens of its own.

name: product_packaging_unit_price_calculator
summary: Adds a wizard that works out a unit price from a packaging price, using the packaging quantity. Buttons next to the sales price, supplier price and pricelist items open the wizard, and the result is saved to that field. The sale price of each packaging is shown on the product's Inventory tab.

name: product_packaging_usability
summary: Adds a search view for product packagings, and a button on products that switches to their packagings. It makes packagings easier to find and reach. It adds no new data fields.

name: product_price_category
summary: Adds a Price Category to products so one pricelist rule can apply to a whole group of products, for example all products in one pricing group. The category is set on the product's General Information, and pricelist rules can be applied to it using Applied on. Set up under Sales, Configuration, Pricelists.

name: product_pricelist_alternative
summary: Lets a pricelist have alternative pricelists, so a product's price becomes the lowest of the reference price and the alternatives. A rule set to ignore alternatives keeps its own price. It is set up on the pricelist form.

name: product_pricelist_alternative
summary: Lets a pricelist have alternative pricelists, and uses the lowest price across the reference pricelist and its alternatives. A rule set to Ignore for the alternative policy turns this off for that product. It is set on the pricelist and on its rules.

name: product_pricelist_assortment
summary: Creates pricelist items automatically from product assortments, so a price applies to all products in an assortment. It links the assortment feature to pricelists. Assortment items are listed on the pricelist form.

name: product_pricelist_by_contact
summary: Lets each contact have its own pricelist for sales, overriding the one from its parent company. The pricelist is set on the Sales and Purchases tab of a child contact. Changing the parent's pricelist overwrites the child contacts' pricelists.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print
summary: Lets users print a price list from the Sales product menu, from selected products or variants, from a pricelist, or from a customer. The printout shows the prices for the chosen pricelist and customer. Advanced pricelist access must be granted to users.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print
summary: Prints a price list directly from products, product variants, pricelists or customers. You can start from Sales, Products, Print Price List, or from the Action menu of a product list. Users need Advanced Pricelists turned on to see these menus.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_company_group
summary: Extends the price list print so it picks the products sold to a group of companies. You select the partner that represents the group on the Customers page, then print or export. It helps when one customer group orders across several companies.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_company_group
summary: Lets users print a price list for the products sold to a company group. Selecting a customer in the group fills the price list with the group's products. It extends the direct price list print.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_website_sale
summary: Lets users group a printed price list by website public categories instead of internal categories. It is for shops that show products on the website by public category. It extends the direct price list print.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_website_sale
summary: Lets the price list print group products by website public categories instead of internal ones. You turn on Filter or Group by public categories in the print wizard and then choose the website categories. It suits price lists for an online shop.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_xlsx
summary: Lets the price list print wizard export to XLSX (Excel) as well, and adds the option to show internal categories. It needs the report XLSX module. Use it when you want a spreadsheet instead of a printed price list.

name: product_pricelist_direct_print_xlsx
summary: Lets users export a price list as an Excel-style spreadsheet, in addition to printing it. The option appears in the price list print wizard. It extends the direct price list print feature.

name: product_pricelist_discount_by_range
summary: Lets a pricelist give different discounts depending on the reference price, such as the cost, falling in each band. A product whose reference price is outside all bands gets no pricelist and a warning. Bands are set on the pricelist item when Discount Type is By range.

name: product_pricelist_fixed_currency_rate
summary: Lets a pricelist rule that is based on another currency use a fixed exchange rate, instead of the live rate. The rate is set on the rule when it is computed from another pricelist. It keeps prices steady across currencies.

name: product_pricelist_fixed_currency_rate
summary: Lets a pricelist rule convert from another currency at a fixed rate that you enter, instead of the daily exchange rate. The field appears as Fixed Currency Rate on advanced pricelist rules that are based on another pricelist. It keeps prices stable across currency moves.

name: product_pricelist_item_list_view
summary: Adds a Pricelist rules menu that lists every pricelist rule in one searchable list. It is useful when you have many rules, such as many fixed prices on variants. You can find a single variant's price without opening each pricelist.

name: product_pricelist_item_list_view
summary: Adds a Pricelist rules menu that lists every pricelist rule in one searchable list. It is useful for finding one variant's price among many fixed-price rules. The menu is under Sales.

name: product_pricelist_item_uom
summary: Lets pricelist rules be set in a unit of measure with a minimum quantity, so prices can differ by unit, for example per gram compared with per kilogram. You set the unit of measure and minimum quantity on a rule for a product. Prices in the rule should be proportional to the product's unit.

name: product_pricelist_margin
summary: Shows the cost, margin and margin percentage on each rule of a pricelist, so users can see the profit as they change the rule. The three columns appear on the price rules list of the pricelist form. It helps with price simulations while editing.

name: product_pricelist_margin
summary: Shows each pricelist rule's cost, margin and margin percent next to its price, so you can check profit while you edit the rules. The three columns appear on the Price rules list of a pricelist. The figures follow the rule as you change it, so you can simulate prices.

name: product_pricelist_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to pricelists, proposed as the user's default when a pricelist is created. Security rules let users see only the pricelists of the operating units they can access. It is set on the pricelist form.

name: product_pricelist_product_price_history
summary: Keeps a log of every change to a fixed price in a pricelist, with the old and new price, the user and the date. A Pricelist History list under Sales, Products shows recent changes. Managers can also print product labels for new prices straight from this list.

name: product_pricelist_revision
summary: Adds a Pricelist items list where you can select several rules to duplicate them with a new date range and a percentage change. It also shows the percentage change in fixed price against the previous version. Use it to plan price changes ahead of time.

name: product_pricelist_revision
summary: Adds a Pricelist items list where you can select several rules to duplicate them with a new date range and a percentage change. It also shows the percentage change in fixed price against the previous version. Use it to plan price changes ahead of time.

name: product_pricelist_revision
summary: Lets users copy pricelist items into new versions with new date ranges and a percentage change, and see how much each fixed price moved from the last version. The Duplicate Item action on the Pricelist Items list starts this. It is a way to plan and record price increases.

name: product_pricelist_simulation
summary: Adds a See Price per Pricelist button on the product form that shows the price in every pricelist for a chosen date and quantity. You choose which pricelists take part in this view on the pricelist form. It helps you compare prices without changing anything.

name: product_pricelist_simulation
summary: Adds a See Price per Pricelist button on the product form that shows the product's price in every pricelist for a chosen date and quantity. It is useful for comparing prices across customer groups. The result opens in a dialog.

name: product_pricelist_simulation
summary: Adds a See Price per Pricelist button on the product form that shows the price in every pricelist for a chosen date and quantity. You choose which pricelists take part in this view on the pricelist form. It helps you compare prices without changing anything.

name: product_pricelist_simulation_margin
summary: Extends the pricelist price preview with the cost, margin and margin percent for each pricelist. You open it from the See Price per Pricelist button on the product form. You can change the date or quantity to check margins in different situations.

name: product_pricelist_supplierinfo
summary: Builds a sales pricelist from the vendor prices on a product, so a rule can be based on the supplier price, optionally with a margin added. The margin is set on each vendor line by users in the Show sale margin group. Checking the result works like any other sales pricelist.

name: product_pricelist_supplierinfo
summary: Lets sales pricelist rules be based on the vendor prices on a product, with an optional sale margin added on top of the purchase price. Supplier minimum quantities can be ignored for the pricelist. The rules are set on pricelist items under Sales, Configuration.

name: product_print_category
summary: Groups products into print categories, with rules that mark a product as To print when chosen fields such as name or price change. You can print the products in bulk from Sales, Products, Print Categories, or from the Print Products action. Price tag templates are needed, and you can create them in the UI.

name: product_print_category
summary: Lets products be grouped into print categories, each with its own label template. A product is flagged to reprint when chosen fields change, such as its name or price. Print jobs are started from Sales, Products, Print Categories, or from the product list actions.

name: product_product_template_link
summary: Adds a button on a product variant that opens its product template. It is a navigation shortcut from the variant back to the template it belongs to. It adds no data fields.

name: product_product_template_link
summary: Adds a button on the product variant form that opens its product template. It saves navigating back to the template to edit shared fields. It is a small navigation addition.

name: product_profile
summary: Lets users set many product fields at once by choosing one profile on the product form, such as a profile for manufactured or purchased items. Profiles can also be used as search filters and groups. Profiles are created under Sales, Configuration, Product Profiles.

name: product_profile
summary: Lets you set up a product profile, such as a sales, purchase or manufacturing type, that fills in many product fields at once from one selection on the product form. Profiles are defined under Sales, Configuration, Product, Product Profiles. Deselecting a profile leaves the values in place for manual editing.

name: product_readonly_security
summary: Adds a permission that stops a user from creating, editing or deleting products and variants, so the user can only view them. You switch it off for a user with the Product edition option on the user form. It is a security setting, not a new screen.

name: product_readonly_security
summary: Adds a Product edition permission that users can be switched off, so they can view products without creating, changing or deleting them. It is set on each user's access rights.

name: product_refund_account
summary: Lets you set separate refund accounts on products and categories, one for credit notes and one for debit notes. These accounts are copied onto refund and debit notes created from invoices. You set them in the Accounting section of the product.

name: product_replenishment_cost
summary: Adds a Replenishment Cost field to products, which is what it would cost to buy one more unit at current market prices, as opposed to the valuation cost. Other margin modules rely on it, and it can be overridden in code. It is a base for margin analysis.

name: product_replenishment_cost
summary: Adds a Replenishment Cost field to products, which is what it would cost to buy one more unit at current market prices, as opposed to the valuation cost. Other margin modules rely on it, and it can be overridden in code. It is a base for margin analysis.

name: product_restrict_payment_acquirer
summary: Limits which online payment providers a customer can use on the portal, based on the products on their sales order. You set the allowed providers on the product's Sales tab, and choose First product or All products in Sales settings. Leaving a product's list empty disables this restriction for that product.

name: product_restricted_type
summary: Lets a product category be restricted to one product type, such as storable or service. Only categories that match a product's type are offered when that type is chosen, and saving a mismatch gives an error. The restriction is set on the category.

name: product_route_mto
summary: Marks a product as make-to-order when one of its routes is set to MTO, and adds an Is MTO flag to the product. It makes MTO products easy to find. It is a technical flag based on routes.

name: product_route_profile
summary: Replaces single route settings on products with reusable route profiles, which each contain a set of routes and can be given a priority per company. Profiles are created under Inventory, Configuration, Settings, Routes Profiles and applied from the Inventory tab on the product. It makes it easier to set up the same routes for many products.

name: product_route_profile_internal_resupply
summary: Adds internal supply routes that apply only to chosen products, such as a retail store restocking some items from one warehouse and others from another. These routes are kept out of the shared route profile. It is set on the warehouse and on the product's Inventory tab.

name: product_sale_description
summary: Adds a short sales description and a longer formatted sales description to products. These can be published to websites or marketplaces. The fields are on the product form.

name: product_sale_manufactured_for
summary: Lets users record which customers a product was made specifically for. On sales orders, the product choice is limited to products made for the selected customer. The field is on the product form.

name: product_sale_team
summary: Adds a Sales Team field to each product so it can be tied to the sales team that owns it. This is a technical building block that other modules rely on, not a standalone feature. The field sits on the product form under General Information.

name: product_search_multi_value
summary: Lets you search products by a list of internal references or barcodes at once, separated by spaces. Use the Multiple search field on the product search view. By default it looks at the internal reference and barcode, and the fields can be changed in a system parameter.

name: product_secondary_unit
summary: Lets you define secondary units of measure for a product, such as selling by weight while also tracking pieces or boxes, even when those units belong to a different unit category. Each secondary unit has a conversion factor and a setting that controls whether the two quantities update each other, stay independent, or prioritise the secondary one. It appears as a Secondary Unit of Measure section on the product's General Information tab.

name: product_secondary_unit
summary: Adds secondary units of measure per product with a conversion factor, such as cases or pallets alongside pieces. You create the units on the General Information tab of the product and set the factor. The secondary unit then appears on the product's sales and purchase quantities.

name: product_secondary_unit
summary: Adds secondary units of measure per product with a conversion factor, such as cases or pallets alongside pieces. You create the units on the General Information tab of the product and set the factor. The secondary unit then appears on the product's sales and purchase quantities.

name: product_sequence
summary: Automatically numbers products with an internal reference taken from a sequence, and lets each product category use its own prefix and sequence. Internal references must be unique and filled in. Category prefixes are set on the Product Category form.

name: product_sequence
summary: Generates product internal references from a sequence, with an optional prefix for each product category. Internal references are unique and required. The prefix and sequence are set on the product category form.

name: product_set
summary: Defines product sets, which are named lists of products used together, so they can be added to a document in one step. Each line can be edited or removed after the set is added. The set is not linked to the document afterwards, so it is a base for the sales version.

name: product_set
summary: Defines product sets, which are named lists of products used together, so they can be added to a document in one step. Each line can be edited or removed after the set is added. The set is not linked to the document afterwards, so it is a base for the sales version.

name: product_set
summary: Lets you save a named group of products that are usually sold or ordered together, then add the whole group to a document in one step. Once added, each line can be edited or removed like any other line. This is the base feature; companion modules such as sale_product_set provide the screens for using it.

name: product_set_sell_only_by_packaging
summary: Warns when a product set is marked as sell only by packaging but some of its lines have no packaging chosen. The product form shows a warning with a link to each affected line so the user can fix them. It connects the packaging-only selling rule with product sets.

name: product_simple_seasonality
summary: Adds simple seasons, such as a recurring yearly period, that can be assigned to products and packagings. It is a way to mark which products belong to which season so other processes can act on them. Seasons are created by the user and picked on the product form.

name: product_sold_by_delivery_week
summary: Adds a hint on products and order lines that shows whether the product was sold and delivered in recent weeks. The hint characters and the number of weeks are configurable with system parameters. Only users in the weekly selling info groups can see it.

name: product_sold_by_delivery_week
summary: Adds a hint on products and order lines that shows whether the product was sold and delivered in recent weeks. The hint characters and the number of weeks are configurable with system parameters. Only users in the weekly selling info groups can see it.

name: product_standard_margin
summary: Shows the standard margin and markup of a product, computed from its sale price and standard cost, both taken without tax. The two fields appear on the product form. They are based on the same currency for both prices.

name: product_standard_margin
summary: Shows the standard margin and markup of a product, computed from its sale price and standard cost, both taken without tax. The two fields appear on the product form. They are based on the same currency for both prices.

name: product_standard_margin_security
summary: Restricts the margin and markup fields on products to users who are allowed to see product costs. It works together with the product cost security module. Users without the right permission do not see the margins.

name: product_standard_price_tax_included
summary: Adds a Cost Price Tax Included field on products, which works out the cost with the sale tax included. It also lets a pricelist be based on that figure, which matters when sale prices include tax, as in a consumer shop. It is only useful when sale prices are tax-included.
keywords: pricelist based on cost with tax

name: product_state
summary: Adds a lifecycle state to products, such as In Development, Normal, End of Lifecycle, or Obsolete. Users pick the state from buttons at the top of the product form. The available states are maintained as a list of product states.

name: product_state
summary: Adds a life-cycle state to products, such as In Development, Normal, End of Lifecycle and Obsolete, and a list of states you can manage. The state is set by picking one of the buttons above the product form. States are configured under Sales, Configuration, Products, Product States.

name: product_state_active
summary: Lets a product state archive or reactivate the products that carry it. Choosing a state marked to activate or deactivate changes whether the product is active. States are set under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product States.

name: product_state_sale
summary: Makes product states available in Sales, so the product lifecycle status is visible to the sales side. This is a thin link module: the states themselves are set up under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product States, and no new screens are added.

name: product_state_stock_base
summary: Makes product states available in Inventory, using the same state setup as the product lifecycle module. States are created under Inventory > Configuration > Products > Product States. No new fields are added by this module.

name: product_status
summary: Computes a status on each product (end of life, discontinued, or new) from date fields on the product's Sales tab. End of life takes priority over discontinued until, which takes priority over new until. Because the status is based on today's date, it updates by itself without anyone editing the product.

name: product_sticker
summary: Lets you attach sticker images, such as certifications or eco logos, to attributes, attribute values or categories. Other modules can then print them on documents like delivery slips when the law requires it. Stickers are managed under Settings, Technical, Database Structure, Product Stickers.

name: product_sticker
summary: Lets you attach sticker images, such as ISO, ecology or safety logos, to product attributes, attribute values and categories, with optional text under the image. It is a base module meant for other modules to build on, for example to print a legally required eco logo on delivery slips. Stickers are managed under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Product Stickers.

name: product_stock_state
summary: Shows a stock state on each product at a glance: In Stock, In Limited Stock, Resupplying, or Out of Stock. The state compares available quantity to a threshold, and a positive forecast means resupplying. Thresholds can be set company-wide, per category, or per product, and the state shows in the product list.

name: product_stock_state
summary: Adds a Stock State field to products, showing On Demand, In Stock, Limited Stock, Resupplying or Out of Stock. It is worked out from quantity on hand against thresholds set per company, per category or per product. The field is shown in the product list.

name: product_supplier_code_purchase
summary: Shows the vendor's own product code on purchase order lines, taken from the vendor price for that product. It helps purchasers match a line to the supplier's catalogue. It appears as a column on the purchase order lines.

name: product_supplier_code_purchase
summary: Shows the vendor's own product code on purchase order lines, taken from the product's vendor pricelist. The code appears in the Product Supplier Code column of the line. It helps match the order to the supplier's catalogue.

name: product_supplierinfo_archive
summary: Lets you archive a vendor pricelist line so it stops applying, without deleting it. Use the archive action on a vendor pricelist entry. Existing variants are not affected, only new ones.

name: product_supplierinfo_archive
summary: Lets you archive individual vendor price lines on a product, so an old supplier price can be hidden without being deleted. Archiving applies to new product variants only, existing variants are not changed. Use the archive action on any vendor price line.

name: product_supplierinfo_code
summary: Shows the main vendor's product code on the product itself, as a Supplier Product Code field. This lets you see the supplier reference without opening the vendor list. It is computed from the vendor pricelist.

name: product_supplierinfo_comment
summary: Adds a comment field to each vendor price line on a product, for notes about a supplier's price or terms. The comment is stored on the vendor price record and shows in the product's Purchase tab.

name: product_supplierinfo_disable_autocreation
summary: Adds a switch in Purchase settings that stops Odoo from automatically creating vendor price lines when purchase orders are validated. Turn it off if purchases should not add or update supplier prices. It is in the Orders section of the purchasing settings.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer
summary: Adds a Customers section on the Sales tab of products, where you record prices per customer, using the same structure as vendor prices. Pricelist rules can then take their price from these customer prices. It is set on the product form.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer
summary: Adds a Customers section on the Sales tab of products, where you record prices per customer, using the same structure as vendor prices. You can also store the customer's own product name and code. Pricelist rules can then take their price from these customer prices.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer_invoice
summary: Puts the customer's own product code on customer invoice lines, taken from the product's customer prices. The code shows on each invoice line for that customer. It is useful when customers identify products by their own codes.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer_picking
summary: Shows the customer's product code and name on the stock moves of a delivery, using the customer prices stored on each product. This helps warehouse staff and delivery documents use the customer's references. It applies to transfers.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer_sale
summary: Fills the customer's product code and name on sale order lines from the customer prices on each product. You can also search products by the customer's name or code, and the values show in the line description. With advanced price formulas, the quantity can be proposed from the customer's minimum quantity.

name: product_supplierinfo_for_customer_sale
summary: Fills the customer's product code and name on sale order lines from the customer prices on each product. You can also search products by the customer's name or code, and the values show in the line description. With advanced price formulas, the quantity can be proposed from the customer's minimum quantity.

name: product_supplierinfo_import
summary: Imports vendor price lists from Excel files, matching products by any product field such as the internal reference. Import templates map each spreadsheet column to an Odoo field, and the import creates or updates vendor prices with a start date and lead time. Found under Purchase > Configuration > Import vendor pricelists.

name: product_supplierinfo_import_by_barcode
summary: Imports vendor price lists from Excel files into the product vendor pricelists, matching products by any product template field such as barcode or code. You start from Purchase, Configuration, Import vendor pricelists, and can save column templates for each supplier's file layout. Products can also be created during the import.

name: product_supplierinfo_import_by_barcode_margin
summary: Adds a sale margin field to the vendor pricelist import wizard, so imported supplier prices carry a sales margin. It works with the supplier-price sales pricelist module. Use it when you want the imported vendor lines to produce sale prices with a markup.

name: product_supplierinfo_import_margin
summary: Extends the vendor pricelist import wizard so you can set a sale margin on the imported prices as they come in. The margin is carried to the resulting price list lines. It needs the supplier pricelist sale margin feature installed.

name: product_supplierinfo_indirect_cost
summary: Adds an estimated indirect cost, as a percent and an amount, to each vendor pricelist line. Indirect costs cover things like transport, handling and insurance, and are estimated from past experience. You set them on the Purchase tab of the product.

name: product_supplierinfo_purchase_contact
summary: Adds a Purchase Contact field to vendor price lines, so a different contact can receive purchase orders created from replenishment for that price. It is set on the vendor pricelist, and the contact is used when ordering from Replenishment.

name: product_supplierinfo_purchase_contact
summary: Adds a Purchase contact to each vendor pricelist line, so a replenishment order for that product goes to that contact instead of the vendor. You set the contact on the vendor pricelist entry. Pressing Order once then creates the purchase order for that contact.

name: product_supplierinfo_qty_multiplier
summary: Lets a vendor pricelist line set a multiplier quantity, so purchase quantities are rounded up to a multiple, for example a case of 6. You set Multiplier Qty on the vendor line in the Purchase tab of the product. If you enter 9 on a line with multiplier 6, the quantity becomes 12.

name: product_supplierinfo_qty_multiplier
summary: Lets a vendor price line carry a multiplier quantity, such as cases of 6, so purchase quantities are rounded up to a full multiple. Ordering 9 units on a multiplier of 6 becomes 12. The multiplier is set on the vendor pricelist line in the product's Purchase tab.

name: product_supplierinfo_revision
summary: Lets you duplicate vendor price lists into a new version valid from a chosen start date, optionally with a percentage increase or decrease. The previous price is kept on the new line so you can see how prices changed over time. Used from the Vendor Pricelists list with the Duplicate Supplier Info action.

name: product_supplierinfo_security
summary: Hides the vendor pricelist on product forms from users who are not purchase users. Only users with purchase permission can see the vendor prices. It is a security rule and adds no new screens.

name: product_supplierinfo_standard_price
summary: Lets you pick one vendor pricelist line as the product's standard cost price, and shows how far the stored cost differs from the vendor price. It uses web notifications to alert users. The vendor lines are on the product form.

name: product_supplierinfo_stock_picking_type
summary: Lets you choose a specific receipt operation type for each vendor price line, so purchases from a given supplier go to a chosen incoming type. It shows on the product's Purchase tab in the vendor lines. Storage locations must be turned on in Inventory settings.

name: product_supplierinfo_update_price
summary: Updates the product's vendor price from a purchase order line. When the price on the line differs from the vendor price list, a refresh button appears next to the unit price so you can save the new price in one click. It works from the purchase order form.

name: product_tag_view
summary: Shows product tags on the General Information tab of the product and variant forms. In standard Odoo the tags sit under the Sales tab, which is hidden for products not marked as sellable, so this makes tags visible and editable for purchase-only products too.

name: product_tags_code
summary: Adds a unique code to product tags, so a tag can be referenced by a short code instead of its name. Codes are entered on the tag form, which is reached from the product form.

name: product_tax_multicompany_default
summary: Sets default sales and purchase taxes on new products for every company, and adds a button to copy taxes from other companies by matching tax code. If the taxes differ between companies, the product is flagged. Taxes are configured under Invoicing, Configuration, Settings.

name: product_tax_multicompany_default
summary: Sets default sales and purchase taxes on new products for every company, and adds a button to copy taxes from other companies by matching tax code. If the taxes differ between companies, the product is flagged. Taxes are configured under Invoicing, Configuration, Settings.

name: product_tax_multicompany_default
summary: Sets default sales and purchase taxes on new products for every company, and adds a button to copy taxes from other companies by matching tax code. If the taxes differ between companies, the product is flagged. Taxes are configured under Invoicing, Configuration, Settings.

name: product_template_default_weight
summary: Uses the template weight when a variant has no weight of its own, so stock moves and delivery packages do not total to zero. It affects picking weight totals and the choose delivery package wizard. The template weight is the fallback.

name: product_template_has_one_variant
summary: Adds a Has one Variant flag to product templates, which is true when the template has exactly one variant. A filter for it is available in the product template list. It is useful for finding simple products that have no variants.

name: product_template_multi_link
summary: Links one product to others as cross-sell suggestions, such as an add-on, or up-sell suggestions, such as a higher-end model. Links are managed under Sales, Configuration, Products, Product Links, or from the product form, and can be used to sync with an e-commerce site.

name: product_template_multi_link
summary: Lets you link product templates to each other as cross-sells, which suggest an extra product, and up-sells, which suggest a higher-end one. You manage links under Sales, Configuration, Products, Product Links, or from each product. It can serve as a base for e-commerce synchronisation.

name: product_template_multi_link_date_span
summary: Adds start and end dates to product links, so a cross-sell or up-sell suggestion is only active for a set period. Some link types can require a start date.

name: product_template_tags
summary: Lets you add tags to products, such as seasonal or featured labels, and shows them on the kanban cards. Tags are created and edited on the product form. It is a simple way to classify products beyond their categories.

name: product_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval step for new products. A new product stays archived in the In Development state until an approver signs off through the Request Validation button and the Reviews section. Approval rules are set up as tier definitions in the tier validation settings.

name: product_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Estimates the total weight of a given quantity of a product using the weights of its packagings, falling back to the product weight when no packaging weight is set. The result is returned in the product's unit of measure. All weights are assumed to be in kilograms, so this is an estimate for shipping or logistics planning.

name: product_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Estimates the weight of a quantity of a product from its packaging weights, and returns it in the product unit. If no packaging has a weight, it falls back to the product weight. It is a function for developers and other modules, with no screen of its own.

name: product_uom_measure_type
summary: A technical module that adds a measure type, such as weight, volume or length, to units of measure and to products. It adds no features on its own, and other modules use the type. Nothing needs to be configured by users.

name: product_uom_measure_type
summary: A technical module that adds a measure type, such as weight, volume or length, to units of measure and to products. It adds no features on its own, and other modules use the type. Nothing needs to be configured by users.

name: product_uom_po_domain
summary: Filters the Purchase unit of measure on products so that only units in the same category as the main unit are offered. Without it, every unit of measure appears in the list, including inconsistent ones. It applies on product template and variant forms.

name: product_uom_updatable
summary: Lets you change a product's unit of measure after it has been used in a transfer, as long as the new unit is in the same category and has the same ratio. Otherwise the change stays blocked. It is set on the product form.
keywords: change unit of measure after use

name: product_uom_updatable
