summary: Lets you change a product's unit of measure after it has already been used in a stock transfer, as long as the new unit is in the same category and has the same conversion factor. This relaxes the normal lock on unit of measure changes.

name: product_uom_use_type
summary: Sorts each unit of measure into use for sales only, for purchases only, or for both, which is the default. Product sale and purchase units then offer only the matching units. The use type is set on each unit of measure.

name: product_usability
summary: Adds a main Product menu that gathers all product-related entries, such as products, attributes, pricelists, units of measure, categories and tags, in one place. It also adds access rules so users can create products and attributes without full Inventory or Sales manager rights. This is a technical extension of product access and menus.

name: product_usability
summary: Adds a main Product menu that gathers products, attributes, pricelists, units of measure and categories in one place. It also adds access rules so users can create products, variants and attributes without full Inventory or Sales manager rights. It fills gaps in the standard product menus.

name: product_user
summary: Adds a Product Manager field on product templates, which points to the internal user responsible for the product. Set it on the product template form. It shows who owns each product.

name: product_variant_attribute_name_manager
summary: Controls how attributes appear in product variant names. You choose whether to show the attribute name and its value, set a short name, set the order of attributes, and decide whether single-value attributes are shown. These options are set on each attribute and on each product's attribute lines.

name: product_variant_attribute_tax
summary: Lets you set one or more taxes on each product attribute value, such as an extra tax on a particular option. You set them in the Taxes column of each value under Configuration, Products, Attributes. Other modules use these taxes on sales orders.

name: product_variant_attribute_tax
summary: Lets you set one or more taxes on each product attribute value, such as an extra tax on a particular option. You set them in the Taxes column of each value under Configuration, Products, Attributes. Other modules use these taxes on sales orders.

name: product_variant_change_attribute_value
summary: Adds a wizard that changes or removes attribute values on many variants at once, from the action menu of the variant list. When a value is removed from every variant of a template, it is also removed from the template's configuration. It saves editing each variant by hand.

name: product_variant_configurator
summary: When you create a product variant, shows a table of the template's attributes so you can pick valid values. It also controls, per template, whether variants are created automatically. The option is set on the Variants tab of the product, and the variant wizard is under Sales, Catalog.

name: product_variant_configurator
summary: When you create a product variant, shows a table of the template's attributes so you can pick valid values. It also controls, per template, whether variants are created automatically. The option is set on the Variants tab of the product, and the variant wizard is under Sales, Catalog.

name: product_variant_configurator_manual_creation
summary: Adds a Create Pending Variants button on templates set to not create variants automatically. The button opens a wizard where you choose the attribute values for the variants you want, and only those are created. It gives you control over which variants exist.

name: product_variant_default_code
summary: Generates each variant's internal reference from a mask on the template, such as a prefix plus attribute codes like JKT01-Wh-M. A default mask is built from the template's attribute lines when none is given. Attribute codes are set on attributes and values, and the reference prefix on the template.

name: product_variant_default_code
summary: Generates each variant's internal reference from a mask on the template, such as a prefix plus attribute codes like JKT01-Wh-M. A default mask is built from the template's attribute lines when none is given. Attribute codes are set on attributes and values, and the reference prefix on the template.

name: product_variant_default_code
summary: Generates each variant's internal reference from a mask on the template, such as a prefix plus attribute codes like JKT01-Wh-M. A default mask is built from the template's attribute lines when none is given. Attribute codes are set on attributes and values, and the reference prefix on the template.

name: product_variant_multi_link
summary: Extends product links down to individual variants, so a specific variant, such as one particular color, can be linked to another product or variant. You set the template first, then pick the variant.

name: product_variant_name
summary: Lets each product variant have its own name, different from the name of its template. The name is shown on the variant. Use it when a variant needs a distinct label.

name: product_variant_name
summary: Lets each product variant have its own name, different from the name of its template. The name is shown on the variant. Use it when a variant needs a distinct label.

name: product_variant_route_mto
summary: Lets you turn make-to-order (MTO) on for individual product variants, even when the parent product is not MTO. A variant can be marked MTO on its own, but cannot be set to non-MTO while its template is MTO. The setting sits on the variant's inventory route options.

name: product_variant_sale_price
summary: Sets a fixed sale price on each product variant, instead of an extra price relative to the template. Each variant's price can then be changed on its own. It replaces the standard extra price setting with absolute prices.

name: product_variant_sale_price
summary: Sets a fixed sale price on each product variant, instead of an extra price relative to the template. Each variant's price can then be changed on its own. It replaces the standard extra price setting with absolute prices.

name: product_variant_specific_description
summary: Gives each product variant its own internal notes, separate from the template's description. The variant's text is shown on its form. Use it when variants need different notes.

name: product_view_inventory_no_search_default_my_count
summary: Removes the My Counts default filter from the inventory counting view, so all counts show when it opens. It is a small view change with no new data. Users can still apply the filter themselves.

name: product_warranty
summary: Sets a warranty duration on products, and on vendor lines, along with the return type, return instructions and return address. This is used in sales and returns. Return instructions are managed under Sales, Configuration, Product Return Instructions, in debug mode.

name: product_warranty
summary: Lets you record a warranty period on products and on each supplier price line, so warranty terms are tied to what you sell and buy. It also keeps a list of return instructions and return addresses that can be attached to supplier lines and the company. Warranty fields show on the product Sales tab and on the Purchase tab of supplier information when Purchase is installed, and return instructions are managed under Sales > Configuration.

name: project_administrator_restricted_visibility
summary: Adds a Restricted Project Administrator access group in the Projects category. Users in this group get the same rights and menus as a project administrator, but they only see the projects they are allowed to see, like a regular project user. Assign it on the user form under Settings > Users & Companies > Users.

name: project_administrator_restricted_visibility
summary: Adds a Restricted Project Administrator access group in the Projects category. Users in this group get the same rights and menus as a project administrator, but they only see the projects they are allowed to see, like a regular project user. Assign it on the user form under Settings > Users & Companies > Users.

name: project_analytic_code
summary: Adds the analytic account code to projects, so you can find a project by typing its analytic code in any project lookup field, such as when entering timesheets. The code is also shown on project kanban cards, and projects can be grouped and searched by analytic account.

name: project_budget
summary: Lets users create and view budgets directly from a project, without needing accounting access. It links OCA Account Budget records to the project, so the budget and its lines show on the project's Budget tab. Users need the Project Budget viewer or manager group.

name: project_crm_postsale_automation
summary: Automatically creates recurring post-sale follow-up opportunities in the CRM from a project. On the project's Post-sale Tracking tab you pick a responsible salesperson, a customer, an interval (days, weeks, months, quarters or years) and optionally a day of the month, and a scheduled job creates the leads, copying the project's internal notes and adding seasonal tags. If one project has a configuration problem, it is logged and skipped so the other projects still run.

name: project_department
summary: Adds a Department field to projects and tasks, so you can record which department owns each one. The field appears in the project and task list, search and form views, so you can filter and group by it. It uses the company's HR departments.

name: project_department
summary: Adds a Department field to projects and tasks, so you can record which department owns each one. The field appears in the project and task list, search and form views, so you can filter and group by it. It uses the company's HR departments.

name: project_duplicate_subtask
summary: Adds a Duplicate with subtasks action on tasks. You can run it from a task's Action menu or on several selected tasks in the task list, and it copies each task together with its child tasks.

name: project_forecast_line
summary: Plans team capacity in the Forecast app. It creates positive forecast lines from each employee's working schedule and negative lines from project tasks, sales quotation lines and time off, so you can see whether a team has spare capacity or is overbooked. It can also estimate when a department will have room to start a new project. This is a planning and reporting setup for managers, not a day-to-day screen.

name: project_group
summary: Adds a Groups field to projects. When a project is set to Invited internal users, everyone in the chosen groups can see that project and its related tasks. Set it in the project's visibility settings.

name: project_group_hr_timesheet
summary: A small technical add-on that makes Project Group work with timesheets, by adding a record rule for timesheets on those projects. It has no screens of its own and is used behind the scenes.

name: project_hr
summary: A technical module that links HR to projects. It adds employee categories to projects and tasks, links tasks to employees, and adds employee categories to users. When a task has an employee category, the assignee list is limited to users whose employee has that category, and the task categories are limited by the project's categories.

name: project_hr
summary: A technical module that links HR to projects. It adds employee categories to projects and tasks, links tasks to employees, and adds employee categories to users. When a task has an employee category, the assignee list is limited to users whose employee has that category, and the task categories are limited by the project's categories.

name: project_hr_expense_analytic
summary: Lets you tag an expense to a project and, optionally, to one of its tasks. Setting the project on an expense fills in its analytic distribution from the project's analytic account, so the cost lands on the project without accounting work. The fields appear on the expense form.

name: project_internal_access_from_portal
summary: Lets portal users, such as customers or other external contacts, open an internal project and its tasks in the portal. It works when a project's Visibility is set to Invited internal/portal users, which you choose in the project's Settings tab under Project > Configuration > Projects.

name: project_kanban_form_direct_access
summary: Makes the project name on a kanban card open the project form directly. Without it, users go through the three dots menu and then Settings. It is a small UX change on the Project dashboard.

name: project_key
summary: Gives each project and task a short key that identifies it uniquely. Projects get an auto-generated key from a sequence, which you can override by typing your own, and tasks get a key and a shareable URL field. The key appears on project create forms in the dashboard and project list.

name: project_key
summary: Gives each project and task a short key that identifies it uniquely. Projects get an auto-generated key from a sequence, which you can override by typing your own, and tasks get a key and a shareable URL field. The key appears on project create forms in the dashboard and project list.

name: project_list
summary: Adds a list view for projects, so you can see them as a table instead of only as kanban cards. It appears alongside the other project views in the Project app.

name: project_merge
summary: Adds a merge wizard to the task list, which combines several selected tasks into one. You can create a new task or merge into an existing one, choose the destination project and set the assignees. Use it to clean up duplicate tasks.

name: project_milestone_status
summary: Shows two progress percentages on project milestones and project updates. Execution is the share of task hours completed compared with pending, and Dedication compares planned hours with effective hours. It depends on timesheets, so it is most useful where hours are recorded.

name: project_milestone_tree
summary: Adds a list (tree) view of project milestones, so you can see milestones across projects in a table. It only adds access to that view and changes nothing else.

name: project_multi_company
summary: A technical module that adds a Company field to project stages and task stages, so each company can have its own stages in a multi-company database. It is a setup detail rather than a screen users work in directly.

name: project_no_portal
summary: Adds a per-company switch under Settings > Project that blocks customer portal access to projects and tasks, and it is on by default. When it is on, existing portal projects move to employee visibility, Share Project and Share Task are disabled, and portal users are denied in searches. Turning it off restores the share actions.

name: project_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to projects and tasks, so users only see the projects and tasks of their own operating units. New projects go to the user's default unit, and a task takes the unit of its project. It needs the Operating Unit module.

name: project_parent
summary: Lets a project have a parent project and sub-projects, so projects can be nested. You can group projects by Parent Project in the kanban and list views, and set the parent on the Settings tab of the project form.

name: project_parent_task_filter
summary: Adds a filter and a group-by so you can show only parent tasks inside a project, and sort tasks by their parent. It also shows the subtask count on kanban cards and turns on subtasks in each project's settings.

name: project_parent_task_filter
summary: Adds a filter and a group-by so you can show only parent tasks inside a project, and sort tasks by their parent. It also shows the subtask count on kanban cards and turns on subtasks in each project's settings.

name: project_pivot
summary: Adds a pivot view for projects, so you can analyse planning dates, project status and other project fields in a cross-tab table. It is one of the view options in the Project app.

name: project_pivot
summary: Adds a pivot view for projects, so you can analyse planning dates, project status and other project fields in a cross-tab table. It is one of the view options in the Project app.

name: project_portal_task_visibility
summary: Changes what portal users see of tasks. Customers only see tasks where they are explicitly a follower, so seeing the project is no longer enough. When a new task is created, the project's followers are added as followers of that task too.

name: project_portal_task_visibility
summary: Changes what portal users see of tasks. Customers only see tasks where they are explicitly a follower, so seeing the project is no longer enough. When a new task is created, the project's followers are added as followers of that task too.

name: project_purchase_link
summary: Gives access to the purchase orders and vendor bills linked to a project, and adds counts and totals for them on the project. It works through the analytic account on purchase and bill lines, and users need the full accounting and analytic accounting groups.

name: project_purchase_link
summary: Gives access to the purchase orders and vendor bills linked to a project, and adds counts and totals for them on the project. It works through the analytic account on purchase and bill lines, and users need the full accounting and analytic accounting groups.

name: project_required_field_by_stage
summary: Makes chosen fields mandatory once a task reaches a given stage. On each task stage you pick the fields that must be filled, and a task cannot move into that stage until they are. Set it under Project > Configuration > Task Stages.

name: project_reviewer
summary: Lets you assign several reviewers to a project task, through a Reviewers field on the task. It is a simple way to record who needs to check the work.

name: project_risk
summary: Tracks project risks using the MOR risk method. Each risk gets probability, impact and proximity ratings, and a rating is calculated from the risk matrix. You set it to Active or Closed, record responses, and see a risk count on each project. Default categories are provided and can be extended under Project > Configuration.

name: project_risk
summary: Tracks project risks using the MOR risk method. Each risk gets probability, impact and proximity ratings, and a rating is calculated from the risk matrix. You set it to Active or Closed, record responses, and see a risk count on each project. Default categories are provided and can be extended under Project > Configuration.

name: project_role
summary: Keeps a project roster. A company-wide list of roles is maintained under Project > Configuration > Project Roles, and people are assigned to those roles on a project, on a company level, or across companies. Each project has an Assignments smart button, and there are settings to inherit assignments and limit roles to assigned ones.

name: project_role
summary: Keeps a project roster. A company-wide list of roles is maintained under Project > Configuration > Project Roles, and people are assigned to those roles on a project, on a company level, or across companies. Each project has an Assignments smart button, and there are settings to inherit assignments and limit roles to assigned ones.

name: project_sale_order_link
summary: Links sales orders and sales order lines to a project, its tasks, and the employee map. Each project gets a smart button that opens the related sales orders, so you can see what was sold for a project.

name: project_sequence
summary: Gives each project an automatic sequence code, shown in its display name using a pattern such as code followed by name. The pattern can be changed under Project > Configuration > Settings, and the list view has a filter on the code.

name: project_sequence
summary: Gives each project an automatic sequence code, shown in its display name using a pattern such as code followed by name. The pattern can be changed under Project > Configuration > Settings, and the list view has a filter on the code.

name: project_share
summary: Adds read-only collaborators to shared projects who can see the kanban and list views the same way internal users do. It extends the project sharing wizard and collaborator settings with a read-only option and an editing-collaborators list.

name: project_stage_extra_info
summary: Adds a Description and an Is Closed flag to project stages, which the menu calls Project Statuses, and adds filters on projects that use them. Managers set the status on a project under Project > Configuration > Project Statuses.

name: project_stage_extra_info
summary: Adds a Description and an Is Closed flag to project stages, which the menu calls Project Statuses, and adds filters on projects that use them. Managers set the status on a project under Project > Configuration > Project Statuses.

name: project_stage_last_update_date
summary: Adds a field recording the last date and time a project's stage was changed. It shows how long a project has been sitting in its current stage.

name: project_stage_last_update_date
summary: Adds a field recording the last date and time a project's stage was changed. It shows how long a project has been sitting in its current stage.

name: project_stakeholder
summary: Tracks stakeholders for each project: a contact, a stakeholder role and a note. Roles are managed as their own list, and a contact's form shows the projects they are involved in.

name: project_status
summary: Adds a Project Status to projects, managed under Project > Configuration > Project Statuses. Each status has a sequence, a description, and Closed and Folded flags, and you pick the status on the project form.

name: project_stock
summary: Lets users use products directly from a project task. Products are added on the Stock Info tab and confirmed to create stock moves, which are completed when the task reaches a done stage. It needs an operation type set up in Inventory and storage locations enabled.

name: project_stock_analytic_tag
summary: Puts analytic tags back on project tasks, so the analytic items created by stock moves from a task carry those tags. It is useful for tracking the cost of materials used on a task.

name: project_stock_product_set
summary: Lets a task use product sets, which are preset groups of products. Choosing Add set on a task creates stock lines for each product in the set on the Stock Info tab. The project stage settings Use Stock Moves and Done Stock Moves control when those moves apply.

name: project_tag_hierarchy
summary: Gives project tags a hierarchy, so a tag can have parent and child tags and the tags form a tree. It is a technical structure for organising project labels.

name: project_tag_multicompany
summary: Adds a Company field to project tags. A tag with no company is shared across all companies, and a tag with a company is only visible in that company.

name: project_tag_multicompany
summary: Adds a Company field to project tags. A tag with no company is shared across all companies, and a tag with a company is only visible in that company.

name: project_tag_security
summary: Restricts project tags to chosen projects. You set Allowed Projects on a tag, and that tag can then only be used on those projects and their tasks. A tag with no allowed projects stays available everywhere.

name: project_task_add_very_high
summary: Adds High and Very High levels to the task priority field, so the priority widget shows three stars instead of one on tasks and on the kanban view. Uninstalling the module turns High and Very High tasks back to Normal.

name: project_task_add_very_high
summary: Adds High and Very High levels to the task priority field, so the priority widget shows three stars instead of one on tasks and on the kanban view. Uninstalling the module turns High and Very High tasks back to Normal.

name: project_task_analytic_propagation
summary: Keeps analytic accounts in step when a task's account changes, so timesheets already recorded (even if validated or pending) pick up the new account. It also copies a project's analytic account to its tasks, and a task's project to its timesheets. It is used from sales orders, task smart buttons and the Extra Info tab.

name: project_task_analytic_propagation
summary: When a task's analytic account changes, as happens with a sales order item, the analytic account on the linked unbilled timesheets is updated too. You trigger it from the task smart button on a sales order, and it works on sales orders that are not yet invoiced.

name: project_task_analytic_propagation
summary: Lets the analytic account on timesheets change even after they are validated, invoiced or pending, when the linked task changes account. Changing a project's analytic account also updates all of its tasks, so the timesheets follow the new account.

name: project_task_ancestor
summary: Restores the Ancestor Task field that Odoo removed in version 18. It sets each task's top-level parent on tasks and timesheets, so you can group Project and Timesheet lists by the ancestor task and use it in reports.

name: project_task_code
summary: Gives each new task a sequential task number, which is kept when a task is duplicated. On a project's Settings tab you choose whether the task name shows the number and title, or only the number.

name: project_task_code_portal
summary: Shows task codes instead of database IDs in the customer portal, including task lists, task pages, search and task URLs. Customers can search tasks by their code, and the task form shows the portal link to share.

name: project_task_create_date
summary: Adds a Creation Date column to the task list view. If the column is hidden, you can turn it on from the list's optional columns menu.

name: project_task_creation_description_notification
summary: When a task is created, the task's description is added to the message posted to followers. Recipients get the context in the notification without opening the task.

name: project_task_customer_ref
summary: Adds an Order Customer Reference field to tasks, to hold the customer's PO or requisition number. A task created from a confirmed service sale order copies the order's customer reference, and edits are written back to the sale order when its reference is empty. The field can also be added to website forms that create tasks.

name: project_task_default_stage
summary: Brings back the Default for New Projects option on task stages, and a stage tab on projects, as in Odoo version 8. You can choose which stages new projects start with, and check the defaults.

name: project_task_default_stage
summary: Brings back the Default for New Projects option on task stages, and a stage tab on projects, as in Odoo version 8. You can choose which stages new projects start with, and check the defaults.

name: project_task_default_stage
summary: Adds a Default for New Projects option on task stages, and a stage tab on projects. You can choose which stages new projects start with and check the defaults.

name: project_task_default_user
summary: Assigns default users to tasks automatically. Default users can be set on the project and on each task stage, with a mode of Replace or Merge. Stage defaults take priority over project defaults when a task is created or moved to that stage.

name: project_task_description_portal
summary: Adds a separate Portal Description tab to tasks, with a switch to show it to customers instead of the normal description. The standard description is still shown to portal users when the switch is off.

name: project_task_description_template
summary: Lets you save description templates for tasks and apply one to a task to fill in its description. Each template has a name, text, active flag and company, and a task has a field to pick the template.

name: project_task_description_template
summary: Lets you save description templates for tasks and apply one to a task to fill in its description. Each template has a name, text, active flag and company, and a task has a field to pick the template.

name: project_task_link
summary: Adds a smart button on the project form that opens the project's tasks. The button label can be customised.

name: project_task_material
summary: Records the products or materials used on a task, with quantities, in a tab on the task form. It is a simple record only, and creates no stock moves or accounting entries.

name: project_task_material
summary: Records the products or materials used on a task, with quantities, in a tab on the task form. It is a simple record only, and creates no stock moves or accounting entries.

name: project_task_name_with_id
summary: Shows the task ID in the task name, for example [ID] task name, and lets you search for tasks by ID. This helps when people select a task by its number, such as on a timesheet.

name: project_task_name_with_id
summary: Shows the task ID in the task name, for example [ID] task name, and lets you search for tasks by ID. This helps when people select a task by its number, such as on a timesheet.

name: project_task_name_with_id
summary: Shows the task ID in the task name, for example [ID] task name, and lets you search for tasks by ID. This helps when people select a task by its number, such as on a timesheet.

name: project_task_note
summary: Adds an Internal Notes field to tasks, which only internal users can see. Use it for remarks that should not reach customers or portal users.

name: project_task_parent_completion_blocking
summary: Stops a parent task from being marked as done while any of its child tasks is still open. Close the child tasks first, and the parent can then be completed.

name: project_task_parent_completion_blocking
summary: Stops a parent task from being marked as done while any of its child tasks is still open. Close the child tasks first, and the parent can then be completed.

name: project_task_parent_due_auto
summary: When the due date of a subtask changes, the parent task's due date is recalculated automatically. This keeps parent deadlines in line with their subtasks.

name: project_task_personal_stage_auto_fold
summary: When a task is closed or cancelled from its project stage, the personal My Tasks stage of the assignee who did it moves to the folded personal stage too. Only that user's personal stage changes. The project stage names must match the personal stage names for this to work.

name: project_task_personal_stage_auto_fold
summary: When a task is closed or cancelled from its project stage, the personal My Tasks stage of the assignee who did it moves to the folded personal stage too. Only that user's personal stage changes. The project stage names must match the personal stage names for this to work.

name: project_task_product
summary: Lets you set a product on a task, so each task says which product it relates to. It also adds a task count to products and product templates, so you can see how many tasks use a product.

name: project_task_product_stock
summary: Adds a lot or serial number to a task's product, for products tracked by lot. It also adds a task count on lots, so you can see which tasks used a given lot.

name: project_task_project_required
summary: Makes Project a mandatory field on tasks, so no task can be saved without a project. A company setting called Require Projects on Tasks can switch this off for a given company.

name: project_task_pull_request
summary: Adds a PR URI field to tasks and lets you require a PR link before a task can move into chosen stages. You pick the required stages under Pull Request URIs on the project's settings. A task without a PR link is blocked from those stages with a validation error.

name: project_task_pull_request
summary: Adds a PR URI field to tasks and lets you require a PR link before a task can move into chosen stages. You pick the required stages under Pull Request URIs on the project's settings. A task without a PR link is blocked from those stages with a validation error.

name: project_task_pull_request_state
summary: Adds a PR State field (Draft, Open, Merged or Closed) to tasks, next to the PR URI field. The default state can be set in General Settings or per project, and the list of states can be changed in code.

name: project_task_pull_request_state
summary: Adds a PR State field (Draft, Open, Merged or Closed) to tasks, next to the PR URI field. The default state can be set in General Settings or per project, and the list of states can be changed in code.

name: project_task_recurring_activity
summary: Lets a recurring task carry activities, such as calls or emails, that are created again each time the task recurs. Each activity is set a number of days after the task creation date. It is set on the Recurrence tab of a recurring task, after enabling recurring tasks in settings.

name: project_task_recurring_activity
summary: Lets a recurring task carry activities, such as calls or emails, that are created again each time the task recurs. Each activity is set a number of days after the task creation date. It is set on the Recurrence tab of a recurring task, after enabling recurring tasks in settings.

name: project_task_related
summary: Adds a Related Tasks tab on the task form, so you can link tasks that relate to each other without a parent or child relationship.

name: project_task_report
summary: Adds a basic printable report for tasks. From a task's Print menu you can choose Print Task, which shows the task details, or Print Task and Chatter, which also includes the messages.

name: project_task_report
summary: Adds a basic printable report for tasks. From a task's Print menu you can choose Print Task, which shows the task details, or Print Task and Chatter, which also includes the messages.

name: project_task_sign_oca
summary: Sends signature requests from a task to its customer, using Sign templates. You can use the Sign from template action on a task, and requests are linked to the task and its project. A template can also be set up to create requests automatically.

name: project_task_stage_allow_timesheet
summary: Marks task stages as open for timesheets. Timesheets can be entered on tasks in a stage with Allow Timesheet ticked. It is set on the stage under Project > Settings > Stages, in debug mode.

name: project_task_stage_auto_state
summary: Automatically marks open tasks as done or cancelled after they have been in a stage for a set number of days. You configure the days and the states per task stage in debug mode, and a daily scheduled action processes the tasks and posts a message in the chatter.

name: project_task_stage_change_restriction
summary: Limits who can move a task into a given stage: only users assigned to the task, project managers, or members of chosen groups. You set this on the task stage under Project > Configuration > Task Stages in debug mode, in the Stage Change Restriction group.

name: project_task_stage_lock
summary: Locks the task stages in the kanban view so one project's board cannot change shared stages, and removes the default group-by from the stage list so the stage order is visible. It is useful when stages are shared across projects and their order must be controlled centrally.

name: project_task_stage_lock
summary: Locks the task stages in the kanban view so one project's board cannot change shared stages, and removes the default group-by from the stage list so the stage order is visible. It is useful when stages are shared across projects and their order must be controlled centrally.

name: project_task_stage_mgmt
summary: Lets you create and assign task stages in the project creation wizard, so a new project starts with its stages. The stages are then visible on the project views.

name: project_task_stage_mgmt
summary: Lets you create and assign task stages in the project creation wizard, so a new project starts with its stages. The stages are then visible on the project views.

name: project_task_stage_state
summary: Adds a State setting to task stages, so moving a task into a stage also sets the task's state to match. The state is set on the stage under Project > Configuration > Stages.

name: project_task_stage_state
summary: Restores a State field on project stages, which Odoo removed in version 8. Each stage can be linked to a state, which lets you group several stages into a few broad groups for automated actions and business logic.

name: project_task_stock
summary: Lets users use products directly from a project task. Products are added on the Stock Info tab and confirmed to create stock moves, which are completed when the task reaches a done stage. It needs an operation type set up in Inventory and storage locations enabled.

name: project_task_stock_product_set
summary: Lets a task use product sets, which are preset groups of products. Choosing Add set on a task creates stock lines for each product in the set on the Stock Info tab. The stage settings Use Stock Moves and Done Stock Moves control when those moves apply.

name: project_task_tag
summary: Limits the tags a task can use to the ones chosen on its project. Tags not set on the project cannot be picked for its tasks.

name: project_task_tag
summary: Limits the tags a task can use to the ones chosen on its project. Tags not set on the project cannot be picked for its tasks.

name: project_template
summary: Lets you mark any project as a template with the Is Template field, filter the list to templates, and create new projects from them. The Create Project from Template link is available on template cards in the kanban view and on the project form.

name: project_timeline
summary: Adds a Timeline view to tasks and projects, showing them along a timeline based on Planned Start and Planned End dates. When a user is assigned to a task with no planned start date, the current time is filled in. The date fields are in the Extra Info tab, which is visible in debug mode.

name: project_timeline
summary: Adds a Timeline view to tasks and projects, showing them along a timeline based on Planned Start and Planned End dates. When a user is assigned to a task with no planned start date, the current time is filled in. The date fields are in the Extra Info tab, which is visible in debug mode.

name: project_timeline_hr_timesheet
summary: Adds task progress from timesheets to the Timeline view, so each task bar shows how much of it has been worked. It extends the Project Timeline module.

name: project_timeline_hr_timesheet
summary: Adds task progress from timesheets to the Timeline view, so each task bar shows how much of it has been worked. It extends the Project Timeline module.

name: project_timesheet_billable_per_line
summary: Lets you mark individual timesheet lines as billable and create sales orders from them. Under Timesheets > Timesheets to bill you select the lines and use Create Sales Orders, which makes one order per analytic account. It is compatible with CRM timesheets.

name: project_timesheet_holidays_dynamic_description
summary: Copies the description from a time off request into the timesheet lines generated from it. This saves retyping the same note on the timesheet. It is switched on per leave type with the Dynamic Description option.

name: project_timesheet_holidays_editable
summary: Makes timesheet lines generated from time off editable again, instead of locked. This lets someone correct the hours actually worked, for example for medical leave. The edit level is set per time off type, with the Generate Timesheets option enabled.

name: project_timesheet_time_control
summary: Records the exact start time of a timesheet line, down to the minute and second, and lets users start and stop timers. On the timesheet form the Date field carries a time, and selecting a task fills in its project. It is found under Timesheets > Timesheet > All Timesheets.

name: project_timesheet_time_control
summary: Records the exact start time of a timesheet line, down to the minute and second, and lets users start and stop timers. On the timesheet form the Date field carries a time, and selecting a task fills in its project. It is found under Timesheets > Timesheet > All Timesheets.

name: project_type
summary: Adds a Project Type and a Task Type, so projects and tasks can be categorised with a list you define under Project > Configuration > Project Types. Types can have parents and subtypes, and projects and tasks can be grouped by type.

name: project_update_portal
summary: Lets project followers and update followers see project updates in the customer portal, without full system access. Portal users can open a list of a project's updates from the project page and view each update in detail. It needs no setup after installation.

name: project_update_visible
summary: Shows the project on the Project Update form, so you can see which project an update belongs to on the same screen. It is found under Project > Manage > Project Updates.

name: project_version
summary: Adds Versions to projects, so you can create versions for a project and assign each task to one of them. This lets you generate reports by project version, such as the release a task belongs to.

name: purchase_advance_payment
summary: Lets you pay a vendor in advance on a purchase order, before or during billing. Advance payments are recorded with a Pay Purchase Advance button, and when the vendor bill is created you choose which advances to attach to it. The advances are listed on the purchase order.

name: purchase_advance_payment_line
summary: Adds advance payment lines to purchase orders. From a purchase order you click Create Payment Line to schedule a payment to the vendor, and the order shows the payment lines and their counts. It needs the SEPA credit transfer and payment mode setup in accounting.

name: purchase_all_shipments
summary: Replaces the In Shipments button on purchase orders with an All Shipments button. It opens the original receipt plus every receipt grouped with it, including those chained by push rules, in the same way the Sales app shows all deliveries for an order.

name: purchase_all_shipments
summary: Replaces the In Shipments button on a purchase order with All Shipments, which shows the original receipt plus every other receipt linked to it through chained or grouped procurements. This matches how the sales module shows all deliveries from a sales order. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_allowed_product
summary: Restricts products on purchase orders and supplier bills to those the vendor can supply. An Order and invoice only supplied products option, set per vendor and copied to their purchases and bills, limits product selection. It can still be changed on each order or bill.

name: purchase_allowed_product
summary: Restricts product choices on purchase orders and vendor bills to the products the chosen vendor supplies. Turn it on for a vendor and its purchases and bills only offer products that vendor is listed for. It is set on the contact under Sales and Purchases.

name: purchase_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic distribution to purchase orders. If every line has the same distribution, the order takes that value, and if the order has one set, all its lines inherit it, which saves entering it line by line.

name: purchase_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic distribution to purchase orders. If every line has the same distribution, the order takes that value, and if the order has one set, all its lines inherit it, which saves entering it line by line.

name: purchase_analytic_distribution_model_warehouse
summary: Lets analytic distribution models be chosen by warehouse, so purchase order lines get the right analytic distribution based on the receiving warehouse. Set the Warehouse on a distribution model under Accounting > Configuration > Analytic Distribution Models. Users can still change the distribution by hand.

name: purchase_analytic_global
summary: Adds a single analytic account to a purchase order that applies to all of its lines. It gives one global analytic plan for the whole order, instead of setting it per line.

name: purchase_analytic_global
summary: Adds one analytic distribution on a purchase order that applies to all of its lines at once, so you do not have to set analytic accounts line by line. It is set on the purchase order header.

name: purchase_analytic_required
summary: Makes the analytic account a required entry on the purchase order form, so orders cannot be saved without one. It builds on Purchase Analytic.

name: purchase_analytic_tag
summary: Adds analytic tags to purchase order lines, so the analytic entries generated from them carry those tags. Tags are a second way to group costs in analytic reports.

name: purchase_analytic_tag
summary: Adds analytic tags to purchase order lines, so the analytic entries generated from them carry those tags. Tags are a second way to group costs in analytic reports.

name: purchase_auto_bill_on_receipt
summary: Creates and posts a vendor bill automatically when a purchase receipt is validated, using a scheduled action. Returns create a posted credit note when the return lines update the order quantities. Auto-billing is set for the company and can be overridden per vendor, with a per-order switch to block it.

name: purchase_backorder
summary: Shows goods received but not yet invoiced, and backordered products, on purchase orders and their lines. A PO Backorders report under Purchase > Purchase lists these quantities and values with the last received and last billed dates, and it can be printed for selected lines.

name: purchase_billing_address
summary: Adds a separate invoice address to purchase orders. Vendors can have a Purchase invoice address contact, which is offered on each purchase order's Invoice address field, so bills go to the right place.

name: purchase_blanket_order
summary: Lets you agree a blanket order with a vendor: a set quantity of products at a fixed price, valid until a set date. Confirmed blanket orders are then used to create new purchase orders at that price until the quantity is used up or the validity ends. It is found under the Purchase menu as Blanket Orders.

name: purchase_blanket_order
summary: Lets you agree a fixed price and total quantity with a vendor in a blanket order, valid until an expiry date. Confirmed blanket orders are then used to create new purchase orders at the agreed price until the quantity or date runs out. Blanket orders have their own menu in the Purchase app.

name: purchase_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user clicks Cancel on a purchase order from the form or list view, a confirmation wizard appears where an optional reason can be entered. The reason, user and date are stored on the order. Orders cancelled by other flows, such as merging RFQs, are not affected.

name: purchase_cancel_reason
summary: Requires a reason from a configured list whenever a draft, RFQ or purchase order is cancelled. The chosen reason is stamped on the order, so you can later report why orders were cancelled. Reasons are set up under Purchase > Configuration.

name: purchase_cancel_reason
summary: Asks for a reason when a purchase order is cancelled. The cancel wizard offers a configured list of reasons, and the chosen one is stored on the order. It works for orders in Draft, RFQ Sent or Purchase Order state.

name: purchase_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to purchase orders, which can be typed in or loaded from a template. The comment can sit above or below the order lines, and it appears on the printed order.

name: purchase_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to purchase orders, which can be typed in or loaded from a template. The comment can sit above or below the order lines, and it appears on the printed order.

name: purchase_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a stored Commercial Vendor field to purchase orders, showing the parent company behind the vendor contact. You can group RFQs and purchase orders by it in the search view, so contacts of the same company roll up together. It works like the Commercial Partner field on invoices.

name: purchase_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a stored Commercial Supplier field to purchase orders, the purchasing twin of the commercial partner on invoices. Use it to group RFQs and purchase orders by the supplier's parent company in the search view.

name: purchase_container
summary: Adds container details to purchase orders and receipts, such as container type, reference, bill of lading number, shipping agent, volume and cost. Containers link to the purchase order and to the incoming transfer, which helps track goods shipped in containers.

name: purchase_create_bill_button
summary: Restores a Create Bill button in the header of a confirmed purchase order, so a vendor bill can be made straight from the order. This button was removed in the move to Odoo 19.
keywords: make vendor bill from purchase order

name: purchase_date_planned_manual
summary: Keeps the planned date that a user sets on purchase order lines, so the system no longer changes it. Lines that are expected to arrive late, based on the scheduled date and vendor lead time, are shown in red on the PO views.

name: purchase_default_terms_conditions
summary: Fills new purchase orders with default terms and conditions, taken from the company or from the vendor. It is switched on in Purchase settings, where the default text is also set, and each vendor can have its own text.

name: purchase_default_terms_conditions
summary: Puts default terms and conditions on purchase orders, taken from the company or from the vendor. You turn on the default terms option in Purchase settings, enter the company text, and can add vendor-specific terms on the vendor contact. They then appear on new quotations.

name: purchase_default_terms_conditions
summary: Fills new purchase orders with default terms and conditions, taken from the company or from the vendor. It is switched on in Purchase settings, where the default text is also set, and each vendor can have its own text.

name: purchase_delivery_split_date
summary: Creates one incoming shipment per scheduled date when a purchase order is confirmed, so goods arriving on different days are received separately. If the scheduled dates on lines change later, the receipts are reorganised to match.

name: purchase_delivery_split_date
summary: Creates one receipt per scheduled date when a purchase order is confirmed, so products due on different days arrive on separate receipts. If the scheduled dates on the lines change later, the receipts are reorganised to match.

name: purchase_deposit
summary: Lets you take a deposit from a vendor on a confirmed purchase order, as a percentage or a fixed amount, using a Register Deposit button. The deposit is billed as a vendor bill line, using a Purchase Deposit product set in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_deposit
summary: Lets you register a deposit on a confirmed purchase order, as a percentage down payment or a fixed amount. A Register Deposit button opens a wizard that can create the deposit bill straight away, which is usually the first bill for the order.

name: purchase_discount
summary: Adds a discount percentage to purchase order lines, and a negative value works as a surcharge. The discount shows on the order and the printed report. Discounts can be stored on the vendor price lines of a product and applied automatically to new orders.

name: purchase_exception
summary: Lets you attach customizable exceptions to purchase orders, such as a product not found or a wrong line format, and filter orders by exception type to fix them. It is especially useful when importing many orders at once and some contain errors. Exceptions can be ignored per line.

name: purchase_exception
summary: Attaches customisable exceptions to purchase orders, so problem orders can be flagged, filtered by exception type and fixed. It is most useful for mass imports of orders, where lines may be wrong, such as a product not found. Lines can be marked to ignore an exception.

name: purchase_exception
summary: Attaches customisable exceptions to purchase orders, so problem orders can be flagged, filtered by exception type and fixed. It is most useful for mass imports of orders, where lines may be wrong, such as a product not found. Lines can be marked to ignore an exception.

name: purchase_fop_shipping
summary: Sets a minimum purchase amount per vendor for free shipping, and flags purchase orders below it so users can add shipping costs or confirm anyway. The amount is set on the vendor contact and the order shows whether the threshold has been reached.

name: purchase_force_invoiced
summary: Lets users mark a locked, done purchase order as Force Invoiced, so it leaves the Waiting Bills list even though not every quantity was billed. It is for disputed quantities or old orders from a migration that you do not want chasing.

name: purchase_force_invoiced
summary: Lets you mark a confirmed and received purchase order as Fully Billed even when the vendor bill is lower than what was received, for example when a supplier disputes quantities. Force-invoiced orders also drop out of the vendor bill matching view. The checkbox is on the Other Information tab for users with the technical setting enabled.

name: purchase_force_invoiced
summary: Lets users mark a locked, done purchase order as Force Invoiced, so it leaves the Waiting Bills list even though not every quantity was billed. It is for disputed quantities or old orders from a migration that you do not want chasing.

name: purchase_force_invoiced
summary: Lets users mark a locked, done purchase order as Force Invoiced, so it leaves the Waiting Bills list even though not every quantity was billed. The field is only visible to users with a technical setting. It is for disputed quantities or old orders from a migration that you do not want chasing.

name: purchase_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced quantity to each purchase order line. The amount entered is subtracted from what is still to be billed, so the to-invoice figure goes down. The field is optional and can be hidden.

name: purchase_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced field on each purchase order line that reduces the quantity still to bill by a set amount. Use it to write off part of a line without a credit note. The field is optional and can be hidden.

name: purchase_fully_invoiced
summary: Adds a Fully Invoiced status to purchase orders that counts only posted bills, not drafts. It gives filters for Fully Received and Fully Invoice Validated orders, so you can see which orders are really closed.

name: purchase_fully_received
summary: Adds an is fully shipped flag to purchase orders that is correct even when some receipts were cancelled. Filters let you list orders that are fully received and fully invoiced, so you can see what is really complete.

name: purchase_invoice_method
summary: Lets you override how a purchase order is billed. You can allow a vendor bill before goods are received, or require receipt first. The Invoice Method is set on the Other Information tab of the purchase order.

name: purchase_invoice_method
summary: Lets you set the invoice method on each purchase order, under Other information. You can force a bill to be created even before receipt, or switch an order from invoicing on ordered quantities to invoicing on received quantities.

name: purchase_invoice_new_picking_line
summary: When a bill is created from a purchase order, it also adds lines for products that arrived on the order's receipts but are not on the order. This is for paying for items that were delivered by mistake, rather than sending them back.
keywords: products not on purchase order billed

name: purchase_invoice_partial_status
summary: Adds a Partially Invoiced status to purchase orders, next to Nothing to Bill, Waiting Bills and Fully Billed. The status is worked out from received and invoiced quantities, so you can see orders that are only part billed.

name: purchase_invoice_plan
summary: Lets you plan vendor bills in advance for a purchase order, splitting the total into installments with set dates, intervals and percentages. Each installment can then be billed one at a time or all at once. The plan is added from an Invoice Plan tab once Use Invoice Plan is chosen on a quotation.

name: purchase_invoice_plan
summary: Adds an Invoice Plan tab to purchase orders, so bills can be planned in advance as a set of instalments by number, start date and interval. After confirmation, Create Bill by Plan can issue all bills at once or one at a time.

name: purchase_invoice_status_line
summary: Shows an invoice status on each purchase order line, and lets you force a line to be invoiced. It is useful for seeing at a glance which lines are still waiting to be billed.

name: purchase_invoice_status_line
summary: Shows the billing status on each purchase order line and lets you force a line to be invoiced. Lines marked as force invoiced also drop out of the vendor bill matching view. The status is visible in the order lines list.

name: purchase_invoicing_no_zero_line
summary: Stops zero-quantity lines being created on purchase bills. An Avoid zero lines option on purchase journals, set under Invoicing > Configuration > Journals, controls it.

name: purchase_landed_cost
summary: Manages extra purchase costs such as freight, customs and handling, and spreads them over receipts. It has a separate screen for assigning landed costs, expense types with preset calculation methods, and distribution by weight, volume, price or quantity. Expense types marked as default are added to each new distribution.

name: purchase_landed_cost
summary: Manages extra purchase costs such as freight, customs and handling, and spreads them over receipts. It has a separate screen for assigning landed costs, expense types with preset calculation methods, and distribution by weight, volume, price or quantity. Expense types marked as default are added to each new distribution.

name: purchase_last_price_info
summary: Shows on each product the supplier, date and price from the most recent confirmed purchase order, including the price in the vendor's currency and its exchange rate. Buyers can check the last price paid before ordering again. It is found on the product's Purchase tab.

name: purchase_last_price_info
summary: Shows the last purchase price, date, supplier and currency on each product's Purchase tab. It also lists the last purchase order lines, so buyers can check what they paid recently.

name: purchase_line_procurement_group
summary: Stops purchase order lines from being merged when replenishment runs come from different procurement groups, such as different sales orders. Each group gets its own purchase line and its own stock moves. This affects how replenishment creates purchase lines.

name: purchase_line_procurement_group
summary: Keeps purchase order lines separate when the procurements that create them have different procurement groups. Stock moves from those lines are also kept apart, so orders from different sources do not get merged together.

name: purchase_line_reassign
summary: Moves selected purchase order lines from one purchase order to another, either an existing order or a new one. You select the lines in a purchase order line list and choose Reassign Lines to Other Purchase. A list view of purchase order lines must be set up to use it.

name: purchase_line_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a vendor comment field on each purchase order line, for notes meant for the supplier. It is a simple text field on the line.

name: purchase_location_by_line
summary: Lets each purchase order line have its own destination location. When the order is confirmed, one incoming shipment is created per combination of destination location and scheduled date. Use it when goods must go to different locations that are not children of the same warehouse location.

name: purchase_location_by_line
summary: Lets you set a destination location on each purchase order line. When the order is confirmed, one receipt is created per combination of destination and expected date, so goods can go to different locations within the same order. The destination shows on the order lines.

name: purchase_lot
summary: Adds a Serial Number (lot) field to purchase order lines and passes it to the receipt when the order is confirmed. Combined with the sale order lot selection module, it lets you buy a specific lot for a sales order.

name: purchase_manual_currency
summary: Lets you set a manual exchange rate on a draft purchase order in a foreign currency, for deals agreed on a different day than the order date. The rate you enter is used instead of the automatic one. It needs multi-currency access and is set on the purchase order header.

name: purchase_manual_delivery
summary: Stops receipts being created automatically when a purchase order is confirmed. Instead, lines with quantities still to receive are highlighted in blue, and a Create Incoming Shipment button lets the user pick which lines to receive. It suits vendors that confirm a purchase order line by line.

name: purchase_manual_delivery
summary: Stops receipts from being created automatically when a purchase order is confirmed. Instead, you create incoming shipments by hand for the lines the supplier has confirmed, using Create Incoming Shipment and picking the lines. It can be set per order or as a default in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_mass_mail
summary: Adds a Send email to selected purchases action on the purchase order list. Select several orders, open the wizard with the default template, and send the same email to all of them. Each order then shows a copy of the email sent and its status changes to sent.

name: purchase_merge
summary: Adds a wizard on the purchase order list to merge several draft orders into one. It only merges orders from the same supplier with the same currency, picking type, incoterms, payment terms and fiscal position. Lines move to the first order, and the emptied orders are cancelled.

name: purchase_merge
summary: Adds a wizard on the purchase order list to merge several draft orders into one. It only merges orders from the same supplier with the same currency, picking type, incoterms, payment terms and fiscal position. Lines move to the first order, and the emptied orders are cancelled.

name: purchase_minimum_amount
summary: Sets a minimum purchase order amount per vendor. When an RFQ's untaxed total is below that minimum, an approval block reason is set automatically and the order cannot be released until someone in the release group clears it. A Blocked filter finds these orders.

name: purchase_mrp_distribution
summary: Lets you buy one product that is split into several others when it is received, without knowing the exact split in advance. Each receipt move gets a Distribute button that opens a wizard to enter the quantity of each product, based on a distribution-type bill of materials. It is for manufacturing businesses that break down purchased goods.

name: purchase_mto_owner
summary: Passes the owner from a source document, such as a sales order under make-to-order, to the purchase order that a stock rule creates. It is a small link between the owner setting and automatic purchasing.

name: purchase_no_rfq
summary: Removes the Request for Quotation stage from purchasing so there is one Purchase Order menu. RFQ becomes Draft and RFQ Sent becomes Sent, and the Print button is always available. It simplifies the workflow for users who do not use quotations.

name: purchase_no_rfq
summary: Removes the Request for Quotation stage so purchasing works from a single Purchase Order menu. The Draft and Sent states replace the old RFQ names, and the Print button is always available. Users work with purchase orders from the start.

name: purchase_only_by_packaging
summary: Makes purchase order lines follow the product's packaging rules. Products can be set to purchase only by packaging, lines that do not fit the packagings are blocked, and a packaging can force the quantity up to a full pack, such as turning 3 units into 5 when the pack is 5. Found on the product and packaging setup and on purchase lines.

name: purchase_open_qty
summary: Adds filters on the Purchase Orders search to find orders that still have quantities to bill or to receive. It also shows the pending quantities on each order and each line, so you can see what is outstanding.

name: purchase_open_qty
summary: Adds filters on purchase orders to find orders with quantities still to bill or still to receive. It also adds quantity-to-bill and quantity-to-receive fields on orders and lines. The new filters are in the purchase orders search bar.

name: purchase_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to purchase orders and their lines, defaulting to the user's unit. When the order is validated, the unit is copied to the vendor bill, which cannot be changed there, and users see only the orders for their units.

name: purchase_order_approval_block
summary: Lets you put a block on an RFQ with a reason, which stops it being approved until a manager releases the block. Reasons are set under Purchases > Configuration. A Blocked filter finds orders waiting on a block.

name: purchase_order_approval_block
summary: Lets a manager put an approval block on an RFQ, with a reason from a list, so it cannot be approved until the block is released. Blocked RFQs can be found with the Blocked filter. Reasons are managed under Purchases > Configuration > Purchase Approval Block Reasons, and release rights go to a dedicated group.

name: purchase_order_approved
summary: Adds an Approved state between draft and Purchase Order, giving purchasing a two-step confirmation. Approved orders cannot be edited, can be set back to draft, and do not create receipts until they are converted to a Purchase Order. It is turned on in Purchase settings or per vendor.

name: purchase_order_approved
summary: Adds an Approved state between RFQ and Purchase Order, giving a two-step approval. Approved orders cannot be edited but can go back to draft, and receipts are only created when the order is converted to a Purchase Order. It can be switched on per company and per supplier in Purchase settings and supplier forms.

name: purchase_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive purchase orders that are locked or cancelled, so the purchase orders list stays manageable on high-volume systems. Archived orders are hidden from the list and can be shown again with the Archived filter. Use Action > Archive on the list.

name: purchase_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive locked or cancelled purchase orders, so they drop off the main list and it stays fast on busy systems. Archive them from Action > Archive in the purchase list, and use the Archived filter to find and restore them.

name: purchase_order_date_approve_editable
summary: Makes the Approval Date on a purchase order editable after confirmation, until the order is locked. By default Odoo makes this date read-only once confirmed. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_order_downpayment
summary: Lets users create a down payment from a purchase order view, and links the resulting payments to that order. A Payments count and list are shown on the order, so you can track what has been paid in advance.

name: purchase_order_duplicate_check
summary: Warns users before they over-order. When a product on a new order already has an open RFQ or an undone receipt on a purchase order, a confirmation wizard appears and the pending orders show on the line. An optional activity can be assigned to a responsible user to check the repeat orders.

name: purchase_order_etd_eta
summary: Adds Estimated Time of Departure and Arrival dates and a shipping schedule note to purchase orders, and shows them on the purchase order and RFQ reports. You can hide the expected arrival date on reports when an ETA is set, in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_order_general_discount
summary: Adds a general discount percentage to a purchase order, applied to every line. A default can be set on each vendor, and in settings you choose which extra discount field the general discount is applied to.

name: purchase_order_general_discount
summary: Adds one general discount percentage to a purchase order, applied to every line. A default discount can be set on the vendor, and settings choose which line discount field it feeds, such as a third discount from the triple discount module. It is entered in the order summary.

name: purchase_order_hide_receipt_status
summary: Hides the Receipt Status field on the purchase order form and list views. It stops it confusing users once the reception status module is installed.

name: purchase_order_import
summary: Adds an Import Quotation File button on RFQs, so a supplier's electronic quotation can update the draft order. You can update only the prices, or prices and quantities. Specific file formats need an extra module, such as the UBL import.

name: purchase_order_import_ubl
summary: Adds support for importing supplier quotations in the UBL standard, as an XML file or a PDF with an embedded UBL XML. It works with the Import Quotation File button on RFQs and updates the draft order from the file.

name: purchase_order_internal_note
summary: Adds an Internal Note field to purchase orders for notes only the team should see. The note is kept off the printed purchase order report.

name: purchase_order_line_deep_sort
summary: Sorts purchase order lines by a chosen field and direction, set as a company default or per order. Sections and notes keep their place, and only product lines are sorted within each block. Sort criteria can follow a related field, such as the product's internal reference.

name: purchase_order_line_deep_sort
summary: Sorts purchase order lines by a chosen field and direction, set as a company default or per order. Sections and notes keep their place, and only product lines are sorted within each block. Sort criteria can follow a related field, but the field must be stored in the database.

name: purchase_order_line_deep_sort
summary: Sorts purchase order lines by a chosen field and direction, set as a company default or per order. Sections and notes keep their place, and only product lines are sorted within each block. Sort criteria can follow a related field, but the field must be stored in the database.

name: purchase_order_line_description
summary: Uses only the product's purchase description on purchase order lines, instead of the sales description. Set the purchase description on the product and new lines take that text.

name: purchase_order_line_effective_date
summary: Shows Effective Date and Last Effective Date on purchase order lines, based on when goods were actually received. It helps compare when goods arrived against the committed date. It is visible on purchase order lines and the purchase report.

name: purchase_order_line_menu
summary: Adds a Purchase Order Lines menu under Purchase > Orders, with its own list views. It lets users browse all purchase lines across orders, rather than opening each order.

name: purchase_order_line_menu
summary: Adds a Purchase Order Lines menu under Purchase > Orders, so you can browse and filter all purchase order lines in one list instead of opening each order. Invoice status and order date are shown on the lines.

name: purchase_order_line_merge
summary: Lets you select purchase order lines from different orders and merge them into one new purchase order. Lines with the same product, price, unit and taxes combine into one line, and partial merges leave the remainder on the original order. Use Action > Merge into Purchase Order on the Purchase Order Lines list.

name: purchase_order_line_note
summary: Adds a Note field to purchase order lines so you can write free text on a line.

name: purchase_order_line_original_date
summary: Keeps the original expected arrival date on each purchase order and line, even after the planned date is changed. This lets you measure a vendor's real delay against what was first promised. It is shown on the purchase order and its lines.

name: purchase_order_line_price_unit_digits
summary: Restores the older on-screen rounding for the unit price on purchase order lines. It is a display-only setting for price precision.

name: purchase_order_line_receipt_status
summary: Adds a Receipt Status to each purchase order line, showing Nothing Received, Partially Received or Fully Received. It is updated when the order is confirmed and when the receipt moves change, so buyers can see what has arrived line by line.

name: purchase_order_line_sequence
summary: Adds line numbers to purchase order lines, shown on the order form and printed report. The number is passed to the stock moves and to the bill lines, so receipts and bills can be matched to the order line.

name: purchase_order_line_sequence
summary: Adds line numbers to purchase order lines, shown on the order form and printed report. The number is passed to the stock moves and to the bill lines, so receipts and bills can be matched to the order line.

name: purchase_order_line_sequence
summary: Numbers purchase order lines (1, 2, 3 and so on) so they appear in order on the order, the quotation report and the vendor bill. If the stock line sequence module is also installed, the numbers carry over to receipts. A Line Number column appears on the order.

name: purchase_order_line_stock_available
summary: Shows the forecast (virtual available) stock of each product on its purchase order line. Buyers can see at a glance whether they need to order more.

name: purchase_order_line_stock_available
summary: Shows the forecasted stock quantity for each product on purchase order lines, so buyers can see stock levels while ordering. It is added as a column on the purchase line.

name: purchase_order_no_zero_price
summary: Stops a purchase order from being confirmed while any line has a zero price, so stock valuation is correct when goods arrive. Missing prices are flagged with an error. A line can still be zero if it has a 100 percent discount.

name: purchase_order_owner
summary: Adds an Assign Owner field to purchase orders, which is passed to the receipt on confirmation. Use it when you buy goods on behalf of a client who owns the stock while you keep it in your warehouse. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_order_owner
summary: Adds an Assign Owner field to purchase orders, which is copied to the incoming receipt when the order is confirmed. Use it when you buy on behalf of a client who owns the stock while you keep it on your premises.

name: purchase_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds a button below the lines of a purchase order that recalculates the prices of the product lines from the current vendor prices. Users run it on purpose, for example after changing the vendor or duplicating an order.

name: purchase_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds a button below the lines of a purchase order that reprices all lines from the current vendor's prices. Use it after changing the vendor or duplicating an order, when you want prices updated. It is a manual action, so prices do not change on their own.

name: purchase_order_product_attachment_mgmt
summary: Adds an Attachments smart button on purchase orders that lists the attachments of all products on the order's lines, in one place.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation
summary: Adds a Recommended Products wizard to purchase orders. It lists products the chosen vendor supplies that were most often delivered to customers in a date range, so buyers can add likely needed items quickly. You set or adjust quantities and press Accept.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation
summary: Adds a Recommended Products wizard to purchase orders. It lists products the current supplier provides, ranked by how often they were delivered to customers in a chosen date range and warehouse, so buyers can add the best sellers. Quantities can be adjusted before accepting.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_brand
summary: Adds a brand filter to the Recommended Products wizard on purchase orders, so suggestions can be narrowed to chosen product brands. It needs the product brand module.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_secondary_unit
summary: Lets the Recommended Products wizard set order quantities in a product's secondary unit where one is defined, such as boxes instead of pieces. It needs the purchase secondary unit module.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_xlsx
summary: Adds an Export button to the Recommended Products wizard, so the suggested products for a supplier can be downloaded as a spreadsheet after quantities are adjusted.

name: purchase_order_purchase_manager
summary: Fills the Buyer field on a purchase order from the supplier's purchase manager, set on the vendor form. The buyer is set automatically until the order is confirmed or locked, and can be changed before that.

name: purchase_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Stops the purchase order line unit price from being recalculated when only the quantity is changed. A custom unit price you typed in stays as it is. It affects editing of purchase order lines.

name: purchase_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Stops a purchase order line's custom unit price from being reset when only the quantity is changed. Previously a quantity edit could recalculate the price and overwrite a manually set one.

name: purchase_order_report_grouped_by_vendor
summary: Adds a Purchase Order Grouped By Vendor report. Select several purchase orders in the list and print it to get them grouped under each vendor.

name: purchase_order_report_hide_tax
summary: Hides the Taxes column on the purchase order document sent to vendors when all lines use the same tax group, because the column adds nothing. Tax groups can be set to always show the column, under Accounting > Configuration > Tax Groups.

name: purchase_order_revision
summary: Keeps a history of revised quotations. On a cancelled or RFQ Sent order, New Revision creates a copy with the same base number and a revision suffix, and the old revisions are archived so they do not clutter searches. The chatter logs each revision.

name: purchase_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets buyers enter purchase quantities in a secondary unit of measure, such as cases instead of pieces. Set a secondary unit and conversion factor on the product, and the main quantity is recalculated automatically.

name: purchase_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets buyers enter purchase quantities and prices in a product's secondary unit on purchase order lines, and the main quantity is calculated from the conversion factor. Vendor pricelists support secondary unit prices, and purchase reports and the vendor portal show figures in the chosen unit.

name: purchase_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets buyers enter purchase quantities in a secondary unit of measure, such as cases instead of pieces. Set a secondary unit and conversion factor on the product, and the main quantity is recalculated automatically.

name: purchase_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets buyers enter quantities and prices in a secondary unit of measure on purchase order lines. Vendor price lines also support a secondary unit price, so supplier pricing can be kept in the unit the vendor uses.

name: purchase_order_supplier_return
summary: Lets you return goods to a vendor by entering a purchase order line with a negative quantity. When the related receipt is validated, the received quantity on the order is reduced. It works for storable products only.

name: purchase_order_supplier_return
