summary: Lets you return products to a supplier by creating a purchase order with a negative quantity. When that order's receipt is validated, the received quantity is reduced accordingly. It only works for storable products.

name: purchase_order_supplierinfo_update
summary: When an RFQ is confirmed, the unit prices on its lines are saved to each product's vendor price record. The next purchase for that product then suggests the last price paid.

name: purchase_order_supplierinfo_update
summary: Automatically updates each product's vendor price and discount with the price from a confirmed purchase order, so the next order suggests the last price paid. It happens each time a request for quotation is confirmed.

name: purchase_order_supplierinfo_update
summary: When an RFQ is confirmed, the unit prices on its lines are saved to each product's vendor price record. The next purchase for that product then suggests the last price paid.

name: purchase_order_type
summary: Adds a configurable Type to purchase orders, which can be used in filters and group-bys. Types can carry their own sequence, payment terms and incoterm, and are managed under Purchases > Configuration > Purchase types.

name: purchase_order_type
summary: Adds a configurable Purchase Order Type to purchase orders, such as Standard or Services, with its own numbering sequence, payment terms and incoterm. Use it in filters and group-bys to report by type. Types are set up under Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_order_type_dashboard
summary: Adds a dashboard of purchase orders grouped by Purchase Order Type, showing counts of RFQs, orders waiting for bills, and orders with nothing to bill. Each type's tile opens its orders.

name: purchase_order_ubl
summary: Embeds a UBL XML file in the purchase order PDF. A draft or RFQ gets a UBL Request for Quotation, and an approved order gets a UBL Order, so a supplier using Odoo can import the PDF automatically.

name: purchase_order_ubl
summary: Embeds a UBL XML file in the purchase order PDF. A draft or RFQ gets a UBL Request for Quotation, and an approved order gets a UBL Order, so a supplier using Odoo can import the PDF automatically.

name: purchase_order_uninvoiced_amount
summary: Shows the amount not yet billed on each purchase order in the purchase order list view. You can see at a glance which orders still have value to bill.

name: purchase_order_uninvoiced_amount_line
summary: Shows the amount not yet billed on each purchase order line in the purchase order lines list.

name: purchase_order_weight_volume
summary: Shows the weight and volume of each purchase order line, and the total weight and volume of the order under Other information. Options in Purchase settings control whether these also appear on the printed order.

name: purchase_order_weight_volume
summary: Shows the weight and volume of each purchase order line, and the total weight and volume of the order under Other information. Options in Purchase settings control whether these also appear on the printed order.

name: purchase_packaging_default
summary: Sets the first packaging defined on a product as the default packaging on purchase order lines. The packaging quantity is worked out from the line quantity and rounded up to whole packs, so buyers never order a fraction of a box or pallet.

name: purchase_packaging_level_qty
summary: Shows how many transport packs, such as pallets, a purchase order needs, based on each product's packaging. Each purchase order line gets a transport quantity and the order gets a total. You pick which packaging level to count in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_packaging_report
summary: Adds packaging quantity and packaging type to printed purchase orders and to the purchase reporting analysis. You can measure or group purchase reports by packaging. Product Packagings must be enabled in Purchase settings first.
keywords: pack size on purchase order print

name: purchase_partner_incoterm
summary: Lets you set a default incoterm (standard shipping terms such as FOB or CIF) and a default incoterm address on each supplier. Purchase orders for that supplier pick up these defaults, and each order gets its own incoterm address field. The supplier setting is on the contact form and the address on the purchase order.

name: purchase_partner_incoterm
summary: Sets a default Incoterm and Incoterm address on each vendor, which fill in automatically on new purchase orders. This lets you set shipping terms and the place of delivery once per vendor. It is set on the vendor contact and shows on the purchase order.

name: purchase_partner_selectable_option
summary: Adds a Selectable in purchase orders switch on vendor contacts. Vendors with it switched off do not appear in the vendor field of new purchase orders. It can be defaulted to off with a system parameter.

name: purchase_partner_selectable_option
summary: Lets you mark a supplier as not selectable on purchase orders, so it no longer appears in the Vendor field when creating a new RFQ. The flag sits on the supplier's Sales and Purchases tab, and a system parameter sets the default for new suppliers. Useful for keeping inactive or blocked suppliers out of new orders.

name: purchase_planned_date_container_deposit
summary: A glue module that keeps the expected arrival date you set on a purchase order when you add a product with a container deposit (returnable packaging) and confirm the order. It only works alongside the manual planned date and container deposit purchase modules. The date appears on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_product_pack
summary: Lets purchase orders use product packs, so a pack added to a request for quotation or purchase order line can be expanded into its components. The pack type and component price settings decide how the lines appear and what they cost. Found under Purchase when adding order lines.

name: purchase_product_pack
summary: Lets you add product packs, which are bundles of component products, to purchase orders. Depending on the pack type and component price settings on the pack product, the order shows the pack as one line, expanded into its components, or with each component priced. This works on purchase order lines.

name: purchase_product_packaging_container_deposit
summary: When a purchase line uses a packaging that carries a container deposit, such as a pallet or returnable crate, this adds the matching deposit lines to the order automatically. The number of deposit items is worked out from the ordered quantity and the packaging sizes. The deposit lines show on the purchase order and its stock moves.

name: purchase_product_template_tags
summary: Adds a Product Tags menu to the Purchase app, so you can open and manage product tags without leaving purchasing. It is a small convenience module with no new fields. The menu appears under the Purchase app.

name: purchase_product_template_tags
summary: Adds a Product Tags menu under the Purchase app, so purchasers can open and manage product tags from there. It adds only the menu entry and no other changes.

name: purchase_quick
summary: Lets you add many products to a purchase order at once from a product list. You enter a quantity to purchase next to each product, and the order line is created or updated; a quantity of zero removes the line. You open the list with Add products inside a purchase order.
keywords: add many products to order at once

name: purchase_quick_discount
summary: Adds a discount field to the quick add product list in purchase orders, so you can enter a discount next to the quantity when adding many products at once. It connects the quick purchase feature with purchase discounts. The field shows in the Add products list.
keywords: discount when adding products to PO

name: purchase_quick_triple_discount
summary: Adds three discount fields, matching the chained discounts from the purchase triple discount module, to the quick add product list for purchase orders. Use it when a supplier gives stacked discounts and you add many products at once. The fields show in the Add products list.

name: purchase_receipt_expectation
summary: A technical base for controlling how receipts are created when a purchase order is approved. It adds a Receipt Expectation field on purchase orders, set to automatic by default, which other modules can extend with custom receipt rules. It has no screens of its own beyond that field.

name: purchase_reception_notify
summary: Notifies the people following a purchase order as soon as its products are received into stock, by posting a message on the order. It adds a new message type for these notifications, and existing active followers are updated to receive them. The notice is triggered when a receipt is validated.

name: purchase_reception_status
summary: Adds a Reception Status to confirmed purchase orders showing whether nothing, part, or all of the order has been received. Purchase managers can force an order to Fully Received from the Other Information tab, after locking it. The status shows on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_reception_status
summary: Shows a reception status on each purchase order: Nothing Received, Partially Received, or Fully Received. Purchase managers can force a locked order to Fully Received with a Force Received checkbox. It is found on the purchase order's Other Information tab.

name: purchase_reception_status_line
summary: Shows a reception status on each purchase order line (nothing, partial or fully received) and rolls them up into the order status. Managers can force a line to fully received. It works best with the purchase order lines menu installed.

name: purchase_reception_threshold
summary: Lets you set a receipt threshold so that small differences between ordered and received quantities do not create a backorder. When a receipt validates within the threshold, the backorder wizard is skipped. The threshold is set in settings, on the supplier, and on the purchase order and its lines.

name: purchase_reorder_control
summary: Stops reordering rules from being used for products that are not purchasable. When a product is marked as not purchased, its reordering rules are removed, so replenishment cannot generate purchase orders for it. The change applies to the product form and to Inventory reordering rules.

name: purchase_reorder_control
summary: Stops reordering rules from being used for products that are not purchasable. When a product is marked as not purchased, its reordering rules are removed, so replenishment cannot generate purchase orders for it. The change applies to the product form and to Inventory reordering rules.

name: purchase_report_date_format
summary: Shows dates without times on printed Request for Quotation and Purchase Order reports, including the expected date, order date, order deadline, and requested date. This keeps the printed documents cleaner for suppliers. It only affects printed reports.

name: purchase_report_date_format
summary: Shows dates without times on printed Request for Quotation and Purchase Order reports, including the expected date, order date, order deadline, and requested date. This keeps the printed documents cleaner for suppliers. It only affects printed reports.

name: purchase_report_hide_line
summary: Lets you hide certain purchase order lines from the printed Purchase Order report, such as lines with zero quantity or zero subtotal. A Hide In Report checkbox on each line controls this, and a company default sets which lines are hidden automatically. The checkbox is on the purchase order lines and the default is in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_report_payment_term
summary: Adds the payment term notes to printed Purchase Order and Request for Quotation reports, so the supplier sees the agreed payment conditions on the document. It only affects printed reports and adds no new fields.

name: purchase_report_payment_term
summary: Adds the payment term notes to printed Purchase Order and Request for Quotation reports, so the supplier sees the agreed payment conditions on the document. It only affects printed reports and adds no new fields.

name: purchase_report_shipping_address
summary: Adds a translatable Warehouse Address Details field to warehouses, so printed purchase documents can show the delivery address in the supplier's language. You edit it on the warehouse form under Inventory configuration. It is used on printed purchase reports.

name: purchase_report_shipping_address
summary: Adds a translatable Warehouse Address Details field to warehouses, so printed purchase documents can show the delivery address in the supplier's language. You edit it on the warehouse form under Inventory configuration. It is used on printed purchase reports.

name: purchase_representative
summary: Sets the Purchase Representative on a purchase order to the user who ran the procurement, so the RFQ or order is sent from that person and replies go to them. It fixes the case where orders are created under the system user.

name: purchase_request
summary: Lets staff raise internal requests for materials or outside services, with quantities and needed-by dates, before anyone creates a purchase order. Requests can be entered by hand or created automatically from manufacturing or sales demand. Buyers turn approved request lines into RFQs, adding to an existing RFQ or creating a new one for a chosen supplier. It is found under the Purchase menu as Purchase Requests.

name: purchase_request_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic distribution field to purchase requests, which also serves as the default for new request lines. You can use it to split a request's cost across analytic accounts such as projects or departments. The field shows on the purchase request form.

name: purchase_request_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user cancels a purchase request, a confirmation wizard appears with an optional reason. It is shown from the request's cancel action.

name: purchase_request_department
summary: Adds a Department field to purchase requests and their lines, filled in automatically from the requester's department. You can group the request list by department. It depends on the employees app.

name: purchase_request_department
summary: Adds a Department field to purchase requests and their lines, filled in from the requester's department when you choose who requested it. You can group the purchase request list by department. The field shows on the purchase request form and list view.

name: purchase_request_exception
summary: Lets you attach custom exceptions to purchase requests, such as an unknown product or a badly formatted line. You can then filter requests by exception type and fix them, which helps when importing many requests at once. Lines also have an Ignore Exceptions option.

name: purchase_request_exception
summary: Lets you attach customizable exceptions to purchase requests, such as a product not found, and filter requests by exception type to fix them. It is useful when a batch of requests has errors during import.

name: purchase_request_substate
summary: Lets you add sub-stages to a purchase request within each main status, such as To Verify before approval. Sub-stages are defined as base substates under Settings > Technical > Database Structure, and their sequence matters. They show in the request's form header.

name: purchase_request_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval workflow to purchase requests. A request that matches a tier definition must be reviewed and approved by the listed reviewers before the Confirm button appears. Users start the review with the Request Validation button and track it on the Reviews tab.

name: purchase_request_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase requests. Requests are sent for review with Request Validation, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and Confirm appears once all are approved. A default tier lets a Purchase Request Manager approve, and more tiers can be added in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_request_to_requisition
summary: Lets buyers turn selected purchase request lines into a purchase agreement, either adding them to a draft agreement or creating a new one. The module tries to combine lines for the same product into one agreement line. It is used from Purchase Requests by selecting lines and choosing Create Purchase Agreement under More.

name: purchase_request_type
summary: Adds configurable purchase request types, such as standard or urgent, that you pick on each request and can use in filters and groupings. A type can also skip the request for quotation step. Types are managed under Purchases, Configuration.

name: purchase_request_type
summary: Adds a configurable Type to purchase requests, such as Standard or Urgent, which can be used in filters and group-bys. A type can also skip RFQ creation, so the request stops at approval. Types are managed under Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_requisition_line_description
summary: Shows the product's purchase description on purchase agreement lines, instead of only the product name. Set the purchase description on the product first.

name: purchase_requisition_multiple_vendor
summary: In the Create Alternative wizard on a purchase agreement, you can select several vendors at once, and an alternative purchase order is created for each one. You start from the Alternatives tab of a purchase agreement. This speeds up getting competing quotes from several suppliers.

name: purchase_requisition_order_remaining_qty
summary: Lets a blanket order agreement track what quantity is left. New RFQs created from the agreement can use the remaining agreed quantity instead of the full amount. You turn this on by setting the agreement type's Quantities option to use remaining quantities. Found under Purchase, Orders, Blanket Orders.

name: purchase_requisition_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval workflow to purchase agreements, covering blanket orders and calls for tender. An agreement that matches a tier definition must be approved by the listed reviewers before it can be confirmed. Users start the review with the Request Validation button and track it on the Reviews tab.

name: purchase_requisition_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase agreements. Agreements are sent for review with Request Validation, and the Confirm button appears once all reviewers approve. Tiers are configured in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_return
summary: Lets you create purchase return orders to send goods back to a vendor or to track a service claim. You confirm the quantities sent back, then create the vendor refund bills from those lines. Return orders sit under Purchase, and vendor bills link back to them.

name: purchase_rfq_number
summary: Gives quotations (RFQs) their own number sequence, separate from purchase orders. For example, RFQ001 becomes PO001 when confirmed, and the RFQ number is kept for reference. It can also auto-attach the RFQ after confirmation. Set in Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_sale_container_deposit_inter_company
summary: A glue module that passes the container deposit flag from an inter-company purchase order to the matching sale order. This keeps the deposit lines correct in the selling company when both companies share one Odoo database. It is technical and has no screen of its own.
keywords: container deposit sale order from PO

name: purchase_sale_inter_company
summary: When one company in the database buys from another, confirming a purchase order in the buyer's company creates a matching sale order in the seller's company. The seller can turn on auto-validation so that sale order confirms by itself. Setup is in Companies settings, on the Inter-Company tab.
keywords: auto create sale order from purchase

name: purchase_sale_inter_company
summary: When one company in the database buys from another, confirming a purchase order in the buyer's company creates a matching sale order in the seller's company. The seller can turn on auto-validation so that sale order confirms by itself. Setup is in Companies settings, on the Inter-Company tab.
keywords: auto create sale order from purchase

name: purchase_sale_link_by_origin
summary: Links purchase orders and sales orders also by the purchase Source Document field, not only by their lines. This keeps the link when a purchase is cancelled or when the origin is typed in by hand.

name: purchase_sale_link_by_origin
summary: Links purchase and sale orders by the Source Document (Origin) field, not just by their order lines. The link survives when a purchase order is cancelled, and manual edits to Origin count as well. You can see the link from the related documents on the purchase and sale order.

name: purchase_sale_stock_inter_company
summary: Extends inter-company purchase-to-sale orders so receipts and deliveries stay in sync. When the seller confirms its delivery, the buyer's receipt is validated with matching quantities and lot or serial numbers. Settings include a default warehouse for generated sale orders and options to sync or block manual validation.

name: purchase_sale_stock_inter_company
summary: Sets a default warehouse for sale orders generated from inter-company purchase orders, so the seller's sales go out from the right location. You set it in Settings under the Inter Company OCA features tab. The module installs automatically when sales, purchasing, and stock are all installed.
keywords: warehouse for sale orders from PO

name: purchase_sale_stock_inter_company_mrp
summary: A glue module for inter-company purchase-to-sale orders when manufacturing is installed. It makes inter-company stock transfers handle bill of materials kits. It is technical and adds no new fields or screens of its own.

name: purchase_security
summary: Restricts which purchase orders each purchase user can see. Purchase users see their own orders, or their team's orders if they are in a purchase team, and the module adds Purchase Teams plus a Purchase Representative on vendors and orders. Groups are set in users' access rights.

name: purchase_security
summary: Restricts which purchase orders each purchase user can see. Users in the new groups see only orders they follow, orders with no responsible user, orders they are responsible for, or orders for their purchasing team. Orders get a Purchase Representative and a Purchase Team to control this.

name: purchase_sign
summary: Lets vendors sign purchase orders online. When enabled, the emailed RFQ shows an Accept and Sign button in the vendor portal, and once the vendor signs, the RFQ is confirmed as a purchase order. It is turned on in Purchase settings and can be handled on each order.

name: purchase_split_by_route
summary: Separates automatic purchases by sale order route, so purchases created by different routes, such as make-to-order, are kept apart. Each route can be flagged to split purchases, and the purchase order has a default route. This affects how replenishment groups purchase orders.

name: purchase_start_end_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to purchase order lines, which are required for products flagged as needing service dates. You can set default start and end dates on the order that fill in new lines. The dates copy to the vendor bill lines when the bill is created.
keywords: start date end date PO line
must have start and end dates

name: purchase_stock_analytic
summary: Copies the analytic distribution from purchase order lines onto the stock moves created when the order is confirmed. This lets the received goods carry the same analytic accounts that were set on the purchase line. It is a technical link with no new fields.

name: purchase_stock_analytic
summary: Copies the analytic distribution from purchase order lines onto the stock moves created when the order is confirmed. This lets the received goods carry the same analytic accounts that were set on the purchase line. It is a technical link with no new fields.

name: purchase_stock_cost_update
summary: Lets you update the cost of goods already received from a purchase order by changing the price on the order line, which adjusts the stock valuation. The valuation difference is shown on the order. It requires average cost valuation on the product category.

name: purchase_stock_date_done_revaluation
summary: For foreign-currency purchases that are not yet billed, changing the effective date of a receipt also revalues the received stock at the exchange rate of the new date. Once the vendor bill is posted, the bill controls the value. Purchases in the company currency are not affected.

name: purchase_stock_line_sequence
summary: Carries the purchase order line numbers over to the stock moves of the receipt, and stops those numbers being edited on the receipt. It is installed automatically when both the purchase line numbers and the picking line numbers modules are installed.

name: purchase_stock_manual_currency
summary: Passes the manual exchange rate set on a purchase order through to the receipt's stock moves, valuation layers and product costs. It keeps stock costs consistent with the rate agreed with the vendor. It adds no new screens.

name: purchase_stock_operating_unit
summary: Copies the operating unit from a purchase order to the receipt when the Deliver To warehouse has one. This keeps operating unit reporting consistent between purchasing and stock. It is a technical bridge, and the operating unit then appears on the receipt.

name: purchase_stock_packaging
summary: Carries the product packaging chosen on a sales order or procurement through to the generated purchase order line, so the purchase uses the same packaging. It is useful for make-to-order routes that create purchases.

name: purchase_stock_packaging
summary: Carries the product packaging from a sale order's procurement into the purchase order line it generates. If the sale used a packaging other than the default, the purchase line uses the same one. This matters for make-to-order routes that create purchases automatically.
keywords: pack size PO line from sale

name: purchase_stock_picking_actual_date_show_currency_rate
summary: A bridge module that uses the actual date of a completed receipt to calculate and show the currency rate on that receipt. It connects the actual date and currency rate display modules. It is technical and has no screens of its own.

name: purchase_stock_picking_backorder_policy
summary: Adds a Purchase Backorder Policy on vendors, with the options Ask, Always, or Never. The policy is copied to each purchase order, can be changed per order before confirming, and then carries over to the receipt. It controls whether a partial receipt creates a backorder.

name: purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links purchase orders, receipts, and vendor bills to each other, so you can see which receipts a bill relates to. On a vendor bill, a Delivery smart button opens the linked receipts. This helps when a supplier bills goods that arrived in parts.
keywords: which receipts a vendor bill relates to

name: purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links purchase orders, receipts and vendor bills, so from a vendor bill you can open the receipts it relates to through a Delivery smart button. It extends the basic invoice-to-transfer link to purchasing.

name: purchase_stock_picking_return_invoicing
summary: Adds billed, refunded, received, and returned quantities to each purchase order line, so a vendor bill or refund proposes the right quantities after goods go back to a supplier. The figures show on the order lines. It also covers returns made before the supplier's bill has arrived.
keywords: credit note for returned goods supplier

name: purchase_stock_picking_return_invoicing
summary: Extends purchase orders so supplier returns and refunds are tracked per line. Each line shows billed and refunded quantities, and received and returnable refundable quantities, so vendor bills and refunds are created with the right amounts. Refund quantities are proposed automatically when the bill or refund is created.

name: purchase_stock_picking_show_currency_rate
summary: Shows the currency rate used on a purchase receipt when the order is in a currency other than the company currency. You can see the rate that goes to stock valuation, or the one applied once the amount is converted to company currency. Multi-currency and rates must be set up first.

name: purchase_stock_price_unit_sync
summary: Updates the cost price on receipt stock moves that are already done when the purchase line price changes, so stock valuation follows the price. It is designed to work with the average cost price sync module.

name: purchase_stock_product_replenish_supplier
summary: Pre-fills the supplier in the product Replenish wizard. When a reordering rule has no supplier, the wizard now uses the product's main supplier instead of leaving the field blank. It appears in the Replenish wizard.

name: purchase_stock_reception_status
summary: Glue module that makes the purchase reception status use the OCA logic when both the reception status and the purchase-stock features are installed. It hides duplicate reception status displays so the order shows one clear status. No setup is needed.

name: purchase_stock_secondary_unit
summary: Copies secondary unit quantities and prices from a purchase order line to the receipt when the order is confirmed, so the receipt shows the quantity in the secondary unit. It needs the purchase secondary unit and stock secondary unit modules.

name: purchase_stock_tier_validation
summary: Stops replenishment from adding to a purchase order that is already pending approval or already approved. If an open RFQ with the same supplier is under review or validated, procurement does not reuse it. It works alongside the purchase tier validation module.

name: purchase_substate
summary: Lets you add sub-stages to a purchase order within each main status, such as Waiting for legal documents before approval. Sub-stages are defined as base substates under Settings > Technical > Database Structure and are shown in the order header.

name: purchase_supplier_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a supplier as soon as a purchase order is created for it. Normally Odoo only does this when a vendor bill is entered. It is a background update in the purchasing flow.

name: purchase_supplier_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a supplier as soon as you create a purchase order for them. Normally the supplier rank only updates when a vendor bill is created. This affects the supplier filters and counts on contacts.

name: purchase_supplierinfo_editable_tree
summary: Makes the vendor price list (supplier info lines) editable directly in its list view. You can update purchase prices in place without exporting and re-importing supplier info. It appears on the product's vendor pricelist.

name: purchase_tag
summary: Lets you add multiple tags to purchase orders, organised as a hierarchy of parent and child tags, and filter or group orders by tag. Tags are picked on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase orders. A user requests validation with a button, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and Confirm Order becomes available once all approvals are in. A Needs my Review filter helps reviewers find their items. Tiers are set in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval workflow to purchase orders. An order that matches a tier definition must be approved by the listed reviewers before the Confirm Order button appears. Users start with Request Validation and track progress on the Reviews tab.

name: purchase_transport_mode
summary: Checks that a purchase order fits the transport mode chosen for it, such as a truck with a weight or load limit. You define transport modes with constraints that apply to the order. A yellow warning appears at the top of the order when a requirement is not met, and the check is turned on in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_transport_mode
summary: Checks that a purchase order fits the transport mode chosen for it, such as a truck with a weight or load limit. You define transport modes with constraints that apply to the order. A yellow warning appears at the top of the order when a requirement is not met, and the check is turned on in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_triple_discount
summary: Lets each purchase order line carry three successive discounts, where each one applies to the price left after the previous. Suppliers can have default discounts set on their contact. The discounts show on the order lines and in the purchase reports.

name: purchase_triple_discount
summary: Gives each purchase order line three successive discounts, applied one after another, instead of a single discount. Each vendor can have default discounts that fill in automatically. Lines show Disc. 1, Disc. 2 and Disc. 3.

name: purchase_uninvoiced_amount_force_invoiced_line
summary: A glue module that sets the uninvoiced amount to zero when a purchase order line is forced to invoiced. Forced lines then stop showing as waiting to be billed. It is technical and applies to purchase order lines.
keywords: stop waiting to bill PO line

name: purchase_uninvoiced_amount_force_invoiced_line
summary: Glue module that sets a line's uninvoiced amount to zero when the line is force invoiced, so a force-invoiced line no longer shows an outstanding amount.

name: purchase_unreconciled
summary: Adds an Unreconciled flag and amount to purchase orders, so accountants can find orders with open journal items on interim accounts. A link opens those journal items. Locking the order can reconcile the leftover stock interim balance, and a write-off account is set in accounting settings.

name: purchase_unreconciled
summary: Adds an Unreconciled flag and amount to purchase orders, so accountants can find orders with open journal items on interim accounts. A link opens those journal items. Locking the order can reconcile the leftover stock interim balance, and a write-off account is set in accounting settings.

name: purchase_uom_discrete
summary: On purchase order lines, quantities in countable units such as units or boxes are rounded up to the next whole number when a fraction is typed in. Weight, volume, length, and time quantities keep their decimals. The rounding applies only on the order form, not to imports or code.

name: purchase_v12_control_menu
summary: Restores the Purchase control menu from Odoo v12, with two shortcuts: pending incoming movements and vendor invoices. The shortcuts appear in the Purchase app menu. Use it if you miss those older shortcuts.

name: purchase_variant_configurator
summary: Lets you pick a product configuration with attributes, such as size or colour, directly on a purchase order line. The matching product variant can be created when the order is confirmed, if that setting is on. The configurator appears below the line.

name: purchase_variant_configurator
summary: Lets you pick a product configuration with attributes, such as size or colour, directly on a purchase order line. The matching product variant can be created when the order is confirmed, if that setting is on. The configurator appears below the line.

name: purchase_vendor_promotion
summary: Shows the start and end dates of a vendor promotion during replenishment, so you can see when a discounted supplier price is active. If Buy is the preferred route, the supplier with the best active or upcoming promotion is chosen automatically. It appears on Replenishment and on reordering rules.

name: purchase_warn_message
summary: Adds a warning message field on purchase orders and shows it as a popup, so the warning is populated not only when the vendor changes. It is an extra alert on the order.

name: purchase_warn_option
summary: Adds predefined warning options to vendors and products, so a blocking or caution message can be picked from a list and applied quickly. The vendor's option shows on purchase orders, and the product's option appears when that product is purchased. Set under the Purchase settings Warnings option, the vendor's Internal Notes tab, and the product's Purchase tab.

name: purchase_work_acceptance
summary: Lets purchasing require a formal Work Acceptance sign-off before goods are received or vendor bills are created, so the company only pays for products and services that were approved. Work Acceptances are created from purchase orders and track due, received and accepted dates. The controls are switched on in Purchase configuration settings, and a Work Acceptance button and WA reference fields then appear on purchase orders, receipts and vendor bills.

name: purchase_work_acceptance
summary: Lets you require a work acceptance before goods are received or vendor bills are created. Only products and services included in an accepted work acceptance can be received or billed. Work acceptances are created from the purchase order and their references show on receipts and bills.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_evaluation
summary: Adds quality scoring to Work Acceptances so each delivery can be rated against evaluation criteria the company defines itself. Criteria and their scores are set up in configuration, filled in on the Evaluation tab of a Work Acceptance, and summarized in a Work Acceptance Evaluation report.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_evaluation
summary: Lets you rate a vendor's work on each work acceptance, using evaluation criteria and scores you define in configuration. Ratings appear on the acceptance's Evaluation tab, and a Work Acceptance Evaluation Report summarizes results by vendor. Evaluation must be enabled in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_invoice_plan
summary: Lets you create Work Acceptances one installment at a time from a purchase order's invoice plan, so each payment installment is backed by an accepted quantity. When billing, the chosen Work Acceptance controls the invoiced quantity instead of the plan, and the plain Create Bill by Plan option is removed. The entry point is the Create WA by Installment button on the purchase order.

name: purchase_work_acceptance_late_fines
summary: Calculates penalties a vendor owes when a delivery is late, using the Work Acceptance due date and a fine rate per day. From the Work Acceptance the user can generate a fines invoice or refund, which posts to a configured late delivery fines revenue account. Fine rates and the account are set in Purchase configuration settings.

name: pydantic
summary: A technical utility for developers that maps Odoo records onto Pydantic models (version 2 or later). It has no screens for business users. Developers building REST or API modules use it to produce typed data from Odoo records.

name: pydantic
summary: A technical utility for developers that maps Odoo records onto Pydantic models, with a generic getter helper for reading fields. It has no screens for business users. Developers building REST or API modules use it to produce typed data from Odoo records.

name: quality_control_mrp_oca
summary: Creates quality control inspections automatically when a manufacturing order is finished. The inspections are linked from the production order, which has shortcuts to them. This connects the quality control and manufacturing apps.

name: quality_control_mrp_oca
summary: Creates quality control inspections automatically when a manufacturing order is finished. The inspections are linked from the production order, which has shortcuts to them. This connects the quality control and manufacturing apps.

name: quality_control_oca
summary: A base module that provides the general quality testing framework. You define questions with yes or no or other descriptive answers, or with measured values in a range, group them into tests, and record results on inspections. It is technical infrastructure that other quality and inspection modules build on.

name: quality_control_oca
summary: A base module that provides the general quality testing framework. You define questions with yes or no or other descriptive answers, or with measured values in a range, group them into tests, and record results on inspections. It is technical infrastructure that other quality and inspection modules build on.

name: quality_control_oca_timesheet
summary: Adds a Timesheets tab to quality control inspections, where you log the time spent on each inspection by project, task, date, and duration. The total hours show on the inspection form and in the inspection list. Use it to track the labor cost of inspections.

name: quality_control_product_manufacturer
summary: Shows the manufacturer and the manufacturer's product code on quality control inspections, based on the product chosen in the inspection's Reference field. This is useful when an inspection needs to name the brand and part number. It appears on the inspection form.

name: quality_control_stock_oca
summary: Creates quality inspections automatically when stock moves are done, based on QC triggers you set on products, product templates, or categories. Inspections link back to the transfer and the lot or serial number. Pickings and lots show counts of passed and failed inspections.

name: quality_control_stock_oca
summary: Creates quality inspections automatically when stock moves are done, based on QC triggers you set on products, product templates, or categories. Inspections link back to the transfer and the lot or serial number. Pickings and lots show counts of passed and failed inspections, and a trigger can make an inspection mandatory before the transfer is validated.

name: queue_job
summary: Adds a background job queue to Odoo, so slow or delayed tasks run after the current action finishes instead of making the user wait. Administrators can view jobs under the Job Queue menu and retry failed ones. This is technical infrastructure for developers and administrators.

name: queue_job
summary: Technical base module that lets Odoo run slow tasks in the background as queued jobs instead of making the user wait. It adds a Job Queue menu to view jobs, retry or cancel them, and control how many run at once through channels. Other modules use it, and developers postpone methods by calling with_delay().

name: queue_job
summary: Adds a background job queue to Odoo, so slow or delayed tasks run after the current action finishes instead of making the user wait. Administrators can view jobs under the Job Queue menu and retry failed ones. This is technical infrastructure for developers and administrators.

name: queue_job_batch
summary: Groups related background jobs into one batch so they can be tracked together, for example 100 records processed as a single group. Running and recently finished batches appear from the systray, with counts of completed and failed jobs. It adds a batch field to each job.

name: queue_job_batch
summary: Groups related background jobs into a batch, so you can see how many have finished or failed and when the whole group is done. Batches are shown through a button in the top systray bar. This is a technical add-on to the Job Queue module.

name: queue_job_cron
summary: Lets a scheduled action run as a background job, and choose which channel it runs in. You tick Run as queue job on the scheduled action. This is a technical add-on to the Job Queue module.
keywords: scheduled action run as queue job

name: queue_job_cron
summary: Lets a scheduled action run as a queued background job, optionally on a dedicated channel so that tasks which must not overlap run one at a time. It is enabled per scheduled action with the Run as queue job flag. Scheduled actions are a technical screen used for automated recurring tasks.

name: queue_job_cron_jobrunner
summary: Runs queued background jobs through scheduled actions, for environments where the standard job runner cannot run, such as Odoo.sh. Installing the module is usually all the setup needed. It is technical, has no screens for business users, and does not support channel limits or priorities.

name: queue_job_cron_jobrunner
summary: Technical module that runs queued background jobs through scheduled actions, for hosting setups where the normal job runner cannot run, such as Odoo.sh. Jobs run on the scheduled-action worker threads, and this simple runner has no channel capacity or priority handling. It is not meant to be installed alongside the regular job runner.

name: queue_job_profiler
summary: Technical debugging aid that records performance profiles of selected background job functions, including SQL and stack trace data. It is enabled per job function from the Queue Job Functions screen, for chosen users and a time window. Results are stored in the profiler log for review by developers.

name: queue_job_subscribe
summary: Lets administrators keep users in the Job Queue Manager group without having them receive an email for every failed background job. A Job Notifications checkbox on the user form controls whether that user follows failed jobs. It is useful when many people share the manager role.

name: queue_job_subscribe
summary: Lets you choose which Job Queue Manager users receive follow-up notifications about failed background jobs. A Job Notifications checkbox on the user form controls this. Users without it stay in the group but are not added as followers of failed jobs.

name: queue_job_web_notify
summary: Shows a pop-up notification in the browser to the related user when a background job fails. You turn it on per job function from the list of job functions. This is a technical add-on to the Job Queue module.

name: remote_report_to_printer
summary: Lets reports print directly to a printer that depends on the remote device the user is working from, such as a particular computer or server. Each remote gets its own printers, trays, and default printer by usage, set under Settings, Remotes. Reports can be set to use the remote's configuration.

name: remove_odoo_enterprise
summary: Hides Enterprise-only apps and features from the Settings screens, and removes the widget that links to the mobile apps in General Settings. It is meant for tidying the Settings pages on Community installations. It only changes how Settings looks.

name: remove_odoo_enterprise
summary: Hides Enterprise-only apps and features from the Settings screens, and removes the widget that links to the mobile apps in General Settings. It is meant for tidying the Settings pages on Community installations. It only changes how Settings looks.

name: rental_base
summary: Adds a Rental menu for managing product rentals on sales orders. Rental orders and their lines carry start and end dates, and a wizard can update those dates across several lines at once. Products get a Can be Rent flag to mark them as rentable.

name: rental_base
summary: Adds a Rental menu for managing product rentals on sales orders. Rental orders and their lines carry start and end dates, and a wizard can update those dates across several lines at once. Products get a Can be Rent flag, on both the product and its variants.

name: rental_offday
summary: Lets a salesperson mark off-days on daily rental order lines, such as weekends or holidays, when the customer keeps the rented item but is not charged the daily price. Off-days are excluded from the price calculation. This works only for products rented by the day.

name: rental_pricelist
summary: Lets you set rental prices per hour, day, week, or month on a product, using standard pricelist features such as bulk prices for longer rentals. A rental service product is created for each time unit, named using company prefixes and suffixes. Prices are entered on the product's Rental Price tab.
keywords: rental services by day week month

name: rental_product_pack
summary: Lets rental orders include product packs, which are bundles of products rented together. When the rental order is confirmed, the pack's components appear on both the outgoing and the return deliveries. Packs are set up with the Pack tab on the product.

name: repair_analytic
summary: Adds an Analytic Distribution to repair orders, so repair costs and recovered value post to analytic accounts when the repair is done. Added parts count as cost, while removed and recycled parts count as recovery. Analytic entries are deleted if the repair is cancelled. The price type, sale price or cost, is set on the operation type.

name: repair_analytic_timesheet
summary: Adds timesheet labor costs to a repair order's analytic distribution when the repair is marked Done. It applies to projects that have Spread Timesheet Cost on Repair turned on. Analytic accounting must be enabled first.

name: repair_calendar_view
summary: Adds a calendar view of repair orders, using each order's repair date, duration, and responsible user. Use it to see the repair schedule and each person's workload at a glance. The calendar is an extra view on the repair orders list.

name: repair_comment_template
summary: Adds comments to repair orders that can be typed directly or loaded from reusable templates. Comments can be placed above or below the repair order lines. They appear on the repair order document.

name: repair_discount
summary: Adds a Discount (%) field to the parts lines and the operation fee lines of repair orders, so you can give a discount on part prices or labor charges for a repair. The discount is entered per line on the repair order.

name: repair_follow_lot_location
summary: Keeps a repair order's current location in step with the actual internal location of its lot or serial number. When the item's stock moves are done during the process, the repair location updates automatically. Enable it with the Follow Lot Location checkbox on the repair order.

name: repair_order_group
summary: Groups several repair orders for the same customer so they can be managed together. Changing the partner, confirming, cancelling, or creating a quotation on one order applies to the whole group. An Add Grouped Repair button creates another order in the same group, and which states show that button is set in Repair settings.

name: repair_order_group_services
summary: A bridge module that makes sure services from every repair order in a group are added to the quotation when the group's quotation is created. It connects repair order groups with repair services. The services then appear together on that one quotation.

name: repair_order_line_sequence
summary: Lets you change the order of part lines on a repair order by dragging them into place in the Parts tab. It is a small usability change to the repair order form.

name: repair_order_product_by_lot
summary: Lets you find a repair product by typing its lot or serial number. The Lot/Serial Number field is always visible on the repair order, and the repair uses that specific lot when it is processed. The product must be tracked by lots.

name: repair_order_template
summary: Lets you save repair order templates that hold the product, tags, internal notes, warranty flag, and spare parts. Choosing a template on a draft repair order fills those in automatically. Templates are managed under Repairs, Configuration.

name: repair_picking
summary: Lets each warehouse run repairs in one, two, or three steps: repair only, pick the component then repair, or also store the removed components. It creates pickings for adding and recycling components and links them to the repair order for traceability. Steps and locations are configured under Inventory, Warehouses.

name: repair_picking_after_done
summary: After a repair is done, a Transfer button appears on the repair order so you can move the repaired item from the repair location to another location with an internal transfer. You choose the destination and the quantity. No configuration is needed.
keywords: repair ready to ship internal transfer
send repaired item out of repair location

name: repair_picking_after_done
summary: After a repair is done, the repaired products can be moved out of the repair location with an internal transfer. You can create it by hand with a Create Transfer button, or turn on Automatic Transfer on Repair Completion in Repairs settings to have it created and validated when the repair is done.

name: repair_purchase_return
summary: Creates a purchase return order to a vendor directly from a repair order, for the parts and operations you are sending back. You pick the vendor in a wizard, and the return order gets the repair's lines. The lines link back to the repair.

name: repair_quality_control
summary: Creates quality control inspections from repair orders, either when the repair is confirmed or when it is done, and either automatically or by hand. A repair can have several inspections. Product triggers set on the product's Inventory tab choose which test is used.

name: repair_quality_control
summary: Creates quality control inspections from a repair order when it is done. A repair can have several inspections, which you create with a Create Inspection button, and a smart button moves between the repair and its inspections.

name: repair_quotation_manual_sync
summary: Changes the link between a repair order and its quotation from automatic to manual. Each part has an Invoiceable checkbox, and the quotation includes only the invoiceable parts. When the repair changes later, a banner on the quotation shows the mismatch, and a Synchronize Lines button brings the quotation up to date.

name: repair_quotation_manual_sync
summary: Changes the link between a repair order and its quotation from automatic to manual. Each part has an Invoiceable checkbox, and the quotation includes only the invoiceable parts. When the repair changes later, a banner on the quotation shows the mismatch, and a Synchronize Lines button brings the quotation up to date.

name: repair_reason
summary: Adds a Root Cause field to repair orders, picked from a list of repair reasons you define, such as Non conformed product. It records why an item needed repair, so you can group repairs by cause. Reasons are managed in the repair configuration.

name: repair_refurbish
summary: When a defective product is repaired, the repair can produce a refurbished product instead. Tick To Refurbish on the repair: the original goes to a Refurbish location and the refurbished version goes on to the destination. Each product's refurbished version is set on its product form.

name: repair_refurbish
summary: For MRP repair orders, produces a refurbished product as the result of repairing a defective one. The defective product goes to the scrap location, and the refurbished version moves to the chosen destination. Each product's refurbished version is set on its product form.

name: repair_reinvoice
summary: Lets you invoice a repair order again after its invoice has been reversed. When an invoice linked to the repair is reversed, the Create Invoice button reappears on the repair order.

name: repair_restrict_lot
summary: Lets you choose the lot or serial number for each part added to a repair order. When the repair is confirmed, the stock reservation is made for those specific lots or serials. Used for parts that are tracked by lot or serial.

name: repair_sale_order
summary: Lets a repair type create a sales order for spare parts. When Create Sale Order is on for the repair type, the repair can generate a sales order for the parts. The repair becomes Done when that sales order is confirmed, and goes back to Confirmed if the sales order is cancelled.

name: repair_scheduled_date_calendar_view
summary: Adds a calendar view of repair orders based on their scheduled date, rather than the date they were done. Each order has a planned duration, which you can type in or set by resizing its calendar block. The default duration is set in Repair settings.

name: repair_security
summary: Adds security groups for the Repair app, so access to repairs can be set separately from Inventory. It is a technical access setup that shows up in user permission settings.

name: repair_security
summary: Adds security groups for the Repair app, so access to repairs can be set separately from Inventory. It is a technical access setup that shows up in user permission settings.

name: repair_service
summary: Adds a Services tab to repair orders for listing the services performed. Once a sales order is created from the repair, the services become sales order lines. If Under Warranty is checked, those service lines are priced at zero.

name: repair_stock
summary: A base module for the stock features of repairs. It holds shared logic for the transfers linked to a repair, including the Transfers smart button. It is technical and is built on by other repair stock modules.

name: repair_stock
summary: A base module for the stock features of repairs. It links repairs to their transfers and shows a Transfers smart button. It is technical and is built on by other repair stock modules.

name: repair_stock_move
summary: Changes when repair stock moves happen. Confirming the repair creates draft moves, starting the repair confirms them, and ending the repair completes them. Components can be added at any stage of the repair, which suits businesses that add parts as they go.

name: repair_stock_move_menu
summary: Adds an Inventory reporting menu that lists repair stock moves, with two filters: Consumptions for parts used in repairs, and Repaired Products for the finished items. Find it under Inventory, Reporting, Repair Stock Moves.

name: repair_substate
summary: Lets you add a sub-status under each main repair status, to show a more detailed step in the repair workflow. Sub-statuses are defined under Technical settings and show in the repair order header. Their sequence matters.

name: repair_timesheet
summary: Adds a Timesheets tab to repair orders for logging time spent on a repair, by project, task, date, and duration. The total hours show on the repair order form and in the repair list view.

name: repair_type
summary: Adds a Repair Type to repair orders. Choosing a type fills in some of the order's fields automatically, including the source and destination locations for the repair. Types are created under Repair, Configuration, Repair Types.

name: repair_type
summary: Sets default source locations for adding, removing, and recycling components on a repair operation type. When that type is picked on a repair order, the component moves take those source locations automatically.

name: repair_type_product_destination
summary: A technical module that adds a Product Destination Location to repair orders, defaulting from the operation type. It has no visible effect on its own, because repaired-product transfers need extra code to use the field. It is a starting template for developers.

name: repair_type_refurbish
summary: Adds a default refurbish destination location to repair types, the same way the standard locations are set. Choose the refurbished location on the repair type, and it fills in on the repair order.

name: repair_type_sequence
summary: Gives each repair type its own numbering sequence, with a prefix and a next number, so repair order references follow the type they belong to. The sequence is set on the repair type.

name: repair_warehouse
summary: Adds a Warehouse field to repair orders. Choosing a repair location sets the warehouse, and location choices are limited to that warehouse. This prevents repairs from mixing locations across warehouses.

name: report_async
summary: Adds a Report Center under the Dashboard menu, where reports can run now or in the background through the job queue. Background reports save their file for later download and can be emailed when ready. Only users with Technical Features rights set up which reports are available.

name: report_async
summary: Adds a Report Center under the Dashboard menu, where reports can run now or in the background through the job queue. Background reports save their file for later download and can be emailed when ready. Only users with Technical Features rights set up which reports are available.

name: report_company_details_translatable
summary: Lets you translate the company details block printed on PDF reports, so the company information can appear in the customer's language. This is useful when printing in non-Latin alphabets, or when domestic and international documents need different languages. The block is edited on the company record.

name: report_context
summary: Technical setting that passes extra context values to a specific printed report, so the report can hide fields or change other options. Each report gets a Context Value field, which is filled in while in debug mode from the report settings. Developers then read that context inside the report template.

name: report_csv
summary: Technical base for producing reports as CSV files instead of PDFs. Developers add their own CSV report classes, and each report can set a text encoding such as cp932 for Japanese systems and how to handle characters that cannot be encoded. Users download the result like any other report.

name: report_display_name_in_footer
summary: Prints the name of the document, such as the order number, in the footer of every page of a PDF report, next to the page numbers. This helps readers match loose pages of a multi-page printout to their document. The list of models that get this footer is set in a system parameter, and the value all turns it on everywhere.

name: report_docx
summary: Lets you design a report as a Word (DOCX) template and print it as a DOCX file. You upload the template, set the model it works on, and test expressions on a record in the DOCX tab. Reports are set up under Settings, Technical, Actions, Report.

name: report_footer_html
summary: Adds an HTML footer to chosen reports, such as an image or company text at the bottom of each printed page. You set the footer in the report's Advanced Properties and adjust the paper format's bottom margin so the footer fits. It is set per report.

name: report_footer_html
summary: Lets you add custom HTML content, such as text or an image, to the footer of chosen printed reports. Set it on the report record under advanced properties, and adjust the bottom margin of the report paper format so the footer fits. Some layouts show the custom footer full width.

name: report_generate_helper
summary: A developer helper that generates a report from a record by passing the report name, without going through the print menu. It adds no screens for business users.

name: report_hotel_reservation
summary: Adds a reporting view that counts hotel reservations by state, for better business intelligence. It is a reporting add-on for the hotel reservation module.

name: report_hotel_restaurant
summary: Adds a reporting view that counts hotel restaurant reservation orders by state, for business intelligence on restaurant activity. It is a reporting add-on for the hotel restaurant module.

name: report_label
summary: Lets you print self-adhesive labels for any list of records, such as product or address labels, choosing how many labels each record gets and an optional starting offset. Label sizes are defined as label paper formats, and each label report is attached to a server action that prints the chosen records. Output is a PDF.

name: report_label
summary: Lets you print self-adhesive labels for any list of records. You select the records, run the label report from the Action menu, choose the number of labels per record and an optional offset, and print to PDF. Label sheet formats are set under Technical, Reporting, Label Paper Format.

name: report_layout_config
summary: Lets you replace the header and footer of printed documents with full-page images, such as a letterhead. The images are set from General Settings under Document Layout by opening Configure Document Layout and choosing the layout images option. The images are stored per company.

name: report_paperformat_company_dependent
summary: Lets each company in a multi-company database use its own paper format for reports. A company created after this module is installed does not get a paper format automatically, so you assign one to each report for that company. The format is set on the report record.

name: report_partner_address
summary: Adds an Address Details field to contacts that can be filled in for each active language, and used in printed documents and the customer portal instead of the standard address when present. If left blank, the standard address format is used. Address Details is not passed on to child contacts.

name: report_pdf_form
summary: Lets you print fillable PDF forms with values pulled from Odoo records. You upload a PDF that has form fields, then map each form field to a field on the record or to a reusable variable. The filled form is produced as a report.

name: report_pdf_zip_download
summary: When several records are printed at once, creates one PDF per record and bundles them into a ZIP file instead of one combined PDF. Printing a single record behaves as normal. It is enabled per report with a Zip Download option under the report's advanced properties.

name: report_positioned_image
summary: Adds logos, watermarks or stamps to PDF reports at exact positions measured in millimeters, shown on every page or on the first page only. Company-level images can be included in any report that opts in, and reports can also carry their own images. Images are set up on the company record under a Report Images tab.

name: report_printed_flag
summary: Marks records as printed when a chosen PDF report is generated, and keeps a log of who printed what and when. You set this up under Settings, Reporting, Printed Flag, with a rule per report and an optional domain filter. Extension modules add the printed flag and log to the records they cover.

name: report_py3o
summary: Technical reporting engine that builds documents from LibreOffice templates (ODT or ODS files) and outputs PDF, Word, Excel or other formats. It lets non-developers design reports in LibreOffice, and users can receive an editable file. Templates are uploaded on each report's settings under the technical actions for reports.

name: report_py3o
summary: A reporting engine that builds documents from LibreOffice templates (ODT or ODS), so report layouts can be designed in LibreOffice without coding. Output can be PDF, DOCX, or other formats, and the generated file can be edited afterward. It is technical: each report is linked to a template file.

name: report_py3o
summary: A reporting engine that builds documents from LibreOffice templates (ODT or ODS), so report layouts can be designed in LibreOffice without coding. Output can be PDF, DOCX, or other formats, and users can edit the generated file. It is technical: each report points to a template file, and each conversion starts a LibreOffice process, which can be slow.

name: report_py3o_fusion_server
summary: Lets an external py3o Fusion server handle document conversion and PDF export instead of a LibreOffice process on the Odoo server, for better speed. It adds PDF export profiles, for example PDF/A, watermarks, password protection and PDF forms, which are set on the server or on an individual report. It requires extra software to be deployed.

name: report_py3o_fusion_server
summary: Hands the format conversion for LibreOffice-based (py3o) reports to a separate Fusion server, instead of a local LibreOffice process. This is faster, and it lets you set PDF export options such as PDF/A, PDF forms, watermarks, and password protection. It needs extra server components deployed, and the options are set under Settings, Technical, Reporting, Py3o.

name: report_qr
summary: Improves how QR codes are printed on reports, giving a cleaner and better structured image than Odoo's standard QR code. Report templates call it with a path and can choose the error correction level. Useful for any printed document that carries a QR code.

name: report_qr
summary: Prints QR codes on reports with a new generator that looks cleaner than the standard one. Report designers choose an error correction level when they add the QR code to a template. It is technical and aimed at report designers.

name: report_qweb_decimal_place
summary: Provides the base for showing unit prices with a different number of decimal places per currency on PDF reports, for example no decimals for yen and more for dollars. You turn on Apply Price Decimal Place and set the number of places on each currency. It has no visible effect until a developer applies it in a report.

name: report_qweb_element_page_visibility
summary: Technical styling helper that lets report designers show a header or footer element only on the first page, the last page, or all other pages of a multi-page PDF. It works by adding CSS classes to elements in the report templates. Typically used to repeat a document number on continuation pages.

name: report_qweb_element_page_visibility
summary: Lets report designers show part of a page header or footer only on the first page, only on the last page, or on every page except one. You add a CSS class to the element in the report template, for example to repeat an invoice number on later pages. It is a technical styling aid for report developers.
keywords: header on every page except first

name: report_qweb_encrypt
summary: Lets PDF reports be password protected. Mark the Encryption field on a report, and the PDF is encrypted with a password typed in for record prints, or with a password generated from the record's data. It is set on the report record.

name: report_qweb_encrypt
summary: Lets PDF reports be password protected. It is set per report, either with a password typed in when printing a single record, or with a password generated automatically from record data. Useful for sending confidential documents such as invoices.

name: report_qweb_field_option
summary: Lets administrators set how many decimal places numbers show on printed reports and views, and choose display options for fields such as a date format. Rules can be limited by unit of measure or currency and by a domain, and when several rules match the strictest one is applied. Configured under Technical Reporting QWeb Field Options.

name: report_qweb_field_option
summary: Lets administrators set decimal precision for float fields and extra display options, such as a date widget, for fields shown on reports and views. Options are set per model and field, optionally per company, and the strictest matching setting applies. This affects printed quantities, prices, and dates on documents like quotations, invoices, and purchase orders.

name: report_qweb_operating_unit
summary: Lets each operating unit have its own header, footer, tagline, details block, and logo, which any report can then use. You set these on the operating unit record. This is for businesses that run several operating units and want branded documents for each.

name: report_qweb_parameter
summary: Adds length rules for fields in QWeb reports. A field can be truncated to a maximum length, or checked against a minimum or maximum length. This is meant for XML reports that must follow a strict format, such as some electronic invoice formats.

name: report_qweb_parameter
summary: Technical helper for XML report templates that need exact field lengths, such as government e-invoicing formats. Template fields can be truncated to a maximum length or checked against minimum and maximum lengths, so invalid documents are caught before sending. It has no separate screen for end users.

name: report_qweb_pdf_cover
summary: Adds an optional front cover and back cover page to PDF reports, either as separate pages or overlapping the first and last pages of the document. It is enabled per report under advanced properties and can use uploaded cover PDFs. Useful for catalogs and formal reports.

name: report_qweb_pdf_cover
summary: Adds an optional front cover and back cover to PDF reports, uploaded as PDFs. A cover can sit on its own page at the start or end of the report, or overlap the first or last page. You turn covers on in the Advanced Properties tab of the report.

name: report_qweb_pdf_watermark
summary: Adds a watermark or background image to PDF reports, inserted at the PDF level so it covers the full page. You can upload a PDF or image for each report, or use an expression to supply it, and a company watermark can be set on the company record. The watermark size and resolution must match the page.

name: report_qweb_pdf_watermark
summary: Adds a watermark or background image to every page of a PDF report, such as a draft stamp or a full-page background. The image is placed at the PDF level so it covers the whole page, and it can come from a PDF or image uploaded on the report, from an expression, or from the company watermark. It is set under the report's advanced properties and company information.

name: report_qweb_signer
summary: Digitally signs PDF reports with a PKCS#12 certificate set up on the company. When a user prints a configured document, the signed PDF downloads automatically. A signed PDF can also be saved as an attachment so it is not signed again, which suits documents where the signing date matters, such as customer invoices.

name: report_qweb_signer
summary: Digitally signs printed QWeb PDF reports with a company certificate (PKCS#12), so the document downloads already signed. Optionally the signed file is saved as an attachment, so later prints return the same copy with its original date. Certificates are uploaded under General Settings, Certificates and Keys.

name: report_qweb_signer
summary: Digitally signs PDF reports with a PKCS#12 certificate set up on the company. When a user prints a configured document, the signed PDF downloads automatically. A signed PDF can also be saved as an attachment so it is not signed again, which suits documents where the signing date matters, such as customer invoices.

name: report_substitute
summary: Lets you swap a standard report for another report when conditions are met, using substitution rules with a domain. For example, each company can get its own invoice layout. The first matching rule is used when the report is called.

name: report_substitute
summary: Lets you set rules so a printed report is automatically replaced by an alternative report when conditions are met, for example a different invoice layout for one company. Each rule has a domain that decides when it applies, and the rules are listed on the report's Substitution Rules tab. Configured under Settings, Technical, Actions, Reports.

name: report_text_format_option
summary: Technical option for text-format reports that sets the character encoding of the exported file, such as cp932 for Japanese systems, and how unsupported characters are handled. It also sets the line ending style. It is configured on the report record under Technical Reports and only affects text reports.

name: report_text_format_option
summary: Adds encoding and line-ending settings for text-type reports, so exports can use a non-UTF-8 encoding such as cp932 for Japanese systems. You also choose whether characters that cannot be encoded are ignored or replaced. These are set on the report record under Technical, Reports.

name: report_wkhtmltopdf_param
summary: Adds custom command-line options for the wkhtmltopdf PDF engine to a paper format, for layouts that must not shrink or change size. Disabling smart shrinking is a common example, used for checks or official forms. The options are set on the paper format under Technical settings, in developer mode.

name: report_wkhtmltopdf_param
summary: Technical option that lets you add extra command-line settings for the PDF engine to a paper format, such as disabling smart shrinking so a printed form lines up exactly. Parameters are added in developer mode on the Paper Format record under Technical Reports. It is mainly used for pre-printed forms and checks.

name: report_xlsx
summary: Technical base for producing reports as Excel (XLSX) files. Developers write a report class that fills the workbook rows, and users can then download it from the print menu like any other report. It has no separate screen for end users.

name: report_xlsx_helper
summary: Provides helpers for building Excel (xlsx) reports in code, including cell types and a base class that speeds up the work. It is for developers creating spreadsheet reports, and it needs the xlsx report module installed.

name: report_xlsx_helper
summary: Adds helper tools that make building Excel reports easier for developers, with ready-made cell types, formats and layout options on top of the XLSX report base. Other modules use it to offer Excel reports. Users simply see the results as Excel downloads.

name: report_xml
summary: A base engine that lets modules generate XML reports, either from code or from QWeb templates. It can validate output against an XSD schema, and sets encoding and declaration options on the report. It is for developers, and business users see no direct result.

name: report_xml
summary: Technical base for producing XML reports, such as files for government or electronic invoicing systems, generated from code or QWeb templates. It can validate the output against an XSD schema and set the XML encoding and declaration. Users do not work with it directly, and other modules build on it.

name: res_company_access_all_children
summary: Gives users access to every child company when they have access to a parent company. Child companies created later are shared automatically with those users, so no per-user setup is needed. This suits company groups with a parent and subsidiary structure.

name: res_company_active
summary: Lets you archive a company from the Archive action, so it no longer shows as an active company. A check stops you archiving a company that is still the active company for users.

name: res_company_active
summary: Lets you archive a company from the Archive action, so it no longer shows as an active company. A check stops you archiving a company that is still the active company for users.

name: res_company_category
summary: Adds Company Categories so you can classify companies, for example for statistics across a multi-company database. Categories can be nested, and each company gets a category on its Configuration tab. Categories are set up under Configuration, Companies, Company Categories.

name: res_company_category
summary: Adds Company Categories so you can classify companies, for example for statistics across a multi-company database. Categories can be nested, and each company gets a category on its Configuration tab. Categories are set up under Configuration, Companies, Company Categories.

name: res_company_code
summary: Adds an optional, unique Code to each company. The code is shown as a prefix in the company switcher, and companies are sorted by code and then by name. The old sequence field is hidden. This is useful when many companies share one database.

name: res_company_code
summary: Adds an optional, unique Code to each company. The code is shown as a prefix in the company switcher, and companies are sorted by code and then by name. The old sequence field is hidden. This is useful when many companies share one database.

name: res_company_gitlab_link
summary: Adds a GitLab Account field to the company record, to hold the company's GitLab link. It is part of the social media links set on the company.

name: res_company_mastodon_link
summary: Adds a Mastodon Account field to the company record, to hold the company's Mastodon link. It is part of the social media links set on the company.

name: res_company_mastodon_link
