summary: Adds a Mastodon Account field to the company record, to hold the company's Mastodon link. It is part of the social media links set on the company.

name: res_company_search_view
summary: Adds a search view for companies, so you can search and group the company list. The street, city, zip, state, and country fields are stored, so they can be used in filters and groupings. It is mainly a base that other modules extend.

name: res_company_search_view
summary: Adds a search view for companies, so you can search and filter the company list. It is mainly a base that other modules extend.

name: res_company_search_view
summary: Adds a search view for companies, so you can search and filter the company list. It is mainly a base that other modules extend.

name: res_partner_category_multi_company
summary: Adds a Company field to contact tags, so each tag can be assigned to a specific company. Tags are set up under Contacts, Configuration, Contact Tags.

name: res_partner_industry_multi_company
summary: Adds a Company field to partner industries, so each industry can belong to a specific company in a multi-company database.

name: res_partner_linkedin_link
summary: Adds a LinkedIn Account field to contacts. A LinkedIn icon appears on the kanban card, and the link shows on the website when the contact is published there.

name: res_partner_mastodon_link
summary: Adds a Mastodon Account field to contacts and companies. A Mastodon icon appears on the kanban card, and the link shows on the website when the contact is published there.

name: res_partner_operating_unit
summary: Adds operating units to contacts. New contacts are assigned your default operating unit, and users only see the customers in operating units they can access. This is set on the contact form.

name: res_partner_product_pricelist_operating_unit
summary: Makes sure a customer's pricelist belongs to one of that customer's operating units. The contact form only offers pricelists from those units, and a pricelist from an unauthorized unit cannot be saved. It requires the operating unit contact module.

name: resource_booking
summary: Adds a Resource Bookings app where people book combinations of resources, such as a consultant and a room, within set schedules. Bookings can be made from the portal, from a tokenized link, or in the backend, and conflicts are detected automatically. Each booking creates a calendar meeting. It suits clinics, sales appointments, classrooms, and hotel rooms.

name: resource_booking
summary: Adds a Resource Bookings app where people book combinations of resources, such as a consultant and a room, within set schedules. Bookings can be made from the portal, from a tokenized link, or in the backend, and conflicts are detected automatically. Each booking creates a calendar meeting. It suits clinics, sales appointments, classrooms, and hotel rooms.

name: resource_calendar_flexible_exclude_weekend
summary: Adds an option on working schedules (resource calendars) that leaves weekend days out of flexible hours calculations. Set it on the working schedule form when the company uses flexible hours. It is a technical setting used with flexible schedules.

name: resource_leaves_geographic
summary: Lets public holidays be limited to a state, so a local holiday applies only to employees in that region. Holidays without a state apply to everyone. Local holidays show with a grey background on the Time Off overview for the matching employees.

name: resource_multi_week_calendar
summary: A hidden technical module that lets a working-time calendar rotate through more than two weeks, such as a three-week cycle. The standard resource module only supports two alternating weeks. Other modules that use alternating weeks must be adapted to work with it, and the note says only the leave module does so at present.

name: rest_log
summary: Records every REST API request in the database, including parameters, results, and errors, to help debug and monitor integrations. Logs are kept for 30 days by default, and this can be changed in system parameters. The Logs menu appears only in developer mode.

name: rest_log
summary: Records every REST API request in the database, including parameters, results, and errors, to help debug and monitor integrations. It can also profile selected endpoints. Logs are kept for 30 days by default, and this can be changed in system parameters. The Logs menu appears only in developer mode.

name: rma
summary: Manages Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) for customer returns. RMAs can be created from scratch, from a delivery order, or from an incoming email, and receipts and return deliveries use Inventory's standard operations. Refunds are created the same way as Odoo's standard refunds, and customers can follow RMAs in the portal.

name: rma
summary: Manages Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) for customer returns. RMAs can be created from scratch, from a delivery order, or from an incoming email, and receipts and return deliveries use Inventory's standard operations. Refunds are created the same way as Odoo's standard refunds, and customers can follow RMAs in the portal.

name: rma_batch
summary: Groups several RMAs from the same return event into one RMA batch. Shared details such as customer, responsible person, team, tags, and date stay in sync across the batch, and actions apply to all its RMAs. Batches move through Draft, Ready, and Confirmed states, and are found under Returns, RMA Batches.

name: rma_batch_sale_auto_detect
summary: Runs the sale order auto-matching across every RMA in a batch at once. If any RMA in the batch cannot be matched, the batch moves to a Manual Treatment state so someone can fix those RMAs. It requires the RMA batch and sale auto-detect modules.
keywords: auto match RMA batch sale order

name: rma_delivery
summary: Lets a return to the customer use a shipping carrier chosen by company strategy, such as always one fixed method or the method set on the customer. The strategy is set under Inventory settings, and reception strategies can be set the same way. The return delivery then gets the chosen carrier.

name: rma_delivery
summary: Lets a return to the customer use a shipping carrier chosen by company strategy, such as always one fixed method or the method set on the customer. The strategy is set under Inventory settings, and reception strategies can be set the same way. The return delivery then gets the chosen carrier.

name: rma_inter_company
summary: Automatically creates an inter-company RMA, so a return on one company's sale also shows up as an RMA in the supplying company. Each RMA can then be managed separately while staying linked. It builds on the inter-company purchase-to-sale and dropshipping setup.

name: rma_lot
summary: Lets you record the lot or serial number on RMAs, so each returned item is traced to a specific lot. An operation can be set to deliver the same lot or serial that was received from the customer. The lot field appears on the RMA form.

name: rma_lot_autocreate
summary: Creates a new stock lot or serial number automatically when an RMA is confirmed, using a sequence set on the RMA operation. Expiration and removal dates can be set on the new lot. Use it for returned items that should get a fresh lot when they come in.

name: rma_procurement_customer
summary: Makes sure the customer from the original delivery is copied onto every stock transfer created in an RMA, including receipts, returns, and replacements. It is a technical link to the customer procurement feature.

name: rma_reason
summary: Lets RMA managers define a list of return reasons, such as a defective product, that users pick from when they create an RMA. Each company can make the reason mandatory or optional. Reasons are set up under RMA, Settings, RMA Reasons.

name: rma_repair
summary: Creates a repair order from an RMA. If the repair succeeds, the item can go back to the customer, and if it does not, the customer can get a refund or a replacement. A Create Repair Order button on the RMA starts it, and smart buttons link the RMA and the repair.

name: rma_repair_follow_lot_location
summary: A glue module that sets the Follow Lot Location option on repair orders created from RMAs, using a default set on the RMA operation. When it is on, the repair location follows the actual location of the lot. It connects RMA repair with repair lot location tracking.

name: rma_repair_location
summary: Sets the warehouse and location used for repair orders created from an RMA, configured on each RMA operation. When set, those values fill in when the repair is generated, instead of the repair module's default. These are set on the RMA operation.

name: rma_repair_lot
summary: A glue module that makes repair orders and RMAs work together with lot and serial numbers. It is technical and has no screens of its own.

name: rma_sale
summary: Links a sales order to an RMA, so returns can be started from a sales order, from the sales order form, or from the customer's portal page. You can pick the sales order on a new RMA, or create one or more RMAs from a sales order. RMAs show as a smart button on the sales order.

name: rma_sale
summary: Links a sales order to an RMA, so returns can be started from a sales order, from the sales order form, or from the customer's portal page. You can pick the sales order on a new RMA, or create one or more RMAs from a sales order. RMAs show as a smart button on the sales order.

name: rma_sale_auto_detect
summary: Automatically links an RMA to the sale order lines it matches. It looks at deliveries to the same customer within the operation's return period, uses delivered quantities oldest first, and splits the RMA when needed. An RMA with no matching delivery is flagged. Use the Link to sale order button on a draft RMA.

name: rma_sale_delivery
summary: Lets you choose the carrier for the receipt when you create an RMA from a sales order. It adds a reception carrier field to the sales order's return wizard.

name: rma_sale_lot
summary: Adds lot and serial number tracking to the return wizard on sales orders. Salespeople can make sure the customer returns the exact lot that was delivered, which improves tracking and inventory accuracy. It extends the RMA lot tracking module.

name: rma_sale_mrp
summary: Lets customers return a kit, which is a bill of materials product, from a sales order. In the portal, customers return whole kits, and in the backend the kit components are returned separately, creating one RMA per component. The number of kits returned cannot exceed the number delivered.

name: rma_sale_mrp
summary: Lets customers return a kit, which is a bill of materials product, from a sales order. In the portal, customers return whole kits, and in the backend the kit components are returned separately, creating one RMA per component. The number of kits returned cannot exceed the number delivered.

name: rma_sale_reason
summary: Lets a salesperson record the return reason when creating an RMA from a sales order, instead of leaving it to the returns team. It extends the RMA sale and RMA reason modules with a reason field in the sales order's return wizard.

name: rma_sale_stock_restocking_fee_invoicing
summary: Adds restocking fees to returns, either a fixed amount or a percentage of the original line price. Fees are set on the RMA operation or on the RMA itself, and are applied when the last receipt step is validated. The fee can reduce the refund quantity or be invoiced manually after receipt.

name: route_planning
summary: Plans delivery routes. You set up route areas (zones), checkpoints (stops), and routes made of ordered checkpoints, with visit time windows set on each customer contact. Partners and the company need latitude and longitude before it works, and a map view is included.

name: route_planning_delivery
summary: Connects Route Planning to delivery methods. When you ship a sales order with a Route Planning carrier and pick a route area, the route and its checkpoint are created automatically when the delivery is created. The carrier's provider is set to Route Planning.

name: route_planning_rma
summary: Adds reception and delivery route areas to RMAs, so the pickings created for a return use the chosen route. Route areas also appear in the return wizard and in the wizard that creates an RMA from another RMA.

name: route_planning_rma_delivery
summary: Shows the delivery and reception route area fields on RMAs and their wizards only when the selected carrier is a Route Planning carrier, and makes the area required in that case. It connects RMA carriers with route planning.

name: route_planning_rma_sale
summary: Adds a reception route area to the RMA creation wizard that starts from a sales order. It links route planning for returns with sales orders.

name: route_planning_sale_stock
summary: Automatically creates routes and checkpoints from the transfers of sales orders. A route area set on the sales order means deliveries are routed as they are created. It works with Route Planning, Sales, and Inventory together.

name: route_planning_stock
summary: Connects Route Planning with Inventory so that delivery orders can create routes and checkpoints automatically. When goods are sent to the transit location of a Route Area, the delivery runs in two steps: the first moves stock onto the vehicle, and the second waits until the driver completes the customer checkpoint, then validates on its own. Setup is in Inventory Settings (Storage Locations) and Route Planning > Configuration > Areas, and the Route Area field appears on delivery orders.

name: rpc_helper
summary: Lets developers and administrators block selected external API calls, such as create or write, on a given model. Blocking can be set in code or in the model's RPC config tab in debug mode. It is a security tool to stop outside systems from changing sensitive data.

name: sale_advance_payment
summary: Lets you record a customer's advance payment against a sale order before the invoice exists, then choose which of those payments to apply when the invoice is created. The payment is entered from a Pay Sale Advance button on the order by picking a journal and an amount. Advance payments appear on the invoice for selection.

name: sale_advance_payment
summary: Lets a salesperson record a customer payment against a sale order before it is invoiced. From the sale order, click Pay Sale Advance, choose a journal and amount, and the advance payment is recorded. When the invoice is created, the open advance payments are listed so they can be applied to it.

name: sale_analytic_brand
summary: Technical bridge module that lets sale order lines take their analytic distribution from brand-specific analytic distribution models. It adds no fields of its own. The result is visible in the Analytic Distribution field on sale order lines.

name: sale_analytic_distribution_model_warehouse
summary: Fills in the analytic distribution on sale order lines automatically, based on the warehouse of the order. You set a warehouse on an analytic distribution model, and sales from that warehouse get its analytic accounts and percentages. Users can still change the distribution by hand. Configured under Accounting > Configuration > Analytic Distribution Models.

name: sale_analytic_tag
summary: Restores analytic tags on sale order lines, so the analytic entries created when the order is invoiced carry those tags. Tags are picked in the Analytic Tags field on each sale order line. Used for reporting and grouping sales by tag.

name: sale_analytic_tag
summary: Restores analytic tags on sale order lines, so the analytic entries created when the order is invoiced carry those tags. Tags are picked in the Analytic Tags field on each sale order line. Used for reporting and grouping sales by tag.

name: sale_attached_product
summary: Lets you set up products that are added automatically to a sales order whenever a main product is added, such as a required accessory. The attached lines take the same quantity as the main line, and they can update automatically when the main quantity changes if that setting is on. Configured on the product's Sales tab under Attached products.

name: sale_attached_product
summary: Lets you set products that are added to a sale order automatically whenever a main product is added, such as an accessory or warranty. Attached lines take the main line's quantity, and an optional setting keeps them updated when that quantity changes. Set up on the Sales tab of a product form; the added lines are flagged as attached on the sale order.

name: sale_auto_remove_zero_quantity_lines
summary: When a sale order is confirmed, any line with a quantity of zero is deleted automatically. Turn it on in Sales Settings under Quotations and Orders (Automatic Removal of Zero Quantity Lines). Keeps confirmed orders free of empty lines.
keywords: clean up sale order on confirm
remove zero quantity products on confirmation

name: sale_auto_remove_zero_quantity_lines
summary: When a sale order is confirmed, any line with a quantity of zero is deleted automatically. Turn it on in Sales Settings under Quotations and Orders (Automatic Removal of Zero Quantity Lines). Keeps confirmed orders free of empty lines.
keywords: clean up sale order on confirm
remove zero quantity products on confirmation

name: sale_automatic_workflow
summary: Lets you define automatic workflows that confirm, invoice, validate and send sales orders without manual steps, for example for orders that come from an online shop. A workflow sets the shipping policy, invoice date and sales team, and decides which steps run automatically. Workflows are managed under Sales, Configuration, Automatic Workflow.

name: sale_automatic_workflow
summary: Lets you define workflows that push a sale order through steps automatically: confirming the order, creating and validating the invoice, emailing it, and confirming the delivery. Each sale order gets an Automatic Workflow, and each step can be limited by conditions. Mainly built for e-commerce connectors, but usable by any sales team; the workflow field appears on the sale order.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_auto_assign
summary: Automatically picks the right automatic workflow when a sales order is created, based on a domain and priority set on each workflow. When a sales order is duplicated, the original workflow is copied only if no automatic match is found. Users do not choose the workflow by hand.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_force_invoiced
summary: Lets an automatic workflow mark matching sales orders as Force Invoiced, so they are treated as fully invoiced when they meet the workflow's domain. The option and domain are set on the workflow under Sales, Configuration, Automatic Workflow. It is used to close orders that will not be invoiced in the normal way.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_job
summary: Runs automatic workflow steps as background queued jobs, one per operation, instead of processing every order in one long scheduled run. Each job is keyed so the same order and step are not queued twice. It is suited to shops with a high volume of orders.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_job
summary: Runs the automatic workflow steps (confirming orders, creating and validating invoices) as background queue jobs instead of one long scheduled action. This helps when there are many orders and the scheduled action would be too slow. Technical add-on: users only notice more reliable background processing, and it needs the queue job module.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_payment_mode
summary: Links payment modes to automatic workflows, so a sale order that uses a payment mode with a workflow picks that workflow automatically. The workflow is chosen on the payment mode in the Invoicing configuration. The workflow then appears on the sale order.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_payment_mode
summary: Links payment modes to automatic workflows, so a sales order that uses a payment mode with a workflow automatically gets that workflow. The workflow is chosen on each payment mode in the invoicing configuration. It is a glue module between payment mode setup and sales automation.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_periodicity
summary: Lets a workflow run on a repeating interval, set in seconds, and shows when it will next run. An option can limit processing to orders created before the last run. It controls how often orders are processed automatically.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_stock
summary: Extends automatic workflows with stock steps, such as choosing whether to ship as products become available or all at once, setting a packing policy, and automatically confirming the delivery order. The workflow also appears on the delivery orders it creates. It is set up in the same configuration as other workflows.

name: sale_automatic_workflow_stock_job
summary: Runs the stock-related workflow steps, such as confirming delivery orders, as background queued jobs rather than one long scheduled run. It works alongside the automatic workflow job module for high-volume shipping.

name: sale_blanket_order
summary: Lets you agree a fixed price with a customer for a set quantity of products over a validity period. Once the blanket order is confirmed, sale orders can be created from it at that price until the validity period ends or the quantity runs out. It has its own Blanket Orders menu in Sales, and sale orders link back to the blanket order they came from.

name: sale_blanket_order
summary: Lets you agree a fixed price with a customer for a set quantity of products until a validity date. Once the blanket order is confirmed, sale orders can be created from it at that price until it expires or the quantity runs out. It has its own Blanket Orders menu in Sales, and sale orders link back to the blanket order they came from.

name: sale_blanket_order
summary: Lets sales teams create a blanket order, a pre-agreed contract to sell a set quantity of products at a fixed price until a validity date or until the quantity runs out. Confirmed blanket orders are then used to create individual sale orders at that price. A Blanket Orders menu in Sales holds the form for customer, salesperson, payment terms, validity date and order lines.

name: sale_block_no_stock
summary: Stops a sales order from being confirmed when the quantity ordered is more than the stock available by a chosen measure, such as stock available on the delivery date. A wizard then lets the user reduce the quantities or move the extra lines to a new order, and users in an allowed group can confirm anyway. It applies to storable products only.

name: sale_block_no_stock
summary: Stops a sale order from being confirmed when the requested quantity is more than what is available in stock. A wizard then lets the user reduce the quantities to what is available, or move the rest to a new order. The check field and the groups allowed to bypass the block are set in Sales Settings. Only storable products are checked.

name: sale_block_no_stock
summary: Stops a sale order from being confirmed when the requested quantity is more than what is available in stock. A wizard then lets the user reduce the quantities to what is available, or move the rest to a new order. The check field and the groups allowed to bypass the block are set in Sales Settings. Only storable products are checked.

name: sale_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to quotations and sales orders, so each document can go out under a specific brand. The brand is carried over to the invoices created from the order, and the printed PDF shows the brand details. The brand is also set on sales teams.

name: sale_brand
summary: Adds a Brand field to quotations and sales orders, so each document can go out under a specific brand. The brand is carried over to the invoices created from the order. The brand is also set on sales teams.

name: sale_cancel_confirm
summary: Adds an optional free-text reason to the standard sales order cancel dialog, and stores the reason, user and date on the cancelled order. It is enabled per company in Sales settings. Use this when free text is wanted instead of a predefined list of reasons.

name: sale_cancel_reason
summary: Requires a reason whenever a sales order is cancelled. Users pick the reason from a list configured in Sales settings, and the reason is stamped on the order. Mass cancellations can carry a reason too.

name: sale_cancel_reason
summary: When a sale order is cancelled, the user must pick a reason from a configured list, and the reason is saved on the order. The cancel wizard shows the list, and the chosen reason is stored as Reason for cancellation on the sale order.

name: sale_cancel_restrict
summary: Blocks cancelling a confirmed sale order when something has already been delivered or an invoice is still open and not cancelled. A warning appears instead of the cancellation. It is switched on in Sales Settings with Enable Sale Cancel Restrict.

name: sale_channel
summary: Adds sales channels such as a marketplace or web shop, so each sale order and invoice records which channel it came from. A channel has a name, company, and type. This is a base module for e-commerce connectors, shown as the Sales Channel field on sale orders and invoices.

name: sale_channel
summary: Adds sales channels such as a marketplace or web shop, so each sale order and invoice records which channel it came from. A channel has a name, company, and type. This is a base module for e-commerce connectors, shown as the Sales Channel field on sale orders and invoices.

name: sale_channel_category
summary: Links product categories to sales channels, so you can see which categories are sold through each channel. Product categories get a Sale Channels field, and channels get a root category field. Shown on product category forms and sales channel forms.

name: sale_channel_category
summary: Links product categories to sales channels, so you can see which categories are sold through each channel. Product categories get a Sale Channels field, and channels get a root category field. Shown on product category forms and sales channel forms.

name: sale_channel_partner
summary: Records the customer account that each sales channel knows a contact by. For example, the same customer buying on Amazon and eBay gets one binding per channel, each with its external ID. Shows as a Sale Channel Bindings tab on contacts and a Sale Channel Partners list on each channel.

name: sale_channel_partner
summary: Records the customer account that each sales channel knows a contact by. For example, the same customer buying on Amazon and eBay gets one binding per channel, each with its external ID. Shows as a Sale Channel Bindings tab on contacts and a Sale Channel Partners list on each channel.

name: sale_channel_product
summary: Links products to specific sales channels, so you can tell which products are sold on which channel. It is a simple linking module that adds a channel link on the product form.

name: sale_channel_product
summary: Links products to specific sales channels, so you can tell which products are sold on which channel. It is a simple linking module that adds a channel link on the product form.

name: sale_channel_search_engine
summary: Connects a sales channel to a search engine such as Elasticsearch, so products and categories linked to that channel can be pushed into the search index. It is a base module for building search exports, adding a Search Engine setting on the channel. Technical, aimed at integrators rather than daily sales users.

name: sale_channel_search_engine
summary: Connects a sales channel to a search engine such as Elasticsearch, so products and categories linked to that channel can be pushed into the search index. It is a base module for building search exports, adding a Search Engine setting on the channel. Technical, aimed at integrators rather than daily sales users.

name: sale_channel_search_engine_category
summary: Pushes the product categories linked to a sales channel into that channel's search engine, keeping the category index in sync. It is a technical integration module, visible through search engine sync records on categories.

name: sale_channel_search_engine_category
summary: Pushes the product categories linked to a sales channel into that channel's search engine, keeping the category index in sync. It is a technical integration module, visible through search engine sync records on categories.

name: sale_channel_search_engine_demo
summary: Demo and test module that installs the sales channel and search engine modules with sample setup, so developers can try the search engine export. It is not meant for production users.

name: sale_channel_search_engine_product
summary: Pushes products linked to a sales channel into that channel's search engine, and shows sync counts (total, done, pending, error) on product templates. It lets someone see whether a product's search index update succeeded. Technical integration visible on product forms.

name: sale_channel_search_engine_product
summary: Pushes products linked to a sales channel into that channel's search engine, and shows sync counts (total, done, pending, error) on product templates. It lets someone see whether a product's search index update succeeded. Technical integration visible on product forms.

name: sale_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to sales orders, which can be loaded from saved comment templates. Comments can sit above or below the order lines, and they are copied to the invoice created from the order. Shows as a comment section on the sale order and the printed quotation.

name: sale_comment_template
summary: Adds comment text to sales orders, which can be loaded from saved comment templates. Comments can sit above or below the order lines, and they are copied to the invoice created from the order. Shows as a comment section on the sale order and the printed quotation.

name: sale_commercial_partner
summary: Adds hidden stored fields on sales orders for the customer's commercial entity and invoice entity, so orders can be grouped by company rather than by individual contact. Settings can limit invoice and delivery address choices to contacts under the same commercial entity. Use Group by Commercial Entity in the sales lists and reports.

name: sale_commercial_partner
summary: Adds stored Customer Entity and Invoice Entity fields to sales orders, so orders can be grouped and reported by the company that owns the contact (the commercial entity). The grouping is available in the Sales order lists and in Sales reporting. The fields are technical, and the grouping is what users see.

name: sale_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a stored Commercial Entity field to sales orders, so orders can be grouped and reported by the company that owns the contact. The grouping is available in the Sales order lists and in Sales reporting. The field is technical, and the grouping is what users see.

name: sale_commercial_partner
summary: Adds stored Customer Entity and Invoice Entity fields to sales orders, so orders can be grouped and reported by the company that owns the contact (the commercial entity). The grouping is available in the Sales order lists and in Sales reporting. The fields are technical, and the grouping is what users see.

name: sale_commission
summary: Calculates sales commissions on quotation and sales order lines. Agents and their commission rates default from the customer, and can be changed per line with the agents button next to the Commission field. The commission lines carry over to the invoice lines; settlements are handled elsewhere.

name: sale_commission
summary: Calculates sales commissions on quotation and sales order lines. Agents and their commission rates default from the customer, and can be changed per line with the agents button next to the Commission field. The commission lines carry over to the invoice lines; settlements are handled elsewhere.

name: sale_commission_agent_restrict
summary: Restricts commission agent users so they only see their own contacts, sales orders and quotations, and their own commission lines. An agent can see a record if they created it or are listed as its agent. Set up by flagging a partner as an agent and assigning the user access groups under Settings > Users.

name: sale_commission_margin
summary: Deducts the agent commission from the margin of a sale order line, so the margin shown is what is left after commission. It works when Margins are enabled in Sales Settings and an agent is set on the line. The margin figures on sale order lines reflect the deduction.

name: sale_commission_margin_oca
summary: Deducts the agent commission from the margin of a sale order line, so the margin shown is what is left after commission. It works when Margins are enabled in Sales Settings and an agent is set on the line. This is the OCA version of the same feature.

name: sale_commission_oca
summary: Calculates sales commissions on quotation and sales order lines. Agents and their commission rates default from the customer, and can be changed per line with the agents button next to the Commission field. The commission lines carry over to the invoice lines; settlements are handled elsewhere. This is the OCA version.

name: sale_commission_oca_product_criteria
summary: Lets one commission type pay different rates depending on the product sold, such as 10 percent on one product, a fixed amount on another, and a default for everything else. Rules are checked from the most specific (variant, product, category) to the general default, in the same way as pricelist rules. Commission items can be managed from their own menu under Commissions > Configuration.

name: sale_commission_oca_product_criteria_semaphore
summary: Adds a semaphore (green, yellow, red) filter to product-based commission rules, so lines marked with a semaphore status can earn a different commission rate. Rules without a semaphore act as the fallback for any line. Shows as a Semaphore field on commission items and on settlement lines.

name: sale_commission_pricelist
summary: Lets you attach a commission to a pricelist rule, so the commission applies whenever that pricelist rule is used on a sale order line. The commission is recalculated when the product or quantity on the line changes. Set on pricelist items under Sales > Products > Pricelists, after enabling multiple sales prices per product.

name: sale_commission_pricelist_oca
summary: Lets you attach a commission to a pricelist rule, so the commission applies whenever that pricelist rule is used on a sale order line. The commission is recalculated when the product or quantity on the line changes. This is the OCA version, set on pricelists and pricelist items under Sales > Products > Pricelists.

name: sale_commission_product_criteria
summary: Lets one commission type pay different rates depending on the product sold, such as 10 percent on one product, a fixed amount on another, and a default for everything else. Rules are checked from the most specific (variant, product, category) to the general default, in the same way as pricelist rules. Commission items are managed from their own menu under Commissions > Configuration.

name: sale_commission_product_criteria_country
summary: Lets a product-based commission rule apply only to customers in a chosen country, so the same product can pay different commission depending on where the customer is. A rule with no country applies to all customers. Shows as a Customer Country field on commission item rules.

name: sale_commission_product_criteria_discount
summary: Lets a commission rule depend on the discount given on the sale order line, so agents earn less commission as the discount grows. A rule gets a discount range (from and to) and only applies to lines whose discount falls in that range. Requires discounts to be enabled in Sales Settings.

name: sale_commission_product_criteria_domain
summary: Limits which commission rules apply to specific groups of customers or sales, so one agent can earn a different amount for the same product depending on the customer. This works on top of product-based commission types. Rules are grouped under Commissions > Configuration > Commission Type Items Groups.

name: sale_commission_product_criteria_fiscal_position_type
summary: Lets a product-based commission rule apply only to customers with a chosen fiscal position type, such as domestic or export tax treatment. Rules with no fiscal position type apply to all customers. Shows as a Fiscal Position Type field on commission item rules.

name: sale_commission_salesman
summary: Automatically uses the salesperson on a quotation as the commission agent, when the customer has no other agent set. A contact linked to a salesperson user has a Convert salesman into agent option under Agent information. The agent still needs a commission rate assigned.

name: sale_commission_salesman
summary: Automatically uses the salesperson on a quotation as the commission agent, when the customer has no other agent set. A contact linked to a salesperson user has a Convert salesman into agent option under Agent information. The agent still needs a commission rate assigned.

name: sale_company_currency
summary: Shows sales order totals in the company currency, so orders in different currencies can be added up properly. A Total Amount column is added to the sales order list and the total is shown on the form after the order total. Useful for multi currency sales reporting.

name: sale_company_currency
summary: Shows sales order totals in the company's own currency, so orders in several currencies can be added up correctly in lists. A company currency total column appears in the list view, and the same amount is shown after the total on the form. It helps when comparing sales made in different currencies.

name: sale_confirm_group
summary: Lets administrators choose which security groups may confirm sales orders, separately for each company. Users outside those groups do not see the Confirm button, and trying to confirm anyway raises an error. It is turned on in Sales settings with the Use SO Confirmation Groups checkbox.

name: sale_credit_note_reversal
summary: Allows a credit note to be reversed back into a customer invoice, and ensures the reversal counts as an invoice on the sales order. It also helps when a credit note was posted by mistake, such as a negative quantity line that should have been an invoice. The sales order's invoice count reflects the corrected document.

name: sale_credit_note_reversal
summary: Lets a customer credit note be reversed in a way that still counts as a customer invoice on the sale order. Standard Odoo does not link a reversal to the sale order, and this module fixes that. It also covers credit notes created by mistake, such as a negative quantity line that stays a credit note.

name: sale_crm_event_reservation
summary: Creates event quotations straight from a CRM opportunity. From an opportunity, click New Event Quotation, pick the event and ticket (or no event), and set the seats wanted, and a quotation is generated for the customer. Also adds a reserved seats figure to event type reporting.

name: sale_custom_rounding
summary: Lets a sales order use its own tax calculation rounding method, instead of only the company default. The method can be picked on the order's Other Information tab, or taken from the customer's invoice address setting. It builds on the custom invoice rounding module.

name: sale_customer_order_frequency
summary: Adds order timing statistics to contacts: average days between orders, days since the last order, and estimated days until the next order. These appear in the Sale group of the Sales and Purchase tab. They help sales teams see buying patterns and plan follow-ups.

name: sale_customer_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a customer as soon as a sale order is created for them, by updating the customer rank. This keeps the Customer filter and customer counts correct without a manual step. Works in the background for sales users, with no new screens.

name: sale_customer_rank
summary: Marks a contact as a customer as soon as a sales order is created for it. Normally Odoo only does this when an invoice is posted. It is a background update in the sales flow.

name: sale_delivery_split_date
summary: Splits a confirmed sales order into one delivery order per requested date on its lines, so items due on different days ship separately. Delivery orders can then be searched by scheduled date, which now shows in the delivery list. It builds on the sale order line date module.

name: sale_delivery_split_date
summary: Splits deliveries by date: when a sale order is confirmed, one delivery order is created for each requested date on its lines. Delivery orders can also be searched by their scheduled date, which now shows in the delivery list view. Relies on the sale order line date feature.

name: sale_delivery_state
summary: Adds a delivery status to sales orders, computed from the delivered quantities on the order lines, so you can see at a glance whether an order is not delivered, partly delivered, or fully delivered. The status can be forced to fully delivered when the customer cancels some quantities. Service lines and delivery fee lines can be skipped in the calculation.

name: sale_delivery_state
summary: Shows a delivery status on each sales order, worked out from how much of each line has been delivered. A user can mark an order as fully delivered when the customer cancelled the rest, and service lines and delivery fee lines can be left out of the check. Other modules use this status, which appears on the sales order.

name: sale_delivery_state
summary: Adds a delivery status to sales orders, computed from the delivered quantities on the order lines, so you can see at a glance whether an order is not delivered, partly delivered, or fully delivered. The status can be forced to fully delivered when the customer cancels some quantities. Service lines and delivery fee lines can be skipped in the calculation.

name: sale_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the value of discounts on sale orders, not just the percentage. The order totals display the total before discount and the discount amount, so the customer can see how much they save. Enabled by the Allow discounts on sales order lines setting in Sales Settings.

name: sale_discount_display_amount
summary: Shows the money value of a discount on sales orders, not only the percentage. The totals show the total without the discount and the discount amount, with or without tax depending on a setting. Line discounts must be allowed in Sales settings first.

name: sale_dms_field
summary: Adds a Documents tab to sales orders, linked to the OCA Document Management System. File templates can create a folder structure on each sales order, so related files are kept with the order. Set up under Documents > Configuration > File templates for the sale model.

name: sale_elaboration
summary: Lets a sale line carry an elaboration, a finishing or handling step done on the product during picking, such as cutting or engraving. When the delivery is validated, an extra order line is added for the elaboration with its surcharge price. Elaborations are set up under Sale > Configuration > Products.

name: sale_elaboration
summary: Lets you add an elaboration, a handling or finishing step such as cutting or engraving, to sales order lines. When the delivery order is validated, an extra surcharge line for the elaboration is added to the sale, and an elaboration route can split the delivery notes. Elaborations and their profiles are set up under Sales Configuration.

name: sale_elaboration
summary: Lets a sale line carry an elaboration, a finishing or handling step done on the product during picking, such as cutting or engraving. When the delivery is validated, an extra order line is added for the elaboration with its surcharge price. Elaborations are set up under Sale > Configuration > Products.

name: sale_elaboration_brand
summary: Adds the product brand to the Sale Elaboration report, so the people handling the elaboration can see the brand of each item. It only applies when the product brand module is also installed.

name: sale_elaboration_margin
summary: Shows the margin on elaboration lines of a sale order, using the cost of the elaboration. Adds elaboration cost, elaboration price and elaboration margin to each sale order line. Requires the sale elaboration module and margin reporting.

name: sale_elaboration_weighing
summary: Shows elaboration details and filters inside the weighing assistant, so warehouse staff weighing a picking can see which items need an elaboration. It extends the weighing screen only. Requires the stock weighing and sale elaboration modules.

name: sale_exception
summary: Attaches configurable exception warnings to sale orders and lines, such as product not in stock, missing ZIP code, or a wrong line format. Orders with exceptions can be filtered and fixed, which is handy when importing many orders that may have errors. Exceptions show on the order and can be set up under Settings > Technical > Exception Rules.

name: sale_exception
summary: Attaches configurable exception flags to sales orders and lines, for example no virtual stock, an empty zip code or a customer warning, so problem orders can be filtered and fixed. It is most useful when importing many orders that may contain errors. Exceptions are defined as rules, and a popup can warn users when they confirm.

name: sale_exception_holidays_public
summary: Raises a sale exception when the delivery date on a sale order falls on a public holiday for the shipping address. The warning appears on confirmation so the date can be changed. Activate the rule Delivery Date is a public holiday under Settings > Technical > Exception Rules.

name: sale_exception_holidays_public
summary: Raises a sale exception when the delivery date on a sale order falls on a public holiday for the shipping address. The warning appears on confirmation so the date can be changed. Activate the rule Delivery Date is a public holiday under Settings > Technical > Exception Rules.

name: sale_exception_line_tooltip
summary: Puts a warning icon on sale order lines that break an exception rule, and shows the rule names when you hover over the icon. The icon disappears once the exception no longer applies. No setup is needed beyond the sale exception module.

name: sale_exception_product_sale_manufactured_for
summary: Blocks a sales order when the customer is not on the list of customers a product may be manufactured for, unless the customer's commercial entity is on that list. It works as a rule in the sale exceptions, so the order shows the problem to be fixed.

name: sale_exception_stock_prebook
summary: Technical glue that stops stock prebook reservations from being released while a sale order has open exceptions. It links the stock prebook and sale exception modules together. Users only see the effect on stock reservations.

name: sale_financial_risk
summary: Extends customer financial risk to sales orders. The risk includes confirmed sales orders not yet invoiced, and a customer over the limit cannot confirm a new sales order. Each sales order line shows its own risk amount.

name: sale_financial_risk
summary: Checks a customer's financial risk when they place sales orders. Each sale order line adds a risk amount for what is ordered or delivered but not yet invoiced, and if the customer goes over their limit they cannot confirm new orders. Limits are set under Customers > Financial Risk, and the risk fields appear on sale orders and partners.

name: sale_financial_risk_info
summary: Shows the customer's credit use on sales orders in an info box, with total risk, credit limit, percentage used and the amount remaining. The wording of the box can be customized through a system parameter. It is visible on the sales order form.

name: sale_fixed_discount
summary: Lets you give a fixed amount discount on a sale order line, in addition to a percentage discount. The discount type can be chosen per line, and the sales order report shows the fixed discount. Enable it through Sales Settings under Pricing > Discounts.

name: sale_fixed_discount
summary: Lets sales lines carry a fixed amount discount as well as a percentage discount, and the sales order report shows the fixed discount too. The Discounts option under Pricing in Sales settings must be turned on first. Users choose the discount type on each line.

name: sale_fixed_triple_discount
summary: Glue module that warns users when a fixed discount and a triple discount are both used on the same sale order line. A warning label appears on the order to say the fixed discount takes priority, and it is recommended to use only one. No new fields.

name: sale_force_invoiced
summary: Lets a sales manager mark a sale order as Invoiced even when not everything ordered or delivered has been invoiced. Useful when a customer disputes quantities after delivery, or when old orders from a previous Odoo version show less invoiced than delivered. A Force Invoiced checkbox on the sale order removes the order from the To Invoice list.

name: sale_force_invoiced
summary: Lets users mark a sales order as Invoiced even when not everything was invoiced, for example after a customer agrees to a smaller quantity without a credit note, or to clear old orders migrated from an earlier Odoo version. Ticking the Force Invoiced field removes the order from the To Invoice list.

name: sale_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced Quantity field to each sales order line that reduces the quantity still to invoice, so the amount to invoice is adjusted without issuing a refund. The field is optional and can be hidden. It builds on the Force Invoiced module.

name: sale_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced Quantity field on each sale order line that reduces the quantity still to be invoiced. Use it to agree a lower invoiced quantity with a customer without issuing a refund. The amount to invoice on the order is adjusted accordingly.

name: sale_force_whole_invoiceability
summary: Lets a sales manager invoice an order before the goods are delivered, even when the product's invoice policy is based on delivered quantities. A Force Invoice Policy button appears on confirmed orders for managers, and once clicked all lines can be invoiced as if delivered.

name: sale_fully_invoiced
summary: Adds a Posted Invoice Status to sales orders, which only counts invoices that are posted, not those still in draft. Use the filter Fully Invoice Validated on the sales order list to find orders that are truly invoiced. Shown as a filter and a status field on sale orders.

name: sale_fully_invoiced
summary: Adds a Posted Invoice Status to sales orders, which only counts invoices that are posted, not those still in draft. Use the filter Fully Invoice Validated on the sales order list to find orders that are truly invoiced. Shown as a filter and a status field on sale orders.

name: sale_global_discount
summary: Applies global financial discounts, such as an early payment or volume discount, to whole sales orders. Discounts default from the customer, and can be set in the order header, with the computed totals shown in the footer. They carry through to the invoice and accounting.

name: sale_global_discount
summary: Applies global financial discounts to sales orders, such as an early payment or volume discount for the whole order, and passes them through to invoices and accounting. A customer's default global discounts are filled in automatically, and the order footer shows the computed discount amounts. It builds on the base global discount module.

name: sale_import_base
summary: Technical base for importing sales orders from a JSON file. Imports are validated and run as background jobs, which return job IDs to track. It is aimed at integrators and developers, not day to day sales users.

name: sale_invoice_blocking
summary: Lets users block invoicing on a sales order by entering a reason, so no regular invoice can be created until the block is removed. Reasons are kept in a list under Sales Configuration, Sales Orders, Invoicing block reasons. A blocked order shows its reason when someone tries to invoice it.

name: sale_invoice_date_from_picking
summary: Sets the invoice date from a date field on the delivery order instead of the invoice creation date. The field is chosen in Sales Settings as Picking Date Field for Invoice Date, and if it is empty the date the last delivery was done is used. Useful when the invoice must be dated on the day the goods left.

name: sale_invoice_delivery_state
summary: Lets you set on each customer whether they should be invoiced after partial or full delivery, and checks that the invoice status of each order matches that policy and the delivery status. This helps catch orders invoiced too early or too late. The setting appears on the customer's record.

name: sale_invoice_frequency
summary: Lets you assign an invoicing frequency to each customer, such as weekly or monthly billing, and then only invoice the orders that match the frequency. Frequencies are created under Sales > Configuration > Invoicing frequency, set on the customer and copied to new orders. Orders can be grouped by frequency.

name: sale_invoice_frequency
summary: Lets you define invoicing frequencies, such as weekly or monthly, and assign one to each customer. Sales orders take the customer's frequency, and orders can be grouped and selected for invoicing by it. Frequencies are created under Sales Configuration, Invoicing frequency.

name: sale_invoice_plan
summary: Lets a sales order use an invoice plan, a schedule of advance and installment invoices each with a date and a percentage of the total. The plan is built on the quotation through a wizard, then invoices are created all at once or one installment at a time. The plan appears on an Invoice Plan tab.

name: sale_invoice_plan
summary: Lets you plan future invoices on a sale order, either as an advance payment or as installments with set dates and percentages. After the order is confirmed, the planned invoices can be created all at once or one at a time from the Invoice Plan tab. The plan is set through a wizard opened from the order.

name: sale_invoice_plan_report
summary: Prints the invoice plan on sales order and quotation PDFs when an order uses one, showing each installment's name, due date, percentage and amount in the order currency. It works automatically once installed. Only orders with Use Invoice Plan enabled and plan lines show the section.

name: sale_invoice_policy
summary: Adds an invoicing policy to each sales order, so the whole order can invoice on ordered quantities, delivered quantities, or the product's own setting. The policy is chosen on the order, and a company-wide default can be set in Sales settings. Invoices follow the policy chosen on the order.

name: sale_invoice_policy
summary: Lets you choose the invoicing policy on each sale order, instead of relying only on the product setting. If the order has no policy, the product's policy is used. The company default is set in Sales Settings under Sale Invoice Policy.

name: sale_invoice_policy
summary: Adds an invoicing policy to each sale order: follow the product setting, invoice ordered quantities, or invoice delivered quantities. The policy applies to the whole order, and it affects storable products only. A company default can be set in Sales Settings under Sale Invoice Policy.

name: sale_invoice_product_not_alone
summary: Lets you mark a product as one that cannot be invoiced on its own. Orders made only of such products do not appear in the list of orders ready to invoice. The flag is set on the product's form.

name: sale_invoice_split_payment
summary: Creates separate invoices for sales orders with different payment terms, even when the customer and products are the same. When several orders are invoiced together, they are split by payment term instead of being merged into one invoice. Use it when each payment term needs its own invoice.

name: sale_invoice_to_partner
summary: Lets a customer have a separate Invoice To partner, a different company that receives and pays its invoices. When a sale order is created for that customer, the invoice address is set to this partner automatically, so invoices are billed to them. It is set on the Invoicing tab of the customer.

name: sale_invoiceability_on_payment_transaction
summary: Allows a sales order to be invoiced once a confirmed payment covering the full order amount exists, even when products are set to delivered quantities. The user can create the invoice from the sales order without validating a delivery first. No configuration is needed.

name: sale_invoicing_date_from_picking
summary: Makes sure the invoice date chosen in the sales invoice wizard is used when invoices are created from selected deliveries (pickings). It connects the invoice date wizard with the picking filter. Use it when you invoice sales orders with a chosen date and specific deliveries.

name: sale_invoicing_date_selection
summary: Lets users set the invoice date in the Create Invoices wizard on sales orders, so all invoices created in that run get the same date. It is useful when invoices should be dated differently from the day they are created.

name: sale_isolated_quotation
summary: Separates quotations from sales orders by giving each its own numbering sequence. Many quotations can be open for a customer, and only the one that is converted becomes a sales order. Quotations have just Draft and Done states, and Convert to Order creates the separate order.

name: sale_last_price_info
summary: Shows on each product its last sale price, last sale date, and last customer, so salespeople can quote consistently. These are also visible on sale order lines as the order date of the last sale. Shown on the product form and the sale order line.

name: sale_last_price_info
summary: Shows on each product the last price it was sold at, the date of that sale and the last customer who bought it. This helps sales reps quote consistently. The sales order line also records the order date for this information.

name: sale_layout_category_hide_detail
summary: Lets you choose, for each section line on a sale order or customer invoice, whether to show its detail lines, its subtotal, its line amounts and its section subtotal in the PDF report and on the customer portal. Flags sit on the right side of the section line. The same behaviour applies to quotations and invoices.

name: sale_layout_category_hide_detail
summary: Lets you choose, for each section line on a sale order or customer invoice, whether to show its detail lines, its subtotal, its line amounts and its section subtotal in the PDF report and on the customer portal. Flags sit on the right side of the section line. The same behaviour applies to quotations and invoices.

name: sale_line_name_option
summary: Hides the internal product code from sales order lines, so each line shows only the product description. It is turned on per company in Sales settings with the No Product Code in Sale Line Name option. Useful when the internal code should not appear to customers.

name: sale_line_refund_to_invoice_qty
summary: Lets you choose whether a credit note's refunded quantity should count as quantity to reinvoice on the sales order line. A checkbox on the credit note can stop refunded quantities from being deducted from the invoiced quantity, and a company default can be set. This decides how much remains to invoice on the order.

name: sale_line_refund_to_invoice_qty
summary: Decides whether a refunded quantity on a credit note should count as quantity to re-invoice on the sale order line. A Not reinvoice refunded quantity checkbox on the credit note, and a Sale qty not to reinvoice flag per invoice line, control this. Shows as a field on sale order lines for refunded quantities not invoiceable.

name: sale_line_refund_to_invoice_qty_skip_anglo_saxon
summary: Technical glue between the refund reinvoice quantity and the refund reason skip anglo saxon modules. It disables the option to edit the reinvoice choice on the credit note wizard, so the two modules do not conflict. Users only see that the option is locked.

name: sale_line_returned_qty
summary: Shows the returned quantity on sale order lines once a return delivery is created and validated. This lets you see how much of a sold product has come back. Shown as a Returned Qty field on each sale order line.

name: sale_line_returned_qty
summary: Shows a Returned Qty column on sales order lines once a return delivery is validated, so you can see how much a customer sent back.

name: sale_line_returned_qty_mrp
summary: Makes the returned quantity work for kit (BoM) products on sales lines. It installs automatically with manufacturing and has no screens of its own.

name: sale_line_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a Vendor Comment field to sales order lines, for notes meant for the supplier that are kept separate from the line description. It is useful when a line needs an instruction for the vendor.

name: sale_loyalty_auto_refresh
summary: Applies loyalty and promotion programs to quotations automatically, with no button click needed. Once a program set to Automatic trigger matches the order, the promotion is applied as lines change. Auto refresh can be switched on or off per company under Sales Settings > Pricing (Auto refresh promotions).

name: sale_loyalty_auto_refresh
summary: Applies loyalty and promotion programs to quotations automatically, with no button click needed. Once a program set to Automatic trigger matches the order, the promotion is applied as lines change. Auto refresh can be switched on or off per company under Sales Settings > Pricing (Auto refresh promotions).

name: sale_loyalty_criteria_multi_product
summary: Lets promotion rules require a combination of several products, such as buy one of product A and product B to get a reward, and uses that setup in sales orders. Set it up the same way as the base multi product criteria module, under the promotion program on the Discount and Loyalty menu.

name: sale_loyalty_exclude
summary: Lets you exclude specific products from a loyalty or promotion program. Excluded products do not count toward the minimum order amount needed for a promotion. Turned on per product with the Loyalty Exclude option on the product form.

name: sale_loyalty_incompatibility
summary: Stops two promotions from being used together on the same sale order when they are set as incompatible. A promotion without a code is simply not applied, while a code promotion shows an error. The incompatibility rules are configured on the promotion programs.

name: sale_loyalty_incompatibility
summary: Stops two promotions from being used together on the same sale order when they are set as incompatible. A promotion without a code is simply not applied, while a code promotion shows an error. The incompatibility rules are configured on the promotion programs.

name: sale_loyalty_initial_date_validity
summary: Stops a promotion from being applied to a sale order before its start date. Set a Start date on the promotion, and it can only be applied to orders from that date on. Works on the promotion form under Sales > Products > Discount and Loyalty.

name: sale_loyalty_limit
summary: Limits how many times a promotion can be used per customer or per salesperson. Once a limit is reached, promotions with a code show an error, and promotions without a code are not applied. The customer limit applies to the whole commercial entity, not each contact.

name: sale_loyalty_limit
summary: Limits how many times a promotion can be used per customer or per salesperson. Once a limit is reached, promotions with a code show an error, and promotions without a code are not applied. The customer limit applies to the whole commercial entity, not each contact.

name: sale_loyalty_limit
summary: Limits how many times a promotion can be used per customer or per salesperson. Once a limit is reached, promotions with a code show an error, and promotions without a code are not applied. The customer limit applies to the whole commercial entity, not each contact.

name: sale_loyalty_multi_gift
summary: Lets a promotion on a sale order offer several gift products to choose from, instead of one fixed reward. The customer or salesperson picks the gift in the reward wizard. Configured as described in the loyalty multi gift base module.

name: sale_loyalty_multi_gift
summary: Lets a promotion on a sale order offer several gift products to choose from, instead of one fixed reward. The customer or salesperson picks the gift in the reward wizard. Configured as described in the loyalty multi gift base module.

name: sale_loyalty_order_info
summary: Adds reporting information about the promotions applied to a sale order: total reward amount including tax, the promo codes used, the coupons generated by the order, and the programs applied. The data is meant for reports rather than screens, so it is not shown on the form.

name: sale_loyalty_order_info
summary: Adds reporting information about the promotions applied to a sale order: total reward amount including tax, the promo codes used, the coupons generated by the order, and the programs applied. The data is meant for reports rather than screens, so it is not shown on the form.

name: sale_loyalty_order_line_link
summary: Links each discount or reward line on a sale order to the promotion that created it, and to the order lines it applies to or came from. This makes promotion results easy to trace. A Related Sales Orders button on the promotion form lists the orders that used it.

name: sale_loyalty_order_line_link
summary: Links each discount or reward line on a sale order to the promotion that created it, and to the order lines it applies to or came from. This makes promotion results easy to trace. A Related Sales Orders button on the promotion form lists the orders that used it.

name: sale_loyalty_order_line_link
summary: Links each discount or reward line on a sale order to the promotion that created it, and to the order lines it applies to or came from. This makes promotion results easy to trace. A Related Sales Orders button on the promotion form lists the orders that used it.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion
summary: Hints at promotions while a sales order is being built. Products that belong to an active promotion get a gift icon on their order line, and clicking it opens the reward wizard listing the available promotions and the products still needed to qualify. Helps salespeople add the right items to unlock a promo.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion
summary: Hints at promotions while a sales order is being built. Products that belong to an active promotion get a gift icon on their order line, and clicking it opens the reward wizard listing the available promotions and the products still needed to qualify. Helps salespeople add the right items to unlock a promo.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion_multi_gift
summary: Adds promotion hints for multi gift rewards on sale orders. When a product from a multi gift promotion is on an order line, a gift icon appears, and the reward wizard lists the promotions that need a minimum quantity of products. Needs the order suggestion and multi gift modules.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion_multi_gift
summary: Adds promotion hints for multi gift rewards on sale orders. When a product from a multi gift promotion is on an order line, a gift icon appears, and the reward wizard lists the promotions that need a minimum quantity of products. Needs the order suggestion and multi gift modules.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion_multi_product
summary: Adds promotion hints for promotions that need a combination of several products. When one of the required products is on an order line, a gift icon appears and the wizard lists the promotions and the other products still needed. Needs the order suggestion and multi product criteria modules.

name: sale_loyalty_order_suggestion_multi_product
summary: Adds promotion hints for promotions that need a combination of several products. When one of the required products is on an order line, a gift icon appears and the wizard lists the promotions and the other products still needed. Needs the order suggestion and multi product criteria modules.

name: sale_loyalty_order_type_applicability
summary: Limits which promotions apply to which sales order types, since by default Odoo applies loyalty programs to every order type. On a loyalty program, you pick the Sales Order Types where it is valid, and it gives no reward on other types. Set on the program under Sales > Products > Discount and Loyalty.

name: sale_loyalty_partner
summary: Links a loyalty program to a specific customer (partner), and lets the Sales Analysis report group promotions by that partner. Useful for customer specific deals tracked as promotions. The partner is set on the program form.

name: sale_loyalty_partner
summary: Links a loyalty program to a specific customer (partner), and lets the Sales Analysis report group promotions by that partner. Useful for customer specific deals tracked as promotions. The partner is set on the program form.

name: sale_loyalty_partner_applicability
summary: Lets a promotion rule apply only to customers who match a filter, such as a customer category or a field on the contact. Coupons earned by one member of a commercial entity can optionally be shared with the other members. Conditions are set in the conditional rules of the program under Sales > Products > Discount and Loyalty.

name: sale_loyalty_partner_applicability
summary: Lets a promotion rule apply only to customers who match a filter, such as a customer category or a field on the contact. Coupons earned by one member of a commercial entity can optionally be shared with the other members. Conditions are set in the conditional rules of the program under Sales > Products > Discount and Loyalty.

name: sale_mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds configured contacts as followers, in copy, of their company's sales orders, so they receive the order emails. On each contact, the Sales Orders option is ticked under the In copy of field. Users do not have to add these contacts by hand.

name: sale_manual_delivery
summary: Stops sale orders from creating deliveries or reserving stock automatically, so deliveries are created by hand. A manual delivery wizard shows what has already been planned, and lets the user choose the quantities, carrier and planned date for each shipment. Built for long projects where material ships in several batches. Enabled per sales team.

name: sale_manual_delivery
summary: Stops sale orders from creating deliveries or reserving stock automatically, so deliveries are created by hand. A manual delivery wizard shows what has already been planned, and lets the user choose the quantities, carrier and planned date for each shipment. Built for long projects where material ships in several batches. Enabled per sales team.

name: sale_manual_delivery
summary: Lets deliveries be created by hand for long-term orders, so the sales order does not reserve stock by itself. Each delivery gets its own planned date and carrier, and a wizard shows how much has already been planned to ship. It suits projects where the material ships in many parts.

name: sale_margin_delivered
summary: Calculates the margin on sale order lines based only on what has actually been delivered, so it can be compared with the full margin. Returns are taken into account. Compare Margin and Margin Delivered in Sales > Reporting > Sales, by Order Reference.

name: sale_margin_delivered_dropshipping
summary: Calculates the delivered margin on sale order lines, also counting dropshipped items. Once dropshipping is enabled in Purchase settings and a product has the Dropship route, its delivered margin is included with outgoing deliveries and returns. Compare Margin and Margin Delivered in Sales Reporting.

name: sale_margin_delivered_security
summary: Technical glue that restricts the delivered margin fields to the same users allowed to see sale margins. No new screens; users who cannot see margins also cannot see delivered margin figures. Requires the margin security module.

name: sale_margin_delivered_security
summary: Technical glue that restricts the delivered margin fields to the same users allowed to see sale margins. No new screens; users who cannot see margins also cannot see delivered margin figures. Requires the margin security module.

name: sale_margin_pricelist_computation
summary: Lets pricelist rules define the cost and sale price used for margin, using formulas. Set a margin cost price formula and/or a margin sale price formula on a pricelist rule, and sales orders using that pricelist show margins calculated from those formulas. Set under Sales > Products > Pricelists.

name: sale_margin_security
summary: Limits who can see or edit margin and cost figures on sale orders. Once the product cost security rules are configured, only authorised users see margin and purchase price on sale orders and order lines. Configure it through the product cost security module.

name: sale_margin_security
summary: Limits who can see or edit margin and cost figures on sale orders. Once the product cost security rules are configured, only authorised users see margin and purchase price on sale orders and order lines. Configure it through the product cost security module.

name: sale_margin_sync
summary: Keeps sale order margins accurate when the cost of a stock move changes. When the cost price of a stock valuation entry is corrected, the margin on the related sale order is recalculated. Runs in the background, with no new screens.

name: sale_margin_update
summary: Adds a Recalculate Price By Margin wizard on sale order lines. Enter a target margin percentage and the unit price is recalculated to hit it. Useful for setting a sale price from a desired profit level. Needs the sale margin feature to be enabled.

name: sale_minimum_amount
summary: Sets a minimum untaxed amount per customer for sale orders. An order below the minimum is blocked automatically with an approval block reason, and it cannot be confirmed until the block is released or the amount reaches the minimum. The minimum is set on the customer and shows on the sale order.

name: sale_mrp_bom
summary: Lets you pick a specific Bill of Materials on a sale order line, so that the manufacturing order created from the sale uses that BOM. Useful when a product has alternative recipes or subcontracting routes. Requires a special permission to choose the BOM on sale lines.

name: sale_mrp_bom
summary: Lets a sales order line specify which bill of materials to use, for example an alternative manufacturing or subcontracting route. When the order is confirmed, the production order uses that bill of materials. Only users with the matching permission can choose it.

name: sale_mrp_bom_menu
summary: Adds a Bills of Materials menu under Sales > Products, so salespeople can open BOMs without going to Manufacturing. It is only a navigation shortcut.

name: sale_multi_template_application
summary: Lets you apply more than one quotation template to the same sales order. Lines from earlier templates are kept when another template is chosen, instead of being replaced. The template field is then cleared so the order is not tied to a single partial template.

name: sale_multicompany_reporting_currency
summary: Shows each sale order total converted into the multicompany reporting currency, so orders in different currencies can be compared on one common basis. The converted amount and rate are shown on the sale order next to the order total. It needs the multicompany reporting currency module.

name: sale_no_portal_button
summary: Removes the access button from sales order notification emails sent to customers who have no portal user, so they are not sent a link they cannot use. Only contacts linked to a user keep the button. It applies when messages are sent from the order chatter.

name: sale_numeric_step
summary: Adds plus and minus buttons to the quantity and price fields on sales orders, making them easier to use on tablets and phones. Works through the numeric step widget module. Visible when editing order lines.

name: sale_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to sales orders and order lines, taken from the sales team. Security rules make sure users only see sales orders for the operating units they can access. Reports can be grouped by operating unit.

name: sale_operating_unit
summary: Adds an Operating Unit to sales orders and order lines, taken from the sales team. Security rules make sure users only see sales orders for the operating units they can access. Reports can be grouped by operating unit.

name: sale_operating_unit_sequence
summary: Gives each operating unit its own numbering sequence for sale orders, so orders from different units are numbered separately. The sequence is set on the operating unit and can be edited under Technical Sequences by users with technical permissions.

name: sale_order_add_byproduct
summary: When a manufacturing order for a sold product is closed, its by-products are added to the originating sale order as invoiceable lines. This lets by-products sold to the customer be invoiced and tracked on the same order. By-product products should have a category such as By-products, and the by-products are listed on the BOM.

name: sale_order_amount_to_invoice
summary: Shows the total amount still to be invoiced on quotations and sales orders, on the order lines, the form and the list view. The list and line fields are hidden by default and must be turned on from the list column settings. It helps see what is left to bill.

name: sale_order_approval_block
summary: Blocks a sale order from being confirmed until someone releases it, with a block reason such as credit check or price approval. Reasons are set up in a list of Sale Approval Block Reasons, and an order can be blocked and released by a user. Shows as an approval block field on the sale order.

name: sale_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive sale orders that are Locked or Cancelled, so they disappear from the everyday sales order list. Archived orders can still be seen with the Archived filter and restored. Archive is found through the Action menu on the list view.

name: sale_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive locked or cancelled sales orders so they no longer clutter the sales order list, while still being kept. Archived orders can be found with the Archived filter and restored from there. Archiving is done from the list's Action menu.

name: sale_order_blanket_order
summary: Extends sales orders so they can act as blanket orders with a validity period, and later call-off orders draw down the blanket quantities and are delivered and invoiced one at a time. The blanket order drives stock and invoicing, and by default stock is only reserved when a call-off is created. A sales setting can make normal sale orders for blanket products create call-offs automatically.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_carrier_auto_assign
summary: Technical glue module for companies that use both blanket orders and automatic carrier assignment. It keeps the delivery fee line out of blanket order call-off matching, so a second call-off is not wrongly rejected with a 'product is not part of linked blanket order' error. There is no separate screen for users.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_sale_margin
