summary: Makes sure call off order lines that come from a blanket order show a margin of zero, since their financial impact is handled on the blanket order. Bridges the blanket order and sale margin features. No new fields.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_stock_prebook
summary: Adds an At Confirm reservation strategy to blanket orders, so stock is reserved for future call-offs as soon as the blanket order is confirmed, starting from its validity start date. This makes sure the quantities are available when customers call them off. The strategy is chosen on the blanket order's reservation strategy field.

name: sale_order_blanket_order_stock_prebook_release
summary: Glue module that makes sure that when pre-booked stock is released for blanket order deliveries, the blanket order's start date sets the priority. Blanket orders that start earlier are served first. Users see this through the move date priority and commitment date on the sales order.

name: sale_order_cancel_optional_email
summary: Makes cancelling a confirmed sales order happen straight away, without the wizard that offers to email the customer. A separate Send Email and Cancel button opens that wizard when the customer should be told. This prevents cancellation emails from going out by accident.

name: sale_order_carrier_auto_assign
summary: Fills in the delivery carrier on sales orders automatically, either when the order is created or when it is confirmed. On confirmation the delivery cost line is added too. The behavior is set under Sales settings, Shipping.

name: sale_order_carrier_auto_assign
summary: Sets the delivery method on a sale order automatically when it is confirmed, along with its delivery cost line. Enabled in Sales Settings under Shipping, with the Enable on confirmation option. Saves the salesperson from picking a carrier on every order.

name: sale_order_country_allowed_product
summary: Limits which products a salesperson can add to a sale order based on the country of the shipping address. Each product has a list of Sale Allowed Countries, and empty means available everywhere. Users in the Ignore products sale countries group can still add any salable product.

name: sale_order_currency_rate
summary: Shows the exchange rate of a foreign currency on sale orders. The rate can be shown as foreign to company currency, or as company to foreign currency, and this is chosen in Sales Settings under Quotations and Orders.

name: sale_order_customer_free_ref
summary: Splits the customer reference on a sale order into two fields: a customer order number (PO id) and a free reference. The standard customer reference becomes computed from the two. Both fields are also passed to the invoices created from the order, which helps with EDI flows.

name: sale_order_disable_user_autosubscribe
summary: Stops the order's salesperson from being added automatically as a follower of every sales order. Other followers are not changed. It is useful when the salesperson should not receive every order notification.

name: sale_order_end_user
summary: Adds an End User to sales orders for cases where goods pass through an intermediate buyer before reaching the final user, which some legal requirements need the supplier to know. The end user is separate from the shipping destination. Set on the sale order form.

name: sale_order_finish_service
summary: Adds a finished flag to service sales orders, with a Finish or Unfinish button, to mark that the service has been completed or delivered. The button appears once the order is confirmed. The flag is kept on the order and its lines.

name: sale_order_general_discount
summary: Sets one general discount percentage on a whole sales order, and that discount is copied to every order line's discount field. A default general discount can also be set on a customer. Set in the order header on the sale order form.

name: sale_order_general_discount
summary: Sets one general discount on a sales order and copies it to every line, instead of entering it line by line. Customers can have a default general discount, and each product can opt out of it. The discount is shown on the order and in each line's discount field.

name: sale_order_general_discount_triple
summary: Lets the general discount on a sales order be applied to any of the three discount fields on order lines, when triple discounts are used. The discount types for general and pricelist discounts are chosen in Sales Settings under Pricing. Set to No apply to turn this off.

name: sale_order_global_stock_route
summary: Lets you choose one or more warehouse routes (paths such as multi step delivery) on a quotation, and the routes are passed down to every order line. A line can still have its own route set. Needs Multi-Step Routes enabled under Inventory settings, and the route field appears on the sale order.

name: sale_order_global_stock_route
summary: Lets you choose one warehouse route (path such as multi step delivery) on a quotation, and it is passed down to the order lines. A line can still have its own route set. Needs Multi-Step Routes enabled under Inventory settings, and the route field appears on the sale order.

name: sale_order_global_stock_route
summary: Lets a sales quotation carry one route, such as a particular warehouse path, that applies to all of its lines. It is set in the Route field on the quotation and needs Multi-Step Routes enabled.

name: sale_order_import
summary: Adds an Import RFQ or Order wizard to the Sales menu, so a customer's purchase order or RFQ file can be turned into a quotation or sales order. It works with the base formats, and specific formats such as UBL and EDIFACT are added by separate modules. If a quotation for the same customer already exists, the wizard offers to update it instead.

name: sale_order_import
summary: Adds an Import RFQ or Order wizard to the Sales menu, so a customer's purchase order or RFQ file can be turned into a quotation or sales order. It works with the base formats, and specific formats such as UBL and EDIFACT are added by separate modules. If a quotation for the same customer already exists, the wizard offers to update it instead.

name: sale_order_import_address_extended
summary: Makes sale order file imports read street names and house numbers correctly into separate address fields. It is a glue module between the order import and the extended address module, and users see the result as correct addresses on imported orders.

name: sale_order_import_edifact
summary: Lets the sale order import read EDIFACT D96A ORDER files, a standard electronic order format used by some large retailers. Imported orders become quotations or sales orders in the normal import flow. Other formats such as X12 are not covered by this module, and each customer may need a specific release.

name: sale_order_import_packaging
summary: When importing an order file, matches each line's product by the code on one of its packagings, and sets that packaging on the order line. The quantity in the file is then read as a number of packs rather than units. Helpful for customers who order by case or box.

name: sale_order_import_partner_identification
summary: Makes sale order file imports read the customer's ID numbers from the file and match them to the right partner. It is a glue module between the order import and the partner identification module, so imported orders are linked to the correct customer.

name: sale_order_import_ubl
summary: Adds support for importing UBL XML purchase orders and RFQs, including PDFs that carry an embedded UBL XML, through the sale order import wizard. Imported lines, prices and parties are read from the file. Sample files are included for testing.

name: sale_order_import_ubl_customer_free_ref
summary: Reads the customer reference from a UBL order file and stores it on the imported sale order. Technical glue between the UBL import and the customer free reference module. Users see the customer reference filled in automatically.

name: sale_order_import_ubl_line_customer_ref
summary: Reads customer references for individual lines from a UBL order file, so each sale line keeps the customer's own item reference. The reference is taken from a note on the line that starts with customer_ref. Technical glue between the UBL import and the stock line customer reference module.

name: sale_order_import_ubl_requested_delivery
summary: Reads the requested delivery period from a UBL order file and sets it on the imported sale order. Technical glue between the UBL import and the requested delivery module, so customer delivery windows arrive with the order.

name: sale_order_invoice_amount
summary: Adds Invoiced Amount and Uninvoiced Amount totals to sale orders, so you can see how much of an order has been billed and how much is still to bill. Shown on the sale order form.

name: sale_order_invoice_amount
summary: Shows the invoiced amount and the amount still to invoice on sales orders, in the totals just above the order total on the form, and as optional columns in the list view. It gives a quick view of billing progress for each order.

name: sale_order_invoice_amount
summary: Changes how invoiced and to-invoice amounts are calculated on sale orders, using the quantities invoiced against the quantities ordered instead of invoice amounts alone. It is switched on per company with Enable amount invoiced based on quantity in settings.

name: sale_order_invoicing_finished_task
summary: Lets service tasks control when their sales lines can be invoiced. For a service product set to invoicing control by task, billing waits until the task is marked invoiceable, which can be set on the task or automatically by a project stage. It suits service work billed only once finished.

name: sale_order_invoicing_finished_task
summary: Controls when service order lines can be invoiced, based on their related task. A task can be marked as invoiceable by hand, even before it is finished, and the option can be tied to a project stage, such as always invoiceable in the Done stage. Set up on service products with Invoicing control by task.

name: sale_order_invoicing_grouping_criteria
summary: Lets you decide how sales orders are grouped into invoices, by adding fields such as customer reference or project to the default grouping. Criteria are set under Invoicing > Configuration > Invoicing Grouping Criteria, and can be set per company or per customer. Invoice and currency grouping always stay in place.

name: sale_order_invoicing_grouping_criteria
summary: Lets you define extra criteria for grouping sales orders into one invoice, on top of the standard company, customer and currency rule. Criteria are set under Invoicing > Configuration > Management > Invoicing Grouping Criteria. Orders that differ on those fields are invoiced separately when Invoice Order runs.

name: sale_order_invoicing_picking_filter
summary: Lets you invoice a sale order based on what was actually shipped in selected deliveries. When creating an invoice from the order, choose Regular Invoice and select the pickings to bill, and only those products and quantities are invoiced. With no pickings selected, the usual flow applies.

name: sale_order_invoicing_picking_filter
summary: Lets you create invoices from a sales order using only the products and quantities in chosen delivery orders, instead of the whole order. Deliveries to bill are picked in the invoicing wizard, and if none are selected the normal flow is used. Delivery orders get an invoiced flag.

name: sale_order_invoicing_qty_percentage
summary: Lets you invoice a percentage of an order's quantities, for example 50 percent of 10 service hours gives an invoice line for 5 hours. Choose Percentage of the quantity in the Create Invoice wizard and enter the percentage. Useful for progress billing.

name: sale_order_invoicing_qty_percentage
summary: Lets you invoice a percentage of the ordered quantity on a sales order, such as 50 percent of 10 hours giving a 5-hour invoice line. Choose Percentage of the quantity in the Create Invoice wizard and enter the percentage. It is useful for partial or progress billing.

name: sale_order_invoicing_queued
summary: Runs invoice creation for many sales orders in the background, as parallel queue jobs, instead of one at a time in the foreground. Select orders under Invoicing > Orders to Invoice, then click Enqueue Invoicing, and control returns straight away. Requires Job Queue Manager permission to follow the jobs.

name: sale_order_line_cancel
summary: Lets users cancel the remaining quantity on a sales order line with a dedicated action, and tracks the cancelled and still-to-deliver quantities. It can either only record the cancelled quantity, or also reduce the ordered quantity. The action is found on the sales order line.

name: sale_order_line_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancel Remaining action on sale order lines, so the part of an order that will not be delivered can be cancelled. Two fields track the cancelled quantity and what is still to deliver. A company setting decides whether cancelling also reduces the ordered quantity.

name: sale_order_line_cancel_sale_stock
summary: Cancels only the stock moves for the quantity still to deliver when a line is cancelled, and tracks the cancelled quantity if a line's move is cancelled and nothing else has started. It builds on the order line cancel module and the Inventory app. It is not recommended if ordered quantities can still be edited after confirmation.

name: sale_order_line_cancel_sale_stock
summary: Makes the Cancel Remaining action on sale order lines also cancel the stock moves for the quantity that is still to deliver. Cancelled quantities are tracked when the related stock move is cancelled, as long as no other operation has started on that line. Requires the sale order line cancel module and Inventory.

name: sale_order_line_chained_move
summary: Keeps a separate stock move for each sales order line when the stock rule says so, rather than letting Odoo merge lines with the same product. Each move can then be traced back to its order line. It is set per stock rule under Inventory Configuration, Rules.

name: sale_order_line_client_order_ref
summary: Adds a Customer Order Number field to each sales order line, carried onto the invoice lines. It is useful when one sales order covers several customer purchase orders. It can be shown on sales and invoice reports through the settings.

name: sale_order_line_date
summary: Adds a delivery commitment date to each sales order line, filled in from the requested date. The date is passed on to the stock moves and pickings, and the order's commitment date is worked out from the lines and the shipping policy. Users see it as Delivery Date on the lines.

name: sale_order_line_date
summary: Adds a Delivery Date (commitment date) to each sale order line, filled in from the requested date when the quotation is created. The date is passed to the stock moves and pickings, and the order date is derived from the lines by the shipping policy. The date cannot be edited on the order itself.

name: sale_order_line_date
summary: Adds a Delivery Date (commitment date) to each sale order line, filled in from the requested date when the quotation is created. The date is passed to the stock moves and pickings, and the order date is derived from the lines by the shipping policy. The date cannot be edited on the order itself.

name: sale_order_line_date_next_reception
summary: Shows the next expected receipt date for a product on the sales order line when it is out of stock and a purchase is already on the way. This helps promise the customer a realistic delivery date.

name: sale_order_line_delivery_state
summary: Shows a delivery status on each sales order line, based on how much of that line has been delivered. A line can be marked fully delivered when the customer cancelled the remainder, and delivery fee lines are ignored. It builds on the sale delivery state module.

name: sale_order_line_delivery_state
summary: Shows a delivery status on each sale order line, computed from the delivered quantity, so you can see which lines are not delivered, partly delivered, or fully delivered. A line can be forced to fully delivered when the customer cancels the balance. Delivery fee lines are ignored.

name: sale_order_line_description
summary: Makes sale order lines use only the product's sales description, instead of the internal reference plus name plus sales description. It is turned on in Sales Settings under Product Sale Description, and users need the matching access right to use it.

name: sale_order_line_description
summary: Makes sales order lines use only the product's sales description, instead of reference, name and sales description combined. It is turned on in Sales settings under Product Sale Description, and each user needs the matching access right. Useful when quotes should show only the product text.

name: sale_order_line_effective_date
summary: Adds Effective Date, Last Effective Date and Order Commitment Date fields to sales order lines, showing when each line was actually delivered and when it was promised. When a delivery is split by backorder, the dates track the final shipment. The fields appear on the sales order lines.

name: sale_order_line_field_from_product_attribute
summary: Copies a product attribute value, such as colour or size, into a text field on the sale order line when the product is chosen. This makes attribute values easy to report on and analyse. It is set up on the attribute by choosing a text field to store it in.

name: sale_order_line_final_price
summary: Adds a Final Price field to sales order lines, holding the unit price the customer actually pays after discount. Entering a final price works out the discount automatically, while the catalog price stays visible on the quotation. Unit price and discount become read only for anyone who is not a Sales Administrator, so salespeople enter what the customer pays.

name: sale_order_line_input
summary: Lets users work directly with sales order lines in one list, with search, grouping and the ability to create new lines from there. A new line can be attached to an existing order, and if no order is chosen a new order is created. It is found under Sales, Orders, Sales Order Lines.

name: sale_order_line_menu
summary: Adds an Order Lines menu under Sales, Orders, with list views for browsing all sales order lines. It only adds navigation and views, so users can look through lines and filter them without opening each order.

name: sale_order_line_menu
summary: Adds an Order Lines menu under Sales > Orders, with list and pivot views of every sale order line. Users can search, filter and group lines, for example by product or by date. Useful for analysing what has been sold line by line.

name: sale_order_line_move_to_optional
summary: Lets users move a sales order line into the optional products section, removing it from the main order lines. This is only possible while the order is in Draft or Quotation Sent state. A Move to optional action sits beside each line.

name: sale_order_line_multi_warehouse
summary: Lets one sale order line be fulfilled from several warehouses, so the order is split into several deliveries by warehouse. From the line, a popup lets you pick the warehouses and quantities, limited to the alternative warehouses set on the order's warehouse. Turned on in Inventory settings under Multi Warehouse in Sale Orders.

name: sale_order_line_multi_warehouse
summary: Lets one sale order line be fulfilled from several warehouses, so the order is split into several deliveries by warehouse. From the line, a popup lets you pick the warehouses and quantities, limited to the alternative warehouses set on the order's warehouse. Turned on in Inventory settings under Multi Warehouse in Sale Orders.

name: sale_order_line_no_print
summary: Lets users hide individual sales order, quotation or invoice lines from the printed report and the customer portal, while keeping them on the internal document. A Display in report checkbox on each line controls this. It is useful for internal or helper lines that the customer should not see.

name: sale_order_line_note
summary: Adds a Note field to each sales order line for free text, such as a remark for the team. It is a simple text field on the line and does not change prices or quantities.

name: sale_order_line_note
summary: Adds a Note field to each sale order line, for internal or customer-facing text about that specific product line. It is a simple text field with no other behaviour.

name: sale_order_line_position
summary: Numbers the lines of a sale order automatically (1, 2, 3...) and prints the number on the report, so each line can be referred to during delivery and invoicing. Positions are recalculated when the order is printed, sent or confirmed, and then fixed. A button can recalculate them manually.

name: sale_order_line_position
summary: Numbers the lines of a sale order automatically (1, 2, 3...) and prints the number on the report, so each line can be referred to during delivery and invoicing. Positions are recalculated when the order is printed, sent or confirmed, and then fixed. A button can recalculate them manually.

name: sale_order_line_position
summary: Numbers the lines of a sale order automatically (1, 2, 3...) and prints the number on the report, so each line can be referred to during delivery and invoicing. Positions are recalculated when the order is printed, sent or confirmed, and then fixed. A button can recalculate them manually.

name: sale_order_line_price_history
summary: Lets a salesperson see the past prices charged for a product from a sale order line, using a clock button on the line. From the pop-up they can copy one of those old prices back onto the line. The number of lines shown and whether quotations or the customer's commercial entity are included can be configured.

name: sale_order_line_price_history
summary: Shows the past selling prices for a product from a sale order line, in a clock button popup, and lets you copy one of those old prices onto the line. The number of past lines shown is limited by a system parameter, and quotations can be included. Helps salespeople quote consistently.

name: sale_order_line_price_lock_by_pricelist
summary: Stops salespeople from editing the unit price or discount on a sale order line when the price comes from a locking pricelist rule. Each pricelist sets whether all products, a product category, or a single product is locked. Sales managers are not locked, so they can still change those prices.

name: sale_order_line_price_source
summary: Records where each sale order line's unit price came from: the pricelist (and which pricelist rule), the product's standard price, or a manual entry. The source is updated automatically when a line is created or repriced, and can be inspected on the line. Useful for auditing why a price is what it is.

name: sale_order_line_product_attribute_values
summary: Stores product attribute values, such as a trademark or size, on each sale order line so lines can be viewed and filtered by them. It is a search and reporting aid on the sales order lines. Existing lines are updated through a scheduled action rather than during install.

name: sale_order_line_remove
summary: Lets users delete a sale order line even after the order is confirmed, as long as that line has not been invoiced or delivered. This avoids cancelling and recreating whole orders for small corrections. The line removal is limited by those conditions.

name: sale_order_line_remove
summary: Lets users delete a sale order line from a confirmed order, but only if that line has not been invoiced or delivered. A setting in the Sales configuration turns this on. It is useful for correcting a confirmed order without cancelling the whole thing.

name: sale_order_line_route_visible
summary: Shows the Routes column by default in the order lines of quotations and sales orders. Without this, the column is hidden and each user has to switch it on. It is a display change only.

name: sale_order_line_section
summary: Stores a direct link from each sale order line to the section line it sits under. Standard Odoo only implies this from the order sequence. The link makes it easy to group, filter and report lines by section in lists, exports and reports.

name: sale_order_line_sequence
summary: Adds a line number to sale order lines so they keep a fixed order, and shows that number on sale order reports. The line number also carries over to customer invoice lines. It is a presentation feature for quotes and orders with many lines.

name: sale_order_line_sequence
summary: Shows a line number on each sale order line and keeps the lines in order. The line number is printed on the sale order report and carried to the invoice lines and the delivery, so the same line numbers can be used across documents.

name: sale_order_line_stock_move_history
summary: Adds a button on each sale order line that opens the stock move history for that line's product. It appears next to the Delivered field, so a user can see how stock has moved while reviewing an order. Nothing else on the order changes.

name: sale_order_line_tag
summary: Lets users attach classification tags to individual sale order lines, for example to record why a line exists. The tags are a shared list defined in the system and appear on the line in the sales order. Useful for grouping or reporting on line types.

name: sale_order_line_tag
summary: Lets users add tags to sale order lines to classify them, for example to record why a line was added, changed or discounted. Tags are a simple list managed by the company and picked on the line. Tags can be used to group and filter lines in reports.

name: sale_order_line_variant_description
summary: Gives each product variant its own sales description, which is used as the line name on sale order lines. For example, a red and a blue version of the same product can each have their own customer facing text. Set on each variant of the product.

name: sale_order_line_variant_description
summary: Gives each product variant its own sales description, which is used as the line name on sale order lines. For example, a red and a blue version of the same product can each have their own customer facing text. Set on each variant of the product.

name: sale_order_lot_generator
summary: Creates a lot number automatically for each sale line when the sale order is confirmed, for products flagged Auto Generate Lot. Useful when a lot number is needed for traceability but nobody wants to type one. The flag is set on the product's Inventory tab.

name: sale_order_lot_generator
summary: Automatically creates a lot number for each sale line when the sale order is confirmed, for products flagged to auto-generate lots. The flag is set on the product's Inventory tab. Use it when products are lot-tracked and staff should not type lot numbers by hand.

name: sale_order_lot_selection
summary: Lets a salesperson pick the lot number on a sale order line, so that the chosen lot is the one delivered to the customer. The delivery reserves that lot when it is available. Products must be tracked By Lots, and lots can be changed on confirmed orders if the company allows it.

name: sale_order_lot_selection
summary: Lets salespeople choose the specific lot or serial number on a sale order line, so that exact lot is the one delivered to the customer. Delivery orders reserve that lot when it is in stock. A company setting can exclude lots already tied to pending orders from the choice.

name: sale_order_lot_selection_price
summary: Lets a sale price (or cost) be set on each lot, so an order line using that lot is priced from the lot's value plus any pricelist discount. It is set up with a formula-based pricelist. Use it when different lots of the same product sell at different prices.

name: sale_order_manual_lock
summary: Adds Lock and Unlock buttons to confirmed sales orders, so a user can freeze an order by hand. Works regardless of the automatic locking setting. A locked order can be unlocked by clicking Unlock.

name: sale_order_mass_action
summary: Lets you confirm many quotations at once from the Quotations list, using the Action menu and Mass Action. Only quotations in Draft or Sent state are confirmed, and the others are left as they are. Mainly a time saver for busy sales teams.

name: sale_order_minimum_amount
summary: Stops sales users from confirming a sales order whose total is below a company minimum amount, with an error message showing the minimum. Sales managers are exempt. The minimum is set in Sales Settings as Minimum Allowed Sales Order Amount.

name: sale_order_note_template
summary: Adds reusable Terms and Conditions templates that can be picked on a sale order to fill in its terms text quickly. Templates can use Jinja2 placeholders, and the terms field becomes formatted rich text. These are separate from comment templates, and the terms are not copied to invoices.

name: sale_order_note_template
summary: Adds reusable terms and conditions templates that can be picked on a sale order, and turns the terms field into rich text. Templates are written with Jinja2 so they can fill in order details. Use it to avoid retyping standard terms on every quotation.

name: sale_order_ordered_weight
summary: Calculates the ordered weight of each sale order line and the total ordered weight of the order, and prints the order weight on the sale order report. Line weights can also be printed, but are hidden by default to keep the PDF short. Shown on the sale order and in the order list, hidden by default.

name: sale_order_partner_no_autofollow
summary: Stops the customer from being added as a follower on every new sale order. Standard Odoo does this by default. It is turned on in General Settings under Sales with Customer disable autofollow.

name: sale_order_partner_no_autofollow
summary: Stops the customer from being added as a follower on every new sale order. Standard Odoo does this by default. It is turned on in General Settings under Sales with Customer disable autofollow.

name: sale_order_payment_terms_from_invoice_address
summary: Changes where a sale order takes its payment terms from: the invoice address instead of the customer. Turn on the setting under Sales settings and the Payment Terms field on new orders follows the invoice contact. It does not change how screens look.

name: sale_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds a Recalculate prices button and a Reset descriptions button under the lines of a sale order. Recalculate prices reprices every product line from the current pricelist, which is useful after a pricelist change or a duplicate. Reset descriptions restores product descriptions, and both can be run on several orders at once.

name: sale_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds two buttons under the sale order lines: one recalculates all line prices from the current pricelist, and one resets product descriptions from the product record. Both overwrite earlier manual changes on those lines, so they run only when the salesperson chooses. Handy after changing a pricelist or duplicating an order.

name: sale_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds a Recalculate prices button and a Reset descriptions button under the lines of a sale order. Recalculate prices reprices every product line from the current pricelist, which is useful after a pricelist change or a duplicate. Reset descriptions restores product descriptions, and both can be run on several orders at once.

name: sale_order_priority
summary: Adds a priority field to sale orders and their lines. An order's priority is the highest priority among its lines, and setting it on the order sets all its lines. The priority carries through to the procurement, stock moves and delivery picking created on confirmation.

name: sale_order_priority
summary: Adds a Priority field to sale orders and their lines. An order's priority is the highest of its lines, and setting it on the order sets it on every line. The priority carries through to the procurement, stock moves and delivery, so urgent orders are visible in warehouse operations.

name: sale_order_product_assortment
summary: Restricts which products can be added to a sale order based on the customer's assortment. Products on the customer's allowed list can be selected, and products on the restricted list cannot. Assortments are set up on the customer as described in the product assortment module.

name: sale_order_product_assortment
summary: Limits the products a salesperson can add to a sale order based on the customer's product assortment. Products on the allowed list can be added, and products on the restricted list are blocked. Assortments are defined with the product_assortment module, and the customer field can be changed with a system parameter.

name: sale_order_product_availability_inline
summary: Shows each product's free to use stock quantity right in the product dropdown on sale order lines, so the salesperson sees availability while choosing. It appears on the Product field of the order line.

name: sale_order_product_availability_inline
summary: Shows each product's free-to-use stock quantity in the product dropdown on a sale order line. A salesperson can see whether an item is in stock before choosing it. It needs the Sales and Inventory apps.

name: sale_order_product_picker
summary: Adds a Picker tab on salesman quotations where products can be searched and added to the order with one click, edited or removed from kanban cards, and shown as images. It shows last sales and last prices for the customer. Found under Sales > Orders > Salesman Quotations.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation
summary: Adds a Recommended Products wizard to a sale order that suggests products the customer has recently bought, based on delivered sales. The salesperson picks items from the list and adds them to the order in one step. Prices can come from the list price or the customer's last sale price.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation
summary: Recommends products to sell to a customer based on what was delivered to them recently. A Recommended Products wizard on the sale order lists the most sold products, and the chosen ones can be added to the order with quantities. The price shown can come from the list price or the last sale price.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_elaboration
summary: Extends sale order product recommendations so elaborations (customer-specific details or customizations) can be repeated from the customer's last order for a product, or entered when a recommended product is added. Depends on the sale_elaboration module. Use it when product lines need extra detail beyond the product itself.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_packaging_default
summary: Adds packaging and packaging quantity columns to the recommended products wizard, so a salesperson can add recommendations by package size. Product packagings must be turned on in Sales settings. Use it when products are sold by box or case.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_product_sold_by_delivery_week
summary: Shows the weekly sales figure and the quantity on hand in the product recommendations wizard, so the salesperson can judge how fast each recommended product sells. Needs the weekly sales module and the recommendation module.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_product_sold_by_delivery_week
summary: Shows the weekly sales figure and the quantity on hand in the product recommendations wizard, so the salesperson can judge how fast each recommended product sells. Needs the weekly sales module and the recommendation module.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_quick_add
summary: Adds a button on the sale order that adds all recommended products in one click, skipping the recommendation wizard. Intended for quick repeat orders from the same customer.

name: sale_order_product_recommendation_secondary_unit
summary: Adds the secondary unit of measure to the recommended products wizard, so quantities can be entered in a second unit such as cases or pallets. The secondary unit only appears for products that have one set for sales. It builds on the product recommendations wizard.

name: sale_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Stops a sale line's manual discount and pricelist rule from being reset when only the quantity or unit of measure changes. Without it, changing the quantity recalculates the discount and wipes a negotiated one. Use it when customers have a fixed discount that should survive quantity edits.

name: sale_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Keeps a manually agreed unit price, discount and pricelist when only the quantity on a sale order line is changed. Normally Odoo reprices the line when quantity changes, which undoes a negotiated price. The price is only recalculated when something other than quantity changes.

name: sale_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Keeps a manually agreed unit price, discount and pricelist when only the quantity on a sale order line is changed. Normally Odoo reprices the line when quantity changes, which undoes a negotiated price. The price is only recalculated when something other than quantity changes.

name: sale_order_recurrence
summary: Creates a batch of draft quotations for a customer who orders the same things on a regular schedule, such as weekly or monthly. From a sale order, open Action > Recurrence Wizard, set a start date and recurrence, and one quotation is created per date. Useful for bakers or shops with standing orders.

name: sale_order_report_hide_tax
summary: Hides the Taxes column on the quotation document sent to customers when every line on the order uses the same tax group, so the printout carries no redundant tax information. It applies automatically to printed or emailed quotations from Sales > Orders, with no extra setup.

name: sale_order_report_hide_tax
summary: Hides the Taxes column on the quotation document sent to customers when every line on the order uses the same tax group, so the printout carries no redundant tax information. It applies automatically to printed or emailed quotations from Sales > Orders, with no extra setup.

name: sale_order_report_product_image
summary: Adds product pictures to the printed or emailed quotation and sales order, with a generic icon where a product has no image. You see it when you print or send a quotation from Sales > Orders.

name: sale_order_report_product_image
summary: Adds product pictures to the printed or emailed quotation and sales order, with a generic icon where a product has no image. You see it when you print or send a quotation from Sales > Orders.

name: sale_order_report_without_price
summary: Adds a print option that produces a quotation or sales order without prices. Use it from the print menu on a quote or order when the printout should not show amounts.

name: sale_order_report_without_price
summary: Adds a print option that produces quotation and order PDFs without prices. Use it when sending a document that lists products but should not show amounts. It is chosen from the print menu on the quotation or order.

name: sale_order_requested_delivery
summary: Adds requested delivery start and end date fields to sale orders and their lines, so the customer's preferred delivery window is recorded. The window is shown as a combined period on the order. Use it to capture a date range rather than a single delivery date.

name: sale_order_restrict_copy_archived_product
summary: Blocks duplicating a sale order when it contains archived products, and lists which products are archived. This stops archived items from being quietly copied into new orders. The check runs when the Duplicate action is used on the order.

name: sale_order_revision
summary: Keeps track of revised quotations. A cancelled order gets a New Copy of Quotation button that creates a numbered revision, with a chatter note and a tab listing past revisions. Old revisions are archived so they do not clutter searches.

name: sale_order_revision
summary: Lets a salesperson create a new numbered revision of a cancelled quotation (with a -revno suffix) instead of starting from scratch. Old revisions are archived, listed in a tab on the order, and a chatter note records each new revision.

name: sale_order_safe_commitment_date
summary: Warns when a salesperson sets a delivery (commitment) date earlier than the earliest date the company can actually promise, and flags the order with an alert. The delivery date is in the Other Info tab of the sales order, and an optional view can be unarchived to show it at the top of the form.

name: sale_order_search_line
summary: Lets users search sales orders by the description of their order lines from the sales search bar. Handy when you remember a product description but not the order number or customer.
keywords: search sales order by product description

name: sale_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets salespeople enter sale quantities in a product's secondary unit of measure, such as cases or boxes, and the base quantity updates to match. Secondary units are defined on the product with a conversion factor. Use it when customers order in a different unit than you stock or invoice.

name: sale_order_show_currency_rate
summary: Adds a box to sale order PDF reports showing the exchange rate between the order currency and the company currency, along with the order date. The box appears only when the currencies differ and a rate is available. A company setting chooses the reference currency.

name: sale_order_show_full_address
summary: Shows the complete invoice and delivery addresses on each quotation and sales order, the same way the customer form shows them. Users see them only if they are in the Delivery Address group, which the Customer Addresses setting in Invoicing settings turns on.

name: sale_order_split_strategy
summary: Lets you define split rules that separate one sale order into several orders, for example when some lines need a different carrier or temperature handling. Each strategy uses a saved filter on order lines, and a Split button on the order applies it. Useful for webshop or EDI orders that mix shipping needs.

name: sale_order_tag
summary: Adds tags to sales orders, not just opportunities, so orders can be labeled and grouped by things like type of deal or priority. Sales managers create the tags and users add them on the order form.

name: sale_order_tag
summary: Adds tags to sale orders for classifying them, separate from CRM opportunities. Tags can carry a colour and can be limited to specific sales teams. They are added on the order form.

name: sale_order_team_from_product
summary: Sets the sales team on a quotation automatically from the sales teams defined on its products. If every product shares one team, that team goes on the quote. A setting can skip this when a team is already chosen. It depends on the product_sale_team module.

name: sale_order_transmit_method
summary: Adds a transmission method, such as email, post or portal, to sale orders and carries it through to the invoices. It records how the document should be sent to the customer. It depends on the invoice transmit method module.

name: sale_order_type
summary: Adds sale order types, such as lines of business, each with its own journal, warehouse, sequence, shipping and invoicing policy, payment terms, pricelist and incoterm. Choosing a type on an order fills in all those settings, and a customer can have a default type. It also warns when the customer's pricelist differs from the type's pricelist.

name: sale_order_type
summary: Adds Sale Order Types, which work like lines of business: each type can carry its own journal, warehouse, numbering sequence, shipping and invoicing policy, payment term, pricelist and incoterm. Pick a type on the order, or set a default type on a customer, and the settings fill in automatically; types are set up under Sales > Configuration. Ranking the types also decides which one is the company default when nothing else applies.

name: sale_order_type
summary: Adds Sale Order Types, which work like lines of business: each type can carry its own journal, warehouse, numbering sequence, shipping and invoicing policy, payment term, pricelist and incoterm. Pick a type on the order, or set a default type on a customer, and the settings fill in automatically; types are set up under Sales > Configuration. Ranking the types also decides which one is the company default when nothing else applies.

name: sale_order_type
summary: Adds Sale Order Types, which work like lines of business: each type can carry its own journal, warehouse, numbering sequence, shipping and invoicing policy, payment term, pricelist and incoterm. Pick a type on the order, or set a default type on a customer, and the settings fill in automatically; types are set up under Sales > Configuration. Ranking the types also decides which one is the company default when nothing else applies.

name: sale_order_type_confirm_message
summary: Shows a confirmation pop-up with a custom message before a quotation is confirmed, when its order type has one set. The user must press Confirm in the pop-up to continue. Use it to warn about special terms for certain kinds of orders.

name: sale_order_type_whole_delivered_invoiceability
summary: Adds a switch on each sales order type that stops invoicing until all stockable products on the order are delivered. Orders of that type stay out of the To Invoice list and the Create Invoice button stays unhighlighted until the delivery is complete.

name: sale_order_update_timesheet_price
summary: Lets a user change the unit price of an already invoiced sale order line that is billed on delivered timesheets. A banknote button on the line opens a wizard that creates a new line at the new price and moves the linked projects, tasks, milestones and employee mappings over to it.

name: sale_order_warehouse_from_delivery_carrier
summary: Sets the warehouse on a quotation automatically when a shipping method is selected, using the sales order warehouse configured on that shipping method. The warehouse is not changed once the order is confirmed.

name: sale_order_warehouse_from_delivery_carrier
summary: Sets the warehouse on a quotation automatically when a shipping method is selected, using the sales order warehouse configured on that shipping method. The warehouse is not changed once the order is confirmed.

name: sale_order_warehouse_header
summary: Moves the warehouse field up into the header of the sale order form, so it is easier to find. The search view also gets filter and group-by options for warehouse. It shows on the Sales order form and in order search.

name: sale_order_warehouse_location
summary: Sets the warehouse on a sales order automatically from the shipping address country and state, based on the countries and states assigned to each warehouse. Warehouses are configured under Inventory > Configuration > Warehouses.

name: sale_order_warn_message
summary: A small technical extension that adds a warning message field to sale orders and shows it as a popup. It makes sure the warning is filled in, not only when the customer changes. It appears on the sales order form.

name: sale_order_weight
summary: Adds the products' total weight to the printed sales order report, useful for shipping and transport planning. It appears on the printed quotation or order.

name: sale_order_whole_delivered_invoiceability
summary: Stops a customer's sales orders from being invoiced until all their stockable products have been delivered, when the Whole Delivered Invoiceability option is set on the customer. Affected orders stay out of the To Invoice list until the delivery is complete.

name: sale_packaging_default
summary: Makes packaging easier on sales by moving the packaging fields in front of the quantity, and auto-filling a product's default sales packaging when it is picked. The first packaging enabled for sales is the default. It can also make packaging mandatory when a product has sales packagings.

name: sale_packaging_default
summary: Makes product packaging (for example cases or pallets) the default unit on sales order lines and puts the packaging fields ahead of the quantity. When a product is added to a quote, its first sales-enabled packaging is applied automatically. Needs Product Packagings turned on in Sales settings.

name: sale_packaging_report
summary: Prints the packaging type and number of packages on quotations and orders, and adds packaging quantity measures to the Sales reporting. Set packaging on the products first; the measures are under Sales > Reporting.

name: sale_partner_address_restrict
summary: Limits the invoice and delivery address choices on a sales order to addresses belonging to the selected customer. The address dropdowns then show only that customer's own contacts and addresses.

name: sale_partner_address_restrict
summary: Limits the delivery and invoice address choices on a sale order to addresses that belong to the selected customer. A checkbox on an address marks it as a dropship address, which keeps the buyer's name off the delivery address. The restriction is turned on in Sales settings.

name: sale_partner_company
summary: Sets the selling company on a sales order from the customer record, for setups with several companies. Choose a default selling company on the customer, and new orders for that customer pick it up automatically.
keywords: company on sales order from customer

name: sale_partner_company_group
summary: Adds the customer's company group (from the base company group module) to sales orders, so orders can be grouped or reported by parent group. It shows as a Company Group field on quotations and orders.

name: sale_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a company group field to sales orders, so an order can be tied to a group of related companies. The group comes from the base company group feature. It appears on the sales order form.

name: sale_partner_delay
summary: Adds a per-customer extra delivery lead time, in days, which is added to the product lead time on sales order lines to give a realistic delivery date for that customer. Useful for remote locations or customers with customs or quality checks. It is set on the customer's form.

name: sale_partner_incoterm
summary: Sets a default incoterm (shipping terms) on each customer's Sales and Purchases tab, and allows a different one per contact within the same company. New quotations for that customer pick up the incoterm automatically. The order also gets an incoterm address.

name: sale_partner_incoterm
summary: Sets a default incoterm (shipping terms) on a customer's record, filled in automatically on new quotations for that customer. It can be set per contact and is shown only to users with the incoterms display permission.

name: sale_partner_operating_unit
summary: Sets the operating unit on a sales order from the customer's operating unit, so orders are tracked to the right business unit. Changing the customer updates the order's operating unit to match.

name: sale_partner_order_template
summary: Lets you set an order template on each customer, so a new order for that customer is pre-filled from the template. The template is chosen in the Sales section of the customer record. Use it for customers who regularly buy the same set of products.

name: sale_partner_pricelist
summary: Restricts which pricelists a salesperson can pick on a sales order to the ones allowed for that customer. Set the allowed pricelists on the customer, and leave the field empty to allow all of them; the Use Partner Pricelist option must be on in Sales settings.
keywords: only certain price lists per customer

name: sale_partner_pricelist
summary: Restricts which pricelists a salesperson can pick on a sales order to the ones allowed for that customer. Set the allowed pricelists on the customer, and leave the field empty to allow all of them; the Use Partner Pricelist option must be on in Sales settings.
keywords: only certain price lists per customer

name: sale_partner_primeship
summary: Adds time-limited prime memberships to customers. Confirming a sale order with a membership product activates the membership for a set number of months, and it expires automatically. Customers show their current membership status on their record and can be filtered by it.

name: sale_partner_sale_contact
summary: Adds a Sale Contact field to quotations, sales orders and invoices, so you can name the person at the customer who drives the deal while the company stays as the customer. The contact can appear on the printed reports and is picked from the customer's child contacts.

name: sale_partner_sale_contact_on_project
summary: Copies the Sale Contact from a sales order to any project it creates from a service product, so the named contact shows on the project form. It needs the Sale Contact module and the Project app.
keywords: contact person project created from sale

name: sale_partner_selectable_option
summary: Lets you mark a contact as not selectable on sale orders, so it will not appear in the Customer field. The default for new contacts can be changed with a system parameter. Use it to keep certain contacts off orders while still keeping them in the database.

name: sale_partner_selectable_option
summary: Keeps customers marked as not selectable in orders out of the Customer field on quotations and orders. Uncheck Selectable in orders on the customer's Sales tab to block it; the default for new customers can be changed in system parameters.

name: sale_partner_shipping_default_partner_invoice
summary: Sets the invoice address on a sale order from the shipping address, using a Default Invoice Address on the customer record. When the shipping address is chosen, the invoice address follows. It is set up on the partner form.

name: sale_partner_utm_source
summary: Copies the customer's source (UTM source) onto new quotations automatically, and users can change it there. It also adds a source grouping to the sales order and invoice lists.

name: sale_payment_mode_brand
summary: Limits the payment modes offered on a sales order to those allowed for the selected brand. Each brand's allowed payment modes are set under Settings > Users and Companies > Brands, and the sales order list then filters by brand.

name: sale_payment_sheet
summary: Lets salespeople record customer payments on a payment sheet from the Sales app, without needing accounting rights. A confirmed sheet creates a bank statement, and from the invoice list users can pay selected invoices through an Action wizard.

name: sale_payment_sheet
summary: Lets salespeople record customer payments on a payment sheet without needing accounting rights. The sheet can be tied to specific invoices and, once confirmed, creates a bank statement for accounting. The journals a user can pay into are set on the user record.

name: sale_payment_sheet_financial_risk
summary: Lets payments collected on payment sheets that are not yet reconciled reduce a customer's credit risk. Turn on Deduct Sale Payment Sheet on the customer's Financial Risk to net these amounts against each risk limit. Requires the Financial Risk and Payment Sheet modules.

name: sale_payment_sheet_financial_risk
summary: Lets sale payment sheet amounts that are collected but not yet reconciled reduce a customer's financial risk. When the option is turned on, the deducted amounts are shown grouped by risk type. It suits sales teams that collect payment in the field.

name: sale_payment_term_security
summary: Restricts changing payment terms on sales orders to users who have the permission to manage payment terms. Other users can see the terms but cannot edit them; the permission is granted per user in the user settings.

name: sale_planned_consumed_date
summary: Technical helper that sets a planned consumed date on each sales order line, defaulting to the customer commitment date. Inventory planning uses it when reserving stock for the order, so it has no separate screen of its own.

name: sale_planner_calendar
summary: Plans recurring commercial visits to customers as calendar events, so salespeople get a daily list of the visits due. Recurring visits are created from a partner's smart button and managed under the Calendar planner menu, with settings for how far ahead to plan and whether attendees get invitations.

name: sale_planner_calendar
summary: Lets sales reps plan recurring customer visits as calendar events, created from a smart button on the partner. A planner screen shows what each rep has to do today, and visits can be reassigned through a wizard. Settings control how far ahead visits are generated and whether attendees get invitations.

name: sale_portal_debranding
summary: Technical module that replaces Odoo-specific wording in the Connect your software dialog on the customer portal sale page with generic text, and removes the Get your Odoo section. Customers see the change in that portal dialog only.

name: sale_price_compliance
summary: Colors each sales order line by how its price compares with the product's list price, using up to three compliance tiers set on the product, its category or the company. Lines priced below the last tier are blocked, and only Sale Administrators can confirm such orders; the tiers can also be filtered in sales reports.

name: sale_pricelist_display_surcharge
summary: Shows surcharges to customers as well as discounts. Standard Odoo hides a price increase from the customer, but when Show Surcharge is checked on a pricelist rule the adjustment is always displayed, provided the pricelist is shown to customers.

name: sale_pricelist_display_surcharge
summary: Makes a pricelist rule always show a surcharge on the customer's document, instead of only showing discounts that benefit the customer. The Show Surcharge option is set on the pricelist rule. Use it when a rule adds cost and the increase should be visible.

name: sale_pricelist_from_commitment_date
summary: Uses the order's delivery (commitment) date, instead of the order date, to pick the pricelist price for each line. It also lets you show the Delivery Date in the order header and make it mandatory, both set in Sales settings. Use it when prices depend on when goods will be delivered.

name: sale_pricelist_from_commitment_date
summary: Uses the order's commitment (delivery) date instead of the order date when a pricelist calculates line prices, so date-based price rules follow when the goods are delivered. It takes effect on sales order lines once a commitment date is set.

name: sale_pricelist_global_rule
summary: Applies pricelist quantity breaks to the total quantity across all lines of a sales order, so several variants or products in the same category can together reach a volume discount. Pricelist rules are set to Global by product template or category, and a Recompute pricelist global button on the quotation refreshes the prices.

name: sale_pricelist_item_advanced
summary: Adds a Pricelist Items menu under Sales > Products so all pricelist rules can be browsed in one list. Users need the pricelist access right to see it.

name: sale_pricelist_packaging
summary: Adds packaging to pricelist rules, so the same product can sell at different prices depending on the packaging chosen. Use it when a case is priced differently per unit than a single item. The packaging is set on the pricelist rule.

name: sale_pricelist_technical
summary: Lets you mark a pricelist as technical, so it is used only to compute other pricelists and is hidden from sales orders and customer forms. Only members of the Technical / Basic Pricelists group can set the flag, from Sales > Configuration > Pricelists.

name: sale_pricelist_triple_discount
summary: Carries three discounts from a pricelist rule (the standard discount plus Discount 2 and Discount 3) onto quotation and sales order lines. The extra discounts are set only on rules of type Discount or Formula, and the pricelist must show discounts to customers.

name: sale_probability_amount
summary: Adds a win probability to quotations. New quotes start at 50%, drop to 0% when cancelled and go to 100% when confirmed. The quotation list can total the expected amount in company currency, which gives a simple sales pipeline view.

name: sale_procurement_customer
summary: Passes the invoiced customer on to the procurement group created when a sales order is confirmed, so warehouse orders carry the customer. It is a technical link between sales and stock.

name: sale_procurement_group_by_line
summary: A technical base module that gives each sale order line its own procurement group, so other modules can route lines separately. On its own it changes nothing visible to users. Other modules that create per-line procurement build on it.

name: sale_procurement_group_by_line
summary: Technical base module that gives each sales order line its own procurement group, for other modules that need one procurement per line. On its own it adds no visible feature.

name: sale_product_catalog_extended
summary: Extends the product catalog opened from a sales order with one card per order line, inline New line, Edit and Remove actions, and search options for origin, last sales (180 days by default) and last sale price. The defaults are set under Sales > Configuration > Settings in the Product Catalog block.

name: sale_product_category_menu
summary: Shows the Product Categories menu under Sales > Configuration > Products, so sales users can reach product categories without the inventory or purchase apps. It only changes menu visibility.

name: sale_product_company
summary: Lets you pick the list of companies a product can be sold from, on the product form. If the product's own company field is set, that takes priority over the list.

name: sale_product_company_multi_add
summary: Filters the products offered by the Add Multiple Products wizard to those the chosen selling company is allowed to sell. It needs the selling companies setting and the multi add tool installed.

name: sale_product_configurator_widget_product_label
summary: Technical glue module so the product configurator and section and note lines display their labels correctly together. It has no visible feature of its own.

name: sale_product_email
summary: Sends a product-specific email to the buyer when a sale is confirmed, using a mail template chosen on the product's Sales tab. It sends one mail per product at order confirmation, not when an invoice is posted.

name: sale_product_identification
summary: Requires an identification document, such as an authorisation or proof of age, before certain restricted products can be sold to a customer. Products get identification categories that are mandatory or optional, set on the product's Sales tab. It builds on the partner_identification module.

name: sale_product_matrix_secondary_unit
summary: Lets salespeople choose secondary units (for example boxes or cases) in the product matrix grid when adding a configured product to a quotation. A default sale secondary unit can be preselected in the matrix dialog.

name: sale_product_multi_add
summary: Adds a button on a sale order that opens a wizard to add many products and quantities at once. Use it to fill a large order quickly instead of adding one line at a time. The wizard adds the chosen items as order lines.

name: sale_product_multi_add
summary: Adds an Add Multiple Products button to sales orders that opens a wizard to search, select and add several products with quantities in one step. It saves entering each product as a separate line.

name: sale_product_pack
summary: Lets sales orders use product packs, so a pack added to a quotation or sales order expands into its component lines. The pack type and component price settings control how the pack is shown and priced to the customer, with an optional discount per component. Found under Sales when adding order lines.

name: sale_product_pack
summary: Adds product packs (kits) to sales orders: a pack product expands into its component lines, and the pack type and component price options decide whether components are priced separately or included in the pack price. Set Is Pack on a product under Sales > Products.

name: sale_product_pack_fixed_discount
summary: Technical glue module that stops fixed discounts from being applied to pack lines or pack components, except for packs whose components can be modified. Users see no change beyond the discount restriction.

name: sale_product_packaging_container_deposit
summary: Adds container deposit lines, such as returnable pallets or crates, to a sales order automatically, based on the ordered quantity and each product's packaging. The deposit products come from the product packaging container deposit setup.

name: sale_product_pricelist_operating_unit
summary: Limits the pricelists offered on a sales order to those linked to the same operating unit as the order. Pick a pricelist that belongs to the order's operating unit.

name: sale_product_set
summary: Adds a Product Set wizard to quotations, so a salesperson can add a predefined group of products in one step with preset quantities and discounts. Once added, the lines are ordinary order lines that can be changed or removed.

name: sale_product_set
summary: Adds a Product Set wizard to quotations, so a salesperson can add a predefined group of products in one step with preset quantities and discounts. Once added, the lines are ordinary order lines that can be changed or removed.

name: sale_product_set
summary: Lets a sales manager define product sets, which are fixed lists of products with quantities, that salespeople can add to a quotation in one step through a wizard. Each set line becomes a separate order line that can be edited afterwards. Use it for standard bundles that the customer does not see as one product.

name: sale_product_set_packaging_qty
summary: Lets product set lines use packagings and packaging quantities, so a set can state how many cases it includes. It is a small add-on with no new fields of its own, and it works alongside product sets and stock.

name: sale_product_template_tags
summary: Adds a Product Tags menu under the Sales app, so salespeople can open and manage product tags from there. It adds only the menu entry and no other changes.

name: sale_product_variant_attribute_tax
summary: Adds the taxes set on a product attribute value (for example a size or an option) to the order line when that value is selected. Users see the extra taxes on the quotation line when they edit the product attributes.

name: sale_production_state
summary: Shows the manufacturing state on sale orders and their lines, computed from the related manufacturing orders. Salespeople can see whether production has started or finished without opening the manufacturing orders. It requires the sale_mrp module.

name: sale_project_copy_tasks
summary: For service products set to copy tasks, copies the task list from a template project into the sales order's project when the order is confirmed. Useful for standard onboarding or delivery checklists.

name: sale_project_copy_tasks
summary: For service products set to copy tasks, copies the task list from a template project into the sales order's project when the order is confirmed. Useful for standard onboarding or delivery checklists.

name: sale_project_reimbursement_cost
summary: Shows provisions (advance costs) and reimbursable costs on the Project Updates dashboard. The provision is a sales order line on the project's order, and reimbursements come from vendor bills linked to the project.

name: sale_project_task_description_template
summary: Lets a service product carry a task description template, which is applied to tasks created from its sales order lines. Optionally adds the order line's product name and quantity above the template text.

name: sale_project_task_recurrency
summary: Sets up recurring tasks on a service product, so when a generated task is marked done the next one is created on the product's recurrence schedule. Configured on the product form, with the Recurring Tasks option enabled on the project.

name: sale_project_task_selection
summary: Lets the salesperson pick the project or task for a service order line before the order is confirmed. If one is set, automatic project or task creation is skipped and the line is linked to it instead.

name: sale_promotion_rule
summary: Adds promotion rules to sales orders: automatic promotions applied with an Apply discount button, and coupon codes that take precedence over the automatic ones. Rules are applied in sequence order on the order form.

name: sale_purchase_force_vendor
summary: Lets you pick the vendor on a sales order line that uses a route such as MTO, so the resulting purchase order goes to that vendor. The vendor restriction can be turned off in the purchase product settings.

name: sale_purchase_force_vendor
summary: On a sale order line that uses a make-to-order style route, lets the salesperson pick which vendor must supply the item, so the automatic purchase order goes to that vendor. A company setting can restrict which vendors are allowed on sale lines, and the selected vendor is shown on the sales analysis report. Works through the Sales app and the Inventory routes.

name: sale_purchase_procurement_group_by_line
summary: Technical glue module that lets the purchase-on-sale (MTO) features work with per-line procurement groups on sales orders. It has no visible feature of its own.

name: sale_purchase_stock_auto_cancel
summary: Adds a company setting that cancels the purchase orders created by dropship or made-to-order sales when the sale is cancelled. The option is called POs Auto Cancelation in Sales settings. Use it so purchase orders do not linger after an order is cancelled.

name: sale_purchase_stock_auto_confirm
summary: Adds a company setting that confirms the purchase orders automatically when they are created from a sale through dropship or made-to-order routes. The option is called POs Auto Validation in Sales settings. Use it to skip the manual confirmation step for those purchases.

name: sale_quotation_builder
summary: Lets you design quotation templates with drag-and-drop website building blocks, and adds rich descriptions to products and quotation lines. Templates are created under Sales > Configuration > Quotation Templates, and the Design Template button opens the editor.

name: sale_quotation_number
summary: Gives quotations their own number sequence, separate from confirmed sale orders. When a quotation is confirmed, the order gets the next order number and the quotation number is kept as the origin. The shared numbering option is turned off in Sales settings.

name: sale_quotation_number
summary: Gives quotations their own number sequence (for example SQ001), separate from confirmed sales orders (SO001), so lost quotes no longer use up order numbers. When a quote is confirmed, its original number is kept in the origin field and the order gets a new sales order number. The option is switched off under Sales > Configuration.

name: sale_readonly_security
summary: Adds a permission that lets users view sale orders without being able to create, edit or delete them. Turning off the Sale orders edition permission on a user makes their orders read only. Use it for people who only need to look at orders.

name: sale_rental
summary: Lets you rent products to customers: a rental service on a sales order line creates the delivery and return receipt when the order is confirmed, a rental can be extended by moving the return date, and rented items can also be sold. Rental stock locations are enabled per warehouse, and a Create Rental Service button on the product sets up the service.

name: sale_rental
summary: Lets you rent products to customers: a rental service on a sales order line creates the delivery and return receipt when the order is confirmed, a rental can be extended by moving the return date, and rented items can also be sold. Rental stock locations are enabled per warehouse, and a Create Rental Service button on the product sets up the service.

name: sale_report_commitment_date
summary: Adds the commitment (promised delivery) date to the Sales analysis report, so sales can be grouped or filtered by it. Found under Sales > Reporting.

name: sale_report_country_state
summary: Adds the customer's state to the Sales analysis report, so sales can be filtered or grouped by state. Found under Sales > Reporting.

name: sale_report_delivered
summary: Adds a Sales from deliveries report that counts what has actually shipped, including returns and dropship, with a Total Price Delivered measure. Found under Sales > Reporting > Sales from deliveries.

name: sale_report_delivered_attribute_values
summary: Adds product attribute values, such as size or color, to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered quantities can be filtered and grouped by variant options.

name: sale_report_delivered_attribute_values
summary: Adds product attribute values, such as size or color, to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered quantities can be filtered and grouped by variant options.

name: sale_report_delivered_brand
summary: Adds the product brand to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered sales can be searched and grouped by brand. Found under Sales > Reporting > Sales from deliveries.

name: sale_report_delivered_deposit
summary: Shows customer deposit lines in the Sales from deliveries report, so deposits taken from customers appear with delivered sales. It needs customer deposits turned on for the warehouse.

name: sale_report_delivered_elaboration
summary: Adds an elaboration cost measure to the Sales from deliveries report, for tracking the extra processing cost on sold items. Found under Sales > Reporting > Sales from deliveries.

name: sale_report_delivered_partner_priority
summary: Adds the customer's priority to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered sales can be searched and grouped by partner priority. Found under Sales > Reporting > Sales from deliveries.

name: sale_report_delivered_price_compliance
summary: Adds price compliance tiers to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered sales can be grouped by how compliant their pricing was.

name: sale_report_delivered_semaphore
summary: Adds the order's semaphore (traffic-light status) to the Sales from deliveries report, so delivered sales can be grouped by it.

name: sale_report_delivered_subtotal
summary: Adds Untaxed Total Delivered and Gross Weight Delivered measures to the Sales Reporting, based on delivered quantities rather than ordered ones. Found under Sales > Reporting.

name: sale_report_delivered_volume
summary: Adds a Volume Delivered measure to the Sales analysis report, for analyzing how much volume has shipped. Add it from the Measures menu under Sales > Reporting > Sales.

name: sale_report_margin
summary: Adds a Purchase Price measure to the Sales analysis report, taken from each product's cost and its inventory valuation method, so margins can be analyzed. Add it from the Measures menu under Sales > Reporting > Sales.

name: sale_report_margin
summary: Adds a Purchase Price measure to the Sales analysis report, taken from each product's cost and its inventory valuation method, so margins can be analyzed. Add it from the Measures menu under Sales > Reporting > Sales.

name: sale_report_salesman
summary: Lets all sales groups open Sales > Reporting, where users see either all documents or only their own, depending on their access level. Use it to give salespeople access to sales reports.

name: sale_report_salesman
summary: Lets all sales groups open Sales > Reporting, where users see either all documents or only their own, depending on their access level. Use it to give salespeople access to sales reports.

name: sale_report_salesman
summary: Lets all sales groups open Sales > Reporting, where users see either all documents or only their own, depending on their access level. Use it to give salespeople access to sales reports.

name: sale_report_salesperson_from_partner
summary: Adds a Salesperson From Partner field to the Sales analysis report, so sales can be grouped by the salesperson assigned on the customer record rather than the one on the order.

name: sale_report_salesperson_from_partner
summary: Adds a Salesperson From Partner field to the Sales analysis report, so sales can be grouped by the salesperson assigned on the customer record rather than the one on the order.

name: sale_require_po_doc
summary: Flags customers who require a purchase order or other sales documentation before an invoice can be created. The flag and a documentation note are carried from the customer to the order, with a documentation option on the order. Use it to avoid invoicing customers who must first send a PO.

name: sale_resource_booking
summary: Links sales with resource bookings (appointments or reservable resources). Confirming a sale creates the matching pending bookings, and a booking type can generate a quotation from its linked product. It is set up under Resource bookings > Types.

name: sale_resource_booking
summary: Links sales with resource bookings. Products can be tied to booking types, and confirming a sale creates pending bookings. A Quote button on a booking type generates a sale order with the booked product through a wizard.

name: sale_restricted_qty
summary: Sets minimum, maximum and multiple-of quantity rules on products and product categories. Sales lines are checked against these rules and either blocked or flagged with a warning, depending on the rule. They are configured in the Qty Constraints section of the product's Sales tab.

name: sale_restricted_qty
summary: Sets minimum, maximum and multiple order quantities per product, shown on sales lines as required or recommended. A force option lets a salesperson go past the limits, and the values can be set on the product, its template or its category. Found under Sales > Products > Product Variants.

name: sale_restricted_qty
summary: Sets minimum, maximum and multiple order quantities per product, shown on sales lines as required or recommended. A force option lets a salesperson go past the limits, and the values can be set on the product, its template or its category. Found under Sales > Products > Product Variants.

name: sale_seasonality
summary: Links sales campaigns to seasonalities, so sales can be tracked and reported by season and by campaign. Seasonality appears on the sales report and on campaigns used in sales orders.

name: sale_semaphore
summary: Shows a green, yellow or red indicator on sale lines based on how far the price sits from the product's public price, using discount thresholds set per product or category. The indicator also appears on invoice lines and reports. It makes discount policy visible while selling.

name: sale_shipping_info_helper
summary: Adds computed shipping amounts and item amounts (total, untaxed and tax) to sales orders, so shipping cost can be shown separately in reports and e-commerce. It is a technical helper with no new screen of its own.

name: sale_shipping_info_helper
summary: Adds computed shipping and item amount totals (untaxed, tax and total) to sale orders, for use in reports or e-commerce. Nothing new is shown on screen by default. It depends on the delivery module.

name: sale_sourced_by_line
summary: Lets each sale order line come from a different warehouse than the order's default warehouse. One procurement group is created per warehouse used, and it works with make-to-order and dropship routes only. Use it for lines fulfilled from different sites.

name: sale_start_end_dates
