summary: Adds start and end dates to sale order lines, required for products that must have dates, and default dates on the order that fill new lines. The dates are copied to the invoice lines. It is mainly a building block for rental and similar modules.

name: sale_start_end_dates
summary: Adds Start Date and End Date to sales order lines, required for products flagged Must Have Start and End Dates, with optional default dates on the order. The dates carry over to the invoice lines. It is a technical base module used by rental features.
keywords: start and end date sales line

name: sale_stock_available_info_popup
summary: Adds an Available to promise quantity to the stock info popover on sales order lines, so the salesperson sees what can be promised for the product, and the icon color reflects it. Open it with the chart icon on a storable product line in Sales > Orders > Quotations.

name: sale_stock_available_info_popup
summary: Adds an Available to promise quantity to the stock info popover on sales order lines, so the salesperson sees what can be promised for the product, and the icon color reflects it. Open it with the chart icon on a storable product line in Sales > Orders > Quotations.

name: sale_stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Connects sales with the Available to Promise release process: sales order lines show whether they are available, when they can be expected and how much is delayed, and the stock moves take the order confirmation date as their priority. It shows on the sales order lines and order delivery information.

name: sale_stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Connects sales with the Available to Promise release process: sales order lines show whether they are available, when they can be expected and how much is delayed, and the stock moves take the order confirmation date as their priority. It shows on the sales order lines and order delivery information.

name: sale_stock_available_to_promise_release_block
summary: Lets you block the release of deliveries from a sales order right after it is confirmed, and unblock them later. When a new order goes to the same delivery address, the blocked deliveries can be listed and unblocked so they ship together with the new order.

name: sale_stock_available_to_promise_release_dropshipping
summary: Technical glue module that makes the available-to-promise release work with dropshipping lines on sales orders. It has no visible feature of its own.

name: sale_stock_cancel_restriction
summary: Stops a sales order from being cancelled once its delivery has been validated (Done), so completed shipments are not left without an order. It can be switched on per warehouse.

name: sale_stock_cancel_restriction
summary: Blocks cancelling a sale order when its delivery orders are done. Once a picking is validated, the cancel action is refused with a message. Use it to protect orders that have already shipped.

name: sale_stock_delivery_address
summary: Lets each sale order line go to a different delivery address, splitting deliveries as needed. Each destination can point to its own stock location, so the goods ship from the right place. Setup requires developer mode and rules on the destination locations.

name: sale_stock_delivery_state
summary: A glue module that makes the delivery status on sale orders work with the stock module, by combining sale_delivery_state with stock. Users see the same status field, now computed from deliveries. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: sale_stock_delivery_state
summary: Changes how the delivery status of a sales order is computed, as a bridge between the delivery state and stock modules. The result shows as the sales order's delivery status.

name: sale_stock_expiry_date_on_qty_at_date_widget
summary: Shows the next expiry date in the stock availability widget on a sale order line, so a salesperson can tell the customer when stock expires. It is used with lot or serial tracked products that have expiration dates. Users need the Sales own documents permission and lot management rights.

name: sale_stock_last_date
summary: Shows the date of the last delivery on each sale order line, filled in when the related picking is validated. The field can also be filtered and grouped in the sales report. Use it to see when each line last shipped.

name: sale_stock_line_customer_ref
summary: Adds a customer reference per sale order line that carries through to stock moves, pickings and packages. Lines with the same product but different customer references are kept apart in transfers. Use it when a customer needs its own reference printed on labels.

name: sale_stock_line_sequence
summary: A glue module that makes the line order on sale orders match the line order on delivery orders, so picking lines follow the sale. Sections and notes are not counted. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: sale_stock_line_sequence
summary: Makes delivery order lines follow the sales order line sequence, so the picking lists items in the same order as the quote. Sections and notes are not included in the numbering.

name: sale_stock_operating_unit
summary: Aligns operating units across sales and stock, so sales teams, warehouses and locations are assigned to matching business units and orders and moves stay within the same unit. It is configured under Settings > Users & Companies > Operating Units and in Sales Teams.

name: sale_stock_operating_unit
summary: Aligns operating units across sales and stock, so sales teams, warehouses and locations are assigned to matching business units and orders and moves stay within the same unit. It is configured under Settings > Users & Companies > Operating Units and in Sales Teams.

name: sale_stock_orderpoint_mto_as_mts
summary: When a sales order line uses an MTO route and the warehouse's default delivery route is MTO, makes sure a reorder rule (orderpoint) exists for that product. It is a technical stock-planning helper.

name: sale_stock_partner_delivery_window
summary: Moves the expected delivery date of a sales order to the customer's delivery schedule preference: anytime, workdays only, or the time windows set on the customer record. A warning appears on the order when the commitment date does not fit the preference.

name: sale_stock_partner_warehouse
summary: Sets the default warehouse on a sales order from a warehouse set on the customer record. New orders for that customer pick it up automatically.

name: sale_stock_partner_warehouse
summary: Sets a default warehouse on sale orders from the customer record. A company setting can instead use the shipping contact's warehouse first. If the customer has no warehouse set, the usual default warehouse applies.

name: sale_stock_picking_backorder_policy
summary: Lets you set a backorder policy (Ask, Always or Never) on a customer and on each sales order, and carries it over to the deliveries the order creates. Set it on the contact's Sales & Purchase tab, then adjust it per order before confirming.

name: sale_stock_picking_blocking
summary: Lets a sale be confirmed without creating its delivery, using a delivery block reason. Users in the release group lift the block later, when the delivery should be created. Customers and payment terms can set a default block reason.

name: sale_stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links sales orders, deliveries and customer invoices, so each invoice shows which deliveries it relates to on a Pickings tab. It is useful for partial deliveries and for invoice reports grouped by delivery, for products invoiced on delivery.

name: sale_stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Lets you choose, per company, whether sales are invoiced from the sales order, from the delivery (stock picking), or from both. Invoices created from deliveries use the sales order's pricing and partner details, and invoicing from the order marks the delivery as invoiced. The Sale Invoicing Policy is set in Settings or on the company.

name: sale_stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Adds a Sale Invoicing Policy that decides whether invoices are created from the sales order or from the delivery, so product lines can be invoiced per shipment. With the stock picking option, product lines can no longer be invoiced from the order while service lines still can. It is set on the company or in Invoicing settings.

name: sale_stock_picking_note
summary: Adds an internal note and a customer note for the delivery to sale orders and customer records. The notes are passed to the delivery order when it is created. Use it to brief warehouse staff or show customer comments on pickings.

name: sale_stock_picking_note
summary: Adds an internal picking note and a customer comment to customers and sales orders, and copies them onto the delivery. Warehouse staff get the internal note on the picking, while the customer comment is for the customer.

name: sale_stock_picking_reservation_policy
summary: Adds a Reservation Policy (Partial or All or nothing per line) on the customer and on the sales order, and carries it over to the deliveries. With all or nothing per line, a stock line is reserved only when its full quantity is available.

name: sale_stock_picking_validation_blocking
summary: Blocks validation of a sale's delivery orders from the sale order, so stock is reserved but not shipped until approval. A Block Delivery Validation button on the order sets the block, and the Validate button disappears from the related pickings. Use it when goods must be held for sign-off.

name: sale_stock_prebook
summary: Lets you reserve stock for a quotation before it is confirmed, using the Reserve Stock and Release reservation buttons on the quote. The reservation creates real pickings and moves, so the stock is held for that customer.

name: sale_stock_prebook_cancel_line
summary: Technical fix so the cancelled quantity on a sales order line ignores quantities that were only prebooked. It has no new screen of its own.

name: sale_stock_prebook_stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Counts stock already reserved by a sales prebook as available to promise on sales orders. It is a technical extension of the prebook and available-to-promise modules.

name: sale_stock_prebook_stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Counts stock already reserved by a sales prebook as available to promise on sales orders. It is a technical extension of the prebook and available-to-promise modules.

name: sale_stock_product_pack
summary: Makes packs that are stored products work correctly across sales and inventory, so delivered quantities are counted properly and a storable pack can be invoiced when shipped. It is a compatibility layer and adds no screens of its own.

name: sale_stock_product_pack
summary: Makes product packs work when the pack itself is a storable product, by computing delivered quantities correctly for each pack type. This lets packs be invoiced after delivery.

name: sale_stock_product_recommendation
summary: Adds stock forecast information to the recommended products wizard, so a salesperson can see whether a recommended product can be delivered. It shows on draft sale orders and builds on the product recommendation module. It helps decide whether to accept each recommendation.

name: sale_stock_qty_at_date_widget_multi_warehouse
summary: Changes the availability icon on a sale line so it considers stock in every warehouse, not just the order's warehouse. The icon turns yellow when gathering stock from all warehouses would cover the demand, and red when it would not. The popover lists the stock in each warehouse.

name: sale_stock_reference_by_line
summary: Technical base module that creates a separate stock reference (formerly a procurement group) for each sales order line, for modules that need one per line. Adds no visible feature on its own.

name: sale_stock_release_channel
summary: Stops the release channel search from applying extra filters when a sales order has a commitment date. It is a technical integration of release channels with sales.

name: sale_stock_release_channel
summary: Stops the release channel search from applying extra filters when a sales order has a commitment date. It is a technical integration of release channels with sales.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_delivery
summary: Technical integration of release channels with delivery on sales orders, so the commitment date rule also applies to shipments. It has no screen of its own.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_delivery
summary: Technical integration of release channels with delivery on sales orders, so the commitment date rule also applies to shipments. It has no screen of its own.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_delivery_date
summary: Computes the sales order's expected delivery date from the release channels that are available for its warehouse, carrier and shipping partner. The resulting date shows as the order's expected date.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_delivery_date
summary: Computes the sales order's expected delivery date from the release channels that are available for its warehouse, carrier and shipping partner. The resulting date shows as the order's expected date.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_delivery_date_plan_shipment_lead_time
summary: Technical fix so delivery date calculations refresh when shipment preparation plans change for release channels. It has no visible feature of its own.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_partner_by_date
summary: Lets a salesperson set a release channel on a sales order for a specific delivery date, under the Other info tab in the Delivery section. The channels offered follow the order's warehouse, and the delivery takes the channel from the order when confirmed.

name: sale_stock_release_channel_partner_by_date_delivery
summary: Restricts the release channels offered on a sales order to those that fit the selected shipping method. The shipping method can be set automatically with the delivery auto refresh module.

name: sale_stock_reservation_issue_on_qty_at_date_widget
summary: Turns the availability icon on a sale line yellow when the line would sell more than the free stock today, because reserved stock from other orders is in the way. The warning appears before confirmation. It helps catch reservation clashes early.

name: sale_stock_restocking_fee_invoicing
summary: When a customer returns goods, the return wizard can add a restocking fee to the sales order, for the whole return or per line. The fee product is set in Inventory settings under Valuation.

name: sale_stock_return_request
summary: Extends supplier return requests so a return can be linked to the purchase orders it amends and to its refunds. The related sales orders are shown on the return request. It lives under the Inventory operations menu.

name: sale_stock_secondary_unit
summary: Copies the secondary unit sale data from the sale line to the stock moves when the order is confirmed, so the delivery shows quantities in the second unit too. The secondary unit is set on the product. Use it when warehouse staff pick in cases or other units.

name: sale_stock_warehouse_multicompany
summary: Lets several companies sell stock from a shared warehouse. The sales order, taxes and invoices belong to the selling company, while the stock moves belong to the company that owns the stock. The companies allowed to sell are chosen on the warehouse.

name: sale_stock_weighing
summary: Shows the sales order details on the cards of the weighing assistant, so staff weighing a shipment can see which order it belongs to. It appears in the Inventory weighing screens.

name: sale_substate
summary: Adds substates to sales orders, so each order state can have a sub-status such as waiting for legal documents. Substates are defined under Settings > Technical > Sub State Configuration and show in the order header.

name: sale_substate
summary: Adds configurable sub-statuses to sale orders, such as waiting for legal documents, which refine each main state. Sub-statuses are set up in the technical configuration and shown in the order header. Use it to track where an order is held within a state.

name: sale_team_payment_term
summary: Sets a payment term on sales teams, used when neither the order nor the customer has one. The priority is the term on the order first, then the customer's term, then the team's term. Use it to give a sales channel a default payment term.

name: sale_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval process to sale orders. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve it, and only then can the order be confirmed. Reviews appear on a Reviews tab, and a Needs my Review filter helps approvers, while printing unvalidated quotations can optionally be blocked.

name: sale_timesheet_budget
summary: Adds a Budget tab on projects linked to sales orders, where planned income and expense lines (positive or negative) can be recorded against the project's budget. It appears on the project form.

name: sale_timesheet_budget
summary: Adds a Budget tab on projects, where you add expected income and expense lines against a planned budget. Lines can be positive or negative and are linked to the project's analytic account. The budget total shows on the project record in the Project app.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_description
summary: Adds timesheet details to the invoice lines created from timesheet-based sales orders, so the invoice shows what work was done. The description style is chosen under Timesheet Invoice Description in the Timesheets settings, in the Billing section. Lines can also be split by timesheet.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_description
summary: Adds timesheet details to invoice lines, so customers see the hours billed, for example by employee or by task. It is set under Timesheets > Configuration > Settings in the Billing section, and applies to products based on timesheets.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_link
summary: Links timesheet entries to invoices, so work can be invoiced in advance or linked by hand. Invoices also show a warning when the customer has timesheets not yet linked to any invoice. It needs the Timesheets Administrator permission.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_link
summary: Lets you link timesheet lines to an existing customer invoice of the same customer, so you can invoice work before the hours are actually done. The linked invoice shows as a column in the timesheet list. Users need the Timesheets Administrator permission.

name: sale_timesheet_line_exclude
summary: Lets you mark a timesheet entry as non-billable so it is left out of the sales order's invoicing, which is useful for by-task billing. Use the Non-billable checkbox in the timesheet list or on the task's Timesheets tab.

name: sale_timesheet_line_exclude
summary: Lets you exclude a specific timesheet entry from being invoiced on the sales order, even when its task is billed. This is useful for billing by task when one entry should not be charged. You tick Non-billable on the timesheet list or on the task's Timesheets tab.

name: sale_timesheet_project_manual
summary: Lets you create the project and tasks from a draft sale order before it is confirmed, using a Generate Project or Task button. It applies to service products set to create a task or a project. Use it when planning work before the sale is final.

name: sale_timesheet_rounded
summary: Rounds timesheet amounts to a set unit on each project, so 5 minutes of work can be invoiced as 15 minutes. The rounding unit and method are set on the project, and each entry can still be overridden by hand. The rounded quantity flows into the sales order and invoice.

name: sale_timesheet_rounded
summary: Rounds timesheet amounts for billing based on the project's rounding unit and method, for example so 5 minutes is billed as 15. Delivered quantities and invoices use the rounded amounts, and entries can be overridden by hand. It is configured on the project form.

name: sale_timesheet_task_exclude
summary: Excludes a task and all the timesheets logged against it from the sales order, which is useful for by-employee billing. Tick Exclude From Billing on the task form.

name: sale_timesheet_timeline
summary: Lets you plan start and end dates and assignees for service lines on sales orders, in a timeline view, and passes them to the tasks created when the order is confirmed. The planning also shows on the customer's portal order view.

name: sale_timesheet_timeline
summary: Lets you plan start and end dates and assignees for service lines on a sales order, using a timeline view. Those dates and people carry over to the task created when the order is confirmed. The plan is also shown to customers on the order portal.

name: sale_transaction_form_link
summary: Adds a button on the sales order form that opens the payment transactions linked to the order. The button appears only when transactions exist.

name: sale_transaction_form_link
summary: Adds a button on the sale order to open the online payment transactions linked to it, when there are any. Use it to check payment attempts for an order without leaving the sale. The button shows a count of transactions.

name: sale_triple_discount
summary: Gives each sales order line three discount fields, applied one after another so each discount is taken from the amount left by the previous one. The Discount on lines group is needed to see them.

name: sale_validity_auto_cancel
summary: Automatically cancels quotations a set number of days after their expiry date, using a daily scheduled action. The number of days is set in Sales settings, and each customer can opt out with the Auto-cancel option on the Sales & Purchase tab.

name: sale_validity_auto_cancel
summary: Automatically cancels quotations once they pass their expiry date plus a set number of days. A scheduled action runs this once a day, and it stays off until the company sets the number of days. A customer-level and order-level flag controls whether a quote is included.

name: sale_variant_configurator
summary: Lets a sales order line use the product configurator, so choosing a product and its attributes creates or selects the matching product variant when the order is confirmed. Variants are picked directly on the sales order lines.

name: sale_variant_configurator
summary: Lets a sales order line use the product configurator, so choosing a product and its attributes creates or selects the matching product variant when the order is confirmed. Variants are picked directly on the sales order lines.

name: sale_variant_configurator
summary: Lets a sales order line use the product configurator, so choosing a product and its attributes creates or selects the matching product variant when the order is confirmed. Variants are picked directly on the sales order lines.

name: sale_variant_configurator
summary: Lets a sales order line use the product configurator, so choosing a product and its attributes creates or selects the matching product variant when the order is confirmed. Variants are picked directly on the sales order lines.

name: sale_warn_option
summary: Adds standard warning options to customers and products that show during sales, such as a blocking message when selling a product. Warnings are picked from a list and set quickly on the customer's internal notes or the product's Sales tab. Sale Warnings is turned on in Sales settings.

name: sale_wishlist
summary: Adds wishlists to customers. A sales manager creates a product set of the wishlist type and assigns it to a partner, who then gets a smart button to view and create more wishlists. It is a base for e-commerce or other wishlist features.

name: sale_wishlist
summary: Adds a wishlist type to product sets, so a customer can have one or more wishlists of products. A wishlist smart button on the customer opens their lists; it can serve as a base for e-commerce or sales use.

name: sales_team_invoiced_target_domain
summary: Lets you choose a domain, in Sales settings, that decides which invoices count toward each sales team's invoiced amount. It is found under the Team Invoiced Domain block.

name: sales_team_invoiced_target_report
summary: Shows invoiced amounts on the sales team kanban cards, based on the invoice domain set in Sales settings, alongside quotations and sales waiting to be invoiced. It is found under CRM > Reporting > Teams.

name: sales_team_operating_unit
summary: Adds an operating unit to each sales team, proposes the user's default operating unit when a team is created, and hides teams from users without access to that unit. It is set on the sales team form.

name: sales_team_operating_unit
summary: Adds an operating unit to each sales team, proposes the user's default operating unit when a team is created, and hides teams from users without access to that unit. It is set on the sales team form.

name: sales_team_security
summary: Adds a User: Team documents group so salespeople see only the contacts, quotations and leads of their own sales team. It also propagates the team to contacts and syncs followers by salesperson; the group is set on the user under the Sale section.

name: sales_team_security
summary: Adds a User: Team documents group so salespeople see only the contacts, quotations and leads of their own sales team. It also propagates the team to contacts and syncs followers by salesperson; the group is set on the user under the Sale section.

name: sales_team_security
summary: Adds a User: Team Documents Only group so salespeople see only the contacts, quotations and leads of their own sales team. It also propagates the team to contacts and syncs followers by salesperson; the group is set on the user under the Sale section.

name: sales_team_security
summary: Adds a Team documents permission for salespeople, so they see only the contacts, quotations and leads that belong to their sales team or have no team. It also keeps followers in sync on company and contact records. Users with own documents only access see just their own contacts.

name: sales_team_security_crm
summary: Glue module that applies the team-based document permissions to CRM leads and opportunities. Users in the team documents group see only the leads of their own team once CRM is installed.

name: sales_team_security_sale
summary: Glue module that applies the team-based permissions to quotations and sales orders, for users in the User: Team Documents Only group. The group is set on the user under the Sales section of the access rights tab.

name: sales_team_security_sale
summary: Glue module that applies the team-based permissions to quotations and sales orders, for users in the User: Team Documents Only group. The group is set on the user under the Sales section of the access rights tab.

name: scheduler_error_mailer
summary: Emails a chosen template when a scheduled action (background job) fails, so administrators learn about errors without checking logs. The error email template is picked on each scheduled action under Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions.

name: scheduler_error_mailer
summary: Emails a chosen template to a contact whenever a scheduled action fails with an error. This lets someone know quickly when an automatic job breaks. The template is picked on each scheduled action under Settings, Technical, Automation, Scheduled Actions.

name: scrap_reason_code
summary: Adds reason codes to scrap orders, each with a fixed scrap location and optional allowed product categories, so every scrap is recorded with a reason. Codes are managed under Inventory > Configuration > Scrap Reason Codes.

name: scrap_reason_code
summary: Adds reason codes for scrapping stock, so each scrap order records why the items were scrapped. The scrap location fills in automatically from the chosen reason; codes are created under Inventory > Configuration > Scrap Reason Codes.

name: search_engine_image_thumbnail
summary: Technical module that generates image thumbnails for records exported to a search engine index, so developers can include thumbnail images in the index. It adds no features by itself, and the thumbnail sizes are set on the search engine backend.

name: search_engine_image_thumbnail
summary: Technical module that generates image thumbnails for records exported to a search engine index, so developers can include thumbnail images in the index. It adds no features by itself, and the thumbnail sizes are set on the search engine backend.

name: search_engine_serializer_pydantic
summary: Technical module that adds a base class for serializers built on Pydantic models, and shows the generated JSON schema on the search index form to document the exported fields. Developers use it when writing search engine serializers.

name: search_engine_serializer_pydantic
summary: Technical module that adds a base class for serializers built on Pydantic models, and shows the generated JSON schema on the search index form to document the exported fields. Developers use it when writing search engine serializers.

name: sell_only_by_packaging
summary: Restricts sales of a product to whole packagings, so a request for 3 units of a product sold in 5-unit cases is rounded up to 5 (and rounded down for returns). Turn on Only sell by packaging on the product and Force sale quantity on the packaging.

name: sell_only_by_packaging
summary: Makes sale lines follow product packaging rules. Products can be restricted to selling only by packaging, and a packaging can force the quantity to round up to its size, so 3 units becomes 5 if packs are 5. Lines that break the rules are blocked. Use it for products that must be sold in full cases.

name: sentry
summary: Sends Odoo server errors and warnings to a Sentry error-tracking service so developers are alerted to problems. It is set up through the Odoo configuration file with a Sentry key. End users see no change.

name: sentry
summary: Technical module that sends Odoo errors and log events at or above a set level to Sentry, an error-tracking service. It is configured in the Odoo configuration file and has no user-facing screens.

name: sentry_client
summary: Sends JavaScript errors from the browser part of Odoo to Sentry, with optional performance tracking and session replay that are off by default. Settings are under Settings, General Settings, Sentry Browser, and individual users can opt out of session replay in their preferences. The Sentry library is included so no outside connection is needed to load it.

name: sequence_check_digit
summary: Adds a check digit to the end of sequence numbers, so typing mistakes in manually entered numbers can be caught. Standard algorithms such as Luhn, Damm and ISO 7064 are available and are chosen on each sequence.

name: sequence_check_digit
summary: Adds a check digit to the end of document numbers so typos can be caught visually or by integrations. Several standard check methods can be chosen on each sequence under Settings, Technical, Sequences. It is useful where numbers are read or typed by hand, such as labels or manual references.

name: sequence_python
summary: Lets a sequence number be calculated from a Python expression, for example to produce alphanumeric numbers, random or UUID-based numbers, or numbers that hide the real count. It is switched on under the Python tab of the sequence.

name: sequence_python
summary: Lets a sequence number be calculated from a Python formula, for example to add separators, use UUIDs, or hide the true count of orders from customers. The formula is entered on the Python tab of a sequence record under Settings, Technical, Sequences. Administrators use it to build custom numbering schemes.

name: sequence_reset_period
summary: Lets document numbers restart on a chosen schedule, such as monthly, weekly or daily, instead of only yearly. The reset period is set on each sequence under Settings, Technical, Sequences. It is useful when numbering needs to restart more often than once a year.

name: sequence_reset_period
summary: Resets sequence numbering monthly, weekly or daily instead of the default yearly reset, for documents that need shorter numbering periods. The reset rule is set on the sequence.

name: server_action_logging
summary: Writes log entries when server actions start and when they finish, with their duration, and can log SQL queries for a chosen action. Developers use it to diagnose slow automations; the only user-facing option is Enable SQL Debug on the server action.

name: server_action_logging
summary: Writes log entries when server actions start and when they finish, with their duration, and can log SQL queries for a chosen action. Developers use it to diagnose slow automations; the only user-facing option is Enable SQL Debug on the server action.

name: server_action_mass_edit
summary: Lets users add, change or remove the value of one or more fields on many records at once from the Action menu. You can set up which fields are editable, the groups allowed to use it, filters, and a warning message in the wizard.

name: server_action_mass_edit
summary: Lets users change the same field on many selected records at once from the Action menu of a list, with a choice to set or remove the value. Admins define which fields can be mass edited through a server action of the new Mass Edit type under Settings, Technical, Server Actions. It saves time when many records need the same change.

name: server_action_mass_edit_onchange
summary: Extends Mass Edit so that automatic field updates, the same ones that fire when a user types on a form, run after a bulk change. This keeps related fields consistent when many records are changed together. It is configured on the mass edit server action.

name: server_action_navigate
summary: Lets users jump from a selection of records to the related records, such as seeing every product sold on a set of sales orders. It appears in the Action menu of list views and is set up under Settings > Technical > Server Actions.

name: server_action_navigate
summary: Adds a Navigate option to server actions on list views, so you can jump from a selection of records to the related records through a field, such as from sale orders to the products on them. It is a technical tool for moving between linked data quickly.

name: server_action_sort
summary: Lets users sort the lines of selected records, such as sales order lines, by chosen criteria from the Action menu, with optional groups allowed to use it. It is set up as a server action on the model.

name: server_action_sort
summary: Lets an admin set up a Sort action so users can reorder the lines of any list, such as sale order lines, by chosen criteria. The action appears in the Action menu of that model's list view after selecting records. It is configured under Settings, Technical, Actions, Server Actions.

name: server_env_printing_server
summary: Reads the printing server address, port, user and password from the server environment configuration instead of the database. It is relevant for IT administrators setting up printing across environments.

name: server_environment
summary: Technical module that lets an Odoo instance read some configuration values from its environment (dev, test, production) and from configuration files, so secrets such as API keys need not sit in the database. Secret values are hidden outside the dev environment, and the values are listed under the Configuration menu.

name: server_environment
summary: Technical module that lets an Odoo instance read some configuration values from its environment (dev, test, production) and from configuration files, so secrets such as API keys need not sit in the database. Secret values are hidden outside the dev environment, and the values are listed under the Configuration menu.

name: server_environment
summary: Technical module that lets an Odoo instance read some configuration values from its environment (dev, test, production) and from configuration files, so secrets such as API keys need not sit in the database. Secret values are hidden outside the dev environment, and the values are listed under the Configuration menu.

name: server_environment_autocreate
summary: Technical module that creates records automatically based on the server environment configuration, for example one record per environment. It has no user interface.

name: server_environment_data_encryption
summary: Technical module that falls back to encrypted values stored in Odoo when a setting is missing from the configuration file, so environment-specific secrets can be managed from production. Each environment needs its own encryption key.

name: server_environment_data_encryption
summary: Technical module that falls back to encrypted values stored in Odoo when a setting is missing from the configuration file, so environment-specific secrets can be managed from production. Each environment needs its own encryption key.

name: server_environment_delivery
summary: Lets shipping methods (delivery carriers) be configured per server environment, for example a different production setting for a carrier. It is set in the configuration file under the delivery carrier section.

name: server_environment_delivery
summary: Lets shipping methods (delivery carriers) be configured per server environment, for example a different production setting for a carrier. It is set in the configuration file under the delivery carrier section.

name: server_environment_ir_config_parameter
summary: Lets system parameters (Settings > Technical > System Parameters) be set from the server environment configuration file, so the file value overrides the one in the database. Administrators use it to keep environment-specific settings out of the database.

name: session_db
summary: Stores user login sessions in a database instead of on the server's disk, which makes it easier to run several Odoo servers behind a load balancer. It is set up through the server configuration and an environment variable. Users notice no difference, but it is useful for scaled hosting.

name: session_db
summary: Technical module that stores user login sessions in the database instead of on the server's file system, which simplifies deployments across several servers. It is enabled in the server-wide modules and needs a database connection setting.

name: shipment_advice
summary: Manages truck loading and unloading through shipment advices: planned shipments with arrival and departure times, dock assignment, and tracking of how much of each transfer and package has been loaded. Users plan, load and unload transfers from the Inventory app.

name: shipment_advice_planner
summary: Lets users plan ready transfers into shipment advices from the Inventory transfers list, grouping them into one shipment advice per warehouse. It is the simple base planning mode.

name: shipment_advice_planner_toursolver
summary: Adds a TourSolver planning method that uses the TourSolver route optimization service to group customer deliveries into the best routes, based on customer locations and available resources. It needs a TourSolver account, API key and resources set up in the Inventory settings.

name: shipment_advice_planner_toursolver_queue_job
summary: Runs TourSolver route calculations in background jobs, so planning does not hold up the screen while the routes are computed. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: shopfloor
summary: Back end for the Shopfloor barcode scanner app for warehouse work: it provides the REST APIs for scenarios such as cluster picking, zone picking, checkout and packing, and delivery, configured per operation type. Warehouse staff use it through a handheld scanner front end, so a front end app is needed on top.

name: shopfloor
summary: Back end for the Shopfloor barcode scanner app for warehouse work: it provides the REST APIs for scenarios such as cluster picking, zone picking, checkout and packing, and delivery, configured per operation type. Warehouse staff use it through a handheld scanner front end, so a front end app is needed on top.

name: shopfloor_base
summary: Core back end of the Shopfloor scanner app: defines the apps, menus, profiles and scenarios that the scanner screens use, and provides the REST API. It is set up under the Shopfloor menu in Inventory and has no screens of its own for regular users.

name: shopfloor_base
summary: Core back end of the Shopfloor scanner app: defines the apps, menus, profiles and scenarios that the scanner screens use, and provides the REST API. It is set up under the Shopfloor menu in Inventory and has no screens of its own for regular users.

name: shopfloor_batch_automatic_creation
summary: When a picker taps Get Work on the scanner and no batch is available, a cluster picking batch is created for them automatically. The Shopfloor menu sets the limits: maximum transfers, weight and volume per batch, grouping by customer, and whether creation is on at all.

name: shopfloor_batch_automatic_creation
summary: When a picker taps Get Work on the scanner and no batch is available, a cluster picking batch is created for them automatically. The Shopfloor menu sets the limits: maximum transfers, weight and volume per batch, grouping by customer, and whether creation is on at all.

name: shopfloor_checkout_sync
summary: Synchronizes the destination location with the first scanned move line, for cluster picking, location content transfer and zone picking. It is a glue module that takes effect for operation types with Checkout Sync turned on.

name: shopfloor_cluster_picking_repack
summary: Adds a Pack pickings option to the cluster picking scanner scenario, so operators pack items from the same order into a package while picking several orders together. The package is created in the background as the destination of the moves.

name: shopfloor_cluster_picking_repack_mobile
summary: Adds the packing step of cluster picking to the Shopfloor mobile scanner app. It is the screens part only; the logic comes from the cluster picking repack module.

name: shopfloor_dangerous_goods
summary: Glue module between Shopfloor and the dangerous goods module, so scanner flows handle dangerous goods products. It has no visible feature of its own.

name: shopfloor_dangerous_goods_mobile
summary: Shows the limited quantity label on stock move lines and packages that contain dangerous goods, in the Shopfloor mobile scanner app. Scanner users see the warning while handling those items.

name: shopfloor_delivery_shipment
summary: Adds a delivery-with-shipment-advice scenario to the scanner app, so staff can plan and manage shipment advices for outgoing deliveries. An option on each Shopfloor menu controls whether shipment advice creation is allowed.

name: shopfloor_delivery_shipment_mobile
summary: Adds the mobile screens for the delivery shipment scenario in the Shopfloor scanner app. It is the front end part only; the logic comes from the delivery shipment module.

name: shopfloor_example
summary: Technical example showing how a developer can build a custom scanner scenario on top of the Shopfloor frontend. It is hidden from users and meant as a reference, not for production use.

name: shopfloor_gs1
summary: Lets the Shopfloor Scan action read GS1 barcodes, such as those carrying lot, expiry or quantity data, and find the matching Odoo record. It uses the biip library to decode the code.

name: shopfloor_gs1
summary: Lets the Shopfloor Scan action read GS1 barcodes, such as those carrying lot, expiry or quantity data, and find the matching Odoo record. It uses the biip library to decode the code.

name: shopfloor_mobile
summary: The handheld scanner screens for Shopfloor: operators log in with an API key, choose a profile, and work through scenarios such as receiving, picking and delivery from the main menu. It is set up under Inventory > Configuration > Shopfloor.

name: shopfloor_mobile
summary: The handheld scanner screens for Shopfloor: operators log in with an API key, choose a profile, and work through scenarios such as receiving, picking and delivery from the main menu. It is set up under Inventory > Configuration > Shopfloor.

name: shopfloor_mobile_base
summary: Base mobile front end for Shopfloor scanner apps, providing the login, profile selection and scenario menus that other scanner apps build on. Operators reach it from Inventory > Configuration > Shopfloor.

name: shopfloor_mobile_base
summary: Base mobile front end for Shopfloor scanner apps, providing the login, profile selection and scenario menus that other scanner apps build on. Operators reach it from Inventory > Configuration > Shopfloor.

name: shopfloor_mobile_base_auth_api_key
summary: Lets scanner app users log in with an API key. The allowed API key groups are set on each Shopfloor app, and this is the login method used by the mobile scanner app.

name: shopfloor_product_dimension
summary: Adds product length, height, width, weight and dimensional unit to the product details shown in scanner flows, so staff see sizes while picking or packing.

name: shopfloor_product_expiry_assign
summary: Adds an Ignore expiration date option to Shopfloor menus, so scanner workers can reserve goods from expired lots in supported scenarios such as location content transfer. A company-wide setting does the same everywhere.

name: shopfloor_product_manufacturer
summary: Shows the product's manufacturer in the product details of the Shopfloor scanner app. It is a glue module between Shopfloor and the product manufacturer module.

name: shopfloor_reception
summary: Adds a receiving flow to the Shopfloor warehouse app, so warehouse staff can receive goods against an incoming transfer and pack them into the right logistic units. It also adds a 'scheduled today' filter option to the Shopfloor menu configuration. It is a scenario of the Shopfloor scanner app rather than a separate screen in Odoo.

name: shopfloor_reception
summary: Adds a receiving flow to the Shopfloor warehouse app, so warehouse staff can receive goods against an incoming transfer and pack them into the right logistic units. It also adds a 'scheduled today' filter option to the Shopfloor menu configuration. It is a scenario of the Shopfloor scanner app rather than a separate screen in Odoo.

name: shopfloor_reception_add_packaging
summary: Lets a warehouse worker create a new packaging for a product, such as a new box or case size, while receiving goods in Shopfloor, instead of leaving the receiving task to set it up in Odoo first. The option is switched on from the Shopfloor menu configuration. It extends the Shopfloor receiving flow.

name: shopfloor_reception_add_packaging_mobile
summary: Adds a 'create new packaging' button to the quantity screen of the handheld Shopfloor receiving flow. Workers can add a packaging from the barcode device while entering how much they received. It is the mobile front end for the add packaging feature.

name: shopfloor_reception_dock
summary: Adds dock information to the Shopfloor receiving flow, so receipts can be tied to the dock door they are being unloaded at. It depends on the Stock Picking Dock module, which provides the dock assignment on transfers. Technical glue between the two; the dock itself is set up outside the scanner app.

name: shopfloor_reception_dock_mobile
summary: Shows the dock on the receipt cards in the handheld Shopfloor app, so workers can see where a receipt is meant to be unloaded. It is the mobile front end for the Shopfloor dock feature. Only the cards in the mobile receiving list are affected.

name: shopfloor_reception_grn
summary: Lets a warehouse worker find a receipt by scanning its GRN (goods received note) in the Shopfloor app, instead of browsing or searching for it. It depends on the Stock GRN module, which provides the GRN reference. Works as a scenario step on the scanner app.

name: shopfloor_reception_grn_mobile
summary: Shows the GRN number on the receipt cards in the handheld Shopfloor receiving screens, so workers can match a physical goods received note to the right receipt. It is the mobile front end for the GRN feature.

name: shopfloor_reception_helpdesk
summary: Lets warehouse workers raise a Helpdesk ticket from the Shopfloor receiving flow, for example to report a problem with a delivery. Each receiving operation type is set to use a Helpdesk team, and the ticket reasons ('motives') are defined in the Helpdesk configuration. It depends on the Helpdesk Management stock integration.

name: shopfloor_reception_helpdesk_mobile
summary: Adds the handheld screens for creating Helpdesk tickets during a receipt in the Shopfloor app. Workers can record an issue from the barcode device without going back to a desktop. It is the mobile front end for the receiving helpdesk feature.

name: shopfloor_reception_measuring_device
summary: Lets workers measure a package during receiving with a measuring device such as a Zippcube or Cubiscan, instead of typing dimensions by hand. The measured values are used in the packaging dimension step of the Shopfloor receiving flow. It is a glue module between the packaging dimension and Stock Measuring Device modules.

name: shopfloor_reception_measuring_device_mobile
summary: Adds the handheld screens for using a measuring device, such as a Zippcube or Cubiscan, during the packaging dimension step of receiving. Workers can take measurements on the barcode device while receiving. It is the mobile front end for the measuring device feature.

name: shopfloor_reception_mobile
summary: Handheld version of the Shopfloor receiving flow. Workers receive products and create the packs for each logistic unit from a barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the receiving scenario.

name: shopfloor_reception_mobile
summary: Handheld version of the Shopfloor receiving flow. Workers receive products and create the packs for each logistic unit from a barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the receiving scenario.

name: shopfloor_reception_package_dimension
summary: On the destination step of the Shopfloor receiving flow, asks the worker to check and, if needed, change the package height. The new value is saved when the destination location is scanned. It depends on the Stock Quant Package Dimension module, which stores the dimensions on the package.

name: shopfloor_reception_package_dimension_mobile
summary: Handheld version of the package height step on the destination screen of the Shopfloor receiving flow. Workers can check and change the package height from the barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the package dimension feature.

name: shopfloor_reception_packaging_dimension
summary: Adds an optional step to the Shopfloor receiving flow. Before quantities are entered, each packaging of the received product is checked for missing data, and the worker is asked to fill it in. The data asked for (length, width, height, weight, barcode) is chosen per packaging level, and the step is switched on from the Shopfloor menu.

name: shopfloor_reception_packaging_dimension_mobile
summary: Handheld screens for filling in missing packaging dimensions during receiving. When the option is enabled on the Shopfloor menu, workers see the packaging data prompts on the barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the packaging dimension step.

name: shopfloor_reception_packaging_dimension_mobile
summary: Handheld screens for filling in missing packaging dimensions during receiving. When the option is enabled on the Shopfloor menu, workers see the packaging data prompts on the barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the packaging dimension step.

name: shopfloor_reception_product_barcode
summary: Adds an optional step to the Shopfloor receiving flow. If a received product has no barcode, the worker is asked to scan one, and it is saved on the product before quantities are entered. GS1 barcodes are parsed to pull out the EAN when the Shopfloor GS1 module is installed.

name: shopfloor_reception_product_barcode_mobile
summary: Handheld screen that lets workers set a product barcode during receiving when the product has none. It is the mobile front end for the product barcode step, enabled from the Shopfloor menu. The barcode is saved on the product being processed.

name: shopfloor_reception_putinpack_restriction
summary: Hides the package actions in the Shopfloor receiving flow for receipt types that do not use packages, which keeps the scanner screens simpler. Whether a receipt type uses packages is set on its operation type. Useful for administrators who want a leaner receiving screen.

name: shopfloor_reception_refund_return
summary: A small technical link that marks returns created from the Shopfloor flow as 'to refund'. When a return move is created in the scanner app, the flag is set on it, so refund handling can pick it up. It depends on the Stock Account module, and it adds no screens of its own.

name: shopfloor_reception_vendor_packaging
summary: Adds receiving-specific handling for vendor packagings (supplier-defined packs) in the Shopfloor receiving flow, building on the Shopfloor vendor packaging module. It is a technical glue module with no separate screen of its own. The behavior it adds only shows up when the receiving scenario is used.

name: shopfloor_rest_log
summary: Adds a 'Shopfloor / Logs' shortcut that opens the REST request log, so Shopfloor managers can see the calls the mobile app makes to Odoo and any errors they produce. Each log entry also records the app version and the real user behind the call. It is a technical tool for support and troubleshooting.

name: shopfloor_rest_log
summary: Adds a 'Shopfloor / Logs' shortcut that opens the REST request log, so Shopfloor managers can see the calls the mobile app makes to Odoo and any errors they produce. Each log entry also records the app version and the real user behind the call. It is a technical tool for support and troubleshooting.

name: shopfloor_single_product_transfer
summary: Lets a worker move a single product, or a lot of it, from one location to another in the Shopfloor scanner app, without creating a full transfer. The worker picks a source location, then a product or lot in it, then the destination. Which locations are allowed depends on how the scenario is configured.

name: shopfloor_single_product_transfer_mobile
summary: Handheld version of the single product transfer screens, for moving one product or lot between locations on a barcode device. It is the mobile front end for the single product transfer scenario in Shopfloor.

name: shopfloor_vendor_packaging
summary: Adds a Shopfloor setting that hides vendor packagings (supplier-defined packs) from the scanner screens, so workers only see the packagings they actually use. The option is found on the Shopfloor menu configuration. It depends on the Product Packaging Level Vendor module.

name: shopfloor_workstation
summary: Lets you set up workstations, named stations with a barcode, under Inventory / Configuration / Shopfloor / Workstations. A worker scans the workstation barcode in the mobile app to load its settings, such as a Shopfloor profile and a default printer. Useful for quick setup of a scanner app user.

name: shopfloor_workstation
summary: Lets you set up workstations, named stations with a barcode, under Inventory / Configuration / Shopfloor / Workstations. A worker scans the workstation barcode in the mobile app to load its settings, such as a Shopfloor profile and a default printer. Useful for quick setup of a scanner app user.

name: shopfloor_workstation_label_printer
summary: Sets a default label printer on each Shopfloor workstation, so labels print to the right printer when a worker scans that station in the mobile app. The printer is chosen on the workstation record under Inventory / Configuration / Shopfloor / Workstations. It depends on the base label printer module.

name: shopfloor_workstation_mobile
summary: The handheld side of workstations: a worker scans a workstation barcode under Settings in the mobile Shopfloor app to sync their settings to that station. It is the mobile front end for the Shopfloor workstation module.

name: shopify_connector
summary: Connects one or more Shopify stores to Odoo 19 Community. It keeps products, stock levels, customers, orders, returns, refunds and fulfillments in sync, and it has a Shopify dashboard under the Shopify menu showing sync status, errors and webhook health. Setup happens under Shopify > Configuration > Instances, where a store is onboarded with its API token and webhook secret.

name: shopify_connector
summary: Connects one or more Shopify stores to Odoo 18 Community. It keeps products, stock levels, customers, orders, returns, refunds and fulfillments in sync, and it has a Shopify dashboard under the Shopify menu showing sync status, errors and webhook health. Setup happens under Shopify > Configuration > Instances, where a store is onboarded with its API token and webhook secret.

name: shopify_connector_account
summary: Adds Shopify Payments accounting on top of the Shopify connector. Payouts from Shopify are imported, with their fees, disputes, gift card liability and currency differences, and turned into journal entries that must balance before posting. Set up per Shopify instance under the instance's financial configuration.

name: shopify_connector_pos
summary: Imports Shopify point-of-sale orders into Odoo as regular sale orders, keeping the retail location, cash rounding and exchange details. Each Shopify retail location is mapped to an Odoo warehouse. POS orders show up in the normal Shopify order list, with filters for POS orders and pending POS orders.

name: sign_oca
summary: Lets users prepare PDF documents for electronic signature inside Odoo, with fields placed on the page for each signer. Templates and signature roles are set up under Sign, and requests can be sent to any record, such as a contact, with signed copies kept on the record. Signers sign in the portal and every access is logged.

name: slow_statement_logger
summary: A technical tool that logs SQL queries which take longer than a set time to the Odoo log, for people who cannot read the PostgreSQL log. It is set in the Odoo configuration file, and it can expose confidential data in the log, so it should be used with care. Nothing changes for end users.

name: sms_alternative_provider
summary: Technical base module that lets Odoo use several SMS providers, with each one restricted to certain country or area codes, so different countries can be sent through different providers. Providers are set up under Settings > Technical > Phone/SMS > SMS providers. On its own it sends nothing; it is for developers building an SMS provider.

name: sms_dummy_provider
summary: Adds a fake SMS provider for testing SMS flows without sending real messages. You choose the result a test message should end with, and sent messages appear in a Results field on the gateway record under Settings > Technical > Phone/SMS > SMS providers. Only useful in test or demo databases.

name: sms_messagebird
summary: Adds MessageBird as an SMS provider, so Odoo can send text messages through a MessageBird account. Enter the MessageBird API key on a gateway of type MessageBird under Settings > Technical > Phone/SMS > SMS providers. The module adds the provider option only; the messages go out through the MessageBird service.

name: sms_no_automatic_delete
summary: Keeps sent SMS messages in the database instead of letting Odoo delete them automatically, and deletes them only after a set number of days. The retention period is the SMS Purge Days setting, found under General Settings > Contacts, with 90 days as the default. The state of a saved SMS is set to sent once it goes out.

name: sms_no_automatic_delete
summary: Keeps sent SMS messages in the database instead of letting Odoo delete them automatically, and deletes them only after a set number of days. The retention period is set by the SMS Purge cron job, with 90 days as the default. The state of a saved SMS is set to sent once it goes out.

name: sms_ovh_http
summary: Lets Odoo send SMS through the OVH HTTP SMS service instead of Odoo's default SMS provider. The OVH account details (SMS account, API user, password and sender name) are entered on an IAP account set to the SMS OVH HTTP provider under Settings > Technical > IAP Account. Failed sends store their error detail on the SMS record.

name: sms_twilio
summary: Lets Odoo send SMS through Twilio instead of Odoo's default SMS provider. Twilio credentials and phone numbers are entered on an IAP account set to Twilio under Settings > Technical > IAP Account, with a separate test account option. Failed sends keep their error detail on the SMS record.

name: social_media_advertising
summary: Adds paid advertising to the Social Media app: campaign groups, campaigns, tags, and a list of the ads served by each connected social network. Each social network keeps its own campaigns and stage names, and the advertising accounts are fetched from the social network under Social Media > Configuration > Accounts. It builds on Social Media Base and is used by the platform connectors.

name: social_media_advertising_linkedin
summary: Connects LinkedIn Ads to the Social Media Advertising features, so LinkedIn campaign groups, campaigns and sponsored creatives can be created from Odoo or imported from LinkedIn. LinkedIn status values such as Draft, Active and Paused appear as stages. The LinkedIn menus live under Social Media > Advertising and Configuration > Stages.

name: social_media_base
summary: The foundation of the Social Media app: linked social accounts, scheduled posts that go to several accounts, a dashboard of published posts with their figures, and daily statistics per account. Social accounts are linked under Social Media > Configuration > Accounts, and posts are created from the dashboard's Add Post button. It does not connect to any network by itself, so it needs a connector module to publish.

name: social_media_calendar
summary: Adds a calendar view to the Social Media Posts menu, so posts are shown on the day they are planned and coloured by their state. Clicking a post opens a short popover, and draft posts can be edited from there. It is installed automatically with Social Media Base and needs no setup.

name: social_media_linkedin
summary: Lets Odoo publish posts, with images or a video, to LinkedIn company pages that the user administers, and keeps the daily page figures. Only company pages are supported, not personal profiles. Posts created in Odoo appear under Social Media > Posts, and LinkedIn account credentials are entered on the social account.

name: social_media_linkedin_sync
summary: Imports the posts a LinkedIn company page has already published, along with each post's figures, comments and reactions, so they appear in Odoo. It also finds posts that were deleted on LinkedIn. Import runs from the Update button on the social dashboard and the scheduled sync actions, and it needs no extra setup.

name: social_media_sync
summary: Imports the posts an account has already published on its social network, with each post's figures, comments and reactions, so they can be reviewed in Odoo. It adds the full post list, its search filters and the post form, and runs an initial import when a new account is linked. It is kept separate because it makes many calls that grow with account history.

name: spreadsheet_dashboard_oca
summary: Lets dashboard editors build and edit Odoo dashboards with the OCA spreadsheet editor, instead of the standard one. Dashboards are created from a spreadsheet, given a section, and limited to chosen user groups, under the Dashboards app. It is a technical extension for dashboard configuration.

name: spreadsheet_dashboard_oca
summary: Lets dashboard editors build and edit Odoo dashboards with the OCA spreadsheet editor, instead of the standard one. It adds the dashboard activation and import options to the dashboard setup under the Dashboards app. It is a technical extension for dashboard configuration.

name: spreadsheet_dashboard_oca
summary: Lets dashboard editors build and edit Odoo dashboards with the OCA spreadsheet editor. It also adds a Share button on each dashboard, where share links can be listed, copied and revoked. Users can manage their own shares, and dashboard admins can manage everyone's.

name: spreadsheet_dashboard_purchase_oca
summary: A hidden technical module that adds a spreadsheet dashboard for vendors (purchasing) to the Dashboards app. It has no description of its own beyond its title, so the exact figures shown come from the spreadsheet itself. It depends on the Purchase app.

name: spreadsheet_dashboard_purchase_stock_oca
summary: A hidden technical module that adds a spreadsheet dashboard for purchases, combining purchasing with stock, to the Dashboards app. It has no description beyond its title, so the exact figures come from the spreadsheet itself. It builds on the vendor purchase dashboard and the Purchase Stock module.

name: spreadsheet_oca
summary: Adds a spreadsheet editor to Odoo Community, so users can create and edit spreadsheets with formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE, and share them with other users or groups. Spreadsheets are kept under the Spreadsheet menu, and they can be filled with Odoo data. It is an alternative to the Enterprise spreadsheet edition.

name: spreadsheet_oca
summary: Adds a spreadsheet editor to Odoo Community, so users can create and edit spreadsheets with formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE, and share them with other users or groups. Spreadsheets are kept under the Spreadsheet menu, and they can be filled with Odoo data. It is an alternative to the Enterprise spreadsheet edition.

name: spreadsheet_quotation
summary: Lets a quotation template carry a spreadsheet calculator for pricing. When a sales order is created from that template, the calculator is copied to the order and shows only that order's lines, and columns can be mapped back to the order lines. The calculator is created from the Quotation Calculator field on Sales > Configuration > Quotation Templates.

name: sql_export
summary: Lets administrators export the results of a read-only SQL query to a CSV file from the Dashboards menu, using parameters such as the current company or user. Queries can only read data, and each export records when and by whom it was last run. It is a base for other export options.

name: sql_export
summary: Lets users export the result of a read-only SQL query to a CSV file, from the Dashboards menu under SQL Export. The query can use placeholders for the current company and user, and it cannot change data. Intended for technical users or analysts who need data that the standard reports do not show.

name: sql_export_delta
summary: Extends SQL exports so they can output only the rows that changed since the previous run, rather than the full data set. It is turned on per export with a Delta checkbox while the export is still in draft. Useful for syncing data to other systems without resending everything.

name: sql_export_excel
summary: Extends SQL Export so the query result can be saved as an Excel file. A template Excel file can also be attached to a query, and the data is then written into a chosen sheet and position, which is handy when the workbook already holds calculations. Configured on each SQL export query under the Dashboards menu.

name: sql_export_excel
summary: Lets a SQL export produce an Excel file instead of CSV, and can fill an existing Excel template so the Odoo data lands in a chosen sheet and cell position. This is useful when the spreadsheet holds calculations that depend on Odoo data. The template is stored as an attachment on the export.

name: sql_export_mail
summary: Emails the result of a SQL export to chosen users on a schedule. Each export has a list of users to notify, and a scheduled action controls when the email goes out. Several exports can share one scheduled action.

name: sql_export_mail
summary: Lets a SQL export query be emailed as a CSV file to chosen users on a schedule. Each query has its own users to notify, and a scheduled action (cron) sends the file at the times you set. Configured on the SQL export query itself under the Dashboards menu.

name: sql_request_abstract
summary: Technical base that provides a shared way to store and run read-only SQL queries, with draft and valid states and access limited by group or user. It is a building block for other modules such as SQL Export and BI SQL Editor, and can run against an external database configured on the server. End users do not use it directly.

name: sql_request_abstract
summary: A technical base for other modules that need saved, read-only SQL queries. It provides query records with draft and valid states, access by user or group, and a block on tables that hold secrets. It adds no screens by itself, and it can optionally run queries on an external database set in the server configuration.

name: sql_request_abstract
summary: A technical base for other modules that need saved, read-only SQL queries. It provides query records with draft and valid states, access by user or group, and a block on tables that hold secrets. It adds no screens by itself and is used by modules such as SQL Export.

name: srm
summary: Turns the CRM pipeline into a supplier relationship tool. Leads can come from supplier requests as well as customer ones, and a supplier lead can be converted into a Request for Quotation or purchase order. Purchase counts and amounts show on the lead, and the flow runs from the CRM app.

name: stay
summary: Manages guest stays at a lodging or community house, with rooms, dormitories and beds, and tracks the meals each guest needs (breakfast, lunch, picnic, dinner and bed nights). Guest stays are registered under the Stays menu, a daily journal is generated for the kitchen and printed as a report, and room bookings are checked for capacity. Built for French abbeys.

name: stay
summary: Manages guest stays at a lodging or community house, with rooms, dormitories and beds, and tracks the meals each guest needs (breakfast, lunch, picnic, dinner and bed nights). Guest stays are registered under the Stays menu, a daily journal is generated for the kitchen and printed as a report, and room bookings are checked for capacity. Built for French abbeys.

name: stay_api
summary: Provides a web API so a form on the website can create a new draft stay in Odoo when a guest submits it. The guest's name, contact details and message are stored on the stay, and the stay type and default company are set in configuration. Intended for technical integration, not for end users.

name: stay_report_py3o
summary: Replaces the standard stay journal report with a Py3o version that has a cleaner layout. The printed paper is the same report the kitchen uses, now generated from a template. Users print it from the same Stays reports menu as before.

name: stay_report_py3o
summary: Replaces the standard stay journal report with a Py3o version that has a cleaner layout. The printed paper is the same report the kitchen uses, now generated from a template. Users print it from the same Stays reports menu as before.

name: stock_account_anglo_saxon_cogs_kit
summary: For companies using Anglo-Saxon (perpetual) accounting, lets kit products stay as consumables while the cost of goods sold still posts correctly on invoices. Without it, Odoo's guidance is to make kits storable, which means tracking their stock quantities. Applies to sales and manufacturing kits and affects accounting entries, not stock levels.

name: stock_account_change_qty_reason
summary: Lets each stock quantity change reason, such as damage or count correction, post to its own accounting account for stock valuation. Accounts are set on the preset reason under Inventory > Configuration > Inventory Adjustment Reasons. It applies both to the product quantity wizard and to inventory adjustments, so write-offs hit the right ledger accounts.

name: stock_account_invoice_report_lot_expiry
summary: Adds an Expiration Date column to the lots table on printed customer invoices, so the customer can see the expiry of each lot or serial number they were invoiced for. The column appears when lots are shown on invoices and the product is tracked by lots with expiry dates. It only changes the invoice printout.

name: stock_account_move_reset_to_draft
summary: Lets a vendor bill be reset to draft even when it has already created a stock valuation adjustment, such as when the bill price differs from the receipt price and the received stock has not been used yet. The module creates the reversing valuation entry needed when the bill goes back to draft. Useful when a supplier bill needs correcting after it has been confirmed.

name: stock_account_move_reset_to_draft
summary: Lets a vendor bill be reset to draft even when a valuation difference was created against a receipt whose stock has not yet been consumed. On reset, Odoo creates an offsetting stock valuation entry that reverses the price difference. It is useful for products using average cost or FIFO costing.

name: stock_account_product_run_fifo_hook
summary: Technical hook in the FIFO cost calculation, so other modules can change what is stored on FIFO candidates. It is developer-facing and has no screens.

name: stock_account_product_run_fifo_hook
summary: A developer-only extension that adds hook points into the FIFO costing calculation for products, so custom modules can store extra information on FIFO candidates. Nothing changes for users until another module uses these hooks. It is a technical base for custom valuation logic.

name: stock_account_product_run_fifo_hook
summary: A developer-only extension that adds hook points into the FIFO costing calculation for products, for Odoo 19, where valuation moved from valuation layers to stock moves. Custom modules can read FIFO candidate moves, enrich them, and control the standard price update. It adds nothing for users until another module uses these hooks.

name: stock_account_quantity_history_location
summary: A small technical link that makes the stock quantity history report work with both the location filter and accounting valuation. It adds no fields or screens of its own. Users see the combined behavior on the quantity history report under the Inventory reports menu.

name: stock_account_show_automatic_valuation
summary: Shows the Automatic Valuation option in Inventory settings for Community edition, where Odoo hid it. It lets you choose automated inventory valuation for stock movements.

name: stock_account_valuation_discrepancy_adjust
summary: Adds a wizard that compares inventory value in stock with the value in accounting for each product, and shows where they do not match. From the wizard, an accounting adjustment entry can be posted to clear the difference. It is meant for companies whose stock valuation is linked to accounting, and it builds on the Valuation Report module.

name: stock_account_valuation_report
summary: Changes the Dual Inventory Valuation report under Inventory > Reporting so each product's quantity and value are shown separately for the inventory side and the accounting side. This makes it possible to see where stock and accounting disagree. It is for companies using perpetual (automated) inventory valuation.

name: stock_account_valuation_report
summary: Changes the Dual Inventory Valuation report under Inventory > Reporting so each product's quantity and value are shown separately for the inventory side and the accounting side. This makes it possible to see where stock and accounting disagree. It is for companies using perpetual (automated) inventory valuation.

name: stock_analytic
summary: Adds an Analytic Distribution field to stock moves, so warehouse movements can carry analytic accounts such as a project or department. When a move creates journal items, those items get the analytic split. Set up per analytic plan under Invoicing > Configuration > Analytic Plans by enabling Stock Move.

name: stock_analytic_rule
summary: Automatically creates analytic lines when stock moves between chosen locations, using rules set per source and destination. The amount can come from the product list price or from a formula on the product category (average price, weight and a supplement). Rules and category values are set under Inventory > Configuration.

name: stock_archive_constraint
summary: Stops a product or a storage location from being archived while it still has stock quants or stock moves. The archive action is blocked with an error instead of silently hiding stock. Applies to the Products and Inventory Locations screens.

name: stock_archive_constraint
summary: Stops products and storage locations from being archived while they still have stock or related transactions. Users see an error explaining why archiving is blocked. It is part of the warehouse setup and applies to the Products and Locations screens.

name: stock_auto_move
summary: Lets a stock move be processed automatically as soon as the products are in its source location, instead of someone validating it by hand. Moves can be flagged automatic on a procurement rule, and chained moves are triggered by the previous step or by the scheduler. Automatic moves are grouped under a procurement group named 'Automatic'.

name: stock_auto_move
summary: Lets a stock move be processed automatically as soon as the products are in its source location, instead of someone validating it by hand. Moves can be flagged automatic on a procurement rule, and chained moves are triggered by the previous step or by the scheduler. Automatic moves are grouped under a procurement group named 'Automatic'.

name: stock_available
summary: Adds an 'Available for sale' quantity to each product, based on the projected stock and optionally on incoming goods, pending sales quotations or production capacity. The figure appears on the product form, and the calculation options are chosen under Inventory > Configuration > Settings. By default it is the forecast (virtual) stock.

name: stock_available
summary: Adds an 'Available for sale' quantity to each product, based on the projected stock and optionally on incoming goods, pending sales quotations or production capacity. The figure appears on the product form, and the calculation options are chosen under Inventory > Configuration > Settings. By default it is the forecast (virtual) stock.

name: stock_available_base_exclude_location
summary: A technical base module that lets other modules mark locations to leave out when calculating product availability. It adds no screens of its own. Developers use it to build exclusion features on top of stock availability.

name: stock_available_base_exclude_location
summary: A technical base module that lets other modules mark locations to leave out when calculating product availability. It adds no screens of its own. Developers use it to build exclusion features on top of stock availability.

name: stock_available_exclude_location
summary: Lets you pick locations under Inventory > Configuration > Settings that should not count toward product availability, such as a quarantine or damaged-goods area. The chosen locations and their sub-locations are left out of the available quantity. It builds on the availability exclusion base module.

name: stock_available_immediately
summary: Changes the available-to-promise quantity so that planned incoming receipts are not counted, only the stock that is actually on hand (less what is already promised). This gives a stricter figure for what can be sold right now. It is a technical variant of the stock available module, and it adds no screens of its own.

name: stock_available_immediately
