summary: Changes the available-to-promise quantity so that planned incoming receipts are not counted, only the stock that is actually on hand (less what is already promised). This gives a stricter figure for what can be sold right now. It is a technical variant of the stock available module, and it adds no screens of its own.

name: stock_available_immediately_exclude_location
summary: Adds a checkbox on each stock location to leave it out of the immediately usable quantity. Tagged locations, such as quarantine or damaged areas, then stop counting toward the figure that can be sold right away. It is set on the location form under Inventory > Configuration > Locations.

name: stock_available_immediately_exclude_location
summary: Adds a checkbox on each stock location to leave it out of the immediately usable quantity. Tagged locations, such as quarantine or damaged areas, then stop counting toward the figure that can be sold right away. It is set on the location form under Inventory > Configuration > Locations.

name: stock_available_location_get_domain
summary: A technical helper that lets developers get a stock location filter that behaves the same way as the product availability calculation. It adds no screens or fields for users. Used by other availability modules.

name: stock_available_location_get_domain
summary: A technical helper that lets developers get a stock location filter that behaves the same way as the product availability calculation. It adds no screens or fields for users. Used by other availability modules.

name: stock_available_mrp
summary: Counts the production potential, meaning how many units could be manufactured from the components on hand, in the available-to-promise quantity of a product. The basis can be set to other product quantities, such as components available to promise. It needs the Manufacturing app and is configured under Inventory > Configuration > Settings.

name: stock_available_mrp
summary: Counts the production potential, meaning how many units could be manufactured from the components on hand, in the available-to-promise quantity of a product. The basis can be set to other product quantities, such as components available to promise. It needs the Manufacturing app and is configured under Inventory > Configuration > Settings.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Lets warehouse staff release delivery orders in any chosen order without giving the stock to whoever was released first. Each delivery move reserves the quantity promised to the customer, so the first-come, first-served rule and FEFO/FIFO removal are applied correctly. Chained moves are released by hand from Inventory > Operations > Stock Allocation, and the feature is turned on per route.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release
summary: Lets warehouse staff release delivery orders in any chosen order without giving the stock to whoever was released first. Each delivery move reserves the quantity promised to the customer, so the first-come, first-served rule and FEFO/FIFO removal are applied correctly. Chained moves are released by hand from Inventory > Operations > Stock Allocation, and the feature is turned on per route.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_block
summary: Lets users block a delivery so it cannot be released yet, and unblock it later, using buttons on the transfer. A route option can also block a backorder automatically when the goods to deliver are not available. It extends the release feature in Inventory > Operations > Stock Allocation.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_carrier_alternative
summary: When a delivery order is released, lets the system switch to an alternative shipping method if the preferred one does not fit, such as when the parcel is over the carrier's weight or volume limit. Alternative carriers are listed on each delivery method, and extra rules can be added to its picking domain. It is an add-on to the delivery release feature.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_delivery
summary: A small glue module that keeps the delivery route correct when the shipping method of an unreleased delivery order is changed. The moves then follow the route that the new delivery method expects. It adds no screens of its own and works with the stock release feature.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_dynamic_routing
summary: A technical glue module between the stock release feature and dynamic routing. At present it only contains tests that confirm the two work together, so end users see no change. It is for developers and the implementers of these modules.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_dynamic_routing
summary: A technical glue module between the stock release feature and dynamic routing. At present it only contains tests that confirm the two work together, so end users see no change. It is for developers and the implementers of these modules.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_exclude_location
summary: A glue module that makes the release feature respect the locations marked as excluded from available stock. Those locations do not count when deciding whether a delivery can be released. It adds no screens; the location flag is set as in the exclusion modules.

name: stock_available_to_promise_release_exclude_location
summary: A glue module that makes the release feature respect the locations marked as excluded from available stock. Those locations do not count when deciding whether a delivery can be released. It adds no screens; the location flag is set as in the exclusion modules.

name: stock_available_unreserved
summary: Shows the 'Free to Use' quantity, meaning on-hand stock not already reserved for another operation, on product templates and in all product views. A flag on stock quants marks lines that contain unreserved stock, and a button opens those quants from the product form. It helps spot products at risk of a stock-out.

name: stock_available_unreserved
summary: Shows the 'Free to Use' quantity, meaning on-hand stock not already reserved for another operation, on product templates and in all product views. A flag on stock quants marks lines that contain unreserved stock, and a button opens those quants from the product form. It helps spot products at risk of a stock-out.

name: stock_average_daily_sale
summary: Calculates the average daily consumption of each product from past stock moves, by ABC class and location, and suggests a recommended reorder quantity that includes a safety stock. Settings are made under Inventory > Configuration > Average daily sales computation parameters, and results appear in a report. It can skip weekends, and it builds on the ABC classification module.

name: stock_barcodes
summary: Adds a barcode scanning screen for stock operations such as receipts, deliveries and inventory counts, so warehouse users can scan products, lots and locations instead of typing. Scan actions and options are set under the Barcodes menu and per operation type. It is the base scanning interface that other barcode modules extend.

name: stock_barcodes
summary: Adds a barcode scanning screen for receipts, deliveries, internal transfers, relocations and inventory adjustments, working with USB or Bluetooth scanners in any desktop or mobile browser. It can run in free or guided mode, shows stock by location in a product information dialog, and recognizes product, packaging, lot, package and location barcodes. Barcode behavior is set per operation type under the Barcodes menu.

name: stock_barcodes_picking_batch
summary: Extends the barcode scanning screens so that batch pickings can be processed by scanning, and scanning a quant barcode fills in the product, lot and location. It adds the batch candidates to the scanner wizard. It needs the Stock Barcodes and Batch Pickings modules.

name: stock_brand
summary: Carries the brand chosen on a sales order over to its delivery order, so the delivery slip shows the same brand as the sale. Users pick the brand on the sale order, and the printed delivery slip includes it. Printing with the brand layout needs the Brand External Report Layout module.

name: stock_buffer_capacity_limit
summary: Adds a Storage Capacity Limit to DDMRP stock buffers, so the reorder suggestion never pushes stock above what the location can hold. Recommended purchase or manufacturing quantities are cut back to fit the limit. It is set on each buffer in the DDMRP buffer setup.

name: stock_buffer_route
summary: Lets a user force a specific route, such as a supplier or a manufacturing route, for a DDMRP stock buffer, instead of the one Odoo would pick by default. Only routes that apply to the buffer's location, or to locations above it, can be chosen. It is set on the buffer itself, and the buffer's vendor can be set in the make-procurement step.

name: stock_buffer_route
summary: Lets a user force a specific route, such as a supplier or a manufacturing route, for a DDMRP stock buffer, instead of the one Odoo would pick by default. Only routes that apply to the buffer's location, or to locations above it, can be chosen. It is set on the buffer itself, and the buffer's vendor can be set in the make-procurement step.

name: stock_buffer_sales_analysis
summary: Adds a smart button on a DDMRP stock buffer that opens the sales analysis for its product, with the quantity sold shown on the buffer. Only users who can see their own documents get the button, matching the product form. It needs the Sales app and the Sales Teams module.

name: stock_buffer_sales_analysis
summary: Adds a smart button on a DDMRP stock buffer that opens the sales analysis for its product, with the quantity sold shown on the buffer. Only users who can see their own documents get the button, matching the product form. It needs the Sales app and the Sales Teams module.

name: stock_card_report
summary: Adds a Stock Card report under Inventory > Reporting that lists every in and out movement of a product in a chosen location over a date range, with a starting balance. Results can be viewed on screen or exported to PDF or XLSX. Useful for auditing how a product's stock level changed over time.

name: stock_change_qty_reason
summary: Requires a reason to be recorded when stock quantities are changed by inventory adjustments, either for the whole adjustment or for each line. Admins can also define a list of preset reasons to pick from. Reasons are kept under Inventory, Configuration, Settings, Inventory Adjustment.

name: stock_checkout_sync
summary: Adds a Checkout Sync action on pick transfers that moves the related packing lines to one chosen packing location, so all goods for an order gather in the same place. It is switched on per operation type.

name: stock_customer_deposit
summary: Lets a customer leave stock with the company as a deposit, which is stored in the warehouse and later delivered to them free of charge. A sales order can be marked as a customer deposit, and when the customer later orders the deposited goods, those lines get a 100 percent discount. Customer deposits are enabled per warehouse, and they rely on consignment and multi-step routes.

name: stock_customer_deposit
summary: Lets a customer leave stock with the company as a deposit, which is stored in the warehouse and later delivered to them free of charge. A sales order can be marked as a customer deposit, and when the customer later orders the deposited goods, those lines get a 100 percent discount. It also adds a deposit route and an invoice link, and it relies on consignment and multi-step routes.

name: stock_customer_deposit_elaboration
summary: A glue module that keeps the customer deposit route on a sales order line when a sale elaboration is added to it. Without it, adding an elaboration can change the route the line uses. It is set up through the Sale elaboration configuration together with the customer deposit settings.

name: stock_customer_deposit_sale_margin
summary: When a customer's deposited goods are delivered on a new sales order, sets the cost on that order line to zero, so the margin reflects that the goods were already paid for earlier. It extends customer deposits and works with the sales margin reporting. Users see the zero cost on the order line.

name: stock_cycle_count
summary: Plans rolling cycle counts, where small parts of the warehouse are counted on a set schedule instead of doing one full stock take. Each day the system proposes locations to count based on configured rules, and zero-quantity confirmations can be requested to check empty locations. Rules are set under Inventory, Configuration, Cycle Count Rules, and the planned counts appear under Operations.

name: stock_cycle_count
summary: Sets up cycle counting, where small parts of the warehouse are counted on a regular schedule instead of a full yearly stock take. Counting rules per warehouse or zone decide which locations are proposed each day, and a daily job creates the count tasks that turn into inventory adjustments. Accuracy reports show how well each location's records match reality, and rules are set under Inventory > Configuration > Cycle Count Rules.

name: stock_dangerous_goods
summary: Adds flags showing whether products, move lines or packages contain dangerous goods in limited quantity. It is a glue module with the EU dangerous goods (ADR) product module.

name: stock_delivery_note
summary: Adds a free-text Delivery Note field to each transfer, which is printed on the delivery report. Warehouse or sales staff can write instructions or a message for the carrier or customer, found on the Additional Info tab of the transfer. It is useful for notes that should travel with the parcel.

name: stock_delivery_note
summary: Adds a free-text Delivery Note field to each transfer, which is printed on the delivery report. Warehouse or sales staff can write instructions or a message for the carrier or customer, found on the Additional Info tab of the transfer. It is useful for notes that should travel with the parcel.

name: stock_delivery_note
summary: Adds a free-text Delivery Note field to each transfer, which is printed on the delivery report. Warehouse or sales staff can write instructions or a message for the carrier or customer, found on the Additional Info tab of the transfer. It is useful for notes that should travel with the parcel.

name: stock_demand_estimate
summary: Lets planners record expected demand for a product at a location over a chosen period, such as expected sales for next month. The estimates are stored as lines for later use, though this module does not use them itself. Lines are created under Inventory, Demand Planning.

name: stock_demand_estimate
summary: Lets planners record expected demand for a product at a location over chosen time periods, such as next month or next quarter. The module only stores the estimates; it does not use them to drive purchasing or replenishment on its own. Other modules can build on the figures.

name: stock_demand_estimate_matrix
summary: Adds a grid view for entering demand estimates, with products down the side and time periods across the top. Date ranges are defined under Inventory > Configuration > Date Ranges, and estimates are created under Inventory > Demand Planning. Built on the demand estimate module.

name: stock_demand_estimate_matrix
summary: Gives planners a grid view to enter demand estimates for many products across several date periods at once. Periods come from date ranges set under Inventory, Configuration, Date Ranges. Grids are opened from Inventory, Demand Planning, Create Demand Estimates.

name: stock_depot
summary: Lets you record a depot for each partner, which is the local point where a transporter drops parcels for onward delivery. It only creates the depot record on the partner; it does not change any stock flow yet. It is a base module meant to be extended for transport workflows.

name: stock_depot
summary: Lets you record a depot for each partner, which is the local point where a transporter drops parcels for onward delivery. It only creates the depot record on the partner; it does not change any stock flow yet. It is a base module meant to be extended for transport workflows.

name: stock_dock
summary: Lets you define the loading docks of each warehouse, with a name and barcode for each dock used by trucks to load or unload goods. The docks are kept under the warehouse configuration and can be picked on transfers that use them. It is the base record that other dock features build on.

name: stock_dynamic_routing
summary: Lets warehouse setups add extra internal transfers automatically, based on where goods are picked from or put away to, such as a high-bay or handover area. Routing rules are defined per location under Inventory > Settings > Stock Routing, and the extra transfer is created when a move is reserved. It lets a warehouse use different operation types for different zones without manual steps.

name: stock_dynamic_routing
summary: Routes stock moves by the location they come from or go to. For example, goods leaving a high-bay can automatically get an extra handover transfer when reserved. Routing rules are set under Inventory settings in the Stock Routing menu.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_checkout_sync
summary: Glue module with tests that confirm checkout sync and dynamic routing work together. It adds no features of its own.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_delivery
summary: Lets selected dynamic routing rules pass the carrier onto the extra routing moves they create. It is set per routing rule with the Propagation of carrier option.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_delivery_procurement_group_carrier
summary: Glue module so the carrier taken from the procurement group, rather than the transfer, is used when carriers are passed on in dynamic routing.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_reserve_rule
summary: Glue module that adds a warning on routing records when a reservation rule applies, so users see the conflict in the routing form.

name: stock_exception
summary: Attaches custom exception rules to transfers, such as a product that does not exist or a bad line, so problem transfers can be filtered and fixed. Checks run on a schedule and when a transfer is confirmed or validated. It is useful after mass imports of transfers, where some lines are likely to fail.

name: stock_exception
summary: Attaches custom exception rules to transfers, such as a product that does not exist or a bad line, so problem transfers can be filtered and fixed. Checks run on a schedule and when a transfer is confirmed or validated. It is useful after mass imports of transfers, where some lines are likely to fail.

name: stock_financial_risk
summary: Blocks a customer's transfers when the customer has gone over a financial risk limit, such as a credit limit, so goods cannot be shipped to them until it is resolved. The limits are set under Customers > Financial Risk, and the block is applied when a delivery is attempted. It extends the partner financial risk feature to stock moves.

name: stock_financial_risk
summary: Blocks stock transfers, such as deliveries, for customers who are over their financial risk limit. A user who tries to transfer goods for such a customer gets an error. This is useful when goods should not ship to customers who owe too much.

name: stock_fleet_delivery_driver
summary: Lets you assign a default vehicle to delivery methods and transfers, and a driver to the batch, so a delivery batch carries its vehicle and driver to the warehouse team. Vehicles and drivers come from the Fleet app, and batches can be grouped by vehicle or driver. It needs Dispatch Management and Batch transfers to be enabled.

name: stock_free_quantity
summary: Shows the Free Quantity on the product template form, which is the quantity on hand that is not yet reserved for another operation. It adds the field to the product form so it is visible without opening the stock report. Use it to see how much can still be promised.

name: stock_free_quantity
summary: Shows the Free Quantity on the product form, which is the quantity on hand that is not yet reserved for another operation. It adds the field to both the product variant and the product template. Use it to see how much can still be promised without opening the stock report.

name: stock_full_location_reservation
summary: Adds a button that extends a transfer's reservation to the entire content of the source location, for example moving all 20 units when a move only asked for 2. It is used for location content transfers, such as clearing a bin in the shopfloor scanner app. A merge option can combine the lines into a single move, which replaces the original move.

name: stock_grn
summary: Adds Goods Received Notes, the paperwork a warehouse records when a transporter drops off goods, under Inventory > Products. A GRN records the carrier, supplier delivery note number, pallet counts and docks, and it is linked to the incoming receipts. It marks goods as received without moving stock, so the receipts can then be processed.

name: stock_helper
summary: A hidden technical module with shared helper methods used by other stock modules. It has no screens and does nothing for users by itself.

name: stock_helper
summary: A hidden technical module with shared helper methods used by other stock modules. It has no screens and does nothing for users by itself.

name: stock_intercompany
summary: When one company in a multi-company database ships goods to another, creates the matching incoming transfer in the receiving company automatically. Each company sets an intercompany incoming operation type in Inventory settings. Lots and packages are not handled yet.

name: stock_intercompany
summary: When one company in a multi-company database ships goods to another, creates the matching incoming transfer in the receiving company automatically. Each company sets an intercompany incoming operation type in Inventory settings. Lots and packages are not handled yet.

name: stock_intercompany_bidirectional
summary: Extends intercompany transfers so stock can flow both ways between companies, with separate outgoing and incoming operation types. Shipping from one company creates the matching incoming transfer in the other. Settings let you copy quantities done from the counterpart transfer and carry packages and lot numbers across.
keywords: company A to company B stock

name: stock_interwarehouse_transfer
summary: Adds an Inter-Warehouse Transfer document under Inventory > Operations, used to move stock from one warehouse to another in the same company. Confirming it creates an outgoing transfer at the source and an incoming one at the destination, linked through the transit location. Direct internal moves between warehouses are blocked so this document is the only route.

name: stock_inventory
summary: Groups inventory adjustments into named sessions, such as a yearly count, so each count can be followed and traced as one piece of work. Sessions can cover all products, selected products, one product or one lot in the chosen locations, and can be run in batches. It is found under Inventory > Operations > Inventory Adjustments.

name: stock_inventory
summary: Groups inventory adjustments into named inventory counts, so a stock take can be tracked and followed as one document with a clear reference and state. Users pick the products to count by all products, by hand, one product, one lot, or by filter. Groups are listed under Inventory, Operations, Inventory Adjustments.

name: stock_inventory_count_to_zero
summary: Lets users request a count on inventory lines with the count set to zero by default, which is useful for checking that empty locations really are empty. The count is requested from the Inventory Adjustments list with a button. Users then apply the result when ready.

name: stock_inventory_count_to_zero
summary: Lets a stock manager request a count from the Inventory Adjustments list, with each line defaulting to zero, so counters confirm empty spots or enter what they find. The adjustment is applied later, when the manager is ready. Useful for checking that a location is really empty.

name: stock_inventory_discrepancy
summary: Shows how far each counted line differs from the system quantity and holds an inventory for approval when the difference is above a set threshold. Only users in the Validate All Inventory Adjustments group can approve held counts, while stock users can still validate small differences. Thresholds are set on warehouses and locations.

name: stock_inventory_discrepancy
summary: Shows, for each line of an inventory adjustment, how far the counted quantity differs from the system quantity. It can block the adjustment from being validated when a discrepancy is above a threshold set by the user, so large unexplained differences must be reviewed first. It is used from the Inventory Adjustments screens.

name: stock_inventory_hide_apply_all
summary: Hides the Apply All button on the inventory adjustments list for everyone, so counts are not applied in one click by accident. Users in the Apply All Inventory Adjustments group can still see the button. It is a simple permission tweak for the Inventory Adjustments screen.

name: stock_inventory_justification
summary: Lets users attach one or more justifications, such as damage or theft, to an inventory adjustment. The reasons are copied onto the stock moves, quants and move lines when the adjustment is validated, so the reason stays with each correction. Justifications are chosen in the Inventory Adjustments list.

name: stock_inventory_justification
summary: Lets users attach one or more justifications, such as damage or theft, to an inventory adjustment. The reasons are copied onto the stock moves, quants and move lines when the adjustment is validated, so the reason stays with each correction. Justifications are set up under Inventory > Configuration > Inventory justifications.

name: stock_inventory_location_state
summary: When an inventory count starts, lists every sub-location under the counted locations and tracks which ones are done. An inventory cannot be validated until all sub-locations have been counted. The progress shows on the inventory form.

name: stock_inventory_lockdown
summary: Blocks stock moves in and out of a location while its inventory count is in progress, and blocks creating or changing locations during the count. Users who try get an error message. It keeps the counted stock steady until the count is finished.

name: stock_inventory_lockdown_product
summary: Makes the inventory lockdown product-specific, so during an open stock count only movements of the products being counted are blocked, not every movement in the counted locations. It is turned on as a soft lockdown in the company settings. It builds on the inventory lockdown module.

name: stock_inventory_preparation_filter
summary: Adds a Filtered Products option when creating an inventory adjustment, where a domain filter chooses which products to count and update. The filter is shown as a domain widget on the adjustment form. Users start the adjustment from the Inventory Adjustments list.

name: stock_inventory_preparation_filter
summary: Adds more ways to choose products when preparing an inventory adjustment: products matching a domain filter, all products in a category, or several lots at once. This saves selecting products one by one for a partial count. It extends the Inventory Adjustments form.

name: stock_inventory_quantity_history
summary: Keeps the theoretical and the counted quantity at the time of each inventory adjustment, so they can be reviewed later. After validating an adjustment, the two figures appear on the Moves History report. It is useful for auditing how far counts differed from the system.

name: stock_inventory_restriction
summary: Limits who can change or validate inventory adjustments to the users assigned to them, while inventory managers keep full access. It is a permission safeguard for the stock count process. Regular users only see and work on counts they are assigned to.

name: stock_inventory_valuation_report
summary: Adds a report button on the Inventory Valuation report, so the value of all products in internal locations can be viewed on screen or exported to PDF or XLSX. The user picks a date to value the stock at. It is found under Inventory > Reporting > Inventory Valuation.

name: stock_inventory_verification_request
summary: Creates slot verification requests when a count finds a difference above the allowed threshold, so a stock manager can assign someone to recheck that small location. Requests are created from a pending adjustment with a Request Verification button and tracked under Inventory, Inventory Control. The aim is to fix counting errors before the stock moves on.

name: stock_landed_costs_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic account and analytic tags to each landed cost line, so when the landed cost is validated, its journal items get the same analytic split. Freight, duty and similar extra costs can then be tracked against a project or department. Works when the cost account matches on the journal item.

name: stock_landed_costs_currency
summary: Lets extra landed costs, such as freight or duties, be entered in a foreign currency. The amount is converted to the company currency at the exchange rate of the landed cost date, and the converted figure is what goes into product costs. Needs Multi-Currencies to be enabled, and the Multi Currencies extra right on the user.

name: stock_landed_costs_delivery
summary: When a purchase order is sent with a carrier, adds the carrier's price as a landed cost line on the receipt, so the freight is included in the product cost. The shipping method must allow creating landed cost lines, and the split method is set on the method. It links purchasing and delivery with landed costs.

name: stock_landed_costs_priority
summary: Adds a priority field to landed costs, so they can be ranked by importance or urgency, for example with stars on the list. It is a simple ranking field and does not change how costs are calculated. Found on the Landed Costs list under Inventory > Operations.

name: stock_landed_costs_priority
summary: Adds a priority level to landed costs, so you can rank them by importance or urgency.

name: stock_landed_costs_purchase_auto
summary: Creates a landed cost automatically when a purchase order is confirmed and its receipt is validated, linking it to the purchase order and the picking. This saves creating each landed cost by hand for purchase-driven costs. The new landed cost appears under Inventory > Operations > Landed Costs.

name: stock_landed_costs_purchase_auto
summary: Creates a landed cost record automatically when a purchase order is confirmed, linked to the order and to its receipt once validated. It is found under Inventory > Operations > Landed Costs.

name: stock_landed_costs_security
summary: Makes Landed Costs a full application with its own icon and menu, and gives access to a dedicated user group. Members of that group can create and validate landed costs without needing wider inventory rights. Access is granted per user in the Inventory section of the user's access rights.

name: stock_location_address
summary: Adds an address to each storage location, so purchases can be sent to a specific address for that location. If a location has no address, the parent location's address is used. Set under Inventory > Settings > Locations once storage locations are enabled.

name: stock_location_address_purchase
summary: Makes the delivery address on a purchase order come from the destination location of the chosen operation type. That lets goods bought for a specific site or location be delivered to that site's address. Set up through the location address module.

name: stock_location_bin_name
summary: Builds bin location names automatically from the zone, row, rack, level and box attributes of a location, so names stay consistent. The naming format is set on each location. Warehouse staff see the generated names in location lists and transfers.

name: stock_location_children
summary: Adds a Children button that lists every location below a chosen location at any depth, not only the first level. This makes it easier to see everything stored inside a zone or building. It is found on the location form under Inventory, Configuration, Locations.

name: stock_location_children
summary: Adds a field that lists every sub-location under a stock location, not just its direct children, so you can see the whole branch at once. It is stored, so searches over the full tree stay fast. Found on each location under Inventory > Configuration > Warehouse Management > Locations, using the Children button.

name: stock_location_empty
summary: Adds a stock amount to locations and a filter for empty locations, so warehouse staff can quickly find free spaces. The list of locations shows the quantity stored in each one. It is used when looking for places to put new stock.

name: stock_location_fill_state
summary: Labels each location as empty, filled, being filled or being emptied, based on current and planned moves, and lets users filter by that label. It is shown as a column on the Locations list. Customer and supplier locations are excluded to keep the screen fast.

name: stock_location_fill_state_qty_picked
summary: A small link module that makes the fill state of locations account for quantities already picked. It only connects two other modules and has no screens of its own. Users see the more accurate location status in the Locations list.

name: stock_location_is_sublocation
summary: A technical helper that adds a way to check whether a location sits inside another location. It is used by other modules and has no screens of its own. Users see no change.

name: stock_location_lockdown
summary: Lets admins mark internal locations as blocked for storage, so no stock can be put into them. This is useful for parent locations that exist only to group other locations, or for places temporarily taken out of use. The Block Stock Entrance checkbox is set on each location.

name: stock_location_lockdown
summary: Blocks stock from being put into parent or zone locations that exist only to organise the warehouse tree. A checkbox called Block Stock Entrance on an internal location stops any product from being added there. Set on the location form under Inventory > Configuration > Locations.

name: stock_location_lockdown
summary: Blocks stock from being put into parent or zone locations that exist only to organise the warehouse tree. A checkbox called Block Stock Entrance on an internal location stops any product from being added there. Set on the location form under Inventory > Configuration > Locations.

name: stock_location_orderpoint
summary: Lets you set a replenishment rule on a storage location, so that any product in it is topped up from another location when stock runs low, using the same min and max criteria. It is meant for internal replenishment between warehouse locations, and the rules are set under Inventory > Configuration. It needs Storage Locations and Multi-Step Routes enabled.

name: stock_location_orderpoint
summary: Lets you set a replenishment rule on a storage location, so that any product in it is topped up from another location when stock runs low, using the same min and max criteria. It is meant for internal replenishment between warehouse locations, and the rules are set under Inventory > Configuration. It needs Storage Locations and Multi-Step Routes enabled.

name: stock_location_orderpoint_average_daily_sale
summary: Lets a location replenishment rule size its refill from the average daily sales of each product. Choosing the Average Daily Sale method on a location rule makes the quantity follow recent consumption. It extends the location orderpoint and the average daily sale features.

name: stock_location_orderpoint_cleanup
summary: Lets authorised users delete the transfers that location replenishment rules have generated, from the rule form or from the list of rules, and optionally run the rule again afterwards. Scheduled cleanup can also be set up as a cron job. Only users in the Location Orderpoint Cleanup group can use it, and by default that is the Inventory administrators.

name: stock_location_package_restriction
summary: Controls whether a storage location may hold packages, so a location can be set to forbid packages, require exactly one package, or require packages without mixing loose goods. A warning shows on the location when its contents break the rule. It is set on each location under Inventory > Configuration > Locations.

name: stock_location_pending_move
summary: Shows the incoming and outgoing moves that are planned for each location, grouped by the location they come from. Users can open them from the location form via Pending Move or Pending Operations. Storage locations need to be enabled first.

name: stock_location_position
summary: Adds position fields to storage locations, such as corridor, row, rack and level, and box coordinates for X, Y and Z. These describe where each location sits physically in the warehouse. Fields appear on the location form under Inventory, Configuration, Locations.

name: stock_location_position
summary: Adds position fields to storage locations: corridor, row, rack and level, plus box coordinates (X, Y, Z). The position fields help people find a location physically, and the coordinate fields were renamed from position to box. Set on each location in the warehouse configuration.

name: stock_location_product_restriction
summary: Lets a location be restricted to a single product, so that different products cannot be mixed in it. The rule can be set on any location and is passed down to its sub-locations unless overridden. It stops a bin from holding a second product by mistake.

name: stock_location_release_channel_restriction
summary: Stops stock from one release channel, such as a particular customer group or carrier wave, being put into a location that holds stock for a different channel. The location takes on the channel of the pending outgoing moves until they leave, then it is freed. Enabled per location under Inventory > Configuration > Warehouse Management > Locations.

name: stock_location_tray
summary: Organizes a storage location as a grid of cells, such as a tray with rows and columns, and creates the sub-locations for each cell automatically. Tray types define the grid size and are set in Inventory settings, and a location is given a tray type on its form. Moves can then show which cell stock is taken from or put into.

name: stock_location_validate_inventory
summary: Adds a 'Location Validate Inventory' group and an action on a location to confirm its current stock is correct. Confirming clears any counted differences and records the location's last inventory date. Without it, only Inventory Managers can validate, and only when a quant needs a counted quantity.

name: stock_location_zone
summary: Classifies storage locations into zones, areas, bins and stock locations so warehouse picking and putaway can be organized by area. A zone is an area that pickers work in, and an area is where stock is put away. Each location shows its kind on its form under Inventory, Configuration, Locations.

name: stock_location_zone
summary: Organises storage locations into zones, areas and bins, so a warehouse can be described by how it is laid out. A zone is an area that pickers work in, an area holds put-away storage, and a bin is a leaf location. Each location shows its kind, and the zone and area it belongs to, on its form.

name: stock_lock_lot
summary: Lets a lot or serial number be blocked so it cannot be moved, for example while it is under quality hold. A product category can block new lots by default, and locations can be marked as allowed to take locked lots. Users need a permission to block or unblock lots.

name: stock_lock_lot
summary: Lets you block a serial number or lot so it cannot move into a location unless that location allows locked stock. The default for new lots can be set per product category.

name: stock_lot_catalog
summary: A base for showing lots and serial numbers as a catalog of products that users can browse and pick from, similar to the Catalog option in sales and purchases. Lots now carry product attribute values and an image. It is a base that other catalog features build on.

name: stock_lot_catalog_condition
summary: Adds a condition colour to lots in the lot catalog, so a lot's condition such as new or used can be seen at a glance. It builds on the lot catalog and the lot condition feature. Users see the colour in the catalog.

name: stock_lot_catalog_price
summary: Uses the list price of the product as the price of each lot shown in the lot catalog. It connects the lot catalog with the lot list price feature. Users see prices for each lot when browsing.

name: stock_lot_catalog_sale
summary: Adds a Catalog lot option on sales order lines, so a salesperson can browse lots and add them to the order from a catalog window. The lot attribute values are stored on each order line. It is opened from the order lines list of a sales order.

name: stock_lot_catalog_warehouse
summary: Adds a warehouse search panel to the lot catalog, so users can filter the lots shown by warehouse. It connects the lot catalog with the warehouse lot feature. Users pick a warehouse on the side of the catalog view.

name: stock_lot_condition
summary: Lets you tag each serial number or lot with a condition such as Good or Defective, and optionally require a note explaining it. Conditions are defined under Inventory > Configuration > Products > Lot conditions and show on the lot form.

name: stock_lot_image
summary: Adds a list of images, videos or embed codes to each lot or serial number, shown in an Images tab on the lot form. Handy for photographing a specific item.

name: stock_lot_is_archived
summary: Adds an Is Archived flag on lots and serial numbers, separate from the normal archive setting. A scheduled job can flag older lots automatically, so that only the lot with the latest expiry date stays active. The job is found under Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions.

name: stock_lot_list_price
summary: Lets you set a sales price (list price) on each lot or serial number, so an individual unit can carry its own price. Requires the stock_account module, and the price shows on the lot form.

name: stock_lot_multi_image
summary: Lets you attach several pictures to a lot or serial number in an Images tab, with the first image used as the main picture. It builds on the base multi-image feature.

name: stock_lot_on_hand_first
summary: Shows lots that still have stock at the top of the lot choice list when filling in operation details, so old lots with nothing left are not picked by mistake. It is switched on per operation type when the operation uses existing lots. It applies to the detailed operations on transfers.

name: stock_lot_on_hand_first
summary: Shows lots that still have stock at the top of the lot choice list when filling in operation details, so old lots with nothing left are not picked by mistake. It is switched on per operation type when the operation uses existing lots. It applies to the detailed operations on transfers.

name: stock_lot_production_date
summary: Adds a Production Date field on lots and serial numbers, so the date a lot was made is recorded alongside its other lot details. It appears on the lot form under Inventory > Products > Lots/Serial Numbers. It is simple data capture with no extra workflow.

name: stock_lot_production_date
summary: Adds a Production Date field to lot and serial numbers, so you can record when each lot or serial was manufactured. It shows on the lot or serial number form in Inventory.

name: stock_lot_remove
summary: Automatically moves stock out of the warehouse once its lot's removal date has passed, reserved or not, by running a daily job per warehouse. The source location and the picking type are set on the warehouse, and removal is switched on there under Warehouse Configuration. It is used for perishable or expiring goods.

name: stock_lot_scrap
summary: Adds a Scrap button on the lot or serial number form that scraps all stock quants in that lot. It requires Lots & Serial Numbers to be turned on in traceability settings.

name: stock_lot_warehouse
summary: Adds an informational Warehouse field to lots and serial numbers, so you can see which warehouse a lot belongs to. It is for reference only and does not restrict stock moves.

name: stock_measuring_device
summary: Provides a common framework for connecting measuring and weighing devices, which measure package size and weight, to Odoo. A measuring device is set up under Inventory > Configuration > Measuring Devices, and its Wizard button takes measurements that fill in packaging length, width, height and weight. Device-specific modules plug their brand into this framework.

name: stock_measuring_device_zippcube
summary: Connects the Bosch Zippcube package measuring device to Odoo, so the Wizard on a measuring device can fill in a package's measured size and weight. After each measurement the Refresh button brings the reading in. It is a device driver built on the common measuring device framework.

name: stock_move_actual_date
summary: Adds an Actual Date to transfers, scraps and moves, to record when a movement really happened if it is entered late. Valuation layers and stock history reports use this date, and users need the Modify Actual Date group to edit it.

name: stock_move_actual_date
summary: Adds an Actual Date to transfers, scraps, stock moves and valuation layers, so a late-entered transfer can record the date it really happened. The date flows down to the moves and the stock valuation, and it can be used for reporting. Users need the Modify Actual Date permission to edit it on completed records.

name: stock_move_actual_date
summary: Adds an Actual Date to transfers, scraps, stock moves and valuation layers, so a late-entered transfer can record the date it really happened. The date flows down to the moves and the stock valuation, and it also drives the stock quantity history report. Users need the Modify Actual Date permission to edit it on completed records.

name: stock_move_auto_assign
summary: When goods arrive in a location, Odoo checks in the background whether other waiting moves for the same product can now be reserved there, so they do not sit idle. The checks run as queued jobs, so users are not slowed down when they validate a receipt. Applies to chained moves only when they have no further steps.

name: stock_move_auto_assign
summary: When goods arrive in a location, Odoo checks in the background whether other waiting moves for the same product can now be reserved there, so they do not sit idle. The checks run as queued jobs, so users are not slowed down when they validate a receipt. Applies to chained moves only when they have no further steps.

name: stock_move_auto_assign_auto_release
summary: After new stock arrives and the auto-assign check reserves it, moves that are ready to be released are released automatically in the background. This means waiting deliveries move forward without someone releasing them by hand. It runs on queued jobs and needs the release feature and auto-assign to be installed.

name: stock_move_auto_assign_auto_release
summary: Once a move becomes available, releases the waiting moves automatically in background jobs, one job per product, so users are not slowed down. It builds on auto assign and delayed release of moves.

name: stock_move_auto_assign_auto_release_exclude_location
summary: Leaves locations that are excluded from the immediately usable quantity out of the automatic release check, so stock arriving in a quarantine or other excluded location does not release deliveries. It extends the auto-assign and auto-release behavior with the location exclusion setting.

name: stock_move_backdating
summary: Lets you record a transfer with a past movement date (Forced Effective Date), which also sets the journal entry date when perpetual valuation is on. Use it when stock was physically moved earlier but is only entered now.

name: stock_move_backdating
summary: Lets users record stock movements with a past date, so the history matches what really happened. A backdate is set on a ready transfer with the Fill Actual Movement Date button, and the valuation and journal entries then use that date when the transfer is validated. It is used when a movement was not recorded on the day it happened.

name: stock_move_common_dest
summary: A technical field that finds the other moves feeding the same destination move in a chain, sharing the same transfer. It adds no screens of its own and is used by other logistics features that need to group related moves.

name: stock_move_common_dest
summary: Technical module that adds a field on stock moves listing the other moves that share the same downstream destination transfer. It is used by other chained-move features and has no screen of its own.

name: stock_move_delay_report
summary: Adds a Delay Analysis report under Inventory > Reporting that shows how many days incoming and outgoing moves take per responsible partner, with graph, pivot and list views. The pivot also shows the share of moves done on time. It helps spot suppliers or carriers that are consistently late.

name: stock_move_forced_lot
summary: Lets a procurement force a specific lot onto the stock move it creates, so only that lot is reserved. Useful when a particular serial number must be shipped.

name: stock_move_free_reservation_reassign
summary: When an inventory adjustment makes stock reserved for a transfer no longer available, Odoo tries to reserve the affected lines again straight away from other available stock. This setting is turned on under Inventory > Configuration > Settings, and it stops transfers from silently losing their stock after a count.

name: stock_move_free_reservation_reassign
summary: When an inventory adjustment makes stock reserved for a transfer no longer available, Odoo tries to reserve the affected lines again straight away from other available stock. This setting is turned on under Inventory > Configuration > Settings, and it stops transfers from silently losing their stock after a count.

name: stock_move_line_auto_fill
summary: Adds an Auto Fill Operations button on transfers that fills in the done quantities from the scheduled or reserved quantities, so a receipt or delivery that matches the plan needs only a few edits. For lot-tracked products the reserved quantity is used directly. Options on each operation type control whether the button shows and whether lots are auto-assigned.

name: stock_move_line_change_lot
summary: Improves changing the lot on a transfer line. When a new lot is chosen, the system checks its available quantity and, where needed, moves reservations away from other lines, without taking stock from lines that are already picked. The reserved quantity is adjusted, and a new line is created for any part that cannot be covered.

name: stock_move_line_change_lot
summary: When you change the lot on a move line, it checks availability and takes over reservations from other lines if needed, without taking from lines already picked. If only part of the quantity is available, the line is split so the rest is covered.

name: stock_move_line_dates
summary: Adds Scheduled Date and Deadline to move lines, so you can filter and group wave planning by when lines are due. It is used from the Prepare Wave option on an operation type.

name: stock_move_line_expiration_date_required
summary: For products set to a zero-day expiry, forces the expiration date to be entered by hand on move lines instead of calculated. A transfer cannot be confirmed until those dates are filled in.

name: stock_move_line_expiration_date_required
summary: Makes the expiration date a required entry on receipt lines for products whose expiry is set to be typed in by hand, instead of calculated from the receipt date. A transfer with such a line without an expiration date cannot be confirmed. The rule applies to products set to use expiration dates with zero days after receipt.

name: stock_move_line_lock_qty_done
summary: Locks the done quantity of a stock move once it is validated, so it cannot be edited afterwards. The lock is turned on per company in Inventory settings, and only users in the group that can edit done quantities for done moves can still change it. It protects validated stock records from later edits.

name: stock_move_line_lot_link
summary: Makes the lot or serial number on the Detailed Operations lines clickable, so you can jump straight to its form. Without it the lot name sometimes shows as plain text.

name: stock_move_line_qty_picked
summary: Adds a separate Picked quantity on move lines, so scanning counts does not change the reserved quantity. It brings back the done-quantity behavior from earlier Odoo versions.

name: stock_move_line_reference_link
summary: Makes the Reference field on stock move lines clickable, so you can open the source document directly from the Detailed Operations view.

name: stock_move_line_reserved_quant
summary: Stores on each move line the specific stock quant it reserved, so a line can be traced back to the exact lot, package or location it took stock from. This allows filtering destinations by the properties of the reserved stock. It adds no screens; it is a technical link used by other modules.

name: stock_move_line_serial_unique
summary: Stops a serial number from being received when that same serial already has stock elsewhere, for example after an owned and an unowned version of the same serial. The check runs when a serial is typed in and when a new lot is created on receipt. It prevents duplicate serial numbers in purchase receipts.

name: stock_move_location
summary: Adds an Operations > Move from location wizard that moves all or selected stock from one location to another in one step, either immediately or as a planned transfer. Quantities can be edited per line but cannot exceed what is available, and reservations are ignored.

name: stock_move_location_purchase_uom
summary: Glue between Move Stock Location and Purchase UoM. When the operation type uses purchase units, transfers created by the Move to location button use each product's purchase unit.

name: stock_move_manage_priority
summary: Lets the priority of an individual stock move be set, so one line of a transfer can be reserved before others even if the transfer's own priority is the same. The option is turned on in Inventory settings, and the priority field appears on the Operations list of the transfer for users in the move priority manager group. It helps when stock for one product is limited.

name: stock_move_not_merge_by_dest_moves
summary: Stops Odoo from merging stock moves that lead to different sales moves, for a two-step or multi-step shipment. Without it, lines that should ship separately could be combined and mixed up. It needs the Sales and Inventory integration and a multi-step delivery process.

name: stock_move_original_date
summary: Keeps the original scheduled date on a move when the date is later changed, so supplier delays can be measured against the planned date. It is shown on moves and transfers.

name: stock_move_original_date
summary: Keeps the date a transfer was originally scheduled for, even when the scheduled date is later changed. This lets reports measure how late a supplier or carrier really was against the first plan. The original date is stored on the moves and on the transfer.

name: stock_move_packaging_qty
summary: Adds packaging quantity fields to stock moves and move lines, so a transfer can show how many packs or boxes are involved as well as units. An operation type option can calculate the done packaging quantity automatically.

name: stock_move_pivot_total_price
summary: Adds a Total Price measure to the Move Analysis pivot report, showing the value of each product line based on quantity and sales price. Find it under Inventory > Reporting > Move Analysis, then pick Total Price as a measure. It is a reporting addition only and does not change any records.

name: stock_move_planned_consumed_date
summary: Stops moves for the same product from being merged when they have different planned consumption dates, such as stock that must be used before a short expiry. The planned consumed date is stored on each move, but the module does not set it by itself; the procurement logic has to fill it in. Useful for expiry-driven stock allocation.

name: stock_move_priority_picking_assign
summary: Lets a stock move be created with a priority, such as Urgent, and passes that priority on to the transfer when it is assigned. Optionally, moves are grouped into separate transfers by priority on a given operation type. It needs the move priority management setting turned on.

name: stock_move_propagate_first_move
summary: Records on each move the first move and first operation type of the procurement chain that created it, so you can tell at a glance whether it belongs to an incoming or outgoing process.

name: stock_move_propagate_first_move
summary: Records on each stock move which original move started the procurement chain and which operation type it came from, so a move can be classed as part of an incoming or outgoing flow without following the chain. The two fields show on the move line. It is a technical traceability feature.

name: stock_move_purchase_price_update
summary: Lets warehouse staff correct the purchase price of goods while receiving them against a purchase order, as long as that purchase order has not been invoiced yet. A Purchase Price column can be shown on receipt operations and their detailed operations. The change is made from the Receive Products flow on the purchase order.

name: stock_move_purchase_uom
summary: Lets an operation type use the purchase unit of measure for its stock moves, set on the operation type form along with a rounding method. Useful when you buy in cases or boxes but count in single units, or the reverse.

name: stock_move_quantity_product_uom
summary: Shows a move's quantity in the product's own unit of measure, which can differ from the unit used on the move. It helps reports where units are mixed.

name: stock_move_quick_lot
summary: Lets the lot name and optional end-of-life date be typed straight into the Operations tab of a transfer, so the lot is created when the transfer is validated without a separate lot screen. It is for products tracked by lots, with lot tracking turned on in Inventory settings. It saves time on receipts of new lots.

name: stock_move_reset_quantity
summary: Lets you reset all quantities on a transfer's moves and move lines back to zero in one action. Useful when you want to re-enter counts from scratch.

name: stock_move_source_relocate
summary: Changes the source location of moves that cannot be filled where they are, using relocation rules by location, operation type and an optional domain. Useful for handling replenishments from one central spot, and partly available moves are split.

name: stock_move_source_relocate_dynamic_routing
summary: Glue module so source relocation works with dynamic routing, letting relocated moves pick up the routing that applies to their new source.

name: stock_move_valuation_usage
summary: Shows which incoming stock moves were used to value each outgoing move, with the quantity and value taken from each. This makes it possible to revalue stock later, for example when a purchase price changes after receipt. For make-to-order cases it uses the specific incoming move, and otherwise it avoids moves that are already reserved, and it is found under Inventory > Reporting.

name: stock_move_value_report
summary: Adds an Operations Cost Value report that prints the cost of the done transfers, scraps, inventory adjustments or chosen stock moves and move lines as a PDF. It is started from the Print menu on the Transfers, Scrap, Stock Moves or Moves History lists. Only done operations are included in the figures.

name: stock_move_value_report
summary: Adds separate Cost Value print reports for transfers and scraps, as well as for chosen stock moves, that show the cost of each operation as a PDF. They are started from the Print menu on the Transfers, Scrap and Stock Moves lists. Only done operations are included in the figures.

name: stock_move_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a Vendor Comment field to stock moves and move lines, for notes coming from the supplier.

name: stock_mts_mto_mrp_rule
summary: When a manufacturing order has only part of a component in stock, splits the component move in two: the part that is in stock is reserved straight away for production, and the rest is ordered through the make-to-order route. It runs automatically when the product's route has a rule set to Split Procurement. It removes the need to plan partial components by hand.
keywords: make to stock make to order split

name: stock_mts_mto_rule
summary: Adds a Make To Stock plus Make To Order route. For each sale it takes what is in stock first and creates a purchase order only for the shortfall, and it is enabled per warehouse with Use MTO+MTS rules.

name: stock_mts_mto_rule
summary: Adds a Make to Stock plus Make to Order route. When a sale needs more than is on hand, the stock that is available is delivered from the warehouse and a purchase order is raised for only the rest, based on the virtual stock at the time. It is chosen on the product's route, and the company's warehouse form must have the MTO+MTS option turned on.
keywords: make to stock make to order

name: stock_no_negative
summary: Blocks any transfer, manufacturing order or other stock operation that would push a stockable product or location below zero, so wrong stock records must be fixed before shipping or consuming. Consumables can still go negative. Exceptions can be set per product, product category or location with the Allow Negative Stock option.

name: stock_no_negative
summary: Blocks validation of any stock operation that would leave a stockable product with negative quantity at a location, so the stock must be fixed first. Exceptions can be set per product, product category or location with the Allow Negative Stock option.

name: stock_operating_unit
summary: Adds operating units to warehouses, stock locations and transfers, so stock can be split by business unit or branch and each unit only sees its own stock. Warehouses and locations are assigned to a unit, and transfers record the requesting unit. It is a base for the operating unit features in stock.

name: stock_operating_unit_access_all
summary: Lets a specific user see and work on stock pickings from all operating units without being added to every operating unit in their user settings. It is aimed at a shared team, such as procurement, that needs to handle transfers across the whole company. The option is a checkbox on the user record under Settings, Users and Companies, Users.

name: stock_operating_unit_access_all
summary: Lets a specific user see and work on stock pickings from all operating units without being added to every operating unit in their user settings. It is aimed at a shared team, such as procurement, that needs to handle transfers across the whole company. The option is a checkbox on the user record under Settings, Users and Companies, Users.

name: stock_orderpoint_default_location
summary: Lets you set a default storage location per warehouse for new reordering rules, instead of always using the main Stock location. It is useful when replenishment should land in a specific bin or zone. The setting is on the warehouse form, under Warehouse Configuration, as Default Orderpoint Location.

name: stock_orderpoint_default_location
summary: Lets you set a default storage location per warehouse for new reordering rules, instead of always using the main Stock location. It is useful when replenishment should land in a specific bin or zone. The setting is on the warehouse form, under Warehouse Configuration, as Default Orderpoint Location.

name: stock_orderpoint_generator
summary: Adds reorder rule templates that can be applied to many products at once, so you do not have to create min and max rules one product at a time. Changes to a template are copied to every product linked to it by a scheduled action, and min and max quantities can optionally be calculated automatically. Templates are under Inventory, Configuration, Products, Reordering Rule Templates.

name: stock_orderpoint_manual_procurement
summary: Lets a user start purchase or manufacturing requests straight from the Reordering Rules list, using the quantity the system recommends, instead of waiting for the scheduler. You can do this for one rule or several at once. The recommended quantity is converted to the unit of measure set on the rule, and users need a special security group to edit that quantity.

name: stock_orderpoint_move_link
summary: Records which reordering rule created each stock move, so you can trace a transfer back to the rule that triggered it. When moves are chained, the rule is carried forward to the later moves. The link appears on the stock move as Linked Reordering Rules.

name: stock_orderpoint_move_link
summary: Records which reordering rule created each stock move, so you can trace a transfer back to the rule that triggered it. When moves are chained, the rule is carried forward to the later moves. The link appears on the stock move as Linked Reordering Rules.

name: stock_orderpoint_mto_as_mts
summary: Turns make-to-order products into stock-driven replenishment by creating a reordering rule with min and max of zero for each MTO product, so the need is triggered through the rule rather than the MTO route. Warehouses can choose whether to archive those rules when a product stops being MTO. It is set up on the warehouse and product route configuration.
keywords: make to order as make to stock

name: stock_orderpoint_mto_as_mts
summary: Turns make-to-order products into stock-driven replenishment by creating a reordering rule with min and max of zero for each MTO product, so the need is triggered through the rule rather than the MTO route. Warehouses can choose whether to archive those rules when a product stops being MTO, and can pick an automatic or manual trigger for the generated rules. It is set up on the warehouse and product route configuration.
keywords: make to order as make to stock

name: stock_orderpoint_no_horizon
summary: Removes the date cutoff that normally ignores incoming receipts planned beyond a rule's lead days. With this module, all future incoming and outgoing moves count toward the forecast on reordering rules, so a postponed receipt is no longer mistakenly treated as missing stock. It adds no new fields; it changes how the Reordering Rules forecast is calculated.

name: stock_orderpoint_origin
summary: Writes the actual sales orders and manufacturing orders behind a replenishment into the Origin field of the purchase orders it creates, instead of only the name of the reorder rule. It also adds a Sale smart button on those purchase orders that opens the source sales orders. This uses the demand shown in the Forecast report when you create orders from the Replenishment menu.

name: stock_orderpoint_origin_mrp_link
summary: Extends the replenishment origin tracking so that purchase orders created from the Replenishment menu show the manufacturing orders that generated the demand. A Manufacturing smart button on the purchase order opens those MOs. It requires the replenishment origin module and the purchase and manufacturing bridge.

name: stock_orderpoint_purchase_link
summary: Links each purchase order line to the reordering rules that caused it, so you can see from a purchase line which rule created it. In chained moves, the rule carries through from stock moves to the purchase line. The link is kept on the purchase order line and on the reordering rule.

name: stock_orderpoint_purchase_link
summary: Links each purchase order line to the reordering rules that caused it, so you can see from a purchase line which rule created it. In chained moves, the rule carries through from stock moves to the purchase line. The link is kept on the purchase order line and on the reordering rule.

name: stock_orderpoint_route
summary: Lets you pick a specific route for a reordering rule, overriding the route Odoo would otherwise choose when the rule runs. Only routes that apply to the rule's location, or to a location above it, can be selected. The route is set on the reordering rule form.

name: stock_orderpoint_safety_stock
summary: Calculates safety stock and min and max levels for reordering rules automatically, using historical daily demand, its variability, and the lead time. It uses a Cycle Service Level target, so you set how often you want to avoid stockouts during a replenishment cycle instead of typing min and max by hand. The calculation runs daily, and you can switch a rule back to Manual mode at any time.

name: stock_orderpoint_uom
summary: Lets replenishment orders be created in a different unit of measure from the product's stock unit, set on the reordering rule. For example, a product stocked in centimeters can be ordered in meters, so the transfer quantity is easy for warehouse staff to read. Set the procurement unit on the product and turn on the multiple units of measure setting in Inventory settings.
keywords: buy in meters stock in centimeters

name: stock_orderpoint_variant_mto_as_mts
summary: Connects the MTO as MTS replenishment feature to product variants, so reordering rules are triggered per variant rather than only per template. It is a glue module with no screens of its own. It is technical and is only useful if you have both features installed.

name: stock_override_procurement
summary: Technical module that lets code override location and other fields of a procurement through the values passed in. Developers use it; there are no screens.

name: stock_override_procurement
summary: A technical module for developers. It lets custom code override fields such as location and product when a procurement is created, when the core code only provides some of those values. It has no screens and no effect for end users on its own.

name: stock_owner_restriction
summary: Keeps stock that belongs to a supplier or customer (consignment) out of normal availability, so it is not reserved for ordinary deliveries from your own stock. You set an owner restriction on the operation type, and the quantities with an assigned owner are excluded from the on-hand and reservation numbers. It needs the Consignment option enabled in Inventory settings under Traceability.

name: stock_owner_restriction
summary: Keeps stock owned by a specific partner, such as consignment stock, out of reservations made for other operations. The restriction is chosen per operation type, and consignment must be enabled in Traceability settings.

name: stock_package_type_category
summary: Lets you group package types, such as pallets, cartons or bags, into named categories with a code and color. This makes it easier to organize packaging in warehouse setup and in lists. Categories are created under Inventory, Configuration, Delivery, Package Type Categories, and the Packages setting must be on.

name: stock_package_type_volume
summary: Adds a volume measure to package types, so each package type knows its size in volume units. It shows on the package type form under Inventory settings.

name: stock_packaging_calculator
summary: Transitional module that only installs product_packaging_calculator, which has been renamed and moved. Use the packaging calculator features through that module instead.

name: stock_packaging_calculator
summary: Works out how many of each packaging size are needed to cover a quantity, such as how many pallets, big boxes and single boxes make up 2,860 units. It is mainly a helper for developers and other modules, and it shows the breakdown as a display line on the product. The breakdown is only as good as the packagings defined on the product.

name: stock_packaging_calculator
summary: Works out how many of each packaging size are needed to cover a quantity, such as how many pallets, big boxes and single boxes make up 2,860 units. It is mainly a helper for developers and other modules, and it shows the breakdown as a display line on the product. The breakdown is only as good as the packagings defined on the product.

name: stock_packaging_calculator_packaging_level
summary: A technical bridge that makes the packaging calculator use the packaging type code instead of the packaging name when it shows the breakdown. It has no screens of its own and only matters when the packaging level module is installed alongside the calculator.

name: stock_partner_delivery_window
summary: Lets you record each customer's preferred delivery time, such as any time, fixed time windows, or weekdays only. When someone moves a delivery's scheduled date outside that customer's preferred window, Odoo shows a warning so the date can be corrected. The preference is set on the contact form under the Sales and Purchases tab.

name: stock_partner_delivery_window
summary: Lets each customer have a preferred delivery time window or weekday, and warns when a delivery's scheduled date falls outside it. It is set on the customer's Sales & Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_analytic
summary: Lets you set an analytic distribution, which is the cost or project split used in accounting, directly on a transfer. The distribution is copied down to the stock moves on that transfer. It shows on the transfer form so warehouse documents can carry the same analytic tracking as the related costs.

name: stock_picking_analytic
summary: Lets you set an analytic distribution, which is the cost or project split used in accounting, directly on a transfer. The distribution is copied down to the stock moves on that transfer. It shows on the transfer form so warehouse documents can carry the same analytic tracking as the related costs.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot
summary: Creates lot or serial numbers automatically when a receipt is validated without them, for products and operation types you flag. You turn the option on per operation type, product, or product category, so an incoming delivery of tracked goods does not stop on a missing lot. It is set on the operation type, product, and product category forms.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot
summary: Creates lots automatically when a receipt is validated without lot numbers, for products and operation types set to auto-create. It is switched on per product and per operation type.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot_qty
summary: Extends automatic lot creation so that a lot is generated for every set number of units received, for example one lot per 100 units. You can also require that the received quantity be a multiple of that batch size. Lot numbers come from a lot sequence chosen in Inventory settings under Stock Serial Lot.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot_sequence
summary: Bridge module so lots created automatically use the lot numbering sequence from the product lot sequence module. It is technical and has no screens.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot_sequence
summary: A technical bridge between automatic lot creation and the lot sequence feature, so automatically created lots use the lot numbering sequence. It has no screens of its own.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_package
summary: On validation, puts all move lines of a transfer into a new package, either one package for the whole transfer or one per product packaging. The mode is set on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_availability_filter
summary: Adds three filters to the Transfers list: Available, Expected, and Not Available. They let you quickly find receipts and deliveries that are fully ready, partly waiting for stock, or blocked because the products will not arrive. The filters appear on the Transfers list view under Inventory.

name: stock_picking_back2draft
summary: Lets you reopen a cancelled transfer and put it back into Draft so it can be edited and processed again. You open the cancelled transfer and click the Back to Draft button. It is a simple reversal of a cancellation.

name: stock_picking_back2draft
summary: Lets you reopen a cancelled transfer and set it back to draft with a button, for example when it needs to be processed after all.

name: stock_picking_backorder_move_qty
summary: When a transfer is validated with some quantity missing, the backorder prompt lets you choose how much of each product line goes into the backorder, instead of all or nothing. This is useful when only some items on a delivery or receipt are short. The per-line choice appears in the backorder confirmation window.

name: stock_picking_backorder_policy
summary: Lets you set the backorder rule on an individual transfer, overriding the operation type default. Each transfer can be set to Ask, Always, or Never create a backorder when some quantity is missing, which suits customers who always or never want the rest shipped later. The field is on the transfer form and is empty by default, so the operation type setting applies.

name: stock_picking_backorder_strategy_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancel option to the Create Backorder setting on operation types, so leftover quantities from a partial receipt or delivery are cancelled instead of creating a backorder.

name: stock_picking_batch_account
summary: When a batch is set to Done, automatically creates invoices for the sales orders behind its transfers, for customers who have opted in. It can also print those invoices from the batch.

name: stock_picking_batch_account_sale_type
summary: Lets a sales order type turn on automatic batch invoicing, so batches for orders of that type are invoiced when done. It extends batch invoicing to sales order types.

name: stock_picking_batch_creation
summary: Creates a batch of transfers on demand from a Make Picking Batch wizard, filtering by operation types, device capacity (weight, volume, bins) and maximum lines, and optionally grouping by partner or priority. It is found under Inventory > Operations.

name: stock_picking_batch_creation
summary: Adds a Make Picking Batch wizard under Inventory, Operations that builds a batch of transfers for a chosen operator device, such as a forklift or trolley. The batch is sized by the device's maximum weight, volume, number of compartments, and a maximum number of lines. Device types are defined under Inventory, Configuration, Stock Device Types.

name: stock_picking_batch_creation_split_kit
summary: When a batch is created, splits kit transfers so that each device's compartment limit is respected. It extends the batch creation wizard using kit splitting.

name: stock_picking_batch_extended
summary: Adds more control to batch pickings, which group several transfers for one picker to process together. You can give a batch a name and notes, group the batch by fields of the transfers, and see extra details on the batch form. A per-company setting decides whether the extended batch handling is used, and a batch report can be printed.

name: stock_picking_batch_extended
summary: Adds a name, notes, grouping options and extra fields to batch transfer creation and the batch form, plus a batch picking report. Batch validation can also be switched to the OCA approach per company.

name: stock_picking_batch_extended_account
