summary: Creates customer invoices automatically when a batch transfer is marked Done, for customers who have the batch auto invoice option turned on. It also lets you print the invoices of the sales orders linked to the batch's transfers. Turn the option on under the partner's Sales and Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_batch_extended_account_sale_type
summary: Adds a setting on sales order types so that batch auto invoicing can be turned on per order type, not only per customer. It extends the batch invoicing feature for businesses that use several sale order types. It is set on the sale order type form.
keywords: invoice on batch done by type

name: stock_picking_batch_group_by_date
summary: Lets automatic batch creation group transfers by their scheduled date, so pickings due on the same day end up in the same batch. You turn this on per operation type. It is a small add-on to the batch picking feature.

name: stock_picking_batch_invoice_frequency
summary: Lets sales orders with an invoice frequency be invoiced automatically when their transfers are put in a batch and validated. It is enabled with Automatic Batch Invoicing on the invoice frequency.

name: stock_picking_batch_operation_quick_change
summary: Lets you change the destination location of all operations in a batch at once, using a wizard. You choose the old and new destinations, optionally for all lines.

name: stock_picking_batch_outgoing
summary: Shows the outgoing batch on the origin transfers in multi-step routes, so you can see which batch picked up each step. It depends on the first-move propagation module.

name: stock_picking_batch_packaging_qty
summary: Shows packaging quantity columns in batch transfer views, so pickers see how many boxes or packs to take in each batch and on Detailed Operations. It needs batch transfers and product packaging turned on.

name: stock_picking_batch_partner_enable
summary: Lets you exclude certain customers or suppliers from automatic batch grouping. When an operation type has automatic batches turned on, only partners marked as allowed for batch grouping are batched together. The option is on the contact form.

name: stock_picking_batch_planner
summary: Plans origin batches or waves from a destination batch with one click, using the grouping rules on the operation type, and adds smart buttons to the linked batches or waves. It is used with two-step or three-step deliveries.

name: stock_picking_batch_print_invoices
summary: Prints invoices from a batch, depending on the operation type setting: invoices only, invoices and pickings, or either. It needs the batch pickings printing module.

name: stock_picking_batch_print_pickings
summary: Prints picking documents for a whole batch at once, set per operation type with a number of copies. It needs batch transfers turned on.

name: stock_picking_batch_report
summary: Prints a batch transfer report that groups the pickings by location and lists the picking details. It is meant for the Print Batch Transfer button on a batch. The report is written for two step delivery routes only.

name: stock_picking_batch_report
summary: Lets users print a batch picking document from a batch transfer. It is a standard report add-on for batches, with the print action on the batch form.

name: stock_picking_batch_start
summary: Adds Start buttons on a batch transfer so a picker can start all the transfers in the batch at once from the batch form, instead of opening each transfer. It depends on the picking start feature, and it shows a started flag on the batch. It appears on the batch transfer form and kanban views.

name: stock_picking_batch_substate
summary: Adds a configurable sub-status field to batch transfers, so you can track more detail than the standard states. The sub-statuses are defined in Settings, Technical, Sub State Configuration. The field appears on the batch transfer form.

name: stock_picking_batch_validate_confirm
summary: When a batch is validated while some origin moves are still pending, shows a confirmation listing those moves. Users need the Validate Incomplete Batches group to confirm.

name: stock_picking_batch_validate_confirm
summary: When someone validates a batch while some sales-linked moves are still pending, a confirmation wizard lists those pending moves first. This stops a batch from being closed without the user noticing that some items were skipped. Only users with the Validate Incomplete Batches permission can confirm it.

name: stock_picking_batch_weighing
summary: Adds a button on batch transfers that opens the weighing assistant, so a batch's items can be weighed from the batch form or kanban view. It depends on the base weighing module. It is a bridge between batch transfers and weighing.

name: stock_picking_carrier
summary: Fills in the shipping method on a receipt or delivery automatically, using the one set on the customer or supplier contact. You can choose per company and per operation type whether this auto assignment is on. Carriers are set on the contact under the Sales and Purchases tab and then carried onto the transfer.

name: stock_picking_carrier_from_rule
summary: Fills in the shipping method on a transfer created by a stock rule, using the delivery method set on the partner address that the rule points to. It only fills the carrier when the transfer does not already have one. The carrier then shows on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_comment_template
summary: Adds reusable comment text to transfer documents, such as standard shipping notes or warnings, that can be inserted on the transfer and printed. You manage the comment templates under Inventory, Configuration, Document Comments. The comments show up on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_comment_template
summary: Adds reusable comment text to transfer documents, such as standard shipping notes or warnings, that can be inserted on the transfer and printed. You manage the comment templates under Inventory, Configuration, Document Comments. The comments show up on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_commercial_partner
summary: Shows the commercial entity, meaning the parent company a contact belongs to, on each transfer. You can search for transfers by that entity and group the transfers list by it, which helps when one company's deliveries should go out together. The field is read only and comes from the contact record.

name: stock_picking_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a Commercial Entity field on transfers, taken from the customer's parent company, so you can search and group transfers by the company they belong to. It appears on the transfer form and list view.

name: stock_picking_completion_info
summary: Shows a ribbon on a transfer when completing it unlocks the next chained transfers, so the operator knows the downstream step can now be processed. It is switched on per operation type.

name: stock_picking_completion_info
summary: Shows a ribbon on a transfer when finishing it would let the next chained transfers in the route be processed. It is for multi-step warehouse flows, so a picker can see that a pick or pack unlocks the next step. It is turned on per operation type.

name: stock_picking_consolidation_priority
summary: Raises the priority of all related transfers in a chain once packing has started on one of them, so an order already being picked is pushed through. It is enabled with a setting on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_customer_ref
summary: Shows the sales order's Customer Reference on each related transfer, and makes it searchable. The reference entered on the sales order appears on the delivery.

name: stock_picking_customer_ref
summary: Copies the customer reference from a sales order onto every transfer created from it, so warehouse staff can see the customer's own order number. The field can also be searched and filtered on. Edit it on the sales order and it appears on the related transfers.

name: stock_picking_date_deadline_syncs_scheduled_date
summary: Keeps a transfer's Scheduled Date aligned with its Deadline when the deadline changes, while still letting you move the scheduled date freely. Deadlines come from the sales commitment date or the move deadline.

name: stock_picking_delivery_link
summary: Shows the final delivery and its carrier on every earlier transfer in a pick, pack, and ship flow, so staff on the pick or pack can see where the goods are going. It adds a link to the delivery from each intermediate operation. A setting on the operation type can also choose the delivery package type when packing.

name: stock_picking_delivery_link
summary: Shows the final delivery and its carrier on every earlier transfer in a pick, pack, and ship flow, so staff on the pick or pack can see where the goods are going. It adds a link to the delivery from each intermediate operation.

name: stock_picking_delivery_package_type_carrier
summary: Lets you tie package types to specific shipping carriers, so that when packing a delivery only the packages a carrier accepts can be chosen. This gives finer control over which boxes or containers go with which carrier. The setting is on the package type form under Delivery Methods.

name: stock_picking_delivery_package_type_domain
summary: A technical base module that narrows the list of package types offered in the Choose Delivery Package wizard when packing a delivery with a carrier. On its own it does nothing visible, and it is meant to be extended by other modules that set the filter rules.

name: stock_picking_dock
summary: Links one or more dock doors to a transfer, so warehouse staff can record which dock a receipt or delivery is loaded or unloaded at. The Docks field appears on the transfer form. It requires the base dock management module.

name: stock_picking_filter_lot
summary: When picking goods out or scrapping them, the lot or serial number choices are limited to lots that are actually in the source location. This stops staff from picking a lot that is stored somewhere else. It applies in the detailed operations on a transfer.

name: stock_picking_filter_lot
summary: When picking goods out or scrapping them, the lot or serial number choices are limited to lots that are actually in the source location. This stops staff from picking a lot that is stored somewhere else. It applies in the detailed operations on a transfer.

name: stock_picking_filter_lot
summary: On outgoing transfers and scraps, only shows lots that exist in the origin location when you pick them. Lots need a company set for the filter to work.

name: stock_picking_grn_mandatory
summary: Makes a Goods Received Note (GRN) mandatory on selected receipt operation types, so a receipt cannot be validated until the GRN is filled in. You turn the requirement on per operation type. It depends on the GRN module, which provides the GRN field.

name: stock_picking_group_by_base
summary: Technical module that provides a helper for adding database indexes used by transfer grouping features. Developers call it from other grouping modules; it has no screens.

name: stock_picking_group_by_max_weight
summary: Limits how much weight a transfer can carry when Odoo groups moves into an existing transfer, so a grouped delivery does not exceed a maximum weight. The maximum is set per operation type. It works alongside the other grouping modules.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier
summary: Combines sales order lines going to the same customer address and carrier into one delivery order, instead of creating a separate delivery for each order. Orders set to ship only when all products are ready still get their own delivery. The delivery slip lists remaining quantities grouped by order, and grouping can be turned on per operation type or per warehouse, with a per-customer opt out.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier
summary: Combines several sales orders for the same customer and carrier into one delivery order, placed in an existing open delivery with the same address. Orders set to ship when all products are ready always get their own delivery. It is enabled per warehouse or operation type.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier
summary: Combines sales order lines going to the same customer address and carrier into one delivery order, instead of creating a separate delivery for each order. Orders set to ship only when all products are ready still get their own delivery. The delivery slip lists remaining quantities grouped by order, and grouping can be turned on per operation type or per warehouse, with a per-customer opt out.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier_by_date
summary: Adds the scheduled date to delivery grouping, so deliveries are merged only when they share the same date as well as the same customer and carrier. It is turned on per operation type.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier_force_move_type
summary: Glue module so that forcing a shipping policy on a picking type works together with grouping deliveries by partner and carrier. It is technical and has no screens.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier_sale_line_position
summary: A glue module for the delivery slip when customer deliveries are grouped. It shows the line position column only when positions are used, and adds the position to the remaining quantities list at the bottom of the report. It needs the grouping module and the sale line position module.

name: stock_picking_immediate_transfer_warning
summary: When a reserved transfer is validated without anything marked as picked, shows a warning that all reserved quantities will be processed, with Process or Discard buttons. It only appears when validating from the screen.

name: stock_picking_import_serial_number
summary: Adds an Import S/N button on receipts that loads serial numbers from an Excel file, matching each row to a product and writing its serial or package. You choose which product field to match on and which spreadsheet columns hold the product, serial, and package. This saves typing long lists of serial numbers on a large receipt.

name: stock_picking_import_serial_number
summary: Lets you import serial numbers from an Excel file onto an incoming transfer, matching products and columns set in settings. It is useful for large receipts with many serial numbers.

name: stock_picking_info_lot
summary: Adds a free text Lot Info field to each line in the detailed operations of a transfer, so lot details can be recorded even when Odoo is not tracking lots. This is useful when a third party logistics provider manages lot tracking and sends the details to you. Whether the field is optional or required is set on each product's Inventory tab.

name: stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links deliveries to the customer invoices created from their sales orders, so you can see which shipments a given invoice covers. This matters when a sale is delivered and invoiced in parts. A Pickings tab on the invoice and a Invoices link on the transfer show the connection; it only applies to products invoiced on delivery.

name: stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Base module that links transfers to invoices: each invoice gets a Pickings tab, and each transfer shows its invoices. The sales and purchase link modules are built on top of it.

name: stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links deliveries to the customer invoices created from their sales orders, so you can see which shipments a given invoice covers. This matters when a sale is delivered and invoiced in parts. A Pickings tab on the invoice and an Invoices link on the transfer show the connection; it only applies to products invoiced on delivery.

name: stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Lets you create customer invoices straight from a delivery or receipt, without going through a sales or purchase order. You can also select several transfers in the list and invoice them together in one grouped invoice. An Invoicing tab appears on transfers that have been invoiced, and a transfer's invoice status updates if its invoice is cancelled or deleted.

name: stock_picking_invoicing
summary: Lets you create invoices straight from a delivery or receipt (stock picking), without going through a sales or purchase order. A button on the picking asks to create the invoice, and selected pickings can be grouped into one invoice from the list view. An Invoicing tab then shows the invoices created from it.

name: stock_picking_invoicing_incoterm
summary: Shows the Incoterm, the standard international trade term such as FOB or CIF, on each transfer, taken from the related sales order. It is useful for export shipments where the trade terms must appear on warehouse documents. The field appears on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_kind
summary: Adds a Picking Kind field to transfers that is worked out automatically from the source and destination locations, such as receipt, delivery, or internal. It lets you filter and group transfers by what kind of movement they are, even when the operation type does not say so. It is a technical field shown on the transfer.

name: stock_picking_kind
summary: Adds a Picking Kind field to transfers, computed from the source and destination locations (for example receipt, delivery or internal), so the type of movement can be filtered.

name: stock_picking_late_activity
summary: Runs a scheduled check that finds transfers whose scheduled date has already passed for the operation types you choose, and creates an activity for a named user to update the date. It helps catch overdue receipts or deliveries that nobody has rescheduled. You turn it on per operation type and pick the responsible user there.

name: stock_picking_line_sequence
summary: Adds a sequence number to each product line on a transfer, so lines can be ordered and kept in a set order on the transfer and its printouts. You can change the order of the lines by this number. It works on stock moves within a transfer.

name: stock_picking_line_sequence
summary: Adds a sequence number to each line of a transfer and lets you reorder the lines, so they show in a fixed order.

name: stock_picking_location_check
summary: Checks at validation that the locations on each transfer line sit inside the locations set on the transfer itself, and blocks validation with an error if they do not. Users with the right permission can tick Allow Location Inconsistency to bypass the check. It protects against stock being moved into the wrong part of the warehouse.

name: stock_picking_mass_action
summary: From a transfer list, applies Mark as Todo, Check Availability, Force Availability or Transfer to many selected transfers at once. A scheduled action can also check availability in the background, and it is off by default.

name: stock_picking_mass_action
summary: Lets you confirm, check availability of, or validate many transfers at once from the Transfers list, using a wizard. It also offers an optional scheduled action that re-checks availability on outgoing confirmed transfers, which can run more often than the procurement scheduler. The scheduled action is off by default.

name: stock_picking_move_line_no_print
summary: Lets you hide chosen operation lines from a delivery slip, so the customer only sees the lines that matter. You toggle a Display in Report column on the operations of a delivery. Hidden lines still exist on the transfer and only disappear from the printout.

name: stock_picking_move_package_to_package
summary: When a whole package is moved on a transfer, lets you choose a destination package for it, so packages can be repacked into another package. The Destination Package field appears in the packages list of the transfer. It can only be edited while the moves are still in draft, and the operation type must have Move Entire Packages turned on.

name: stock_picking_mrp_mass_production_order
summary: From a receipt, internal transfer, or stock request that has been validated, creates several manufacturing orders in one step, sized to the quantities on the transfer. It checks that the quantity to produce does not exceed available stock, and it links each new order to the right pending stock move so material is not allocated twice. Requires the mass production order module.

name: stock_picking_operation_quick_change
summary: Adds a Change Location button on a transfer that changes the destination location of its operations in one step, for all lines or for one product. It saves editing each line by hand when the destination has to change. The button opens a small wizard on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_operation_quick_change
summary: Lets you change the destination location of all operations in a single transfer at once, from a wizard. You choose the old and new location, optionally for all lines.

name: stock_picking_operations_multilang
summary: Lets the Picking Operations report print in the customer's language or in the warehouse's language, instead of always using the user's language. The choice is made per warehouse under Inventory, Configuration, Warehouses. It only affects the printed report.

name: stock_picking_operations_multilang
summary: Lets the Picking Operations report print in the customer's language or in the warehouse's language, instead of always using the user's language. The choice is made per warehouse under Inventory, Configuration, Warehouses. It only affects the printed report.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference
summary: Turns the Source Document on transfers into a clickable link to the document it came from, when a matching record exists. Sales and purchase navigation is added automatically when those apps are installed.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference
summary: Makes the Source Document field on a transfer a clickable link to the sales order, purchase order, or other record it came from, when a record with that name exists. Without this, the source document is plain text you have to search for by hand. Installing it can also bring in the sales and purchase navigation extensions.
keywords: go to sales order from delivery

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_purchase
summary: Lets the Source Document link on a transfer open the purchase order it came from. It extends the source document link feature to purchase orders. It is installed automatically with the origin reference module when purchasing is installed.
keywords: open purchase order from source document

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_purchase
summary: Makes the source document link on a transfer open the originating purchase order.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_sale
summary: Makes the source document link on a transfer open the originating sales order.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_sale
summary: Lets the Source Document link on a transfer open the sales order it came from. It extends the source document link feature to sales orders. It is installed automatically with the origin reference module when sales is installed.
keywords: open sales order from source document

name: stock_picking_origin_state
summary: Shows on a transfer the status of the upstream transfers it depends on, such as whether the earlier pick or receipt is done yet. It also shows a label that combines the earlier operation type's name with its status. This helps staff see why a later step is waiting.

name: stock_picking_partner_brand
summary: Sets the brand on a transfer automatically from the customer's brand, so deliveries for a brand are labelled without manual entry. If the customer has no brand, or is cleared, the transfer's brand is cleared too. The brand is assigned on each customer contact form.

name: stock_picking_partner_note
summary: Lets you keep standing notes for the warehouse team on each customer, such as packing instructions, and have those notes appear on that customer's transfers. You define note types under Inventory, Configuration, Note Types and link them to shipping operation types. An option can stop a note from being edited or deleted while several customers use it.

name: stock_picking_partner_note
summary: Adds customer-specific preparation notes to transfers. Notes are kept on the customer, filtered by a note type set on the shipping operation type, and can be locked against edits when shared by several customers.

name: stock_picking_partner_vat
summary: Shows the customer or vendor VAT number on the transfer form and on the Picking Operations and Delivery Slip reports.

name: stock_picking_portal
summary: Lets customers log in to the portal and see their delivery orders under a Stock Operations menu, with the document number, date, delivery address, and items. Customers can sign a delivery in the portal, and you can create a shareable link to a delivery so a person without a login can sign it. You choose which operation types are visible to customers in Inventory settings.

name: stock_picking_portal
summary: Lets customers log in to the portal and see their delivery orders under a Stock Operations menu, with the document number, date, delivery address, and items. Customers can sign a delivery in the portal, and you can create a shareable link to a delivery so a person without a login can sign it. You choose which operation types are visible to customers in Inventory settings.

name: stock_picking_portal_owner
summary: Adds a My Consigned Pickings section to the customer portal, where a consignment owner can see the transfers of goods they own that are stored in your warehouse. Access is read only and limited to operation types set as visible in the portal. Each transfer needs its Owner set.

name: stock_picking_procure_method
summary: Lets you set a transfer's supply method to Apply Procurement Rules instead of Take From Stock, so creating the transfer can trigger a make to order or buy flow. This is how you start a multi warehouse resupply from the transfer itself. The supply method is a field on the transfer, and it needs multi step routes and the relevant replenishment routes set up.

name: stock_picking_procure_method
summary: Lets a transfer use the Apply Procurement Rules supply method instead of Take From Stock, so a planned transfer can trigger make-to-order flows such as purchases or manufacturing. It is set in the Supply Method field on the transfer.

name: stock_picking_product_assortment
summary: Limits which products can be added to an outgoing transfer for a customer, based on the customer's product assortment whitelist and blacklist. Products on the whitelist are allowed, and products on the blacklist cannot be selected. The assortment is set up on the customer through the product assortment module.

name: stock_picking_product_assortment
summary: Limits the products that can be added to a transfer for a partner to that partner's product assortment, so only allowed products (or only non-blacklisted ones) can be picked. It uses the product_assortment setup.

name: stock_picking_product_availability_inline
summary: Shows each product's free to use quantity right in the product dropdown on a transfer line, so staff can see stock while choosing the product. It does not change which products can be picked. The number appears as part of the product name in the Operations list on the transfer form.
keywords: free to use quantity product list

name: stock_picking_product_barcode_report
summary: Lets you print barcode labels for the products on a transfer, choosing how many labels to print for each line. You pick a label report and can set a default one under Inventory settings, Barcode Format. Labels are printed from the Print menu on a validated transfer.

name: stock_picking_product_barcode_report
summary: Lets you print barcode labels for the products on a transfer, choosing how many labels to print for each line. You pick a label report and can set a default one under Inventory settings, Barcode Format. Labels are printed from the Print menu on a validated transfer.

name: stock_picking_product_barcode_report_secondary_unit
summary: Sets the default number of barcode labels to print based on a product's secondary unit of measure, such as cases or pallets. It extends the barcode label wizard and needs the Units of Measure setting turned on along with the secondary unit feature.
keywords: default label count unit of measure

name: stock_picking_product_barcode_report_secondary_unit
summary: Sets the default number of barcode labels to print based on a product's secondary unit of measure, such as cases or pallets. It extends the barcode label wizard and needs the Units of Measure setting turned on along with the secondary unit feature.
keywords: default label count unit of measure

name: stock_picking_product_interchangeable
summary: Lets a sales order fall back to a substitute product when the ordered item is short. If the original product lacks enough stock, its interchangeable substitute is added to the delivery to complete the order. You set the substitute products and a mode, such as only if everything is available, on delivery operation types.
keywords: replacement product when out of stock

name: stock_picking_product_link
summary: Adds a Product smart button on a transfer that shows how many products are in it and opens the product list for that transfer when clicked. It is a quick way to see the products in a transfer from the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_progress
summary: Shows a percentage progress on each transfer, lines, and move line, based on how much of the planned quantity has been marked done so far. A transfer's progress is the average of its lines. It helps staff see at a glance how far along a receipt or delivery is.

name: stock_picking_progress
summary: Adds a progress percentage on moves (share of quantity processed) and on transfers (the average across their moves). It is shown on the transfer and move views.

name: stock_picking_propagate_scheduled_date
summary: When a move's scheduled date changes, the same time shift is applied to the chained moves downstream, keeping a multi-step delivery in sync.

name: stock_picking_purchase_order_link
summary: Adds a Purchase Order smart button on a receipt that opens the purchase order that created it. It is a quick way to go from a receipt to the buying document behind it. It needs the purchase and inventory integration to be installed.

name: stock_picking_purchase_order_link
summary: Adds a Purchase Order smart button on a receipt that opens the purchase order that created it. It is a quick way to go from a receipt to the buying document behind it. It needs the purchase and inventory integration to be installed.

name: stock_picking_purchase_order_link
summary: Adds a Purchase Order smart button on a receipt that opens the purchase order it was created from.

name: stock_picking_putaway_recompute
summary: Lets you refresh the destination locations on a transfer after putaway rules have changed, so stock lands in the new spots. A Recompute Putaways button appears on the transfer and on its detailed operations, and it only changes lines that have no quantity done yet and no destination package. It must be enabled on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_putinpack_restriction
summary: Lets you require or forbid a destination package on an operation type, so a receipt or delivery must always be packed into a package, or never is. When packages are forbidden the Put in Pack button is hidden on those transfers. Set it on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_quick
summary: Lets you add or update many products on a transfer at once from a product list, by entering the quantity to process for each one. A zero quantity removes that line again. It is a faster way to fill in a transfer than adding lines one at a time.

name: stock_picking_report_custom_description
summary: Copies the description typed on a sales order line, such as a custom product note, onto the matching transfer line, and prints it on the delivery slip and picking reports. If the sales line text changes later, the transfer text follows. You see it on the transfer from the sales order's Delivery smart button.

name: stock_picking_report_custom_description
summary: Copies the description typed on a sales order line, such as a custom product note, onto the matching transfer line, and prints it on the delivery slip and picking reports. If the sales line text changes later, the transfer text follows. You see it on the transfer from the sales order's Delivery smart button.

name: stock_picking_report_delivery_cost
summary: Shows the shipping charge for the delivery method on the delivery slip and the picking operations printout. The cost is calculated on the fly with the same rules the standard delivery module uses. It appears only on transfers that are not yet done or cancelled.

name: stock_picking_report_delivery_cost
summary: Shows the shipping charge for the delivery method on the delivery slip and the picking operations printout. The cost is calculated on the fly with the same rules the standard delivery module uses. It appears only on transfers that are not yet done or cancelled.

name: stock_picking_report_delivery_custom_name
summary: On printed delivery slips, shows the description you typed for a line in place of the internal product name, whenever a description is set. A default delivery description can be set on each product for customers to see. It changes only what is printed, not the product itself.

name: stock_picking_report_delivery_driver
summary: Prints the name of the delivery driver on the delivery slip and the picking operations report for delivery transfers. The driver comes from the shipping method used on the sales order. It only affects the printed documents.

name: stock_picking_report_external_note
summary: Adds an External Notes field on transfers that is printed on customer-facing reports such as the delivery slip. Use it for messages the customer should see, as opposed to internal notes. The field is on the Notes tab of the transfer.

name: stock_picking_report_external_note
summary: Adds an External Notes field on transfers that is printed on customer-facing reports such as the delivery slip. Use it for messages the customer should see, as opposed to internal notes. The field is on the Notes tab of the transfer.

name: stock_picking_report_external_note
summary: Adds an External Notes field on transfers that is printed on customer-facing reports such as the delivery slip. Use it for messages the customer should see, as opposed to internal notes. The field is on the Notes tab of the transfer.

name: stock_picking_report_header_repeater
summary: Changes the delivery document report so the header block, such as the company and address details, repeats at the top of every page when a transfer runs to several pages. It is a print layout change only.

name: stock_picking_report_header_repeater
summary: Changes the delivery document report so the header block, such as the company and address details, repeats at the top of every page when a transfer runs to several pages. It is a print layout change only.

name: stock_picking_report_incoming_delivery_address
summary: Shows the pick-up address on the printed delivery slip and picking operations report for incoming transfers, such as customer returns. The option is set on the operation type. Without it, incoming reports show no address for where the goods came from.

name: stock_picking_report_internal_delivery_address
summary: Shows the delivery address on the printed reports for internal transfers, which normally carry no address. It is a print change only for transfers whose operation type is internal.

name: stock_picking_report_internal_delivery_address
summary: Shows the delivery address on the printed reports for internal transfers, which normally carry no address. It is a print change only for transfers whose operation type is internal.

name: stock_picking_report_printed_flag
summary: Keeps track of whether a transfer's warehouse documents have been printed, and which reports were printed. You can filter transfers to Printed or Not Printed and group them by printed report name. It builds on the printed flag module and works across companies.

name: stock_picking_report_product_sticker
summary: Prints product stickers on the delivery slip, at a position you choose on the operation type or on each transfer. Stickers are product labels such as fragile or handle with care, and the setting can also be switched off per transfer. It is a printed layout feature for delivery slips.

name: stock_picking_report_product_sticker
summary: Prints product stickers on the delivery slip, at a position you choose on the operation type or on each transfer. Stickers are product labels such as fragile or handle with care, and the setting can also be switched off per transfer. It is a printed layout feature for delivery slips.

name: stock_picking_report_qty_undelivered
summary: Adds a summary of the quantities that were not delivered to the delivery slip, for operation types where you turn it on. It shows which products fell short after a partial validation without a backorder. It is a printed report change only.

name: stock_picking_report_salesperson
summary: Prints the salesperson's name on the delivery slip and picking operations report for deliveries that come from a sale. The name is taken from the related sales order. It only affects the printed documents.

name: stock_picking_report_summary
summary: Lets you select several transfers and print one PDF summary showing total quantities per product, plus a detail section listing each delivery. You can choose whether to show prices. It is useful for checking a batch of deliveries before preparing them.

name: stock_picking_report_summary
summary: Lets you select several transfers and print one PDF summary showing total quantities per product, plus a detail section listing each delivery. You can choose whether to show prices. It is useful for checking a batch of deliveries before preparing them.

name: stock_picking_report_valued
summary: Adds the sales value of the goods to the delivery slip, with untaxed amount, tax, and total, for customers you flag as valued. The value uses the quantity done if the transfer is done, and the reserved quantity otherwise. Set the Valued Picking option on the customer's Sales and Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_report_valued
summary: Adds the sales value of the goods to the delivery slip, with untaxed amount, tax, and total, for customers you flag as valued. The value uses the quantity done if the transfer is done, and the reserved quantity otherwise. A Valued checkbox can also be set on each transfer, which overrides the customer setting when the company option is on.

name: stock_picking_report_valued
summary: Adds the sales value of the goods to the delivery slip, with untaxed amount, tax, and total, for customers you flag as valued. The value uses the quantity done if the transfer is done, and the reserved quantity otherwise. Set the Valued Picking option on the customer's Sales and Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_report_valued
summary: Adds the sales value of the goods to the delivery slip, with untaxed amount, tax, and total, for customers you flag as valued. The value uses the quantity done if the transfer is done, and the reserved quantity otherwise. Set the Valued Picking option on the customer's Sales and Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_report_valued_sale_mrp
summary: Makes the valued delivery slip correct when a sold product is a kit. The kit's components are shown as one kit line on the slip, and the total reflects the kit price, including components that have serial or lot numbers. It applies to sales of kit products delivered from stock.
keywords: bill of materials kit valued picking

name: stock_picking_report_valued_sale_mrp
summary: Makes the valued delivery slip correct when a sold product is a kit. The kit's components are shown as one kit line on the slip, and the total reflects the kit price, including components that have serial or lot numbers. It applies to sales of kit products delivered from stock.
keywords: bill of materials kit valued picking

name: stock_picking_report_without_order_qty
summary: Hides the quantity column on the delivery note report, so the printed slip does not show the ordered quantity. It is a print-only layout change for the delivery slip.

name: stock_picking_reservation_policy
summary: Lets you choose, per operation type or per transfer, whether stock is reserved as much as possible or all or nothing per line. With all or nothing, a line is reserved only if its full quantity is in stock, so partly available lines stay unreserved. It works at reservation time and does not touch lines fed by chained moves.

name: stock_picking_restrict_cancel_printed
summary: Blocks cancelling a transfer once its documents have been printed, and shows the printed flag on the transfer form. A message tells the user they cannot cancel a transfer that is already printed. The rule can be turned off per operation type with the Restrict cancelation if printed option.

name: stock_picking_restrict_cancel_printed
summary: Shows a printed flag on transfers and blocks cancelling a transfer once it has been printed, unless the operation type allows it. The restriction is set per operation type.

name: stock_picking_restrict_cancel_with_orig_move
summary: Stops a transfer from being cancelled when it is part of a chain of moves whose earlier steps are still open. When someone tries, Odoo shows an error listing the earlier transfers so they can be dealt with first. It applies to operation types where the 'Restrict Cancellation with Original Moves' option is turned on.

name: stock_picking_restrict_partial_validation
summary: Lets you require that transfers of a chosen operation type are either fully reserved and moved in full, or not validated at all. This suits all-or-nothing transfers such as kit movements, where no backorder should ever be created. The option is switched on per operation type under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types, and users get a blocking message if they try to validate early or for less than the demand.

name: stock_picking_return_empty_package
summary: When a customer returns a package, puts only the goods inside back into stock and not the package itself. This stops an empty box or pallet from being counted as inventory on a return. It is turned on for the return operation type with the Empty package at return option.

name: stock_picking_return_empty_package
summary: When goods come back from a customer in a package, this makes sure only the package contents go back into stock and the empty package itself does not. It is switched on with an 'Empty package at return' option on the return operation type. The effect shows up on the return transfer in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_return_lot
summary: On a return of lot or serial tracked goods, creates a separate return line for each lot and fills it in with the lot from the original delivery. This makes it clear which lot or serial number may be received back, so the wrong one is not accepted. It relies on the restrict lot module to enforce the match.

name: stock_picking_return_lot
summary: On a return of lot or serial tracked goods, creates a separate return line for each lot and fills it in with the lot from the original delivery. This makes it clear which lot or serial number may be received back, so the wrong one is not accepted. It relies on the restrict lot module to enforce the match.

name: stock_picking_return_lot
summary: When returning a lot or serial-tracked product, the return is split into one line per lot and pre-filled with the lots from the original delivery. That way the receiver knows exactly which lot numbers are accepted back. It is reached from the Return button on a done receipt or delivery in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_return_refund_option
summary: Lets you change whether a returned product should be refunded to the customer after the sales or purchase order is already confirmed and invoiced. It is for the case where goods come back after an invoice has been made. The refund choice is set on the transfer.

name: stock_picking_return_refund_option
summary: Lets you change the refund option on delivery moves after they are confirmed, so returned products can be refunded even after an invoice exists. It works for sales and purchase orders, by updating the To Refund option on the delivery. Use it when a customer or supplier returns goods after invoicing.

name: stock_picking_return_restricted_qty
summary: Stops a return from being larger than what was actually delivered. If a user tries to return more than was shipped, Odoo shows a warning. It is turned on per operation type with the 'Restrict Return Quantity' checkbox in Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_return_restricted_qty
summary: Stops a return from being larger than the quantity that was actually delivered. Trying to return more than was delivered shows a warning. You turn the check on per operation type with the Restrict Return Quantity option.

name: stock_picking_sale_order_link
summary: Adds a Sales Order smart button on a transfer that opens the sales order it came from. It is a quick way to move from a delivery back to the sale. It needs the sales and inventory integration.

name: stock_picking_sale_order_link
summary: Adds a Sales Order smart button on transfers so you can jump from a delivery straight to the sale that created it. It is shown on the transfer form once a delivery has been generated from a confirmed sales order. It lives in Inventory on the transfer form and links back to Sales.

name: stock_picking_send_by_mail
summary: Lets you email a delivery order to a contact straight from the transfer, using the standard send by email window. You open the transfer, choose Send by Email, and send it. It is useful when a customer or carrier needs the delivery document in their inbox.

name: stock_picking_send_by_mail
summary: Lets you email a delivery order to someone directly from the transfer. A Send by Email button on the Delivery Order opens the standard mail composer with the picking attached. It is used from the Inventory transfer form.

name: stock_picking_show_backorder
summary: Shows on a transfer which backorders were created from it, in a new tab on the form. This is handy when a partial receipt or delivery has been validated and you want to see the remaining transfers at a glance. It appears on the transfer form in Inventory after you create a backorder.

name: stock_picking_show_linked
summary: Adds a smart button on a transfer to open the previous transfers in a chained route, so you can move between linked steps quickly. It is useful with multi-step deliveries and receipts.

name: stock_picking_show_linked
summary: Adds smart buttons on a transfer that open the transfers before it and after it in a chained route, such as the pick that feeds a pack. It makes it easy to move between the steps of a multi-step delivery or receipt. The buttons appear on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_show_linked
summary: Adds smart buttons on a transfer that open the transfers before it and after it in a chained route, such as the pick that feeds a pack. It makes it easy to move between the steps of a multi-step delivery or receipt. The buttons appear on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_show_lot
summary: Adds a button on transfers to open the lot or serial numbers created from that transfer, for operation types set to create new lots on the fly. It saves hunting through the lot list to find what was just entered. It appears on the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_show_return
summary: Adds a Returns tab on a transfer that has returns, listing the return transfers that came from it. On a returned transfer it also adds an Origin picking button to jump back to the original transfer. Both appear on the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_show_return
summary: Shows the returns made from a transfer on a Returns tab, and shows the original transfer on a returned transfer through an Origin picking button. It lets you trace a return back to the delivery it came from without searching. The tab and button appear on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_stage
summary: Adds a Stage field to transfers so you can track where each one sits in your own workflow, using colored stages you define. The stages are kept in their own list and shown on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_start
summary: Adds a Start button on a transfer that marks it as started, which stops new product lines from being added while the picker is working on it. You can also choose to assign the responsible user only when the picking starts, from Inventory settings. It is a simple way to lock a transfer once picking begins.

name: stock_picking_status_notification
summary: Sends an in-app notification to chosen internal users when a transfer reaches a state you care about, such as Waiting or Ready. Notification rules are set up by operation type and source document pattern, and the first matching rule is used. The notification has the document number, a message, and a button that opens the transfer.

name: stock_picking_supplier_ref
summary: Adds a Supplier Delivery Reference field on receipts, to hold the vendor's own reference or delivery note number, and makes it searchable. The field only appears on incoming transfers.

name: stock_picking_supplier_ref
summary: Adds a Supplier Reference field to receipts so you can record the supplier's own reference number and search receipts by it. The field appears only on incoming transfers. It is useful for matching receipts to the supplier's documents.

name: stock_picking_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to transfers. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve in tiers, and only then can the transfer be validated. Reviewers can filter for transfers that need their review, and the tiers are set up under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: stock_picking_to_batch_group_fields
summary: When you add selected transfers to a new batch, lets you group them by chosen fields, so Odoo creates one batch per group. For example, you can split transfers into batches by carrier or by customer. It needs the batch transfers feature turned on.

name: stock_picking_to_batch_group_fields
summary: When grouping selected transfers into a new batch, you can choose one or more fields (such as customer, carrier or destination) to split them into separate batches. It makes it easier to prepare grouped shipments in one go. It is used from Inventory > Overview via Action > Add to batch, after batches are enabled in Settings.

name: stock_picking_type_bypass_reservation
summary: Lets an operation type reserve stock even when there is not enough on hand, so an outgoing or internal transfer shows as fully reserved. The extra quantity is flagged as a phantom reservation on the move line. It is turned on from the operation type with debug mode on.

name: stock_picking_type_bypass_reservation
summary: Lets an operation type reserve stock even when there is none on hand, so the transfer shows as fully reserved. This is mainly useful for testing or for flows where physical stock is handled outside Odoo. The option is set on an Internal or Outgoing operation type in Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types, with debug mode on.

name: stock_picking_type_force_move_type
summary: Forces the shipping policy on an operation type so it overrides the policy set on the sales procurement group. This is useful in pick, pack and ship setups where the pick step should wait until all goods are available. It is set on the operation type under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_type_shipping_policy
summary: Lets each operation type force its own shipping policy, such as ship as soon as possible or ship all at once, onto the transfers it creates. This matters in pick, pack, ship setups with split routes, where the pack step must wait for all the picks. The policy is set on the operation type.
keywords: wait for all picks before pack

name: stock_picking_type_shipping_policy
summary: Lets each operation type force its own shipping policy, such as ship as soon as possible or ship all at once, onto the transfers it creates. This matters in pick, pack, ship setups with split routes, where the pack step must wait for all the picks. The policy is set on the operation type.
keywords: wait for all picks before pack

name: stock_picking_type_user_restriction
summary: Limits which operation types a user can see and use, so each person only works with the transfer types assigned to them. Other operation types are hidden from them. A stock manager sets the assigned users on the operation type, and the user needs the restricted group to get this behaviour.
keywords: user sees only own warehouse operations
users see only their operation types

name: stock_picking_unreserve_button
summary: Adds an Unreserve button on the transfer form to release the stock reserved for it, so the reservation can be recalculated or the quantities changed. The standard button was removed in newer versions, and this brings it back. It is used when a transfer holds stock that should go to another order.

name: stock_picking_variable_qty
summary: For multi-step deliveries, the quantity processed at the first step (such as Pick) can differ from what was ordered, and the later steps then follow that actual quantity. When the option is enabled on the upstream operation type, validating a step updates the downstream moves to match. It is set under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_volume
summary: Calculates the volume of goods on each transfer and on each stock move, using the product dimensions. This helps estimate how many trucks or which handling device a transfer needs. The volume is shown on the transfer form and the move form, and it depends on each line's state and quantities.

name: stock_picking_volume
summary: Computes the total volume of each transfer and its moves from product dimensions, so you know its size for planning trucks or handling equipment. The value follows the move state, using the done quantity or the quantity still to do.

name: stock_picking_volume
summary: Calculates the volume of goods on each transfer and on each stock move, using the product dimensions. This helps estimate how many trucks or which handling device a transfer needs. The volume is shown on the transfer form and the move form, and it depends on each line's state and quantities.

name: stock_picking_volume_packaging
summary: Refines the transfer volume by using the volume of the product packaging that can be picked for a move, where that volume is recorded. Where packaging has no volume, it falls back to the product volume.

name: stock_picking_volume_packaging
summary: Improves the volume of each stock move by using the volume of the packaging that would be picked to fill it, instead of only the product volume. Packagings without a volume are ignored. It is for businesses that record packaging dimensions, and it is mostly used by warehouse picking apps.

name: stock_picking_warn_message
summary: Shows a warning banner at the top of a transfer when the chosen customer or vendor has a warning set on their contact. Users need the Warnings option turned on in Inventory settings first. Warnings are then set on each partner record.

name: stock_picking_warn_message
summary: Adds a warning field on transfers, shown as a popup, so a warning is set when a transfer is created or changed, not only when the customer is changed. It is a technical hook for warning text that the warehouse team needs to see. It adds fields to the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_whole_scrap
summary: Lets you scrap all the quantities on a transfer in one step, including lots, owners and packages. A Scrap All button on a delivery opens a wizard prefilled with every line so you can review and confirm. It is used from Inventory > Dashboard > Delivery Orders.

name: stock_portal_lot_list_download
summary: Lets a customer logged into the portal download an Excel file listing the serial or lot numbers in each delivery of their sales order. The download appears on the sales order in the portal, only for deliveries that include lot or serial tracked products. It saves customers from asking which serial numbers they received.

name: stock_procurement_customer
summary: Stores a customer on the procurement group, which is the record that links a sale to its stock moves, and passes it on to the transfer. This is useful when the customer on the transfer is different from the party that receives the goods. The customer field is on the procurement group and the transfer; it does nothing alone and needs another module to use it.

name: stock_product_demand_info
summary: Shows how much of a product was sold or used over periods you define, such as the last 7 days or the last year, on the product and on the reordering rules. You define the periods under Inventory settings, Products, Demand Periods, using the same date expressions as Odoo domains. It helps judge stock levels against past demand.

name: stock_product_pack
summary: Makes a pack product show the stock it can actually provide, calculated from its components, for both On Hand and Forecasted quantities. Moves for the components are used instead of a move for the pack itself. Packs are set up on the product form with Is Pack checked, a pack type, and a component price.

name: stock_product_pack
summary: Shows On Hand and Forecasted quantities for a pack based on the stock of its components, so you can see how many packs can be made. Packs can be set so they do not create their own stock moves, and component moves are created as usual.

name: stock_product_qty_by_packaging
summary: Glue module that shows the quantity in packaging terms (for example 3 boxes) on stock moves, move lines and quants, and displays it on the move lines of a transfer. It needs the packaging calculator.

name: stock_product_qty_by_packaging
summary: Adds the quantity expressed in packagings, such as cartons or pallets, to stock moves, move lines, and stock quants. It shows that breakdown in the picking's move line view. It connects the packaging calculator to the stock screens.

name: stock_product_security
summary: Adds an Inventory access level called User: Manage Products, which lets a user create and edit products while keeping the rest of the inventory user rights. You assign it on the user form in the Inventory section. It is a permissions setting only.

name: stock_product_set
summary: Lets you add a predefined product set (a bundle of products) to a planned transfer in one click, with a line created for each product. It saves typing the same group of products over and over. It is used from the Add set button on a planned transfer in Inventory.

name: stock_product_template_tags
summary: Shows the Product Tags menu inside the Inventory app, so users can find and manage product tags without leaving Inventory. It only adds a menu entry and has no other effect.

name: stock_production_lot_active
summary: Lets you archive lots and serial numbers that are no longer needed, and restore them later. Archived lots drop out of everyday lists so they stop cluttering selections. It appears on the lot and serial number records in Inventory.

name: stock_production_lot_expired_date
summary: Helps fill in expiry dates for lots and serial numbers faster by calculating them from a base date you choose in Inventory settings under Traceability. When you enter a lot's manufacturing or other base date, the expiry date is filled in from it. It needs the product expiry module.

name: stock_production_lot_expired_date
summary: Helps fill in expiry dates for lots and serial numbers faster by calculating them from a base date you choose in Inventory settings under Traceability. When you enter a lot's base date, the expiry date is filled in from it. It needs the product expiry module.

name: stock_production_lot_quantity_tree
summary: Shows the quantity on hand for each lot or serial number in the lots list view. It saves opening each lot to see how much stock it holds. It is a list view change only.

name: stock_pull_list
summary: Builds a pull list for a location that shows, for each product, the shortfall between what is needed and what is available, including incoming stock. From that list you can create procurements for the shortfall quantities, grouped as you choose. It is started from Inventory, Operations, Generate Pull List.

name: stock_push_delay
summary: Lets you re-run the push rules on a finished transfer, so the transfer can be split or routed again to the right final location. It does nothing if no push rule applies. It is used when the work of a transfer needs to follow the push rules after the fact.

name: stock_putaway_hook
summary: A technical base module that adds hooks so other modules can plug in their own putaway strategies, which decide where received goods are stored. It also makes the rule fields on the putaway views change as needed. It has no effect for users until another module adds a strategy.

name: stock_putaway_hook
summary: A technical base module that adds hooks so other modules can plug in their own putaway strategies, which decide where received goods are stored. It also makes the rule fields on the putaway views change as needed. It has no effect for users until another module adds a strategy.

name: stock_putaway_last_location
summary: When a product is put away, Odoo can suggest the location where that product was last put away, instead of the usual default. This keeps stock of the same product in the same place. It is turned on per location with the Putaway Default To Last Location option, which needs Storage Locations enabled in Inventory settings.

name: stock_putaway_product_template
summary: Lets you define putaway rules for a product template from the product form, so one rule covers all of its variants instead of one rule per variant. Storage locations must be turned on, and the user needs the push and pull flows permission. The rules are listed under the Putaway rules tab on the product.

name: stock_putaway_product_template
summary: Lets you define putaway rules on the product template from the product form, instead of on each variant. It requires Storage Locations and the push and pull flows setting.

name: stock_putaway_rule_product_handle
summary: Shows a drag handle on product putaway rules so a stock manager can reorder them by dragging. The order sets which rule is applied first. Only stock managers can change the order.

name: stock_quant_available_quantity
summary: Adds the Available Quantity column back to the stock quant views under Reporting, Locations. It shows how much of each stock line is free to use, which older versions of Odoo displayed. It is a view change only.

name: stock_quant_cost_info
summary: Adds an Adjustment Cost column to the quant details of inventory adjustments, showing the value of the difference between the counted and the theoretical quantity at the product cost. It is also shown in the PDF report of the adjustment. The cost updates when the counted quantity changes.

name: stock_quant_cost_info
summary: Adds an Adjustment Cost column to the Physical Inventory details and its PDF report, calculated as the counted-minus-theoretical quantity times the product cost. It shows the value effect of a stock count before you apply it.

name: stock_quant_expiration_date_tree
summary: Shows the expiration, use, and alert dates for each stock quant in the stock quant list view. This lets you see when stock at each location is due to expire. It needs the product expiry module.

name: stock_quant_history
summary: Lets you look back at stock as it was on a past date. You take a snapshot for a chosen date under Reporting, History, Stock Snapshot, then open the snapshot to see the quantities per product and location at that time, and compare them. The first snapshot is built from all past stock moves in the database.

name: stock_quant_history_queued
summary: Makes stock snapshot generation run in the background using the queue job feature, so large snapshots do not tie up the screen. A snapshot shows an In Progress state while it is being built. It extends the stock history snapshot feature.

name: stock_quant_lock
summary: Locks chosen stock so other operations cannot use it. Odoo reserves the unreserved quantity with a special lock transfer, and unlocking cancels that transfer to release the stock. The lock is recorded through standard stock documents, so the history stays traceable, and only operation types set to Allow quant lock can be used.

name: stock_quant_manual_assign
summary: Lets you choose which exact stock lines, such as specific lots, packages or locations, a transfer line reserves, instead of accepting Odoo's automatic choice. You open the Manual Quants wizard from the tag icon on the move line, select the quants, and confirm. It gives detailed control over which goods leave the warehouse.

name: stock_quant_manual_assign
summary: Lets you choose which exact stock lines, such as specific lots, packages or locations, a transfer line reserves, instead of accepting Odoo's automatic choice. You open the Manual Quants wizard from the tag icon on the move line, select the quants, and confirm. It gives detailed control over which goods leave the warehouse.

name: stock_quant_package_archive
summary: Lets you archive stock packages so they no longer show in lists, without deleting them. Archived packages can be shown again by removing the archive filter. It is a small housekeeping option on the package record.

name: stock_quant_package_dimension
summary: Adds length, width, height, volume, and weight fields to each stock package, plus an estimated weight in kilograms. This lets you record how big and heavy a pallet or box is. The fields appear on the package form.

name: stock_quant_package_dimension
summary: Adds length, width, height, volume, and weight fields to each stock package, plus an estimated weight in kilograms. This lets you record how big and heavy a pallet or box is. The fields appear on the package form.

name: stock_quant_package_dimension
summary: Adds length, width, height, volume, and weight fields to each stock package. This lets you record how big and heavy a pallet or box is. The fields appear on the package form.

name: stock_quant_package_dimension_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Estimates the weight of a package from the packaging dimensions and the products in it, and stores that estimate on the package. It builds on the package dimension and packaging weight modules. It helps when packages are not weighed.

name: stock_quant_package_multi_reference
summary: Lets one package carry several reference codes, such as a supplier barcode and an internal number, with one marked as the main reference. The main reference is what shows on the package. Each reference has a priority order.

name: stock_quant_package_product_packaging
summary: Assigns a product packaging type to a package automatically when the package holds only one product and the quantity matches that packaging, such as a full carton. It also works out the package type from the number of products inside. This keeps package records consistent after moves are done.

name: stock_quant_package_product_packaging
summary: Assigns a product packaging type to a package automatically when the package holds only one product and the quantity matches that packaging, such as a full carton. This keeps package records consistent after moves are done.

name: stock_quant_package_product_packaging
summary: Assigns a product packaging type to a package automatically when the package holds only one product and the quantity matches that packaging, such as a full carton. This keeps package records consistent after moves are done.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info
summary: Shows which transfers or manufacturing orders are holding reserved stock for a product, and lets you open them from the product's stock view. It answers the question of why on hand stock is not free to use. The button sits next to the reserved quantity on the product.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info
summary: Lets you see, from a product's on-hand view, which transfers or manufacturing orders are reserving its stock, and jump to them. A button next to the reserved quantity opens the related transfers.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info_mrp
summary: Extends the product reservation view so that manufacturing orders holding reserved stock are listed and can be opened, alongside transfers. It needs the reservation info module and manufacturing. The button next to the reserved quantity shows the related MO.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info_mrp
summary: Extends the reservation lookup so reserved stock can be traced to the manufacturing order holding it, not only to transfers. It needs Manufacturing installed.

name: stock_quant_safe_inventory
summary: Stops a stock count adjustment from changing a quantity while the same product, location, lot, and package are already marked as picked on a transfer that has not been validated yet. This prevents a count from being overwritten mid-picking. It is turned on in Inventory settings.

name: stock_quantity_history_location
summary: Lets you run an inventory report for a chosen location as of a past date, or as of today. You open Reporting, Locations, choose Inventory at Date and Location, pick the location and the date, then confirm. It shows what was in that location at that time.

name: stock_quantity_history_location
summary: Lets you run an inventory or inventory valuation report for a chosen location as of a past date, or as of today. You turn on storage locations, then go to Reporting, Locations, Inventory at Date and Location, choose the location and date, and confirm. It shows what was in that location at that time.

name: stock_receipt_lot_info
summary: When receiving lot or serial tracked goods, lets you type in the best before, removal, and alert dates yourself instead of accepting the dates Odoo calculates. Optional columns on the receipt's detailed operations hold the extra fields. The values you enter are stored on the lot.

name: stock_receipt_lot_info
summary: When receiving lots or serial numbers, you can enter the best-before, removal and alert dates yourself instead of accepting the automatic calculations. These dates appear as optional columns in the detailed operations on a receipt. The lots then keep those dates, which is useful for expiry-tracked stock.

name: stock_reception_discrepancy_distribution
summary: When a receipt brings in more than was ordered and that stock was meant for several customer orders, a wizard lets you decide how to share the extra between those orders. This avoids creating an extra outgoing transfer. It appears on the receipt before it is validated, and needs the multi-step routes and Replenish on Order (MTO) route set up.

name: stock_release_channel
summary: Splits outgoing transfers into named release channels, such as pallets only or parcels only, so warehouse work can be managed in batches. Each transfer is placed in the first channel whose rule it matches, and a kanban dashboard shows how many transfers are to do, released, done, or late in each channel. Channels are set up by stock managers under Inventory, Configuration, Release Channels.

name: stock_release_channel
summary: Splits outgoing transfers into named release channels, such as pallets only or parcels only, so warehouse work can be managed in batches. Each transfer is placed in the first channel whose rule it matches, and a kanban dashboard shows how many transfers are to do, released, done, or late in each channel. Channels are set up by stock managers under Inventory, Configuration, Release Channels.

name: stock_release_channel_auto_release
summary: Adds an Automatic release mode to release channels, so transfers are released as soon as they enter the channel or as stock becomes available, without someone pressing the release button. Batch mode stays the default. Automatic release stops while the channel is locked.

name: stock_release_channel_auto_release
summary: Adds an Automatic release mode to release channels, so transfers are released as soon as they enter the channel or as stock becomes available, without someone pressing the release button. Batch mode stays the default. Automatic release stops while the channel is locked.

name: stock_release_channel_batch_mode_commercial_partner
summary: Releases transfers in a channel together by commercial entity, so that all deliveries for one parent company go out in the same batch. This suits customers whose sites are shipped by the same carrier to the same place. You select the Grouped by Commercial Entity batch mode on the channel.

name: stock_release_channel_carrier_alternative
summary: A glue module that connects release channels to alternative carriers. When a released transfer gets a new transfer with a different carrier, the channel is checked again for that new transfer, and if no channel fits, the new transfer is not released. It is a technical bridge for warehouses that use both features.

name: stock_release_channel_cutoff
summary: Adds a daily cutoff time to each release channel, and turns the cutoff time red on the channel's kanban card once the time has passed while the channel is still open. This warns staff that orders have missed the carrier pickup or day's cutoff. The time is set on the channel form.

name: stock_release_channel_cutoff
summary: Adds a daily cutoff time to each release channel, and turns the cutoff time red on the channel's kanban card once the time has passed while the channel is still open. This warns staff that orders have missed the carrier pickup or day's cutoff. The time is set on the channel form.

name: stock_release_channel_delivery
summary: Adds a Shipping Methods filter to release channels, so a channel only takes transfers using the carriers you pick. This is a more direct alternative to writing a domain when you do not split deliveries into separate operation types per carrier. The field is on the channel form under selection criteria.

name: stock_release_channel_delivery
summary: Adds a Shipping Methods filter to release channels, so a channel only takes transfers using the carriers you pick. This is a more direct alternative to writing a domain when you do not split deliveries into separate operation types per carrier. The field is on the channel form under selection criteria.

name: stock_release_channel_depot
summary: Adds a depot to release channels and to transfers, so a channel can be set up to release deliveries for a particular depot. The depot is picked on the channel and carried onto the transfer. It needs the depot module for stock.

name: stock_release_channel_geoengine
summary: Restricts a release channel to customers located inside a chosen delivery zone on a map. When a zone is set, only deliveries for customers in that zone are selected for the channel. Individual customers can be excluded from location-based selection on their contact form.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_address
summary: Lets a release channel be limited to certain countries and states, matched against the customer's address on each transfer. A channel with no countries or states set takes transfers from any address. It is a simple way to split deliveries by region.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_by_date
summary: Assigns a specific release channel to a delivery address for a particular date, so that deliveries to that address on that day go through a chosen channel. Those date-specific assignments are set on the customer's contact form and on the release channel. It depends on the shipment lead time module.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_by_date_delivery_window
summary: A glue module that combines the date-specific release channel assignment with the partner delivery window rules, so both are respected when a channel is chosen. It has no screens of its own.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_by_date_public_holidays
summary: A glue module that combines the date-specific release channel assignment with public holiday rules, so a channel assigned to a date respects holidays. It has no screens of its own.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_delivery_window
summary: Stops a release channel from taking transfers whose shipment date falls outside the customer's preferred delivery window. The channel is skipped for those transfers, so they are released into a channel that fits the customer's delivery time. It applies the rules from the partner delivery window module.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_delivery_window
summary: Stops a release channel from taking transfers whose shipment date falls outside the customer's preferred delivery window. The channel is skipped for those transfers, so they are released into a channel that fits the customer's delivery time. It applies the rules from the partner delivery window module.

name: stock_release_channel_partner_public_holidays
summary: Adds an option on a release channel to exclude public holidays, so the channel is skipped when the shipment date is a public holiday. You turn it on in the Selection criteria tab of the channel. It requires the public holidays module.

name: stock_release_channel_plan
summary: Groups release channels into preparation plans, such as one plan for each weekday, so you can launch all the channels in a plan at the start of the day with one action. The plans are managed under Inventory, Operations, Release Plans. Only stock managers can change them.

name: stock_release_channel_plan
summary: Groups release channels into preparation plans, such as one plan for each weekday, so you can launch all the channels in a plan at the start of the day with one action. The plans are managed under Inventory, Operations, Release Plans. Only stock managers can change them.

name: stock_release_channel_plan_depot
summary: Lets you set a depot on a release channel preparation plan, so each plan can be tied to the depot it is prepared from. The depot field sits on the preparation plan form in the release channel planning screens under Inventory.

name: stock_release_channel_plan_process_end_time
summary: Glue module for release channel preparation plans. When you launch a plan, the launch wizard asks for a process end date that is set on every release channel in the plan. Users see it in the plan launch screen under Inventory.

name: stock_release_channel_plan_process_end_time
summary: Glue module for release channel preparation plans. When you launch a plan, the launch wizard asks for a process end date that is set on every release channel in the plan. Users see it in the plan launch screen under Inventory.

name: stock_release_channel_plan_shipment_lead_time
summary: Glue module that shows, in the release channel preparation plan, which day each channel has to be prepared on. It is based on the channel's delivery weekdays and its delivery lead time. The weekday fields are on the release channel form.

name: stock_release_channel_plan_shipment_lead_time
summary: Glue module that shows, in the release channel preparation plan, which day each channel has to be prepared on. It is based on the channel's delivery weekdays and its delivery lead time. The weekday fields are on the release channel form.

name: stock_release_channel_process_end_time
summary: Sets a process end date and time on each release channel, which becomes the channel's deadline when it is woken up.
