It can also copy that date to the pickings' scheduled date and to move deadlines, so pickings sort in channel order and moves can merge. The timezone comes from the warehouse address or the company, and the feature is switched on in Inventory settings.

name: stock_release_channel_process_end_time
summary: Sets a process end date and time on each release channel, which becomes the channel's deadline when it is woken up. It can also copy that date to the pickings' scheduled date and to move deadlines, so pickings sort in channel order and moves can merge. The timezone comes from the warehouse address or the company, and the feature is switched on in Inventory settings.

name: stock_release_channel_propagate_channel_picking
summary: On an outgoing operation type, a checkbox makes the internal pickings created from an outgoing picking inherit its release channel. This keeps multi-step deliveries (pick, pack, ship) in the same channel. The checkbox is on the operation type settings under Inventory.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_advice
summary: Plans shipment advices for the released pickings of a release channel, using the Plan shipment button on the channel. In this base version, all ready pickings of a channel are grouped into one shipment advice per warehouse. Shipment advices are the dock and truck planning records.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_advice
summary: Plans shipment advices for the released pickings of a release channel, using the Plan shipment button on the channel. In this base version, all ready pickings of a channel are grouped into one shipment advice per warehouse. Shipment advices are the dock and truck planning records.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_advice_deliver
summary: Adds a Deliver button on locked release channels. Pressing it sets the channel to a delivering state and runs a background job that validates the channel's shippings, creates the shipment advices and processes them. The channel shows an error state if the job fails.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_advice_process_end_time
summary: Adds a delay in minutes between the release channel's process end time and the time the truck arrives at the dock, plus a departure delay. The delays can be set per channel or per warehouse, and the channel's value is used first when shipment advices are created.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_advice_toursolver
summary: Uses the TourSolver route optimizer to plan the shipment advices (truck routes) for the ready and released pickings of a release channel. Channels get a set of delivery resources (vehicles or drivers) to plan against, under the Plan shipment flow.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_lead_time
summary: Sets a shipment date on each release channel, computed as the process end date plus a shipment lead time in days, using the warehouse calendar. Deliveries promised after the shipment date are kept out of the channel, and only pickings scheduled before the shipment date count as release ready. The delivery date is also shown on the shipment advice.

name: stock_release_channel_shipment_lead_time
summary: Sets a shipment date on each release channel, computed as the process end date plus a shipment lead time in days, using the warehouse calendar. Deliveries promised after the shipment date are kept out of the channel, and only pickings scheduled before the shipment date count as release ready. The delivery date is also shown on the shipment advice.

name: stock_release_channel_show_volume
summary: Shows the total volume of transfers on each release channel, split by state (all, release ready, released, available, waiting, late, priority, done). The figures appear on the release channel form under Inventory.

name: stock_release_channel_show_weight
summary: Shows the total weight of transfers on each release channel, split by state (all, release ready, released, available, waiting, late, priority, done). The weight is the estimated product weight, not the measured shipping weight.

name: stock_release_channel_warehouse_calendar
summary: Technical glue module that connects release channels with the warehouse calendar feature. It adds no fields of its own, so nothing new appears on screen by itself. It is what lets calendar-based date calculations, such as the shipment lead time, use the warehouse calendar.

name: stock_remote_measure
summary: Lets stock operations read weights or other measures directly from a connected remote scale. You set the remote device on an operation type, then request the measure from the device on the move lines. The device is set under Inventory operation types.

name: stock_removal_location_by_priority
summary: Adds a removal priority to stock locations, so when two locations hold stock of the same date the higher-priority one is used first. It is switched on in Inventory settings and set on each location.

name: stock_removal_location_by_priority
summary: Adds a removal priority number to locations and stock quants. When the same product sits in two locations with the same incoming date, stock is taken from the location with the higher priority first, whether the removal strategy is FIFO or LIFO. Turn it on in Inventory Settings under Operations.

name: stock_replenishment_mrp_bom_selection
summary: In Inventory's Replenishment screen, the Order button on a manufactured product opens a wizard. There you choose the quantity to produce and the bill of materials to use, and you can check the on-hand quantity of each component.

name: stock_report_partner_ref
summary: Prints the customer's reference (the partner ref, or the commercial partner's ref as a fallback) on the Delivery Slip and Picking Operations reports. If the customer has a reference, it appears on the printed document from Inventory.

name: stock_report_quantity_by_location
summary: Adds an Inventory report that lists every stockable product by location, with quantity on hand, reserved and unreserved. You can filter by locations, availability and whether the quantity is above zero.

name: stock_reporting_access
summary: Adds an Inventory Reporting Access group so regular inventory users can open the Inventory Reporting menu without being full inventory administrators. Admins assign users to it in the group settings. It also notes that stock valuation layers need extra access rights when stock_account is installed.

name: stock_request
summary: Lets employees request stock they regularly need to be moved to their chosen location, such as supplies for a team. Each request is evaluated by the location's replenishment rules, and any resulting transfers can be opened from the request. Requests are under Inventory, Stock Requests, with settings for permissions and virtual locations.

name: stock_request
summary: Lets employees request products that the company stocks regularly, to be moved to their chosen location. Requests are created and confirmed under Stock Requests, then routed through the location's procurement rules, and linked transfers are reachable from a Transfers button on the request.

name: stock_request_analytic
summary: Adds an analytic distribution to stock requests, so the stock moves created from them carry analytic accounts. You can also set a default distribution on a stock request order that new requests inherit.

name: stock_request_bom
summary: Lets a stock request be created from a bill of materials, so choosing a product and a quantity fills the request lines with its components. The requested quantity can be adjusted afterwards. It appears as extra fields on the stock request order form.

name: stock_request_direction
summary: Lets users say whether a stock request is to send products out of or bring products into a warehouse, without picking the internal location. Warehouse staff then choose the right route when reviewing the request. The direction is shown on stock requests and request orders.

name: stock_request_direction
summary: Adds a direction field (to or from the warehouse) to stock requests and orders, so users don't need to pick the inventory location themselves. The warehouse team reviews the request and chooses the route.

name: stock_request_kanban
summary: Turns printed kanban cards into stock requests, so when a card's product is used up and the card is scanned, the replenishment is requested automatically. This is a lean way to reorder products that are not stored as normal stock. Cards are created under Inventory, Stock Requests, Stock Requests Kanban, and can be scanned with a barcode reader.

name: stock_request_kanban
summary: Lets you use stock requests as reorder cards for products that are never stored as normal stock, such as consumables. Print a barcoded kanban card, keep it with the product, and scan it under Stock Requests once the product is used up to create a new request. Inventory kanban counts are also supported.

name: stock_request_mrp
summary: Shows the manufacturing orders that were created because of a stock request. A smart button on the stock request and on the stock request order lists them, for requests that trigger production right away.

name: stock_request_mrp
summary: Shows the manufacturing orders that were created because a stock request was confirmed, and lets users open them from the request. This ties production back to the request that triggered it. Links appear on the stock request and manufacturing order forms.

name: stock_request_picking_type
summary: Adds a Stock Request Orders operation type, so requests show up in Inventory with their own tile. The tile and operation type show counts of requests to do, in progress and late. Stock request orders are also reachable from Inventory > Operations.

name: stock_request_picking_type
summary: Adds a Stock Request Orders operation type, so requests show up in Inventory with their own tile. The tile and operation type show counts of requests to do, in progress and late. Stock request orders are also reachable from Inventory > Operations.

name: stock_request_purchase
summary: When confirming a stock request creates a purchase order right away, the purchase orders appear on the stock request through a smart button. You can see the purchase orders from the request and from the stock request order.

name: stock_request_purchase
summary: Shows the purchase orders that were created because a stock request was confirmed, and lets users open them from the request. This ties buying back to the request that triggered it. Links appear on the stock request and purchase order forms.

name: stock_request_purchase_request
summary: Links stock requests to purchase requests, so a purchase request created from a stock request can be found from the stock request, and the other way around. The description is minimal, so this is inferred from the link fields it adds.

name: stock_request_stage
summary: Adds a Kanban view to stock requests where you drag each request through stages you define under Stock Requests settings. A stage can set the request's status and can complete its pickings when reached.

name: stock_request_submit
summary: Adds a Submitted status to stock requests. A supervisor can check the request before it is confirmed and correct its route if needed, from the request form under Stock Requests.

name: stock_request_submit
summary: Adds a Submitted step to stock requests, so a supervisor can review and correct the route before the request goes ahead. Supervisors see submitted requests and can adjust them. It adds a status and a route field on the stock request.

name: stock_request_tier_validation
summary: Requires stock requests to be approved through tiers before they can be confirmed, such as a warehouse manager then a director. A Request Validation button starts the approvals, and reviews are listed on the request's Reviews tab. Tiers are set under Settings, Technical, Tier Validations.

name: stock_request_tier_validation
summary: Adds multi-level approval to stock requests and stock request orders. The requester clicks Request Validation, reviewers approve on the Reviews tab, and the Confirm button appears once every review is approved. A filter shows requests waiting for your review.

name: stock_reservation_date_show
summary: Displays the date on which stock moves were reserved. It is a small display addition, so the date shows wherever stock moves are viewed.

name: stock_reserve
summary: Lets you reserve stock for a product, with an optional validity date after which the reservation is lifted automatically. Reserved quantity is taken out of the forecast, so reorder rules may trigger. Reservations are created from the product's Stock Reservations smart button, and you can release them with the Release button.

name: stock_reserve
summary: Lets you reserve stock for a product, with an optional validity date after which the reservation is lifted automatically. Reserved quantity is taken out of the forecast, so reorder rules may trigger. Reservations are created from the product's Stock Reservations smart button, and you can release them with the Release button.

name: stock_reserve_rule
summary: Sets rules for which locations stock is taken from and in what order, including filters and removal strategies such as emptying bins first or taking full packaging first. Rules are set under Inventory > Configuration > Stock Reservation Rules, and suit warehouses with many bins or packages.

name: stock_reserve_rule
summary: Sets rules for which locations stock is taken from and in what order, including filters and removal strategies such as emptying bins first or taking full packaging first. Rules are set under Inventory > Configuration > Stock Reservation Rules, and suit warehouses with many bins or packages.

name: stock_reserve_sale
summary: Lets you reserve stock on sales order lines before the quotation is confirmed, with an optional validity date. Use the Reserve Stock button or the lock icon on a line. Reservations are lifted when the quotation is cancelled or confirmed.

name: stock_restrict_by_planned_consumed_date
summary: Stops stock from being reserved when its expiry date is earlier than the customer's planned consumed date. It helps with products that have a shelf life. FEFO still picks the earliest-expiring goods first, so the reservations are not optimized.

name: stock_restrict_immediate_adjustment
summary: Makes the stock quantity list read-only when it is opened from a product's On Hand button or the inventory report, so quantities can only be changed through Inventory Adjustments with an explicit Apply. It prevents accidental stock changes.

name: stock_restrict_lot
summary: Technical base module that adds a Restrict Lot field to stock moves and pickings. The lot carries through chained moves, and a move restricted to a lot can only reserve or transfer that lot. It has no visible effect on its own and is meant for other modules to build on.

name: stock_restrict_lot
summary: Technical base module that adds a Restrict Lot field to stock moves and pickings. The lot carries through chained moves, and a move restricted to a lot can only reserve or transfer that lot. It has no visible effect on its own and is meant for other modules to build on.

name: stock_restrict_lot
summary: Adds a Restrict Lot field on stock moves and transfers so a line can be limited to one specific lot or serial number. The restriction passes along chained moves, so the same lot is used down the line. This is a base module with no visible effect on its own, and other modules build on it.

name: stock_return_request
summary: Lets users return stock from a location to a supplier, a customer, or another internal location by reversing the matching earlier transfers. The user searches for the products and lots to return, and the returns are created from the original pickings. The return request is found under Inventory, Operations, Return Request.

name: stock_route_location_source
summary: Technical module that adds a helper on routes to find the true source location of a destination by following upstream pull rules. It has no screens; other modules call it.

name: stock_route_mto
summary: Adds an MTO checkbox to stock routes, so you can mark make-to-order routes and filter the route list by it. Set it under Inventory > Settings > Routes.

name: stock_route_mto
summary: Adds an MTO checkbox on routes, so you can mark which routes are make-to-order and filter for them in the route list.

name: stock_rule_reserve_max_quantity
summary: In multi-step outgoing routes (pick, pack, ship), when a picking brings in more than the demand, the chained steps reserve the full picked quantity. This is switched on per rule with the Reserve Max Quantity checkbox, which needs debug mode to show. It applies only when enough stock is available.

name: stock_rule_reserve_max_quantity
summary: In multi-step outgoing routes, when more is picked than the demand, the chained steps reserve the full picked quantity instead of only the need. It is enabled per rule with the Reserve Max Quantity checkbox, which needs debug mode to show. It applies only when enough stock is available.

name: stock_scrap_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancelled status to scrap orders, so a scrap can be cancelled and then set back to draft if needed. Cancelling also removes its stock move. It appears on Inventory > Operations > Scrap with Cancel and Set to Draft buttons.

name: stock_scrap_location_default
summary: Lets you set a default scrap location for the whole company, so new scrap orders use it instead of the first scrap location Odoo finds. It is set under Inventory > Settings > Warehouse, and the Storage Locations option must be on.

name: stock_scrap_security
summary: Sets up dedicated security groups for scrapping stock, so access to scrap orders can be limited to chosen users. The module text does not spell out which exact rights each group grants. It is configured through the access rights of the scrap model in Inventory.

name: stock_scrap_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to scrap orders. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve in tiers, and only then can the scrap be validated. Reviewers can filter for scraps that need their review, and tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: stock_scrap_tier_validation_mrp
summary: Fixes scrapping from a manufacturing order when scrap needs approval. Scrap opens in the main window instead of a popup, so the record is saved and the validation request can be sent. It only matters if scrap approval is already set up.

name: stock_search_supplierinfo_code
summary: Lets you search pickings by a product's supplier code, which is the vendor's own product reference. It is mainly useful for receipts, where the supplier's code is printed on the delivery paperwork. The search is on the transfers list in Inventory.

name: stock_search_supplierinfo_code
summary: Lets you search pickings by a product's supplier code, which is the vendor's own product reference. It is mainly useful for receipts, where the supplier's code is printed on the delivery paperwork. The search is on the transfers list in Inventory.

name: stock_secondary_unit
summary: Lets a product carry a second unit of measure with a conversion factor, so stock quantities can be shown and entered in both units. The second-unit quantity appears on the product list and on stock moves.

name: stock_secondary_unit
summary: Shows product quantities in a second unit of measure, such as cases next to pieces, using a conversion factor you set. The second unit and its on-hand quantity appear on the product's Inventory tab and in the product list.

name: stock_split_picking
summary: Adds a Split button on transfers that are ready, letting you break one transfer into two or more separate ones without validating it. Lines can be split by the quantities entered, or all moves can be put into their own transfers. Both resulting transfers stay confirmed and unprocessed. It is used from the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_split_picking
summary: Adds a Split button on outgoing transfers. It splits the transfer into two confirmed transfers, based on the quantities you enter, without processing either one. You can also put every line in its own transfer or choose specific lines for a new one.

name: stock_split_picking
summary: Adds a Split button on outgoing transfers. It splits the transfer into two confirmed transfers, based on the quantities you enter, without processing either one. You can also put every line in its own transfer or choose specific lines for a new one.

name: stock_split_picking_dimension
summary: Extends the split button so a transfer can be divided by size limits: maximum number of lines, volume and weight. Each new transfer stays within those limits, which helps when loading trucks or parcels. The By Dimension option is picked in the Split wizard on transfers in Inventory.

name: stock_split_picking_kit
summary: Adds a Quantity of kits mode to the Split wizard, so a transfer can be split into groups of a set number of kits. You can also choose the sort order used before splitting. Multi-level bills of materials are not supported. It is used from the Split button on transfers in Inventory.

name: stock_storage_category_capacity_name
summary: Gives storage category capacity records a readable name in the interface, which core Odoo does not provide. It is mostly a display improvement in the storage category settings.

name: stock_storage_category_capacity_name
summary: Improves how storage category capacity records are named on screen, because standard Odoo does not name them clearly. It is a display-only change in the storage category setup under Inventory.

name: stock_storage_type
summary: Adds storage types to packages and locations, so a package is put away according to its package type (height, weight or custom conditions) and the storage categories of each location. Package types and storage categories are set under Inventory > Settings, and the package type put-away is applied after the standard product put-away.

name: stock_storage_type
summary: Adds storage types to packages and locations, so a package is put away according to its package type (height, weight or custom conditions) and the storage categories of each location. Package types and storage categories are set under Inventory > Settings, and the package type put-away is applied after the standard product put-away.

name: stock_storage_type_buffer
summary: Lets you define a buffer in front of a group of storage locations. When the buffer is full or has goods on the way, its locations are removed from put-away, so goods are not sent to an area that cannot be reached right now. It extends the storage type put-away and is useful with buffer zones that feed bays or alleys.

name: stock_storage_type_move_line_qty_picked
summary: Technical glue module that lets storage type computations use the picked quantity on stock move lines. It adds no fields and nothing new shows on screen by itself.

name: stock_storage_type_putaway_abc
summary: Adds an ABC storage strategy, so products and locations are rated A, B or C and goods are put away in the matching locations first. Locations are sorted by max height first, then by ABC rating and package putaway sequence. The ABC rating is set on products and on locations.

name: stock_storage_type_putaway_abc
summary: Adds an ABC storage strategy, so products and locations are rated A, B or C and goods are put away in the matching locations first. Locations are sorted by max height first, then by ABC rating and package putaway sequence. The ABC rating is set on products and on locations.

name: stock_valuation_layer_accounting_date
summary: Adds an Accounting Date to stock valuation layers, taken from the linked journal entry or, if there is none, from the creation date in the user's timezone. Inventory valuation reports can then be run as of an accounting date. You use it from Inventory > Reporting > Inventory Valuation with the Inventory at Date wizard.

name: stock_valuation_layer_inventory_filter
summary: Lets you filter the valuation report to inventory adjustment moves, group it by reference and filter by date, so you can see what each stock count changed in value. It is found under Inventory > Reporting > Valuation and needs stock_account.

name: stock_valuation_layer_inventory_filter
summary: Lets you filter the valuation report to inventory adjustments, group it by reference, and filter by creation date. This gives a more detailed inventory valuation for adjustments. You use it from Inventory > Reporting > Valuation, after applying inventory adjustments with a description.

name: stock_valuation_layer_total_value
summary: Shows the total value and new unit price on a valuation layer after a landed cost is added. You can see the original cost and the updated cost on the same valuation layer in the list and form views.

name: stock_valuation_layer_usage
summary: Shows which stock valuation layers (incoming costs) were used by each outgoing stock move, and how much quantity and value each move took. The usage is shown in a Valuation Layers section on the completed stock move. It also makes make-to-order deliveries take the cost of their specific incoming layer, not just the oldest one.

name: stock_valuation_layer_usage
summary: Tracks which incoming stock valuation layers were used by each outgoing move, and how much quantity and value was taken from each. This makes it possible to trace costs when a purchase price changes later and a revaluation is needed. For make-to-order flows, the outgoing cost is taken from the specific incoming layer rather than simply the oldest, and usage appears under Inventory > Reporting > Stock Moves as a Valuation Layers section.

name: stock_vertical_lift
summary: Core setup for Vertical Lift Modules, the automated shelving machines such as Kardex or Modula. It adds shuttle and tray configuration on locations and dedicated screens to pick, put away and count stock; the physical drivers come from other addons.

name: stock_vertical_lift_empty_tray_check
summary: After a tray is released and the system thinks it is empty, it asks the operator to confirm that it really is. An inventory adjustment is then posted to zero if it is empty, or left in draft if not. It is enabled in Inventory settings.

name: stock_vertical_lift_kardex
summary: Adds support for Kardex Remstar vertical lift storage units to the vertical lift module. It is an interface add-on, so the lift is controlled through the vertical lift setup rather than a new screen.

name: stock_vertical_lift_packaging_level
summary: Glue module that shows the full packaging level name instead of the plain packaging name on vertical lift screens. It installs automatically when packaging levels are present.

name: stock_vertical_lift_pick_priority
summary: On a vertical lift, the pick screen lists goods for the most urgent outgoing deliveries first, based on the priority and date of the deliveries waiting for them. Skipped lines still come last, and it relies on the urgent-transfers setting from the vertical lift module.

name: stock_vertical_lift_qty_by_packaging
summary: Glue module that adds the quantity-by-packaging display (for example 3 boxes) to the vertical lift transfer screen. It needs both the packaging quantity and vertical lift modules.

name: stock_vertical_lift_server_env
summary: Adds OCA Server Environment settings to vertical lift shuttles, so connection details can differ between environments such as test and production. It is a technical integration layer.

name: stock_vertical_lift_storage_type
summary: Makes vertical lift putaways respect storage types: when a package has a storage type, the operator is not asked to scan a tray type and the matching putaway is applied. Tray storage types are set on the tray types.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt
summary: Adds a simple management system for Vertical Lift Modules (VLMs), with trays, tray types and tasks. A location can be flagged as a VLM with its connection details, and stock moves are turned into VLM tasks for the lift. It is a lighter alternative to the stock_vertical_lift module.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt
summary: Lightweight management for Vertical Lift Modules: define trays and tray types on locations, track what sits in each tray, and handle lift pick, put and transfer tasks from transfers. It is a simpler alternative to the full vertical lift setup.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt_kardex
summary: Adds Kardex as a vendor choice for vertical lift locations in the lightweight VLM module. It only sets the vendor selection; machine communication is provided elsewhere.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt_modula
summary: Adds Modula as a vendor choice for vertical lift locations in the lightweight VLM module. It only sets the vendor selection; machine communication is provided elsewhere.

name: stock_warehouse_calendar
summary: Adds a working-hours calendar to each warehouse. When a transfer is created from a replenishment or make-to-order rule, its expected start date skips non-working days, so the lead time is counted in working days. The calendar is set on the warehouse in Inventory settings.

name: stock_warehouse_calendar
summary: Attaches a working schedule to each warehouse, so generated transfers get start dates that account for lead times and working hours. For example, a move needed on a Monday is started on the last working day before it. It is set on the warehouse form.

name: stock_warehouse_calendar
summary: Adds a working-hours calendar to each warehouse. When a transfer is created from a replenishment or make-to-order rule, its expected start date skips non-working days, so the lead time is counted in working days. The calendar is set on the warehouse in Inventory settings.

name: stock_warehouse_flow
summary: Adds routing flows, which pick a different delivery route for a stock move based on criteria such as the carrier and product attributes. Examples are whole pallet, cold chain or dangerous goods, each with its own rules and operation types. Flows are configured under Inventory > Settings > Routing Flows.

name: stock_warehouse_flow
summary: Adds routing flows, which pick a different delivery route for a stock move based on criteria such as the carrier and product attributes. Examples are whole pallet, cold chain or dangerous goods, each with its own rules and operation types. Flows are configured under Inventory > Settings > Routing Flows.

name: stock_warehouse_flow_delivery_refresh
summary: When the carrier on a delivery changes, moves waiting for release get the routing flow reapplied. This keeps the delivery route in line with the new carrier. It links routing flows with the release process.

name: stock_warehouse_flow_release
summary: Applies the warehouse routing flow when a move is released, so release-based deliveries follow the same route logic as other moves. It connects routing flows with the release process, and the setting is on the route.

name: stock_warehouse_out_pull
summary: Restores pull rules for outgoing deliveries as they worked before Odoo 18, so a multi-step delivery creates its chained transfers from one procurement. It is enabled per warehouse with the Outgoing Pull Rules option.

name: stock_warehouse_relationship
summary: Technical module that adds a warehouse field to pickings, moves, move lines, quants and packages. It has no screen of its own and is a base for other modules, such as ones that restrict users to certain warehouses.

name: stock_warehouse_resupply_route_push
summary: Switches inter-warehouse resupply to push rules. A first transfer moves stock from the source warehouse to an inter-warehouse location, and only after it is done does a second transfer take it to the receiving warehouse. It is enabled per warehouse with a regenerate button.

name: stock_warehouse_security
summary: Restricts which warehouses each user can see and work in, set on the user form. A user with no warehouses listed can see all of them.

name: stock_warn_option
summary: Adds a choice of predefined warning options to a contact's 'Warning on the Picking' setting, so a blocking message can be set quickly rather than typed each time. It keeps the warning text consistent across partners. It is set on a partner's Internal Notes tab, with the Warnings setting enabled in Inventory.

name: stock_weighing
summary: Adds a shopfloor weighing assistant for stock operations, so warehouse staff can record the weight of each detailed operation. You start it from the Weighing app or from an operation type set to weighing. The weighed quantities and weights are recorded on the moves and move lines.

name: stock_weighing_auto_create_lot
summary: Creates lots automatically when operations are added from the weighing kanban card. It applies only to operation types and products with Auto Create Lot turned on, and it requires the stock weighing assistant to be set up.

name: stock_weighing_auto_package
summary: Adds an Auto package toggle to the Record Weight wizard. When it is on, each detailed operation added gets a freshly created package, and the setting is remembered per product. You use it from a transfer's move card by clicking the add-operation button.

name: stock_weighing_brand
summary: Shows the product brand and brand logo on the weighing assistant's kanban cards. It only adds a visual cue, so the product's brand is easier to spot while weighing.

name: stock_weighing_owner_restriction
summary: Applies the owner restriction rules from the operation type to the weighing assistant. The stock and lot pickers then show only the quants and lots the user is allowed to pick. It is useful when stock belongs to several owners.

name: stock_weighing_remote_measure
summary: Lets the weighing assistant take the weight straight from a connected remote scale. You select the measuring device on the weighing wizard, and the weight is filled in from the device.

name: stock_whole_kit_constraint
summary: Stops a kit product (a bill of materials of type kit) from being delivered partially, so all its components leave together. You can allow partial delivery per product on the Inventory tab, Logistics group, and it is on by default.

name: storage_backend
summary: Technical base for storing files outside Odoo, such as on Amazon S3 or an SFTP server. You define storage backends and their categories under the technical settings, and other storage modules build on them.

name: storage_backend
summary: Technical base for storing files outside Odoo, such as on Amazon S3 or an SFTP server. You define storage backends under the technical settings, and other storage modules build on them.

name: storage_backend_environment
summary: Glue module that lets storage backends read their settings from the server environment configuration. It adds no visible fields, so it matters for deployments rather than daily use.

name: storage_backend_ftp
summary: Adds FTP as a storage backend type, with host, port, encryption, login and passive mode settings. Once set up, files can be stored on and read from an FTP server.

name: storage_backend_ftp_environment
summary: Glue module that lets the FTP storage backend read its settings from the server environment configuration. It adds no visible fields.

name: storage_backend_s3
summary: Adds Amazon S3 as a storage backend type, with bucket, access key, region and file access settings. Once set up, files can be stored in and read from an S3 bucket.

name: storage_backend_s3_environment
summary: Glue module that lets the Amazon S3 storage backend read its settings from the server environment configuration. It adds no visible fields.

name: storage_backend_sftp
summary: Adds SFTP as a storage backend type, with host, port, login, password or SSH key settings. Once set up, files can be stored on and read from an SFTP server. It needs the paramiko Python library on the server.

name: storage_backend_sftp_environment
summary: Glue module that lets the SFTP storage backend read its settings from the server environment configuration. It adds no visible fields.

name: storage_file
summary: Lets Odoo records (such as invoices or attachments) keep their files on an external storage backend, with checksum and mimetype stored. Files are linked to any Odoo record and can be kept on a high-availability file server.

name: storage_file
summary: Lets Odoo records (such as invoices or attachments) keep their files on an external storage backend, with checksum and mimetype stored. It also has a wizard to replace a stored file and a wizard to move files between backends.

name: storage_file_environment
summary: Glue module that lets storage files use the server environment configuration for their storage backend. It adds no visible fields.

name: storage_file_swap_backend_queue
summary: Runs the Swap Backend wizard as background queue jobs in batches, so moving many files between storage backends does not time out. The batch size and the job channel concurrency are set in the system parameters and job settings.

name: storage_image
summary: Stores images and resized copies (such as thumbnails) in a storage backend, with checksum and mimetype kept. It is meant for things like product images served from a CDN or cheaper archive storage.

name: storage_image_product
summary: Attaches images to product templates, variants and product categories, using stored images. Categories get an Image field, and products get images on the Variants tab after attribute selection under Sales > Products.

name: storage_media
summary: Stores media files, typed by media type, on a public storage so they can be opened on the web by customers. You add a media item from the storage form, after installing the module and configuring the storage backend.

name: storage_media_product
summary: Attaches media to products and product categories, using stored media. Categories get an Image field, and products get images on the Variants tab after attribute selection under Sales > Products.

name: storage_thumbnail
summary: Adds thumbnail support to stored files, so smaller copies of an image are generated and their URLs are kept. It is a building block for the image and media storage modules and has no screen of its own.

name: subscription_oca
summary: Creates subscriptions that generate recurring invoices or orders on a schedule, such as monthly or yearly. Subscription templates set the billing frequency and invoicing method, and products can be flagged as subscribable so that selling them starts a subscription. Subscriptions are managed under the Subscriptions app.

name: subscription_oca
summary: Creates subscriptions that generate recurring invoices or orders on a schedule, such as monthly or yearly. Subscriptions can also be paused and resumed, and a pause can end on a set date, so a customer can be put on hold without closing the subscription. Templates set the billing frequency, and the Subscriptions app holds the records.

name: subscription_oca
summary: Adds subscriptions that generate recurring invoices or orders on a schedule set by a template, such as daily or monthly. Subscriptions are managed with stages, lines and close reasons, and products can be marked as subscribable so that selling them creates a subscription. Invoices generated by a subscription are linked back to it.

name: supplier_calendar
summary: Lets a vendor's own working calendar (such as factory closing days) drive the lead time on purchases. Scheduled dates on receipts and purchase order dates then skip the supplier's closed days instead of counting plain calendar days. It is set on the vendor's contact under Purchase, in Delay Calendar Type.

name: supplier_calendar
summary: Gives each vendor a working calendar so supplier lead times are counted in working days instead of plain calendar days. The calendar is used when computing scheduled receipt dates on pickings and order dates on purchase orders. It is set up from the vendor record, using a resource working schedule defined in developer mode.

name: survey_answer_generation
summary: Prefills the answers of one survey from another survey's answers, through questions you link between them. Users can see when they changed a prefilled answer, using a Diff with origin column on the participation answers. It is set up on the survey's Options tab under Questions.

name: survey_certification_branding
summary: Lets each certification survey have its own company name and logo on the certificate, instead of the company settings. You set them on the survey's Options tab, under Certification Branding, once Is a Certification is ticked.

name: survey_certification_py3o
summary: Lets you choose or upload an ODT template (through Py3o) for a certification survey's certificate report. A completed certification then uses that template, so you can check the customized certificate. It is set on the survey itself under Surveys.

name: survey_certification_sending
summary: Controls how certificates are sent after a participant passes a certification survey. By default they are emailed automatically, but you can tick Skip Auto Email to send them manually later. Passed certificates that were not sent are tracked on the answer record.

name: survey_contact_generation
summary: Creates or links a contact from the answers to a survey, when an anonymous user submits it. You set Generate Contact on the survey's Options tab and map survey questions to contact fields, with an optional parent company.

name: survey_contact_generation_model_selection
summary: Lets contact generation from a survey work with the model selection question type, so a contact can be created or linked from a choice of record. It is a bridge between contact generation and the model selection question type.

name: survey_crm_generation
summary: Creates a CRM lead or opportunity from each submitted survey, with a link back to the answers. You turn on Generate leads on the survey's Options tab, and can set default tags and the sales team. Questions you mark appear in the lead description.

name: survey_crm_generation_model_selection
summary: Lets lead generation from a survey work with the model selection question type, so a lead can be created from a choice of record. It is a bridge between CRM survey generation and the model selection question type.

name: survey_crm_sale_generation
summary: Links the CRM lead created from a survey to the quotation generated from the same survey. When the quotation is confirmed, the lead is marked as won automatically.

name: survey_formio
summary: Generates a Form.io compatible JSON from a survey, so it can be shown in the Form.io form widget, and creates a survey response from the JSON Form.io returns. Matrix questions are not supported, since Form.io has no matching component. It is a developer-facing integration, not a screen users work in.

name: survey_legal
summary: Adds a legal terms checkbox that participants must tick before submitting a survey. You set it per survey on the Options tab, along with the terms link and text.

name: survey_link_base
summary: Technical base that adds a mixin and a wizard for creating a survey invitation from any other record, such as a customer or a booking. It is not used directly, and other modules build on it.

name: survey_multi_company
summary: Restricts a survey to one company, so only users of that company can see and access it. You set the company on the survey form.

name: survey_next_survey_update_partner
summary: Updates a contact that was generated from a survey when the linked follow-up survey changes the values. It connects contact generation with answer prefilling, so a new answer updates the same contact.

name: survey_partner_representative
summary: Lets an authorized user fill in a survey on behalf of another person or organization, using the survey's share link. The user needs the Representative on surveys permission, and the survey must have Allow Partner Representing on, under Participants on the Options tab.

name: survey_question_type_binary
summary: Adds a file upload question type to surveys, with a single file or multiple files. You can set the allowed file types and the maximum file size for each question.

name: survey_question_type_five_star
summary: Adds a five star rating question type to surveys. Participants pick between one and five stars, and you choose this type when adding a question on the survey.

name: survey_question_type_model_selection
summary: Adds a question type where the participant picks a record of a chosen model, such as a product or customer, optionally filtered by a domain. Survey editors also get read-only access to the model list so they can set it up.

name: survey_question_type_nps
summary: Adds an NPS (Net Promoter Score) question type to surveys, so participants give a 0 to 10 likelihood-to-recommend score. You pick this type when adding a question on the survey.

name: survey_resource_booking
summary: Links a survey to a resource booking type, so a booking can invite the customer to fill in the survey. Answers can be read from the booking, and you can send invitations from the list view for several bookings at once.

name: survey_resource_booking
summary: Links a survey to a resource booking type, so a booking can invite the customer to fill in the survey. Answers can be read from the booking, and you can send invitations from the list view for several bookings at once.

name: survey_result_mail
summary: Emails the survey answers to the person who filled in the survey, as soon as they finish it. You turn on Send survey answers on the survey's Options tab and choose a template with the answers inline or attached.

name: survey_sale_generation
summary: Creates a quotation from each survey submission, based on the answers and the products linked to them. You turn on Generate Quotations on the survey's Options tab and choose the sales team, and the quotation can be emailed to the customer.

name: survey_skip_start
summary: Lets a survey skip the start screen, so participants go straight to the first question. You turn on Skip start screen in the Questions section of the survey's Options tab.

name: survey_xlsx
summary: Adds an XLSX report that prints all the results of a survey into a spreadsheet. You run it from the survey's results.

name: sustainability
summary: Tracks CO2 equivalent emissions in accounting, using emission factors that are applied to purchases and sales. Each emission factor database and value is kept in Odoo, and the results appear on the journal items, invoices and product origins. It is designed around the GHG Protocol for CSRD reporting, and extra modules add the reporting views and sales and purchase tracking.

name: sustainability_account_asset_management
summary: Glue module that makes the sustainability (CO2) tracking work with the OCA asset management module, so depreciation lines carry emissions too. It adds no visible fields of its own.

name: sustainability_account_asset_management
summary: Glue module that makes the sustainability (CO2) tracking work with the OCA asset management module, so depreciation lines carry emissions too. It adds no visible fields of its own.

name: sustainability_employee_commuting
summary: Calculates CO2 emissions from employee commuting, using each employee's transport mode and average weekly distance. The results are posted as accounting entries by a scheduled job, and the module can also cover remote work days when hr_homeworking is installed.

name: sustainability_employee_commuting
summary: Calculates CO2 emissions from employee commuting, using each employee's transport mode and average weekly distance. The results are posted as accounting entries by a scheduled job.

name: sustainability_hr_expense_report
summary: Adds CO2 accounting data to expense reports, so expenses carry emission figures alongside their amounts. Expenses are the employee expense claims from the Expenses app.

name: sustainability_mis_builder
summary: Provides CO2 accounting lines to MIS Builder reports, so management reports can show emissions by account and period. It adds a carbon account line source for those reports.

name: sustainability_mis_builder
summary: Provides CO2 accounting lines to MIS Builder reports, so management reports can show emissions by account and period. It adds a carbon account line source for those reports.

name: sustainability_point_of_sale
summary: Adds CO2e information to Point of Sale receipts when it is switched on in the Sustainability settings. Customers see the emission figures on the receipt.

name: sustainability_product_label_print
summary: Adds CO2e information to printed product labels when it is switched on in the Sustainability settings. Label printing then shows the product's emissions.

name: sustainability_purchase
summary: Tracks CO2e on purchase orders when it is switched on in the Sustainability settings. Each purchase order and line carries the emissions linked to its supplier, so buying choices show their footprint.

name: sustainability_purchase_stock
summary: Adds a delivery address to purchase orders for the sustainability features, so carbon data can follow receipts into stock. It is switched on from the Sustainability settings.

name: sustainability_sale
summary: Tracks CO2e on sales orders when it is switched on in the Sustainability settings. Each sales order shows its carbon total and uncertainty.

name: sustainability_spreadsheet_dashboard
summary: Adds a CO2 accounting dashboard built as a spreadsheet. It is a hidden technical add-on, so it appears as a dashboard in the Sustainability area rather than as its own menu.

name: sustainability_stock
summary: Adds CO2e information to inventory and deliveries when switched on in Sustainability settings. It can estimate freight emissions for transfers through a Climatiq connection, and it creates a carbon journal entry for the freight.

name: sustainability_website_sale
summary: Adds CO2e information to eCommerce product pages when switched on in the Sustainability settings. Online shoppers see the emissions of each product.

name: task_project_status
summary: Shows the project's status on the task form, so people working on a task can see where the project stands. It is a small read-only addition to the task view.

name: template_content_swapper
summary: Lets you replace text in QWeb templates, such as printed quotations or the web shop, without writing a custom module. You create Template Content Mapping records under Settings > Technical > User Interface, pointing at the report or template and the text to swap.

name: template_content_swapper
summary: Lets admins replace wording in printed reports, emails and web pages without writing custom code, for example changing Salesperson to Sales Representative on quotations. Each replacement is a mapping record set up under Settings, Technical, User Interface, Template Content Mappings. Changes can be set per language.

name: tms
summary: Manages vehicles, drivers, routes, crews and trips for transport operations. You set up vehicles, drivers and locations under TMS > Master Data, then run orders and trips by team and stage. Optional features add licenses, insurance, route stops and units of measure in the Settings screen.

name: tms_account
summary: Creates invoices and vendor bills from TMS trips. A completed trip can generate the customer invoice from a confirmed sale order, or the supplier bill from a purchase order, and the trip's costs are tracked with analytic accounting.

name: tms_account_asset
summary: Creates a fixed asset with depreciation for each TMS vehicle, once asset profiles and vehicle categories are set up. A vehicle record then links to its asset, and the asset profile is marked as a TMS vehicle profile. Setup is under the Accounting asset profiles and the Transport categories.

name: tms_document
summary: Stores documents such as driver licenses, vehicle insurance and inspections, with expiry dates against each driver or vehicle. Each document shows as valid, expiring or expired, and an expired critical document blocks starting a trip for that driver or vehicle. You find documents under TMS > Documents, or on the driver and vehicle forms.

name: tms_expense
summary: Lets drivers and users record trip expenses such as fuel, tolls and hotels, directly on a transport trip. Two new expense categories are created, Fuel and Toll, and the expenses are submitted automatically when the trip is completed.

name: tms_product
summary: Manages vehicles as products in inventory, so fleet vehicles can be received on a stock receipt and given a cargo type and capacity. It also lets you create trip service products, which are sold or bought for a trip.

name: tms_purchase
summary: Creates purchase orders from transport trips and for buying vehicles from drivers or other suppliers. Receiving a vehicle product creates the fleet vehicle with the order date, receiving location and amount.

name: tms_sale
summary: Adds transport services to sales orders, so selling a trip or passenger seat creates transport orders from the sale order lines. Seat tickets are managed for passenger vehicles. The description on this copy is a generic template, so details are taken from the models.

name: tms_sale
summary: Adds transport services to sales orders, so selling a trip or passenger seat creates transport orders from the sale order lines. Seat tickets are managed for passenger vehicles, and vehicles get a service product for sales.

name: tracking_manager
summary: Lets admins track changes to all fields of a model in the chatter, including one2many and many2many lines, so line-level edits such as quantity changes on sale order lines are logged. Tracking is enabled per model under Settings, Technical, Models, Custom Tracking. Fields can be picked by hand or by a domain.

name: tracking_manager
summary: Tracks changes to every field on any model that has a chatter, including one2many and many2many fields and line changes. You turn it on per model under Settings > Models, then choose which fields to track, either by hand or by a domain.

name: tracking_manager_domain
summary: Adds an optional condition to field tracking, so a change is only logged in the chatter when a chosen domain is met. It extends Tracking Manager and is configured on each tracked field. It keeps the chatter from filling up with changes that do not matter.

name: tracking_manager_domain
summary: Adds a domain to each tracked field, so changes are only recorded when the parent record matches a condition. For example, a field can be tracked only when the partner is a company. It extends Tracking Manager.

name: uom_alias
summary: Lets you give a unit of measure one or more alternative names, such as a supplier's code for Unit, and then find the unit by any of those names. This is useful when reading supplier invoices whose unit codes differ from Odoo. Aliases are added on each unit of measure under Inventory > Settings > UoM Categories.

name: uom_alias
summary: Lets you add alternative names (aliases) to a unit of measure, and search for it by any of them. This helps when a supplier invoice uses a different unit code, such as UND for Unit. Aliases are added under Inventory > Settings > UoM Categories.

name: uom_category_active
summary: Lets you archive units of measure categories, so unused categories disappear from the lists while keeping their history. Use the Archive button on the category form under Inventory > Configuration > Units of Measure > UoM Categories.

name: uom_unece
summary: Adds a UNECE Code field to units of measure, using the UN/CEFACT standard list. It is used for e-invoicing formats such as CII and UBL, and existing units are filled in automatically. You find the field on each unit of measure record.

name: uom_unece
summary: Adds a UNECE Code field to units of measure, using the UN/CEFACT standard list. It is used for e-invoicing formats such as CII and UBL, and existing units are filled in automatically. You find the field on each unit of measure record.

name: upgrade_analysis
summary: A migration tool that compares the data model and modules of two Odoo versions or instances to produce analysis files used when upgrading. It is intended for developers running upgrades and should not be kept on a live production database. End users have no reason to use it.

name: upgrade_analysis
summary: Technical migration tool that compares the data model and module data of two Odoo versions or instances, and writes analysis files. Migration developers use it, and it is not meant for production databases. Most users will not need it.

name: url_attachment_search_fuzzy
summary: Adds a trigram index on the URL of attachments, which speeds up searches on URLs in large databases. It has no screen of its own, and it can make some pages, such as login, load faster on big databases.

name: user_all_groups
summary: Adds a Member of all Groups checkbox to the user form, so a user gets every access group automatically. It also adds new groups to that user when a module is installed. It is meant for admin users and for development, not for everyday users.

name: user_log_view
summary: Adds a smart button on the user form that opens that user's authentication log, so you can see their sign-in history. You find it under Settings > Users & Companies.

name: user_log_view
summary: Adds a smart button on a user's form that opens their authentication logs, so you can see their recent sign-ins. Use it to check when a user logged in. It is found under Settings, Users and Companies.

name: users_ldap_groups
summary: Adds users to Odoo groups automatically based on LDAP attributes, using mapping rules set on the LDAP server configuration. You can choose whether only LDAP-mapped groups are set, or LDAP groups are added on top of groups set by hand, which is a security choice.

name: users_ldap_groups
summary: Adds users to Odoo groups automatically based on LDAP attributes, using mapping rules set on the LDAP server configuration. You can choose whether only LDAP-mapped groups are set, or LDAP groups are added on top of groups set by hand, which is a security choice.

name: users_ldap_mail
summary: Reads each user's name and email address from the LDAP server when they sign in with LDAP. You set the name and mail attributes on the LDAP server record under Settings > Integrations.

name: users_ldap_mail
summary: Maps the name and email from LDAP directory accounts onto Odoo users, so LDAP-logged users get the right name and email. The mapping is set on the LDAP server settings under Process Parameters. It extends the LDAP login module.

name: users_ldap_populate
summary: Creates Odoo users from an LDAP server in bulk, using the Populate button on the LDAP configuration. You can also choose to deactivate users no longer in LDAP, and keep some users out of deactivation.

name: users_ldap_populate
summary: Creates Odoo users from an LDAP server in bulk, using the Populate button on the LDAP configuration. You can also choose to deactivate users no longer in LDAP, and keep some users out of deactivation.

name: utm_medium_multi_company
summary: Adds a company field to UTM mediums, so each medium can belong to one company in a multi-company setup. It is set on the medium record under Marketing settings.

name: utm_source_multi_company
summary: Adds a company field to UTM sources, so each source can belong to one company in a multi-company setup. It is set on the source record under Marketing settings.

name: vault
summary: Adds an end-to-end encrypted vault for passwords and files. Encryption and decryption happen in the browser, so the server cannot read the secrets, and access to each vault is granted per user with read, create, write, share and delete rights. It requires HTTPS to work.

name: vault
summary: Stores secrets and files in an end-to-end encrypted vault, so passwords and documents can be shared with specific users without Odoo's server being able to read them. Encryption happens in the browser, and each user needs a second password for vault access. Search works on entry names, not on the encrypted contents, and HTTPS is required.

name: vault_share
summary: Lets a user share a single secret with someone outside Odoo through a link and a PIN. The link is deleted after a set number of accesses or when it expires. It is for short-term sharing, because a numeric PIN can be guessed.

name: vault_share
summary: Lets users share a secret with someone outside Odoo through a link protected by a PIN. Shares can be made from a vault entry or created directly, and they are deleted when the access count runs out or the share expires. It is not meant for long-term storage of secrets.

name: vcp_git
summary: Adds git download support to Version Control Platform, so code can be fetched from git repositories. It is a base layer for hosting services such as GitHub or GitLab.

name: vcp_github
summary: Connects the Version Control Platform to GitHub, so GitHub organizations, repositories, users and pull requests show up in Odoo. It builds on the git download support.

name: vcp_management
summary: Manages version control platforms such as GitHub or GitLab in Odoo. You add a platform with its host and API keys, then track repositories, branches, pull requests and reviews, with processing rules and statistics for each user and organization.

name: vcp_odoo
summary: Imports Odoo modules from version control repositories, so you can analyse their manifests, authors, dependencies and Python libraries. It is a tool for auditing and studying Odoo code, not a day-to-day user feature.

name: vcp_portal
summary: Connects Version Control Platform data with the Odoo customer portal, so the portal can use it. It is a small integration module.

name: vcp_website
summary: Shows Version Control Platform data, such as organizations and users, on partner pages of the Odoo website. It is a glue module between the platform and the website.

name: vendor_transport_lead_time
summary: Splits a vendor's delivery delay into supplier lead time and transport lead time, which are added together for the total. This lets purchasing see how much of the wait is transport so shipping can be planned. The split appears on vendor price list entries and on purchase order lines.

name: voip_oca
summary: Lets you make phone calls from Odoo through a softphone in the browser, connected to a PBX (phone system) over a websocket. Each user has their own PBX login, and the phone widget is opened from the top bar. Test environments never contact the PBX.

name: web_action_conditionable
summary: Adds conditions to the create and delete actions in One2many tree views, so you can decide when a user may add or remove lines there. It works in any tree view that sits inside a One2many field.

name: web_action_conditionable
summary: Adds conditions to the Create and Delete actions on one2many list fields. This lets a developer decide when a user may add or remove lines inside a form. It has no screen of its own and is meant for developers building forms.

name: web_advanced_search
summary: Makes search filters more powerful, especially for related fields. You can filter a record by a linked record's field, such as customers whose invoices have a credit limit above a value. Use the Filters option in a search view and pick a relational field.

name: web_apply_field_style
summary: Adds a CSS class to chosen fields in form views, so they can be highlighted, for example for training. Styles are set in code, per model, rather than on screen.

name: web_calendar_slot_duration
summary: Lets developers set custom time slot lengths in backend calendar views, for example 30 minutes or 10 minutes, so events snap to the chosen grid. It has no end-user feature by itself and needs another module that uses it. Demo data changes the Scheduled Actions calendar to 10-minute slots.

name: web_calendar_slot_duration
summary: Lets calendar views use custom slot durations for snapping and event length. It adds no screen of its own, and it is set through the action context for developers.

name: web_chatter_camera
summary: Adds a camera button to the chatter on mobile, so you can take a photo and attach it straight to a record. The button only shows on phones and tablets.

name: web_chatter_position
summary: Lets each user choose where the chatter (messages and activity panel) sits on a form: auto, bottom or to the side. The choice is made in User Preferences, and the form can use the full width. It works in both Community and Enterprise.

name: web_chatter_position
summary: Lets each user move the chatter (the messages and activity panel) to another position on the form, from their preferences. It works in both Community and Enterprise.

name: web_chatter_position
summary: Lets each user choose where the chatter (messages and activity panel) sits on forms, through User Preferences with the options auto, bottom or sided. The position can also be changed on the fly with a button at the top right of form views. It works in both Community and Enterprise.

name: web_company_color
summary: Changes the colors of the top navigation bar and buttons to match the company logo. Colors are set in the Navbar section of the company form, and a logo with transparency gives the best result. The change is seen throughout the backend.

name: web_company_context_highlight
summary: Highlights the company switcher in the top bar when more than one company is selected, so users notice which companies they are working in. The highlight colours are set under Settings > General Settings, in the Companies section.

name: web_copy_confirm
summary: Shows a confirmation dialog before a record is duplicated from the Action menu on a form. It helps prevent accidental copies.

name: web_copy_confirm
summary: Shows a confirmation pop-up when a user picks Duplicate from the Action menu on a form, so a record is not copied by accident. The user confirms before the copy is made. It applies to standard form views in any app.

name: web_dark_mode
summary: Adds a dark mode to the Odoo backend for Community edition. Each user switches it on from the user menu at the top right, and it can follow the device setting.

name: web_dark_mode
summary: Adds a dark mode to the Odoo backend for Community users. Each user switches it on from the user menu at the top right, and can choose to follow their device setting. It changes only the look of the backend.

name: web_dashboard_tile
summary: Adds an Overview dashboard made of tiles, each showing a count or a sum, average, minimum, maximum or median of records for a domain. Clicking a tile opens the matching list. Tiles can be personal, global or limited to groups, and they are set up under Dashboards > Configuration.

name: web_date_format_numeric
summary: Shows dates in numeric form, such as 31/01/2026, instead of the spelled-out month, for any language where it is switched on. You turn it on per language under Settings > Translations > Languages.

name: web_datetime_picker_default_time
summary: Lets a date-and-time field take a default time when the user only picks a date, such as 17:00 for a commitment date. Without it, the time used is the time the page was opened. The default is set in the form view, either as a fixed value or computed from a field.

name: web_dialog_size
summary: Adds a button to every dialog window to expand it to full width and restore it again, and lets dialogs be dragged around. Administrators can set dialogs to open maximized by default with a system parameter. The button sits in the top right corner of pop-up dialogs.

name: web_dialog_size
summary: Adds a button to dialog boxes that expands them to full width or restores them, and makes them draggable. Admins can set dialogs to open maximized by default with a system parameter.

name: web_disable_export_group
summary: Adds a separate Direct Export (xlsx) group, so a user can be allowed the quick export from a list view without getting the full Export All feature. Admins always keep full export rights. It is set by assigning users to the group in the user settings.

name: web_disable_export_group
summary: Adds a separate Direct Export (xlsx) group, so you can allow a user to export from the list view without giving them the full Export All feature. Admins can always export.

name: web_domain_field
summary: Technical add-on that lets a developer filter a relational field in a view by the value of another field on the same form, instead of a fixed filter. Developers use it when they build views, and it has no screen of its own.

name: web_edit_user_filter
summary: Lets normal users edit their saved filters and remove parts of a filter (facets) from the search bar, without needing debug mode. You open the Favorites menu in a list or kanban view, click the star on a filter, then the pencil icon to edit it.

name: web_editor_class_selector
summary: Lets admins create CSS class records under Settings > Technical > User Interface, so users can apply those classes from the HTML editor. The CSS itself must be loaded by a custom module.

name: web_editor_class_selector
summary: Lets administrators define custom CSS class names that users can apply to blocks in the HTML editor, such as signatures or templates. The actual CSS must be loaded by a custom module. Classes are set up under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Web editor Class.

name: web_editor_disable_chatgpt
summary: Removes the ChatGPT option from the HTML editor, so users cannot generate or rewrite text with it. It takes effect on installation and has no other visible change. Use it where AI text tools are not wanted.

name: web_editor_media_dialog_dms
summary: Lets users insert images or links to files from the document management system into HTML fields in the web editor, such as product descriptions or website pages. Typing /image opens the media dialog, where the DMS tab offers the files. Files can optionally be shared with public users.

name: web_editor_media_dialog_dms
summary: Adds the DMS tab to the HTML editor's media dialog, so you can insert an image from the document management system with a link to its file. Typing /image in an HTML field opens the dialog, and public sharing can be allowed on the file.

name: web_environment_ribbon
summary: Shows a red ribbon in the top left corner of every backend page, so test databases are easy to spot. The ribbon text and colours are set with system parameters, and it can be hidden by clearing the name parameter.

name: web_environment_ribbon
summary: Shows a red ribbon with a TEST label in the top left corner of every backend page, so test or staging databases are easy to tell apart from live ones. The label and colors can be changed or hidden with system parameters. It appears on all backend screens once installed.

name: web_excel_export_dynamic_expand
summary: When exporting a grouped list to Excel, it exports either only the main groups or the full tree, depending on whether the groups are collapsed or one is open. This means the export matches what is on screen. It applies to grouped list views.

name: web_export_html_as_text
summary: Lets you export HTML fields as plain text instead of HTML code. You tick Export HTML as text in the export dialog from a list view.

name: web_favicon
summary: Lets you set a custom browser tab icon (favicon) on the company record, for branding or to tell several Odoo instances apart. The icon also shows for portal users when the website apps are not installed. Browsers cache icons, so a change may need a cache clear to appear.

name: web_field_numeric_formatting
summary: Lets developers show float and integer fields without thousands separators, in list and form views. It is a backport for version 16, not a screen users change.

name: web_field_tooltip
summary: Adds a tooltip next to a field's label on any form, with rich text you write. You configure tooltips under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Fields Tooltips, or from the form itself.

name: web_field_tooltip
summary: Adds a tooltip next to a field's label on any form, with plain text you write. You configure tooltips under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Fields Tooltips, or from the form itself.

name: web_filter_header_button
summary: Lets selected search filters appear as buttons in the top control panel of a list or kanban view, rather than only inside the filter dropdown. Users click a button to apply the filter straight away. Developers choose which filters to show with a context setting.

name: web_font_size_report_layout
summary: Adds a font size choice (9, 10, 12 or 14 pt) to the Document Layout wizard, so printed invoices, quotations and orders can be made smaller or larger. You choose it under Settings > General Settings > Companies > Configure Document Layout.

name: web_font_size_report_layout
summary: Adds a Font Size setting to the Document Layout wizard, so company PDF reports such as invoices, quotations and sales orders can be printed in a chosen size from 9 pt to 14 pt. The standard size is 10 pt. It is set under Settings > General Settings > Companies > Configure Document Layout.

name: web_form_banner
summary: Shows alert banners at the top of backend forms, based on rules you write per model, such as a warning when a sale order is over a credit limit. Each banner has a severity of info, warning or danger, and the text can use placeholders or custom HTML.

name: web_form_banner
summary: Shows rule-based alert banners at the top of backend forms, such as a warning when a record needs attention. Each banner has a severity of info, warning or danger, and you create the rules under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Form Banner Rules.

name: web_form_banner
summary: Shows configurable alert banners at the top of backend forms, such as a warning on a sale order that needs attention. Rules pick the model and views, the message, the severity and when to show it. Rules are set up under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Form Banner Rules.

name: web_group_by_percentage
summary: Shows each group's share of the total as a percentage in grouped list views. Group a list by one or more fields to see it.

name: web_group_expand
summary: Adds Expand all and Collapse all buttons to grouped list views, in place of the pagination. One level of groups is opened or closed at a time.

name: web_group_expand
summary: Adds Expand all and Collapse all buttons to grouped list views, so every group opens or closes in one click. The buttons sit in the top right, where the pager normally is. It works one group level at a time.

name: web_help
summary: Adds an in-app help framework with step-by-step guides that users can reopen at any time, unlike the standard tours that run once and only for admins. A ? button next to the view switcher opens the guide for that screen.

name: web_help
summary: Adds an interactive help framework that walks users through a screen step by step, with help bubbles they can reopen at any time. It is open to all users, not just admins, and does not force them to create records. A demo guide is reached from the question mark button next to the view switcher on the Users list.

name: web_hide_field_with_key
summary: Lets a user hide a field on a form by pressing the P key, for fields marked with a special CSS class. It is a developer-prepared feature for tidying up a screen.

name: web_ir_actions_act_multi
summary: Lets a button trigger several actions at once, such as closing a dialog and then reloading the page. This is a developer feature with no screen of its own. It is used by code that returns a list of actions.

name: web_ir_actions_act_multi
summary: Technical add-on that lets one button or action run several actions in a row. Developers use it when returning actions from code, and it adds no screen for users.

name: web_ir_actions_act_window_message
summary: Technical add-on that lets a button show a message box to the user on screen. Developers use it when returning a message action, and it does nothing on its own.

name: web_ir_actions_act_window_message
summary: Lets a button show a pop-up message box with a title and text to the user, such as a confirmation or a result. The close button text can be changed or hidden. This is a developer feature used by server code, with no screen of its own.

name: web_ir_actions_act_window_page
summary: Lets a form view page to the next or previous record after a button action, for example after validating a record in a review queue. The demo adds Previous Partner and Next Partner buttons to the contact form. It is mainly a developer feature.

name: web_ir_actions_client_scan
summary: Adds a barcode scan action to the web backend, so a camera or a scanner can read a code and send it to a server method. Developers attach it to a button through a client action, and it opens a scan popup.

name: web_ir_actions_close_wizard_refresh_view
summary: Lets a wizard refresh the view behind it when it closes, so the list updates without reloading the page. Developers return this action from the wizard method.

name: web_leaflet_draw_lib
summary: Adds the Leaflet Draw library to Odoo, so maps can have drawing tools such as shapes and markers. It is a developer library and depends on the Leaflet library.

name: web_leaflet_lib
summary: Adds the Leaflet JavaScript mapping library to Odoo, so maps can be shown in views. Map tiles come from a tile server that you set in the system parameter leaflet.tile_url. It is a developer library used by map views.

name: web_leaflet_lib
summary: Adds the Leaflet JavaScript mapping library to Odoo, so maps can be shown in views. Map tiles come from a tile server that you set in the system parameter leaflet.tile_url. It is a developer library used by map views.

name: web_leaflet_lib
summary: Adds the Leaflet JavaScript mapping library to Odoo, so maps can be shown in views. Map tiles come from a tile server that you set in the system parameter leaflet.tile_url. It is a developer library used by map views.

name: web_listview_range_select
summary: Lets you select a range of records in a list by holding Shift and clicking a second record. You can repeat the range selection as often as you like.

name: web_loading_block_ui
summary: When a request takes longer than a set delay, such as opening a heavy report or saving a large record, the whole screen is blurred with a centered Loading spinner until it finishes. This brings back the behavior of Odoo 16 and earlier. The delay is set by a system parameter in milliseconds, with 3000 as the default.

name: web_m2x_options
summary: Adds display options to many2one and many2many tag fields, such as hiding the Create and Create and Edit entries, changing how many suggestions show, or stopping the create dialog on errors. By default the create options are hidden for users who cannot create the related record. It is set in the field options in views.

name: web_m2x_options
summary: Adds options to Many2one and Many2many dropdowns in form fields. You can hide the Create and Create and Edit entries, change how many suggestions appear, and show colors on tags. Create options are hidden automatically if the user cannot create the record anyway.

name: web_m2x_options_manager
summary: Gives a screen under Settings > Technical > Models to choose the Create and Create and Edit options for relational fields, without editing code. Each model's form has a Create/Edit Options tab listing its fields. It is for administrators who want to control those dropdown entries.

name: web_merge_notebook_tab
summary: Lets an administrator combine several tabs on a form into one tab, so users no longer have to click through many small tabs to check or fill in a record.
