Settings are made under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Merge Notebook tab Settings, where you pick the form view and the tabs to merge. The merged tab then appears on that form in any app where the view is used, such as product or contact forms.

name: web_no_bubble
summary: Removes the small bubble-style help hints that Odoo 10 and later added to the backend, giving a cleaner look. Help boxes are kept. It is a visual, technical module and changes nothing in business data.

name: web_no_bubble
summary: Removes the guided bubbles that Odoo shows on screens. Help boxes are kept. It is for users who find the bubbles distracting, and it takes effect once installed.

name: web_notify
summary: A technical base module that lets the server push instant pop-up notifications to a user's screen while they work in Odoo. Notifications come in success, danger, warning, info and default colours, and can optionally play a sound. Developers call its methods from custom code, and the module adds per-user channel name settings on the user record.

name: web_notify
summary: Lets the server send live pop-up notifications to a user's screen, in success, warning, danger, info or default colors. This is a technical module: developers call it from code, and users see the message appear on screen. Each user can have their own channel names for these notices.

name: web_notify_channel_message
summary: Sends an instant notification to everyone in a Discuss channel when a new message is posted there. Members see it on screen straight away without having to check the channel. It is for channel members in the Discuss app.

name: web_notify_channel_message
summary: Sends an instant pop-up notification to everyone in a Discuss channel whenever a new message is posted there. It uses the web notification feature, so members see the alert on screen while they are working in Odoo. Nothing is added to the forms; it only changes what users are alerted to.

name: web_notify_upgrade
summary: Sends a notice to all active users when a module is installed or upgraded, asking them to refresh the page to see the changes. It helps avoid users working on a stale screen after an update. It is a technical module that runs in the background.

name: web_notify_upgrade
summary: Shows a notification to every active user when a module has been installed or updated, asking them to refresh the page so they see the latest changes. It is a technical helper for administrators who upgrade Odoo and want users to pick up changes without confusion. It adds no screens or fields.

name: web_phone_field_whatsapp
summary: Adds a WhatsApp option to phone number fields in the Odoo backend, so a user can open a WhatsApp chat with a contact in one click from the phone number they have already typed. It opens WhatsApp Web or the WhatsApp app. It appears wherever a phone field uses the phone widget, such as contact or lead forms.

name: web_pivot_computed_measure
summary: Adds a Computed Measure option to the pivot view's Measures menu. You can combine two measures with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division or percentage, and the result shows as a new column. It works on pivot reports in any app.

name: web_portal_properties
summary: Adds a Show in portal setting to custom properties, so chosen property values appear on the customer portal for that record. Users can also edit them there when the field uses the portal widget. Developers add the setting to the field definition.

name: web_pwa_customize
summary: Lets you set the name, icon and colors used when Odoo is installed as a Progressive Web App on a phone or computer. These are set under Settings > General Settings in the Progressive Web App section. It affects how the app looks once installed.

name: web_pwa_oca
summary: Makes Odoo installable as a progressive web app, so users can add it to their phone or desktop home screen and open it like a standalone app. Administrators set the app name, short name, icon and colours under Settings > General Settings > Progressive Web App. The change is visible on the device home screen after install, not inside the business screens.

name: web_quick_start_screen
summary: Gives users a configurable start screen of quick action buttons when they log in, so they go straight to common tasks. It can be set per user or used as shared screens. Quick actions are created under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Screen actions.

name: web_refresh_from_backend
summary: A technical tool for developers and administrators that forces open views to reload for selected users, optionally only for specific records. For example, when an opportunity is won, the salespeople's kanban and form views can refresh to show the change. It adds a reload_views helper on the user model and warns that unsaved edits on a form may be lost.

name: web_refresher
summary: Adds a refresh button next to the pager in list and kanban views, so a user can reload the records on screen without leaving and returning to the view. It is a small convenience for seeing the latest data. No new fields or settings are added.

name: web_refresher
summary: Adds a refresh button next to the pager on list and kanban views, so the displayed records reload without a full page refresh. It is a small convenience button available on any list or kanban screen.

name: web_remember_tree_column_width
summary: Remembers the width each user sets for list view columns, so the layout is kept across sessions and after filtering, grouping or reordering. Users do not have to resize columns again each time they open a list. It applies to all list views.

name: web_remember_tree_column_width
summary: Keeps the column widths a user sets in list views, so they are still in place the next time they open that list, and after filtering, grouping or reordering columns. It is a per-user display convenience in any list view. No business data or settings are changed.

name: web_responsive
summary: Makes the backend work better on phones and tablets and adds several desktop shortcuts. Highlights include a full-screen app menu with search, sticky list headers, bigger checkboxes, and Alt+Shift+number keyboard shortcuts. It also lets users choose whether to be redirected to the home page after login.

name: web_responsive
summary: Makes the Odoo backend usable on phones, tablets and desktops, with a full-screen app menu and app search, sticky list headers and form status bars, bigger inputs on mobile, and keyboard shortcuts such as Alt+Shift+S for Save. It changes the look and navigation across all apps, and is maintained by the community rather than Odoo S.A. It is the base that several other responsive add-ons depend on.

name: web_responsive_attachment_preview
summary: Brings back the attachment preview panel on the right side of forms, such as invoices, when web_responsive is used. Users can see an attached PDF or image next to the record without opening it separately. It is a display setting that appears on forms with attachments.

name: web_responsive_company
summary: Improves the company switcher in the top bar for users who work across many companies. The list shows each company's logo and code, sorts by name, and can be searched by typing part of the name. It is only useful for databases with many companies.

name: web_responsive_company_color
summary: Connects the responsive layout to the company color settings, so the elements added by web_responsive use the same colors set for the company. It has no screen of its own, and it should be installed alongside both modules. Colors are set as described in the company color module.

name: web_save_discard_button
summary: Restyles the Save and Discard buttons on forms so they are easier to see. It is a visual change only and applies across backend forms. It has no settings.

name: web_save_discard_button
summary: Restyles the Save and Discard buttons on forms in the backend so they are easier to spot. It is a visual change only and does not alter how records are saved. It applies wherever those buttons appear.

name: web_search_deactivate_autosearch
summary: Adds an Auto search checkbox next to the search bar. When it is unchecked, a user can add several filters, group-bys or favourites and the list only refreshes once they click the search icon. This avoids running a slow search after every single filter. It appears on any view with a search bar, such as lists and kanban boards.

name: web_search_with_and
summary: Lets a user search the same field twice and get records that match both terms, instead of either one. For example, customers containing both John and Smith in the name field. It is used from the search bar by holding Shift when adding the second term. It works in any view that has the omnibar search.

name: web_search_with_and
summary: Lets a user search the same field twice and get records matching both terms, instead of either term. For example, searching for customers named John and then Smith returns contacts containing both. Hold Shift while choosing the field in the search bar to switch to AND.

name: web_searchbar_full_width
summary: Stretches the search bar across the full width of the screen and moves it below the breadcrumb, so many active filters fit on one line instead of pushing the page down. The breadcrumb also gets more room for long titles. It is a display change on all views with a search bar.

name: web_select_all_companies
summary: Adds a single action that selects or clears every company at once in the company switcher, for users who need to see data across all their companies. It saves clicking each company one by one. It applies to the top-bar company menu for multi-company users.

name: web_send_message_popup
summary: Changes the Send a message link under a record's chatter so it opens the full email pop-up straight away, with subject, templates, attachments and followers. This skips the small text box step. It applies to the chatter on every form.

name: web_session_auto_close
summary: Logs out users who have been inactive for a set time, and returns the page to the login screen. The timeout, in seconds, is set in Settings > General. It helps protect shared computers and sensitive data.

name: web_sheet_full_width
summary: Makes the main form sheet use the full width of the screen instead of a centered narrow column, so wide forms have more room. It works in both Community and Enterprise. The module's author notes that web_responsive already includes this and is the better choice for new installs.

name: web_sort_menu
summary: Sorts the app names in the apps dropdown and the top navigation menu alphabetically, based on the user's language. The sorting applies automatically after installation, with no settings.

name: web_sort_menu
summary: Sorts the apps in the Odoo app menu alphabetically, based on the language each user has set. With web_responsive installed, the top navigation bar apps are also sorted this way. It changes only the order of the app menu, not any data.

name: web_systray_button_init_action
summary: Adds a button in the top bar that jumps straight to the user's home screen, which is the action they chose as their Home action in their preferences. It only shows up in debug mode, and the user must have a Home action set on their Preferences tab. It is a navigation shortcut for any user.

name: web_systray_button_init_action
summary: Adds a button to the top bar that jumps to the user's chosen home action, such as their preferred screen. It appears only when a home action is set in the user's preferences. Debug mode is needed to set that preference.

name: web_theme_classic
summary: Adds stronger contrast to form fields so input boxes stand out from the page, making forms easier to read and fill in. It is a visual theme change that applies to form views in the backend. It does not change any data or behaviour.

name: web_theme_classic
summary: Adds stronger visual contrast to form fields so users can see where inputs are and which ones are required before they try to save. It restores the look of Odoo 15 forms while keeping the save-as-you-go behaviour of newer versions. It is a styling change on form views in the backend.

name: web_theme_classic
summary: Makes input fields easier to see by giving them a visible border and marking required fields clearly, similar to the Odoo 15 look. Each user can switch it on for themselves, or make it persistent across devices in preferences. It changes only the look of the backend.

name: web_time_range_menu_custom
summary: Adds a Custom Period tab to the date filter menu, so users can filter by a chosen date range such as the last 7 days. In pivot views, the comparison tab gets the same option, so a period can be compared against a reference period. It appears wherever date filters and pivot tables are used.

name: web_time_range_menu_custom
summary: Adds a Custom Period option to the date filter menu, so users can build their own date ranges such as the last 7 days. The same option is available for the comparison period in pivot views. It applies to any screen with date-based filters.

name: web_timeline
summary: Adds a Timeline view that shows records as bars or events on a zoomable time axis, for example for planning or scheduling. Users switch to it with the clock icon in the view switcher. Developers set it up with a view definition naming the start and end date fields.

name: web_timeline
summary: Adds a Timeline view type, shown as a clock icon in the view switcher, that displays records as bars or events along a time axis. Users can zoom, pan and click through events, and the view fits itself to the records after a search or group-by. Developers define it with a timeline view in XML, which is useful for schedules, bookings and project phases.

name: web_toggle_chatter
summary: Adds a button on backend forms to show or hide the chatter, the messages and activity panel. This frees room for the form when the chatter is not needed. It appears on any form view once installed.

name: web_touchscreen
summary: On tablets and other touchscreen devices, sub-forms in one2many fields use the kanban-style view, which is easier to tap. It applies on any device with a touch screen, whatever its size. It is used on forms that contain such sub-views, such as a sale order's lines.

name: web_tree_column_keyboard_resize
summary: Lets users widen or narrow a list column with Shift plus the Up or Down arrow while editing a row, without using the mouse. The change lasts only while that row is being edited, and then the column returns to its normal width. It applies in editable list views.

name: web_tree_duplicate
summary: Adds a Duplicate action to the Action menu of list views, so a user can copy selected records directly from the list. Only the rows currently shown are copied, so the list limit matters when duplicating many records. Developers can turn the option off per list view.

name: web_tree_dynamic_colored_field
summary: Lets developers color a list cell's background or text based on the record's data, for example red for customers. It is set up in the list view definition with options on the field. It is a technical module with no screen of its own.

name: web_tree_many2one_clickable
summary: Makes linked-record fields in list views clickable, so a user can open the related contact, product or other record straight from the list with a button, without leaving the list. It applies to many2one columns in list views. It is a navigation convenience.

name: web_tree_many2one_clickable
summary: Makes many2one and reference fields in list views clickable, so you can open the linked record with a button without going into the form. Hover over a cell and click the button that appears. It is turned on automatically after installation.

name: web_view_google_map
summary: Adds a Google Map view type that shows records with coordinates as markers, colour-coded and grouped into clusters when zoomed out. It also adds address fields with Google Places autocomplete. On Contacts, the partner action already offers a map mode, and a user needs a Google Maps API key configured in settings.

name: web_view_leaflet_map
summary: Adds a Leaflet Map view type, using OpenStreetMap, that shows each record with a location as a marker and groups nearby markers together when zoomed out. It needs coordinates on the records, which can be filled in with the base_geolocalize module. The view is developer-configured and appears in the view switcher of any action that enables it.

name: web_view_leaflet_map
summary: Adds a Leaflet Map view type, using OpenStreetMap, that shows each record with a location as a marker and groups nearby markers together when zoomed out. It needs coordinates on the records, which can be filled in with the base_geolocalize module. The view is developer-configured and appears in the view switcher of any action that enables it.

name: web_view_leaflet_map_partner
summary: Adds a map icon to the Contacts app so users can see customers and other contacts plotted on an OpenStreetMap map. Only contacts with latitude and longitude show up, and those coordinates can be filled in with base_geolocalize. It builds on the generic leaflet map view.

name: web_view_leaflet_map_partner
summary: Adds a map icon to the Contacts app so users can see customers and other contacts plotted on an OpenStreetMap map. Only contacts with latitude and longitude show up, and those coordinates can be filled in with base_geolocalize. It builds on the generic leaflet map view.

name: web_widget_bokeh_chart
summary: A developer tool that lets a custom Python field render an interactive Bokeh chart inside a standard Odoo form or view. It is for building custom analytics screens, and a non-technical user will only see it if a developer has added a chart field to a view. It has no effect on standard screens.

name: web_widget_bokeh_chart
summary: Lets developers display interactive Bokeh charts inside standard Odoo views, using a computed field that holds the chart. It is for developers building custom chart screens. It has no end-user feature of its own.

name: web_widget_char_size
summary: Adds a size option to text fields in the interface, which limits how many characters a user can type. It is a technical widget option that a developer sets in the view, and it replaces the older size parameter on the field definition, which is deprecated. Users see it as a character cap on specific text boxes.

name: web_widget_char_size
summary: Adds a size option to Char fields so the input accepts only a set number of characters. The option is set in the view definition. The older way of setting size on the field itself is deprecated.

name: web_widget_datepicker_fulloptions
summary: Adds a Today button to the date picker and a Close button that keeps the selected date. It saves a click when entering the current date on any date field. Clearing a date is still not possible because of a limitation in Odoo core.

name: web_widget_domain_editor_dialog
summary: Brings back the dialog that lets a user open the list of records matched by a domain filter and pick or edit specific records from it. It is aimed at administrators who build saved filters in debug mode, such as user-level filters, and combines the Odoo search engine with manual record selection. It appears on domain fields in debug forms.

name: web_widget_domain_editor_dialog
summary: Lets users edit a domain filter in a pop-up dialog and see the matching records as they build it. It is most useful in user-defined filters, where a user picks a model and adds conditions. In debug mode it is reached from Settings > Technical > User Interface > User-defined Filters.

name: web_widget_domain_editor_dialog
summary: Brings back the dialog that lets a user open the list of records matched by a domain filter and pick or edit specific records from it. It is aimed at administrators who build saved filters in debug mode, such as user-level filters, and combines the Odoo search engine with manual record selection. It appears on domain fields in debug forms.

name: web_widget_dropdown_dynamic
summary: Lets a Char, Integer or Selection field fill its dropdown choices from server code, so the options can change depending on other values. The choices can be narrowed based on context, such as what a user has already filled in. It is for developers, and the demo is on the user-defined filters screen.

name: web_widget_dropdown_dynamic
summary: A developer widget that fills a dropdown with options fetched from the server when the form loads, rather than a fixed list. It filters the values of text, integer or selection fields, so the choices can change with the data. Business users see it as a dropdown whose options match what is currently available.

name: web_widget_image_download
summary: Adds a Download button to image fields, so a user can save the picture to their computer. In the example, it appears on a contact's form in the Contacts app. It is an extra action on image widgets.

name: web_widget_image_download
summary: Adds a Download button to image fields, such as the contact photo, so a user can save the picture to their computer. It appears on the form in edit mode, for example at the top left of a contact record. It only copies the image and changes nothing in the record.

name: web_widget_image_webcam
summary: Adds a webcam option to image fields so a user can take a snapshot with the computer camera and save it directly to the record, such as a contact photo or product image. It works in major browsers, but Chrome needs the site to be served over HTTPS, and the module has a setup note for sites without HTTPS. It appears on image fields in forms.

name: web_widget_mapbox
summary: Adds a Mapbox map widget for JSON fields on forms, showing markers on a map with optional icons, colours and clickable popups that open a record. Users can switch between map and satellite views. It needs a public Mapbox token entered under Settings > General Settings > Integrations, and it is for developers to place on a form.

name: web_widget_mapbox_demo
summary: A demo module that adds a Mapbox tab to the contact form, showing the contact as a draggable pin and nearby child contacts as clickable icons. Dragging the pin and saving updates the contact's geo latitude and longitude. It needs a Mapbox token set in General Settings, and it is meant for trying out the Mapbox widget rather than daily use.

name: web_widget_mpld3_chart
summary: A developer tool that lets a custom Python field show an interactive matplotlib-style chart, rendered in the browser, inside a standard Odoo form or view. It provides an abstract parser that developers inherit from. Business users only see it where a developer has added such a chart field.

name: web_widget_mpld3_chart
summary: Lets developers show interactive matplotlib charts inside standard Odoo views, using a JSON field that holds the chart. It is for developers building custom chart screens. It has no end-user feature of its own.

name: web_widget_numeric_step
summary: Adds plus and minus buttons beside number fields in edit mode, so a user can raise or lower a value with a click. The step size and the minimum and maximum can be set on the field, for example for a credit limit. It is used on number fields in forms, and the module's description points to the Credit Limit field on a user as a demo.

name: web_widget_numeric_step
summary: Adds plus and minus buttons beside number fields, so values can be nudged up or down in edit mode. The step size and minimum and maximum limits can be set in the view. The Credit Limit field on a user record is the demo.

name: web_widget_o2m_attachment_image_gallery
summary: Lets a view show a set of images as a gallery, such as a kanban of product or record pictures. It is set up in the view XML. It is for developers building image-heavy screens.

name: web_widget_one2many_tree_line_duplicate
summary: Adds a clone icon to each line of a one2many list, so a line can be copied in one click. The copy does not run the normal default or onchange values. It is turned on per field with an allow_clone option in the view.

name: web_widget_open_tab
summary: Adds an icon button to the first column of a list view that opens the record in a new browser tab, while clicking the row still opens it in the same window. It can also be switched on for any model through a setting on the model definition. It is useful when a user needs to keep the list open while checking a record.

name: web_widget_open_tab
summary: Adds a button in a list that opens the record in a new browser tab, while a normal click still opens it in the same window. This is useful when a user wants to keep a list open and check a record elsewhere. It is set on a field in the list view, or added as an option on the model in Technical settings.

name: web_widget_pattern
summary: Lets a text field be checked against a pattern, such as digits only, when a user types in it. The pattern can be set in the Python field definition or on the view. Demo data limits the second address line on partner forms to numbers.

name: web_widget_pattern_partner_autocomplete
summary: A technical glue module that makes the input pattern rules (regex validation) work on the partner autocomplete fields. It adds no new screens or fields of its own. Its effect shows up only where a pattern has been defined for those fields.

name: web_widget_plotly_chart
summary: A developer tool that lets a custom Python field show an interactive Plotly chart inside a standard Odoo form or view. Developers compute the chart data in code and attach it to a text field. Business users only see it where a developer has added a chart.

name: web_widget_plotly_chart
summary: A developer tool that lets a custom Python field show an interactive Plotly chart inside a standard Odoo form or view. Developers compute the chart data in code and attach it to a text field. Business users only see it where a developer has added a chart.

name: web_widget_popover
summary: Shows a Char or Text field as a small icon, and the full text appears in a tooltip when the user hovers over it. This keeps long notes out of the way on busy forms. It is set on the field in the view with the popover widget.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note
summary: Merges the product and the description into one column on invoice lines, so the product label shows right after the product name and a button lets the user add a description when none exists. It keeps invoice lines compact and easier to read. It appears on invoice lines in Invoicing > Customers > Invoices.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note
summary: Merges the product and the description into one column on invoice lines, so the product label shows right after the product name and a button lets the user add a description when none exists. It keeps invoice lines compact and easier to read. It appears on invoice lines in Invoicing > Customers > Invoices.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label
summary: Shows the full text of an invoice or purchase order line in the product label widget, including the product name. Previously the widget hid the product name from the label, which made editing descriptions confusing. It applies to lines on invoices and purchase orders.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label
summary: Makes the label shown in the product and note widget on invoice and purchase lines display the full line name or description. Without it, the widget strips the product name out of the label, which can be confusing when editing a description. It is a display change on invoice and purchase order lines.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label_sale
summary: A glue module that makes the full-label section and note widget work on sale order lines. It also makes invoices reuse the sale line's name when they are created from an order. It is technical and adds no new screens.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_name_visibility
summary: Adds an eye icon on invoice lines that toggles whether the product name shows in the line description. Users can hide the product name and keep only the description. It appears on the customer invoice lines in Invoicing > Customers > Invoices.

name: web_widget_progressbar_gradient
summary: Shows progress bars that change colour as the value rises, from green through yellow to red, which makes high values stand out at a glance. An option reverses the colours for fields where a high number is good. It applies to progress bar fields that a developer has set to use this widget.

name: web_widget_remaining_days_exact_date
summary: Shows the exact calendar date next to the remaining-days count on date fields, such as a due date that reads 3 days left and also shows the date itself. It can be turned off per field with an option. It appears on fields that use the remaining days widget.

name: web_widget_remote_measure
summary: Lets a user take a reading from a networked scale or measuring device and have the value typed into the form automatically, for example a weight for a stock move. Devices are set up under Settings > Technical > Devices > Remote devices, and a user picks their device in the top bar when permitted. Only websocket devices are supported at the moment.

name: web_widget_remote_measure_utilcell
summary: Adds support for UTILCELL brand scales as a protocol option on a remote measure device, so their readings can be sent into Odoo. The scale must be reachable over the network by direct TCP connection. It is set on the remote device form under Settings > Technical > Devices > Remote devices.

name: web_widget_section_and_note_text_scrollable
summary: Makes long descriptions and notes on invoice and sales lines scroll inside their box when they are not being edited, so long text does not stretch the line. It is a layout change for the section and note widget on lines. It only affects the display of long text.

name: web_widget_sub_view
summary: A technical widget that lets a developer place a list of related records inside a form, with its own search filters and a chosen view type, list on desktop and kanban on phones by default. It can set default values and the creation action for the embedded list. Business users see it as a related list embedded in a form.

name: web_widget_url_advanced
summary: Lets a developer show a link with a custom label instead of the raw web address, taken from another field on the record, such as the partner's name on a website link. Many2one fields use their display name automatically. It changes how URL fields look on forms and lists.

name: web_widget_url_advanced
summary: Lets a URL field show a custom link text, such as the partner's name, instead of the raw web address. You can also add a prefix to the link. Many2one fields work too, using their display name. It is set in the view definition.

name: web_widget_x2many_2d_matrix
summary: Shows a one-to-many list as a grid, with one axis for rows, one for columns and editable cells where they meet. For example, a manager can enter planned hours for each employee against each task in one table. It is a technical widget that other modules use.

name: web_widget_x2many_2d_matrix
summary: Shows a related-records field as a grid, with one axis for one field, the other axis for a second field, and an editable value in each cell. For example, a manager can enter planned hours for each task and employee in one table. It is set up by a developer on a one2many field, and it replaces the usual list for that field.

name: webservice
summary: A technical framework that lets Odoo call external web services over HTTP, and stores the connection details (address, login, API key, OAuth2 settings) in a webservice backend record. Developers use it to connect Odoo to third-party systems. It has no screens for everyday users beyond the connection setup.

name: webservice
summary: A technical framework for calling external web services from Odoo, built on webservice_core. It adds OAuth2 sign-in options such as token URL and client credentials to the webservice backend record, and returns the full HTTP response to the developer. Business users only see it through the connection settings an administrator or developer creates.

name: webservice
summary: A technical framework that lets Odoo call external web services over HTTP, with connection details stored on a webservice backend record. It is the older form of the module that depends on server_environment, so the configuration can differ per environment. Developers use it to connect to third-party systems, and business users rarely see it.

name: webservice_core
summary: The lightweight base for outbound web service calls. It provides a webservice backend record that stores the address and login details (public, username and password, or API key), and lets a developer call it with a single line of code. It is set up under Settings > Technical > WebService Backend by an administrator.

name: webservice_server_env
summary: A small glue module that connects the web service backend settings to the server environment feature, so credentials can be provided per environment. When a database is neutralised, such as a copy for testing, stored credentials for the backend are cleared. It is a technical setup module with no screens of its own.

name: website_account_fiscal_position_partner_type
summary: Lets e-commerce customers say whether they are an end customer or a company during checkout, so the right taxes are applied, which matters for EU One-Stop-Shop sales. Administrators can add B2B and B2C explanation text to the registration page under the website settings. It appears on the website sign-up and checkout.

name: website_altcha
summary: Adds a self-hosted, privacy-friendly captcha to website forms, so visitors must pass a check that tells real people from bots. It is switched on under Configuration > Website, in the Privacy section, and does not send data to outside captcha services. Administrators can set the key, algorithm, timeout and cost on each website.

name: website_analytics_matomo
summary: Connects an Odoo website to Matomo, a privacy-focused web analytics tool, so visits are tracked there. Administrators enter the Matomo website ID and host under Settings > General Settings > Website. It can also send a user ID so visits can be linked to logged-in users.

name: website_analytics_matomo
summary: Connects an Odoo website to Matomo, a privacy-focused web analytics tool, so visits are tracked there. Administrators enter the Matomo website ID and host under Settings > General Settings > Website. It can also send a user ID so visits can be linked to logged-in users.

name: website_attribute_set
summary: Shows the extra product attributes defined in PIM on the e-commerce product page, and lets shoppers compare products by those attributes. Attributes must be flagged E-Commerce Visibility and linked to the product's attribute set. Users find the setting under PIM > Attributes > Product Attribute, and the values appear on the shop product page.

name: website_blog_scheduled_publication
summary: Lets a website editor set a future date and time for a blog post, and the post is published automatically then. A Schedule button on the blog post opens a date picker, and a Publish button publishes right away. Followers are notified on publication, and blog post lists can be filtered by scheduled or published date under Website > Content > Blog Posts.

name: website_breadcrumb
summary: Shows breadcrumb trails, such as Home > Products > Chairs, at the top of website pages. Breadcrumbs only appear for pages whose address matches a website menu item, and the switch is in the website editor's Customise tab. Editors can adjust menus under Website Admin > Configuration > Menus.

name: website_cf_turnstile_login
summary: Adds a Cloudflare Turnstile bot check to the website login form, so automated logins are blocked. It requires the Cloudflare Turnstile module to be set up first. It appears on the customer login page of the website.

name: website_conditional_visibility_user_group
summary: Lets website editors show a block on a page only to internal users, only to portal users, or to everyone who is logged in. Editors set it in the website builder's Style tab under Visibility, then Conditional. It changes what logged-in visitors see on the public website.

name: website_cookiebot
summary: Shows a Cookiebot consent banner on the website, so visitors can accept or refuse cookies before any are set, and adds a Cookies Policy link in the footer. It is switched on in Website > Configuration > Settings under the privacy section, and needs the Domain Group ID from Cookiebot. It affects what visitors see on the public site.

name: website_cookiebot
summary: Shows a Cookiebot consent banner on the website, so visitors can accept or refuse cookies before any are set, and adds a Cookies Policy link in the footer. It is switched on in Website > Configuration > Settings under the privacy section, and needs the Domain Group ID from Cookiebot. It affects what visitors see on the public site.

name: website_cookiefirst
summary: Connects the website to the Cookiefirst consent service, so visitors see a GDPR cookie banner and choose which cookies to allow. The domain must be registered with Cookiefirst, and the API key goes in the Cookiefirst ID field under Website > Configuration > Settings. Only one cookie consent solution should be active at a time.

name: website_cookiefirst
summary: Connects the website to the Cookiefirst consent service, so visitors see a GDPR cookie banner and choose which cookies to allow. The domain must be registered with Cookiefirst, and the API key goes in the Cookiefirst ID field under Website > Configuration > Settings. Only one cookie consent solution should be active at a time.

name: website_crm_privacy_policy
summary: Adds a privacy policy tick box to the website contact form, so the visitor must agree before sending. It takes the policy text from the website legal page module. The module is deprecated, and the website_form_require_legal module now covers the same need on any form.

name: website_crm_quick_answer
summary: Sends an automatic welcome email to anyone who submits the website contact form, using a template that can be edited. The email comes from the main company's address. The template is under Settings > Technical > Email > Templates, and the automated action is under Settings > Technical > Automation.

name: website_crm_quick_answer
summary: Sends an automatic welcome email to anyone who submits the website contact form, using a template that can be edited. It needs the submit button configured to create an opportunity, and the email comes from the main company's address. The template is under Settings > Technical > Email > Templates.

name: website_debranding
summary: Removes the Powered by Odoo link from the footer of the public website. It is on by default, and the switch is under Website > Customize > Brand Promotion. It only changes the public site's footer and no business data.

name: website_event_altcha
summary: Adds the self-hosted ALTCHA bot check to the event registration form on the website, so automated sign-ups are blocked. It needs the website ALTCHA captcha module and the events website module. It appears on the public event registration step.

name: website_event_calendar
summary: Adds a generic calendar download option and some open-source calendar options to the Add to calendar choices on website event pages, alongside the existing Google and Outlook options. The generic ICS option is a neutral label for the same calendar file. Nothing needs configuring, and the options show on the public event page.

name: website_event_contact
summary: Adds a Contact section to the public event page, showing the event contacts that were entered on the event record in the back office. Editors turn it on from the website builder's Customize tab under the event page section. Visitors can then see who to reach about the event.

name: website_event_crm_invitation
summary: Lets a salesperson invite a lead or customer from a CRM opportunity to register for an event type on the website, by sending them an email with a link. Opportunities can advance automatically to the next stage once the invite is sent, if the stage is set up for it. It appears on the opportunity form in CRM under the Invite to website button.

name: website_event_external
summary: Lets an event be listed on the website alongside internal events while its registration happens on another website. Users tick External Event on the event form and enter an External Link, and the registration-related fields are hidden. It appears in the events list on the public site.

name: website_event_filter_city
summary: Adds a city filter to the events page on the website, so visitors can narrow the list of events to a chosen city. The filter can be switched on or off by editors in the website builder. The city is taken from a city field on each event.

name: website_event_membership_restriction
summary: Restricts event registration on the website to current members only. Each event has an Allow registration only to members tick box, and visitors who are not logged in or not members cannot reach the registration step. It is set on the event form under Events > Events.

name: website_event_questions_by_ticket
summary: Lets an event question appear only for certain ticket types, so a buyer of a VIP ticket can be asked extra questions that a standard ticket buyer does not see. Questions with no ticket limit show to everyone. It is set on each question on the event's Questions page.

name: website_event_questions_by_ticket
summary: Lets an event question appear only for certain ticket types, so a buyer of a VIP ticket can be asked extra questions that a standard ticket buyer does not see. Questions with no ticket limit show to everyone. It is set on each question on the event's Questions page, and needs the event sales module.

name: website_event_require_legal
summary: Requires website visitors to tick an acceptance box for terms and conditions before they can register for an event. Editors can write custom terms text, and if none is set, the default links to the terms page. Each accepted registration keeps a note of the acceptance in its chatter.

name: website_event_require_legal
summary: Requires website visitors to tick an acceptance box for terms and conditions before they can register for an event. Editors can write custom terms text, and if none is set, the default links to the terms page. Each accepted registration keeps a note of the acceptance in its chatter.

name: website_event_require_login
summary: Makes visitors log in before they can register for an event on the website. If an event is set to require login, a pop-up asks logged-out visitors to sign in first. It is set with a Require login for website registrations tick box on the event form.

name: website_event_ribbon
summary: Adds coloured ribbon labels, such as Sold Out or Featured, to event cards on the website. Administrators define ribbons with a name, colours and position, then pick one on each event. It changes how events look in the public event list.

name: website_event_sale_b2x_alt_price
summary: Shows the alternative price on the website event registration page, such as the tax-excluded price on a B2C site, so visitors can see what they will really pay under special tax rules. It applies to event tickets that have taxed products. It is set up by configuring tickets and publishing the event.

name: website_event_sale_cart_quantity_readonly
summary: Stops website shoppers from changing the ticket quantity directly in their cart for event tickets. To change the number, a shopper removes the line and registers again from the event page. It is a checkout behaviour change on the website shop for events.

name: website_event_ticket_limit
summary: Adds a Max. per order field to event tickets, so an administrator can cap how many tickets one buyer can purchase at once on the website. Setting it to 0 keeps Odoo's default limit of 9, and a higher value raises the limit above 9. It is set on the ticket line of an event.

name: website_event_ticket_limit
summary: Adds a Max. per order field to event tickets, so an administrator can cap how many tickets one buyer can purchase at once on the website. Setting it to 0 keeps Odoo's default limit of 9, and a higher value raises the limit above 9. It is set on the ticket line of an event.

name: website_event_track_stage_cancelled
summary: When an event is cancelled, moves all of its sessions to the cancelled stage in one step, by using the Cancel Event button. It works together with the event stage cancelled module. It affects the session list of events that use sessions.

name: website_exclude_sitemap
summary: Lets a website administrator hide chosen public pages from the search engine sitemap by listing their paths or patterns under Website > Configuration > Settings > Sitemap Exclusions. The pages stay public and reachable; only the sitemap file changes. The sitemap is refreshed when pages are added, removed or renamed.

name: website_form_require_legal
summary: Adds a Legal terms acceptance option to website forms, so a visitor must confirm a terms or privacy statement before submitting. The editor can change the wording and link it to a terms page through the text editor. It is set on a form block in the website editor.

name: website_form_require_legal
summary: Adds a Legal terms acceptance option to website forms, so a visitor must confirm a terms or privacy statement before submitting. The editor can change the wording and link it to a terms page through the text editor. It is set on a form block in the website editor.

name: website_forum_subscription
summary: Adds a Subscribe or Unsubscribe button to the website forum cards and the forum panel, so visitors can choose whether to get forum notifications. The button follows each visitor's current subscription state. It appears on the public forum pages.

name: website_geoengine
summary: A technical base for the website map features, adding endpoints that send geographic data from the server to public pages. It also adds an opening hours field to contacts. Nothing appears to visitors until a map feature such as the store locator is added on top of it.

name: website_geoengine_store_locator
summary: Adds a Store Locator map block to the website, showing physical store contacts on a map with a limit on how many results appear before visitors need to filter. Contacts of type store, with tags, are the ones shown. The block is dragged in from the website builder's Geospatial section.

name: website_google_tag_manager
summary: Connects the website to Google Tag Manager by entering the container ID under Website > Configuration > Settings. Marketing tags for analytics and ads can then be managed in Google Tag Manager without changing the website. It affects the tracking code on the public site.

name: website_google_tag_manager
summary: Connects the website to Google Tag Manager by entering the container ID under Website > Configuration > Settings. Marketing tags for analytics and ads can then be managed in Google Tag Manager without changing the website. It affects the tracking code on the public site.

name: website_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Connects a website form to helpdesk so that submitting it creates a helpdesk ticket. Customers can open a support request from the public website without logging in. It is a bridge between the website and helpdesk.

name: website_legal_page
summary: Adds template legal pages, such as privacy policy and terms, to the website, which editors can rewrite in the website builder. It complements the account terms page if the accounting app is installed. The pages are templates and must be checked and adapted before being used.

name: website_legal_page
summary: Adds template legal pages, such as privacy policy and terms, to the website, which editors can rewrite in the website builder. It complements the account terms page if the accounting app is installed. The pages are templates and must be checked and adapted before being used.

name: website_llms
summary: Serves a llms.txt file at the root of the website, giving AI language models a plain-text summary of the company, services and key links. The text is written under Website > Configuration > Settings in the Website Info section, and a default is used if it is left empty. It only changes what that file contains.

name: website_llms
summary: Serves a llms.txt file at the root of the website, giving AI language models a plain-text summary of the company, services and key links. The text is written under Website > Configuration > Settings in the Website Info section, and a default is used if it is left empty. It only changes what that file contains.

name: website_local_font
summary: Lets an administrator upload their own font files, such as OTF, TTF, WOFF or WOFF2, and make them available to every website theme. Without it, Odoo only offers Google fonts for the site. Uploaded fonts can be removed again when no longer needed, and the upload is done from the website editor's Themes section.

name: website_login_page_editable
summary: Makes the login page at /web/login editable in the website builder, so content blocks can be placed above or below the login form. Editors drag a block into the marked areas and save. It changes the public sign-in page, which customers and staff see.

name: website_membership
summary: Publishes a public members directory on the website, listing the association's members with a Google map view. It is a backport from Odoo, so it sits outside the OCA contributor agreement. Members appear once their membership is valid, and the directory is shown on the public website.

name: website_membership_gamification
summary: Shows gamification badges that a member has earned on their entry in the public members directory, and lets staff give a badge to a contact from the contact form. Only contacts linked to a user can receive badges. Badges are set up under Settings > Gamification Tools > Badges, with an optional link and an expiry date for website display.

name: website_membership_gamification
summary: Shows gamification badges that a member has earned on their entry in the public members directory, and lets staff give a badge to a contact from the contact form. Only contacts linked to a user can receive badges. Badges are set up under Settings > Gamification Tools > Badges, with an optional link and an expiry date for website display.

name: website_membership_non_paid_member
summary: Adds members with a draft or confirmed membership invoice, but no recorded payment, to the public members directory. It is useful when payments have not yet been entered in Odoo. The two options are switched on under Settings > General Settings > Website.

name: website_membership_random_order
summary: Shows the public members directory in a random order, with a short disclaimer at the top of the list. It is useful when an association wants no member to always appear first. It changes only the order of the members page.

name: website_membership_random_order
summary: Shows the public members directory in a random order, with a short disclaimer at the top of the list. It is useful when an association wants no member to always appear first. It changes only the order of the members page.

name: website_menu_by_user_status
summary: Controls whether each website menu item is shown to logged-in visitors, to public visitors, or to both. Editors set this on the menu item from the page settings in Website > Configuration. It changes what navigation links each kind of visitor sees.

name: website_menu_by_user_status
summary: Controls whether each website menu item is shown to logged-in visitors, to public visitors, or to both. Editors set this on the menu item in Website > Configuration > Menus, with developer mode on. It changes what navigation links each kind of visitor sees.

name: website_odoo_debranding
summary: Removes the Powered by Odoo link from the footer of the public website. It is on by default, and the switch is under Website > Customize > Brand Promotion. It only changes the public site's footer and no business data.

name: website_odoo_debranding
summary: Removes the Powered by Odoo link from the footer of the public website. It is on by default, and the switch is under Website > Customize > Brand Promotion. It only changes the public site's footer and no business data.

name: website_partner_form
summary: Adds a Website tab to the contact form in the back office, so staff can edit a contact's website description and short description without going to the website. Before, those fields could only be changed through the website itself. It appears on contact forms in Contacts.

name: website_product_configurator
summary: Lets shoppers configure a product step by step on the e-shop, choosing options such as size or colour before adding it to the cart. The configurator steps come from the product configurator setup, and a website template can be chosen for them in settings. Confirmed configurations flow into the sale order.

name: website_product_document_download_counter
summary: Counts how many times each product document, such as a brochure or spec sheet, is downloaded from the website. A download counter appears on the document card in the product area. The count is turned on per document with a Count downloads switch, and only for documents already published on the website.

name: website_recaptcha_v2
summary: A helper module that adds Google reCAPTCHA v2 checking to website forms, so bots are blocked by a tick-box or puzzle challenge. It is set under Settings > Website with a site key and secret key. Other modules use it to place the check on their forms, so it does nothing visible on its own.

name: website_require_login
summary: Restricts chosen website pages, such as /shop, so that only logged-in visitors can open them and everyone else is asked to sign in. Administrators list the paths under Website > Configuration > Authorization required URLs, and child pages are covered too. It affects who can see those public pages.

name: website_require_login
summary: Restricts chosen website pages, such as /shop, so that only logged-in visitors can open them and everyone else is asked to sign in. Administrators list the paths under Website > Configuration > Authorization required URLs, and child pages are covered too. It affects who can see those public pages.

name: website_sale_acquirer_confirm_order
summary: Automatically confirms the sales order when a customer pays with a payment method marked Confirm Order Automatically, so these orders skip manual confirmation. The option is set on the payment method.

name: website_sale_affiliate
summary: Runs an affiliate programme on the online shop, so partners who refer customers get credit for the sales they bring. Affiliates are created under Sales > Affiliate Program, and each affiliate gets a link with a reference code added to shop pages. Sales that follow a tracked visit are linked back to the affiliate.

name: website_sale_attribute_filter_form_submit
summary: Makes shop attribute filters wait for a submit button, so shoppers can tick several filters before the product list updates, instead of the list refreshing after each choice. It is switched on per website from the shop's Configure menu with Manual filters. It works for attribute filters only.

name: website_sale_attribute_filter_form_submit
summary: Makes shop attribute filters apply only when the shopper clicks Submit, instead of applying on every click. Shoppers can pick several filters before seeing results. Only attribute filters are affected, and the option is turned on from the website editor.

name: website_sale_attribute_filter_multiselect
summary: Lets shoppers pick several values of a product attribute at once using checkboxes in the shop filters, such as several colours or sizes. It is turned on by changing an attribute's display type to Multiple Select under Sales > Configuration > Attributes. Range attributes on the product page show like select attributes.

name: website_sale_b2x_alt_price
summary: Shows an alternative price next to the main price in the online shop. On a B2B shop the price with tax is shown alongside the price without tax, and on a B2C shop the reverse. Discounts are included and update when the shopper picks variants, and the display can be turned on or off per website.

name: website_sale_barcode_search
summary: Lets shoppers find products on the website by typing or scanning a product barcode in the shop search box. It needs no setup beyond installing it.

name: website_sale_cart_add_product_xlsx_csv
summary: Adds an import button to an empty website cart, so a customer can upload an Excel or CSV file listing product codes and quantities to fill the cart in one go. A downloadable example file shows the required columns. The button and file size limit are set in Website > Configuration > Settings.

name: website_sale_cart_expire
summary: Cancels shopping carts that have been inactive for a set time, so abandoned carts do not stay open in Sales. The delay is set in Website > Settings under Expire Carts, and an optional countdown timer can be shown to shoppers in the Customize menu. Each sale order keeps an expiry date.

name: website_sale_cart_expire
summary: Automatically cancels online shopping carts that have had no activity after a set delay, which is configured in the website settings. This clears out abandoned carts so they do not stay open as quotes.

name: website_sale_cart_selectable
summary: Adds a per-product switch that turns the Add to Cart button on or off in the online shop, so some products can be shown without being sold online. It is set on the product's eCommerce tab under Website > Products > Products. Products without the button can still be seen on the shop.

name: website_sale_category_breadcrumb
summary: Shows the full chain of parent product categories as breadcrumbs on the shop, along with any extra categories a product belongs to. Installing it and refreshing the page is all that is needed.

name: website_sale_charge_payment_fee
summary: Adds a fee for paying with a chosen online payment method, such as a card surcharge. When a shopper picks that method, a fee line is added to the online order. The fee can be a fixed amount or a percentage and is set on the payment method.

name: website_sale_checkout_country_vat
summary: On checkout, the VAT country code is picked from a country dropdown separately from the VAT number, so the number is checked without a country prefix. Shoppers are guided to choose a country, and the default comes from the website, the public user or the company.

name: website_sale_checkout_skip_payment
summary: Lets selected logged-in customers finish a shop checkout without a payment step. The order becomes a quotation that is emailed to them and set to Quotation Sent. Administrators tick Skip Website Checkout Payment on the customer's sales settings, under Sales > Customers.

name: website_sale_checkout_skip_payment
summary: Lets selected logged-in customers finish a shop checkout without a payment step. The order becomes a quotation that is emailed to them and set to Quotation Sent. Administrators tick Skip Website Checkout Payment on the customer's sales settings, under Sales > Customers.

name: website_sale_checkout_skip_payment
summary: Lets selected logged-in customers finish checkout without a payment step. The quotation is emailed to them and set to Quotation Sent. It is turned on per customer in the sales settings, and a custom message can be shown on the website.

name: website_sale_comparison_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the product comparison pages when prices are hidden on the shop. It extends the hide price feature to comparisons.

name: website_sale_comparison_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices in the product comparison pages on the shop too, in addition to the shop listing where the hide-price module already hides them. It is for shops that show products without prices. It changes only the comparison view.

name: website_sale_comparison_specification_variant
summary: Makes the Specifications section on the shop product page, and on the comparison page, show only the attribute values that match the variant the shopper has selected. Values are limited through the Exclude for setting on each attribute value under Website > Products > Attributes. The section updates when the shopper changes the variant.

name: website_sale_empty_cart
summary: Adds an Empty Cart button to the website shopping cart, so a shopper can remove all products in one click. It can be turned on or off per website in the website settings.

name: website_sale_financial_risk
summary: Adds a credit payment option to the online shop for customers who have enough credit left under their financial risk limit. If the order fits within that credit, it is confirmed automatically. The On credit payment provider must be turned on and published, and credit limits are set as in the financial risk module.

name: website_sale_financial_risk
summary: Adds an On Credit payment method to the online store. Customers with enough remaining credit can place an order paid on credit, and the order is confirmed automatically. Credit limits are the same as those in Financial Risk.

name: website_sale_hide_empty_category
summary: Hides product categories on the shop that have no products, including parent categories whose children are all empty, in the top category bar and elsewhere. The behavior can be switched in the web editor.

name: website_sale_hide_no_variant_attributes
summary: Keeps informational attributes that never create a variant, such as material or care notes, out of the shop's variant selector and out of the rules that grey out options. This stops a shopper seeing an option greyed out because of an attribute they cannot pick. It applies automatically to attributes set to Variant Creation: Never.

name: website_sale_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the online shop, including on the product page, in search results and in recently viewed products. Prices can be hidden for everyone by default or set per customer, and a custom message can replace the price. Buying hidden products is restricted.

name: website_sale_invoice_address
summary: Restores the older behaviour where an online shop order uses the invoice address the customer chose, instead of forcing the order contact as the invoice address. It matters for business customers whose billing contact is different from the buyer. It applies to orders placed through the e-commerce checkout.

name: website_sale_loyalty_page
summary: Publishes active promotions and coupons on a public /promotions page, each with its own banner image and text. Items show in sequence order with promotions listed before coupons, and visitors can click an image to enlarge it. It is set up under Website > eCommerce > Loyalty > Discount & Loyalty, with the Website tab and a publish button.

name: website_sale_loyalty_page
summary: Publishes active promotions and coupons on a public /promotions page, each with its own banner image and text. Items show in sequence order with promotions listed before coupons, and visitors can click an image to enlarge it. It is set up under Website > eCommerce > Loyalty > Discount & Loyalty, with the Website tab and a publish button.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard
summary: Suggests promotions to shoppers when a product in their cart is part of a promotion's rules, and lets them configure and apply the promotion from a wizard on the website. Shoppers can also choose a promotion from the Suggested promotions list in the cart or from the /promotions page. It needs the loyalty and promotion suggestion modules installed.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard
summary: Suggests promotions to shoppers when a product in their cart is part of a promotion's rules, and lets them configure and apply the promotion from a wizard on the website. Shoppers can also choose a promotion from the Suggested promotions list in the cart or from the /promotions page. It needs the loyalty and promotion suggestion modules installed.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard_multi_gift
summary: Extends the cart promotion suggestions to multi-gift promotions, so a shopper sees the offer and can configure and apply it in the wizard on the website. Suggestions appear when a product in the cart matches the multi-product rules. It builds on the suggestion wizard module.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard_multi_gift
summary: Extends the cart promotion suggestions to multi-gift promotions, so a shopper sees the offer and can configure and apply it in the wizard on the website. Suggestions appear when a product in the cart matches the multi-product rules. It builds on the suggestion wizard module.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard_multi_product
summary: Extends the cart promotion suggestions to multi-product promotions, so a shopper who has some of the required products sees the offer and can configure and apply it from the website wizard. It is aimed at buy-several-products deals. It builds on the suggestion wizard module.

name: website_sale_loyalty_suggestion_wizard_multi_product
summary: Extends the cart promotion suggestions to multi-product promotions, so a shopper who has some of the required products sees the offer and can configure and apply it from the website wizard. It is aimed at buy-several-products deals. It builds on the suggestion wizard module.

name: website_sale_menu_partner_top_selling
summary: Adds a My regular products page to the shop, listing the products that a customer's company buys most often, ranked by units sold. It appears as a link in the shop's category menu when the category panel is on. The number of products shown is set under Settings > Website > Products.

name: website_sale_one_time_delivery_address
summary: Lets a reseller's customer enter a one-time delivery address at website checkout, for drop-shipped orders to an end customer. The address is saved as a child contact of the reseller, and the order keeps the reseller as the billing partner. Only customers with Allow Drop-shipping ticked on their contact can use it, and it is useful for EDI-linked orders.

name: website_sale_order_shipping_modification
summary: Lets a portal customer change the delivery address on a quotation they received, directly from their portal page. A button appears on sent quotations and opens the same address picker used at checkout, and the customer can choose an existing address or add a new one. It only offers addresses that are allowed for the order.

name: website_sale_order_shipping_modification
summary: Lets portal customers change the delivery address on a quotation they received, from the Quotations page of the customer portal. They can pick an existing delivery address of their company or add a new one, limited to the allowed addresses.

name: website_sale_order_type
summary: Makes the order type set on a customer's contact carry over to the sale order created when that customer buys on the website. For example, a customer set to a wholesale order type gets wholesale orders from the shop. The order type is set per contact under Sales > Customers.

name: website_sale_order_type
summary: Makes the order type set on a customer's contact carry over to the sale order created when that customer buys on the website. For example, a customer set to a wholesale order type gets wholesale orders from the shop. The order type is set per contact under Sales > Customers.

name: website_sale_order_type
summary: Makes website orders use the sales order type. The order type set on a customer's contact applies to the orders they place online, and a website can have its own order type that takes precedence. It is useful when online orders need a special order type.

name: website_sale_product_accessory
summary: Shows a Suggested accessories block on the shop product page, listing the accessory products set on the product with their prices and links. Shoppers see cross-sell suggestions while they research the main product, not only after adding it to the cart. Accessories are set on the Sales tab of the product.

name: website_sale_product_assortment
summary: Restricts which products appear on the online shop using product assortments. A website filter can hide products that are not in the assortment, or leave them visible. It is configured on the assortment's website availability setting.

name: website_sale_product_assortment
summary: Lets an assortment, which is a chosen list of products, control what appears on the online shop. An assortment can hide products that are not part of it, or be left unrestricted. The website availability option is set on the assortment's filter record.

name: website_sale_product_attachment
summary: Lets a shopper download files such as manuals, spec sheets, firmware or warranties from a product page on the shop. Files are attached under the eCommerce tab of the product, and they must be public. Administrators can also set this from the attachment record in Technical settings.

name: website_sale_product_attachment
summary: Lets a shopper download files such as manuals, spec sheets, firmware or warranties from a product page on the shop. Files are attached under the eCommerce tab of the product, and they must be public. Administrators can also set this from the attachment record in Technical settings.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_category
summary: Groups the shop's attribute filters under their attribute categories, such as Size or Color, as collapsible sections. Categories and whether they show folded are set under Website, eCommerce, Products, Attribute Categories.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_collapse
summary: Lets shop filter groups for product attributes be folded or unfolded, so long attribute lists take up less space on the shop page. Editors switch Collapsible attribute filters on in the website customise menu. Attributes and their values are set under Website > eCommerce > Attributes.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_order
summary: Moves the attribute values that are currently selected to the top of the shop filter list for the pill display type, so the active choices are easy to see. Editors turn on Filters Marked First in the website editor's Style tab. It affects only how the shop filter list is ordered.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_order
summary: Moves the attribute values that are currently selected to the top of each filter list on the shop, so active choices are easy to see. It is turned on from the web editor's Customize tab.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_value_filter_existing
summary: Hides attribute values in shop filters when no product variant uses them. This keeps the filter list to options that actually lead to products.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_value_filter_existing
summary: Hides attribute values in the shop filters when no product variant uses them, so shoppers only see choices that lead to actual products. It is a filter clean-up for attribute values that exist in the database but are not used on any variant. It affects the shop's attribute filter list.

name: website_sale_product_brand
summary: Adds brand filtering to the online shop, with a brand landing page for each brand that shows its header, footer and products. Brands are created under Website > eCommerce > Product brands, and each brand can be published or hidden, and assigned to one website when several exist. It appears on the shop filters and at /shop/brand.

name: website_sale_product_brand
summary: Adds brand filtering to the online shop, so shoppers can narrow products by brand. Brands are created under Website > Settings > Products > Product brands, and a brand can be unpublished to hide it from the shop. It is the earlier version of the brand filter, without the landing pages.

name: website_sale_product_brand
summary: Adds a shop filter by product brand, with brands assigned to products. A brand can be unpublished to hide it from the online store. Brands are managed under Website, eCommerce, Product brands.

name: website_sale_product_description
summary: Adds a separate HTML description for the online store on each product, shown on the shop product page in place of the internal sales description. It is edited on the product form.

name: website_sale_product_detail_attribute_image
summary: Shows attribute images, names and values on the shop product page. An attribute can have a website image and an alternative name, and each value can have one too. An attribute is shown only when it is published on the website.

name: website_sale_product_detail_attribute_image
summary: Shows attribute names, images and values on the shop product page, with an image and a website display name for each attribute. Attributes are set up under Website > Configuration > Products > Attributes, and an attribute appears only when its Publish in website option is on. It changes what shoppers see on the product page.

name: website_sale_product_document_type
summary: Groups the published documents on a product page by their document type, such as manuals or certificates, with a heading above each group. Documents without a type appear under Other documents. It installs automatically once the product document type module and the shop are both installed.

name: website_sale_product_document_type_variant
summary: Keeps product documents grouped by document type on the shop product page when a shopper switches variant, so the grouping does not disappear after the page refreshes. It is a small fix that joins two other modules together. It installs on its own once both are present.

name: website_sale_product_document_variant
summary: Lets a document attached to one product variant, such as a spec sheet for one size, be published on the shop product page. The Documents section changes to show the documents for whichever variant the shopper has selected, without a page reload. A section is hidden when the chosen variant has no published document.

name: website_sale_product_eprel
summary: Shows the EU energy label and product information sheet links from the EPREL database on the online product page. It relies on the EPREL data stored on the product.

name: website_sale_product_image_sample
summary: Shows a thumbnail picture for each option of a product attribute, such as a colour swatch, so shoppers choose a variant by image. It is set by changing an attribute's display type to Product image under Sales > Configuration > Attributes. It changes how variant choices look on the shop product page.

name: website_sale_product_item_cart_custom_qty
summary: Lets shoppers choose a quantity directly on product cards in the shop list and add that amount to the cart, without opening the product page. It is enabled through the web editor's Add to Cart option on product items.

name: website_sale_product_item_cart_custom_qty
summary: Lets a shopper choose a quantity directly on a product tile in the shop and add that amount to the cart with one click, instead of opening the product first. The Add to Cart button on product tiles must be switched on in the shop's website editor under Customize. It changes the shop listing page only.

name: website_sale_product_matrix
summary: Lets shoppers enter quantities for each variant in a grid, called a product matrix, and add them all to the cart from the website. For products with variants, the Order grid entry option is set under Sales Variant Selection on the product. From the shop, a Configure options button opens the grid with the quantities already in the cart.

name: website_sale_product_matrix_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices in the product matrix on the shop, as well as on the listing pages where the hide-price module already hides them. It is for shops that show a grid without prices. It changes only how the matrix looks.

name: website_sale_product_minimal_price
summary: On the shop list, products with variants show a From price based on the lowest variant price, and the list can be sorted by that minimal price. The product page still shows the price of the chosen variant.

name: website_sale_product_minimal_price
summary: For products with variants that have different prices, shows a From price on the shop listing, using the lowest variant price. It also lets the shop sort products by that minimum price. Shops that use several price lists must turn on Multiple Prices per Product under Website > Configuration > Settings > Shop - Products.

name: website_sale_product_minimal_price_hide_price
summary: Hides the price scale shown on the product page when the website is set to hide prices. It makes the minimal price module work with the hide price module. It changes only what shoppers see on product pages where prices are hidden.

name: website_sale_product_multi_website
summary: Lets one product be published on several chosen websites instead of only one, while others are left out. Products are set on the Website fields of the product form, and the publication and access rules then follow those websites. It is for multi-website setups that share one catalogue.

name: website_sale_product_pack
summary: Makes product packs, which bundle several components under one product, work properly in the online shop. In the cart, the components show under the main pack line and cannot be edited on their own, and removing the pack removes them too. The resulting quotation matches what the back office would produce.

name: website_sale_product_pack
summary: Makes product packs, which bundle several components under one product, work properly in the online shop. In the cart, the components show under the main pack line and cannot be edited on their own, and removing the pack removes them too. The resulting quotation matches what the back office would produce.

name: website_sale_product_reference_displayed
summary: Shows the internal product reference together with the product name on shop pages, for example as [CODE] Product name. It can be switched on or off for each page and website through the Product Reference option in the website editor's Customize menu. It changes only how product names look on the shop.

name: website_sale_product_reference_displayed
summary: Shows products in the shop with their internal reference included in the name, such as an SKU, so shoppers can see product codes on listings. It can be turned on or off per template and per website.

name: website_sale_product_reference_displayed
summary: Shows the internal product reference with the product name on shop pages, and in the website product search results. It can be switched on or off per page through the Product Reference option in the website editor. It keeps search results consistent with the shop listing.

name: website_sale_product_sort
summary: Sets a default sort order for the shop product list, such as by price or name, per website. Other modules can add extra sort options.

name: website_sale_quick_checkout
summary: Adds a Payment button next to the main confirm button on the Order, Address and Extra Info checkout steps, so a returning customer can jump straight to payment. The button does not appear on the payment page itself. Nothing needs setting up once installed.

name: website_sale_require_legal
