summary: Requires a shopper to accept the legal terms before a new delivery or invoice address is saved on the web shop. Acceptance is recorded as a note on the customer and, for online payments, on the sale order. Legal pages must be set up first, and the option is switched on in the address page's Customize menu.

name: website_sale_require_legal
summary: Requires shoppers to accept legal terms before entering a new address at checkout, and logs the acceptance on the customer and on the sales order. The terms come from the legal pages set up on the website. It is turned on from the web editor.

name: website_sale_require_legal
summary: Requires a shopper to accept the legal terms before a new delivery or invoice address is saved on the web shop. Acceptance is recorded as a note on the customer and, for online payments, on the sale order. Legal pages must be set up first, and the option is switched on in the address page's Customize menu.

name: website_sale_resource_booking
summary: Lets customers sell resource bookings, such as a room or equipment slot, through the online shop, and pre-book a slot before paying. Pre-bookings can be set to expire if not paid within a timeout set on the product's Resource booking timeout field. It is for businesses that rent or reserve resources.

name: website_sale_secondary_unit
summary: Lets online customers buy products in secondary units of measure, such as boxes or pallets, as well as the base unit. Secondary units are set on the product's website page and appear as a choice in the shop. The base unit can be disabled so that only secondary units can be bought.

name: website_sale_secondary_unit
summary: Lets shoppers buy a product in its own secondary units, such as a box or a pallet, instead of the base unit. Secondary units are defined per product, and the chosen ones appear next to the quantity selector on the shop page. Both quantities are kept on the sale order line, and the units are set up under Inventory when that setting is on.

name: website_sale_secondary_unit_product_matrix
summary: Lets shoppers enter quantities in a product matrix on the shop, using the secondary units defined on each product. It combines the matrix ordering and secondary unit modules, so a grid can order by box or pallet. The matrix is switched on through the Order grid entry option on the product.

name: website_sale_slides_multi_qty
summary: Lets a customer buy several seats in an online course at once, and sends them an invitation link by email so colleagues can join without a separate order. The number of participants is capped at the number of courses bought. Anonymous invitees enter their details, and the course is set to On Payment enrolment.

name: website_sale_slides_order_line_link
summary: Links the sale order line to the course participation record when an eLearning course is sold on the website, so you can trace which sale produced which enrolment. It adds no screens of its own, and the link is visible on the order line and the participation record. It is a base for other eLearning sales modules.

name: website_sale_slides_portal
summary: Adds a My courses page to the customer portal, listing the courses that the customer's company bought through the website. It appears once a course sales order is confirmed and the customer logs in. It is used for eLearning courses bought with several seats.

name: website_sale_slides_survey_multi_qty
summary: Lets each participant in a multi-seat course sit their own certification survey, with each attempt linked to that person's course participation. Participants who share one purchaser can therefore keep their certificates separate. It applies to course surveys in the eLearning area.

name: website_sale_stock_available
summary: Makes the online shop judge stock by the Available quantity instead of the Free to Use quantity, and stops shoppers buying more than is available when a product is set to prevent sales without stock. Before, the shop used the forecast, but that changed in version 15. It is set on the product's Sales tab and in Inventory settings.

name: website_sale_stock_available
summary: Makes the online shop judge stock by the Available quantity, which includes incoming moves, instead of the Free to Use quantity. Shoppers cannot buy more than is available for products set to prevent sales without stock. It is set on the product's Sales tab, and it changes the shop's stock messages.

name: website_sale_stock_available
summary: Uses the Available quantity instead of the Free to Use quantity for stock messages and cart limits on the shop, for products set to prevent sales when out of stock. Shoppers cannot buy more than the available quantity.

name: website_sale_stock_list_preview
summary: Shows stock availability on product cards in the shop list, so shoppers see stock status before opening a product. It appears when the Add to Cart option is turned on in the web editor.

name: website_sale_stock_list_preview
summary: Shows stock information on product tiles in the shop listing, so shoppers see availability before opening a product. It is switched on with the Add to Cart view option in the shop's Customize menu, and per product through the Availability setting. It changes the shop listing page only.

name: website_sale_stock_picking_policy
summary: Lets a customer choose at checkout whether their deliverable items should ship together in one shipment or as available. A Shipping Policy section appears when the cart has physical products, and the estimated delivery date updates when the choice changes. It writes the picking policy onto the cart's sale order.

name: website_sale_stock_product_matrix
summary: Shows the stock available for each variant in the product matrix when a shopper adds items from the shop. It is switched on per storable product by enabling the option to display stock. It changes only the add-to-cart grid for that product.

name: website_sale_stock_provisioning_date
summary: Shows a Next provisioning date on a product page in the shop when the product is out of stock, so shoppers know when it will be back. The date is the nearest future supply date. It is turned on per product with Show Next Provisioning Date in the eCommerce tab.

name: website_sale_stock_provisioning_date
summary: Shows the next expected restock date on the product page for products that are out of stock. It is turned on per product in the eCommerce tab of the product form.

name: website_sale_suggest_create_account
summary: Suggests that shoppers log in or create an account in the cart without forcing them to, and keeps the Process Checkout button unhighlighted so guest checkout still works. This avoids duplicate customer records from one-time buyers.

name: website_sale_suggest_create_account
summary: Suggests that a guest buyer log in or create an account at the cart, without forcing it, so guest checkout is still possible. The Process Checkout button is not highlighted, which nudges visitors toward signing in. It avoids duplicate contacts while not blocking one-time buyers.

name: website_sale_tax_selection
summary: Lets each customer's company choose whether shop prices show tax excluded or tax included, instead of one setting for the whole website. The choice is set on the Website Tax Display field under the customer's contact in the sales section. If nothing is set, the website's standard tax display applies.

name: website_sale_tax_toggle
summary: Adds a tax toggle button to the shop so shoppers can view prices with or without tax. The starting setting is chosen per website under Website > Configuration, with the Toggle default tax option. It affects only how prices are displayed to visitors on the shop.

name: website_sale_tax_toggle
summary: Adds a toggle on the shop so shoppers can switch prices between tax included and tax excluded. The default is set per website in the website settings.

name: website_sale_uom_continuous
summary: Lets customers buy fractional amounts of products sold by weight, length or volume, such as 2.5 kg or 3 metres, on the online shop. Products sold in whole units still only accept whole numbers. The cart count treats each continuous line as one item, and the product page, configurator, cart and checkout all use the decimals.

name: website_sale_variant_extra_fields
summary: Lets a website manager show product variant fields, and more kinds of fields such as numbers, dates, dropdowns and linked records, in the extra fields area of the shop product page. A variant field value updates live when the shopper picks another combination. It is configured under Website > Configuration > Settings with the Product Page Extra Fields setting.

name: website_sale_vat_required
summary: Makes the VAT number a required field on the checkout form, and rejects a missing or invalid VAT with an error. It suits B2B shops that need tax numbers on every order.

name: website_sale_vat_required
summary: Makes the VAT number field required on the online shop checkout form, and rejects a VAT number that is not valid. A shopper who leaves it blank or types a wrong number gets an error and cannot continue. It affects only the website checkout for business buyers.

name: website_sale_wishlist_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices in the wishlist pages as well as on the shop, for shops that do not show prices. It extends the hide-price module, which only covers the main shop pages. It changes what shoppers see on their wishlist.

name: website_sale_wishlist_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the wishlist pages when prices are hidden on the shop. It extends the hide price feature to wishlists.

name: website_sale_wishlist_keep
summary: Brings back the option to add a product to the cart while keeping it on the wishlist, and keeps that option ticked after the shopper leaves the wishlist. Odoo 19 removed the tick box. It is switched on in the wishlist page's Style tab under Keep items on wishlist.

name: website_sale_wishlist_keep
summary: Sets the Keep items on wishlist option to be ticked by default on the wishlist page, so products stay on the wishlist when a shopper adds them to the cart. The option is switched on in the website's Customize menu. It changes only the wishlist page's default setting.

name: website_sale_wishlist_keep
summary: Keeps the option Add to cart but keep it in my wishlist checked, so it stays selected after the shopper leaves the wishlist. It is turned on from the web editor's Customize tab.

name: website_search_header
summary: Adds a search bar to the website header. On desktop, visitors can show or hide it, and on mobile the search box is always visible. It helps visitors find pages and products without opening a separate search page.

name: website_select2
summary: Makes dropdown lists on the website and the customer portal searchable, so a visitor can type to narrow a long list, such as the country list on the My Account page. Dropdowns can be left out or forced on with CSS classes. It changes how select boxes behave for visitors.

name: website_slides_attendees_completed_time
summary: Adds a Completed Time field, in hours, to each attendee of an eLearning course. It totals the time of the slides each attendee has completed, which gives a view of effort as well as progress. It appears in the attendee views of courses.

name: website_snippet_big_button
summary: Adds a Big Buttons block to the website builder, with two large buttons, such as like and not like, whose links can be changed by clicking on them. It is placed from the Blocks panel under the Content category. It only adds content to pages where an editor puts it.

name: website_snippet_country_dropdown
summary: A developer building block that provides a country dropdown with a text field, to be used inside HTML forms on the website. Developers inherit it to build their own forms, and it has no visible effect on its own. Business users see it only in forms that have been built with it.

name: website_snippet_country_dropdown
summary: A developer building block that provides a country dropdown with a text field, to be used inside HTML forms on the website. Developers inherit it to build their own forms, and it has no visible effect on its own. Business users see it only in forms that have been built with it.

name: website_snippet_country_phone_code_dropdown
summary: A developer building block that adds a country dropdown which fills in the matching phone dialling code in a text field, for use in website forms. Developers inherit it to build their own forms. Business users only see it in forms that have been built with it.

name: website_snippet_marginless_gallery
summary: Adds a Marginless Gallery block to the website builder, which shows photos in a grid with no gaps between them. It is found under the Images category of the Blocks panel. It only changes pages where an editor adds the block.

name: website_snippet_product_category
summary: Adds a Product Category block to the website builder that shows the shop's product categories, with their images, as a scrollable tree. Categories are chosen for the block in eCommerce > eCommerce Categories. It appears on any web page where an editor drags the block in.

name: website_snippet_product_category
summary: Adds a Product Category block to the website builder that shows the shop's product categories, with their images, as a scrollable tree. A category appears only when it and its parent categories are enabled for the block, and it can be limited to chosen websites. Categories are set under website > eCommerce > eCommerce Categories.

name: website_snippet_product_category
summary: Adds a Product Category block to the website builder that shows selected eCommerce categories as a scrolling strip with images. Categories are chosen individually and can optionally be limited to certain websites.

name: website_social_media_link
summary: Shows the social media links, such as Facebook and LinkedIn, on the website's settings form in the back office, so they can be edited after the website is created. Before, changing them meant editing the company record, which was not copied through. It affects the links the website displays.

name: website_user_login_redirect_custom
summary: Sends website and portal users to a custom page after they log in or sign up, such as a welcome page or the shop. It is switched on under Website > Configuration > Settings in the Privacy section, where the relative address is also entered. It applies to every login and new signup on the site.

name: website_whatsapp
summary: Adds a floating WhatsApp button to the website, so visitors can start a chat with the company in one tap. The WhatsApp number, default message and link tracking are set in Website > Configuration > Settings, under Use Whatsapp. It is visible on every public page once switched on.

name: website_whatsapp
summary: Adds a floating WhatsApp button to the website, so visitors can start a chat with the company in one tap. The WhatsApp number, default message and link tracking are set in Website > Configuration > Settings, under Use Whatsapp. It is visible on every public page once switched on.
